30\. The hermits said- О monster! Listen to the religions of men etc. residing in the seven continents of this earth.

## \|\| 11.31 \|\|

*yojanānāṃ pramāṇeṇana pañcāśatkoṭirāyatā \|*  
*jalopari mahīyaṃ hi naurivāste sarijjale \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. This earth extended as much as fifty crore yojana has existed on the water as a boat on the river.

## \|\| 11.32 \|\|

*tasyopari ca deveśo brahma śaulendramuttamam \|*  
*karṇikākāramatyuccaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sattma \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О gentleman! Lord Brahma has established a hypotenuse shaped highest mountain (the king of mountain) above it.

## \|\| 11.33 \|\|

*tasyemāṃ nirmame puṇyāṃ prajāṃ devaścaturdiśam \|*  
*sthānāni dvīpasaṃjñāni kṛtavāṃśca prajāpatiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Lord Brahma then created the holy subject thereupon and everywhere. Thus, the places called islands were also created.

## \|\| 11.34 \|\|

*tatra madhye ca kṛtavāñjambūdvīpamiti śrutam \|*  
*tallakṣaṃ yojanānāṃ ca pramāṇena nigadyate \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Jambudvipa at the middle of earth was then created. Its expanse is said to be about one lakh yojana.

## \|\| 11.35 \|\|

*tato jalanidhī raudro bāhyato dviguṇaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tasyāpi dviguṇaḥ plakṣo bāhyataḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. There is a gigantic ocean, just double the measurement of the earth around the land so created. There exists an island called Salmali just double in expanse than this great ocean.

## \|\| 11.36 \|\|

*tatastvikṣurasodaśca bāhyato valayāsṛtiḥ \|*  
*dviguṇaḥ śālmalidvīpo dviguṇo 'sya mahodadheḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. There is an ocean containing care-juice outside that island. Its measurement is just double that of Salmali.

## \|\| 11.37 \|\|

*surodo dviguṇastasya tasmācca dviguṇaḥ kuśaḥ \|*  
*ghṛtodo dviguṇaścaiva kuśadvīpāt prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The ocean containing liquor is double in expanse than it and its double in measurement is an island called Kusadvipa. The ocean containing ghee is double in measurement than it.

## \|\| 11.38 \|\|

*ghṛtodād dviguṇaḥ proktaḥ krauñcadvīpo niśācara \|*  
*tato 'pi dviguṇaḥ proktaḥ samudro dadhisaṃjñitaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О monster! Kraunca-dvipa is double in measurement than Ghrtasagara and Dadhi ocean is double than it.

## \|\| 11.39 \|\|

*samudrād dviguṇaḥ śākaḥ śākād dugdhābdhiruttamaḥ \|*  
*dviguṇaḥ saṃsthito yatra śeṣaparyaṅkago hariḥ \|*  
*ete ca dviguṇāḥ sarve parasparamapi sthitāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Sakadvipa is just double than Dadhi-sagara. Further, Ksirasagara is double than Sakadvipa on which Sri Hari is existed.

## \|\| 11.40 \|\|

*catvāriṃśadimāḥ koṭyo lakṣāśca navatiḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*yojanānāṃ rākṣasendra pañca cāti suvustṛtāḥ \|*  
*jambūdvīpāt samārabhya yāvatkṣīrābdhirantataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О demon king! The expanse from Jambudvipa to Ksirasagara is thus measured to be about forty crore ninety lakh fire yojana.

## \|\| 11.41-42 \|\|

*tasmācca puṣkaradvīpaḥ svādūdastadanantaram \|*  
*koṭyaścatasro lakṣāṇāṃ dvipañcāśacca rākṣasa \|\| 41 \|\|*

*puṣkaradvīpamāno 'yaṃ tāvadeva tathodadhiḥ \|*  
*lakṣamaṇḍakaṭāhena samantādibhipūritam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. О monster! There fall then Puskara-dvipa and an ocean of drinking water. Puskara-dvipa is measured about four crore fifty two lakh yojana. Then there falls a sea of the same measurement. Its expanse about one lakh yojana is filled by Arujakataha from four sides.

## \|\| 11.43-44 \|\|

*evaṃ dvīpāstvime sapta pṛthagdharmāḥ pṛthakkriyāḥ \|*  
*gadiṣyāmastava vayaṃ śṛmuṣva tvaṃ niśācara \|\| 43 \|\|*

*plakṣādiṣu narā vīra ye vasanti sanātanāḥ \|*  
*śākānteṣu na teṣvasti yugāvasthā kathañcana \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. Thus, these seven continents are consisting of separate religious and activities (deeds). О monster! We here with describe them. Listen to it carefully. О Brave, the Sanatana Purusa who resides in the continents falling from Plaksa to Saka has no provision of era (yuga).

## \|\| 11.45 \|\|

*modante devavatteṣāṃ dharmo divya udāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*kalpānte pralayasteṣāṃ nigadyeta mahābhuja \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О chivalrous! They enjoy like gods. Their religion is called divine religion. It is said that there takes place Pralaya (devastation) when a Kalpa is over.

## \|\| 11.46 \|\|

*ye janāḥ puṣkaradvīpe vasante raudradarśane \|*  
*paiśācamāśritā dharmaṃ karmānte te vināśinaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The people living in Puskara-dvipa having a dreadful look, are resorted to the Paisacika religion. They meet to destruction when a Karma is over.

## \|\| 11.47 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*kimarthaṃ puṣkadvīpo bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*durdarśaḥ śaucarahito ghoraḥ karmāntanāśakṛt \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Sukesi said- Why have you described Puskara-dvipa as dreadful, impure, gross and meeting to destruction when a Karma is over?

## \|\| 11.48 \|\|

*tasmin niśācara dvīpe narakāḥ santi dāruṇāḥ \|*  
*rauravādyāstato raudraḥ puṣkaro ghoradarśanaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The hermits said- "O monster! Raurava etc. dreadful hells have existed in that island. This is the reason why it looks dreadful.

## \|\| 11.49 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*kiyantyetāni raudrāṇi narakāṇi tapodhanaḥ \|*  
*kiyanmātrāṇi mārgeṇa kā ca teṣu svarūpatā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Sukesi said- О ascetics! How many are those dreadful hells? How much is there route? How do they look like?

## \|\| 11.50 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva rākṣasaśreṣṭha pramāṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ rauravādīnāṃ saṃkhyā yā tvekaviṃśatiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The hermits said- О demon king! Listen to the characteristics and expanse of all those Raurava etc. hells. They are twenty one in number.

## \|\| 11.51 \|\|

*dve sahasre yojanānāṃ jvalitāṅgāravistṛte \|*  
*rauravo nāma narakaḥ prathamaḥ parikīrttitaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The first hell is called Raurava. It is two thousand yojana in expanse and there blazes fire everywhere.

## \|\| 11.52 \|\|

*taptatāmramayī bhūmiradhastādvāhnitāpitā \|*  
*dvitīyo dvigustasmānmahāraurava ucyate \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The second hell called Maharaurava is just double in measurement than it. Its land is made up of burning copper. Fire is ignited every time beneath the surface.

## \|\| 11.53 \|\|

*tato 'pi dviḥsthitaścānyastamisro narakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*andhatāmisrako nāma caturtho dvigumaḥ paraḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Tamistra hell is just double in expanse than it. Andhatamistra is double than Tamistra in expanse. It is the fourth in the series.

## \|\| 11.54 \|\|

*tatastu kālacakreti pañcamaḥ parigīyate \|*  
*apratiṣṭhaṃ ca narakaṃ ghaṭīyantraṃ ca saptamam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The fifth in the series is the hell called Kalacakra. Apratistha is the sixth and Ghatiyantra is seventh in tliis series of hells.

## \|\| 11.55 \|\|

*asipatravanaṃ cānyatsahasrāṇi dvisaptatiḥ \|*  
*yojanānāṃ parikhyātamaṣṭamaṃ narakottamam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The eighth hell called Asi-patra forest is seventy two thousand yojana in expanse.

## \|\| 11.56 \|\|

*namakaṃ taptakumbhaṃ ca daśamaṃ kūṭaśālmaliḥ \|*  
*karapatrastathaivoktastathānyaḥ śvānabhojanaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The ninth is Taptakumbha, Kutasalamali; the tenth, Karapatra eleventh and Svanabhojana is the twelfth hell in this series.

## \|\| 11.57 \|\|

*saṃdaṃśo lohapiṇḍaśca karambhasikatā tathā \|*  
*ghorā kṣāranadī cānyā tathānyaḥ kṛmibhojanaḥ \|*  
*tathāṣṭādaśamī proktā ghorā vaitaraṇī nadī \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. There fall thereafter Sandamsa, Lohapinda, Karambhasikata, dreadful alkali river, Krmibhojana and the eighteenth hell is called Vaitarani river respectively.

## \|\| 11.58 \|\|

*tathāparaḥ śoṇitapūyabhojanaḥ kṣurāgradhāro niśitaśca cakrakaḥ \|*  
*saṃśoṣaṇo nāma tathāpyanantaḥ proktāstavaite narakāḥ sukeśin \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Then there fall Sonitapuyabhojana, Ksuragradhara, Nisita, Cakraka and Samsosana hells. These are endless hells. О Sukesi! Thus, description on these hells has been made before you.

## Chapter 12. Description of fruits of Karman

## \|\| 12.1 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*karmaṇā narakānetān kena gacchanti vai katham \|*  
*etad vadantu viprendrāḥ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sukesi said- О Brahmins! Please, tell that how the people fall and on account of what kind of deeds they perform? I am curious to listen to it all from you.

## \|\| 12.2 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*karmaṇā yena yeneha yānti śālakaṭaṅkaṭa \|*  
*svakarmaphalabhogārthaṃ narakān me śṛṇuṣva tān \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The hermits said- О Salakatamkata (monster)! Listen to the deeds performed by the people that lead them to fall in these hells.

## \|\| 12.3-4 \|\|

*vedavevadvijātīnāṃ yairnindā satataṃ kṛtā \|*  
*ye purāṇetihāsārthān nābhinandanti pāpinaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kurunindākarā ye ca sakhavighnakarāśca ye \|*  
*dāturnivārakāye ca teṣu te nipatanti hi \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The people doing continuous criticism of the Veda, gods and Dvijatis, showing dishonour to the practical exercise of the essence contemplated in the Purana and History, critics to their teachers, the people putting hurdles on yajna and the sinners who resist the donor from falling into those hells.

## \|\| 12.5-6 \|\|

*suhṛddampatisodaryasvāmibhṛtyapitāsutān \|*  
*yājyopādhyāyayoryaiśca kṛto bhedo 'dhamairmithaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kanyāmekasya dattvā ca dadatyanyasya ye 'dhamāḥ \|*  
*karapatreṇa pāṭyante te dvidhā yamakiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The mean people who create mutual discrimination between friends, couple, siblings, devotees, father and son, priest and their clients as also who promise to first give their daughters to a man but thereafter commit breach of trust by solemnising their marriage with other men are split into two parts by saw (Karapatra) by the executives of Yama.

## \|\| 12.7 \|\|

*paropatāpajanakāścandanośīrahāriṇaḥ \|*  
*bālavyajanaharttāraḥ karambhasikatāśritāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The people putting others in pain, theft scandal and uslra (khasa), snatcher of wings made fans (cavara) fall in Karambhasikata hell.

## \|\| 12.8 \|\|

*nimantrito 'nyato bhuṅkte śrāddhe daive sapaitṛke \|*  
*sa dvidhā kṛṣyate mūḍhastīkṣṇatuṇḍaiḥ khagottamaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The fools invited to sraddha for Pitf but eat other places are split into two parts of their bodies by the predator birds of large bodies through their sharp beak.

## \|\| 12.9 \|\|

*marmāṇi yastu sādhūnāṃ tudan vāgbhirnikṛntati \|*  
*tasyopari tudantastu tuṇḍaistiṣṭhanti pattriṇaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The man who blows sharply on the heart of gentlemen by his harsh words, several birds with their sharp beaks sit on his body and peck hard white piercing the flesh therefrom.

## \|\| 12.10 \|\|

*yaḥ karoti ca paiśunyaṃ sādhūnāmanyathāmatiḥ \|*  
*vajratuṇḍanakhā jihvāmākarṣante 'sya vāyasāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The man who behaves like an animal with the gentlemen, his tongue is pierced by the crows having beaks like a thunderbolt and sharp nails.

## \|\| 12.11 \|\|

*mātāpitṛgurūṇāṃ ca ye 'vajñāṃ cakruruddhatāḥ \|*  
*majjante pūyavimmūtre tpratiṣṭhe hyadhosukhāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The people showing disobedience to their parents and teachers are drowned reverse (i.e. legs up while head downside) in Apratistha hell filled with urine, night-soil, pus etc.

## \|\| 12.12-13 \|\|

*devatātithibhūteṣu bhṛtyeṣvabhyāgateṣu ca \|*  
*abhuktavatsu ye 'śnanti bālapitragnimātṛṣu \|\| 12 \|\|*

*duṣṭacāsṛkpūyaniryāsaṃ bhuñjate tvadhamā ime \|*  
*sūcīmukhāśca jāyante kṣudhārttā girivigrahāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The mean people who eat by keeping hungry the gods, guests, other creatures, slaves, beggars, child, parents and the fire get gigantic mountain-like body but middle like a narrow mouth, starve and receive only the contaminated blood with pus as food to survive.

## \|\| 12.14 \|\|

*ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭānāṃ viṣamaṃ bhojayanti ye \|*  
*viḍbhojanaṃ rākṣasendra narakaṃ te vrajanti ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О demon king! The people who distribute food with partiality to the persons seated in a row for a meal, fall into the hell called Vidbhojana.

## \|\| 12.15 \|\|

*ekasārthaprayātaṃ ye paśyantaścārthinaṃ narāḥ \|*  
*asaṃvibhajya bhuñjanti te yānti śleṣmabhojanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The people who do not share their food with a partner to any journey even while he is desirous, fall into the hell called Slesmabhojana.

## \|\| 12.16 \|\|

*gobrāhṇaṇāgnayaḥ spṛṣṭā yairucchiṣṭaiḥ kṣapācara \|*  
*kṣipyante hi karāsteṣāṃ taptasumbhe sudāruṇe \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О monster! The hands that touch a cow, Brahmin and fire at the state when impurity stuck to them, are forcibly thrown into the hot-pitcher.

## \|\| 12.17 \|\|

*sūryendutārakā dṛṣṭā yairucchiṣṭaiśca kāmataḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ netragato vahnirdhamyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The eyes that look at the sun, moon and constellation in the state when the body is anyway impure, are burnt by Yama's executives by putting fire in them.

## \|\| 12.18-19 \|\|

*mitrajāyātha jananī jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitā svasā \|*  
*jāmayo guravo vṛddhā yaiḥ saṃspṛṣṭāḥ padā nṛbhiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*baddhāṅghrayaste vigaḍairlohairvāhnipratāpitaiḥ \|*  
*kṣipyante raurave ghore hyājānuparidāhinaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. The feet of those people are tied with the burning (hot) iron bar and thrown into Raurava hell, where they bum up to the thighs, who have touched a friend's wife, mother, elder brother, father, sister, daughter, teacher and the old age people.

## \|\| 12.20 \|\|

*pāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ māṃsaṃ vṛthā bhuktāni yairnaraiḥ \|*  
*teṣāmayoguḍāstaptāḥ kṣipyante vadane 'dbhutāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Those who eat sweet meat (payasa), Krsara and meat voluntarily without purpose lying there for offering it to gods, receive forcibly a burning rod in their mouth in the hell.

## \|\| 12.21-22 \|\|

*gurudevadvijātīnāṃ vedānāṃ ca narādhamaiḥ \|*  
*nindā niśāmitā yaistu pāpānāmiti kurvatām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ lohamayāḥ kīlā vahnivarṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*śravaṇeṣu nikhanyante dharmarājasya kiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Hot iron nails are hammered frequently into the ears of mean people who listen to wrong things about their teacher, gods, Brahmins and the Vedas. It is done by the executives of Dharmaraja.

## \|\| 12.23-24 \|\|

*prapādevakulālāmān vipraveśmasabhāmaṭhān \|*  
*kūpavāpītaḍāgāṃśca bhaṅktvā vidhvaṃsayanti ye \|\| 23 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ carma dehataḥ kriyate pṛthak \|*  
*karttikābhiḥ sutīkṣṇībhiḥ suraudrairyamakiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The skin of the body is decorticated by using sharp knives in spite of cries made by mean people who destroy Prapa, temple, garden, Brahmin's home, convent, conference, well, pond and flower garden. All this is done cruelly by Yama's servants.

## \|\| 12.25 \|\|

*gobrāhmaṇārkamagniṃ ca ye vai mehanti mānavāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ gudeva cāntrāṇi viniḥkṛntanti vāyasāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The people who discharge urine and night- soil at the presence of a cow, Brahmin, sun and fire receive so severe a punishment that the cows will enjoy the flesh of their intestine by extracting it through the anus out.

## \|\| 12.26 \|\|

*svapoṣaṇaparo yastu parityajati mānavaḥ \|*  
*putrabhṛtyakalatrādibandhuvargamakiñcanam \|*  
*durbhikṣe saṃbhrame cāpi sa śvabhojye nipātyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The man who eats alone leaving his poor son, servant and wife including siblings who starve from thrown into the hell called Svabhojana.

## \|\| 12.27 \|\|

*śaraṇāgataṃ ye tyajanti ye ca bandhanapālakāḥ \|*  
*patanti yantrapīḍe te tāḍya mānāstu kiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The people who lift up the protection cover from the man sheltered and a guard who watches over a prison are punished severely and thrown into Yantra-pida hell.

## \|\| 12.28 \|\|

*kleśayanti hi viprādīn ye hyakarmasu pāpinaḥ \|*  
*te piṣyante śilāpeṣe śoṣyanate 'pi ca śoṣakaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The sinners causing pain to Brahmins by nuisance committed are ground on the boulders and the fire sucks their bodies until these turn into ashes.

## \|\| 12.29 \|\|

*nyāsāpahāriṇaḥ pāpā badhyante nigaḍairapi \|*  
*śrutkṣāmāḥ śuṣkatālvoṣṭhāḥ pātyante vṛścikāśane \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The people misappropriating the trust fund are tied with hot iron bars, are left for starving and without water, to drink. Then they are thrown into Vrscikasana hell.

## \|\| 12.30 \|\|

*parvamaithuninaḥ pāpāḥ paradāraratāśca ye \|*  
*te vahnitaptāṃ kūṭāgrāmāliṅgante ca śālmalīm \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The sinners doing coition on auspicious days and who do intercourse with other's wife have to embrace Salmali with hot nails.

## \|\| 12.31 \|\|

*upādhyāyamadhaḥkṛtya yairadhītaṃ dvijādhamaiḥ \|*  
*teṣāmadhyāpako yaśca sa śilāṃ śirasā vahet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The dvijas and their teachers have to bear a burden of boulders who do study from preceptors but offer them a seat lower than their own.

## \|\| 12.32 \|\|

*mūtraśleṣmapurīṣāṇi yairutsṛṣṭāni vāriṇi \|*  
*te pātyante ca viṇmūtre durgandhe pūyapūrite \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The rudes discharging urine, phlegm and night-soil on water are thrown in Vinmutra hell filled with the stench night-soil and pus.

## \|\| 12.33 \|\|

*śrāddhātitheyamanyonyaṃ yairbhuktaṃ bhuvi mānavaiḥ \|*  
*parasparaṃ bhakṣayante māṃsāni svāni bāliśāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The fools who eat themselves the food offered for guests on the occasion of sraddha have to eat the flesh of each other after death and on rebirth.

## \|\| 12.34 \|\|

*vedavahnigurutyāgī bhāryāpitrostathaiva ca\| giriśṛḍgādadhaḥpātaṃ pātyante yamakiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Those persons are thrown down from the peak of mountain who abandon the Vedas, fire, teacher, wife, father and mothet.

## \|\| 12.35 \|\|

*punarbhūpatayo ye ca kanyāvidhvaṃsakāśca ye \|*  
*tadgarbhaśrāddhabhug yaśca kṛmīnbhakṣetpipīlikāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The people who accept food offered on the occasions of sraddha by the person married to a widow, involved in coition with an unmarried girl and by the children so bom are compelled to eat insects and ants.

## \|\| 12.36 \|\|

*cāṇḍālādantyajādvāpi pratigṛhṇāti dakṣiṇām \|*  
*yājako yajamānaśca so 'smāntaḥ sthūlakīṭakaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The priests and their clients receiving Daksina from Candala and Antyajas have to be bom as heavy insects living in caves in their re-birth.

## \|\| 12.37 \|\|

*pṛṣṭhamāṃsāśino mūḍhāstathaivotkocajīvinaḥ \|*  
*kṣipyante vṛkabhakṣe te narake rajanīcara \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О monster! The sneaking and bribe accepting mdes are thrown into the hell called Vrkabhaksa.

## \|\| 12.38-40 \|\|

*svarṇasteyī ca brahmaghnaḥ surāpo gurulalpagaḥ \|*  
*tathā gobhūmiharttaro gostrībālahanāśca ye \|\| 38 \|\|*

*eta narā dvijā ye ca goṣu vikrayiṇastathā \|*  
*somavikrayiṇo ye ca vedavikrayiṇastathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kūṭasabhyāstvaśaucāśca nityanaimittanāśakāḥ \|*  
*kūṭasākṣyapradā ye ca te mahāraurave sthitāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. The people committing loot of gold, murderer of Brahmin, drunkard, cohabiting with teacher's wife, snatcher of cow and the land, torturers to women and children, vendor of soma and Veda, diplomat, untidy, nonabiding by routine and dvijas who submit forged evidence have to dwell in the hell called Maharaurava.

## \|\| 12.41-42 \|\|

*daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi tāvat tāmisrake sthitāḥ \|*  
*tāvaccaivāndhatāmisre asipatravane tataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tāvaccaiva ghaṭīyantre taptakumbhe tataḥ param \|*  
*prapāto bhavate teṣāṃ yairidaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The above-said sinners have to live ten thousand years in each hell known as Tamistra, Andhatamistra, Asipatravana, Ghat iyantra and Taptakumbha one after another in a systematic manner.

## \|\| 12.43 \|\|

*ye tvete narakā raudrā rauravādyāstavoditāḥ \|*  
*te sarve kramaśaḥ proktāḥ kṛtaghne lokanindite \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The people ungrateful and condemned by the public are thrown by turns in all dreadful Raurava hells, about which I have already told you.

## \|\| 12.44 \|\|

*yathā surāṇāṃ pravaro janārdano yathā girīṇāmapi śaiśirādriḥ \|*  
*yathāyudhānāṃ pravaraṃ sudarśanaṃ yathā khagānāṃ vinatātanūjaḥ \|*  
*mahoragāṇāṃ pravaro 'pyananto yathā ca bhūteṣu mahī pradhānā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. As Janardana in gods, the Himalaya in mountains, Sudarsana in weapons, Garuda in birds, Anantanaga in serpents and earth in all beings is supreme.

## \|\| 12.45 \|\|

*nadīṣu gaṅgā jalajeṣu padmaṃ surārimukhyeṣu harāṅghribhaktaḥ \|*  
*kṣetreṣu yadvatkurujaṅgalaṃ varaṃ tīrtheṣu yadvat pravaraṃ pṛthūdakam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. As the Ganges in rivers, lotus in water bom flowers, Siva's devotee in daityas, Kurujangala in regions and Prthudaka in holy place is supreme.

## \|\| 12.46 \|\|

*sarassu caivottaramānasaṃ yathā vaneṣu puṇyeṣu hi nandanaṃ yathā \|*  
*lokeṣu yadvatsadanaṃ viriñceḥ satyaṃ yathā dharmavidhikriyāsu \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. As uttaramanasa in reservoirs, Nandana in holy forests, abode of Brahma in lokas, Satya property in religious deeds.

## \|\| 12.47 \|\|

*yathāśvamedhaḥ pravaraḥ kratūnāṃ putro yathā sparśavatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ \|*  
*tapodhanānāmapi sumbhayoniḥ śrutirvarā yadvadihāgameṣu \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Asvamedha in yajna, son in things worth touching, Agastya in ascetics and the Veda in Agama scriptures.

## \|\| 12.48 \|\|

*mukhyaḥ purāṇeṣu yathaiva mātsyaḥ svāyaṃbhuvoktistvapi saṃhitāsu \|*  
*manuḥ smṛtīnāṃ pravaro yathaiva tithīṣu darśā viṣuveṣu dānam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. As Matsya Purana among the Puranas, code laid down by Svayambhu among codes, Manusmrti among smrtis, Amavasya among lithi and donation made on Visuvas (rotation of Aries and Libra) among other donations is greatest.

## \|\| 12.49 \|\|

*tejasvināṃ yadvadihārka ukto ṛkṣeṣu candro jaladhirhvadeṣu \|*  
*bhavān yathā rākṣasasattameṣu pāśeṣu nāgastimiteṣu bandhaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. And as the sun in ascetics, moon in constellations, ocean in reservoirs, you in demon kings and Nagapas in the pasas making inactive is supreme.

## \|\| 12.50 \|\|

*dhānyeṣu śalirdvipadeṣu vipraḥ catuṣpade gauḥ śvapadāṃ mṛgendraḥ \|*  
*puṣpeṣu jātī nagareṣu kāñcī nārīṣu rambhā śramīṇāṃ gṛhasthaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. And as Sali in paddys, Brahmin in human beings, cow in cattle, lion in wild animal, Jati in flowers, Kanci in cities, Rambha in women and household in asramas is supreme.

## \|\| 12.51-52 \|\|

*kuśasthalī śreṣṭhatamā pureṣu deśeṣu sarveṣu ca madhyadeśaḥ \|*  
*phaleṣu cūto mukuleṣvaśokaḥ sarvauṣadhīnāṃ pravarā ca pathyā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*mūleṣu kandaḥ pravaro yathokto vyādhiṣvajīrṇaṃ kṣaṇadācarendra \|*  
*śveteṣu dugdhaṃ pravaraṃ yathaiva kārpāsikaṃ prāvaraṇeṣu yadvat \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. As Kusasthali in Puris, Madhyadcsa in all countries, mango in fruits, Asoka in buds and Pathya in all herbs is supreme. О monster! As Kanda in roots, constipation in disease, milk in white things and garments in cotton is supreme.

## \|\| 12.53-54 \|\|

*kalāsu mukhyā gaṇitajñatā ca vijñānamukhyeṣu yathendrajālam \|*  
*śākeṣu mukhyā tvapi kākamācī raseṣu mukhyaṃ lavaṇaṃ yathaiva \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tuṅḍgeṣu tālo nalinīṣu pampā vanaukaseṣveva ca ṛkṣarājaḥ \|*  
*mahīruheṣveva yathā vaṭaśca yathā haro jñānavatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Expertise in mathematics, Indrajala in science, Kacamaci in vegetables, salt in essences (rasas), tala in tall things, Pampa in lotus reservoirs, bear in vanankasa, banyan in trees and Mahadeva among scholars are supreme. (And) О monster! As-

## \|\| 12.55-56 \|\|

*yathā satīnāṃ himavatsutā hi yathārjunīnāṃ kapilā variṣṭhā \|*  
*yathā vṛṣāṇāmapi nīlavarṇo yathaiva sarveṣvapi duḥsaheṣu \|*  
*durgeṣu raudreṣu niśācareśa nṛpātanaṃ vaitaraṇī pradhānā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*pāpīyasāṃ tadvadiha kṛghnāḥ sarveṣu pāpeṣu vanaśācarendra \|*  
*brahmaghnagoghnādiṣu niṣkṛtirhi vidyetata naivāsya tu duṣṭacāriṇaḥ \|*  
*na niṣkṛtiścāsti kṛtaghnavṛtteḥ suhṛtkṛtaṃ nāśayato 'bdakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Parvati in chaste women, Kapila in cows, blue bull in bulls and Vaitarani is supreme among all dreadful, difficult and intolerable hells, the ungrateful is the most heinous sinner among all other sinners. The sins like the murder of a Brahmin and cow can be absolved when the regrettal prescribed is observed but the sin of destroying what is created by a friend (gentleman) cannot be absolved even if the regrettal observed for as many as several crore years (viz. ungrateful man is deed the most heinous miscreant and such crime is uncompoundable).

## Chapter 13. Description of Bhuvana-kosa

## \|\| 13.1 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*bhavadbhiruditā ghorā puṣkaradvīpasaṃsthitiḥ \|*  
*jambūdvīpasya saṃsthānaṃ kathayantu maharṣayaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sukesi said- О hermits! You have described the gross painful location of Puskaradvipa. Kindly, tell us now about Jambudvipa.

## \|\| 13.2 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*jambūdvīpasya saṃsthānaṃ kathyamānaṃ nisāmaya \|*  
*navabhedaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ svargasokṣaphalapradam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The hermits replied- "Listen to the details about Jambudvipa from us. That most extended island is divided into nine parts and it renders the man with emancipation and heavenly abode."

## \|\| 13.3 \|\|

*madhye tvilāvṛto varṣo bhadraśvaḥ pūrvato 'dbhutaḥ \|*  
*pūrva uttarataścāpi hiraṇyo rākṣaseśvara \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О demon king- Ilavrta varsa has existed in its middle, Bhadrasva varsa at the east and Hiranya varsa has existed at its north-east direction.

## \|\| 13.4 \|\|

*pūrvadakṣiṇataścāpi kiṃnaro varṣa ucyate \|*  
*bhārato dakṣiṇe prokto harirdakṣiṇapaśacime \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. It is said that Kinnara varsa has existed at its eastern-south, Bharata varsa at south and Hari varsa at its southern-west direction.

## \|\| 13.5 \|\|

*paścime kekumālaśca ramyakaḥ paścimottare \|*  
*uttare ca kururvarṣaḥ kalpavṛkṣasamāvṛtaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Ketumala varsa has existed at the west, Ramyaka varsa at western-north and Kuru varsa covered by kalpavrksa at its north direction.

## \|\| 13.6-8 \|\|

*puṇyā ramyā navaivaite varṣāḥ śālakaṭaṅkaṭa \|*  
*ilāvṛtādyā ye cāṣṭau varṣaṃ muktvaiva bhāratam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*na teṣvasti yugāvasthā jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ na ca \|*  
*teṣāṃ svābhāvikī siddhiḥ sukhaprāyā hyatnataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*viparyayo na teṣvasti nottamādhamamadhyamāḥ \|*  
*yadetad bhārataṃ varṣaṃ navadvīpaṃ nisācara \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. O Salakatarhkata (monster)! These nine are the holy and attractive varsa. Besides Bharata varsa there is no fear of death and old age as also yugavastha in all the eight varsas. Success pouring with pleasure in abundance and that too without efforts is achieved there. There is no discrimination as best, medium and mean (or uttama, madhyama and adham) and reversion anyway. О monster! There are nine isles in this Bharata varsa. All these isles are surrounded by oceans and mutually inaccessible.

## \|\| 13.9-10 \|\|

*sāgarāntaritāḥ sarve agamyāśca parasparam \|*  
*indrīpaḥ kaserumāṃstāmravarṇo gabhastimān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nāgadvīpaḥ kaṭāhaśca siṃhalo vāruṇastathā \|*  
*ayaṃ tu navamasteṣāṃ dvīpaḥ sāgarasaṃvṛtaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The names given to these nine isles are- Indradvipa, Kaseruman, Tamravarna, Gabhastiman, Nagadvipa, Kataha, Simhala and Varuna. The ninth dvipa known as Kumara is surrounded by the sea and extended from south to north side.

## \|\| 13.11 \|\|

*kumārākhyaḥ parikhyāto dvīpo 'yaṃ dakṣiṇottaraḥ \|*  
*pūrve kirātā yasyānte paścime yavanāḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O warrior! Kirata live at the east, Yavana at the west, Andhra at south and Turuska people live at the northern border of this Bharata varsa.

## \|\| 13.12-13 \|\|

*āndhrā dakṣimate vīra turuṣkāstvapi cottare \|*  
*brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ sūdrāścāntaravāsinaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ijyāyuddhavaṇijyādyaiḥ karmabhiḥ kṛtapāvanāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ saṃvyavahāraśca ebhiḥ karmabhiriṣyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. In the interior of this island, there live the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras. All of them are having purity through the activities like yajna, war, commerce etc. Their behaviour, attainment of material and metaphysical success and evil as also good take place through these activities.

## \|\| 13.14 \|\|

59\. O monster! We have described in detail about these countries falling under the territory of Kumaradvipa. We shall now give a true account of the religions prevalent in these countries. Listen to it carefully.

## Chapter 14. Description of Teachings of Religion

## \|\| 14.1-2 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*ahiṃsā satyamastaṃ dānaṃ kṣāntirdamaḥ śamaḥ \|*  
*akārpaṇyaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca tapaśca rajanīcara \|\| 1 \|\|*

*daśāṅgo rākṣasaśreṣṭha dharmo 'sau sārvavarṇikaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇasyāpi vihitā cāturāśramyakalpanā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. The hermits said- О demon king! The religion consisting of ten parts (angas) i.e. non-violence, truthfulness, asatya (afraid of telling a lie), donation, forgiveness, control over senses (dama), sama, generosity, purity (sauca) and penance has been prescribed for all people. A provision of four as'ramas has been made for the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 14.3 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ cāturāśramyaṃ vistarānme tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*ācakṣadhvaṃ na me tṛptiḥ śṛṇvataḥ pratipadyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Sukesi said- О austere hermits! Describe in detail the provision of four asramas for the Brahmanas. My curiosity is increasing manifold and I am still unsatiated.

## \|\| 14.4 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*kṛtopanayanaḥ samyag brahmacārī gurau vaset \|*  
*tatra dharmo 'sya yastaṃ ca kathyamānaṃ niśāmaya \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The hermit said- "The celibate should live at the residence of the preceptor when thread ceremony has been duly performed. His religion prescribed there are being explained by me now. Please, listen to it carefully.

## \|\| 14.5-6 \|\|

*svādhyāyo 'thāgniśuśruṣā snānaṃ bhikṣāṭanaṃ tathā \|*  
*gurorniṃvedya taccādyamanujñātena sarvadā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*guroḥ karmaṇi sodyogaḥ samyakprītyupapādanam \|*  
*tenāhūtaḥ paṭheccaiva tatparo nānyamānasaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. (This religion is) to do perseverance, serve the fire (i.e. participate in offering), to bathe daily, to go out for alms, to offer the food first to the preceptor and then he should take when allowed by him. Prepared always to act on instructions given by the preceptor, to develop love duly in the heart of die preceptor, to read with mind in concentration when called by the preceptor.

## \|\| 14.7-8 \|\|

*ekaṃ dvau sakalān vāpi vedān prāpya surormukhāt \|*  
*anujñāto varaṃ dattvā gurave dakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*gārhasthyāśramakāmastu gārhasthyāśramamāvaset \|*  
*vānaprasthāśramaṃ vāpi caturthaṃ svecchayātmanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. After completion of study in one, two or all the Vedas under the guidance of the preceptor, he should offer daksina (fee) for teaching. Then, those desirous of household life should enter into it or resort to voluntarily Vanaprastha or reclusion with the permission of that preceptor.

## \|\| 14.9 \|\|

*tatraiva vā gurorgehe dvijo niṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt \|*  
*gurorabhāve tatputre tacchiṣye tatsutaṃ vinā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Or he should determine to live with the preceptor throughout his life and observe Naishika Brahmacarya till he breathes his last. (If so desired) he should live with the son of the preceptor if he is dead or with any disciple for the lack of his son.

## \|\| 14.10 \|\|

*śuśrūṣan nirabhīmāno brahmacaryāśramaṃ vaset \|*  
*evaṃ jayati mṛtyuṃ sa dvijaḥ śālakaṭaṅkaṭa \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Salakatankata! He should live always in celibacy and give up ego forever. The dvija living under strict compliance of these rules, conquers the death itself.

## \|\| 14.11-12 \|\|

*upāvṛttastatastasmād gṛhasthāśramakāmyayā \|*  
*asamānarṣikulajāṃ kanyāmudvahed niśācara \|\| 11 \|\|*

*svakarmaṇā dhanaṃ labdhvā pitṛdevātithīnapi \|*  
*samyak saṃprīṇayed bhaktyā sadācārarato dvijaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. О monster! After being liberated from there, one should solemnise marriage with a virgin bom in a gotra/clan other than his own. The dvija observing courtesy should earn wealth through functions executed by his own industry and satiate duly with keen devotion the Pitrs, gods and guests.

## \|\| 14.13 \|\|

*sadācāro nigadito yuṣmābhirmama suvratāḥ \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ śrotumicḥāmi kathayadhvaṃ tamadya me \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Sukesi said- О great resolute! You have described etiquette which I have understood. I want to listen now to its characteristics from you. Please, describe those characteristics.

## \|\| 14.14 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*sadācāro nigaditastava yo 'smābhirādarāt \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣyāmastacchṛṇuṣva niśācara \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The hermit said- О monster! Listen to the characteristics of etiquette/courtesy already described by us.

## \|\| 14.15 \|\|

*gṛhasthena sadā kāryamācāraparipālanam \|*  
*na hyācāravihinasya bhadramatra paratra ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The household should always observe etiquette in his life. The man without courtesy cannot see welfare in this material and metaphysical world (after death).

## \|\| 14.16 \|\|

*yajñadānatapāṃsīha puruṣasya na bhūtaye \|*  
*bhavanti yaḥ samullaṅghya sadācāraṃ pravartate \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The yajna, donation and penance made/observed by a man contravening etiquette never become benevolent.

## \|\| 14.17 \|\|

*hurācāro hi puruṣo neha nāmutra nandate \|*  
*kāryo yatnaḥ sadācāre ācāro hantyalakṣaṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The man without etiquette does not feel pleasure in the material and metaphysical world. One should, therefore, always endeavour towards observing etiquette. Etiquette decays the evils adhered to the personality.

## \|\| 14.18 \|\|

*tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ sadācārasya rākṣasa \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanāstacca yadi śreyo 'bhivāñchasi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О monster! We, now talk about the features of that etiquette. If you wish any good, then listen to the etiquette with concentration.

## \|\| 14.19 \|\|

*dharmo 'sya mūlaṃ dhanamasya śākhā puṣpaṃ ca kāmaḥ phalamasya mokṣaḥ \|*  
*asau sadācārataruḥ sukeśin saṃsevito yena sa puṇyabhokta \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О Sukesi! Its root is the religion, wealth is one of its branches Kama is its flower and emancipation is its fruit. The man who has taken care of such and etiquette tree, always enjoys pleasure (punya) in his life.

## \|\| 14.20 \|\|

*brahmo muhūrte prathamaṃ vibudhyedanusmared devavarān maharṣīn \|*  
*prābhātikaṃ maṅgalameva vācyaṃ yaduktavān devapatistrinetraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He should first recollect the images of great gods and hermits and chant the morning prayer as propounded by lord Mahadeva.

## \|\| 14.21 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*kiṃ taduktaṃ suprabhātaṃ śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*prabhāte yat paṭhan martyo mucyate pāpabandhanāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Sukesi said- What is the prayer propounded by god Sankara worth chanting at dawn capable to absolve all sins of the people.

## \|\| 14.22 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ rākṣasaśreṣṭha suprabhātaṃ haroditam \|*  
*śrutvā smṛtvā paṭhitvā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The hermit said- О demon king! Listen to morning pray propounded by Mahadeva. The man is absolved from all evils by listening to recollecting and reading it.

## \|\| 14.23 \|\|

*brahma murāristripurāntakārī bhānuḥ śaśī bhūmisuto budhaśca \|*  
*guruśca śukraḥ saha bhānujena kurvantu sarve mama suprabhātam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. May lord Brahma, Visnu, Sankara, Surya, Candrama, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn bless me with a fine morning!

## \|\| 14.24 \|\|

*bhṛgurvasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṅgirāśca manuḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ sagautamaḥ \|*  
*raibhyo marīciścyavano ṛbhuśca kurvantu sarve mama suprabhātam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. May Bhrgu, Vasistha, Kratu, Angira, Manu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Gautama, Raibhya, Marici, Cyavana and Rbhu hermits bless me with a fine morning.

## \|\| 14.25 \|\|

*sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandanaḥ sanātano 'pyāsuripiṅgalau ca \|*  
*sapta svarāḥ sapta rasātalāśca kurvantu sarve mama suprabhātam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. May Sanatkumara, Sanaka, Sanandana, Sanatana, Asuri, Pingala, seven voices and all the seven nether worlds bless me with a fine morning.

## \|\| 14.26 \|\|

*pṛthvī sagandhā sarasāstathā'paḥ sparśaśca vāyurjvalanaḥ satejāḥ \|*  
*nabhaḥ saśabdaṃ mahatā sahaiva yacchantu sarve mama suprabhātam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. May the earth with smell, water with liquid, wind with touch, fire with flame, ether with word and Mahatatva bless me with a fine morning.

## \|\| 14.27 \|\|

*saptārṇavāḥ sapta kulācalāśca saptarṣayo dvīpavarāśca sapta \|*  
*bhūrādi kṛtvā bhuvanāni sapta dadantu sarve mama suprabhātam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. May the seven seas, seven pioneer mountains, seven hermits, seven supreme islands and the earth etc. seven worlds (lokas) render me with a fine morning.

## \|\| 14.28 \|\|

*itthaṃ prabhāte paramaṃ pavitraṃ paṭhet smaredvā śṛmuyācca bhaktyā \|*  
*duḥsvapnanāśo 'nagha suprabhātaṃ bhavecca satyaṃ bhagavatprasādāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. One should read, recollect or listen to this holiest morning prayer. О innocent! (when it is done) the nightmare is decayed and one obtains a fine morning.

## \|\| 14.29 \|\|

*tataḥ samutthāya vicintayena dharmaṃ tathārthaṃ ca vihāya śayyām \|*  
*utthāya paścāddharirityudīrya gacchet tadotsargavidhiṃ hi kartum \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. He should then give thought to religion and wealth (essence) and go for defection with the name of Hari on his lips after leaving the bed.

## \|\| 14.30 \|\|

*na devagobrāhmaṇavahnimārge na rājamārge na catuṣpathe ca \|*  
*kuryādathotsargamapīha goṣṭhe pūrvāparāṃ caiva samāśrito gām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Do not defecate on the route of the cow, gods (temple), Brahmana and fire, highways and roundabouts, in cowpen and facing east or west direction.

## \|\| 14.31 \|\|

*tatastu śaucārthamupāharenmṛdaṃ gude trayaṃ pāṇitale ca sapta \|*  
*tathobhayoḥ pañca catustathaikāṃ liṅge tathaikāṃ mṛdamāhareta \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He should then take soil for attaining purity and smear the anus thrice, left palm seven time, ten times oh both palms and once on the penis. (Then it should be washed with clean water after due rubbing).

## \|\| 14.32 \|\|

*nāntarjalādrākṣasa mūṣikasthalāt śaucāvaśiṣṭā śaraṇāt tathānyā \|*  
*valmīkamṛccaiva hi śaucanāya grāhya sadācāravidā nareṇa \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О monster! An enlightened man should not take clay from the bottom of a reservoir, mice burrow residual from that used by others and from the home side. It should be taken from the termite.

## \|\| 14.33 \|\|

*udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vāpi vidvān prakṣālya pādau bhuvi saṃniviṣṭaḥ \|*  
*samācamedadbhiraphenilābhirādau parimṛjya mukhaṃ dviradbhiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The learned person first washes his feet then sit facing north or east and washes the mouth twice with water. He should then do acamana with the water without froth.

## \|\| 14.34 \|\|

*tataḥ spṛśetkhāni śiraḥ kareṇa saṃdhyāmupāsīta tataḥ krameṇa \|*  
*keśāṃstu saṃśodhya ca dantadhāvanaṃ kṛtvā tathā darpaṇadarśanaṃ ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He should then touch his senses and the head. Thereafter, he should clean hair, teeth and after a look at the mirror, then he should observe saridhya.

## \|\| 14.35 \|\|

*kṛtvā śiraḥsnānamathāṅiḍkaṃ vā saṃpūjya toyena pitṝn sadevān \|*  
*homaṃ ca kṛtvālabhanaṃ śubhānāṃ kṛtvā bahirnirgamanaṃ praśastam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A man definitely achieves success on the mission duly proposed when he goes out from home after a complete or brief bath, obeisance offered to Pitrs and gods with water and things used in worship are duly touched.

## \|\| 14.36-37 \|\|

*dūrvādadhisarpirathodakumbhaṃ dhenuṃ savatsāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suvarṇam \|*  
*mṛdgomayaṃ svastikamakṣatāni lājāmadhu brāhmaṇakanyakāṃ ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*śvetāni puṣpāṇyatha śobhanāni hutāśanaṃ candamarkabimbam \|*  
*aśvatthavṛkṣaṃ ca samālabheta tatastu kuryānnijajātidharmam \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. One should observe his respective dharma (deed) after giving a touch with hand to durva, curd, ghee, a pitcher full of water, cow with a calf, bull, gold, clay, cowdung, mark of svastika, aksata (rice), laja, honey, virgin of a Brahmana, beautiful white flower, fire, sandal, sun ball and pipala.

## \|\| 14.38-39 \|\|

*deśānuśiṣṭaṃ kula dharmamagryaṃ svagotradharmaṃ na hi saṃtyajet \|*  
*tenārthasiddhiṃ samupācareta nāsatpralāpaṃ na ca satyahīnam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*na niṣṭhuraṃ nāgamaśāstrahīnaṃ vākyaṃ vadetsādhujanena yena \|*  
*nindyo bhavennaiva ca dharmaḥedī saṃgaṃ na cāsatsu nareṣu kuryāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. One should not abandon the religion (law) prevalent in the country, the family and gotra. He should earn wealth even by practising the professions that do not infringe upon his religion. One should never deliver an untrue statement, a sentence not permissible in Agama scripture and in harsh ways.

## \|\| 14.40 \|\|

*saṃdhyāsu varjyaṃ surataṃ divā ca sarvāsu yonīṣu parābalāsu \|*  
*āgāraśūnyeṣu mahītaleṣu rajasvalāsveva jaleṣu vīra \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. O chivalrous! One should not do intercourse in the evening and at the day time. Coition with other's wife in all yonis, on the land without home, with a woman in her menstruation cycle and in the water.

## \|\| 14.41 \|\|

*vṛthāṭanaṃ thā dānaṃ vṛthā ca paśumāraṇam \|*  
*na karttavyaṃ gṛhasthena vṛtā dāraparigraham \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. A household (grhastha) should not go anywhere without purpose, not give futile donation, not slaughter and animal and should not develop close contact with women.

## \|\| 14.42 \|\|

*vṛthāṭanānnityahānirvṛthādānāddhanakṣayaḥ \|*  
*vṛthā paśughnaḥ prāpnoti pātakaṃ narakapradam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Routine affairs are impeded on purposeless movements, futile donation causes loss of money and the man slaughtering an animal without any strong and rational purpose is stuck to evils that lead to the hell.

## \|\| 14.43 \|\|

*saṃtatyā hāniraślāghayā varṇasaṃkarato bhayam \|*  
*bhetavyaṃ ca bhavelloke vṛthādāraparigrahāt \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The children have to bear insults inflicted by society when their father develops illicit relations with women; it increases fear of having hybrid bom and fear of humiliation from the society too.

## \|\| 14.44 \|\|

*parasve paradāre ca na kāryā buddhiruttamaiḥ \|*  
*parasvaṃ narakāyaiva paradārāśca mṛtyave \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. An enlightened man should not be entangled with other's money and wives as other's money throws into hell and other's wife becomes a cause for death.

## \|\| 14.45 \|\|

*nekṣet parastriyaṃ nagnāṃ na saṃbhāṣena taskarān \|*  
*udkyādarśanaṃ sparśaṃ saṃbhāṣaṃ ca vivarjayet \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. One should not see other's wife naked, nor talk to the smugglers and nor touch, converse with or even see at menstrual state any women.

## \|\| 14.46 \|\|

*naikāsane tathā stheyaṃ sodaryā parajāyayā \|*  
*tathaiva syānna mātuśca tathā svaduhitustvapi \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. One should not sit at the same seat with his sister and other's wife. Similarly, he should not sit at the same seat with his mother and daughter too.

## \|\| 14.47 \|\|

*na ca snāyīta vai nagno na śayīta kadācana \|*  
*digvāsaso 'pi na tathā paribhramaṇamiṣyate\|*  
*bhinnāsanabhājanādīn dūrataḥ parivarjayet \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. One should not bathe and sleep naked. One should not walk naked.

## \|\| 14.48 \|\|

*nandāsu nābhyaṅgamupācareta kṣauraṃ ca riktāsu jayāsu māṃsam \|*  
*pūrṇāsu yoṣitparivarjayeta bhadrāsu sarvāṇi samācareta \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Give up broken seat and utensil even from a distance. He should not do massage on tithis like Pratipada, Sasthi and Ekadasi, not shave on Cathurthi, Navami and Caturdasi (Rikta) tithis and not eat meat on Jaya (i.e. Tytiya, Astami and Trayodasi) tithis.

## \|\| 14.49 \|\|

*nābhyaṅgamarke na ca bhūmiputre kṣauraṃ ca śukre ravije ca māṃsam \|*  
*budheṣu yoṣinna samācareta śeṣeṣu sarvāṇi sadaiva kuryāt \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Should not do coitus on Purna (Pancami, Dasami and Purnima) and should do all these functions on Bhadra (Dvitiya, Saptami and Dvadasi) tithis. Massage on Sunday and Tuesday, shave on Friday, meat on Saturday and coition with wife on Wednesday is prohibited. The rest of days are good for all other works.

## \|\| 14.50 \|\|

*citrāsu haste śravaṇe ca tailaṃ kṣauraṃ viśākhāsvabhijitsuvarjyam \|*  
*mūle mṛge bhāgrapadāsu māṃsaṃ yoṣinmaghākṛttikayottarāsu \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Massage on Citra, Hasta and Sravana constellations, shave on Visakha and Abhijita constellation, eating of flesh on Mula, Mrgasira and Bhadrapada constellation and coition with wife on three uttaras (i.e. uttaraphalguni, uttarasadha and uttarabhadra- pada) should be avoided.

## \|\| 14.51 \|\|

*sadaiva jarjyaṃ śayanamudakśirās tathā pratīcyāṃ rajanīcareśa \|*  
*bhuñjīta naiveha ca dakṣiṇāmukho na ca pratīcyāmabhibhojanīyam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О demon king! Slumbering with head facing uttara and west is always prohibited and meal should not be taken while facing south and the west.

## \|\| 14.52 \|\|

*devālayaṃ caityataruṃ catuṣpathaṃ vidyādhikaṃ cāpi guruṃ pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*mālyānnapānaṃ vasanāni yatnato nānyairdhṛtāṃścāpi hi dhārayed budhaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Pradaksina (circular walking in obeisance) of temple, Caityataru (respectable trees), roundabout, person more intelligent than him and preceptor should be made.

## \|\| 14.53 \|\|

*snāyācchiraḥsnānatayā ca nityaṃ na kāraṇaṃ caiva vinā niśāsu \|*  
*grahoparāge svajanāpayāte muktvā ca janmarkṣagate śaśaṅke \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. One should first sprinkle water on head while bathing. Bath at night without any strong reason and besides eclipse period, death of any near and dear ones and entrance of moon in constellation of birth should not be taken.

## \|\| 14.54 \|\|

*nābhyaṅgitaṃ kāyamupaspṛśecca snāto na keśān vidhunīta cāpi \|*  
*gātrāṇi caivāmbarapāṇinā ca snāto vimṛjyād rajanīcareśa \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. О demon king! One should not touch an anointed body, should not shake hair immediately after a bath and the hands and body should not be dried with a towel after bath.

## \|\| 14.55 \|\|

*vasecca deśeṣu surājakeṣu susaṃhiteṣveva janeṣu nityam \|*  
*akrodhanā nyāyaparā amatsarāḥ kṛṣīvalā hyoṣadhayaśca yatra \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. One should settle in a state where a just king is ruling where tolerant, just and non- envious people are loving and where peasants and medicines are available in abundance.

## \|\| 14.56-57 \|\|

*na teṣu deśeṣu vaseta buddhimān sadā nṛpo daṇḍarucistvaśaktaḥ \|*  
*jano 'pi nityotsavabaddhavairaḥ sadā jigīṣuśca niśācarendra \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*yacca jarjyaṃ mahābāho sadādharmasthitairnaraiḥ \|*  
*yadbhojyaṃ ca samuddiṣṭaṃ kathayiṣyāmahe vayam \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. Wise people should give up a country where the king inflicts rigorous punishment but his position is weak, where the pubic always celebrate the festivities, where people are mutually envious and intend to conquer or put down one another.

## \|\| 14.58 \|\|

*bhojyamannaṃ paryuṣitaṃ snehāktāṃ cirasaṃbhṛtam \|*  
*asnehā vrīhayaḥ ślakṣṇā vikārāḥ payasastathā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The hermits said- О brave king! We will describe the prohibited things as also the things worth eating for the religion-abiding people.

## \|\| 14.59 \|\|

*śaśakaḥ śalyako godhā śvāvidho matsyakacchapau \|*  
*tadvad dvidalakādīni bhojyāni manurabravīt \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The food cooked in oil, ghee etc. fatty matters even if stale and kept for longer hours and the rice and milk and milk products i.e. curd, ghee etc. even if stale and kept for longer hours are eatable.

## \|\| 14.60 \|\|

*maṇiratnapravālānāṃ tadvanmuktāphalasya ca \|*  
*śailadārumayānāṃ ca tṛṇamūlauṣadhānyapi \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The rabbit, porcupine, godha (goha), svavidha (particular animal), fish, tortoise and pulses have been described by Manu as eatables.

## \|\| 14.61-62 \|\|

*śūrpadhānyājinānāṃ ca saṃhatānāṃ ca vāsasām \|*  
*valkalānāmaśeṣāṇāmambunā śuddhiriṣyate \|\| 61 \|\|*

*sasnehānāmathoṣṇena tilakalkena vāriṇā \|*  
*kārpāsikānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ suddhiḥ syātsaha bhasmanā \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Water purifies gems, pearls, coral, precious stones, stones and wooden pots, the straws, roots and medicines, the surpa-dhanya, hide of deer, ready-made garments and all clothes made up of tree bark.

## \|\| 14.63 \|\|

*nāgadantāsthiśṛṅgāṇāṃ takṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate \|*  
*punaḥ pākena bhāṇḍānāṃ mṛnmayānāṃ ca medhyatā \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The clothes bearing stains of oil or ghee etc. are purified by hot water and by rubbing them with a cake of sesamum oil while clothes made of cotton are cleaned with ash.

## \|\| 14.64 \|\|

*śuci bhaikṣaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā \|*  
*rathyāgatamavijñātaṃ dāsavargeṇa yatkṛtam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Ivory, bone and horns are cleaned by cutting (scratching). Clay pots are cleaned when baked on furnace again.

## \|\| 14.65 \|\|

*vākpraśastaṃ cirātītamanekāntaritaṃ laghu \|*  
*ceṣṭitaṃ bālavṛddhānāṃ bālasya ca mukhaṃ śuci \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The food obtained in alms, the hand of craftsmen, saleable commodity, the face of a female, the commodity brought from a distant place (i.e. commodity in transit), alien things and the things made by servants are always pure.

## \|\| 14.66 \|\|

*karmāntāṅgāraśālāsu stanandhayasutāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*vāgvipruṣo dvijendrāṇāṃ saṃtaptāścāmbubindavaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. A topic duly explained, old (product), small and developed through several processes applied, the deed performed by children (babies) and old people are always pure.

## \|\| 14.67 \|\|

*bhūmirviśudhyate khātadāhamārjanagokramaiḥ \|*  
*lepādullekhanāt sekād veśma saṃmārjanārjanāt \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The ladies having milk-feeding sons in workshop, inner-cell (antargrha) and fire place (furnace), the drop of spit from the mouth of teamed Brahmanas and hot water drops are always pure.

## \|\| 14.68 \|\|

*keśakīṭāvapanne 'nne goghrāte makṣikānvite \|*  
*mṛdambubhasmakṣārāṇi prakṣeptavyāni śuddhaye \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The land is cleaned when excavated, fire blazed, broomed, cattle grazed, smeared, scratched and irrigated and the home is cleaned by sweeping and offering pray to god.

## \|\| 14.69 \|\|

*audumbarāṇāṃ cāmlena kṣāreṇa trapusīsayoḥ \|*  
*bhasmāmbibhiśca kāṃsyānāṃ śuddhiḥ plāvodravasya ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. In order to clean hair, insects and flies affected and that affected by saliva of a cow; clay, water, ash and alkali should be sprinkled on the same.

## \|\| 14.70 \|\|

*amedhyāktasya mṛttoyairgandhāpaharaṇena ca \|*  
*anyeṣāmapi dravyāṇāṃ śuddhirgandhāpahārataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Copper vessels are cleaned by acid zinc and lead are cleaned by alkali; pots made of bronze are cleaned by ash and water; and liquids are cleaned when their smaller portion is swayed.

## \|\| 14.71 \|\|

*mātuḥ prasravaṇe vatsaḥ śakuniḥ phalapātane \|*  
*gardabho bhāravāhitve śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The articles having impurity when impure particles are mixed can be cleaned when washed by using clay and water and when their odour is removed. Other articles are also cleaned when the odour is removed.

## \|\| 14.72 \|\|

*rathyākardamatoyāni nāvaḥ pathi tṛṇāni ca \|*  
*mārutenaiva suddhyanti pakveṣṭakacitāni ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The udders are cleaned when calf first sucks, the fruit dropped by bird from a tree is pure, a donkey is pure (sincere) in carrying burden and the dog is pure (exert) in chasing the animal worth hunting.

## \|\| 14.73 \|\|

*śṛtaṃ droṇāḍhakasyānnamamedhyābhiplutaṃ bhavet \|*  
*agramuddhṛtya saṃtyājyaṃ śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ smṛtam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. The wind purifies the route, mud, water, boat, straw dropped on the path and the lump of bricks baked in a furnace.

## \|\| 14.74 \|\|

*upavāsaṃ trirātraṃ vā dūṣitānnasya bhojane \|*  
*ajñāte jñātapūrve ca naiva śuddhirvidhīyate \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. If cooked food in one Drona or one Adhaka is touched with impure thing, the upper portion from it should be removed and thrown and water should be sprinkled on the remaining portion. It will certainly purify that food.

## \|\| 14.75 \|\|

*udakyāśvānanagnāṃśca sūtikāntyāvasāyinaḥ \|*  
*spṛṣṭvā snāyīta śaucārthaṃ tathaiva mṛtahāriṇaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Provision of observing fast for three nights has been made when impure food is eaten by mistake or inadvertence but no purity is possible if such food is taken deliberately.

## \|\| 14.76 \|\|

*sasnehamasthi saṃspṛsya savāsāḥ snānamācaret \|*  
*ācamyaiva tu niḥsnehaṃ gāmālabhyārkamīkṣya ca \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. One should take a bath for regaining purity if a female in her menstruation cycle, a dog, a naked person, a female who recently delivered a child, a Candala and people carrying a corpse is touched.

## \|\| 14.77 \|\|

*na laṅghayetpurīṣāsṛkṣṭhīvanodvarttanāni ca \|*  
*gṛhāducchiṣṭaviṇmūtre pādāmbhāṃsi kṣiped bahiḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. One should take a bath with the clothes on but purity is regained only when acamana, a touch of cow, a glance at the sun is made if a dry bone is touched.

## \|\| 14.78 \|\|

*pañcapiṇḍānanuddhatya na snāyāt paravāriṇi \|*  
*snāyīta devakhāteṣu sarohadasaritsu ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. One should not jump over night-soil, blood, spit and material used for massage (ubatana). Waste thing, night-soil, urine and the water once used for washing the feet should be thrown out from the home.

## \|\| 14.79 \|\|

*nodyānādau vikāleṣu prājñastiṣṭhet kadācana \|*  
*nālaped janavidviṣṭaṃ vīrahīnāṃ tathā striyam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. One should not take a bath without extracting out fine palmful of clay from the pond dug by other persons. It is always good to take a bath in natural lakes, reservoirs and rivers.

## \|\| 14.80 \|\|

*devatāpitṛsacchāstrayajñavedādinindakaiḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā tu sparśamālāpaṃ śuddhyater'kāvalokanāt \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. A wise man should not stay untimely in garden etc. public places. He should avoid from talking with proved rudes and the women without husband and sons.

## \|\| 14.81 \|\|

*abhojyāḥ sūtikāṣaṇḍhamārjārākhuśvakukkuṭāḥ \|*  
*patitāpaviddhanagnāścāṇḍālādyadhamāśca ye \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. A men attains purity by gazing at the illuminating sun if he touched the rudes who criticise gods, pitps, the scriptures (smrti etc.), yajna and the Vedas and conversed with-them.

## \|\| 14.82 \|\|

*sukeśiruvāca \|*  
*bhavadbhiḥ kīrtitābhojyā ya ete sūtikādayaḥ \|*  
*amīṣāṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvato lakṣaṇāni hi \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. One should not take food in the residences of Sutikas, Sanda, Marjara, Akhu, Svina, Kukkuta, Patita, Apaviddha, Nagna and Candala etc. mean people.

## \|\| 14.83 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇasyaiva yāvarodhatvamāgatā \|*  
*tāvubhau sūtiketyuktau tayorannaṃ vigarhitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Sukesi said- I want to listen to the characteristics of Sotikas etc. food in whose home is prohibited by you. Please, explain them materially.

## \|\| 14.84 \|\|

*na juhotyucite kāle na snāti na dadāti ca \|*  
*pitṛdevārcanāddhīnaḥ sa ṣaṇḍhaḥ parigīyate \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The hermit said- When wife of a Brahmana has illicit physical relation with another Brahmana, both of them are called Sutikas. The food at their home, therefore, suffers from impurity.

## \|\| 14.85 \|\|

*dambhārthaṃ japate yaśca tapyate yajate tathā \|*  
*na paratrārthamudyakto sa mārjāraḥ prakīrtitiḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. The man who does not perform havana, bath, who does not give donation and who is without obeisance to Pitrs and gods is called Sanda.

## \|\| 14.86 \|\|

*vibhave sati naivātti na dadāti juhoti ca \|*  
*tamāhurākhuṃ tasyānnaṃ bhuktvā kṛcchreṇa suddhyati \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Marjara is a man who observes japa, tapa and yajna for ostentation and who does nothing good for others.

## \|\| 14.87 \|\|

*yaḥ pareṣāṃ hi marmāṇi nikṛntanniva bhāṣate \|*  
*nityaṃ paraguṇadveṣī sa śvāna iti kathyate \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Akhu is a man who does not enjoy his life, give in donation and perform havana in spite of being wealthy. The man who eats food at his home regains purity when Krcchrvrata is observed.

## \|\| 14.88 \|\|

*sabhāgatānāṃ yaḥ sabhyaḥ pakṣapātaṃ samāśrayet \|*  
*tamāhuḥ kukkuṭaṃ devāstasyāpyannaṃ vigarhitam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The man who does modest partiality for the people presented in any assembly is called Kukkuta by gods. Food at his home is, therefore, also prohibited.

## \|\| 14.89 \|\|

*svagharmaṃ yaḥ sutsṛjya paradharmaṃ samāśrayet \|*  
*anāpadi sa vidvadbhiḥ patitaḥ parikīrtyate \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The man who adopts conversion of religion in spite of being there no adversity befallen is called Patita by the scholars.

## \|\| 14.90 \|\|

*devatyāgī pitṛtyāgī gurubhaktyaratastathā \|*  
*gobrāhmaṇastrīvadhakṛdapaviddhaḥ sa kīrtyate \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Apaviddha is the man who has abandoned the gods, the Pitrs, no donation for preceptor and who has murdered a cow, Brahmana and woman.

## \|\| 14.91 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ kule na vedo 'sti na sāstraṃ naiva ca vratam \|*  
*te nagnāḥ kīrtitāḥ sadbhis teṣāmannaṃ vigarhitam \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. That gentle man addresses the man as Nagna who does not observe the Vedas, scriptures and resolutions. Food at his home is therefore, prohibited.

## \|\| 14.92 \|\|

*āśārtānāmadātā ca dātuśca pratiṣedhakaḥ \|*  
*śaraṇāgataṃ yastyajati sa cāṇḍālo 'dhamo naraḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. A man is addressed as Candela who does not give anything to his dependants (who expect and are eligible to receive from him), who restricts the donor and who abandons the man sheltered.

## \|\| 14.93 \|\|

*yo bāndhavaiḥ parityaktaḥ sādhubhirbrāhmaṇairapi \|*  
*kuṇḍāśī yaśca tasyānnaṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. That man should observe Candrayana fast for purity if he has taken food at the home of such a man who once had eaten at the residence of the person abandoned by siblings, sages and Brahmanas as also at the residence of kunda (viz. the son bom as a result of his mother's illicit relation with another man when her husband is still living).

## \|\| 14.94 \|\|

*yo nityakarmaṇo hāniṃ kuryānnaimittikasya ca \|*  
*bhuktvānnaṃ tasya śuddhyeta trirātropoṣito naraḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Purity is regained when a man observes fast as long as three nights if he has taken food in the home of a man who does not perform his routine and day-to-day needful acts.

## \|\| 14.95 \|\|

*gaṇakasya niṣādasya gaṇikābhiṣajostathā \|*  
*kadaryasyāpi śuddhyeta trirātropoṣito naraḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. It is true that routine is prohibited at the time when someone is bom or dead in a family but naimittika karma (day-to-day affairs) should not be abandoned.

## \|\| 14.96 \|\|

*nityasya karmaṇo hāniḥ kevalaṃ mṛtajanmasu \|*  
*na tu naimittikocchedaḥ karttavyo hi kathañcana \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. It has been stated by Bhrgu that the father should take a bath with clothes on when a son is bom and the kith and kin when someone is dead should take a bath with that procedure.

## \|\| 14.97 \|\|

*jāte putre pituḥ snānaṃ sacailasya vidhīyate \|*  
*mṛte ca sarvabandhūnāmityāha bhagavān bhṛguḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. The persons of homogeneity (sagotra) should give Jalanjali for the satiation of dead souls (preta) after funeral away from the area of the village. They should do Asthi-samcaya on the first, fourth or the seventh day.

## \|\| 14.98 \|\|

*pretāya salilaṃ deyaṃ bahirdagdhvā tu gotrajaiḥ \|*  
*prame 'hni caturthe vā saptame vāsthisaṃcayam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. There is provision of touching one another after Asthi-samcaya so made. The sodaka (people falling in fourteen generations of genealogy) and sapindaja (people falling under seven generations) should observe urdhavadaihika-kriya when the days of sodaka are over.

## \|\| 14.99-100 \|\|

*ūrddhvaṃ saṃcayanātteṣāmaṅgasparśo vidhīyate \|*  
*sodakaistu kriyā kāryā saṃśuddhaistu sapiṇḍajaiḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*viṣodbandhanaśastrāmbuvahnipātamṛteṣu ca \|*  
*bāle pravrāji saṃnyāse deśāntaramṛte tathā \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. О brave! Sauca of immediate nature takes place if death of someone is caused by poisoning, hanging, weapon, water, fire and’ falling from high places and when any child, sage and recluse is dead or such death is caused in a foreign country. This sauca is also of four types. The same procedure is followed when abortion takes place. Other asauca takes full time for purity.

## \|\| 14.101 \|\|

*sadyaḥ śaucaṃ bhavedvīra taccāpyuktaṃ caturvidham \|*  
*garbhasrāve tadevoktaṃ pūrṇakālena cetare \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. (That sauca of immediate nature) It is observed by Brahmanas for a Ahoratra, by Ksatriya it is for three days, by Vaisya it is observed for six days and Sildra observe if for twelve days.

## \|\| 14.102 \|\|

*brahmaṇānāmahorātraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ dinatrayama \|*  
*ṣaḍrātraṃ caiva vaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ dvādaśāhnikam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. People of all varnas should observe it with the difference of ten, twelve, fifteen days and one month respectively.

## \|\| 14.103 \|\|

*daśadvādaśamāsārddhamāsasaṃkhyairdiṃśca taiḥ \|*  
*svāḥ svāḥ karmakriyāḥ kuryuḥ sarve varṇā yathākrāmam \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Ekodista sraddha should be observed as per the procedure prescribed for the purpose of satiation of Preta. A man should perform Sapindlkarana when period of a year is passed since death.

## \|\| 14.104 \|\|

*pretamuddisya karttavyamekoddiṣṭaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ prete āvatsarānnaraiḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. One should do tarpana (sraddha) as per the procedure prescribed in the Vedas on Amavasya and Pumima when Preta is turned into Pitr.

## \|\| 14.105 \|\|

*tataḥ pitṛtvamāpanne darśapūrṇādibhiḥ subhaiḥ \|*  
*prīṇanaṃ tasya karttavyaṃ yathā śrutinidarśanāt \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. О monster! One should donate land etc. for the purpose of Pitara so that they could enjoy pleasure above.

## \|\| 14.106 \|\|

*piturarthaṃ samuddiśya bhūmidānādikaṃ svayam \|*  
*kuryādyenāsya suprītāḥ pitaro yānti rākṣasa \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. The things preferred by the person when he was living should be offered to meritorious people with a wish of their being abundantly available to him after death.

## \|\| 14.107 \|\|

*yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ kiñcid yaccāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe \|*  
*tattad guṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣayamicchatā \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. One should always do perseverance on Trayi (Veda), be a scholar and money should be earned by adopting lawful means. Arranging yajna as per capacity is also prescribed.

## \|\| 14.108 \|\|

*adhyetavyā trayī nityaṃ bhāvyaṃ ca viduṣā sadā \|*  
*dharmato dhanamāhāryaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ cāpi śaktitaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. О monster! A man should execute the deeds not deteriorating his soul and there should be no scope for doubt while executing them. The work so executed should not be in the nature worth concealing from greatmen.

## \|\| 14.109 \|\|

*yaccāpi kurvato nātmā jugupsāmeti rākṣasa \|*  
*tat karttavyamaśaṅkena yanna gopyaṃ mahājane \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. The man irrespective of being household (grhasta) obtains Dharma, Artha and Kama as a reward for such conduct and he attains welfare in this material and that metaphysical world when he is dead.

## \|\| 14.110 \|\|

*evamācarato loke puruṣasya gṛhe sataḥ \|*  
*dharmārthakāmasaṃprāptiḥ paratreha ca śobhanam \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. We have described the best kind of grhasthasrama. We will now describe the religion of Vanaprastha. Listen to it carefully.

## \|\| 14.111 \|\|

*eṣa dūddeśataḥ prokto gṛsthāśrama uttamaḥ \|*  
*vānaprasthāśramaṃ dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmo 'vadhāryatām \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. The wise man should adopt or enter into Vanaprastha asrama where grand-son is bom and he feels that his body is decaying.

## \|\| 14.112 \|\|

*apatyasaṃtatiṃ dṛṣṭvā prājño dehasya cānatim \|*  
*vānaprasthāśramaṃ dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmo 'vadhāryatām \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. He should live on wild products there and dry up his body by observing penance. He should sleep on the ground, observe celibacy and do worship of pitara, gods and guests.

## \|\| 14.113 \|\|

*tatrāraṇyopabhogaiśca tapobhiścātmakarṣaṇam \|*  
*bhūmau śayyā brahmacaryaṃ pitṛdevātithikriyā \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. He should do havana, take a bath thrice, put tree bark on body for clothes and sip the juice extracted from the wild fruits. All this is the procedure to be followed while in Vanaprashta.

## \|\| 14.114-115 \|\|

*homastriṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāraṇam \|*  
*vanyasnehaniṣevitvaṃ vānaprasthavidhistvayam \|\| 114 \|\|*

*sarvasaṅgaparityāgo brahmacaryamamānitā \|*  
*jitendriyatvamāvāse naikasmin vasatiściram \|\| 115 \|\|*

114-115. (The religion for the fourth Asrama are) to give-up company of people, to observe celibacy, to live humbly, to control the senses, to live for a short-term at one place, to live without activities, to live on alms, control on loose temperament, to acquire self-knowledge (realisation) and to realise perfectly his soul.

## \|\| 14.116 \|\|

*ananārambhastathāhāro bhaikṣānnaṃ nātikopitā \|*  
*ātmajñānāvabodhecchā tathā cātmāvabodhanam \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. О monster! We have thus described the religion (dharma) of the fourth asrama. Now listen to the other religion of the varnas.

## \|\| 14.117 \|\|

*caturthe tvāśrame dharmā asmābhiste prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*varṇadharmāṇi cānyāni niśāmaya niśācara \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. The asramas i.e. Brahmacarya, Grhastha and Vanaprastha as also the conducts prescribed for Brahmana are also prescribed for Ksatriyas.

## \|\| 14.118 \|\|

*gārhasthyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca vānaprasthaṃ trayāśramāḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyasyāpi kathitā ye cācārā dvijasya hi \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. O monster! Grhastha and Vanaprastha two asramas are provided for Vaisyas and only provision of Grhasthasrama is prescribed for Sudras.

## \|\| 14.119 \|\|

*vaikhānasatvaṃ gārhasthyamāśramadvitayaṃ viśaḥ \|*  
*gārhasthyayamuttamaṃ tvekaṃ śūdrasya kṣaṇadācara \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. One should not abandon the above-said religions of varnas in this world because god sun is annoyed if these are not followed.

## \|\| 14.120 \|\|

*svāni varṇāśramoktāni dharmāṇīha na hāpayet \|*  
*yo hāpayati tasyāsau parikupyati bhāskaraḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. О monster! When god sun is annoyed, he aggravates the diseases and creates circumstances to ruin his family (kula).

## \|\| 14.121 \|\|

*kupitaḥ kulanāśāya īśvaro rogavṛddhaye \|*  
*bhānurvai yatate tasya narasya kṣaṇadācara \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. One should, therefore, neither give up his religion nor be careless for its protection and defend his family from destruction. The man is cursed by Divakara (sun) if he has abandoned his religion.

## \|\| 14.122 \|\|

*tasmāt svaradharmaṃ na hi saṃtyajeta na hāpayeccāpi hi nātmavaṃśam \|*  
*yaḥ saṃtyajeccāpi nijaṃ hi dharmaṃ tasmai prakupyeta divākarastu \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Pulastya said- When preaching is so completed, Sukesi saluted those learned hermits and took a flight to his city keeping in memory the topics of religion told there.

## Chapter 15. Description of Character of Sukesi

## \|\| 15.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*tataḥ sukeśirdevarṣe gatvā svapuramuttamam \|*  
*samhūyābravīt sarvān rākṣasān dhārmikaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О divine hermit! Sukesi called all monsters when he got down in his city and told them about the topics on religion.

## \|\| 15.2-4 \|\|

*ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamindriyasaṃyamaḥ \|*  
*dānaṃ dayā ca kṣāntiśva brahmacaryamamānitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*śubhā satyā ca madhurā vāṅ nityaṃ satkriyā ratiḥ \|*  
*sadācāraniṣevitvaṃ paralokapradāyakāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ityūcurmunayo mahyaṃ dharmamādyaṃ purātanam \|*  
*sohamājñāpaye sarvān kriyatāmavikalpataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Non-violence, truthfulness, non-slealing, purity, control over senses, donation, kindness, forgiveness, celibacy, humility, sweet and ear pleasing speech, regular affection for noble deeds and observing etiquette are the religions which give pleasure to a man in heaven (Paraloka). The sages have told me of such a most ancient and foremost religion. I therefore instruct you all to observe this religion without pelting logic otherwise.

## \|\| 15.5 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*tataḥ sukeśivacanāt sarva eva niśācarāḥ \|*  
*trayodaśāṅgaṃ te dharma cakrurmuditamānasāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Pulastya said- All monsters since then began to observe the religion consisting of thirteen parts (angas) including non-violence.

## \|\| 15.6 \|\|

*tataḥ pravṛddhiṃ sutarāmagacchanta niśācarāḥ \|*  
*putrapautrārthasaṃyuktāḥ sadāṭārasamanvitāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. As a result of monsters being enlightened, the forth-coming generation i.e. their sons and grandsons also learned courtesy and thus, they achieved admirable progress and development.

## \|\| 15.7 \|\|

*tajjayotistejasteṣāṃ rākṣasānaṃ mahātmanām \|*  
*gantuṃ nāśaktuvan sūryo nakṣatrāṇi na candramāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The splendour (Aura) of those gentle monsters developed so much so that the sun, constellations and moon could not move on their route.

## \|\| 15.8 \|\|

*tatastribhuvane brahman niśācarapuro 'bhavat \|*  
*divā candrasya sadṛśaḥ kṣaṇadāyāṃ ca sūryavat \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Brahmana, the city of monsters in three- world then became moon-like in the day and sun-like at night.

## \|\| 15.9 \|\|

*na jñāyate gatirvyomni bhāskarasya tato 'mbare \|*  
*śaśaṅkamiti tejastvādamanyanta purottamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. It then became tough to watch the motion of sun-god as having extra-brilliance, that city looked like the moon in the sky.

## \|\| 15.10 \|\|

*svaṃ vikāsaṃ vimuñcanti niśāmiti vyacintayan \|*  
*kamalākareṣu kamalā mitramityavagamya hi \|*  
*rātrau vikasitā brahman vibhūtiṃ dātumīpsavaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Brahmana! The lotus stopped blossoming in the day as it confused it for night while considering that city as sun at night. They began to blossom in order to give outstanding honour.

## \|\| 15.11 \|\|

*kauśikā rātrisamayaṃ buddhvā niragaman kila \|*  
*tān vāyasāstadā jñātvā divā nighnanti kauśikān \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The owls came out from their caves creating the day as night and the crows began to hit them hard treating it as the day.

## \|\| 15.12 \|\|

*snātakāstvāpagāsveva snānajapyaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*ākaṇṭhamagnāstiṣṭhanti rātrau jñātvātha vāsaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The celibate people (snataka) began to dip deep in river, do japa in standing posture in water treating the night as day.

## \|\| 15.13 \|\|

*na vyayujyanta cakraāśca tadā vai puradarśane \|*  
*manmānāstu divasamidamuccairbruvanti ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The couple of cakravaka birds did not separate from each other due to confusion of being the night as day and began to yell loudly.

## \|\| 15.14 \|\|

*nūnaṃ kāntāvihīnena kenaciccakrapattriṇā \|*  
*utsṛṣṭaṃ jīvitaṃ śūnye phūtkṛtya saritastaṭe \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Any male cakravaka has definitely breathed his last lonely at the bank of river on account of severe pain of separation from his partner.

## \|\| 15.15 \|\|

*tato 'nukṛpayāviṣṭo vivasvāstīvraraśmibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃtāpayañjagat sarvaṃ nāstameti kathañcana \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The sun-god has melted seeing the pain of that bird and forgotten the time for his setting. This is one reason why he is continuously heating up the earth with acute rays.

## \|\| 15.16 \|\|

*anye vadanti cakraāhvo nṛnaṃ kaścin mṛto bhavet \|*  
*tatkāntayā tapastaptaṃ bhartṛśokārttayā bata \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Some other say- "Any cakravaka has definitely lost his life and his mate in sheer pain of separation has observed any toughest penance.

## \|\| 15.17 \|\|

*ārādhitastu bhagavāṃstapasā vai divākaraḥ \|*  
*tenāsau śaśinirjetā nāstameti ravirdhruvam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. This is the reason why, god sun pleased on her penance is not setting and he has conquered the moon god.

## \|\| 15.18 \|\|

*yajvino homaśālāsu saha ṛtvigbhiradhvare \|*  
*prāvarttayanta karmāṇi rātrāvapi mahāmune \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O great hermit! The clients (yajamana) with Rtvijas are regularly performing yajna in yajnasalas even in the night.

## \|\| 15.19 \|\|

*mahābhāgavatāḥ pūjāṃ viṣṇoḥ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*ravau śaśini caivānye brahmaṇo 'nye harasya ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Mahabhagavata (denotes to lord Visnu) are worshipping lord Visnu and other people are doing worship of sun, moon, Brahma and other people are doing worship of sun, moon, Brahma and Siva.

## \|\| 15.20 \|\|

*kāminaścāpyamanyanta sādhu candramasā kṛtam \|*  
*yadiyaṃ rajanī ramyā kṛtā satatakaumudī \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The sensuous people opined that the moon has executed a nice work by featuring regular and attractive night with moonlight.

## \|\| 15.21-23 \|\|

*anye 'bruvaṃllokagururasmābhiścakrabhṛd vaśī \|*  
*nirvyājena mahāgandhairarcitaḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*saha lakṣmyā mahāyogī nabhasyādicaturṣvapi \|*  
*aśūnyaśayanā nāma dvitīyā sarvakāmadā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tenāsau bhagavān prītaḥ prādācchayanamuttamam \|*  
*aśūnyaṃ ca mahābhogairanastamitaśekharam \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Some others opined that we performed the worship of lord Visnu, great yogi and discus- holder with Mahalaksmi during Srilvana etc. four months. It was done with keen obeisance and scented flowers. Sarvakamada Asunyasayana Dvitiya falls in this very period and the lord has with pleasure provided everlasting rest with all luxuries.

## \|\| 15.24-25 \|\|

*anaye 'bruvan dhruvaṃ devyā rohiṇyāśaśinaḥ kṣayam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ rudrārādhanakāmyayā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*puṇyāyāmakṣayāṣṭamyāṃ vedoktavidhinā svayam \|*  
*tuṣṭena śaṃbhunā dattaṃ varaṃ cāsyai yadṛcchayā \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Some others said that goddess Rohini definitely has observed strict penance on the tithi of Aksayastami for recovery of her husband moon's health from T.B. She thus wants the pleasure of Rudra. As lord Siva has pleased her now, her desire is fulfilled.

## \|\| 15.26 \|\|

*anye 'bruvan candramasā dhruvamārādhito hariḥ \|*  
*vrateneha tvakhaṇḍena tenākhaṇḍaḥ śaśī divi \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Some other said that the moon has worshipped lord Visnu by observing a penance integrated. This is the reason, the moon is regular (unsplit).

## \|\| 15.27 \|\|

*anye 'bravañchaśāṅkena dhruvaṃ rakṣā kṛtātmanaḥ \|*  
*padadvayaṃ samabhyarcya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. A few others opined that the moon indeed has defended him by worship at the feet of Sri Visnu, the lord with unique splendour.

## \|\| 15.28 \|\|

*tenāsau dīptimāṃścandraḥ paribhūya divākaram \|*  
*asmākamānandakaro divā tapati sūryavat \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The moon so illuminated has given defeat to the sun and spreading his beams like sun for our pleasure.

## \|\| 15.29 \|\|

*lakṣyate kāraṇairanyairbahubhiḥ satyameva hi \|*  
*śaśaṅkanirjitaḥ sūryo na vibhāti yathā purā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. It is being watched due to the presence of several evidences that the sun defeated by the moon is not so powerful as before.

## \|\| 15.30 \|\|

*yathāmī kamalāḥ ślakṣṇā raṇadbhṛṅgaṇāvṛtāḥ \|*  
*vikacāḥ pratibhāsante jātaḥ sūryodayo dhruvam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. These beautiful lotus flowers are blossomed and surrounded by the humming commonwealth of bees. This scene ipso-facto appears as if it is dawn.

## \|\| 15.31 \|\|

*yathā cāmī vibhāsanti vikacāḥ kumudākarāḥ \|*  
*ato vijñāyate candra uditaśca pratāpavān \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. As the bouquet of lily has blossomed hence, it transpires that the mighty moon has arisen.

## \|\| 15.32 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃbhāṣatāṃ tatra sūryo vākyānī nārada \|*  
*amanyata kimetaddhi loko vakti śubhāśubham \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Narada! God sun began to think on the opinions so given by different classes of people; that is why these are so different in approach and saying just the reverse to the reality.

## \|\| 15.33 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃcintya bhagavān dadhyau dhyānaṃ divākaraḥ \|*  
*āsamantājjagad grastaṃ trailokyaṃ rajanīcaraiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. God sun was engrossed in this thinking and saw in concentration that the entire territory of three-world has slept in the grip of monsters all around.

## \|\| 15.34 \|\|

*tatastu bhagavāñjñātvā tedajaso 'pyasahiṣṇutām \|*  
*niśācarasya vṛddhiṃ tāmacintayata yogavit \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Having understood properly the rapid progress of monsters and intolerance to their splendour, he began to think on an action plan.

## \|\| 15.35 \|\|

*tato 'jñāsīcca tān sarvān sadācāraratāñśucīn \|*  
*devabrāhmaṇapūjāsu saṃsaktān dharmasaṃyutān \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. As a result of the thorough investigation, he concluded that all monsters are enlightened, holy by deeds and worship god and Brahmanas. Thus, he saw that those are religion-abiding.

## \|\| 15.36 \|\|

*tatastu rakṣaḥkṣayakṛt timiradvipakesarī \|*  
*mahāṃśunakharaḥ sūryastadvighātamacintayat \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The sun god known as the destroyer of monsters and analogous to the lion with sharp nails of his beams for elephant-like dark began to ponder over suitable tricks to destroy monsters.

## \|\| 15.37 \|\|

*jñātavāṃśca tataśchidraṃ rākṣasānāṃ divaspatiḥ \|*  
*svadharmavicyutirnāma sarvadharmavighātakṛt \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. God sun at last came to ask to search out loopholes helpful enough to breach their religion-abiding nature. Such a shortcoming can destroy all religions.

## \|\| 15.38 \|\|

*tataḥ krodhābhibhūtena bhānunā ripubhedibhiḥ \|*  
*bhānubhī rākṣasapuraṃ tad dṛṣṭaṃ ca yathaicchayā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The sun so annoyed then watched in depth that monster city through his beams competent in killing the enemy.

## \|\| 15.39 \|\|

*sa bhānunā tadā dṛṣṭaḥ krodhādhmātena catruṣā \|*  
*nipapātāmbarād bhraṣṭaḥ kṣīṇapuṇya iva grahaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. That city so gazed at with furious eyes by lord sun fell immediately down from the sky like a star lost on account of noble deeds (punya).

## \|\| 15.40 \|\|

*patamānaṃ samālokya puraṃ śālakaṭaṅkaṭaḥ \|*  
*namo bhavāya śarvāya idamuccairudīrayat \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Having seen his city so falling Salakatankat a (Sukesi) chanted the hymn "namo bhavaya sarvaya" with a loud voice.

## \|\| 15.41 \|\|

*tamākranditamākarṇya cāraṇā gaganecarāḥ \|*  
*hā deti cukruśuḥ sarve harabhaktaḥ patatyasau \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. All caranas (soothsayers) moving in the sky cried when they heard about that commotion created by the monsters in pain with these words- "Oh! Oh! this Siva's devotee is falling down!

## \|\| 15.42 \|\|

*taccāraṇavacaḥ śarvaḥ śrutavān sarvago 'vyayaḥ \|*  
*śrutvā saṃcintayāmāsa kenāsau pātyate bhuvi \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Omnipresent imperishable Sarva (Sartkara) heard the cries so made by caranas and began to think as to who may be so cruel as to dash him down on the earth.

## \|\| 15.43 \|\|

*jñātavān devapatinā sahasrakiraṇena tat \|*  
*pātitaṃ rākṣasapuraṃ tataḥ kruddhastrilocanaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Не came to know very soon that it is sun- god who has dashed down that city of monster. He was filled with anger.

## \|\| 15.44 \|\|

*kruddhastu bhagavantaṃ taṃ bhānumantamapaśyata \|*  
*dṛṣṭamātrastriṇetreṇa nipapāta tato 'mabarāt \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The furious lord Siva threw his gaze at sun and within no time he fell down on the earth.

## \|\| 15.45 \|\|

*gaganāt sa paribhraṣṭaḥ pathi vāyuniṣevite \|*  
*yadṛcchayā nipatito yantramukto yathopalaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Dashed from sky, the sun-god began to fall like a stone sprung up in the route where void has existed (viz. there is absence of air).

## \|\| 15.46 \|\|

*tato vāyupathānmuktaḥ kiṃśukojjvalavigrahaḥ \|*  
*nipapātāntarikṣāt sa vṛtaḥ kinnaracāraṇaiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Then he crossed the route where air has existed and now began to fall down from space. His body was as white as a flower of canker bloom and he was surrounded by Kinnaras and Caranas.

## \|\| 15.47 \|\|

*cāraṇerveṣṭito bhānuḥ pravibhātyambarāt patan \|*  
*arddhapakvaṃ yathā tālāt phalaṃ kapibhirāvṛtam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. While falling down from space, god sun appeared like a half-ripened fruit of Tala tree surrounded by monkeys. This is because he was surround by Kinnaras and Caranas.

## \|\| 15.48 \|\|

*tatastu ṛṣayo 'bhyetya pratyūcurbhānumālinam \|*  
*nipatasva harikṣetre yadi śreyo 'bhivāñchasi \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The sages then approached the sim and suggested that for the cause of welfare he should fall in the territory belonging to Hari.

## \|\| 15.49 \|\|

*tato 'vravīt patanneva vivasvāṃstāṃstapodhanān \|*  
*kiṃ tat kṣetraṃ hareḥ puṇyaṃ vadadhvaṃ śīghrameva me \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Sun while falling speedily asked those sages- "Tell me immediately where has that holy territory of Hari existed?"

## \|\| 15.50 \|\|

*tamūcurmunayaḥ sūryaṃ śṛṇu kṣetraṃ mahāphalam \|*  
*sāmprataṃ vāsudevasya bhāvi tacchaṅkarasya ca \|\| 50 \|\|*
