*nīlāśca keśāḥ kuṭilāśca tasya karṇau samāṃsau susamā ca nāsā \|*  
*dīrghāśca tasyāṅgulayaḥ suparvāḥ padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ daśanāśca subhrāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. His hair is blue and curly, both ears are fleshy, soild nose, fingers of hands and toes of feet are beautiful with nodes and long in size and his teeth are all white.

## \|\| 21.53 \|\|

*samunnataḥ ṣaḍbhirudāravīryastribhirgabhīrastripu ca pralambaḥ \|*  
*raktastathā pañcasu rājaputraḥ kṛṣṇaścaturbhistribhirānato 'pi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. That valorous king is unnata from six places, gambhira from three places, long from three other places, red from five places, dark from four places and humble (bent) from three places.

## \|\| 21.54 \|\|

*dvābhyāṃ ca śuklaḥ surābhiścaturbhiḥ dṛśyanti padmāni daśaiva cāsya \|*  
*vṛtaḥ sa bhartā bhagavān hi pūrvaṃ taṃ rājaputraṃ bhuvi saṃvicintya \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. He is white at three places and fragrant at four places. Lotus marks are visible at his ten places. О lord! I have already determined to be the bride of that king on the earth.

## \|\| 21.55 \|\|

*dadasva māṃ nātha tapasvine 'smai guṇopapannāya samīhitāya \|*  
*nehānyakāmāṃ pravadanti santo dātuṃ tathānyasya vibho kṣamasva \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. О lord! Offer me to that austere and meritorious king only as the scholars say that the virgin passionate to any particular man should not be offered to other. О sovereign! I bid apology if you see any mistake in my statement.

## \|\| 21.56 \|\|

*devadeva uvāca \|*  
*ityevamuktaḥ savituśca putryā ṛṣistadā dhyānaparo babhūva \|*  
*jñātvā ca tatrārkasutāṃ sakāmāṃ mudā yuto vākyamidaṃ jagāda \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Lord Visnu said- The austere hermit did meditation on the matter, became happy to know her attachment for Samvarana and replied-

## \|\| 21.57 \|\|

*sa eva putri nṛpatestanūjo dṛṣṭaḥ purā kāmayase yamadya \|*  
*sa eva cāyāti mamāśramaṃ vai ṛkṣātmajaḥ saṃvaraṇo hi nāmnā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. О daughter! You had seen the same king in the forest for which you have been brought here. That Samvarana, the son of Rksa is coming soon to my asrama.

## \|\| 21.58 \|\|

*athājagāma sa nṛpasya putrastamāśramaṃ brāhmaṇapuṅkavasya \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā sthitastvapaśyat tapatīṃ narendraḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Shortly that king came to the asrama of Vasistha. He bowed his head before Vasistha, saluted with sheer obeisance and saw Tapati there.

## \|\| 21.59 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā ca tāṃ padmaviśālanetrāṃ tāṃ pūrvadṛṣṭāmiti cintayitvā \|*  
*papraccha keyaṃ lalanā dvijendra sa vāruṇiḥ prāha narādhipendram \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He thought he had already seen her when he watched her huge lotus eyes. He asked- "O divine! Who is this spinster?" Vasistha, the son of Varuna replied.

## \|\| 21.60 \|\|

*iyaṃ vivasvadduhitā narendra nāmnā prasiddhā tapatī pṛthivyām \|*  
*mayā tavārthāya divākaro 'rthitaḥ prādānmayā tvāśramamānininye \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O King! This is the daughter of sun popularly known as Tapati on the earth. Lord sun offered her to me when I so requested for you and thus, she is brought here.

## \|\| 21.61 \|\|

*tasmāt masuttiṣcha narendra devyāḥ pāṇiṃ tapatyā vidhivad gṛhāṇa \|*  
*ityevamukto nṛpatiḥ prahṛṣṭo jagrāha pāṇiṃ vidhivat tapatyāḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Hence, О King! Prepare yourself soon to solemnise marriage with Tapati. The king overflowed with joy and solemnise marriage with Tapati with exercise of all rites prescribed for marriage.

## \|\| 21.62 \|\|

*sā taṃ patiṃ prāpya mano 'bhirāmaṃ sūryāmajā śakrasamāprabhāvam \|*  
*rarāma tanvī bhavanottameṣu yatā mahaindraṃ divi daityakanyā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. That Tapati (daughter of sun) began to live in the palace with her beautiful and meritorious husband so happily as if Paulomi (daughter of a monster) enjoyed pleasure with Mahendra in the heaven.

## Chapter 22. Glorification of Brahma-saras

## \|\| 22.1 \|\|

*devadeva uvāca \|*  
*tasyāṃ tapatyāṃ narasattamena jātaḥ sutaḥ pārthivalakṣaṇastu \|*  
*sa jātakarmādibhireva saṃskṛto vivarddhatājyena huto yathāgniḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lord Visnu said- "Tapati gave birth to a son, having all characteristics of a king as a result of consummation with that chivalrous Samvarana. His body availed growth as the fire on pouring ghee and all rituals like Jatakarma were executed in due course of time."

## \|\| 22.2 \|\|

*kṛto 'sya cūḍākaraṇaśca devā vipraṇa mitrāvaruṇātmajena \|*  
*navābdikasya vratabandhanaṃ ca vede ca śāstre vidhipārago 'būt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О gods! Vasistha, the son of couple gods Mitra and Varuna, executed the ritual of Cudakarana for him. The ritual of upanayana was carried out when he attained the age of nine years and thus he acquired outstanding knowledge on the Vedas and scriptures in due course of time.

## \|\| 22.3 \|\|

*tataścatuḥpaḍbhirapīha varṣaiḥ sarvajñatāmabhyagamata tato 'sau \|*  
*khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puruṣottamo 'sau nāmnā kuruḥ saṃvaraṇasya putraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He acquired all requisite standard of knowledge at the age of twenty four years. That son of Samvarana got popularity as Kuru in this world.

## \|\| 22.4 \|\|

*tato narapatirdṛṣṭvā dharmikaṃ tanayaṃ śubham \|*  
*dārakriyārthamakarod yatnaṃ śubhakule tataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The king Samvarana then wished to see the marriage of his learned and meritorious son with a virgin from a noble family.

## \|\| 22.5 \|\|

*sodāminīṃ sudāmnastu sutāṃ rūpādhikāṃ napaḥ \|*  
*kurorarthāya vatavān sa prādāt kurave 'pi tām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He thought fit Saudamani, the daughter of Sudama for his meritorious son Kuru in his search for a bride and Sudama on his part had also given due consent.

## \|\| 22.6 \|\|

*sa tāṃ nṛpasutāṃ labdhvā dharmārthāvavirodhayan \|*  
*reme tanvyā saha tayā paulomyā maghavāniva \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Kuru began to enjoy the pleasures of conjugal life as Paulomi (Saci) with Indra in heaven by taking care of the limits drawn in Dharma and Artha (the essence). He was extremely happy with Saudamani, his wife.

## \|\| 22.7 \|\|

*tato narapatiḥ putraṃ rājyabhārakṣamaṃ balī \|*  
*viditvā yovarājyāya vidhānenābhyaṣecayat \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The king then made him crowned prince as he thought him competent to handle the affairs of state aptly.

## \|\| 22.8 \|\|

*tato rājye 'bhiṣiktastu kuruḥ pitrā nije pade \|*  
*pālayāmāsa sa mahīṃ putravacca svayaṃ prajāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Having so enthroned and assigned with all affairs of the state, Kuru began ruling the earth and subject with the same spirit as a father for his children.

## \|\| 22.9 \|\|

*sa eva kṣetrapālo 'bhūt paśupālaḥ sa eva hi \|*  
*sa sarvapālakaścāsīt prajāpālo mahābalaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He became the most powerful king having a strong command on territory, great ruler, good administrator and just.

## \|\| 22.10 \|\|

*tato 'sya buddhirupannā kīrtirloke garīyasī \|*  
*yāvatkīrtiḥ susaṃsthā hi tāvadvāsaḥ suraiḥ saha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. With the passage of time he came to know that fame is supreme to acquire in this world. Divine dwelling stands for the time, the account of fame is not over.

## \|\| 22.11 \|\|

*sa tvevaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭho yāthātathyamavekṣya ca \|*  
*vicacāra mahīṃ sarvāṃ kīrtyarthaṃ tu narādhipaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. After giving due thought to the factual aspects, that king decided to move around the entire earth in order to acquire fame.

## \|\| 22.12 \|\|

*tato dvaitavanaṃ nāma puṇyaṃ lokeśvaro balī\|*  
*tadāsādya susaṃtuṣṭo viveśābhyāntaraṃ tataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In course of his tours, that powerful king reached Dvaitavana and wished to see interior of the forest.

## \|\| 22.13-14 \|\|

*tatra devīṃ dadarśātha puṇyāṃ pāpavimocanīm \|*  
*plakṣajāṃ brahmaṇaḥ putrīṃ harijihvāṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sudarśanasya jananīṃ hvandaṃ kṛtvā suvistaram \|*  
*sthitāṃ bhagavatīṃ kūle tīrthakoṭibhirāplutām \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. He saw there goddess Sarasvati, the holy river emanating from the Plaksa tree, the tongue of Hari (Harijihva), daughter of Brahma, mother of Sudarsana, flowing on a broadened bed and surrounded by several crore holy places at her bank.

## \|\| 22.15 \|\|

*tasyāstajjalamīkṣyaiva snātvā prīto 'bhavannṛpaḥ \|*  
*samājagāma ca punaḥ brahmaṇo vedimuttarām \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The king took a dip in that river and his body felt unprecedented cool and fresh. Then he went to the altar of Brahma (syamantapancaka) existed at the north.

## \|\| 22.16 \|\|

*samantapañcakaṃ nāma dharmasthānamanuttamam \|*  
*ākamantād yojanāni pañca ca sarvataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. That holy place Samantapancaka is spread on a land five yojana each from four sides.

## \|\| 22.17 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*kiyantyo vedayaḥ santi brahmaṇaḥ puruṣottama \|*  
*yenottaratayā vedirgāditā sarvapañcakā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The gods said- "O Purusottama! How many altars has Brahma? As you told Sarvapancaka, the altar at north."

## \|\| 22.18 \|\|

*devadeva uvāca\|*  
*vedayo lokanāthasya pañca dharmasya setavaḥ \|*  
*yāsu yaṣṭaṃ sureśena lokanāthena śaṃbhunā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Lord Visnu said- "Brahma, the creator of the world has five altars existing as a bridge to religion and lord Sambhu had performed yajna on them all."

## \|\| 22.19-20 \|\|

*prayāgo madhyamā vediḥ pūrvā vedirgayāśiraḥ \|*  
*virajā dakṣiṇā vediranantaphaladāyinī \|\| 19 \|\|*

*pratīcī puṣkarā vedistribhiḥ kuṇḍairalaṅkṛtā \|*  
*samantapañcakā coktā vedirevottarāvyayā \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Prayaga is the middle altar, Gayasira, is the altar at east, Viraja is southern altar, Puskara, decorated by three ponds is the western altar and imperishable Syamantapancaka has been said to be the northern altar.

## \|\| 22.21 \|\|

*tamamanyata rājarṣiridaṃ kṣetraṃ mahāphalam \|*  
*kariṣyāmi kṛṣiṣyāmi sarvān kāmān yathepsitān \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The royal saint Kuru thought of making fruit pouring in that area and started cultivating all desires.

## \|\| 22.22 \|\|

*kṛtvā sīraṃ sa sauvarṇaṃ gahya rudravṛṣaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*pauṇḍrakaṃ yāmyamahiṣaṃ svayaṃ karṣitumudyataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He alighted from his chariot with this determination and constructed an unique place for acquisition of fame.

## \|\| 22.23 \|\|

*taṃ karṣantaṃ naravaraṃ samabhyetya takratuḥ \|*  
*provāca rājan kimidaṃ bhavān kartumihodyataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. He made a plough of gold, yoked the bull of lord Sankara and Paundraka buffalo of Yama and prepared himself for ploughing.

## \|\| 22.24 \|\|

*taṃ karṣantaṃ naravaraṃ samabhyetya śatakratuḥ \|*  
*provāca rājan kimidaṃ bhavān kartumihodyataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. In the meantime, Indra appeared there and enquired of the king- "O king! for what purpose are you ready to act here?"

## \|\| 22.25 \|\|

*rājābravīt suravaraṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamāṃ dayām \|*  
*kṛṣāmi śaucaṃ dānaṃ ca yogaṃ ca brahmacāritām \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The king replied- "I intend to grow crops of penance, truth, forgiveness, kindness, purity, generosity, yoga and celibacy here.

## \|\| 22.26 \|\|

*tasyovāca harirdevaḥ kasmādbījo nareśvara \|*  
*labdho 'ṣṭāṅgeti sahasā avahasya gatastataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Indra said- О king! where from did you get this seed consisting of eight parts (things)? With these words, lord Indra smiled and immediately left that place.

## \|\| 22.27 \|\|

*gate 'pi śakra rājarṣirahanyahani sīradhṛk \|*  
*kṛṣate 'nyān samantācca saptakrośān mahīpatiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The king began to plough the field up to seven kosa from each side and adopted it as a regular practice for a long period.

## \|\| 22.28 \|\|

*tato 'hamabruvaṃ gatvā kuro kimidamityatha \|*  
*tadāṣṭāṅgaṃ mahādharmaṃ samākhyātaṃ nṛpeṇa hi \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Then one day I also visited there and asked- "O Kuru! what are you doing?" The king replied- "I am cultivating the great religion consisting of eight limbs."

## \|\| 22.29-31 \|\|

*tato mayāsya gaditaṃ nṛpa bījaṃ kva tiṣṭhati \|*  
*sa cāha mama dehasthaṃ bījaṃ tamahamabruvam \|*  
*dehyahaṃ vāpayiṣyāmi sīraṃ kṛṣatu vai bhavān \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tato nṛpatinā bāhurdakṣiṇaḥ prasṛtaḥ kataḥ \|*  
*prasṛtaṃ taṃ bhujaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā cakreṇa vegataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*sahasradhā tataśchidya datto yuṣmākameva hi \|*  
*tataḥ savyo bhujo rājñā dattaś chinno 'pyasau mayā \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. I then asked further- "O king! Where is that seed?" The king replied- "It is within my body." I requested- "Give me that seed as I will assist you in sowing and you with plough the field." The king stretched his right arm. I immediately cut-off that arm through discus in several thousand pieces and gave them to you all. Then the king stretched his left arm. I also cut-off that in several micro pieces.

## \|\| 22.32 \|\|

*tathaivoruyugaṃ prādānmayā chinnau ca tāvubhau \|*  
*tataḥ sa me śiraḥ prādāt tena prīte 'smi tasya ca \|*  
*varado 'smītyathetyukte kururvaramayācata \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He then offered both thighs to which I also cut into pieces. He then offered his head and I was pleased with him and he asked blessing when I undertook for that.

## \|\| 22.33 \|\|

*yāvadetanmayā kṛṣṭaṃ dharmakṣetraṃ tadastu ca \|*  
*snātānāṃ ca mṛtānāṃ ca mahāpuṇyaphalaṃ tviha \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Kuru said- May the land so ploughed by me become popular as a holy place and the persons taking a bath and dying here attain great blessings for their noble deeds.

## \|\| 22.34-35 \|\|

*upavāsaṃ ca dānaṃ ca snānaṃ japyaṃ ca mādhava \|*  
*homayajñādikaṃ cānyacchubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vibho \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tvatprasāddhṛṣīkeśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara \|*  
*akṣayaṃ pravare kṣetre bhavatvatra mahāphalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. О Madhava! О sovereign god! О Hrsikesa with conch and discus in hands! the activities like fast, donation, bath, japa, havana, yajna etc. and even the evils may bestow undepleting fruits under your grace.

## \|\| 22.36-37 \|\|

*tathā bhavān suraiḥ sārdhaṃ samaṃ devena śalinā \|*  
*vasa tvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa mannāmavyañjake 'cyuta \|*  
*ityevamuktastenāhaṃ rājñā bāḍhamuvāca tam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tathā ca tvaṃ divyavapurbhava bhūyo mahīpate \|*  
*tathāntakāle māmeva layaṭameṣyasi suvrata \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. "And О Pundarikaksa! О Acyuta! this place known after my name (Kuruksetta) should be made residence by you with Sankara and other gods. I request for your grace." I nodded positive and then blessed- "O king! receive again the divine body and О resolute! I bless that you will merge with me after death."

## \|\| 22.38 \|\|

*kīrtiśca śāśvatī tubhyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tatraiva yājakā yajñān yajiṣyanti sahasraśaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Your fame shall remain everlasting here undoubtedly. Several thousand people shall host yajna here.

## \|\| 22.39-40 \|\|

*tasya kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ dadau sa puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*yakṣaṃ ca candranāmānaṃ vāsukiṃ cāpi pannagam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vidyādharaṃ śaṅkukarṇaṃ sukeśiṃ rākṣaseśvaram \|*  
*ajāvanaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ mahodevaṃ ca pāvakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Lord Visnu appointed the demi-god Candra, Vasuki serpent, Sankukarna, Vidyadhara, Sukesi demon king, Ajavana, the king and Mahadeva, the fire for defending that holy place.

## \|\| 22.41 \|\|

*etāni sarvato 'bhyetya rakṣanti kurujāṅgalam \|*  
*amīṣāṃ balino 'nye ca bhṛtyāścaivānuyāyinaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. All the above including their attendants and followers defend Kurujangala from all directions.

## \|\| 22.42 \|\|

*aṣṭau sahasrāṇi dharanurdharāṇāṃ ye vārayantīha suduṣkṛtān vai \|*  
*snātuṃ na yacchanti mahograrūpāstavanyasya bhūtāḥ sacarācarāṇām \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The archers, eight thousand in number, restrict the entrance of evil-doers and they do not allow the sinners of this mobile and inert world of creatures to take a dip in the holy

## \|\| 22.43 \|\|

*tasyaiva madhye bahupuṇya uktaḥ pṛthūdakaḥ pāpaharaḥ śivaśca \|*  
*puṇyā nadī prāṅmukhatāṃ prayātā yatraughayuktasya śubhā jatāḍhyā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. There is a holy place Prthudaka just at the centre of it. A holy river with clean water flows from here towards east.

## \|\| 22.44 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ prajeyaṃ prapitāmahena sṛṣṭā samaṃ bhūtagaṇaiḥ samastaiḥ \|*  
*mahī jalaṃ vahnisamīrameva khaṃ tvevamādau vibabhau pṛthūdakaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Lord Brahma had created at the initial phase of creating the earth, water, fire, air and ether etc. all organisms in this holy place and it is called Prthudaka.

## \|\| 22.45 \|\|

*sarve tathā toyadhayo mahānta-stīrthāmi nadyaḥ svaṇāḥ sarāsi \|*  
*saṃnirbhitānīha mahābhujena sadevamārgaḥ salilaṃ hi teṣu \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Waters of all great oceans, holy places, rivers, springs and reservoirs created by lord Brahma are assembled with the water of this holy place.

## \|\| 22.46 \|\|

*devadeva uvāca*  
*sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyorantare kurujāṅgale \|*  
*sunipravaramāsīnaṃ purāṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam \|*  
*aṣṭacchanta dvijavarāḥ prabhāvaṃ sarasastadā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Lord Visnu said- During ancient period, the Brahmins asked the old hermit Lomaharsana about the magnificence of reservoir (sarovara). He was then living at Kurujangala, a place located between Sarasvati and Drsadvati.

## \|\| 22.47 \|\|

*pramāṇaṃ saraso brūhi tīrthānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*devatānāṃ ca māhātmyamutpattiṃ vāmanasya ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. (They requested)- Describe the expanse of this reservoir, the magnificence pertaining to the holy places and gods residing and the origin of Vamana.

## \|\| 22.48 \|\|

*etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ romaharṣasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*praṇipatya purāṇarṣiridaṃ vacanamavravīt \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Having heard this request from them the highly pleased primeval hermit saluted and said die following words-

## \|\| 22.49 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*brahmaṇamagryaṃ kamalāsanasthaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathā lakṣmisamanvitaṃ ca \|*  
*rudraṃ ca devaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā tīrthaṃ mahad brahmasaraḥ pravakṣye \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Lomaharsana said- I describe the great holy place of Brahmasara with the expression of my humble salute to lord Brahma seated on the lotus, Visnu with Laksmi and lord Mahadeva.

## \|\| 22.50 \|\|

*rantukādaujasaṃ yāvat pāvanācca caturmukham \|*  
*saraḥ saṃnihitaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvameva tu \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Brahma had stated long ago that this reservoir is extended from Rantuka to Aujasa and from Pavana to Caturmukha.

## \|\| 22.51 \|\|

*kalidvāparayormadhye vyāsena ca mahātmanā \|*  
*saraḥpramāṇaṃ yatproktaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О great Dvijas! Listen to the dimension of this reservoir as told by the great soul Vyasa during the middle period of Kali and Dvapara (the age).

## \|\| 22.52 \|\|

*viśveśvarādasthipuraṃ rathā kanyā jaradgavī \|*  
*yāvadoghavatī proktā tāvatsaṃnihitaṃ saraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. This reservoir extends in the length from Vis'ves'vara to Astipura and from Kanya Jaradgavi to Oghavati.

## \|\| 22.53 \|\|

*mayā śrutaṃ pramāṇaṃ yat paṭhyamānaṃ tu vāmane \|*  
*tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ puṇyaṃ vṛddhikaraṃ mahat \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О great Dvijas! Listen to the authoritative dimension, as I heard from Vamana Purana.

## \|\| 22.54 \|\|

*viśveśvarād devavarā nṛpāvanāt sarasvatī \|*  
*saraḥ saṃnihitaṃ jñeyaṃ samantādarthayojanam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. This reservoir spread a yojana each from all sides should be considered in expanse from Visvesvara to Devavara and from Nrpavana to the Sarasvati.

## \|\| 22.55 \|\|

*etadāśritya devāśca ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ \|*  
*sevante muktikāmārthaṃ svargārthe cāpare sthitāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The gods and hermits resort to it and use the water of this reservoir with sole desire of emancipation and other people reside here with a desire to attain heaven after death.

## \|\| 22.56 \|\|

*brahmaṇā sevitamidaṃ sṛṣṭikāmena yoginā \|*  
*viṣṇunā sthitikāmena harirūpeṇa sevitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Yogi Brahma had used this water for creation and Visnu as Hari sipped it for the proper maintenance of the world.

## \|\| 22.57 \|\|

*rudreṇa ca saromadhyaṃ praviṣṭena mahātmanā \|*  
*sevya tīrthaṃ mahātejāḥ sthāṇutvaṃ prāptavān haraḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The great soul Rudra entered at its middle portion and sipped the holy water. He thus attained the essence of being Sthanu.

## \|\| 22.58 \|\|

*ādyaiṣā brahmaṇo vedistato rāmahṛdaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*karuṇā ca yataḥ kṛṣṭaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ smṛtam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. It was initially an altar of Brahma but subsequently, it was addressed as "Ramahrada". Later on it was ploughed by Kuru and since then popularly known as Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 22.59 \|\|

*tarantukārantukayoryadantaraṃ yadantaraṃ rāmahṛdāccaturmukham \|*  
*etkurukṣetrasamantapañcakaṃ pitāmahasyottaravedirucyate \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The portion between Tarantuka and Arantuka as also Ramahrada and Caturmukha is Samantapancaka Kuruksetra and this very place is called the north altar of Brahma.

## Chapter 23. Description of Bali’s Coronation as the King of demons

## \|\| 23.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*brūhi vāmanamāhātmyamutpattiṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yathā balirniyamito dattaṃ rājyaṃ śatakratoḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits said- "Describe particularly the magnificence of Vamana and his origin and please explain how lord Vamana had bridled Bali and returned the heaven to Indra which was conquered by him."

## \|\| 23.2 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ prītā vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*utpattiṃ ca prabhāvaṃ ca nivāsaṃ kurujāṅgale \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Lomaharsana said- О sages! listen with pleasure to the origin, magnificence and his dwelling in Kurujangala.

## \|\| 23.3 \|\|

*tadeva vaṃśaṃ daityānāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*yasya vaṃśe samabhavad balirvairocaniḥ purā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О great Dvijas! Further, listen about the demon dynasty in which Bali, the son of Virocana bom in the distant past.

## \|\| 23.4-6 \|\|

*daityānāmādipuruṣo hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā \|*  
*tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma dānavaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tasmād virocano jajñe balirjajñe virocanāt \|*  
*hate hiraṇyakaśipau devānutsādya sarvataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ ca teneṣṭaṃ trailokye sacarācare \|*  
*kṛtayatneṣu deveṣu trailokye daityatāṃ gate \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Long ago, Hiranyakasipu was the king of demons. Prahlada, the valorous demon, was his son. Prahlada was the father of Virocana and Virocana was blessed with Bali as son. On the death of Hiranyakasipu, Bali ruled properly over the three-world as he had defeated the gods from their respective places and positions. The gods however, did tremendous effort to defend but could not stay before the demon army led by Bali, resulting to which three-world was subjugated by demons.

## \|\| 23.7 \|\|

*jaye tathā balavatormayaśambarayostathā \|*  
*śuddhāsu dikṣu sarvāsu pravṛtte dharmakarmaṇi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The mighty Maya and Sambara conquered. Everywhere spread the religious acts and the directions got purity.

## \|\| 23.8-9 \|\|

*saṃpravṛtte daityapathe ayanasthe divākare \|*  
*prahlādaśambaramayairanuhvādena caiva hi \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dikṣu sarvāsu suptāsu gagane daityapālite \|*  
*deveṣu makhaśobhāṃ ca svargasthāṃ darśayatsu ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. God sun too shifted to daksinayana (i.e. favourable to the demons). Prahlada, Sambara, Maya and Anuhrada etc. demons began to defend the state from all directions. The sky too was subjugated by the demons. The gods began to see the yajna then hosted in the heaven.

## \|\| 23.10 \|\|

*prakṛtisthe tato loke vartamāne ca satpathe \|*  
*abhāve sarvapāpānāṃ dharmabhāve sadotthite \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The entire world stood rigid in nature and began compliance of the religion. As evils ceased, the spiritual conscience rooted undeviated.

## \|\| 23.11 \|\|

*catuṣpāde sthite dharme hyadharme pādavigrahe \|*  
*prajāpālanayukteṣu bhrājamāneṣu rājasu \|*  
*svadharmasaṃprayukteṣu tathāśramanivāsiṣu \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The religion was duly established in its four segments. The evil reduced to stand on a single segment. All kings took care of their subjects and people from all asramas began to follow the acts prescribed for them as per their respective religion.

## \|\| 23.12 \|\|

*abhiṣikto 'suraiḥ sarvairdaityarājye balistadā \|*  
*hṛṣṭeṣvasurasaṃgheṣu nadatsu muditeṣu ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The demons at this peaceful phase of time, enthroned Bali and the community of demons as a whole celebrated festivities at that auspicious moment.

## \|\| 23.13 \|\|

*athābhyupagatā lakṣmīr baliṃ padmāntaraprabhā \|*  
*padmodyatakarā devī varadā supraveśinī \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Laksmi, the goddess having radiance of lotus petal, who blessed with wealth came to Bali. A lotus flower was in her hand.

## \|\| 23.14 \|\|

*śrīruvāca*  
*bale balavatāṃ śreṣṭha daityarāja mahādyute \|*  
*prītāsmi tava bhadraṃ te devarājaparājaye \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Laksmi said- О great victorious king! О valorous demon king! I am graceful to you for the defeat that you gave to Indra. I bless you with all good things.

## \|\| 23.15 \|\|

*yattvayā yudhi vikramya devarājyaṃ parājitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ sattvaṃ tato 'haṃ svayamāgatā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Since you have conquered the divine state by virtue of the valour you showed in the battle-field, I have therefore, came to see you.

## \|\| 23.16 \|\|

*nāścaryaṃ dānavavyāghra hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kule \|*  
*prasūtasyāsurendrasya tava karme damīdṛśam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O great demon! It's not so surprising a matter as you were bom in the family of the demon king Hiranyakasipu.

## \|\| 23.17 \|\|

*viśeṣitastvayā rājan daityendraḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*yena bhuktaṃ hi nikhilaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О king! You are more peculiar them your great grandfather Hiranyakasipu because you are ruling over the three-world entirely.

## \|\| 23.18 \|\|

*evamuktvā tu sā devī lakṣmīrdaityanṛpaṃ balim \|*  
*praviṣṭā varadā sevyā sarvadevamanoramā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. With these words addressed to Bali, that Laksmi goddess entered with him- the goddess worshipped by all gods, who is worth adoration, is a favourite and gracious to all.

## \|\| 23.19-21 \|\|

*tuṣṭāśca devyaḥ pravarāḥ hrīḥ kīrtirdyutireva ca \|*  
*prabhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā bhūtir ṛddhirdivyā mahāmatiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śrutiḥsmṛtiriḍā kīrtiḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistathā kriyā \|*  
*sarvāścapsaraso divyā nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prapadyante sma daityendraṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram \|*  
*prāptamaiśvaryamatulaṃ balinā brahmavādinā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. All great goddesses Hri, Kirti, Dyuti, Prabha, Dhrti, Ksama, Bhuti, Rddhi, Divya, Mahamati, Sruti, Smriti, Ida, Santi, Pusti, Kriya and the nymphs expert at singing and dance then were pleased with Bali and they began to serve him in varied ways. Thus, Bali the follower of Brahma obtained the unique prosperity of the entire three-world.

## Chapter 24. Victory of Bali on gods

## \|\| 24.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*devānāṃ brūhi naḥ karma yadvṛttāste parājitāḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ devātidevo 'sau viṣṇurvāmanatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits said- Please, tell us what activity caused such a defeat for the gods and how the god Visnu became Vamana.

## \|\| 24.2 \|\|

*balisaṃsthaṃ ca trailokyaṃ dṛṣṭvā devaḥ purandaraḥ\| meruprasthaṃ yayau śakraḥ svamāturnilayaṃ śubham \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When Indra saw that the three-world has been subjugated by Bali, he went to his mother who was then living on mountain Meru, all safe as a residence.

## \|\| 24.3 \|\|

*samīpaṃ prāpya mātuśca kathayāmāsa tāṃ giram \|*  
*ādityāśca yathā yuddhe dānavena parājitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He described the complete events pertaining to the battle against demons which resulted in defeat for the gods when he safely reached there before his mother.

## \|\| 24.4 \|\|

*yadyevaṃ putra yuṣmābhirna śakyo hantumāhave \|*  
*balirvirocanasutaḥ sarvaiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Aditi said- О son! you cannot kill Bali, the son of Virocana even if you join gods with Marudganas if the state of affair is so dangerous.

## \|\| 24.5 \|\|

*sahasraśirasā śakyaḥ kevalaṃ hantumāhave \|*  
*tenaikena sahasrākṣa na sa hyanyena śakyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О thousand-eyed son! Only a thousand heads (lord Visnu) can kill him in the battle and he cannot be killed by any other ways.

## \|\| 24.6 \|\|

*tadvat pṛcchāmi pitaraṃ kaśyapaṃ brahmavādinam\| parājayārthaṃ daityasya balestasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. I will ask your father Kasyapa, follower of Brahma, for the defeat of that great soul Bali.

## \|\| 24.7-11 \|\|

*tato 'dityā saha surāḥ paṃprāptāḥ kaśyapāntikam \|*  
*tatrāpaśyanta mārīcaṃ muniṃ dīptataponidhim \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ādyaṃ devaguruṃ divyaṃ pradīptaṃ brahmavarcasā \|*  
*tejasā bhāskarākāraṃ sthitamagniśikhopamam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nyastadaṇḍaṃ tapoyuktaṃ baddhakṛṣṇājināmbaram \|*  
*valkalājinasaṃvītaṃ pradīptamiva tejasā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*hutāśamiva dīpyantamājyagandhapuraskṛtam \|*  
*svādhyāyavantaṃ pitaraṃ vapuṣmantamivānalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*brahmavādisatyavādisurāsuraguruṃ prabhum \|*  
*brāhmaṇyāpratimaṃ lakṣmyā kaśyapaṃ dīptatejasam \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. The gods then went to Kasyapa who was filled with splendour, austerity, the son of sage Marici, glowing with the radiance of Brahma, who was Devaguru, the first bom Purusa. His aura was like the sun beams, his body was blazing with tremendous flame like the fire of sacrifice. He was pondered over perseverance, follower of Brahma, truthful, preceptor of gods and demons alike and his influence was great because of having been graced by Laksmi.

## \|\| 24.12 \|\|

*yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvalokānāṃ prajānāṃ patiruttamaḥ \|*  
*ātmabhāvaviśeṣeṇa tṛtīyo yaḥ prajāpatiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He is the third Prajapati on account of being his creator of the three worlds, the best Prajapati and spiritually being great.

## \|\| 24.13 \|\|

*atha praṇamya te vīrāḥ sahādityā surarṣabhāḥ \|*  
*ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve brahmāṇamiva mānasāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. All gods went in the company of Aditi saluted him and reported the following matter as Narada reported the matter to his father i.e. Brahma.

## \|\| 24.14 \|\|

*ajeyo yudhi śakreṇa balirdaityo balādhikaḥ \|*  
*tasmād vidhatta naḥ śreyo devānāṃ puṣṭivardhanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Indra has been defeated by the mightiest demon Bali. Hence, suggest the measures benevolent for the gods now so that they could become more powerful.

## \|\| 24.15 \|\|

*śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*akarod gamane buddhi brahmalokāya lokakṛt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Kasyapa, the creator of world (loka) decided to visit the abode of Brahma for appropriate suggestions in the matter.

## \|\| 24.16 \|\|

*kaśyapa uvāca*  
*śakra gacchāma sadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramādbhutam \|*  
*tathā parājayaṃ sarve brahmaṇaḥ khyātumudyatāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Kasyapa said- О Indra! Let us go to the most excellent abode of lord Brahma land report the matter there immediately.

## \|\| 24.17 \|\|

*sahādityā tato devāyātāḥ kāśyapamāśramam \|*  
*prasthitā brahmasadanaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. All gods went with Aditi to that asrama then marched quickly towards the abode of Brahma duly protected and surrounded by the hermits.

## \|\| 24.18 \|\|

*te muhūrtena saṃprāptā brahmalokaṃ suvarcasaḥ \|*  
*divyaiḥ kāmagamairyānairyathārhaiste mahābalāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. All those gods, mighty and brilliant reached there within seconds through their divine aircraft operated merely by the desire.

## \|\| 24.19 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ draṣṭumicchantastaporāśinamavyāyam \|*  
*adhyagacchanta vistīrṇā brahmaṇaḥ paramāṃ sabhām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Those people so desirous to see lord Brahma entered into the assembly hall spacious enough to sit and discuss.

## \|\| 24.20 \|\|

*ṣaṭpadodgītamadhurāṃ sāmagaiḥ samudīritām \|*  
*śreyaskarīmamitraghnīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjahṛṣustadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. They were pleased to see the auditorium from where the murmuring sound of bees was coming out from chanting Sama, a place all benevolent and worth killing the enemies.

## \|\| 24.21 \|\|

*ṛco bahvacamukhyaiśca proktāḥ kramapadākṣarāḥ \|*  
*śuśruvurvibudhavyāghrā vitateṣu ca karmasu \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Those gods heard the Reas of the Rgveda chanted systematically by the best scholars in course of executing several intensive rituals there.

## \|\| 24.22 \|\|

*yajñavidyāvedavidaḥ padakramavidastathā \|*  
*svareṇa paramarṣiṇāṃ sā babhūva praṇāditā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The auditorium echoed continuous with the voice of the supreme hermits, well learned in the Vedas, the procedure of yajna.

## \|\| 24.23-25 \|\|

*yajñasaṃstavavidbhiśca śikṣāvidbhistathā dvijaiḥ \|*  
*chandasāṃ caiva cārthajñaiḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*lokāyatikamukhyaiśca śuśruvuḥ svaramīritam \|*  
*tatra tatra ca viprendrā niyatāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*japahomaparā mukhyā dadṛśuḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ \|*  
*tasyāṃ sabhāyāmāste sa brahma lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. The gods heard the voice of the expert in saihstaras of yajna, the educationist (learned), the scholars learned in the meaning of Vedic hymns, the Dvijas expert in all learning and experienced in the best Lokayatikas. They all were chanting hymns. The sons of Kasyapa saw there the best Brahmins who were expert at executing japa, havana in an orderly manner. Lokapitamaha Brahma was seated in that auditorium.

## \|\| 24.26 \|\|

*surāsuraguruḥ śrīmān vidyayā vedamāyayā \|*  
*upāsanta ca tatraiva prajānāṃ patayaḥ prabhum \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The Prajapatis present there were adoring lord Brahma who is the preceptor to the gods and demons alike and enriched with Vidya (learning) and Vedamaya.

## \|\| 24.27-33 \|\|

*dakṣaḥ pracetāḥ pulaho marīciśca dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca gautamo nāradastathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*vidyāstathāntarikṣaṃ ca vāyustejo jalaṃ maho \|*  
*śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*prakṛtiśca vikāraśca yaccānyat kāraṇaṃ mahat \|*  
*sāṅgopāṅgāśca catvāro vedā lokapatistathā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nayāśca kratavaścaiva saṅkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca \|*  
*ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svayaṃbhuvamupāsate \|\| 30 \|\|*

*artho dharmaśya kāmaśca krodho harṣaśca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*sakro bṛhaspatiścaiva saṃvarta'tha budhastathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*śanāścaraśca rāhuśca grahāḥ sarve vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*maruto viśvakarmā ca vasavaśca dvijottamāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*divākaraśca somaśca divā rātristathaiva ca \|*  
*arddhamāsāśca māsāśca ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ ca saṃsthitāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

27-33. O the great Dvijas! Lord Brahma was being worshipped by Daksa, Praceta, Pulaha, Marici, Bhrgu, Atri, Vasistha, Gautama and Narada, all learnings, the ether, air, splendour, water, earth, word, touch, complexion, essence and smell, nature, deformation, another great causes, the four Vedas with their angas (parts) and lokapati, ethics, offering, resolution, breathing (prana) and by numerous others. О great dvijas! Artha, Dharma, Kama, anger, gaiety, Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, Saturn and demon head stars were also present in an orderly manner there. Marudganas, Visvakarma, Vasu, sun, moon, day, night, fortnight, month and six seasons were also there.

## \|\| 24.34-36 \|\|

*tāṃ praviśya sabhāṃ divyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvakāmikām \|*  
*kaśyapastridaśaiḥ sārddha putrairdharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sarvatejomayīṃ divyāṃ brahmarṣigaṇasevitām \|*  
*brāhmyā śriyā sevyamānām acintyāṃ vigataklamām \|\| 35 \|\|*

*brahmaṇaṃ prakṣya te sarve paramāsanamāsthitam \|*  
*śirobhiḥ praṇatā devaṃ devā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The best among religion abiding hermits Kasyapa entered that auditorium filled with all desires, splendour, brilliance, radiating with splendour of Brahma (the knowledge). It was indescribable and beyond imagination. He turned towards Brahma in that auditorium who was seated on the best chair and saluted him with all hermits known to Brahma.

## \|\| 24.37 \|\|

*tataḥ praṇamya caraṇau niyatāḥ paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śāntā vigatakalmaṣāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. All those resolute attained de-nova mental power; their sins were absolved and they cooled down when they saluted that supreme soul.

## \|\| 24.38 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tu tān surān sarvān kaśyapena sahāgatān \|*  
*āha brahma mahātejā devānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Lord of celestials Brahma said when he saw the gods came there with Kasyapa.

## Chapter 25. Departure of Kasyapa and gods to Ksirasagara

## \|\| 25.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca*  
*yadarthamiha saṃprāpta bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi \|*  
*cintayāmyahamapyagre tadarthaṃ ca mahābalā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said- О mighty gods! I am pondering over the matter earlier for which you all have now come to me.

## \|\| 25.2-3 \|\|

*bhaviṣyati ca vaḥ sarvaṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ yat surottamāḥ \|*  
*balerdānavamukhyasya yo 'sya jetā bhaviṣyati \|\| 2 \|\|*

*na kevalaṃ surādīnāṃ gatirmama sa viśvakṛt \|*  
*trailokyasyāpi netā ca devānāmapi sa prabhuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. О great gods! Your desire shall reap complete success. The creator of the universe who will defeat the demon king Bali is not only the god of gods but I also adore him and consider him saviour. He is the leader of the three-worlds and sovereign to all gods.

## \|\| 25.4 \|\|

*yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ viśveśaśca sanātanaḥ \|*  
*pūrvajo 'yaṃ sadāpyāhurādidevaṃ sanātanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The god of all worlds, forefather to all is also addressed as Sanatana Adideva.

## \|\| 25.5 \|\|

*tandevāpi mahātmānaṃ na viduḥ ko 'pyasāviti \|*  
*devānāsmān śrutiṃ viśvaṃ sa vetti puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The gods etc. do not know that supreme soul but he is well introduced to the gods, myself, Sruti and the universe very well.

## \|\| 25.6-8 \|\|

*tasyaiva tu prasādena pravakṣye paramāṃ gatim \|*  
*yatra yogaṃ samāsthāya tapaścarati duścaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kṣīrodsayottare kūle udīcyāṃ diśi viśvakṛt \|*  
*amṛtaṃ nāma paramaṃ sthānamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*bhavantastatra vai gatvā tapasā śaṃsitavratāḥ \|*  
*amṛtaṃ sthānamāsādya tapaścarata duścaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. I, on his pleasure suggest to you the best measures for resolving your problem. All people go to the best place addressed by scholars as Amrta. It is located at the northern bank of Ksirasagara that falls at north from here. The creator of this universe is seated there in a tough penance under Yoga. You all resolute should at that place and sit in tough penance.

## \|\| 25.9-13 \|\|

*tataḥ śroṣyatha saṃghuṣṭāṃ snigdhagambhīraniḥ svanām \|*  
*uṣṇānte toyadasyeva toyapūrṇasya niḥsvanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*raktāṃ puṣṭakṣarāṃ ramyamābhayāṃ sarvadā śivām \|*  
*vāṇīṃ paramasaṃskāraṃ vadatāṃ brahmavādinām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*divyāṃ satyakarīṃ satyāṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm \|*  
*sarvadevādhidevasya tato 'sau bhāvitātmanaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tasya vratasamāptyāṃ tu yogavratavisarjane \|*  
*amoghaṃ tasya devasya viśvatejo mahātmanaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kasya kiṃ vo varaṃ devā dadāmi varadaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*svāgataṃ vaḥ suraśreṣṭhā matsamīpamupāgatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

9-13. You will hear at the end of the summer season the voice of that lord. It will appear as a thundering cloud, tender with grave sound, filled with love, attractive, impressive words intertwined, all benevolent, processed like the follower of Brahma, divine, truthful and competent to abolish the evils. Thus, when Yogavrata of metaphysician Kasyapa will be over, lord Visnu will address you all- "O gods! I greet you all come to me. I want to bless you. Ask you all the desirous thing and each will definitely receive the same.

## \|\| 25.14-15 \|\|

*tato 'ditiḥ kaśyapaśca gṛhṇīyātāṃ varaṃ tadā \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā pādau tasmai devāya dhīmate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*bhagavāneva naḥ putro bhavatviti prasīda naḥ \|*  
*uktaśca parayā vācā tathāstvati sa vakṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Aditi and Kasyapa then bowed their heads at the feet of lord Brahma and wished that the god might appear as their son with his pleasure. He impliedly fulfil their desire when it is blessed by him.

## \|\| 25.16 \|\|

*devā bruvanti te sarve kasyapo 'ditireva ca \|*  
*tathāstviti surāḥ sarve praṇamya śirasā prabhum \|*  
*śvetadvīpaṃ samuddiśya gatāḥ saumyadiśaṃ prati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Kasyapa, Aditi and all gods accepted unanimously the suggestion, bowed their heads in honour and marched towards north from the Svetadvipa.

## \|\| 25.17 \|\|

*te 'cireṇaiva saṃprāptāḥ kṣīrodaṃ saritāṃ patim \|*  
*yathoddiṣṭaṃ bhagavatā brahmaṇā satyavādinā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. They all reached shortly the bank Ksirasagara as suggested by lord Brahma.

## \|\| 25.18 \|\|

*te krāntāḥ sāgarān sarvān parvatāṃśca sakānanān \|*  
*nadīśca vividhā divyāḥ pṛthivyāṃ te suroktamāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Those gods crossed on their way all oceans of this earth, the mountains surrounded by forests and numerous other divine rivers too.

## \|\| 25.19 \|\|

*apaśyanta tamo ghoraṃ sarvasattvavivarjitam \|*  
*abhāskaramamaryādaṃ tamasā sarvato vṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. They all then saw the land deserted, unseen by the sun, and surrounded by the endless darkness from all sides.

## \|\| 25.20-21 \|\|

*amṛtaṃ sthānamāsādyakaśyapena mahātmanā \|*  
*dīkṣitāḥ kāmadaṃ divyaṃ vrataṃ varṣa sahasrakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prasādārthaṃ sureśāya tasmai yogāya dhīmate \|*  
*nārāyaṇāya devāya sahasrākṣāya bhūtaye \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Whey they finally reached the place known as Amrta, the learned hermit Kasyapa consecrated all gods of Kamadavrata for one thousand years in order for the pleasure of that Yogi, thousand-eyed, benevolent Narayana.

## \|\| 25.22 \|\|

*brahmacaryeṇa maunena sthānavīrāsanena ca \|*  
*krameṇa ca surāḥ sarve tapa ugraṃ samāsthitāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. All gods then sat in strict penance by observing celibacy, silence and in posture of Virasana in an orderly manner.

## \|\| 25.23 \|\|

*kaśyapastatra bhagavān prasādārthaṃ mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*udīrayata vedoktaṃ yamāhuḥ paramaṃ stavam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Lord Kasyapa chanted a Vedic psalm known as the supreme soul Visnu for attaining their grace.

## Chapter 26. Eulogy of Narayana by Kasyapa

## \|\| 26.1 \|\|

*kaśyapa uvāca namo 'stu te devadeva ekaśṛṅga vṛṣārcce sindhuvṛṣa vṛṣākape suravṛṣa anādisaṃbhava rudra kapila viṣvaksena sarvabhūtapate dhruva dharmadharma vaikuṇṭha vṛṣāvarta anādimadhyanidhana dhanañjaya śuciśravaḥ pṛśnitejaḥ nijaya (5) amṛteśaya sanātana tridhāma tuṣita mahātattva lokanātha padmanābha viriñce bahurūpa akṣaya akṣara havyabhuja khaṇḍaparaśo śatakra muñjakeśa haṃsa mahādakṣiṇa hṛṣīkeśa sūkṣma mahāniyamadhara viraja lokapratiṣṭha arūpa agraja dharmaja dharmanābha (10) gabhastinābha śatakratunābha candraratha sūryatejaḥ samudravāsaḥ ajaḥ sahasraśiraḥ sahasrapāda adomukha mahāpuruṣa puruṣottama sahasrabāho sahasramūrte sahasrāsya paruṣottama sahasrabāho sahasramūrte sahasrāsya sahasrasaṃbhava sahasrasattvaṃ tvamāhuḥ \|*  
*puṣpahāsa carama tvameva vauṣaṭ (15) vaṣaṭkāraṃ tvāmāhuragrayaṃ makheṣu prāśitāraṃ sahasradhāraṃ ca bhuśca bhuvaśca svaśca tvameva vedavedya brahmaśaya brāhmaṇapriya tvameva dyaurasi mātariśvāsi dharmo 'si hotā potā mantā netā homahetus tvameva agraya viśvadhāmnā tvameva digbhiḥ subhāṇḍa (20) ijyo 'si sumedho 'si samidhastvameva matir gatir dātā tvamasi \|*  
*mokṣo 'si yogo 'si \|*  
*sṛjasi \|*  
*dhātā paramayajño 'si somo 'si dīkṣito 'si dakṣiṇāsi viśvamasi \|*  
*sthavira hiraṇyanāma nārāyaṇa trinayana ādityavarma ādityatejaḥ mahāpuruṣa (25) puruṣottama ādidedeva suvikrama prabhākara śaṃbho svayaṃbho bhūtādiḥ mahābhūto 'si viśvabhūta viśvaṃ tvameva viśvagoptāsi pavitramasi viśvabhava ūrdhvakarma amṛta divaspate vācaspate ghṛtārce anantakarma vaṃśa pragvaṃśa viśvapāstvameva varārthināṃ varado 'si tvam \|*  
*(30) caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañjabhireva ca \|*  
*hūyate ca punardvābhyāṃ tubhyaṃ hotrātmane namaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Kasyapa prayed- Salute to Ekasrnga, Vrsarci, Sindhuvrsa, Vrsakapi, Suravrsa, Anadisambhava, Rudrakapila, Visvaksena, Sarvabhutapati, Dhruva, Dharmadharma, Vaikuntha, Vrsavartta, Anadimadhyanidhana, Dhananjaya, Sucisrava, Prsniteja, Nijajaya, Amrtesaya, Sanatana, Tridhama, Tusita, Mahatattva, Lokanatha, Padmanabha Virinci, Bahurupa, Aksaya, Aksara, Havyabhuja, Khandaparasu, Sakra, Munjakesa, Hansa, Mahadaksina, Hrsikesa, Suksma, Mahaniyamadhara, Viraja, Lokapratistha, Arupa, Agraja, Dharmaja, Dharmanabha, Gabhastinabha, Satakratunabha, Candraratha, Suryateja, Samudravasa, Aja, Sahastrasira, Sahastrapada, Adhomukha, Mahupurusa, Purusottama, Sahastrabahu, Sahastramurti, Sahastrasya and Sahastrasambhava you are addressed as Sahastrasattva. О Puspahasa, О Carama! you are Vausat and addressed as Vasat. You are Agrayya, Prasitara in yajnas, Sahastradhara, Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah. You are Vedavedya, Brahmasaya, Brahmanapriya, Dyauh, Matarsva, Dharma, Hota, Pota, Manta, Neta and Homahetu. You are Agrayya of Visvateja and Subhanda by directions viz. the directions are embedded with you. You are Ijya, Sumedha, Samidha, Mati, Gati and donor. You are Yoga, emancipation, Strsta, Dhata, Paramayajna, Soma, Diksita, Daksina and the universe. You are Sthavira, Hiranyanabha, Narayana, Trinayana, Adityavarna, Adityateja, Mahapurusa, Purusottama, Adideva, Suvikrama, Prabhakara, Sambhu, Svayambhu, Bhuta etc., Mahabhuta, Visvabhuta and the universe. You are the saviour and protector of this world; you are sacred, Visvabhava, Urdhrakarma, Amrta, Divaspati, Vacaspati, Ghrtarci, Anantakarma, Vansa, Pragvansa, Visvapa and bless the desired object to the devotees. Salute to havi (oblation) receiver as- four (asravaya), four (astu srausad), two (yaja), five (ye yajamahe) and again two (vasat) syllables (thus, total = 7 syllables) because you yourself are Hotra (havana).

## Chapter 27. Grant of boon to Aditi by lord Visnu

## \|\| 27.1-2 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nārāyaṇastu bhagavāñchrutvaivaṃ paramaṃ stavam \|*  
*brahmajñena dvijendreṇa kaśyapena samīritam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*upāca vacanaṃ samyak tuṣṭaḥ puṣṭapadākṣaram \|*  
*śrīmān prītamanā devo yadvadet prabhurīśvaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Lomaharsana said- The psalm so offered and chanted by the learned Dvija Kasyapa had accessed to lord Narayana, he was pleased and said in syllables intertwined with tendemess- O great gods! you ask any desired thing. May you all enjoy welfare, I will give the desire wish to you all.

## \|\| 27.3-4 \|\|

*varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ bhadraṃ vo varado 'smi surottamāḥ \|*  
*kaśyapa uvāca*  
*prīto 'si naḥ suraśreṣṭha sarveṣāmeva niścayaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vāsavasyānujo bhrātā jñātīnāṃ nandivardhanaḥ \|*  
*adityā api ca śrīmān bhagavānasta vai sutaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Kasyapa replied- О great god! We all have determined to ask on your pleasure that you please appear from the womb of Aditi as she desired and become her son as also Indra could see you as his younger brother.

## \|\| 27.5 \|\|

*aditirdevamātā ca etamevārthamuttamam \|*  
*putrārthaṃ varadaṃ prāha bhagavantaṃ varārthinī \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Aditi, the mother of all gods, also begged that lord to see him as her son commensurate with the desire of her husband Kasyapa.

## \|\| 27.6 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ*  
*niḥśreyasārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ daivatānāṃ maheśvara \|*  
*trātā bhartā ca dātā ca śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ sadā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The gods said- О Mahesvara! Please, be a defender, donor, survivor and shelter always for the supreme welfare of us.

## \|\| 27.7 \|\|

*tatastānabravīdviṣṇurdevān kaśyapameva ca \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva yuṣmākaṃ ye bhaviṣyanti śatravaḥ \|*  
*muhūrtamapi te sarve na sthāsyanti mamāgrataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Lord Visnu then said to those gods and Kasyapa- "irrespective of the number of your enemies, those shall not stay even for a moment before me."

## \|\| 27.8-9 \|\|

*hatvāsurāgaṇan sarvān yajñabhāgāgrabhejinaḥ \|*  
*havyādāṃśca surān sarvān kavyādāṃśca pitṛnapi \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kariṣye vibudhaśreṣṭhāḥ pārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā \|*  
*yathāyātena sārgeṇa nivartadhvaṃ surottamāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. О great gods! killing the demons, I will manage the oblation of offering for gods and their meal, the foremost oblation of yajna and Kavya for the Manes. О great gods! Go back now to the same route from which you have come to me.

## \|\| 27.10-13 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*evamukte tu devena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ pūjayanti sma taṃ prabhum \|\| 10 \|\|*

*viśvedevā mahātmānaḥ kaśyapo 'ditireva ca \|*  
*namaskṛtya sureśāya tasmai devāya raṃhasā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*prayātāḥ prāgdiśaṃ sarve vipulaṃ kaśyapāśramam \|*  
*te kaśyapāśramaṃ gatvā kurukṣetravanaṃ mahāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

*prasādya hyaditiṃ tatra tapase tāṃ nyayojayan\| tha sā cacāra tapo ghoraṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. Lomaharyana said- All gods including Kasyapa and Aditi worshipped lord Visnu happily, bowed their head with sheer respect and returned to the asrama of Kasyapa which was situated at the east from there. They thus reached Kuruksetra at the asrama of Kasyapa, congratulated Aditi, engaged her in penance and thus, she observed strict penance for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 27.14-16 \|\|

*tasyā nāmnā vanaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham \|*  
*ārādhanāya kṛṣṇasya vāgjitā vāyubhojanā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*daityairnirākṛtān dṛṣṭvā tanayānṛṣisattamāḥ \|*  
*vṛthāputrāhamiti sā nirvedāt praṇayāddharim \|*  
*tuṣṭāva vāgbhiragryābhiḥ paramārthavabodhinī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇatā bhaktavatsalam \|*  
*devadaityamayaṃ cādimadhyamāntasvarūpiṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. О great hermits! The forest in which Aditi observed the penance later-on address as Aditivana after her name. It was indeed divine forest which fulfilled the desire of Aditi. О great hermits! Aditi who saw that her sons were humiliated by demons, noticed their weakness, worried for their success, had observed silence, lived on air and chanted psalms for the pleasure of lord Visnu, the great shelter, gracious to the devotees, the sovereign god, the creator, protector and destroyer of the universe.

## \|\| 27.17 \|\|

*aditiruvāca*  
*namaḥ kṛtyārtināśāya namaḥ puṣkaramāline \|*  
*namaḥ paramakalyāṇa kalyāṇāyādivedhase \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Aditi recited- I salute the god who remove the pains caused by Krtya, I salute god who wears a Puskara garland. О supreme god! You render the best to the devotees. You are welfare in yourself and the foremost creator of this universe. I salute you.

## \|\| 27.18 \|\|

*namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye \|*  
*namaḥ paṅkajasaṃbhūtisaṃbhavāyātmayonaye \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Salute to lotus-eyed god, salute to god having lotus on navel. Salute to the originator of Brahma and salute to Atmayoni.

## \|\| 27.19 \|\|

*śriyaḥ kāntāya dāntāya dāntadṛśyāya cakriṇe \|*  
*namaḥ padmāsihastāya namaḥ kanakaretase \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Salute to the husband of Laksmi, the suppressor of senses, visible to ascetics, holder of discus in hand, the Kanakareta holding lotus and sword in hands.

## \|\| 27.20 \|\|

*tathātmajñānayajñāya yogicintyāya yogine \|*  
*nirguṇāya viśeṣāya haraye brahmarūpiṇe \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Salute to Atmajnana yajna, a topic for Yogis’ meditation, Yogi, Nirguna, peculiar, Hari and Brahmarupa.

## \|\| 27.21 \|\|

*jagacca tiṣṭhate yatra jagato yo na dṛsyate \|*  
*namaḥ sthūlātisūkṣmāya tasmai devāya śārṅiḍṇe \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Salute to the holder of Sarnga bow in whom this universe existed yet invisible and who is so micro and formidable in his features.

## \|\| 27.22-24 \|\|

*yaṃ na paśyanti paśyanto jagadapyakhilaṃ narāḥ \|*  
*apaśyadbhirjagadyaśca dṛśyate hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*bahirjyoti ralakṣyo yo lakṣyate jyotiṣaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*yasminneva yataścaiva yasyaitadakhilaṃ jagat \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tasmai samastajagatām amarāya namo namaḥ \|*  
*ādyaḥ prajāpatiḥ so 'pi pitṝṇāṃ paramaḥ patiḥ \|*  
*patiḥ surāṇāṃ yastasmai namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Salute to Vidhata (creator) invisible to the people materialistic but visible at heart, to the people not attached to worldly affairs, who spreads light outside and always invisible, who is seen apparent in the light, the god in whom this whole world is existed, who is the creator of this universe and who himself rules over this world. Frequent salute to the foremost Prajapati, the supreme administrator of Pitrganas and the god Krsna who is the ruler of all gods.

## \|\| 27.25 \|\|

*yaḥ pravṛttairnivṛttaiśca karmastasmai virajyate \|*  
*svargāpavargaphalado namastasmai gadābhṛte \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Salute to the god who holds mace in his hand, who is detached to the intended and given-up trend of deeds and who render with the fruit of heaven emancipation.

## \|\| 27.26 \|\|

*yastu saṃcityamāno 'pi sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati \|*  
*namastasmai viśuddhāya parasmai harimedhase \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Salute to that sacrosanct Harimedha supreme soul who destroys all evils when duly remembered by devotees.

## \|\| 27.27 \|\|

*ye paśyantyakhilādhāramīśānamajamavyayam \|*  
*na punarjanmamaraṇaṃ prāpnuvanti namāmi tam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I salute that god who is the sole cause of the world, Isana, Aja (Unborn) and imperishable (Imperishable), whose glimpse can destroy forever the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 27.28 \|\|

*yo yajño yajñaparamairijyate yajñasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ namāmi prabhumīśvaram \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I salute that yajna form, yajna established, yajna Purusa, Isvara, lord Visnu.

## \|\| 27.29 \|\|

*gīyate sarvavedeṣu vedavidbhirvidāṃ gatiḥ \|*  
*yastasmai vedavedyāya nityāya viṣṇave namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. I salute the god duly praised in all the Vedas by the scholars (known to the Vedas), who is the aim of learned persons, who is known to the Vedas and everlasting.

## \|\| 27.30 \|\|

*yato viśvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasmin pralayameṣyati \|*  
*viśvodbhavapratiṣṭhāya namastasmai mahātmane \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Salute to that supreme soul from whom this world has been originated, will finally merge and who is the cause of the origin and existence of the world.

## \|\| 27.31 \|\|

*ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram \|*  
*māyājālasamunnaddhaṃ tamupendraṃ namāmyaham \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. I salute that Upendra under whose control the movable and immovable Abrahmastamba (world) is so extended.

## \|\| 27.32 \|\|

*yo 'tra toyasvarūpastho bibhartyakhilamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*viśvaṃ viśvapatiṃ viṣṇuṃ taṃ namāmi prajāpatim \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. I salute that ruler of the universe and Prajapati Visnu who provides with maintenance this entire world and who has existed in the form of water.

## \|\| 27.33 \|\|

*mūrta tamo 'suramayaṃ tadvidho vinihanti yaḥ \|*  
*rātrijaṃ sūryarūpī ca tamupendraṃ namāmyaham \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. I salute the Upendra in the form of sun who shelters the tangible dark monster of the night.

## \|\| 27.34 \|\|

*yasyākṣiṇi candrasūryau sarvalokaśubhāśubham \|*  
*paśyataḥ karma satataṃ tamupendraṃ namāmyaham \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Whose sun and moon eyes watch all good and bad activities of organisms executed throughout the three-worlds, I salute that Upendra.

## \|\| 27.35 \|\|

*yasmin sarveśvare sarvaṃ satyametanmayoditam \|*  
*nānṛtaṃ tamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ namāmi prabhavāvyayam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. I salute that unborn, everlasting creator Visnu, the Sarvesvara about whom all that I have said is true and not untrue.

## \|\| 27.36 \|\|

*yadyetatsatyamuktaṃ me bhūyaścāto janārdana \|*  
*satyena tena sakalāḥ pūryantāṃ me manorathāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Janardana! by virtue of the truth if actually I have stated true here may he fulfil my all desires.

## Chapter 28. Grant of boon to Aditi by lord Visnu

## \|\| 28.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ stuto 'tha bhagavān vāsudeva uvāca tām \|*  
*adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāḥ saṃdarśane sthitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- Lord Vasudeva, invisible to all creatures appeared before her as a result of the prayer so made and said-

## \|\| 28.2 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca*  
*manorathāṃstvamadite yānicchasyabhivāñchitān \|*  
*tāṃstvaṃ prāpyasi dharmajñe matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Lord Visnu said- О religion abiding Aditi! You shall undoubtedly receive all that is desired by you under my grace.

## \|\| 28.3 \|\|

*śṛṇu tvaṃ ca mahābhāge varo yaste hṛti sthitaḥ \|*  
*maddarśanaṃ hi viphalaṃ na kadācid bhaviṣyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О great lady! Ask for whatever you desire and listen that a glimpse of me by the devotees seldom proves fruitless.

## \|\| 28.4 \|\|

*yaśceha tvadvane sthitvā trirātraṃ vai kariṣyati \|*  
*sarve kāmāḥ samṛdhyante manasā yānihecchati \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Whosoever person shall live in this forest for three nights with penance, all his desires will be fulfilled by my pleasure.

## \|\| 28.5 \|\|

*dūrastho 'pi vanaṃ yastu adityāḥ smarate naraḥ \|*  
*so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ kiṃ punarnivasan naraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. For to say of the man who resides in that forest when merely remembering once the Aditivana enables a man living at far distance to attain the supreme abode.

## \|\| 28.6 \|\|

*yaśceha brāhmaṇān pañca trīn vā dvāvekameva vā \|*  
*bhojayecchraddhayā yuktāḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Whosoever person shall offer food to fire, a tree, two or even only one Brahmin with sheer obeisance definitely will attain the best position in his life.

## \|\| 28.7 \|\|

*aditiruvāca*  
*yadi deva prasannastvaṃ bhaktyā me bhaktavatsala \|*  
*trailokyādhipatiḥ putrastadastu mama vāsavaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Aditi said- О merciful god! I wish to see my son Indra, the ruler of three-worlds if you indeed are pleased with my devotion.

## \|\| 28.8 \|\|

*hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hṛtaścāsya yajñabhāga ihāsuraiḥ \|*  
*tvayi prasanne parada tat prāpnotu suto mama \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The monsters have exhorted his state and the share in offering (yajna). О gracious lord! My son should regain his right with your pleasure.

## \|\| 28.9 \|\|

*hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ na duḥkhāya mama putrasya keśava \|*  
*prapannadāyavibhraṃśo bādhāṃ me kurute hṛti \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O Kesava! The confiscation of the state from my son is not a matter of worry to me but the bereavement of coparcenary share from the subjugated is the strong cause for my pain.

## \|\| 28.10 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca*  
*kṛtaḥ prasādo hi mayā tava devi yathepsitam \|*  
*svāṃśena caiva te garbhe saṃbhaviṣyāmi kaśyapāt \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The lord said- О goddess! I have graced on you as per your desire. I will come to your womb soon by virtue of coition by Kasyapa through my own rays and thus, will become your son.

## \|\| 28.11 \|\|

*tava garbhe samudbhūtastataste ye tvarātayaḥ \|*  
*tānahaṃ ca haniṣyāmi nivṛttā bhava nandini \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. I will kill all your enemies after birth from your womb. О Nandini! return now to your asrama.

## \|\| 28.12 \|\|

*aditiruvāca*  
*prasīda devadeveśa namaste viśvabhāvana \|*  
*nāhaṃ tvāmudare voḍhumīśa śakṣyāmi keśava \|*  
*yasmin pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ viśvayonistvamīśvaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Aditi said- О god of the gods! Please, be gracious. О beloved of the whole universe! I salute you. О Kesava! О Isa! I will not able to endure you as everything is within yourself. You are Visvayoni and Isvara.

## \|\| 28.13 \|\|

*ahaṃ tvāṃ ca vahiṣyāmi ātmānaṃ caiva nandini \|*  
*na ca pīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi svasti te 'stu vrajāmyaham \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The lord said- О Nandini! I will bear you as well as myself and you will feel no pain during pregnancy. I wish all good of you and now leave this place.

## \|\| 28.14 \|\|

*ityuktvāntarhite deve 'ditirgarbhaṃ samādadhe \|*  
*garbhasthite tataḥ khṛṣṇe cacāla saralā kṣitiḥ \|*  
*cakampire mahāśailā jagmuḥ kṣobhaṃ mahābdhayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. With these words, the lord suddenly vanished. Aditi was conceived within due course of time. The whole universe became capricious since the day Krsna came into the womb of Aditi. The mountains started shivering and oceans frequently rising with tides.

## \|\| 28.15 \|\|

*yato yato 'ditiryāti dadāti padamuttamam \|*  
*tatastataḥ kṣitiḥ khedānnanāma dvijapuṅgavāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О great Brahmanas! The earth falling under the feet of Aditi during pregnancy pressed down on her walking.

## \|\| 28.16 \|\|

*daityānāmapi sarveṣāṃ garbhasthe madhusūdane \|*  
*babhūva tejaso hāniryathoktaṃ parameṣṭhinā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. As lord Brahma had stated earlier, the splendour (so developed by demons by observing religion) of demons began decreasing since the day the lord Madhusudana appeared in the womb of Aditi.

## Chapter 29. Condemning and Imparting of Curse to Bali

## \|\| 29.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*nisteso 'surān dṛṣṭavā samastānasureśvaraḥ \|*  
*prahlādamatha papraccha balirātmapitāmaham \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- When the demon king Bali saw all demons losing their splendour, he enquired of his grandfather Prahlada about the reason for this change.

## \|\| 29.2 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*tāta nistejaso daityā nirdagdhā iva vahninā \|*  
*kimete sahasaivādya brahmadaṇḍahatā iva \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Bali said- О grandfather! The demons have lost their splendour and their physique is now appearing as singed by fire. Why have all these suddenly become as beaten by Brahmadanda?

## \|\| 29.3 \|\|

*duriṣṭaṃ kiṃ tu daityānāṃ ki kṛtyā vidhinirmitā \|*  
*nāśāyaiṣāṃ samudbhutā yena nistejaso 'surāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Has anything wrong taken place for the demons? or any Krtya has been arisen for the destruction of the demons? Otherwise, tell me the reason for the fading of the monsters.

## \|\| 29.4 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*ityasuravarastena pṛṣṭaḥ pautreṇa brāhmaṇāḥ \|*  
*ciraṃ dhyātvā jagādedamasuraṃ taṃ tadā balim \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Lomaharsana said- О Brahmins! Prahlada peeped deep into matter for long when so enquired by Bali. He then replied.

## \|\| 29.5 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca*  
*calanti girayo bhīmirjahāti sahasā dhatim \|*  
*sadyaḥ samudrāḥ kṣubhitā daityā nistejasaḥ kṛtāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Prahlada said- The mountains are trembling, the earth is losing her patience, the oceans are frequently rising with tides and the demons have lost splendour.

## \|\| 29.6 \|\|

*sūryodaye yathā pūrvaṃ tathā gacchanti na grahāḥ \|*  
*devānāṃ ca parā lakṣmīḥ karaṇenānumīyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The stars are not moving as before the sun rises. The peculiar Laksmi of gods through reason is estimated.

## \|\| 29.7 \|\|

*mahadetanmahābāho kāraṇaṃ dānaveśvara \|*  
*na hyalpamiti mantavyaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ kathañcana \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O great arm! О king of demons! It is certainly a major cause. One should not deem it a simple matter and you should exercise any measure for it (In case, it is not done, the direconsequences in future are not ruled out).

## \|\| 29.8 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*ityuktvā dānavapatiṃ prahlādaḥ so 'surottamaḥ \|*  
*atyarthabhakto deveśaṃ jagāma manasā harim \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Lomaharsana said- The demon kin Prahlada then remembered the sacrosanct god Narayana and took his shelter.

## \|\| 29.9 \|\|

*sa dhyānapathagaṃ kṛtvā prahlādaśca mano 'suraḥ \|*  
*vicārayāmāsa tato yathā devo janārdanaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Prahlada began to concentrate on god Janardana and his mind was engrossed in the almighty.

## \|\| 29.10-15 \|\|

*sa dadarśodare 'dityāḥ prahlādo vāmanākṛtim \|*  
*tadantaśca vasūn rudrānaśvinau sarutāstathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sādhyān viśve tathādityān gandharvoragarākṣasān \|*  
*virocanaṃ ca tanayaṃ baliṃ cāsuranāyakam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*jambhaṃ kujambhaṃ narakaṃ bāṇamanyāṃstathāsurān \|*  
*ātmānamurvīṃ gaganaṃ vāyuṃ vāri hutāśanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*samudrādrisariddvīpān sarāṃsi ca paśūn mahīm \|*  
*vayomanuṣyānakhilāṃstathaiva ca sarīsṛpān \|\| 13 \|\|*

*samastalokasraṣṭāraṃ brahmaṇaṃ bhavameva ca \|*  
*grahanakṣatratārāśca dakṣādyāṃśca prajāpatīn \|\| 14 \|\|*

*saṃpaśyan vismayāviṣṭaḥ prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇāt punaḥ \|*  
*prahlādaḥ prāha daityendraṃ baliṃ vairociniṃ tataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

10-15. Не saw dwarf-shaped lord in the womb of Aditi. Prahlada fell in the net of overwhelming surprise when he saw all Vasus, Rudras, both Asvinikumaras, Marutas, Sadhyas, Visvedevas, Adityas, Gandharvas, serpents, monsters, his son Virocana, Bali, Jambha, Kujambha, Naraka, Bana, other monsters including himself and the earth, ether, air, water, fire, oceans, mountains, rivers, islands, reservoirs, animals, birds, all human beings, reptiles, Brahma (the creator), Siva, stars, constellations, galaxy and all Prajapatis including Daksa. However, he soon returned to conscious and said Bali, the son of demon king Virocana.

## \|\| 29.16 \|\|

*tatsaṃjñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ yadarthaṃ bhavatāmiyam \|*  
*tejaso hānirutpannā śṛṇvantu tadaśeṣataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. I have now fully known the cause for the loss of your splendour. Listen to it in detail.

## \|\| 29.17-18 \|\|

*devadevo jagadyonirayonirjagadādijaḥ \|*  
*anādirādirviśvasya vareṇyo varado hariḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*parāvarāṇāṃ paramaḥ parāparasatāṃ gatiḥ \|*  
*prabhuḥ pramāṇaṃ mānānāṃ saptalokagurorguruḥ \|*  
*sthitiṃ kartu jagannāthaḥ so 'cintyo garbhatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Jagannatha, the god of gods, the yoni of the world, ayoni, the foremost bom in the world, unborn, Varenya, Varada, Hari, supreme in Paravars, the axiom of gentlemen in the material and metaphysical world, the authoritative dimension god, preceptor to the preceptors of all the seven lokas has come in the womb for re-establishing stability in this world.

## \|\| 29.19 \|\|

*prabhuḥ prabhūṇāṃ paramaḥ parāṇāmanādimadhyo bhagavānanantaḥ \|*  
*trailokyamaṃśena sanāthamekaḥ kartu mahātmāditijo 'vatīrmaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The god of gods, greatest, beyond- the creation of beginning, middle and the last (viz. unborn, unlived, undead), unending great soul god has incarnated in the form of son to Aditi for the welfare of this entire universe.

## \|\| 29.20 \|\|

*na yasya rudro na ca padmayonirnendro na sūryendumarīcimiśrāḥ \|*  
*jānanti daityādhipa yatsvarūpaṃ sa vāsudevaḥ kalayāvatīrṇaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О the king of demon! Vasudeva never seen even by Rudra, Brahma, Indra, Sun, Moon and Marici etc. has been bom with one of his rays (Каla).

## \|\| 29.21 \|\|

*yamakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yaṃ jñānavidhūtapāpāḥ \|*  
*yasmin praviṣṭā na purarbhavanti taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmi devam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He is addressed as syllable by the people learned in the Vedas, the innocent people by virtue of their knowledge merge with him and never again fall in the cycle of bom and death. I salute Vasudeva of such characteristics.

## \|\| 29.22 \|\|

*bhṛtānyaśeṣāṇi yato bhavanti yathormayastoyandherajasram \|*  
*layaṃ ca yasmin pralaye prayānti taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇato 'smyacintyam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I salute Vasudeva who originates all creatures ceaselessly like the sea waves and calls back to them all within him at the time of great devastation (Mahapralaya).

## \|\| 29.23 \|\|

*na yasya rūpaṃ na balaṃ prabhāvo na ca pratāpaḥ paramasya puṃsaḥ \|*  
*vijñāyate sarvapitāmahādyaistaṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmi nityam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. I salute daily Vasudeva whose complexion, power, influence and magnificence is even unknown to Brahma etc. gods.

## \|\| 29.24 \|\|

*rūpasya cakṣurgrahaṇe tvageṣā sparśagrahitrī rasanā rasasya \|*  
*ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhagrahaṇe niyuktaṃ na ghrāṇacakṣuḥ śravaṇādi tasya \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. (It is true that) he has provided all creatures with eyes to see, skin to touch, tongue to enjoy taste and nose to smell but he himself is without these sensory organs.

## \|\| 29.25 \|\|

*svayaṃprakāśaḥ paramārthato yaḥ sarveśvaro veditavyaḥ sa yuktyā \|*  
*śakyaṃ tamīḍyamanaghaṃ ca devaṃ grāhyaṃ nato 'haṃ harimīśitāram \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The god of all (Sarvesvara) who himself is light, can be realised through the application of mind. I salute that powerful, adorable, innocent, omnipresent, Isa, Hari.

## \|\| 29.26 \|\|

*yenaikadaṃṣṭreṇa samuddhṛteyaṃ dharācalā dhārayatīha sarvam \|*  
*śete grasitvā sakalaṃ jagad yastamīḍyamīśaṃ praṇato 'smi viṣṇum \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The ever stable earth lifted up by him on a single tooth (viz. when god Visnu incarnated as Varaha) is so powerful as all creatures live on it. He sleeps after merging the entire world within him. I salute such magnificent god Visnu.

## \|\| 29.27 \|\|

*aṃśāvatīrṇena ca yena garbhe hṛtāni tejāṃsi mahāsurāṇām \|*  
*namāmi taṃ devamanantamīśamaśeṣasaṃsārataroḥ kuṭhāram \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I salute the god who is like an axe to the world tree (viz. at the time of destruction) ad who had pull out the splendour of mighty demons even when he was in the womb.

## \|\| 29.28 \|\|

*devo jagadyonirayaṃ mahātmā sa ṣoḍśāṃśena mahāsurendrāḥ \|*  
*surendramāturjaṭharaṃ praviṣṭo hṛtāni vastena balaṃ vapūṃṣi \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О great demons! That great soul god in the form of world-yoni has introduced himself into the womb of Indra's mother having sixteenth fraction of his art (Kala) or rays. He has pull all your physical powers now.

## \|\| 29.29 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*tāta ko 'yaṃ harirnāma yato no bhayamāgatam \|*  
*santi me śataśo daityā vāsudevabalādhikāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Bali enquired- О grandfather! Who is such Hari now become cause for our fright? Here are several thousand demons with us who are more mighty than Vasudeva.

## \|\| 29.30-31 \|\|

*vipracittiḥ śibiḥ śaṅkurayaḥ śaṅkustathaiva ca \|*  
*hayaśirā aśvaśirā bhaṅgakāro mahāhanuḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pratāpī praghaśaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kukkurākṣaśca durjayaḥ \|*  
*ete cānye ca me santi daiteyā dānavāstathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Among these demons, some are Vipracitti, Sibi, Sanku, Ayahsanku, Hayasira, Asvasira, Bhankara, Mahahanu, Pratapi, Praghasa, Sambhu, Durjaya and Kukuraksa.

## \|\| 29.32 \|\|

*mahābalā mahāvīryā bhūbhāradharaṇakṣamāḥ \|*  
*eṣāmekaikaśaḥ kṛṣṇo na vīryārddhena saṃmitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. All these are great warriors, valorous and even capable to hold the burden of the entire earth. Krsna is not even comparable to half power which each of these demons holds.

## \|\| 29.33 \|\|

*lomaharṣama uvāca*  
*pautrasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā prahlādo daityasattamaḥ \|*  
*sakrodhaśca baliṃ prāha vaikuṇṭhākṣepavādinam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Lomaharsana said- Prahlada got angry at listening to such a statement derogating the power of god Visnu from his grandson. He said to Bali.

## \|\| 29.34 \|\|

*vināśamupayāsyanti daityā ye cāpi dānavāḥ \|*  
*yeṣāṃ tvamīdṛśo rājā durbuddhiravivekavān \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. All these monsters and demons shall be killed under the rule of such a foolish and malafide king as you are.

## \|\| 29.35 \|\|

*devadevaṃ mahābhāgaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum \|*  
*tvāmṛte pāpasaṅkalpa ko 'nya evaṃ vadiṣyati \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О evil mind! Who except you shall make such derogatory comments on the god of gods, sovereign Vasudeva and Mahabhaga Aja?

## \|\| 29.36-39 \|\|

*ya ete bhavatā proktāḥ samastā daityadānavāḥ \|*  
*sabrahmakāstathā devāḥ sthāvarāntā vibhūtayaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca jagaccedaṃ sādridrumanadīvanam \|*  
*sasamudradvīpaloko 'yaṃ yaścedaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yasyābhivādyavandyasya vyāpinaḥ paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*ekāṃśāṃśakalājanma kastamevaṃ pravakṣyati \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ṛte vināśābimukhaṃ tvāmekamavivekinam \|*  
*durbuddhimajitātmānaṃ vṛddhānaṃ śāsanātigam \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. Who except you, destruction, fool, evil- minded, ignorant to soul (Ajitatma), violator of elder's advice; will put such derogatory remarks about the revered god who has originated all these demons and monsters told by you including gods, the movable and immovable properties, you yourself, me, these mountains, trees, rivers and forest found in this world with all oceans and islands by one mere friction of his art.

## \|\| 29.40 \|\|

*śocyo 'haṃ yasya me gehe jātastava pitādhamaḥ \|*  
*yasya tvamīdṛśaḥ putro devadevāvamānakaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. It is a matter of anxiety to me that the cunning son I am blessed with who could reproduce a son speaking insults to the god of god Visnu.

## \|\| 29.41 \|\|

*tiṣṭhatvanekasaṃsārasaṃghātaughavināśini \|*  
*kṛṣṇe bhaktirahaṃ tāvadavekṣyo bhavatā na kim \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. For to say your devotion for Krsna, the destroyer of the entire world with its creatures, had you not at least take a care of my honour, (who is your grandfather).

## \|\| 29.42 \|\|

*na me priyataraḥ kṛṣṇādapi deho 'yamātmanaḥ \|*  
*iti jānātyayaṃ loko bhavāṃśca ditinandana \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О son of Diti! You yourself including this whole world also knows the fact that I love Krsna beyond my own life. (viz. no value of my life without Krsna).

## \|\| 29.43 \|\|

*jānannapi priyataraṃ prāṇebhyo 'pi hariṃ mama \|*  
*nindāṃ karoṣi tasya tvamakurvan gauravaṃ mama \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. In spite of duly known to the fact that I love Krsna more than my life, you shown disrespect me condemning that god in my presence.

## \|\| 29.44 \|\|

*virocanastava gururgurustayāpyahaṃ bale \|*  
*mamāpi sarvajagatāṃ gururnārāyaṇo hariḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О Bali! Your preceptor (father) is Virocana, I am his preceptor (father) and my preceptor (father) is Narayana Hari.

## \|\| 29.45 \|\|

*nindāṃ karoṣi tasmistvaṃ kṛṣṇe gurugurorgurau \|*  
*yasmāt tasmādihaiva tvam aiśvaryād bhrāṃśameṣyasi \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. (When this is the position) you are condemning your preceptor (Virocana), his preceptor (Prahlada) and my preceptor Sri Krsna. Hence, your prosperity shall lick the dust as a result of such gross humiliation.

## \|\| 29.46 \|\|

*sa devo jagatāṃ nātho bale prabhurjanārdanaḥ \|*  
*nanvahaṃ pratyavekṣyaste bhaktimānatra me guruḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О Bali! That supreme Janardana is the master of this whole universe. Considering me devoted to my preceptor (viz. I myself) you should have not criticised me.

## \|\| 29.47 \|\|

*etāvanmātramapyatra nindatā jagato gurum \|*  
*nāpekṣitastvayā yasmāt tasmācchāpaṃ dadāmi te \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O accused of criticising the preceptor of this whole universe! as you have not taken the least care of me, I curse you.

## \|\| 29.48 \|\|

*yathā me śirasaśchedādidaṃ gurutaraṃ bale \|*  
*tvayoktamacyutākṣepaṃ rājyabhraṣṭastathā pata \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. O Bali! the derogatory remark you made on Acyuta is more cruel than my murder. Hence, dethroned soon and live a pauper's life.

## \|\| 29.49 \|\|

*yathā na kṛṣṇādaparaḥ paritrāṇaṃ bhavārṇave \|*  
*tathācireṇa paśyeyaṃ bhavantaṃ rājyavicyutam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. As there is no other saviour except lord Krsna from the ocean of worldly living, may I see you soon dethroned.

## Chapter 30. Eulogy of Vamana by Brahma

## \|\| 30.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*iti daityapatiḥ śrutvā vacanaṃ raudramapriyam \|*  
*prasādayāmāsa guruṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- The king Bali bowed several times on the feet of the preceptor (Prahlada) in order to pacify him.

## \|\| 30.2 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*prasīda tāta mā kopaṃ kuru mohahate mayi \|*  
*balāvalepamūḍhena mayaitadvākyamīritam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Bali requested- О grandfather! Please, be happy and do not curse me as I fell pray to affection. Such remarks were made by me having been proud of power the vested in me.

## \|\| 30.3 \|\|

*mohāpahatavijñānaḥ papo 'haṃ ditijottama \|*  
*yacchapto 'smi durācārastatsādhu bhavatā kṛtam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O great demon! I am a sinner as I had lost discretion on account of affection gripped. I say good the curse you have inflicted on me.

## \|\| 30.4 \|\|

*rājyabhraṃśaṃ yaśobhraṃśaṃ prapsyāmīti tatastvaham \|*  
*viṣaṇṇo 'si yathā tāta tathaivāvinaye kṛte \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О grandfather! As you have been aggrieved due to my obstinacy, I therefore, accept decay of fame and dethroning.

## \|\| 30.5 \|\|

*trailokyarājyamaiśvaryamanyadvā nātidurlabham \|*  
*sasāre durlabhāstāta guravo ye bhavadvidhāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О grandfather! It is not tough to gain ruling over three-world, the luxury or anything other but a preceptor like you are rarely found.

## \|\| 30.6 \|\|

*prasīda tāta mā kopaṃ kartumarhasi daityapa \|*  
*tvatkopaparidagdho 'haṃ paritapye divāniśam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О guardian of demons! Be happy and spit on the anger now. I am burning in the fire erupted through your anger.

## \|\| 30.7 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca*  
*vatsa kopena me moho janitastena te mayā \|*  
*śāpo datto vivekaśca mohenāpahṛto mama \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Prahlada said- О grandson! I was gripped in affection and it had destroyed within moment my discretion. Hence, I cursed you.

## \|\| 30.8 \|\|

*yadi mohena me jñānaṃ nākṣiptaṃ syānmahāsura \|*  
*tatkathaṃ sarvagaṃ jānan hariṃ kaccicchapāmyaham \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О great demon! Had my discretion not vanished that moment, how then I would have cursed because god is omnipresent.

## \|\| 30.9 \|\|

*yo yaḥ śāpo mayā datto bhavato 'surapuṅgava \|*  
*bhāvyametena nūnaṃ te tasmāttvaṃ mā viṣīda vai \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O demon king! Don’t be anxious any more as the curse will definitely act fully in the course of time.

## \|\| 30.10 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti deveśe bhagavatyacyute harau \|*  
*bhavethā bhaktimānīśe sa te trātā bhaviṣyati \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. I suggest you to become a devotee to that lord Acyuta from this day and he only can defend you.

## \|\| 30.11 \|\|

*śāpaṃ prāpya ca me vīra deveśaḥ saṃsmṛtastvayā \|*  
*tathā tathā vadiṣyāmi śreyastvaṃ prāpsyase yathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О warrior! You have remembered that god of gods when I cursed you. Hence, I will say all which will good for you.

## \|\| 30.12 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*aditirvaramāsādya sarvakāmasamṛddhidam \|*  
*krameṇa hyudare devo vṛddhiṃ prāpto mahāyaśāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Lomaharsana said- When Aditi got all fructifying grace, the great illustrious god (Visnu) began to develop in her womb.

## \|\| 30.13 \|\|

*tato māse 'tha daśame kāle prasava āgate \|*  
*ajāyata sa govindo bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. That god Govinda later on with the initiation of the tenth month was bom in a dwarfs body.

## \|\| 30.14 \|\|

*avatīrṇe jagannāthe tasmin sarvāmareśvare \|*  
*devāśca mumucurduḥkhaṃ devamātāditistathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The gods and their mother Aditi freed themselves from the tough grip of sorrow with the birth of that Jagannatha who was god of gods.

## \|\| 30.15 \|\|

*vavurvātāḥ sukhaspārśā nīrajaskamabhūnnabhaḥ \|*  
*dharme ca sarvabhūtānāṃ tadā matirajāyata \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Pleasant breeze started blowing, the sky looked clear and all organisms are inspired towards welfare activities.

## \|\| 30.16 \|\|

*nodvegaścāpyabhūd dehe manujānāṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tadā hi sarvabhūtānāṃ dharme matirajāyata \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О best Dvijas! The human beings lost anxiety and their mind tended to execute noble deeds.

## \|\| 30.17 \|\|

*taṃ jātamātraṃ bhagavān brahma lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*jātakarmādikāṃ kṛtvā kriyāṃ tuṣṭāva ca prabhum \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Lord Brahma appeared just when god Vamana was bom and performed the rituals like Jatakarma etc. He then chanted the prayer.

## \|\| 30.18 \|\|

*brahmovāca*  
*jayādhīśa jayājeya jaya viśvaguro hare \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarātīta jayānanta jayācyuta \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Brahma said- О god of gods! Victory to you. О undefeated! Victory to you. О preceptor to world, О Hari! Victory to you. О beyond birth and death, О unending god! Victory to you. О Acyuta! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.19 \|\|

*jayājita jayāśeṣa jayāvyaktasthite jaya \|*  
*paramārthārtha sarvajña jñānajñeyārthaniḥsṛta \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О unconquered! Victory to you. О Asesa! Victory to you. О inexpressible! Victory to you. О the supreme essence! О omniscient! You have originated the knowledge and its perceivable meaning! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.20 \|\|

*jayāśeṣa jagatsākṣiñjagatkartarjagadguro \|*  
*jagato 'jagadanteśa sthitau pālayate jaya \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О Asesa! О witness of world! О creator! О preceptor of world! Victory to you. О creator, nourisher and destroyer by movable and immovable! victory to you.

## \|\| 30.21 \|\|

*jayākhila jayāśeṣa jaya sarvahṛdisthita \|*  
*jayādimadhyāntamaya sarvajñānamayottama \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O absolute! Victory to you. О Asesa! Victory to you. О dweller in all hearts! Victory to you. О the beginning, middle and end of everything. О omniscient! О greatest! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.22 \|\|

*mumukṣubhiranirdeśya nityahṛṣṭa jayeśvara \|*  
*yogibhirmuktikāmaistu damādighuṇabhūṣaṇa \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О beyond conscience of the people desirous of emancipation, О ever seeing god! О Isvara! Victory to you. О Yogis aim and О god! with Dama etc. virtues! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.23 \|\|

*jayātisūkṣma durjñeya jaya sthūla jaganmaya \|*  
*jaya sūkṣmātisūkṣma tvaṃ jayānindriya sendriya \|\| 23 \|\|*
