23\. О most micro-form god! О rare to knowledge! Victory to you. О formidable! О world form god! Victory to you. О minutest to the micro! Victory to you. О with and without sensory organs! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.24 \|\|

*jaya svamāyāyogastha śeṣabhoga jayākṣara \|*  
*jayaikadaṃṣṭraprāntena samuddhṛtavasuṃdhara \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О meditator on Maya (illusion)! Victory to you. О syllable on the bed of Sesa! Victory to you. О uplifter of the earth on a single tooth (Varaha)! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.25 \|\|

*nṛkesarin surārātivakṣasthalavidāraṇa \|*  
*sāmprataṃ jaya viśvātman māyāvāmana keśava \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О Nrsimha! О dissector of the hearts of gods' enemies, О Visvatman! О Maya Vamana! О Kesava! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.26 \|\|

*nijamāyāparicchinna jagaddhātarjanārdana \|*  
*jayācintya jayānekāsvarūpaikavidha prabho \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О god you are beyond the reach of illusion (Maya)! О the ruler of world! О Janardana! Victory to you. О god you are beyond imagination and are in countless forms. О absolute outstanding god! Victory to you.

## \|\| 30.27 \|\|

*varddhasva vardhitānekavikāraprakṛte hare \|*  
*tvayyeṣā jagatāmīśe saṃsthitā dharmapaddhatiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О god you have increased numerous defects by way of Prakrti (nature). Such magnificent Hari! May you grow fast. The system of religion exists on you god.

## \|\| 30.28 \|\|

*na tvāmahaṃ na ceśāno nendrādyāstridaśā hare \|*  
*jñātumīśā na munayaḥ sanakādyā na yoginaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O Hari! Sankara, Indra gods including I myself, Sanaka etc. sages or Yogis are not capable to recognise you.

## \|\| 30.29 \|\|

*tvaṃ māyāpaṭasaṃvīto jagatyatra jagatpate \|*  
*kastvāṃ vetsyati sarveśa tvatprasādaṃ vinā naraḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О master of universe! You are covered by an apparel of illusion in this world. О god of all gods! Who can recognise you without your pleasure?

## \|\| 30.30 \|\|

*tvamevārādhito yasya prasādasumukhaḥ prabho \|*  
*sa eva kevalaṃ devaṃ vetti tvāṃ netaro naja \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О sovereign! Only the devotee graced by you knows you and nobody else.

## \|\| 30.31 \|\|

*tadīśvareśvareśāna vibho varddhasva bhāvana \|*  
*prabhavāyāsya viśvasya viśvātman pṛthulocana \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О god of gods! О Isvara, О sovereign! О Bhavana! О the soul of the world! О Prthulocana! may you access growth for the origin of this world?

## \|\| 30.32 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*elaṃ stuto hṛṣīkeśaḥ sa tadā vāmanākṛtiḥ \|*  
*prahasya bhāvagambhīramuvācārūḍhasaṃpadam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Lomaharsana said- The dwarf Hrsikesa then smiled and said in an impressive and elegant manner.

## \|\| 30.33 \|\|

*stuto 'haṃ bhavatā pūrvamindrādyaiḥ kaśyapena ca \|*  
*mayā ca vaḥ pratijñātamindrasya bhuvanatrayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. You yourself, Indra etc. gods and Kasyapa had prayed to me during ancient period. I had also promised to return the empire of heaven to Indra amid your presence.

## \|\| 30.34 \|\|

*bhṛyaścahaṃ stuto 'dityā tasyāścāpi mayāśrutam \|*  
*yathā śakrāya dāsyāmi trailokyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Aditi had then worshipped me and I again promised her that I would give Indra an empire consisting of the three-world absolutely free from encumbrances.

## \|\| 30.35 \|\|

*so 'haṃ tathā kariṣyāmi yathendro jagataḥ patiḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati sahasrākṣaḥ satyametad bravīmi vaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. I shall chalk out a plan there to enthrone the thousand-eyed Indra on the empire of three- worlds. I am giving a true statement to all of you present here.

## \|\| 30.36 \|\|

*tataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ brahma hṛṣīkeśāya dattavān \|*  
*yajñopavītaṃ bhagavān dadau tasya bṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Lord Brahma then gave the hide of a black stag to Hrsikesa and lord Jupiter gave a sacrificial thread (yajnopavita).

## \|\| 30.37 \|\|

*āṣāḍhamadadād daṇḍaṃ marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*kamaṇḍaluṃ vasiṣṭhaśca kauśaṃ cīramathāṅgirāḥ \|*  
*āsanaṃ caiva pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ pītavāsasī \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Marici, the son of Brahma, gave him a stick of Palasa. Vasistha gave a kamandalu and Angira gave a silk cloth. Pulaha gave an asana and Pulastya gave two yellow tint clothes.

## \|\| 30.38 \|\|

*upatasthuśca taṃ vedāḥ praṇavasvarabhūṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*śāstrāṇyaśeṣāṇi tathā sāṃkhyayogoktayaśca yāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Vedas with chanting "Om", all scriptures and the dictums contemplated on philosophies like Samkhya Yoga etc. automatically inserted themselves into his mind.

## \|\| 30.39 \|\|

*sa vāmano jaṭī daṇḍī chatrī dhṛtakamaṇḍaluḥ \|*  
*sarvadevamayo devo baleradhvaramabhyagāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. That Vamana (dwarf) with matted hair, a stick, an umbrella and a water-pot (kamandala) then went to the offering (yajna) hosted by demon king Bali.

## \|\| 30.40 \|\|

*yatra yatra padaṃ viprā bhūbhāge vāmano dadau \|*  
*dadāti bhūmirvivaraṃ tatra tatrābhipīḍitā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Brahmins! The land pressed by the feet of Vamana while walking were turned into deep trenches on his way to Bali.

## \|\| 30.41 \|\|

*sa vāmano jaḍagatirmṛdu gacchan saparvatām \|*  
*sābdhidvīpavatīṃ sarvāṃ cālayāmāsa bhedinīm \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The slow motion of Vamana shook the entire earth consisting of oceans, islands and mountains even when he was putting his steps gently.

## \|\| 30.42 \|\|

*bṛhaspatistu śanakairmārgaṃ darśayate śubham \|*  
*tathā krīḍāvinodārthamatijāḍyagato 'bhavat \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Jupiter became a guide to him and he also put a brake on his swift walking. For the sake of joking and recreation, he was also walking with him at slow speed.

## \|\| 30.43 \|\|

*tataḥ śeṣo mahānāgo niḥsṛtyāsau rasātalāt \|*  
*sāhāyyaṃ kalpayāmāsa devadevasya cakriṇaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The great serpent came up from the nether region and began assisting that god with discus in hand.

## \|\| 30.44 \|\|

*tadadyāpi ca vikhyātamahervilamanuttamam \|*  
*tasya saṃdarśanādeva nāgebhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. That sacred place is popular even today as Ahivila. A man seldom fears serpents when he merely visits that place and sees it.

## Chapter 31. Description of the characters of Vamana and Bali

## \|\| 31.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*saparvatavanāmurvīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣubhitāṃ baliḥ \|*  
*papracchośanasaṃ śukraṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- Bali asked Sukracarya the reason for the shaking of the entire earth with all forests and mountains.

## \|\| 31.2 \|\|

*ācārya kṣobhamāyāti sābdhibhūmidharā mahī \|*  
*kasmācca nāsurān bhāgān pratigṛhṇanti vahnayaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О Acarya! What is the reason for the shaking of this entire earth consisting of oceans and mountains and why the fire is not accepting (burning) the oblation offered for the share of monsters?

## \|\| 31.3 \|\|

*iti pṛṣṭo 'tha balinā kāvyo vedavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*uvāca daityādhipatiṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā mahāmatiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Having questioned by Bali, Sukracarya, the foremost of Vedic scholars, concentrated his mind a long on the topic enquired and then told to the chief of demons.

## \|\| 31.4 \|\|

*avatīrṇo jagadyoniḥ kaśyapasya gṛhe hariḥ \|*  
*vāmaneneha rūpeṇa paramātmā sanātanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The everlasting supreme soul and the cause of this world (jagadyoni) has been bom as Kasyapa's son.

## \|\| 31.5 \|\|

*sa nūnaṃ yajñamāyāti tava dānavapuṅgava \|*  
*tatpādanyāsavikṣobhādiyaṃ pracalitā mahī \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О demon king! He is undoubtedly, coming to your place of offering and this earth is shivering due to the steps he takes in walking.

## \|\| 31.6 \|\|

*kampante girayaśceme kṣubhitā makarālayāḥ \|*  
*neyaṃ bhūtapatiṃ bhūmiḥ samarthā voḍhumīśvaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. By this very reason, these mountains are trembling, the oceans are on tides and this land is not capable to bear the burden of its own master.

## \|\| 31.7 \|\|

*sadevāsuragandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagā \|*  
*anenaiva dhṛtā bhūmirāpo 'gniḥ pavano nabhaḥ \|*  
*dhārayatyakhilān devān manuṣyāṃśca mahāsurān \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He himself holds all gods, Gandharvas, demi-gods, monsters, the earth including serpents, the water, fire, air, ether, human beings and all great monsters.

## \|\| 31.8 \|\|

*iyamasya jagaddhāturmāyā kṛṣṇasya gahvarī \|*  
*dhāryadhārakabhāvena yayā saṃpīḍitaṃ jagat \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. It is the grave illusion of this world holding Krsna and this illusion of the holder and the held in turn is being perceived as the vacillation of the world.

## \|\| 31.9 \|\|

*tatsannidhānādasurā na bhāgārhāḥ suradviṣaḥ \|*  
*bhuñjate nāsurān bhāgānapi tena trayo 'gnayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. As he is near, the monsters being enemies to the gods have been denied the oblation (Havi) and due to such influence, the three- fires are not accepting the share of monsters.

## \|\| 31.10 \|\|

*śukrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaromābravīd baliḥ \|*  
*dhanyo 'haṃ kṛtapuṇyaśca yanme yajñapatiḥ svayam \|*  
*yajñamabhyāgato brahman mattaḥ ko 'nyo 'dhikaḥ pumān \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Bali was in deep exhilaration on hearing the statement of Sukracarya. He said- О Brahmin! I am the luckiest and most successful of persons as the master himself of offering (yajnapati) is approaching me. Who is there any better person than me?

## \|\| 31.11 \|\|

*yaṃ yoginaḥ sadodyuktāḥ paramātmānamavyayam \|*  
*draṣṭumicchanti devo 'sau mamādhvaramupeṣyati \|*  
*yanmayācārya kartavyaṃ tanmamādeṣṭumarhasi \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Yogins stake their life in meditation only to see that supreme and imperishable God and he himself is coming today to my place of offering. О Acarya (Preceptor)! order me what should I do for him?

## \|\| 31.12 \|\|

*śukra uvāca*  
*yajñabhāgabhujo devā vedaprāmāṇyato 'sura \|*  
*tvayā tu dānavā daitya yajñabhāgabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Sukra said- О monster! The Vedas authorise only the gods to enjoy the oblations offered in yajna but you have made the monsters to. accept them.

## \|\| 31.13 \|\|

*ayaṃ ca devaḥ sattvasthaḥ karoti sthitipālanam \|*  
*visṛṣṭaṃ ca tathāyaṃ ca svayamatti prajāḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The god approaching here nourishes and gives stability to the world. He too creates the universe and he himself destroys the creation so made. All this is done on the basis of sattva property (guna).

## \|\| 31.14 \|\|

*bhavāṃstu vandī bhavitā nūnaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthitau sthitaḥ \|*  
*viditvaivaṃ mahābhāgā kuru yat te manogatam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. As god Visnu is engaged in administrative function, you definitely will fall in bondage. Keep this important thing in your mind and do whatever you think best.

## \|\| 31.15 \|\|

*tvayāsya daityādhipate kvalpake 'pi hi vastuni \|*  
*pratijñā naiva voḍhavyā vācyaṃ sāma tathāphalam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О demon king! Don't bind yourself under any promise and do merely a humble chat that will not involve in giving anything.

## \|\| 31.16 \|\|

*kṛtakṛtyasya devasya devārthaṃ caiva kurvataḥ \|*  
*alaṃ dadyāṃ dhanaṃ deve tvetadvācyaṃ tu yācataḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya devabhūtyartha pravṛttasya mahāsura \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О great monster! God Krsna is under resolution to favour gods and execute something in their favour. He is determined to bring back prosperity to the gods. Hence don't say that you will give enough money for gods.

## \|\| 31.17 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*brahman kathamahaṃ brūyāmanyenāpi hi yācitaḥ \|*  
*nāstīti kimu devasya saṃsākasyāghahāriṇaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Bali said- О Brahmin! How can I say even to the common people that the thing begged for is not with me? When this is the position of my conscience, how shall the god of gods be denied by me?

## \|\| 31.18 \|\|

*vratopavāsairvividhair yaḥ prabhurgṛhyate hariḥ \|*  
*sa me vakṣyati dehīti govindaḥkimato 'dhikam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Countless fasts and resolutions are observed in order to see that Hari and when he himself is coming and will beg me for anything, what achievement more than it will be for me to please him?

## \|\| 31.19 \|\|

*yadarthaṃ sumahārambhā damaśaucaguṇānvitaiḥ \|*  
*yajñā kriyante yajñeśaḥ sa me dehīti vakṣyati \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The god (yajnesa) himself will beg for something with expressive words from me for whose grace the people observe Dama, purity etc. virtues and perform the most expensive offerings (yajna).

## \|\| 31.20 \|\|

*tatsādhu sukṛtaṃ karma tapaḥ sucaritaṃ canaḥ \|*  
*yanmā dehīti viśveśaḥ svayameva vadiṣyati \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. As the ruler of this world himself will ask for something from me, it indicates it climax of achievement and confirms the process through which I observed austerity.

## \|\| 31.21 \|\|

*nāstītyahaṃ guro vakṣye tamabhyāgatamīśvaram \|*  
*prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣye 'haṃ na tu nāsti jane kvacit \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О preceptor! Whether you suggest that I should answer in the negative to such a god coming as a beggar? I think it is better to die than to say 'no' to any person.

## \|\| 31.22 \|\|

*nāstīti yanmayā noktamanyeṣāmapi yācatām \|*  
*vakṣyāmi kathamāyāte tadadya cāmare 'cyute \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. When I have never refused anything to any person till date, how then will I refuse Acyuta anything on his arrival?

## \|\| 31.23 \|\|

*ślāghya eva hi vīrāṇāṃ dānāccāpatsamāgamaḥ \|*  
*na bādhākāri yaddānaṃ tadaṅgaṃ balavat smṛtam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The excess donation may bring sometimes adversity to the bold persons but О preceptor! the donation not causing any hurdle in anyway is undoubtedly considered a better donation.

## \|\| 31.24-25 \|\|

*madrājye nāsukhī kaścinna daridro na cāturaḥ \|*  
*na duḥkhito na cobdigno na śamādivivarjitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*hṛṣṭastuṣṭaḥ sugandhī ca tṛptaḥ sarvasukhānvitaḥ \|*  
*janaḥ sarvo mahābhāga kimutāhaṃ sadā sukhī \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Nobody in my realm is pauper, ailing, anxious, sad and in grief and all are virtuous. О lord! all people are healthy, sturdy, satisfied, meritorious and happy here. What to say more when I am also happy always?

## \|\| 31.26 \|\|

*etadviśiṣṭamatrāhaṃ dānabījaphalaṃ labhe \|*  
*viditaṃ muniśārdula mayaitat tvanmukhācchrutam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О sage laureate! I have come to know through your information that I am going to gain the best fruit for donation of a distinct thing.

## \|\| 31.27 \|\|

*matprasādaparo nūnaṃ yajñenārādhito hiraḥ \|*  
*mama dānamavāpyāsau puṣṇāti yadi devatāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. If he satiates the gods by virtue of the donation received from me, it prima-facie purported the pleasure of Hari on my prayer through this offering (yajna).

## \|\| 31.28-29 \|\|

*etadbījavare dānabījaṃ patati ced gurau \|*  
*janārdane mahāpātre kiṃ na prāptaṃ tato mayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*viśiṣṭaṃ mama taddānaṃ parituṣṭāśca devatāḥ \|*  
*uvabhogācchataguṇaṃ dānaṃ sukhakaraṃ smṛtam \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. If the seed of my donation is sown this time in the king seed, great eligible and revered Janardana, what is then left escaped from me? The donation is considered a hundred times greater then enjoyment (consumption).

## \|\| 31.30 \|\|

*matprasādaparo nūnaṃ jajñenārādhito hariḥ \|*  
*tenābhyeti na saṃdeho darśanādupakārakṛt \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Hari as worshipped by me through yajna is definitely pleased with me. He, undoubtedly, is coming here to gratify me.

## \|\| 31.31 \|\|

*atha kopena cābhyeti devabhāgoparodhataḥ \|*  
*māṃ nihantuṃ tato hi syād vadhaḥ ślāghyataro 'cyutāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. If he is coming to kill me on account of my restrictions imposed on offering oblations to gods, such a death under his anger too will be for good.

## \|\| 31.32 \|\|

*etajjñātvā muniśreṣṭha dānavighnākareṇa me \|*  
*naiva bhāvyaṃ jagannāthe govinde samupasthite \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О great sage! take clear notice of my determination and please don't interfere on donation to god when he arrives here.

## \|\| 31.33 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*ityevaṃ vadatastasya prāptastatra janārdanaḥ \|*  
*sarvadevamayo 'tintyo māyāvāmanarūpadhṛk \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Lomaharsana said- As Bali could finish his statement, Janardana in dwarf form by illusion appeared there.

## \|\| 31.34 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭaṃ tu praviṣṭamasurāḥ prabhum \|*  
*jagmuḥ prabhāvataḥ kṣobhaṃ tejasā tasya niṣprabhāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The monsters lost their splendour and began trembling when they saw Hari entered , in the place of offering.

## \|\| 31.35 \|\|

*jeṣuśca munayastatra ye sametā mahādhvare \|*  
*vasiṣṭho gādhijo gargo anye ca munisattamāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Vasistha Visvamitra, Garga and other renowned sages present at that yajna sat on japa (silent chanting).

## \|\| 31.36 \|\|

*baliścaivākhilaṃ janma mene śaphalamātmanaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ saṃkṣobhamāpanno na kaścit kiñciduktavān \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Bali took it as the greatest achievement of his life. As all monsters were trembling and anxious, nobody said anything to Bali.

## \|\| 31.37-38 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ devadeveśaṃ pūjayāmāsa tejasā \|*  
*athāsurapati prahvaṃ dṛṣṭvā munivarāśca tān \|\| 37 \|\|*

*devadevapatiḥ sākṣād viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk \|*  
*tuṣṭāva yajñaṃ vahniṃ ca yajamānamathārcitaḥ \|*  
*yajñakarmādhikārasthān sadasyān dravyasaṃpadam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Dazzled by the glowing presence of Hari, everyone adored him there. The dwarf form god Visnu appreciated the yajna, fire, clients, authorised members for performing that yajna and the items used for offering when he was given honour by Bali and those all great hermits.

## \|\| 31.39 \|\|

*sadasyāḥ pātramakhilaṃ vāmanaṃ prati tatkṣaṇāt \|*  
*yajñavāṭasthitaṃ viprāḥ sādhu sādhvityudīrayan \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О Brahmins! all members to that function then arrived there and began appreciating the god Vamana.

## \|\| 31.40 \|\|

*sa cārghamādāya baliḥ prodbhūtapulakastadā \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa govindaṃ prāha cedaṃ mahāsuraḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Over-excited Bali took Arghya, worshipped Govinda and said to him.

## \|\| 31.41-42 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*suvarṇaratnasaṃghāto gajāśvasamitistathā \|*  
*striyo vastrāṇyalaṅkārān gāvo grāmāśca puṣkalāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*sarve ca saralā pṛthvī bhavato vā yadīpsitam \|*  
*tad dadāsi vṛṇuṣveṣṭaṃ mamārthāḥ santi te priyāḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Bali said- I give the items like gold, gems, elephant, horses, women, ornaments, cows and villages. The entire earth or whatever you ask. Please, say what you want. All my possessions are yours.

## \|\| 31.43 \|\|

*ityukto daityapatinā prītigarbhānvitaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*prāha sasmitagambhīraṃ bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Vamana laughed at such an ear-pleasing request of Bali and seriously said-

## \|\| 31.44 \|\|

*mamāgniśaraṇārthāya dehi rājan padatrayam \|*  
*suvarṇagrāmaratnādi tadarthibhyaḥ pradīyatām \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О king! give me only a piece of land measuring three steps as I want to construct a fire-place (agnisala). Give gold, villages and gems etc. things to other desirous people.

## \|\| 31.45 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*tribhiḥ prayojanaṃ kiṃ te padaiḥ padavatāṃ vara \|*  
*śataṃ śatasahasraṃ vā padānāṃ mārgatāṃ bhavān \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Bali said- О the supreme designated! What use will you do of mere three steps measuring land? Ask for at least a land measuring one hundred or one hundred thousand steps.

## \|\| 31.46 \|\|

*śrīvāmana uvāca*  
*etāvatā daityapate kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mārgaṇe \|*  
*anyeṣāmarthināṃ vittamicchayā dāsyate bhavān \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Lord Vamana replied- О demon king! I am thankful to you and an satisfied. Satisfy other persons with the donation as per their desire.

## \|\| 31.47 \|\|

*etacchrutvā tu gaditaṃ vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*vācayāmāsa vai tasmai vāmanāya mahātmane \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Hearing these words of great souled Vamana, Bali gave word to the great Vamana.

## \|\| 31.48 \|\|

*pāṇau tu patite toye vāmano 'bhūdavāmanaḥ \|*  
*sarvedevamayaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. When the custom of donation was under process, Vamana became gigantic with pouring water drops in his palm. He then showed his body consisting of all gods within it.

## \|\| 31.49 \|\|

*cantrasūryau tu nayane dyauḥ śiraścaraṇau kṣitiḥ \|*  
*pādāṅgulyaḥ piśācāstu hastāṅgulyaśca guhyakāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. (In such a gigantic form) the sun and moon were his eyes, ether was his head, earth was his two feet, the devils were his toes and Guhyaka were the fingers on hand.

## \|\| 31.50 \|\|

*viśvedevāśca jānusthā jaṅghe sādhyāḥ surottamāḥ \|*  
*yakṣā nakheṣu saṃbhūtā rekhāsvapsarasastathā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Visvedevas were his thighs, Sadhyas both his pubic, Yaksas his nails and nymphs the lines.

## \|\| 31.51 \|\|

*dṛṣṭirṛkṣāṇyaśeṣāṇi keśāḥ sūryāśavaḥ prabhoḥ \|*  
*tārakā romakūpāṇi romeṣu ca maharṣayaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. All constellations were his sight, sun-beams were his hair, galaxies were his furs and the hermits were seated on those furs.

## \|\| 31.52 \|\|

*bāhavo vidiśastasya diśaḥ śrotre mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*aśvinau śravaṇe tasya nāsā vāyurmahātmanaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Directions on their angles were his arms, directions were both his ears, both Asvinikumaras were his ear-balls and air was his nose.

## \|\| 31.53 \|\|

*prasāde candramā devo mano dharmaḥ samāśritaḥ \|*  
*satyamasyābhavad vāṇī jihvā devī sarasvatī \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Moon was his forehead and Dharma was his mind, truth was his speech and his tongue was goddess Sarasvati.

## \|\| 31.54 \|\|

*grīvāditirdevamātā vidyāstadvalayastathā \|*  
*svargadvāramabhūnmaitraṃ tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca vai bhruvau \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. God’s mother Aditi was his neck, Vidya (learning) was his shoulders, heaven door was his anus and Tvasta and Pusa were his brows.

## \|\| 31.55 \|\|

*mukhe vaiśvānaraścāsya vṛṣaṇau tu prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*hṛdayaṃ ca paraṃ brahma puṃstvaṃ vai kaśyapo muniḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Vaisvanara was his mouth and Prajapati was his testicles, supreme Brahma was his heart and sage Kasyapa was his Pumstva.

## \|\| 31.56 \|\|

*pṛṣṭhe 'sya vasavo devā marutaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu \|*  
*vakṣasthale tathā rudro dhairye cāsya mahārṇavaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Vasu was his back, Marutas were all his body joints, Rudra was his chest and the great oceans were in his patience.

## \|\| 31.57 \|\|

*udare cāsya gandharvā marutaśca mahābalāḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīrmedhā dhṛtiḥ kāntiḥ sarvavidyāśca vai kaṭiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Gandharva and mighty mantras were in his belly and Laksmi wisdom, patience, splendour and-all learning have existed in his loin.

## \|\| 31.58 \|\|

*sarvajyotīṃṣi yānīha tapaśca paramaṃ mahat \|*  
*tasya devādhidevasya tejaḥ prodbhūtamuttamam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. All luminaries and supreme Mahat tapa are the splendid lustre of the Great God.

## \|\| 31.59 \|\|

*tanau kukṣiṣu vedāśca jānunī ca mahāmakhāḥ \|*  
*iṣṭayaḥ paśavaścāsya dvijānāṃ ceṣṭitāni ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The Vedas were on his body and armpits and great Istis of yajna, the endeavour of animals and Brahmins were both his pubic zones.

## \|\| 31.60 \|\|

*tasya devamayaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇormahātmanaḥ \|*  
*upasarpanti te daityāḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. As the moths go to the flames, those demons rushed to that great soul Visnu in such a gigantic form.

## \|\| 31.61 \|\|

*cikṣurastu mahādaityaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhītavān \|*  
*dantābhyāṃ tasya vai grīvāmaṅguṣṭhenāhanaddhariḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The great monster Ciksura gripped his big toe under teeth. Lord gave a hard blow through the thumb and injured his neck.

## \|\| 31.62 \|\|

*pramathya sarvānasurān pādahastatalairvibhuḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā rūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ saṃjahārāśu medinīm \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. He churned badly all monsters by using his palms and toes and snatched the earth shortly from them.

## \|\| 31.63 \|\|

*tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare \|*  
*nabho vikramamāṇasya sakthideśe sthitāvubhau \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The moon and sun were at the middle portion of his nipples while they shifted at the navel at the time of measuring the ether.

## \|\| 31.64 \|\|

*paraṃ vikramamāṇasya jānumūle prabhākarau \|*  
*viṣṇorāstāṃ sthitasyaitau devapālanakarmaṇi \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Moon and sun shifted to the pubic zone when lord Visnu measured the supreme loka (world) for divine cause.

## \|\| 31.65 \|\|

*jitvā lokatrayaṃ tāṃśca hatvā cāsurapuṅgavān \|*  
*purandarāya trailokyaṃ dadau viṣṇururukramaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. with his gigantic steps, lord Visnu killed all mighty monsters, measured the three-worlds and gave them back to Indra.

## \|\| 31.66 \|\|

*sutalaṃ nāma pātālamadhastādvasudhātalāt \|*  
*balerdattaṃ bhagavatā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. That mightiest god Visnu then gave Bali the empire of Sutala named nether world which was just beneath the earth.

## \|\| 31.67-69 \|\|

*atha daityaiśvaraṃ prāha viṣṇuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ \|*  
*yat tvayā salilaṃ dattaṃ gṛhītaṃ pāṇinā mayā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*kalpapramāṇaṃ tasmāt te bhaviṣyatyāyuruttamam \|*  
*vaivakhate tathātīte kāle manvantare tathā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*sāvarṇike tu saṃprāpte bhavānindro bhaviṣyati \|*  
*idānīṃ bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ dattaṃ śakrāya vai purā \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. Lord Visnu then said to Bali- As I have accepted the water given by you on my palm, you therefore, enjoy longevity for a Kalpa and become Indra when Vaivasvata Manvantara is over and Savarnika Manvantara will commence. This is because I have already given Indra sanction to rule throughout the Manvantara currently in existence.

## \|\| 31.70 \|\|

*caturyugavyavasthā ca sādhikā hyekasaptatiḥ \|*  
*niyantavyā mayā sarve ye tasya paripanthinaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The provision of the period which is worked out for some more than the seventy one frequency of four ages viz. the period of one Manvanatara, I will regulate the enemies of Indra during this entire period.

## \|\| 31.71-76 \|\|

*tenāhaṃ parayā bhaktyā pūrvamārādhito bale \|*  
*sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ samāsādya vaco mama \|\| 71 \|\|*

*vasāsura mamādeśaṃ yathāvatparipālayan \|*  
*tatra devasukhopete prāsādaśatasaṃkule \|\| 72 \|\|*

*protphullapadmasarasi hvadasuddhasaridvare \|*  
*sugandhī pūpasaṃpanno varābharamabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*srakcandanādidigdhāṅgo nṛtyagītamanoharān \|*  
*upabhuñjan mahābhogān vividhān dānaveśvara \|\| 74 \|\|*

*mamājñayā kālamimaṃ tiṣṭha strīśatasaṃvṛtaḥ \|*  
*yāvatsuraiśca vipraiśca na virodhaṃ gamiṣyasi \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tāvat tvaṃ bhuṅkṣva saṃbhogān sarvakāmasamanvitān \|*  
*yadā suraiśca vipraiśca virodhaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi \|*  
*bandhiṣyanti tadā pāsā vāruṇā ghoradarśanāḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

71-76. О Bali! He had worshipped me with sheer reverence for a long time. Hence, follow my words and enter into the nether world called Sutala and enjoy the divine pleasure there. There are several thousand palaces, reservoirs enriched with full blossoms lotus, fountains and streams flowing with clean and pure water. О demon king! reside there up to the period told by me. Smear scent on body, wear beautiful garments, garlands and sandal, enjoy the company of several hundred beautiful women, their dance and songs and remember that unless you give honour to Brahmins and gods, you will not enjoy all desirous pleasures there. In case, you forget my advice, the Pasa (lord) of Varuna will grip you very hard.

## \|\| 31.77 \|\|

*baliruvāca*  
*tatrāsato me pātāle bhagavan bhavadājñayā \|*  
*kiṃ bhaviṣyatyupādānamupabhogopapādakam \|*  
*āpyāyito yena deva smareyaṃ tvāmahaṃ sadā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Bali said- О god! О lord! What will the material for my consumption in the nether world? I need them in abundance so that I could keep your grace always in mind without worries.

## \|\| 31.78 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca*  
*dānānyavidhidattāni śrāddhānyaśrotriyāṇi ca \|*  
*hutānyaśraddhayā yāni tāni dāsyanti te phalam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The Lord said- The donations made by you without following the procedure prescribed, the obeisance without calling expert Brahmins and the havanas you have performed till date without reverence, will bless you there.

## \|\| 31.79 \|\|

*adakṣiṇāstathā yajñāḥ kriyāścāvidhinā kṛtāḥ \|*  
*phalāni tava dāsyanti adhītānyavratāni ca \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. The yajna you have performed without fee (daksina) given to Brahmins, the deeds performed haphazard and the sturdy without resolution shall fructify for you there.

## \|\| 31.80 \|\|

*udakena vinā pūjā vinā darbeṇa yā kriyā \|*  
*ājyena ca vinā homaṃ phalaṃ dāsyanti te bale \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. О Bali! The worship made without water, the ritual without using kusa grass and the havana without ghee will become fruitful to you.

## \|\| 31.81 \|\|

*yaścedaṃ sthānamāśritya kriyāḥ kāścitkariṣyati \|*  
*na tatra cāsuro bhāgo bhaviṣyati kadācana \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Whosoever will perform any activity (religious) at this place, will never be subjugated by the monsters.

## \|\| 31.82-83 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhāśrame mahāpuṇye tathā viṣṇupade hvade \|*  
*ye ca śrāddhāni dāsyanti vrataṃ niyamameva ca \|\| 82 \|\|*

*kriyā kṛtā ca yā kācid vidhināvidhināpi vā \|*  
*sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. Sraddha, donation, fast or resolution and any activity either made abiding by procedure of not by any person at holiest Jyesthasrama and the reservoir called Visnupada Sarovara shall all fructify undoubtedly for him.

## \|\| 31.84 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe ekādasyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā viṣṇupade hvade \|*  
*dānaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The man attains to the supreme position by observing fast on Ekadasi of bright fortnight in the month of June (Jyestha) month, a bath in Visnupada reservoir calls Brahmin and satisfies him with daksina.

## \|\| 31.85 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*balervaramimaṃ dattvā śakrāya ca triviṣṭapam \|*  
*vyāpinā tena rūpeṇa jagāmādarśanaṃ hariḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Lomaharsana said- After gracing this way Bali and giving the empire of the three-world to Indra, the lord in so gigantic a complexion vanished.

## \|\| 31.86 \|\|

*śaśāsa ca yathāpūrvaṃmindrastrailokyamūrjitaḥ \|*  
*niḥśeṣaṃ ca tadā kālaṃ baliḥ pātālamāsthitaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. The mighty Indra then took over the affairs of the three-world and Bali resided/ruled the nether world throughout the period as suggested by god Visnu.

## \|\| 31.87 \|\|

*ityetat kathitaṃ tasya viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*vāmanasya śṛṇvan yastu sarvapāṣaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Thus, the best episode pertaining to that god Vamana was explained. Whosoever will listen to this magnificent story shall definitely be absolved from his sins.

## \|\| 31.88-89 \|\|

*baliprahlādasaṃvādaṃ mantritaṃ baliśukrayoḥ \|*  
*balerviṣṇośca caritaṃ ye smariṣyanti mānavāḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*nādhayo vyādhayasteṣāṃ na ca mohākulaṃ manaḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ puṃsastasya kadācana \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. О great Brahmins! Those people shall enjoy healthy living and peace of mind (free from anxiety due to affection) who keep in memory the collocation between Bali and Prahlada, the deliberation of Bali and Sukra and the noble deeds of Bali and Visnu.

## \|\| 31.90 \|\|

*cyutarājyo nijaṃ rājyamiṣṭaprāptiṃ viyogavān \|*  
*samāpneti mahābhāgā naraḥ śrutvā kathāmimām \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О great souls! The person dethroned receives again his empire and the man suffering from pain of separation gets again an opportunity to see his beloved by listening to it.

## \|\| 31.91 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo vedamāpnoti kṣatriyo jayate mahīm \|*  
*vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhiṃ ca śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*vāmanasya ca māhatmyaṃ śṛṇvan pāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. (By listening to it) the Brahmin gets proper learning in the Vedas, the Ksatriya conquers the earth and the Vaisya receives prosperity as also the Sudra attains pleasure. Its listening absolves a man from his sins.

## Chapter 32. Markandeya eulogises Sarasvati

## \|\| 32.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*kathameṣā samutpannā nadīnāmuttamā nadī \|*  
*sakakhatī mahābhāgā kurukṣetrapravāhinā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits asked- How did the best river Sarasvati among all other rivers originate? We see it flowing in Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 32.2 \|\|

*kathaṃ saraḥ samāsādya kṛtvā tīrthāni pārśvataḥ \|*  
*prayātā paścimāmāśāṃ dṛśyāhṛśyagatiḥ śubhā \|*  
*etad vistarato brūhi tīrthaṃvaṃśaṃ sanātanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. How did this holiest river adopt the western direction with its meeting in reservoir, originating several holy places at along its banks and its visible and invisible flow?

## \|\| 32.3 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*plakṣavṛkṣāt samudbhūtā saricchreṣṭhā sanātanī \|*  
*sarvapāpakṣayakarī smaraṇādeva nityaśaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Lomaharsana said- This everlasting holiest river having extreme power to absolve the evils by mere calling its to one's memory; it has emanated from the Plaksa tree.

## \|\| 32.4 \|\|

*saiṣā śailasahasrāṇi vidārya ca mahānadī \|*  
*praviṣṭā puṇyatoyaughā vanaṃ dvaitamiti smṛtam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. This great river of clean water entered in Dvaita forest after penetrating the womb of several thousand mountains.

## \|\| 32.5 \|\|

*tasmin palkṣe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*praṇipatya tadā mūrdhnā tuṣṭāvātha sarasvatīm \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The great sage Markandeya saw goddess Sarasvati on that Plaksa tree, bowed his head and prayed.

## \|\| 32.6-7 \|\|

*tvaṃ devi sarvalokānāṃ mātā devāraṇiḥ śubhā \|*  
*sadasad devi yatkiñcinmokṣadāyyarthavat padam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tat sarvaṃ tvayi saṃyogi yogivad devi saṃsthitam \|*  
*akṣaraṃ paramaṃ devī yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma viśvaṃ caitat kṣarātmakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. О goddess! You are the mother of all lokas (worlds) and Arani (originator) of the gods. О goddess! all positions of truth, falsehood, leading to emancipation and wealth (essence) are annexed with you like two joint things (matter). О goddess! The supreme knowledge syllable and this mortal world has always existed within you.

## \|\| 32.8 \|\|

*dāruṇyavasthito vahnirbhṛmau gandho yathā dhruvam \|*  
*tathā tvayi sthitaṃ brahma jagaccedamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. As the fire in wood and smell in land has existed everlastingly, knowledge (Brahma) and this entire world has existed within you.

## \|\| 32.9 \|\|

*oṅkārākṣarasaṃsthānaṃ yat tad devi sthirāsthiram \|*  
*tatra mātrātrayaṃ sarvamasti yad devi nāsti ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. О goddess! Everything either movable or immovable exists in the syllable "Om". Whatever is in existence or non-existence holds three matras of the syllable Om.

## \|\| 32.10-12 \|\|

*trayo lokāstrayo vedāstraividyaṃ pāvakatrayam \|*  
*trīṇi jyotīṃṣi vargāśca trayo dharmādayastathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*trayo guṇāstrayo varṇāstrayo devāstathā kramāt \|*  
*traidhātavastathāvasthāḥ pitaraścaivamādayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*etanmātrātrayaṃ devi tava rūpaṃ sarasvati \|*  
*vibhinnadarśanāmādyāṃ brahmaṇo hi sanātanīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. The three worlds (Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah), the three Vedas (Rk, Yajuh and Sama), three learnings (Ayurveda, Dhanurveda and Gandharva), three fires (Garhapatya, Avahanlya and Daksinagni), three luminaries (sun, moon and fire), three steps (vargas) i.e. Dharma, etc., three properties (sattva etc.), three varnas (Brahmana etc. three castes.), three gods, three dhatus (vata, pitta and kapha), three stages (awakening, dream, dormance) and three ancestors (father etc.,) all three matras are your own forms. You are called Adya and Sanatani icon having varied forms of Brahma.

## \|\| 32.13 \|\|

*somasaṃsthā haviḥsaṃsthā pākasaṃsthā sanātanī \|*  
*tāstvaduccāraṇād devi kriyante brahmavādibhiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О goddess! the follower of Brahma (knowledge) perform Somasamstha, Havihsamstha and everlasting Pakasamstha with the chanting of your name.

## \|\| 32.14-15 \|\|

*anirdeśyapadaṃ tvetadarddhamātrāśritaṃ param \|*  
*avikāryakṣayaṃ divyaṃ pariṇāmavivarjitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tavaitat paramaṃ rūpaṃ yanna śakyaṃ mayoditum \|*  
*na cāsyena na vā jihvātālvoṣṭhādibhirucyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О goddess. Undefmable, composed of half a measure, supreme, unchanging, imperishable, celestial, devoid of alteration is this your other supreme form which I cannot express. And even the mouth does not declare it, nor the tongue, the copper-coloured lip, or other organs.

## \|\| 32.16-17 \|\|

*sa viṣṇuḥ sa vṛṣo brahma candrākrajyotireva ca \|*  
*viśvāvāsaṃ viśvarūpaṃ viśvātmānamanīśvaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sāṅkhyasiddhāntavedoktaṃ bahuśākhāsthirīkṛtam \|*  
*anādimadhyanidhanaṃ sadasacca sadeva tu \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. That form of yours is Visnu, Vrsa (Dharma) Brahma, moon, sun and the flame. Whose dwelling is the universe, which has the form of the universe; which is the ruler of the universe, the Supreme Ruler; which is mentioned in the discussions of the Sankhya and Vedanta philosophies, and firmly established in many Vakhas; which is without beginning middle or end; which is good, bad, and neutral.

## \|\| 32.18 \|\|

*ekaṃ tvanekadhāpyekabhāvavedasamāśritam \|*  
*anākhyaṃ ṣaḍguṇākhyaṃ ca bahvākhyaṃ triguṇāśrayam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. It is equally in one and manifold forms, based on one's exclusive devotion to the Vedas, beyond explanation, enriched with six properties (gunas) including luxury etc., consisting of countless explanations and a basis for the three properties (gunas).

## \|\| 32.19 \|\|

*nānāśaktivibhāvajñaṃ nānāśaktivibhāvakam \|*  
*sukhāt sukhaṃ mahātsaukhyaṃ rūpaṃ tattvaguṇātmakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. This form of yours being formed of the element property knows the origin of numerous powers and their originator too. It is the greatest and supreme pleasure (Mahatsukha).

## \|\| 32.20 \|\|

*evaṃ devi tvayā vyāptaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca yat \|*  
*advaitāvasthitaṃ brahma yacca dvaite vyavasthitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О goddess, that which has parts is pervaded by you, and so also that which has no parts; that which resides in non-duality, and that which resides in duality.

## \|\| 32.21 \|\|

*ye'rthā nityā ye vinaśyanti cānye ye'rthāḥ sthūlā ye tathā santi sūkṣmāḥ \|*  
*ye vā bhūmau ye 'ntarikṣenyato vā teṣāṃ devi tvatta evopalabdhiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Things that are permanent, and others that perish; those again that are gross, or those that are subtler than the subtle; those again that are on the earth, or those that are in the atmosphere or elsewhere;— they all derive their perceptibility from you indeed.

## \|\| 32.22 \|\|

*yadvā mūrtaṃ yadamūrtaṃ samastaṃ yadvā bhūteṣvekamekaṃ ca kiñcit \|*  
*yacca dvaite vyastabhūtaṃ ca lakṣyaṃ tatsaṃbaddhaṃ tvatsvarairvyañjanaiśca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Whatever is tangible or intangible, that exists in all organisms in single form, that only for them and the form which is seen as separate forms in Dvaita (duality) that all is connected with your vowels and consonants.

## \|\| 32.23 \|\|

*evaṃ stutā tadā devī viṣṇorjihvā sarasvatī \|*  
*pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ mārkaṇḍeya mahāsunim \|*  
*yatra tvaṃ neṣyase vipra tatra yāsyāmyatandritā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thereupon, being praised thus, the goddess Sarasvati, who is Visnu's tongue, answered the great hermit Markandeya. О Brahmin! I will follow you continuously and without feeling wearied myself wherever you want to take me.

## \|\| 32.24 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca*  
*ādyaṃ brahmasaraḥ puṇyaṃ tato rāmahvadaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*kuruṇā ṛṣiṇā puṣṭaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ smṛtam \|*  
*tasya madhyena vai gāḍhaṃ puṇyā puṇyajalāvahā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Markandeya said- The place at first famous as Brahmasara, then Ramahrda and finally renowned as Kuruksetra when it was cultivated by hermit Kura is all good for your flow. Hence, please, flow there.

## Chapter 33. Praise of Sarasvati

## \|\| 33.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*ityuṣervacanaṃ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ \|*  
*nadī pravāhasaṃyuktā kurukṣetraṃ viveśa ha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- Taking care of the words of highly intelligent Markandeya, the river flowed in Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 33.2 \|\|

*tatra sā rantukaṃ prāpya puṇyatoyā sarasvatī \|*  
*kurakṣetraṃ samāplāvya prayātā paścimāṃ diśam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. That holy water Sarasvati entered in Rantuka, flowed through Kuruksetra and then took a turn towards the west.

## \|\| 33.3 \|\|

*tatra tīrthasahasrāṇi ṛṣibhiḥ sevitāni ca\| tānyahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. There are several thousand holy places surrounded by hermits in Kuruksetra. I will describe them with pleasure of lord Brahma.

## \|\| 33.4 \|\|

*tīrthānāṃ smaraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*snānaṃ muktikaraṃ proktamapi duṣṭṛtakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Even evildoers are blessed when they bring into memory the holy places and visiting them absolves them from sins and a bath there enables them to attain emancipation.

## \|\| 33.5 \|\|

*ye smaranti ca tīrthāni devatāḥ prīṇayanti ca \|*  
*snānti ca śraddadhānāśca te yānti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The persons who keep in memory the holy places with sheer obeisance, please the gods and who take a bath there, attain the supreme position.

## \|\| 33.6 \|\|

*apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato 'pi vā \|*  
*yaḥ smaret kurukṣetraṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The person who is either pure in heart or malicious or whatever his position and who remembers Kuruksetra, becomes pure in body and mind both.

## \|\| 33.7 \|\|

*kurukṣatraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyaham \|*  
*ityevaṃ vācamutsṛjya sarvapāṣaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. I will go to Kuruksetra and reside there; whosoever says or resolves, absolves the man from all sins.

## \|\| 33.8 \|\|

*brahmajñānaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ gograhe maraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ kurukṣetre muktiruktā caturvidhā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The knowledge on Brahma, Sraddha in Gaya, stake of life for the cause of cows defence and dwelling in Kuruksetra are the four acts said to be deserving emancipation for human beings.

## \|\| 33.9 \|\|

*sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyordevanadyoryadantaram \|*  
*taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmavartaṃ pracakṣate \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The country made by gods in the middle of two divine rivers i.e. Sarasvati and Drsadvati, is called Brahmavarta.

## \|\| 33.10 \|\|

*dūrastho 'pi kurukṣetre gacchāmi ca vasāmyaham \|*  
*evaṃ yaḥ satataṃ brūyāt so 'pi pāṣaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The person who says- "I will go to Kuruksetra and reside there" is absolved from all sins committed.

## \|\| 33.11 \|\|

*tatra caiva saraḥsnāyī sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ \|*  
*tasya jñānaṃ brahmamayamutpatsyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. the man who takes a bath in the reservoir while living on the bank of Sarasvati, undoubtedly acquires Brahmajnana.

## \|\| 33.12 \|\|

*devatā ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sevante kurujāṅgalam \|*  
*tasya saṃsevanānnityaṃ brahma cātmani paśyati \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The gods, hermits and siddhas always live in Kuruksetra. The men living there regularly perceives Brahma within him.

## \|\| 33.13-14 \|\|

*cañcalaṃ hi manuṣyatvaṃ prāpya ye mokṣakāṅkiṇaḥ \|*  
*sevanti niyatātmāno api duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*te vimuktāśca kaluṣairanekajanmasaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*paśyanti nirmalaṃ devaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ sanātanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. The evildoers and whosoever reside there keen of emancipation by putting appropriate control over their senses, get rid of the painful chain of sins coming down from several evils committed in numerous preceding lines and can see the almighty in their hearts.

## \|\| 33.15 \|\|

*brahmavediḥ kurukṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihitaṃ saraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The persons attain supreme position who continuously live in Kuruksetra, worship Brahmavedi and take a bath in the holy water of the reservoir which has been there.

## \|\| 33.16 \|\|

*grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ kālena patanād bhayam \|*  
*kurukṣetre mṛtānāṃ ca patanaṃ naiva vidyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Decline of the stars, constellations and galaxy is sure in the course of time but the persons dying in Kuruksetra never suffer from falling down.

## \|\| 33.17 \|\|

*yatra brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ \|*  
*gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāḥ sevanti sthānakāṅkṣiṇaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Brahma etc. gods, hermits, siddhas, soothsayers, Gandharvas, nymphs and demigods reside there for the sake of attaining to supreme position.

## \|\| 33.18 \|\|

*gatvā tu śraddhāyā yuktaḥ snātvā sthāṇumahāhvade \|*  
*manasā cintitaṃ kāmaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. A man undoubtedly enjoys desired fruit when he visits there (Kuruksetra) and takes a bath in the great reservoir of Sthanu as it is called.

## \|\| 33.19-21 \|\|

*niyamaṃ ta tataḥ kṛtvā gatvā saraḥ pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*rantukaṃ ca samāsādya kṣamayitvā punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sarasvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya ca \|*  
*puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca naivaidyaṃ datvā vācamudīrayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tava prasādād yakṣendra vānāni saritaśca yāḥ \|*  
*bhramiṣyāmi ca tīrthāni avighneṃ kuru me sadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. One should first devise a regulated routine, walk around the reservoir (sarovara), visit Rantuka, pray to be absolved of his evils again and again, take a bath in Sarasvati, see the demi-god, salute him and submit a prayer when flowers, fragrance and naivedya is duly offered as- "O the king of demi-gods! I will walk around the forest, rivers and holy places here. So, please, remove all hurdles I may find in those places."

## Chapter 34. Account of the forests, rivers and tirthas of Kuruksetra

## \|\| 34.1 \|\|

*ṛśaya ūcuḥ*  
*vanāni sapta no brūhi nava nadyaśca yāḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*tīrthāni ca samagrāṇi tīrthasnānaphalaṃ tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits said- Describe please, the magnificence of those seven forests, nine rivers, all holy places and a bath in them.

## \|\| 34.2 \|\|

*yena yena vidhānena yasya tīrthasya yat phalam \|*  
*tat sarvaṃ vistateṇeha brūhi paurāṇikottama \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О best among the hermits learned in the Puranas! Kindly tell us the procedure to be adopted for each and every holy place in order to reap perfect grace.

## \|\| 34.3 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca\|*  
*śṛṇu sapta vanānīha kuruthetrasya madhyataḥ \|*  
*yeṣāṃ nāmāni puṇyāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Lomaharsana said- Listen to the names of the seven forests of Kuruksetra as by merely listening to these names, a man attains Derfect freedom from the clutches of evils.

## \|\| 34.4-8 \|\|

*kāmyakaṃ ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ tathāditivanaṃ mahat \|*  
*vyāsasya ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ phalakīvanameva ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tatra sūryavanasthānaṃ tathā madhuvanaṃ mahat \|*  
*puṇyaṃ śītavanaṃ nāma sarvakalmaṣanāśanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vanānyetāni vai sapta nadīḥ śṛṇuta me dvijāḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī nadī puṇyā tathā vaitaraṇī nadī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*āpagā ca mahāpuṇyā gaṅgā mandākinī nadī \|*  
*madhusrāvā vāsunadī kauśikī pāpanāśinī \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dṛṣadvatī mahāpuṇyā tathā hiraṇvatī nadī \|*  
*varṣākālavahāḥ sarvā varjayitvā sarasvatīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

4-8. These names are Kamyak-vana, Aditivana, Vyasavana, Pulakivana, Suryavana, Madhuvana and Sitavana. All these are sacred forests. О Brahmins! now listen to the names of the holy rivers. These are- Sarasvati, Vaitarani, Apaga, Mandakini, Gangs, Madhusrava, Vasu, Kausiki, Drsadvati and Hiranyavati. All rivers besides Sarasvati among these only flow during the rainy season.

## \|\| 34.9 \|\|

*etāsāmudakaṃ puṇyaṃ prāvṛṭkāle prakīrtitam \|*  
*rajasvalatvametāsāṃ vidyate na kadācana \|*  
*tīrthasya ca prabhāveṇa puṇyā hyetāḥ saridvarāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Their water is considered clean and pure during the rainy season. These never suffer from the impurity of menstruation. By virtue of being holy places, all these rivers are holy.

## \|\| 34.10 \|\|

*śṛṇvantu munayaḥ prītāstīrthasnānaphalaṃ sahat \|*  
*gamanaṃ smaraṇaṃ caiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О sages! Listen cheerfully to the great fruit for bathing in this holy place. A visit and keeping it in memory a bath are major measures to efface the evils.

## \|\| 34.11 \|\|

*rantukaṃ ca naro dṛṣṭvā dvārapālaṃ mahābalam \|*  
*yakṣaṃ samabhivādyaiva tīrtayātrāṃ samācaret \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The journey should be started when the gatekeeper demi-god Rantuka is duly seen and saluted.

## \|\| 34.12 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprāndrā nāmnāditivanaṃ mahat \|*  
*adityā yatra gutrārthaṃ kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahattapaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Brahmins! Aditivana should then be visited. Aditi had observed strict penance here for being blessed with a son.

## \|\| 34.13 \|\|

*tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca aditiṃ devamātaram \|*  
*putraṃ janayate śūraṃ sarvadoṣivivarjitam \|*  
*ādityaśatasaṃkāśaṃ vimānaṃ cādhirohati \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The person reproduces a chivalrous and meritorious son when he takes a bath and then sees the icon of Aditi here. He rides on an aircraft (Virnana) illuminated as several thousand suns (viz. he receives extraordinary guide from almighty and performs noble deeds in his life-time).

## \|\| 34.14 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam \|*  
*savanaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ yatra saṃnihito hariḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О great Brahmins! The place renowned as Savana should then be visited. It is the everlasting place of residing where lord Visnu, the defender of the world, always resides.

## \|\| 34.15 \|\|

*vimale ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca vimaleśvaram \|*  
*nirmalaṃ svargamāyāti rudralokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Then there comes Vimala tirtha. The man who takes a bath and sees the temple of Vimalesvara attains divine life and goes to the abode of Rudra after his death.

## \|\| 34.16 \|\|

*hariṃ ca baladevaṃ ca ekatrāsasamanvitau \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā mokṣamavāpnoti kalikalmaṣasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The man seeing Krsna and Balarama jointly sitting absolves him from all evils which may usually be committed due to the impact of the Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 34.17-18 \|\|

*tataḥ pāriplavaṃ gacchet tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ vedasaṃyutam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*brahmavedaphalaṃ prāpya nirmalaṃ svargamāpnuyāt \|*  
*tatrāpi saṃgamaṃ prāpya kauśikyāṃ tīrthasaṃbhavam \|*  
*saṃgame ca naraḥ snātvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. He should then go to Pariplava, a holy place, famous all over the three-world. Heavenly abode is achieved and the man approaches Brahma (knowledge) as a blessing for taking a bath and seeing Brahma with the Vedas. Supreme position is achieved when a man takes a bath at the confluence of Kausiki

## \|\| 34.19 \|\|

*dharaṇyāstīrthamāsādya sarvapāpavimocanam \|*  
*kṣāntiyukto naraḥ snātvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The man given to forgiveness as virtue in him, attains supreme position when he takes a bath in the holy place of Dharani. It absolves him from all sins attached with a man.

## \|\| 34.20 \|\|

*dharaṇyāmaparādhāni kṛtāni puruṣeṇa vai \|*  
*sarvāṇi kṣamate tasya snātamātrasya dehinaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. All offences committed by a man in this world are compounded or waived off when he takes a bath here.

## \|\| 34.21 \|\|

*tato dakṣāśramaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā dekṣeśvaraṃ śivam \|*  
*aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A visit to the asrama of Daksa and a sight of Siva as Daksesvara endows a man with the fruit as he would have obtained for Asvamedha yajna (horse sacrifice).

## \|\| 34.22 \|\|

*tataḥ śālūkinīṃ gatvā snātvā tīrthe dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*hariṃ hareṇa saṃyuktaṃ pūjya bhaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*prapnotyakṣimatāṃllokān sarvapāpavivarjitān \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О great Brahmins! The man attains to the desired worlds (lokas) and his sins are absolved when he takes a bath in Salukini, the holy place and bows his head with keen reverence before an icon of Hari and Hara both compact.

## \|\| 34.23 \|\|

*sarpirdadhi samāsādya nāgānāṃ tīrthamuttamam \|*  
*tatra snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā mukto nāgabhayād bhavet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The fear of serpent-bite during life-span is effaced for ever when a man visits Sarpirdadhi, the holy place of serpents and takes a bath there.

## \|\| 34.24-27 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā dvārapālaṃ tu rantukam \|*  
*tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ snātvā tīrthavare śubhe \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dvitīyaṃ pūjayed yatra dvārapālaṃ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tava prasādād yakṣendra mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ \|*  
*siddhirmayābhilaṣitā tayā sārddhaṃ bhavāmyaham \|*  
*evaṃ prasādya yakṣendraṃ tataḥ pañcanadaṃ vrajet \|\| 26 \|\|*

*pañcanadāśca rudreṇa kṛtā dānavabhīṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*tatra sarveṣu lokeṣu tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ smṛtam \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. О great Brahmins! One should then again visit Rantuka, the gatekeeper and stay there for a night. He should take a bath the next morning, pay homage to Rantuka and offer food to Brahmins there. He should then say with folded hands- О king of demi-gods! a man is absolved from his evils when graced by you. Bless me that I could get success for what I have proposed. Pancanada, another holy place should then be visited. God Rudra had (constructed) flown five rivers here for the demons. It is, therefore, called Pancanada.

## \|\| 34.28 \|\|

*koṭitīrthāni rudreṇa samāhṛtya yataḥ sthitam \|*  
*tena trailokyavikhyātaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ pracakṣate \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. As Rudra exists there incorporating with him several crore holy places, it is called Kotitirtha.

## \|\| 34.29 \|\|

*tasmin tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ haram \|*  
*pañcayajñānavāpnoti nityaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. A man taking a bath with sheer obeisance and seeing Hara known as Kotisvara is blessed with the same fruit as he would have obtained by arranging of the five sacrifices.

## \|\| 34.30 \|\|

*tatraiva vāmano devaḥ sarvadevaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|*  
*tatrāpi ca naraḥ snātvā hyagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The gods have installed there are icon of god Vamana. A man gets the blessing equal to Agnistoma yajna when he takes a bath there.

## \|\| 34.31 \|\|

*aśvinostīrthamāsādya śraddhāvān yo jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*rūpasya bhāgī bhavati yaśasvī ca bhavennaraḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The man who exercise checks on his senses and has keen obeisance, gets a beautiful complexion and fame as blessing for bathing in the holy place of Asvinikumaras.

## \|\| 34.32 \|\|

*vārāhaṃ tīrthamākhyātaṃ viṣṇunā parikīrtitam \|*  
*tasmin snātvā śraddadhānaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A man achieves supreme position when he takes a bath in the holy place of Varaha as described by lord Visnu himself.

## \|\| 34.33 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrāḥ somatīrthamanuttamam \|*  
*yatra somastapastaptvā vyādhimukto 'bhavat purā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О great Brahmins! Soma-tirtha should then be visited. The moon during long past, had observed strict penance here in order to get rid of disease.

## \|\| 34.34-35 \|\|

*tatra someśvare dṛṣṭvā snātvā tīrthavare śubhe \|*  
*rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*vyādhibhiśca vinirmuktaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*somalokamapāpnoti tatraiva ramate ciram \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. A man is blessed with the fruits equal to Rajasuya yajna, enjoys his life free from the clutches of ailments and physical defects, goes to Somaloka after death and enjoys all pleasure there for a prolonged period as a result of a mere bath in that holy place.

## \|\| 34.36 \|\|

*bhūteśvaraṃ ca tatraiva jvālāmāleśvaraṃ tathā \|*  
*tāvubhau liṅgāvabhyarcya na bhūyo janma cāpnuyāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. There are two lingas (i.e. Bhutesvara and Jvalamalesvara) at that very place. A man gets-rid of the birth and death cycle when he worships them.

## \|\| 34.37-40 \|\|

*ekahaṃse naraḥ snātvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*kṛtaśocaṃ samāsādya tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*puṇḍarīkamavāpnoti kṛkaśauco bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*tato muñjavaṭaṃ nāma mahādevasya dhīmataḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnayāt \|*  
*tatraiva ca mahāgrāhī yakṣiṇī lokaviśrutā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*snātvābigatvā tatraiva prasādya yakṣiṇīṃ tataḥ \|*  
*upavāsaṃ ca tatraiva mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. Fruits equal to the donation of several thousand cows is obtained when a bath is taken in Ekahamsa. The great Dvija attains to purity of mind and a fruit of Punparika (a special yajna) on a mere visit at the holy place of "Krtasauca". He attains Ginapatya on a night halt at holy place of Munjavata of Mahadeva. Mahagrahi Yaksini popularly known to the world is also there. One should take a bath here, pay homage to Yaksini and observe a fast. It will efface all heinous evils committed by him earlier.

## \|\| 34.41 \|\|

*kurukṣetrasya tad dvāraṃ viśrutaṃ puṇyavarddhūnam \|*  
*pradakṣiṇamupāvartya brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ \|*  
*puṣkaraṃ ca tato gatvā abhyarcya pitṛdevatāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. He should do pradaksipa (round turn) of the famous gate of Kuruksetra and offer food to the Brahmins. He should then visit Puskara and do worship of his Pitts.

## \|\| 34.42 \|\|

*jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa āhṛtaṃ tanmahātmanā \|*  
*kṛtakṛtyo bhaved rājā aśvamedhaṃ ca vindati \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Jamdagnya Rama (Parasurama) has established this holy place. The man attains to his ambition and the king avails of the fruit equal to Asvamedha yajna.

## \|\| 34.43 \|\|

*kanyādānaṃ ca yastatra kārtikyāṃ vai kariṣyati \|*  
*prasannā devatāstasya dāsyantyabhimataṃ pharam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Whosoever will solemnise the marriage of his daughter (Kanyadana) there, receives definitely the fruit desired by him provided that it should be performed on a full moon day of Kartika month.

## \|\| 34.44 \|\|

*kapalaśca mahāyakṣo dvārapālaḥ khayaṃ sthitaḥ \|*  
*vighnaṃ karoti pāpānāṃ durgati ca prayacchati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The great demi-god Kapila is the gatekeeper there who punishes the evildoer and restricts their entry inside.

## \|\| 34.45 \|\|

*patnī tasya mahāyakṣī nāmnodūkhalamekhalā \|*  
*āhatya dundubhiṃ tatra bhramate nityameva hi \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. His wife Udukhalamekhala, a great Yaksini strolls there daily plying a trumpet.

## \|\| 34.46 \|\|

*sā dadarśa striyaṃ caikāṃ saputrāṃ pāpadeśajām \|*  
*tāmuvāca tadā yakṣī āhatya niśi dundubhim \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. That Yaksini saw a woman with her son bom in the country of evil played the trumpet and said to her.

## \|\| 34.47 \|\|

*yugandhare dadhi prāśya uṣitvā cācyutasthale \|*  
*tadvad bhūtālaye snātvā saputrā vastumicchasi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. You want to take curd in Yugandhara, live in Acyutasthala, take a bath in Bhutalaya and then dwell permanently with your son.

## \|\| 34.48-49 \|\|

*divā mayā te kathitaṃ rātrau bhakṣyāmi niścitam \|*  
*etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ praṇipatya ca yakṣiṇīm \|\| 48 \|\|*

*uvāca dīnayā vācā prasādaṃ kuru bhāmini \|*  
*tataḥ sā yakṣiṇī tāṃ tu provāca kṛpayānvitā \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. I have talked to you in the day but I will eat you definitely at night. That woman bowed her head and said politely- "O sister! be gracious to me." Yaksini then said her-

## \|\| 34.50 \|\|

*yadā sūryasya grahaṇaṃ kālena bhavitā kvacit \|*  
*saṃnihatyāṃ tadā snātvā pūtā svargaṃ kamiṣyasi \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. You should take a bath on the day of solar eclipse in Sannihatya. It will bring back purity to you and then you will attain to the heaven.

## Chapter 35. Account of various tirthas and forests

## \|\| 35.1-3 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*tato rāmahṛdaṃ gacchet tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*yatra rāmeṇa vipreṇa tarasā dīptatejasā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kṣatramutsādya vīreṇa hradāḥ pañca niveśitāḥ \|*  
*pūrayitvā naravyāghra rudhireṇeti naḥ śrutam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pitarastarpitāstena tathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ \|*  
*tataste pitaraḥ prītā rāmamūcurdvijottamāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Lomaharsana said- The Dvija should then visit Ramahrda. Brahmin Rama (Parasurama), chivalrous son of Jamadagni had made five reservoirs here when he killed forcibly the Ksatriyas. O king to people! We heard that he had filled these five reservoirs with the blood of the Ksatriyas and thus satiated his Pitara and grandfathers. О great Dvijas! the so pleased Pitras then said to Parasurama-

## \|\| 35.4 \|\|

*rāma rāma mahābāho prītāḥ smastava bhārgava \|*  
*anayā pitṛbhaktyā ca vikrameṇa ca te vibho \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О chivalrous! О Bhargava Rama! О sovereign! We are pleased with your devotion to Pitrs and your valour as well.

## \|\| 35.5-8 \|\|

*varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te kimicchasi mahāyaśaḥ \|*  
*evamuktastu pitṛbhī rāmaḥ prabhavatāḥ paraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*abravīt prāñjalirvākyaṃ sa pitṛn gagane sthitān \|*  
*bhavanto yadi me prītā yadya nugrāhyatā mayi \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pitṛprasādādiccheyaṃ tapasāpyāyanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*yacca poṣābhibhūtena kṣatramutsāditaṃ mayā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tataśca pāpānmucyeyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ tejasā hyaham \|*  
*hradāścaite tīrthabhūtā bhaveyurbhuvi viśrutāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. О great illustrious! Ask us whatever you want? Parasurama the most chivalrous said with folded hands- "I would like to regain my power of austerity if you really are pleased with me and desirous of giving what I desire. May the splendour with you absolve me from the offence I committed by the massacre of the Ksatriyas in my vagary of anger. May these reservoirs be famous as holy place in the world!

## \|\| 35.9 \|\|

*evamuktāḥ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ rāmasya pitarastadā \|*  
*pratyūcuḥ paramaprītā rāmaṃ harṣapuraskṛtāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The ancestors cheered on listening to this desire and said-

## \|\| 35.10-11 \|\|

*tapaste varddhūtāṃ putra pitṛbhaktyā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yacca roṣābhibhūtena kṣatramutsāditaṃ tvayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tataśca pāpānmuktastvaṃ pātitāste kvakarmabhiḥ \|*  
*hradāśca tava tīrthatvaṃ gamīṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. О son! May your penance increase manifold by virtue of your devotion to Pitrs. As the Ksatriyas were killed due to their evil acts, you are now free from the trap of that evil. These reservoirs made by you shall undoubtedly become holy places during the days to come.

## \|\| 35.12-14 \|\|

*hradeṣveteṣu ye snātvā svān pitṝṃstarpayanti ca \|*  
*tebhyo dāsyanti pitaro yathābhilaṣitaṃ varam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*īpsitān mānasān kāmān svargavāsaṃ ca śāśvatam \|*  
*evaṃ dattvā varān viprā rāmasya pitarastadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*āmantrya bhārgavaṃ prītāstatraivāntarhitāstadā \|*  
*evaṃ rāmahradāḥ puṇyā bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. The people who do tarpana of their Pitrs after a bath in these reservoirs, shall achieve their ambitions and everlasting residence in heaven after death by the grace of Pitrs. О Brahmins! The Pitrs of Parasurama then wished to return and cheerfully vanished there. Thus, these reservoirs had become holy places.

## \|\| 35.15 \|\|

*snātvā hradeṣu rāmasya brahmacārī śucivrataḥ \|*  
*rāmamabhyarcya śraddhāvān vinded bahu suvarṇakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The man by virtue of his reverence, purity in resolution observes celibacy and takes a bath in the reservoirs made by Parasurama and then worships him. It renders him with considerable quantum of gold.

## \|\| 35.16 \|\|

*vaṃśamūlaṃ samāsādya tīrthasevī susaṃyataḥ \|*  
*svavaṃśasiddhaye viprāḥ snātvā vai vaṃśamūlake \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О Brahmins! A bath in Vansamula tirtha renders a man with axiom in his race when he visits there and regulates his senses properly.

## \|\| 35.17 \|\|

*kāyaśodhanamāsādya tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*śarīrasuddhimāpnoti snātastasmin na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A man's body enjoys purity when he takes a bath in the renowned holy place Kayasodhana. It is famous all through the three worlds.

## \|\| 35.18 \|\|

*suddhadehaśca taṃ yāti yasmānnāvartate punaḥ \|*  
*tāvad bhramanti tīrtheṣu siddhāstīrthaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*yāvanna prāpnuvantīha tīrthaṃ tatkāyaśodhanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The man with so purified a body then goes to a place from where he never returns. The Siddha Purusa visits frequently the holy places unless they reach at Kayasodhana.

## \|\| 35.19 \|\|

*tasmistīrthe ca saṃplāvya kāyaṃ saṃyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*paraṃ padamavāpnoti yasmānnāvartate punaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The man having doubts in mind and heart too approaches such supreme position from where he returns never by cleaning his body in that holy place.

## \|\| 35.20-21 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrāstīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*lokā yatroddhatāḥ sarve viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*lokoddhāraṃ sāmāsādya tīrthasmaraṇatatparaḥ \|*  
*snātvātīrthavare tasmin lokān paśyati śāśvatān \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. О great Brahmins! One should then visit the holy places Lokoddhara, famous in the three worlds. Lord Visnu had promoted all lokas there. A bath in Lokoddhara enables a man to see everlasting lokas provided that he should keep in memory this holy place every time.

## \|\| 35.22 \|\|

*yatra viṣṇuḥ sthito nityaṃ śivo devaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*tau devau praṇipātena prasādya muktimāpnuyāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Visnu and Siva both gods are there. One should, therefore, do salute to them and please for their grace. It will lead him to emancipation.

## \|\| 35.23 \|\|

*śrītīrthaṃ tu tato gacchet śālagrāmamanuttamam \|*  
*tatra snātasya sānnidhyaṃ sadā devī prayacchati \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The holy place pertaining to goddess Salagrama should then be visited. The goddess gives a dwelling place close to her when a bath is taken there.

## \|\| 35.24-27 \|\|

*kapilāhradamāsādya tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca daivatāni pitṛstathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kapilānāṃ sahasrasya phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ \|*  
*tatra sthitaṃ mahādevaṃ kāpilaṃ vapurāsthitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā muktimavāpnoti ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ śivam \|*  
*sūryatīrthaṃ samāsādya snātvā niyatamānasaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*arcayitvā pitṛn devānupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*agniṣṭomamavāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. The blessing equal to donation of one thousand Kapils cows is obtained when a man visits Kapilahrda, a famous holy place in the three-worlds, takes a bath there and worships gods and Pifrs. Emancipation is attained by seeing Mahadeva Siva worshipped there by hermits having pale bodies. The man should observe fast, impose control on his mind and heart, take a bath in Surya-tirtha and worship his Pitrs. It renders the fruit equal to Agnistoma and the devotee goes to Suryaloka (abode of sun) after death.

## \|\| 35.28 \|\|

*sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ bhānuṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā muktimavāpnoti naro jñānasamanvitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The man rendered with knowledge when he sees sun god, with thousand rays and renowned in the three-worlds definitely then attains to emancipation.

## \|\| 35.29 \|\|

*bhavānīvanāmāsādya tīrthasevī yathākramam \|*  
*tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The man on a pilgrimage then goes to Bhavani-vana for religious bathing and receives a gift equal to the donation of one thousand cows.

## \|\| 35.30 \|\|

*pitāmahasya pibato hyamṛtaṃ pūrvameva hi \|*  
*udgārāt surabhirjātā sā ca pātālamāśritā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A cow (Surabhi) was originated from the mouth of Brahma when he was eructating in the distant past. The cow so originated then entered into the nether world.

## \|\| 35.31 \|\|

*tasyāḥ surabhayo jātāḥ tanayā lokamātaraḥ \|*  
*tābhistatsakalaṃ vyāptaṃ pātālaṃ sunirantaram \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The cows generally address as mother by people then bom from that single cow. The generation was so spurted up that the nether world was fully covered with cows.

## \|\| 35.32 \|\|

*pitāmahasya yajato dakṣiṇārthamupāhṛtāḥ \|*  
*āhutā brahmaṇā tāśca vibhrāntā vivareṇa hi \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. These were brought for daksina when lord Brahma arranged an offering and so brought cows trapped in cave thereby misdirected.

## \|\| 35.33 \|\|

*tasmin vivaradvāre tu sthito gaṇapatiḥ svayam \|*  
*yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakalān kāmān prāpnotisaṃyatendriyaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Ganapati himself is seated at the door of that cave, the man who has good control over his senses achieves all success in his mission by merely seeing him there.

## \|\| 35.34-35 \|\|

*saṃginīṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ muktisamāśrayam \|*  
*devyāstīrthe naraḥ snātvā labhate rūpamuttamam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*anantāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautrasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*bhogāṃśca vipulān bhuktvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. As a result of a bath in the holy place Sartgini, a man gets a beautiful complexion, undepleting luxuries, sons and grandsons and occupies, ensures emancipation for the devotee.

## \|\| 35.36 \|\|

*brahmāvarte naraḥ snātvā brahmajñānasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*bhavate nātra sandehaḥ prāṇān muñcati svecchayā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A bath in Brahmivartta leads a man to become a Brahma knower and he abandons body whenever so desired by him.

## \|\| 35.37-38 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā dvārapālaṃ tu rantukam \|*  
*tasya tīrthaṃ sarasvatyāṃ yakṣendrasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā mahāprājña upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*yakṣasya ca prasādena labhate kāmikaṃ phalam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. О great Brahmins! He should then go to the holy place called Rantuka located on the bank of Sarasvati river. Rantuka is a great demi-god and blesses the man with fulfilment of desire when a bath is taken and fast is observed there.

## \|\| 35.39 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā brahmavartaṃ munistutam \|*  
*brahmāvarte naraḥ snātvā brahma cāpnoti niścitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О great Brahmins! One should thereafter visit the holy place Brahmavartta, the place appreciated by sages. A man who takes bath in this place attains supreme Brahma.

## \|\| 35.40-41 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrāḥ sutīrthakamanuttamam \|*  
*tatra saṃnihitā nityaṃ pitaro daivataiḥ saha \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta pitṛdevārcane rataḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhamavāpnoti pitṛn prīṇāti śāśvatān \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. О great Brahmins! Then there comes the number of holy place Sutirthaka. The Pitrs with gods reside there. A bath and worship of gods and Pitrs endows the man with the fruit of Asvamedha sacrifice as this act pleases his Pitrs.

## \|\| 35.42-45 \|\|

*tato 'mbuvanaṃ dharmajña samāsādya yathākramam \|*  
*kāmeśvarasya tīrthaṃ tu snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sarvavyādhivinirmukto brahmavāptirbhaved dhruvam \|*  
*mātṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva yatra snātasya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*prajā vivarddhate nityamanantāṃ cāpnubhācchriyam \|*  
*tataḥ śītavanaṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tīrthaṃ tatra mahāviprā mahadanyatra durlabham \|*  
*punāti darśanādeva daṇḍakaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. О great religious! One should then go to Ambuvana and see the holy place Kamesvara. A bath there ensures obtaining Brahma and a body free from ailments. There falls another holy place Matrtirtha. A bath here blesses one with children and undepleting wealth. Sltavana is then worth seeing. The man should impose due control on his diet and the senses both in route to this holy place. A rare holy place dandaka is also existed in that forest somewhere else. It renders purity of heart and mind merely by seeing it.

## \|\| 35.46 \|\|

*keśānabhyukṣya vai tasmin pūto bhavati pāpataḥ \|*  
*tatra tīrthavaraṃ cānyat svānulomāyanaṃ mahat \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A man gets-rid of clutches of evils when he does mundana ceremony (shaving off hair from head completely). One more holy place Svanulomayana is also there.

## \|\| 35.47-48 \|\|

*tatra viprā mahāprājñā vidvāṃsastīrthatatparāḥ \|*  
*svanulomāyane tīrthe viprāstrailokyaviśrute \|\| 47 \|\|*

*prāṇāyāmairniharanti svalomāni dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*pūtātmānaśca te viprāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. О great Brahmins! In this famous holy place, the learned Brahmins abandon their hair and attain supreme position with all purity in soul.

## \|\| 35.49 \|\|

*daśāśvamedhikaṃ caiva tatra tīrthaṃ suviśrutam \|*  
*tatra snātvā bhaktiyuktastadeva labhate phalam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. There is one more holy place Dasasvamedhika and it renders the same fruit on bathing here as is rendered by Svanulomayana.

## \|\| 35.50 \|\|

*tato gaccheta śraddhāvān mānuṣaṃ lokaviśrutam \|*  
*darśanāt tasya tīrthasya mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The man on pilgrimage should then visit Manusa-tirtha, a popular holy place of the world. Merely seeing it, ensures weaving-off of evils.

## \|\| 35.51 \|\|

*purā kṛṣṇamṛgāstatra vyādhena śarapīḍitāḥ \|*  
*vigāhya tasmin sarasi mānuṣatvamupāgatāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. In days of yore, black stag suffering from the pain of an arrow shot by a hunter fell down in that reservoir but suddenly he gained a manly body.

## \|\| 35.52-55 \|\|

*tato vyādhāśca te sarve tānapṛcchan dvijottamān \|*  
*mṛgā anena vai yātā asmābhiḥ śarapīḍitāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*nimagnāste saraḥ prāpya kva te yātā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*te 'bruvaṃstatra vai pṛṣṭā vayaṃ te ca dvijottamāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*asya tīrthasya māhātmyān mānuṣatvamupāgatāḥ \|*  
*tasmād yūyaṃ śraddadhānāḥ snātvā tīrthe vimatsarāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmuktā bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ snātāśca te sarve śuddhadehā divaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. The hunters had then asked those Brahmins- О great Dvija! a black stag, shot by us has suddenly vanished from this reservoir. Can you tell us where it may be now? The Brahmin replied- "I myself was that stag but now got a human body when I fell in this reservoir. You all can be resolved from sins if a bath with sheer reverence is taken by you." They all followed him, got purity in body and thus, approached the heavenly abode.

## \|\| 35.56 \|\|

*etat tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mānuṣasya dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*ye śṛṇvanti śraddadhānāste 'pi yānti parāṃ gatim \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. О great Dvijas! The people mere listening to this magnificence of Manusa-tirtha too attain supreme position.

## Chapter 36. Account of tirthas of Kuruksetra

## \|\| 36.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*mānuṣasya tu pūrveṇa krośamātre dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*āpagā nāma vikhyātā nadī dvijaniṣevitā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- О great Dvijas! A popular river Apaga flows at a length of one kosa facing east from Manusa-tirtha. Dvijas live on its banks.

## \|\| 36.2 \|\|

*śyāmākaṃ payasā siddhamājyena ca pariplutam \|*  
*ye prayacchanti viprebhyasteṣāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The people who feed Brahmins on a cuisine of Syamaka rice cooked in milk and added ghee, become free from the clutches of sins.

## \|\| 36.3 \|\|

*ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti prāpya tāmāpagāṃ nadīm \|*  
*te sarvakāmasaṃyuktā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The persons doing sraddha on the bank of Apaga river shall undoubtedly receive their mission duly achieved.

## \|\| 36.4-5 \|\|

*śaṃsanti sarve pitaraḥ smaranti ca pitāmahāḥ \|*  
*asmākaṃ ca kule putraḥ pautro vāpi bhaviṣyati \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ya āpagāṃ nadīṃ gatvā tilaiḥ saṃtarpayiṣyati \|*  
*tena tṛptā bhaviṣyāmo yāvatkalpaśataṃ gatam \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The Pitts say and Pitamaha bring to mind a wish to get tarpana made with sesamum seed on the bank of Apaga from a son or grand-son bom in their clan. They imagine that their act will keep them satiated for the period of several hundred kalpas.

## \|\| 36.6 \|\|

*nabhasye māsi samprāpte kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*caturdaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne piṇḍado muktimāpnuyāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The man giving Pinda to his Pifrs at noon on fourteenth day of dark fortnight in the month of Bhadrapada (August) definitely attains to emancipation.

## \|\| 36.7 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā brahmaṇaḥ sthanamuttamam \|*  
*brahmodumbaramityevaṃ sarvalokeṣu piśrutam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О great Brahmins! One should then visit Brahmodumbara, the best place of Brahma as duly known to this world.

## \|\| 36.8 \|\|

*tatra brahmarṣikuṇḍeṣu snātasya dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*saptarṣiṇāṃ prasādena saptasomaphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Brahmins! The man bathing in reservoirs called Brahmarsi/kundas obtains the fruit of Somayajna by the grace of Saptarsis.

## \|\| 36.9-10 \|\|

*bharadvājo gautamaśca jamadagniśca kaśyapaḥ \|*  
*viśvāmitro vasiṣṭhaśca atriśca bhagavānṛpiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*etaiḥ sametya tatkuṇḍaṃ kalpitaṃ bhuvi durlabham \|*  
*brahmaṇā sevitaṃ yasmād brahmodumbaramucyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. This reservoir was made by the joint participation of Bharadvaja, Gautama, Jamadagni, Kasyapa, Visvamitra, Vasistha and the renowned hermit Atri. As lord Brahma resides here it is called Brahmodumbara.

## \|\| 36.11 \|\|

*tasmiṃstīrthavare snāto brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|*  
*brahmalokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A bath in this best holy place of inexpressible and unborn Brahma enables a man to access to Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 36.12 \|\|

*devān pitṝn samuddiśya yo vipraṃ bhojayiṣyati \|*  
*pitarastasya sukhitā dāsyanti bhuvi durlabham \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The man who will feed Brahmins for the purpose of satiation of gods and Pitrs, the pleased Pitrs shall render him with the rare thing of the world.

## \|\| 36.13 \|\|

*saptarṣīśca samuddaśya pṛtham snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāṃ ca prasādena saptalokādhipo bhavet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A man taking a bath seven times i.e. each for the pleasure of a hermit out of seven; their pleasure will endow him ruling on seven worlds.

## \|\| 36.14-15 \|\|

*kapisthaleti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*yasmin sthitaḥ khayaṃ devo vṛddhakedārasaṃjñitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca rudraṃ diṇḍisamanvitam \|*  
*antardhānamavāpnoti śivaloke sa modate \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Kapisthala is a famous holy place there. It decays all evils of devotees. God Vrddha Kedara himself resides there. A bath and worship of god Rudra along with Dindi, gives a power of intuition and he enjoys the pleasure of living in the abode of Siva.

## \|\| 36.16 \|\|

*yastatra tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pibate culakatrayam \|*  
*diṇḍidevaṃ namaskṛtya kedārasya phalaṃ labhet \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The man doing tarpana sipping three palmful water and saluting god Dindi gets fruit of a visit at the holy place of Kedara.

## \|\| 36.17 \|\|

*yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ śivamuddiśya mānavaḥ \|*  
*caitrasuklacaturdaśyāṃ prāpnoti paramaṃpadam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A Sraddha on the fourteenth day of a bright fortnight in the month of Caitra (March) for the pleasure of Mahadeva, provides with the supreme position to the man who acts accordingly.

## \|\| 36.18 \|\|

*kalasyāṃ tu tato gacched yatra devī svayaṃ sthitā \|*  
*durgā kātyāyanī bhadrā nidrā māyā sanātanī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. One should then visit the holy place Kalasi where goddess Bhadra, Nidra, Maya, Sanatani, Katyayani and goddess Durga herself abide.

## \|\| 36.19 \|\|

*kalasyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā durgā taṭe sthitām \|*  
*saṃsāragahanaṃ durgaṃnistarennātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A bath in Kalasi, a sight at goddess Durga on the bank of river enables a man to cross successfully the toughest worldly fort.

## \|\| 36.20-21 \|\|

*tato gaccheta sarakaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

*labhate sarvakāmāṃśca śivalokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*tisrāḥ koṭyastu tīrthānāṃ sarake dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Saraka-tirtha is then worth seeing as it is a rare holy place in the three-worlds. A sight of god Mahesvara on the fourteenth day of dark fortnight enables a man to get success in his mission and after death to deserve a place in the abode of Siva. О great Dvija! Saraka holds three crore holy places in its lap.

## \|\| 36.22-24 \|\|

*rudrakoṭistathā kūpe saromadhye vyavasthitā \|*  
*tasmin sare ca yaḥ snātvā rudrakoṭiṃ smarennaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pūjitā rudrakoṭiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*rudrāṇāṃ ca prasādena sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*aindrajñānena saṃyuktaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*iḍāspadaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ pāpabhayāpaham \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Rudrakoti is located in the well just at the centre of the reservoir. A bath in that reservoir and Rudrakoti in mind automatically amounts to the worship of one crore Rudra. By the grace of Rudras, that man is protected from the defects/evils, rendered with highest conscience and thus, achieves the supreme position. At the same place, there exists a holy place Idaspada. It absolves evils and removes fear from the mind of devotees.

## \|\| 36.25-27 \|\|

*asmin muktimavāpnoti darśanādeva mānavaḥ \|*  
*tatra snātvār'thayitvā ca pitṛdevagaṇānapi \|\| 25 \|\|*

*na durgatimavāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ labhet \|*  
*kedāraṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā tu puruṣaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*kiṃrūpaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ tatraiva bhuvi durlabham \|\| 27 \|\|*
