25-27. A mere watching of this holy place ensures emancipation. A bath and worship of Pifrs and gods here endows one with prosperity and the man receives the desired things. The great holy place Kedara should then be visited. A bath in that place gives fruit of all donations. Kimrupa-tirtha is also there on the ground. A bath here gives a devotee the fruit equal to executing all yajnas.

## \|\| 36.28 \|\|

*sarakasya tu pūrveṇa tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*anyajanma suvikhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A holy place Anyajanma falls on the east from Saraka. It is popular throughout the three worlds.

## \|\| 36.29 \|\|

*nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hatvā dānavamūrjitam \|*  
*tiryagyonau sthito viṣṇuḥ siṃheṣu ratimāpnuvan \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Attaining the form of a lion and slaying the powerful demon, lord Visnu then dwelling among tlte animals developed affection for lions.

## \|\| 36.30 \|\|

*tato devāḥ sagandharvā ārāghya varadaṃ śivam \|*  
*ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṅgā viṣṇudehasya lambhane \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. All gods including Gandharvas the worshipped lord Siva, saluted him and prayed to him to manage the situation. They explained that the return of Nrsimha back in the original form of Visnu has become necessary.

## \|\| 36.31-33 \|\|

*tato devo mahātmāsau śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*yuddhaṃ ca kārayāmāsa divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam \|*  
*yudhyamānau tu tau devau patitau saramadhyataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tasmin sarastaṭe vipro devarṣirnāradaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*aśvatthavṛkṣamāśritya dhyānasthastau dadarśa ha \|\| 32 \|\|*

*viṣṇuścaturbhujo jajñe liṅgākāraḥ śivaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tau dṛṣṭvā tatra puruṣau tuṣṭāva bhaktibhāvitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Mahadeva disguised himself as Sarabha (camel) and fought against Nrsimha for several thousand divine years. Both gods fell into a reservoir while fighting. Divine hermit Narada was in meditation on the bank of that reservoir under a pipala tree. He was suddenly disturbed and looked at them. Lord Visny turned in his original form and Siva in the form of a linga. Narada duly worshipped them.

## \|\| 36.35 \|\|

*namaḥ śivāya devāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave \|*  
*haraye ca umābhartre sthitikālabhṛte namaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Salute to god Siva, salute to impressive Visnu. Salute to administrator god Visnu and the god of destruction Siva.

## \|\| 36.36 \|\|

*harāya vahurūpāya viśvarūpāya viṣṇave \|*  
*tryambakāya susuddhāya kuṣṇāya jñānahetave \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Salute to Hara of varied forms and Visnu of universal form. Salute to great merciful Tryambaka and Krsna, the cause of knowledge.

## \|\| 36.37-38 \|\|

*dhanyo 'haṃ sukṛtī nityaṃ yad dṛṣṭo puruṣottamau \|*  
*mamāśramamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yuvābhyāṃ vimalīkṛtam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*adyaprabhṛti trailokye anyajanmeti viśrutam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. I am lucky and noble as I could see simultaneously both Purusas. My asrama so purified by you has indeed become sacrosanct. This place shall gain popularity as Anyajanma throughout the three worlds.

## \|\| 36.39 \|\|

*ya ihāgatya snātvā ca pitṝn saṃtarpayiṣyati \|*  
*tasya śraddhānvitasyeha jñānamaindraṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The man doing tarpana of his Pitrs after a bath shall receive the power of intuition.

## \|\| 36.40 \|\|

*aśvatthasya tu yanmūlaṃ sadā tatra vasāmyaham \|*  
*aśvatthavandanaṃ kṛtvā yamaṃ raudraṃ na paśyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. I will always reside at the root of pipala tree. The man worshipping this pipala, shall not see Yama in his fierce form.

## \|\| 36.41 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā nāgasya hradamuttamam \|*  
*pauṇḍarīke naraḥ snātvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O great Brahmins! One should then go to the Nagahrda. A bath in Paundarlka ensures the fruit of Pundarika (particular yajna) for the devotee.

## \|\| 36.42 \|\|

*daśamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya caitrasya tu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ japaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ muktimārgapradāyakam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. A bath, japa and sraddha ensures emancipation provided that it is done on tenth day of the bright fortnight in Caitra (March) month.

## \|\| 36.43 \|\|

*tatastriviṣṭavaṃ gacchet tīrthaṃ devanaṣevitam \|*  
*tatra vaitaraṇī puṇyā nadī pāpapramocanī \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Trivis(apa is the next holy place to visit. The gods reside here and a river Vaitarani flows there. It effaces the evils earlier committed.

## \|\| 36.44 \|\|

*tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca śūlapāṇiṃ vṛṣadhvajam \|*  
*sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā gacchatyeva parāṃ gatim \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. A bath and worship of Sulapani Vrsdhvaja effaces the sins of a devotee and he thereby attains supreme position.

## \|\| 36.45 \|\|

*tato gaccheta viprendrā rasāvartamanuttamam \|*  
*tatra snātvā bhaktiyuktaḥ siddhimāpnotyanuttamām \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О great Brahmins! One should then go to the holy place Rasavarta. A bath with devotion renders the best achievement to the devotee here.

## \|\| 36.46 \|\|

*caitra śuklacaturdaśyāṃ tīrthe snātvā hyalepake \|*  
*pūjayitvā śivaṃ tatra pāpalepo na vidyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The evils even cannot touch a man when he takes a bath in the holy place Alepaka on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra (March) and then offer homage to lord Siva.

## \|\| 36.47 \|\|

*tato gacchena viprandrāḥ phalakīvanamuttamam \|*  
*yatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sādhyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ \|*  
*tapaścaranti vipulaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O great Brahmins! One should then visit the holy place Phalakivana. Here reside the gods, gandharvas, sadhyas and hermits. They do penance strictly for one thousand divine years.

## \|\| 36.48 \|\|

*dṛṣadvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā tarpayitvā ca devatāḥ \|*  
*agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindati māvanaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The man receives the fruit of offering like Agnistoma and Atriratra by taking a bath in the river Drsadvati and do tarpana of gods.

## \|\| 36.49 \|\|

*somakṣaye ca saṃprāpte somasya ca dine tathā \|*  
*yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute martyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Listen to the fruit of sraddha on the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight (amavasya) with Monday here.

## \|\| 36.50 \|\|

*gayāyāṃ ca yatā śrāddha pitṛn prīṇāti nityaśaḥ \|*  
*tathā śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ phalakīvanamāśritaiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. As sraddha made on Gaya satiates the Pitrs daily, the persons living in Phalkivana should perform sraddha in the same manner.

## \|\| 36.51 \|\|

*manasā smarate yastu phalakīvanamuttamam \|*  
*tasyāpi pitarastṛptiṃ prayāsyanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The man who ever brings to memory the Phalakivana, his Pitrs too are satiated definitely.

## \|\| 36.52 \|\|

*tatrāpi tīrthaṃ sumahat sarvadevairalaṅkṛtam \|*  
*tasmin snātastu puruṣo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. A holy place sumahat is located there. It is surrounded by gods and the man taking a bath here receives the fruit of the donation of one thousand cows.

## \|\| 36.53 \|\|

*pāṇikhāte naraḥ snātvā pitṛn saṃtarpya mānavaḥ \|*  
*avāpnuyād rājasūyaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca vindati \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The man receives the fruit of Rajsuya yajna, Samkhya (knowledge) and Yoga (karma) when he takes a bath in Panikhata- tirtha and do tarpana for Pitrs.

## \|\| 36.54-55 \|\|

*tato gaccheta sumahat tīrthaṃ miśrakamuttamam \|*  
*tatra tīrthāni muninā miśritāni mahātmanā \|\| 54 \|\|*

*vyāsena muniśārdulā dadhīcyarthaṃ mahātmanā \|*  
*sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāti miśrake snāti yo naraḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Another holy place Misraka is then worth visiting. О great hermits! The great soul Vyasa had mixed the water of all holy places here for Dadhici. The man taking a bath in Misraka-tirtha thus, is considered as if he has bathed in all holy places.

## \|\| 36.56-58 \|\|

*tato vyāsavanaṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ \|*  
*manojave naraḥ snātvā miśrake snāti yo naraḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*manasā cintitaṃ sarvaṃ sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*gatvā madhuvaṭīṃ caiva devyāstīrthaṃ naraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tatra snātvār'cayed devān pitṝṃśca prayato naraḥ \|*  
*sa devyā samanujñāto yathā siddhiṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. One should then impose control over one's senses and observe punctuality in diet. Vyasavana is then the next visiting place. A bath in "Manojava" and the sight of lord Siva undoubtedly renders the man with desired success. A bath and worship of gods and Pitrs in Madhuvati, a holy place pertaining to goddess, endows supreme axiom/achievement by the grace of goddess.

## \|\| 36.59 \|\|

*kauśikyāḥ saṃgame yastu dṛṣadvatyāṃ narottamaḥ \|*  
*snāyīta nayatāhāraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. A bath at the confluence of Kausiki and Drsadvati rivers effaces all the sins attached with a man.

## \|\| 36.60-61 \|\|

*tato vyāsasthalī nāma yatra vyāsena dhīmatā \|*  
*putraśokābhibhūtena dehatyāgāya niścayaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kṛto devaiśca viprendrāḥ punarutthāpitastadā \|*  
*abhigamya sthalīṃ tasya putraśokaṃ na vindati \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. O great Brahmins! There comes then Vyasathali where the learned Vedavyasa had decided to take his last breath in agony of his son's death. However, the gods had again inspired and consoled him. A man seldom suffers from the agony of his son's death whosoever visits there.

## \|\| 36.62 \|\|

*gindattaṃ kūpamāsādya tilaprasthaṃ pradāya ca \|*  
*gaccheta paramāṃ siddhiṃ ṛṇairmuktimavāpnuyāt \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. A visit at Kimdatta Kupa and donation of sesamum a prastha (a certain measurement of quantum) ensures supreme achievement and liberty from the burden of debts to a man.

## \|\| 36.63 \|\|

*yahnaṃ ca sudinaṃ caiva dve tīrthe bhuvi durlabhe \|*  
*tayoḥ snātvā viśuddhātmā sūryalokamapāpnuyāt \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The two holy places- Ahna and Sudina are among the rare places on the earth. A bath in them ensures achieving the abode of sun for a man.

## \|\| 36.64-67 \|\|

*kṛtajapyaṃ tato gacchet triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam \|*  
*tatrābhiṣekaṃ kuvīnta gaṅgāyāṃ prayataḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*arcayitvā mahādevamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatraiva dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ prabhum \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tatra svnātvā śraddadhānaḥ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*tato vāmanakaṃ gacchet triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*yatra vāmanarūpeṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*balerapahṛtaṃ rājyamindrāya pratipāditam \|\| 67 \|\|*

64-67. One should then go at Krtajapya, a holy place renowned throughout the three worlds. Regular dwelling and bath in the Gangs as also worship of Mahadeva endows one with the fruit of Asvamedha (horse sacrifice). Koti- tirtha is also there where a bath and homage to Kotisvara gives a man the fruit of a crore yajnas. Then there is Vamanaka, another holy place known to the three-worlds. It is the same place where Vamana (dwarf) form Visnu had trickily confiscated the empire from Bali and headed it over to Indra.

## \|\| 36.68 \|\|

*tatra viṣṇupadesnātvā arcayitvā ca vāmanam \|*  
*sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The man attains the abode of Visnu when duly purified by a bath in Visnupada, a holy place and worship of god Vamana.

## \|\| 36.69 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhāśramaṃ ca tatraiva sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā naro muktiṃ saṃprayāti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Jyestasrama is also located there. A mere sight of this place enables a man to get emancipation.

## \|\| 36.70 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā jyeṣṭhatvaṃ labhate nṛpu \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. A man gets better living than common men if he observes fast on the eleventh day of bright fortnight in the month of Jyestha (June) month and takes bath on Dvadasi (the twelvth day).

## \|\| 36.71 \|\|

*tatra pratiṣṭhitā viprā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*dīkṣāpratiṣṭhāsaṃyuktā viṣṇuprīṇanatatparāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The magnificence lord Visnu had blessed with supreme position to the Brahmins who were qualified in procedure of yajna etc. and who had worshipped him with due honour.

## \|\| 36.72 \|\|

*tebhyo dattāni śrāddhāni dānāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*akṣayāṇi bhaviṣyanti yāvanmanvantarasthitiḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The donations given to Brahmins fructify undepleting and gain stability up to one Manvantara (viz. the period in which four eras cycled seventy one time).

## \|\| 36.73 \|\|

*tatraiva koṭitīrthaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam \|*  
*tasmistīrthe naraḥ snātvā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. There also exists Koti-tirtha, a renowned holy place throughout the three worlds.

## \|\| 36.74 \|\|

*koṭīśvaraṃ naro dṛṣṭvā tasmitīrthe maheśvaram \|*  
*mahādevaprasādena gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The person receives Ganapatya by the grace of Mahadeva when he pay homage to Kotisvara Mahesvara in that holy place.

## \|\| 36.75 \|\|

*tatraiva sumahat tīrthaṃ sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tasmin snātvā bhaktibhuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The great holy place of great soul Suryadeva is there. The man is adored in the abode of sun by taking a bath with sheer devotion there.

## \|\| 36.76 \|\|

*tato gaccheta vipraindrāstīrthaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam \|*  
*kulottāraṇanāmānaṃ viṣṇunā kalpitaṃ purā \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. О great Brahmins! One should then go to Kulottarana-tirtha. It sways all sins attached to a man. It had been installed by god Visnu for the purification of the people abiding by their religion as prescribed by the Vamasrama long ago.

## \|\| 36.77 \|\|

*varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca tāraṇāya sunirmalam \|*  
*brahmacaryātparaṃ mokṣaṃ ya icchinti sunirmalam \|*  
*te 'pi tattīrthamāsādya paśyanti paramaṃ padam \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The people willing emancipation through celibacy also see supreme position by a visit there.

## \|\| 36.78 \|\|

*brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā \|*  
*kulāni tārayet snātaḥ sapta sapta ca sapta ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The celibate, householder (Grhastha), Vanaprasthi and recluse do welfare for as many as twenty one generations preceding by taking a bath there.

## \|\| 36.79 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ sūdrā ye tatparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*snātā bhaktiyutāḥ sarve paśyanti paramaṃ padam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. The Brahmins, Ksatriya, Vaisya or Sudra taking a bath in that holy place receive supreme positions.

## \|\| 36.80 \|\|

*dūrastho 'pi smared yastu kurukṣetraṃ savāmanam \|*  
*so 'pi muktimavāpnoti kiṃ punarnnivasannaraḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The man at far distant place can also attain emancipation by only bringing the scene of Kuruksetra into his mind. What to say about the man who is permanently living there?

## Chapter 37. Account of the tirthas of Kuruksetra

## \|\| 37.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*pavanasya hrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ śaivaṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- A bath in the reservoir called Pavana mid a vision of Mahesvara effaces all sins of a man and he obtains the position of welfare (Siva).

## \|\| 37.2 \|\|

*putraśokena pavano yasmillīno babhūva ha \|*  
*tataḥ sabrahmakairdevaiḥ prasādya prakaṭīkṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. God Pavana was merged in this very reservoir on account of gloom for the separation of his son and Brahma etc., gods had then pleased him and made him to appear again during ancient period.

## \|\| 37.3 \|\|

*ato gaccheta amṛtaṃ sthānaṃ tacchūlapāṇinaḥ \|*  
*yatra devaiḥ sagandharvaiḥ hanumān prakaṭīkṛtaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. One would then go to Amrta-sthana of Sulapani where the gods with gandharvas originated Hanuman.

## \|\| 37.4-8 \|\|

*tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā amṛtatvamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*kulottāraṇamāsādya tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kulāni tārayet sarvān mātāmahapitāmahān \|*  
*śālihotrasya rājarṣestīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā vimuktastu kaluṣairdaihasaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*śrīkuñjaṃ tu sarasvatyāṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*tato naimiṣakuñjaṃ tu samāsādya naraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*naimiṣasya ca snānena yat puṇyaṃ tat samāpnuyāt \|*  
*tatra tīrthaṃ mahākhyātaṃ vedavatyā niṣevitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

4-8. A bath in that holy place makes a man immortal. The Brahmin conscious of his clan visit at Kulottarana and satiates with emancipation all generations preceding of his paternal and maternal grandfather. A bath in Salihotra holy place sways all the physical evils deliberately or innocently committed by a man. Srikunja is a holy place known to the three worlds in Sarasvati. A bath in that holy place endows a man with the fruit of Agnistoma yajna. Then there comes Naimisa- kunja. A bath in this place gives the fruit of a bath in the holy place of Naimisaranya. A renowned holy place on the bank of Vedavati has existed there.

## \|\| 37.9 \|\|

*rāvaṇena gṛhītāyāḥ keśeṣu dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*tadvadhāya ca sā prāṇān mumuce śokakarśitā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. О great Brahmins! During ancient period, once Ravana caught her by the hair and in a fit of gloom she wished him killed shortly and took her last breath at this very place.

## \|\| 37.10 \|\|

*tato jātā gṛhe rājño najakasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*sītā nāmeti vikhyātā rāmapatnī pativratā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. She was then bom as daughter of Janaka and became a chaste wife of lord Rama. She is still remembered with other chaste ladies.

## \|\| 37.11-14 \|\|

*sā hṛtā rāvaṇeneha vināśāyātmanaḥ svayam \|*  
*rāmeṇa rāvaṇaṃ hatvā abhiṣicya vibhiṣaṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*samānītā gṛhaṃ sītā kīrtirātmavatā yathā \|*  
*tasyāstīrthe naraḥ snātvā kanyāyajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|*  
*tato gaccheta sumahad brahmaṇaḥ sthānamuttamama \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yatra varṇāvaraḥ snātvā brāhmaṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaśca viśuddhatmā paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. Ravana had abducted her for his self- destruction. As the great resolute (Jitacitta) gets fame, Rama killed Ravana, enthroned Vibhisana and came back to the throne of Ayodhya. A man gets the fruit as Kanyadana by taking a bath in this holy place. All his evils are effaced and one attains supreme position. One should then visit the best and great place of Brahma. A bath here makes even a man of inferior varna get elements of a Brahmin and thus attains the supreme place.

## \|\| 37.15 \|\|

*tato gaccheta somasya tīrthaṃ trailokyadurlabham \|*  
*yatra somastapastaptvā dvijarājyamavāpnuyāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Then there comes Soma-tirtha where the moon had obtained the elements of a great Dvija as he had observed strict penance here.

## \|\| 37.16 \|\|

*tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca svapitṝn daivatāni ca \|*  
*nirmalaḥ svargamāyāti kārtikyāṃ candramā yathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By bath and worship of Pitrs and gods, a man is purified as the moon light of full-moon in the month of Kartika (October).

## \|\| 37.17-18 \|\|

*saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham \|*  
*yatra sapta sarasvatya ekībhūtā vahanti ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*suprabhā kāñcanākṣī ca viśālā mānasahradā \|*  
*sarasvatyoghanāmā ca suveṇurvimalodakā \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. A holy place, Saptasarasvata is a rare place in the three-worlds. The seven branches of Sarasvati river known as Suprabha, Каncanaksi, Visala, Manasahrda, Sarasvati, Oghanama, Vimalodaka and Suvenu conglomerate into one and then a single river flows.

## \|\| 37.19-20 \|\|

*pitāmahasya yajataḥ puṣkareṣu sthitasya ha \|*  
*abruvan ṛṣayaḥ sarve nāyaṃ yajño mahāphalaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*na dṛśyate saricchreṣṭhā yasmādiha sarasvatī \|*  
*tachrutvā bhagavān prītaḥ sasmārātha sarasvatīm \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. When all hermits prepared for doing yajna for lord Brahma in the holy place of Puskara, they said - "This yajna shall not fructify with grand success because the holier river Sarasvati is not being seen here." Brahma summoned Sarasvati through meditation when he heard this averment from the hermits appointed for executing yajna.

## \|\| 37.21 \|\|

*pitāmahena yajatā āhūtā puṣkareṣu vai \|*  
*suprabhā nāma sā devī tatra khyātā sarasvatī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The Sarasvati so summoned by lord Brahma when seated for yajna in Puskara appeared and called Suprabha.

## \|\| 37.22 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ prītā vegayuktāṃ sarasvatīm \|*  
*pitāmahaṃ mānayantīṃ te tu tāṃ bahu menire \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Having seen Sarasvati flowing swiftly for keeping up the honour of Brahma, the hermits honoured it very much.

## \|\| 37.23 \|\|

*evameṣā saricchreṣṭhā puṣkarasthā sarasvatī \|*  
*samānītā surukṣetre maṅkaṇena mahātmanā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The great soul Mankana brought this holiest and long-existing Sarasvati and appeared in Puskara at Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 37.24 \|\|

*naimiṣe munayaḥ sthitvā śaunakādyāstapodhanāḥ \|*  
*te pṛcchanti mahātmānaṃ paurāṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Saunanka etc. sages gathered in Naimisaranya asked the most aged (due to longevity) Lomaharsana.

## \|\| 37.25 \|\|

*kathaṃ yajñaphalo 'smākaṃ vartatāṃ satpathe bhavet \|*  
*tato 'brevīnmahābhāgāḥ praṇamya śirasā ṛtīn \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. "How shall the fruit for yajna come to all of us who always walk through the path of welfare?” That learned hermit bowed his head in honour and continued further.

## \|\| 37.26-30 \|\|

*sarasvatī sthitā yatra tatra yajñaphalaṃ mahat \|*  
*etacchrutvā tu manuyo nānāsvādhyāyavedinaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*samāgamya tataḥ sarve sasmaruste sarasvatīm \|*  
*sā tu dhyātā tatastatra ṛṣibhiḥ satrayājibhiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*samāgatā plāvanārthaṃ yajñe teṣāṃ mahātmanām \|*  
*naimiṣe kāñcanākṣī tu smṛtā maṅkaṇakena sā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*samāgatā kurukṣetraṃ puṇyatoya sarasvatī \|*  
*gayasya yajamānasya gayeṣveva mahākratum \|\| 29 \|\|*

*āhūtā ca saricchreṣṭhā gayayajñe sarasvatī \|*  
*viśālāṃ nāma tāṃ prāhurṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

26-30. The great fruit of yajna has always existed where Sarasvati resides. The sages learned several Vedas and then remembered Sarasvati together. When so summoned by the hermits performing session (yajna of long form) river Sarasvati appeared and known as Kancanaksi to flow through the land of Naimisa to give purity to it. That famous river again entered in the form of Sarasvati when the sage Mayanka summoned her. In the offering (yajna) executed by Gaya at Gaya region, Sarasvati was summoned again and the hermits gave it the name of Visala.

## \|\| 37.31 \|\|

*sarit sā hi samāhūtā maṅkaṇena mahātmanā \|*  
*kurukṣetraṃ samāyātā praviṣṭā ca mahānadī \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. That river summoned by the great soul Mankana entered in Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 37.32 \|\|

*uttare kośalābhāge puṇye devarṣisevite \|*  
*uddālakena muninā tatra dhyātā sarasvatī \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The hermit Uddalaka summoned Sarasvati to north Kausala province which was surrounded by the divine hermits.

## \|\| 37.33 \|\|

*ājagāma saricchreṣṭhā taṃ deśaṃ munikāraṇāt \|*  
*pūjyamānā munigaṇairvalkalājinasaṃvṛtaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thus, Sarasvati, the holiest river entered into that province for that sage and worshipped by the sages, wearing tree bark and stag hide for clothes. She got popularity as Manohara and she is capable to efface all sins.

## \|\| 37.34 \|\|

*manohareti vikhyātā sarvapāpakṣayāvahā \|*  
*āhūtā sā kurukṣetre maṅkaṇena mahātmanā \|*  
*ṛṣeḥ saṃmānanārthāya praviṣṭā tīrthamuttamam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. She appeared to give honour to the call of the great soul Mankana in the holiest place of Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 37.35 \|\|

*suveṇuriti vikhyātā kedāre yā sarasvatī \|*  
*sarvapāpākṣayā jñeyā ṛṣisiddhiniṣevitā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Sarasvati river famous as Suvenu is worshipped by the hermits and siddhas. She is called a river effacing all sins.

## \|\| 37.36 \|\|

*sāpi teneha muninā ārādhya parameśvaram \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāmupakārārthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ praveśitā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. She too appeared in Kuruksetra for the good of hermits by virtue of the worship made by that sage.

## \|\| 37.37 \|\|

*dakṣeṇa yajatā sāpi gaṅgādvāre sarasvatī \|*  
*vimalodā bhagavatī dakṣeṇa prakaṭīkṛtā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Daksa while performing yajna in Gangadvara originated goddess Sarasvati.

## \|\| 37.38 \|\|

*samāhūtā yayau tatra maṅkaṇena mahātmanā \|*  
*kurukṣetre tu kuruṇā yajitā ca sarasvatī \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. When Sarasvati worshipped by Kuru at Kuruksetra flew there when she was duly summoned there.

## \|\| 37.39-40 \|\|

*saromadhye samānītā mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā \|*  
*abhiṣṭūya mahābhāgāṃ puṇyatoyāṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yatra maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ saptasārasvate sthitaḥ \|*  
*nṛtyamānaśca devena śaṅkareṇa nivāritaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Learned Markandeya brought Sarasvati in the middle of reservoir through his worship in depth. Lord Sankara had at the same place prevented Mankanaka who was dancing in the holy place of Saptasarasvata.

## Chapter 38. Praise of Siva by Маnkаnаkа

## \|\| 38.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ kasmājjāto mahānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*nṛtyamānastu devena kimarthaṃ sa nivāritaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits said- How did Mankanaka attain special achievement? Who was the father of that great hermit? Why did Mahadeva restrain from him doing dance?

## \|\| 38.2 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*kaśyapasya suto jajñe mānaso maṅkaṇomuniḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ kartuṃ vyavasito gṛhītvā valkalaṃ dvijaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Lomaharsana said- The hermit Mankanaka was the son of Kasyapa bom when he summoned him through intuition. One day he went to take a bath with a tree bark (Balkala) in his hand.

## \|\| 38.3 \|\|

*tatra gatā hyapsaraso rambhādyāḥ priyadarśanāḥ \|*  
*snāyanti rucirāḥ snigdhāstena sārdhamaninditāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The beautiful nymphs like Rambha etc. also were there and all those most beautiful nymphs began to take a bath with them.

## \|\| 38.4 \|\|

*tato munestadā kṣobhādretaḥ skannaṃ yadambhasi \|*  
*tadretaḥ sa tu jagrāha kalaśe vai mahātapāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The semen of that sage ejaculated in the river there but it was picked up by that great ascetic in a pitcher.

## \|\| 38.5-8 \|\|

*saptadhā pravibhāgaṃ tu kalaśasthaṃ jagāma ha \|*  
*tatrarṣayaḥ spata jātā viduryān marutāṃ gaṇān \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vāyuvego vāyubalo vāyuhā vāyumaṇḍalaḥ \|*  
*vāyujvalo vāyureto vāyucakraśca vīryavān \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ete hyapatyāstasyarṣerdhārayanti carācaram \|*  
*purā maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ kuśāgreṇeti me śrutam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṣataḥ kila kare viprāstasya śākaraso 'sravat \|*  
*sa vai śākarasaṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣāviṣṭaḥ pranuttavān \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. The semen so collected in the pitcher was divided into seven parts. Seven hermits were bom from it and were called Marutas. Their names are- Vayuvega, Vayubala, Vayuha, Vaymandala, Vayujvala, Vayureta and mighty Vayucakra. These seven sons of that hermit holds the movable and immovable world. О Brahmins! I heard that the kusa point had injured the hand of Mankanaka. Sakarasa began oozing from his hand as a result of such an injury. When he saw that oozing fluid, he became happy and began dancing in merriment.

## \|\| 38.9-10 \|\|

*tataḥ sarvaṃ pranṛttaṃ ca sathāvaraṃ jaṅmaṃ ca yat \|*  
*pranuttaṃ ca jagad dṛṣṭvā tejasā tasya mohitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*brahmādibhiḥ suraistatra ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ \|*  
*vijñapto vai mahādevo munerarthe dvijottamāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. This dance had influenced the entire movable and immovable world. When Brahma etc. gods and austere hermits saw the entire world dancing, they requested Mahadeva.

## \|\| 38.11-12 \|\|

*nāya nṛtyed yathā deva tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*tato devo muniṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣāviṣṭamatīva hi \|\| 11 \|\|*

*suraṇāṃ hitakāmārthaṃ mahādevo 'bhyabhāṣata \|*  
*harṣasthānaṃ kimarthaṃ ca tavedaṃ munisattama \|*  
*tapasvino dharmapathe sthitasya dvijasattama \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. О god! Do such a thing that can impose restrictions on his dancing. When god Mahadeva saw the hermits in happy moods, he said for their good- О great sages! О great Dvija! What is the reason for your great merriment? You all are austere and religion abiding.

## \|\| 38.13 \|\|

*kiṃ na paśyasi me brahman karācchākarasaṃ srutam \|*  
*yaṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pranutto vai harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The hermit said- О Brahmana! Are you not seeing that Sakarasa is oozing from my hand which the kusa straw injured? As this is a phenomenon to me, I am very happy and in a vagary of mirth I am dancing.

## \|\| 38.14 \|\|

*taṃ prahasyābravīd devo muniṃ rāgema mohitam \|*  
*ahaṃ na vismayaṃ vipra gacchāmīha prapaśyatām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. God Mahadeva laughed and replied to the said sage so enchanted- О Brahmin! Look here I am not feeling any surprise to see this.

## \|\| 38.15 \|\|

*evamuktvā muniśreṣṭhaṃ devadevo mahādyutiḥ \|*  
*aṅgulyagreṇa viprendrāḥ svāṅguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayad bhavaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O Brahmins! With these words god Mahadeva hit on his thumb by the tip of his finger.

## \|\| 38.16 \|\|

*tato bhasma kṣatāt tasmānnirgataṃ himasannibham \|*  
*tad dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitovipraḥ pādayoḥ patito 'bravīt \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Then ashes as white as ice (i.e. clean) began to come out from the injured part. The Brahmana were ashamed to see it and fell on the feet of god Mahadeva. He said-

## \|\| 38.17 \|\|

*nānyaṃ devādahaṃ manye śūlapāṇermahātmanaḥ \|*  
*carācarasya jagato varastvamasi śūladhṛk \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. I do not consider you different from Sulapani Mahadeva. О Sulapani, you are the best among this movable and immovable world.

## \|\| 38.18 \|\|

*tvadāśrayāśca dṛśyante surā brahmādayo 'nagha \|*  
*pūrvastvamasi devānāṃ kartā kārayitā mahat \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О innocent by deeds! Brahma etc. gods are seen as your shelter. You are the first among all gods, you are the creator, nourisher and of supreme form (Mahasvarupa).

## \|\| 38.19 \|\|

*tvatprasādāt surāḥ sarve modante hyakulobhayāḥ \|*  
*evaṃ stutvā mahādevamṛṣiḥ sa praṇato 'bravīt \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. All gods enjoy the pleasure fearlessly under your grace. After the prayer so made, the hermit bowed his head and said-

## \|\| 38.20 \|\|

*bhagavaṃstvaprasādāddhi tapo me na kṣayaṃ vrajet \|*  
*tato devaḥ prasānnātmā tamṛṣiṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О god! Nay my penance not depreciate or subside in any way. Mahadeva then was pleased and said to that hermit.

## \|\| 38.21 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca*  
*tapaste varddhatāṃ vipra matprasādāt sahasradhā \|*  
*āśrame ceha vatsyāmi tvayā sārddhamahaṃ sadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The god said- О Brahmin! may your penance increase several thousand ways. I will always reside in this asrama with you.

## \|\| 38.22-23 \|\|

*saptasārasvate snātvā yo mamarciṣyate naraḥ \|*  
*na tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sārasvataṃ ca taṃ lokaṃ gamiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*śivasya ca prasādena pāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The man who will worship me by taking a bath in this Saptasarasvata, nothing shall be rare to him in this world and in the world of metaphysics. He shall definitely attain the Sarasvataloka and occupy a supreme position under my grace (Siva).

## Chapter 39. Praise of Ausanasa Tirtha

## \|\| 39.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*tatastvauśanasaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchettu śraddhāyānvitāḥ \|*  
*uśanā yatra saṃsiddho grahatvaṃ ca samāptavān \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- One should then visit Ausanasa, a holy place. The Usana (Venus) had got magnificence having good catch on accomplishments.

## \|\| 39.2 \|\|

*tasmin snātvā vimuktastu pātakairjanmasaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*tato yāti paraṃ brahma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The man approaches the supreme Brahma free from the cycle of birth and death and an accumulation of his earlier evils,

## \|\| 39.3 \|\|

*rahodaro nāma muniryatra mukto babhūva ha \|*  
*mahatā śirasā grastastīrthamāhātmyadarśanāt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. It was the grace of seeing this holy place that freed Rahodara, a sage anxious due to the heavy head stuck with him.

## \|\| 39.4 \|\|

*kathaṃ rahodaro grastaḥ kathaṃ mokṣamavāptavān \|*  
*tīrthasya tasya māhātmyamicchāmaḥ śrotumādarāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The hermits said- How was Rahodara, the hermit stuck with a head and how was he freed? We want to listen to you about this magnificence of holy place in detail.

## \|\| 39.5 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*purā vai daṇḍakāraṇye rāghaveṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*vasatā dvijaśārdūlā rākṣasāstatra hiṃsitāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Lomaharsana said- О great Brahmins! Mahatma Raghava had slaughtered the monsters while living in Dandakavana.

## \|\| 39.6 \|\|

*tatraikasya śiraśchinnaṃ rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ \|*  
*kṣureṇa śitadhāreṇa tat papāta mahāvane \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A head of a monster fell in that great forest as somewhere a sharp edged weapon had slit the same. It was the momentum of blow that his head was thrown at such a long distance.

## \|\| 39.7 \|\|

*rahodarasya tallagnaṃ jaṅghāyāṃ vai yadṛcchayā \|*  
*vane vicāratastatra asthi bhittvā viveśa ha \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Eventually it finally fell on the thigh of Rahodara, the sage who was strolling at that time. So high presence it had that it got fixed there by fracturing the bone.

## \|\| 39.8 \|\|

*sa tena lagnena tadā dvijātirna śaśāka ha \|*  
*abhigantuṃ mahāprājñastīrthānyāyatanāni ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. On account of fixing that head on his thigh, the hermit was unable to visit holy places and temples.

## \|\| 39.9 \|\|

*sa pūtinā visravatā vedanārte mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*jagāma sarvatīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāni ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Fainting with intolerable pain, he visited anyhow all holy places on the earth. Due to the deep wound a foul smell began to spread and pus started secreting.

## \|\| 39.10 \|\|

*tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām \|*  
*te 'bruvan ṛṣayo vipraṃ prayāhyaiśanasaṃ pratiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. One day he told about the event thoroughly to the hermits, they advised- "Go to the holy place of Ausanasa."

## \|\| 39.11-13 \|\|

*teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāma sa rahodaraḥ \|*  
*tatastvaiśanase tīrthe tasyopaspṛśatastadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tacchiraścaraṇaṃ muktvā papātāntarjale dvijāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sa virajo bhūtvā pūtātmā vītakalmaṣaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ājagāmāśramaṃ prītaḥ kathayāmāsa cākhilam \|*  
*te śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarve tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*kapālamocanamiti nāma cakruḥ samāgatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. О Dvijas! Rahodara went to Ausanasa. A mere touch of the water proved so magnificent as the head so stuck, fell down into that water. The pain due to the injury vanished within seconds and the hermit returned to his hermitage happily. He again reported how the cure was effected at Ausanasa. The hermits present there unanimously named it Kapalamocana, when they heard of such a surprising event.

## \|\| 39.14 \|\|

*tatrāpi sumahattīrtha viśvāmitrasya viśrutam \|*  
*brāhmaṇyaṃ labdhavān yatra viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A holy place of Visvamitra is also there. Here, Visvamitra had got the essence of Brahmana.

## \|\| 39.15 \|\|

*tasmistīrthavare snātvā brāhmaṇyaṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*brāhmaṇastu viśuddhātmā paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Whosoever takes a bath in that holy place, definitely attains the essence of Brahmana and so a pure hearted Brahmana attains the supreme position.

## \|\| 39.16 \|\|

*tataḥ pūthūdakaṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ \|*  
*tatra siddhastu brahmarṣi ruṣaṅgurnāma nāmataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. One should regulate his routine and put a check on his senses and then visit the holy place Prthudaka. A Brahmarsi Rusangu had got accomplishments (siddhis) here.

## \|\| 39.17 \|\|

*jātismaro ruṣaṅgustu gaṅgādvāre sadā sthitaḥ \|*  
*antakālaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā putrān vacanamabravīt \|*  
*iha śreyo na pasyāmi nayadhvaṃ māṃ pṛthūdakam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The great soul Rusangu lived throughout his life at Gangadvara (Hardvara) but when he saw the time of last breath coming nearer, he called his sons and said- "Take me to Prthudaka as I do not see any welfare here."

## \|\| 39.18 \|\|

*vijñāya tasya tadbhāvaṃ ruṣaṅgoste tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*taṃ vai tīrthe upāninyuḥ sarasvatyāstapodhanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Giving due honour to the last wish of their father, the austere sons took him to Prthdaka (Sarasvati-tirth).

## \|\| 39.19-20 \|\|

*sa taiḥ putraiḥ samānītaḥ sarasvatyāṃ samāplutaḥ \|*  
*smṛtvā tīrthaguṇān sarvān prāhedamṛṣisattamaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sarasvatyuttare tīrthe yastyajedātmanastanum \|*  
*pṛthūdake japyaparo nūnaṃ cāmaratāṃ vrajet \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. That great soul hermit took a bath in Sarasvati, remembered the magnificence of the holy places and declared - "The man receives the element of god at death who takes his last breath in Prthudaka, holy place.

## \|\| 39.21-23 \|\|

*tatraiva brahmayonyasti brahmaṇā yatra nirmitā \|*  
*pṛthūdakaṃ samāśritya sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*cāturvarṇyasya sṛṣṭyarthamātmajñānaparo 'bhavat \|*  
*tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*mukhato brāhmaṇā jātā bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyāstathā \|*  
*ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyajātīyāḥ padbhyāṃ śūdrāstato 'bhavan \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. The Brahmayoni-tirtha installed by Brahma also falls there. Brahma prepared himself for acquiring Brahmajnana which was utilised by him for the wealth of the four varnas. He seated himself at the bank of Sarasvati in Prthudaka. When he was engrossed in the plan of creation, Brahmana originated from his mouth, Ksatriyas from his arms, Vaisyas from both thighs and Sudra originated from his feet.

## \|\| 39.24 \|\|

*cāturvarṇyaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā āśramasthaṃ tatastataḥ \|*  
*evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmayonīti saṃjñitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He then saw the four varnas settled with several stages (asramas). Brahmayoni, the holy place, was so originated/established.

## \|\| 39.25-26 \|\|

*tatra snātvā muktikāmaḥ punaryoniṃ na paśyati \|*  
*tatraiva tīrthaṃ vikhyātamavakīrṇeti nāmataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*yasmin tīrthe bako dālbhyo dhṛtarāṣṭramamarṣaṇam \|*  
*juhāva vāhanaiḥ sārdhaṃ tatrābudhyat tato nṛpaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. The man desirous of emancipation does not observe his rebirth on the earth. Another holy place is Avakirna here. A hermit Dalbhya (as he was bom in Dalbha gotra) Vaka his name had once set the angry Dhrtarastra with his chariot into ashes here and then the king could understand his knowledge.

## \|\| 39.27 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*kathaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tīrthamavakīrṇena nāmataḥ \|*  
*dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa rājñā ca sa kimarthaṃ prasāditaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The hermit asked- How was Avakirna installed and why had the king Dhrtarastra pleased Dalbhya Vaka?

## \|\| 39.28 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*ṛṣayo naimiṣeyā ye dakṣiṇārthaṃ yayuḥ purā \|*  
*tatraiva ca bako dālbhyo dṛtarāṣṭrā mayācata \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Lomaharsana said- Long long ago, the hermits residing in Naimisaranya visited the place of Dhrtarastra for daksina (alms). One of the hermits Vaka begged for alms (contribution) from Dhrtarastra.

## \|\| 39.29-30 \|\|

*tenāpi tatra nindārthamuktaṃ paśvanṛtaṃ tu yat \|*  
*tataḥ krodhena mahatā māṃsamutkṛtya tatra ha \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pṛthūdake mahātīrthe avakīrṇeti nāmataḥ \|*  
*juhāva dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rāṣṭraṃ narapatestataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The king Dhrtarastra told something tantamount to hiuniliation in a language used by village folk and unfrue. Vaka (born in gotra of Dalbhya) was aggrieved at such a behaviour and he vowed to cut flesh and started doing havana of those organs with the intention to destroy the entire kingdom and the king.

## \|\| 39.31 \|\|

*hūyamāne tadā rāṣṭre pravṛtte yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*akṣiyata tato rāṣṭraṃ nṛpaterduṣkṛtena vai \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The nation began falling in morality, bona- fides etc. virtues in the mind of the subject and determination of ruling thus, started due to yajna in strong to destroy.

## \|\| 39.32-34 \|\|

*tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa brāhmaṇasya viceṣṭitam \|*  
*purohitena saṃyukte ratnānyādāya sarvaśaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*prasādanārthaṃ viprasya hyavakīrṇaṃ yayau tadā \|*  
*prasāditaḥ sa rājñā ca tuṣṭaḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇā nāvamantavyāḥ puruṣeṇa vijānatā \|*  
*avajñāto brāhmaṇastu hanyāt tripuruṣaṃ kulam \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. He then thought over the matter, took it as the act of Brahmana the king Dhrtarastra visited Avakirna holy place in order to please the Brahmin. When the king bowed to the extent the sage had wished, it caused pleasure to the hermit. He said to the king- "A scholar should not disobey the Brahmin because the humiliated Brahmin destroys as many as three generations of the concerned to cause pain to such a level of feelings.

## \|\| 39.35 \|\|

*evamuktvā sa nṛpatiṃ rājyena yaśasā punaḥ \|*  
*utthāpayāmāsa tatastasya rājño hite sthitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. He uplifted the king with the stately affairs as also the fame and became a well-wisher and friendly to him.

## \|\| 39.36 \|\|

*tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snāti śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*sa prāpnoti naro nityaṃ manasā cintitaṃ phalam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The man having control on his senses and reverence in mind everyday receives the desired fruits.

## \|\| 39.37 \|\|

*tatra tīrthaṃ suvikhyātaṃ yāyātaṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|*  
*yasyeha yajamānasya madhu susrāva vai nadī \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. A holy place known as Yayata has existed here. The river had flow with honey for the nutrition of the people seated there in penance.

## \|\| 39.38 \|\|

*madhusravaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*tasmin snātvā naro bhaktyā madhunātarpayet pitṝn \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The man is absolved from all sins by taking a dip in that river and the fruit of Asvamedha can be had from it.

## \|\| 39.39 \|\|

*tatrāpi sumahattīrthaṃ vasiṣṭhodvāhasaṃjñitam \|*  
*tatra snāto bhaktiyukto vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamāpnuyāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О Dvijas! A holy place known as Madhusrava has also existed there. A devotee should do tarpana for his forefathers by offering honey to them.

## \|\| 39.40 \|\|

*tatrāpi sumahattīrthaṃ vasiṣṭhodvāhasaṃjñitam \|*  
*tatra snāto bhaktiyukto vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamāpnuyāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A grand and attractive holy place Vasisthodvaha has also existed there. The man taking a bath in it, receives the loka of Vasistha.

## Chapter 40. Account of the Vasitha-apavaha-tirtha in Kuruksetra

## \|\| 40.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*vasiṣṭhasyāpavāho 'sau kathaṃ vai saṃbabhūva ha \|*  
*kimarthaṃ sā saricchreṣṭhā tamṛṣiṃ pratyavāhayat \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits then asked- How had the Vasisthapavaha originated? Why had that rivulet swept away that hermit?

## \|\| 40.2 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*viśvāmitrasya rājarṣervasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*bhṛśaṃ vairaṃ babhūveha tapaḥsparddhākṛte mahat \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Lomaharsana said- On account of competition there arose superfluous envy in the mind of Visvamitra to cross the limits of Vasistha the renowned hermit (Sattvavadi) in intelligence.

## \|\| 40.3 \|\|

*āśramo vai vasiṣṭhasya sthāṇutīrthe babhūva ha \|*  
*tasya paścimadigbhāge viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The hermitage of Vasistha was located in the holy place of Sthanu, the asrama of Visvamitra was located at its west.

## \|\| 40.4-5 \|\|

*yatreṣṭvā bhagavān sthāṇuḥ pūjayitvā sarasvatīm \|*  
*sthāpayāmāsa deveśo liṅgākārāṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vasiṣṭhastatra tapasā ghorarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*tasyeha tapasā hīno viśvāmitro babhūva ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The god of gods Sthanu (Siva) first performed yajna and then established Sarasvati in the form of linga. Vasistha was engrossed in deep penance there. But, Visvamitra was inferior to him in austerity.

## \|\| 40.6-7 \|\|

*sarasvatīṃ samāhūya idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|*  
*vasiṣṭhaṃ munisārdūlaṃ svena vegena ānaya \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ihāhaṃ taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ haniṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*etacchratvā tu vacanaṃ vyathitā sā mahānadī \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. He called Sarasvati and said- Bring the hermit Vasistha with your low (i.e. float him with you). I will kill that great sage at this place. That great river Sarasvati was shocked to listen to this order.

## \|\| 40.8 \|\|

*tathā tāṃ vyathitāṃ dṛṣṭvā vepamānaṃ mahānadīm \|*  
*viśvāmitro 'bravīt kruddho vasiṣṭhaṃ śīghramānaya \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. As Visvamitra was in anger, he again ordered- "Go immediately and bring Vasistha here."

## \|\| 40.9 \|\|

*tato gatvā saricchreṣṭhā vasiṣṭhaṃ munisattamam \|*  
*kathayāmāsa rudatī viśvāmitrasya tad vacaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The river went with a heavy heart to the hermit Vasistha and told him very sadly.

## \|\| 40.10-11 \|\|

*tapaḥkriyāviśīrṇāṃ ca bhṛśaṃ śokasamanvitām \|*  
*uvāca sa saricchreṣṭhāṃ viśvāmitrāya māṃ vacaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpāśīlasya sā satit \|*  
*cālayāmāsa taṃ stānāt pravāheṇāmbhasastadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. He suggested to the sad river- "Flow me to Visvamitra; I am ready. So he was flown with the water waves to him from that place.

## \|\| 40.12 \|\|

*sa ca kūlāpahārema mitrāvaruṇayoḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*uhyamānaśca tuṣṭāva tadā devīṃ sarasvatīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. As the river carrying safely through her banks that Mitravaruna (son of Mitra and Varuna jointly) began to pray to Sarasvati.

## \|\| 40.13 \|\|

*pitāmahasya sarasaḥ pravṛttāsi sarasvati \|*  
*vyāptaṃ tvayā jagat sarvaṃ tavaivāmbhobhiruttamaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О Sarasvati! You came out from the reservoir of lord Brahma. You have surrounded the entire world with your clean water.

## \|\| 40.14 \|\|

*tvamevākāśagā devī megheṣu sṛjase payaḥ \|*  
*sarvāstvāpastvameveti tvatto vayamadhīmahe \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. When Visvamitra found Vasistha brought to his home, he began to search for a weapon to kill him with.

## \|\| 40.15 \|\|

*puṣṭirdhṛtistathā kīrtiḥ siddhiḥ kāntiḥ kṣamā tathā \|*  
*svadhā svāhā tathā vāṇī tavāyattamidaṃ jagat \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. River Sarasvati saw that violent excitement in Visvamitra, smelt of a Brahmin's murder, she immediately turned and flew with his body from there. It again took care in depth of comfortability of Vasiytha.

## \|\| 40.16-17 \|\|

*tvameva sarvabhūteṣu vāṇīrūpeṇa saṃsthitā \|*  
*evaṃ sarasvatī tena stutā bhagavatī tadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sukhenovāha taṃ vipraṃ viśvāmitraśramaṃ prati \|*  
*nyavedayattadā khinnā viśvāmitrāya taṃ munim \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The most austere Visvamitra was over excited seeing that Sarasvati has disobeyed him. He thundered a curse on her.

## \|\| 40.18 \|\|

*tamānītaṃ sarasvatyā dṛṣṭvā kopasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*athānviṣat praharaṇaṃ vasiṣṭhāntakaraṃ tadā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. You turn in a goddess moving on ether by filling clouds with water. You have existed in the form of all waters. We do study from you (viz. it is the only influence that inspires us for doing perseverance).

## \|\| 40.19 \|\|

*taṃ tu kruddhamabhiprekṣya brahmahatyābhayānnadī \|*  
*apovāha vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ madhye caivāmbhasastadā \|*  
*ubhayoḥ kurvatī vākyaṃ vañcayitvā ca gādhijam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. You are the endower of health, holding, fame, brilliance, forgiveness, prudence and speech. This entire world is enslaved of you.

## \|\| 40.20 \|\|

*tato 'pavāhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam \|*  
*abravīt krodharaktākṣo viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. You have existed in the form of speech in all organisms. Goddess Sarasvati so prayed brought that Brahmin comfortably to the asrama of Visvamitra. She offered that innocent sage for Visvamitra very sadly.

## \|\| 40.21 \|\|

*yasmānmāṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhe vañcayitvā vinirgatā \|*  
*śoṇitaṃ vaha kalyāṇi rakṣogrāmaṇisaṃyutā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О great river! As you have disobeyed me, carry blood instead of water and pieces of demon’s bodies.

## \|\| 40.22 \|\|

*tataḥ sarasvatī śaptā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā \|*  
*avahacchoṇitonmiśraṃ toyaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tadā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The gracious river had borne the curse of Visvamitra as long as for a year and carried with her the blood of demons.

## \|\| 40.23 \|\|

*atharṣayaśca devāśca gandharvāpsarasastadā \|*  
*sarasvatīṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhabhūvurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Having seen Sarasvati so dirty, all hermits, gods, gandharvas and nymphs fell into grief.

## \|\| 40.24 \|\|

*tasmintīrthavare puṇye śoṇitaṃ samupāvahat \|*  
*tato bhūtapiśācāśca rākṣasāśca samāgatāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Blood began to flow in that sacrosanct holy place. Devils and Pisacas gathered on the banks of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 40.25 \|\|

*tatasto śoṇitaṃ sarve pibantaḥ sukhamāsate \|*  
*tṛptāśca subhṛśaṃ tena sukhitā vigatajvarāḥ \|*  
*nṛtyantaśca hasantaśca yathā svargajitastathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. They began to live peacefully by sipping the blood so flowing with Sarasvati. They felt gaiety to the extent that they here got heaven through their valour and began dancing in a state of happiness.

## \|\| 40.26 \|\|

*kasyacittvatha kālasya ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ \|*  
*tīrthayātrāṃ samājagmuḥ sarasvatyāṃ tapodhanāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. With the passage of certain time, the hermits went to the banks of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 40.27 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaighoraiḥ pīyamānāṃ mahānadīm \|*  
*paritrāṇe sarasvatyāḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ pracakrire \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. They (the hermits) began to think over a strategy to rescue Sarasvati so surrounded by demons due to the flowing of blood (the best diet of rude monsters) for satiating demons.

## \|\| 40.28-29 \|\|

*te tu sarve mahābhāgāḥ samāgamya mahāvratāḥ \|*  
*āhūya saritāṃ śreṣṭhāmidaṃ vacanamabravan \|\| 28 \|\|*

*kiṃ kāraṇaṃ saricchreṣṭhe śoṇitena hlado hyayam \|*  
*evamākulatāṃ yātaḥ śrutvā vetsyāmahe vayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. All those great resolute and lucky people, summoned together the river Sarasvati and said - О great river! We want to listen as to why the reservoir is full of blood?

## \|\| 40.30-31 \|\|

*tataḥ sā sarvamācaṣṭa viśvāmitraviceṣṭitam \|*  
*tataste munayaḥ prītāḥ sarasvatyāṃ samānayan \|*  
*aruṇāṃ puṇyatoyaughāṃ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanīm \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ sarasvatyā rākṣasā duḥkhitā bhṛśam \|*  
*ūcustān vai munīn sarvān dainyayuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. She then described to them all about the foul play of Visvamitra with Vasistha. The hermits then brought Aruna river to make pure the water of Sarasvati. The demons became sad when they saw the water of Sarasvati so purified. He began to say frequently to all sages in a state of pain and worry.

## \|\| 40.32-33 \|\|

*vayaṃ hi kṣudhitāḥ sarve dharmahīnāśca śāśvatāḥ \|*  
*na ca naḥ kāmakāroyaṃ yad vayaṃ pāpakāriṇaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yuṣmākaṃ cāprasādena duṣkṛtena ca karmaṇā \|*  
*pakṣo 'yaṃ vardhate 'smākaṃ yataḥ smo brahmarākṣasāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. All of us live hungry and seldom abide by the rules. It is not our self will that we are committing sins, but our party gets growth due to your neglect and evil acts towards us. We all are Brahmaraksasa (the people who are lapsed from the essence of Brahma in spite of their birth in the Brahmin community.

## \|\| 40.34 \|\|

*evaṃ vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca kṣatriyāśca vikarmabhiḥ \|*  
*ye brāhmaṇān pedviṣanti te bhavantīha rākṣasāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The Vaisya, Sгdra and Ksatriya too become demons, turn into the tendency of monsters as a result of their various bad activities and are envious to Brahmins.

## \|\| 40.35 \|\|

*yoṣitāṃ caiva pāpānāṃ yonidoṣeṇa varddhate \|*  
*iyaṃ saṃtatirasmākaṃ gatireṣā sanātanī \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Our generations receive a spurt due to the defects of yoni (genital) of misconduct of women. It is the perpetual process of our growth.

## \|\| 40.36-39 \|\|

*śaktā bhavantaḥ sarveṣāṃ lokānāmapi tāraṇe \|*  
*teṣāṃ te munayaḥ śrutvā kṛpāśīlāḥ punaśca te \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarve tapyamānāśca te dvijāḥ \|*  
*kṣutakīṭāvapannaṃ ca yaccocchiṣṭāśitaṃ bhavet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*keśāvapannamādhūtaṃ mārutaśvāsadvaṣitam \|*  
*ebhiḥ saṃsṛṣṭamannaṃ ca bhāgaṃ vai rakṣasāṃ bhavet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tasmājjñātvā sadā vidvān annānyetāni jarjayet \|*  
*rākṣasānāmasau bhuṅkte yo bhuṅkte annamīdṛśam \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. You are capable to do welfare of all lokas. The gracious sages made mutual consult and said- The food is polluted when it comes in touch with sneeze and insects, when it is residual after eating, hair dropped in it, received with insult and polluted by expirated air. It becomes the share of monsters.

## \|\| 40.40 \|\|

*śodhayitvā tu tattīrthamṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*mokṣārthaṃ rakṣasāṃ teṣāṃ saṃgamaṃ tatra kalpayan \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The scholar should take notice of these things and give up such food. One who eats such polluted food, eats only the share of monsters.

## \|\| 40.41 \|\|

*aruṇāyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ saṃgame lokaviśrute \|*  
*trirātropoṣitaḥ snāto mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. That man becomes free from the clutches of all evils who observes fast for three nights and takes a bath in the confluence of Аruna and Sarasvati rivers.

## \|\| 40.42 \|\|

*prāpte kaliyuge ghore adharme pratyupasthite \|*  
*aruṇāsaṃgame snātvā muktimāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. On introduction of the gross Kaliyuga with its devastating effects and the communication or spread off demoralise activities, the man taking a bath in the confluence of Аruna and Sarasvati attains emancipation.

## \|\| 40.43 \|\|

*tataste rākṣasāḥ sarve snātāḥ pāpavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*dviyāmālyambaradharāḥ svargasthitisamanvitāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. All those monsters then took a bath, received purity of heart, put on divine garlands and clothes and got better positions in heaven.

## Chapter 41. Account of Kuruksetra-tirthas and Praise of the Praci Sarasvati

## \|\| 41.1 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca \|*  
*samudrāstatra catvāro darviṇā āha-tāḥ purā \|*  
*pratyekaṃ tu naraḥ snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Lomaharsana said- The hermit Darvi brought there four oceans. A man attains the fruit of the donation made of a thousand cows.

## \|\| 41.2 \|\|

*yatkiñcit kriyate tasmiṃstapastīrthe dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*paripūrṇaṃ hi tatsarvamapi duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О great Dvijas! The penance made there gets perfection even when it is made by an evil-doer.

## \|\| 41.3 \|\|

*śatasāhasrikaṃ tīrthaṃ tathaiva śatikaṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*ubhayorhi naraḥ snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О Brahmins! The man taking a bath in Satasahastrika and Satika places, received the fruit equal to that of the cows donated in number one thousand.

## \|\| 41.4 \|\|

*somatīrthaṃ ca tatrāpi sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitam \|*  
*yasmin snātastu puruṣo rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Somatirtha has existed on the bank of Sarasvati there. The man who takes a bath in it, receives the fruit equal to the Rajasuya yajna.

## \|\| 41.5 \|\|

*reṇukāśramamāsādya śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*mātṛbhaktyā ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The man of keen reverence in heart and who has control on his senses, obtains fruits equal to that received in the form of a mother's blessing.

## \|\| 41.6-7 \|\|

*ṛṇairmukto bhavennityaṃ devarṣipitṛsaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*kumārasyābhiṣekaṃ ca ojasaṃ nāma viśrutam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tasmin snātastu puruṣo yaśasā ca samanvitaḥ \|*  
*kumārapuramāpnoti kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ tu mānavaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The holy place installed by Brahma absolves the man from the debts of gods, hermits and ancestors. The man becomes illustrious by taking a bath in Ojasa, the place where once Kumara (Kartikeya) was coronated. He receives Kumara Рurа as a blessing for the sraddha made there.

## \|\| 41.8 \|\|

*caitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ site pakṣe yastu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*gayāśrāddhe ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The man who will take a bath here on the sixth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra (March) receives the fruit as obtained by how he had observed sraddha in Gaya.

## \|\| 41.9 \|\|

*saṃnihityāṃ yathā śrāddhaṃ rāhugraste divākare \|*  
*tathā śrāddhaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. When the sun is gripped by the demon head viz. at the time of solar eclipse and one does sraddha and the sraddha observed here is analogous to the view of the magnificence. One should, therefore, doubt on it.

## \|\| 41.10 \|\|

*ojase hyakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ vāyunā kathitaṃ purā \|*  
*tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The air had declared several eras ago that the sraddha observed in Ojasa attains everlasting position. One should, therefore, observe sraddha there sure.

## \|\| 41.11 \|\|

*yastu snānaṃ śraddadhānaścaitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*akṣayyamudakaṃ tasya pitṝṇāmupajāyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The pitaras of a person taking a bath with reverence for the peace of mind here on the sixth day of the bright fortnight in Caitra (March) month, receive undepleting water in the heaven (viz. they never feel the discomfort of drinking water while living in heaven).

## \|\| 41.12 \|\|

*tatra pañcavaṭaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*mahādevaḥ sthito yatra yogamūrtidharaḥ svayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A holy place Pancavata has existed there. This place is popularly known throughout the three-worlds. God Mahadeva himself seated there in the form of a Yogi.

## \|\| 41.13 \|\|

*tatra snātvār'cayitvā va devadevaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*gāṇapatyamavāpnoti daivataiḥ saha modate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The man receives the position of Ganapati by taking a dip and worshipping the god of gods Mahesvara. He then lives in the company of gods.

## \|\| 41.14 \|\|

*kurutīrthaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ kuruṇā yatra vai tapaḥ \|*  
*taptaṃ sughoraṃ kṣetrasya karṣaṇārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О great Dvijas! The popular holy place Kurutirtha has existed here. Kuru had seated in strict penance here for ploughing the land.

## \|\| 41.15 \|\|

*tasya ghoreṇa tapasā tuṣṭa indrobravīd vacaḥ \|*  
*rājarṣe parituṣṭo 'smi tapasānena suvrataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Indra said when pleased with his deep penance- "O king hermit! I am pleased with the penance made by you."

## \|\| 41.16 \|\|

*yajñaṃ ye ca kurukṣetre kariṣyanti śatakratoḥ \|*  
*te gamiṣyanti sukṛtāṃllokān pāpavivarjitān \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The people observing sacrifice (yajna) for Indra in Kuruksetra attain the lokas made for noble men and the evils committed by them earlier are effaced.

## \|\| 41.17-18 \|\|

*avahasya tataḥ śakro jagāma tridivaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*āgamyāgamya caivainaṃ bhūyo bhūyo 'vahasya ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śatakraturanirviṇṇaḥ pṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā jagāma ha \|*  
*yadā tu tapasogreṇa cakarṣa dehamātmanaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śakro 'bravīt prītya brūhi yatte cikīrṣitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. God Indra then went to heaven. He laughed to see his Herculean task. Before departing, he made several enquiries ridiculously. When Kuru cultivated his body through toughest penance, Indra asked with love- "Ask for what you desire?"

## \|\| 41.19 \|\|

*kururuvāca*  
*ye śraddadhānāstīrthe 'smin mānavā nivasanti ha \|*  
*te prāpnuvantu sadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Kuru replied- "May the devotees living at this place, attain the abode of Brahma."

## \|\| 41.20 \|\|

*anyatra kṛtapāpā ye pañcapātakadūṣitāḥ \|*  
*asmistīrthe narāḥ snātvā muktā yāntu parāṃ gatim \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. May the people who had committed any evil anywhere and vitiated of five offences (viz. murder of Brahmins, liquor sipping, theft, sex with preceptor’s wife and contact of any kind with these miscreants), receive supreme position by mere a dip in this place!

## \|\| 41.21 \|\|

*kurukṣetre puṇyatamaṃ kurutīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*te dṛṣṭvā pāpamuktastu paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О Dvijas! Kuru is the most sacrosanct place in Kuruksetra; the evil-doers even receive supreme position merely when they visit here.

## \|\| 41.22 \|\|

*kurutīrthe naraḥ snāto mukto bhavati kilviṣaiḥ \|*  
*kuruṇā samanujñātaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A man is absolved from all sins by taking a bath дп Kuruksetra and attains supreme position under the grace of Kuru.

## \|\| 41.23 \|\|

*svargadvāraṃ tato gacchet śivadvāre vyavasthitam \|*  
*tatra snātvā śivadvāre prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. One should visit then the gate of heaven (Stargadvara) existed in Sivadvara (the door of welfare). The man taking a bath in Sivadvara attains supreme position.

## \|\| 41.24-25 \|\|

*tato gacchedanarakaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*yatra pūrve sthito brahma dakṣiṇe tu maheśvaraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*rudrapatnī paścimataḥ padmanābhottare sthitaḥ \|*  
*madhye anarakaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. One should then visit Anaraka, a holy place popular throughout the three worlds. Brahma exists at its east, Mahesvara at south, Rudrapatnl in the west, Padmanabha in the north and in the middle of them this place has existed.

## \|\| 41.26-30 \|\|

*yasmin snātastu mucyeta pātakairupapātakaiḥ \|*  
*vaiśākhe ca yadā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalasya dinaṃ bhavet \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tadā snānaṃ tatra kṛtvā mukto bhavati pātakaiḥ \|*  
*yaḥ prayaccheta karakāṃścaturo bhakṣyasaṃyutān \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kalaśaṃ ca tathā dadyādapūpaiḥ pariśobhitam \|*  
*devatāḥ prīmayet pūrvaṃ karakairannasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tatastu kalaśaṃ dadyāt sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*anenaiva vidhānena yastu snānaṃ samācaret \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sa muktāḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ prayāti paramaṃ padam \|*  
*anyatrāpi yadā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalena bhaviṣyati \|\| 30 \|\|*

26-30. A man is freed from evils and heinous evils committed. A bath on the sixth day of Vaishakha (May) if it falls on Tuesday, absolves the man from all evils attached. One should donate kalasa (metal pitcher) full of four Karaka (special vessel) and Apupas (Mulapua) this day after a bath. He should prior to donation worship the god by offering Karakas cooked with cereal. The men taking a bath with this procedure, attains the supreme position after decay of sins attached. If there is the sixth day of month with Tuesday, the bath on that day also fructifies in spite of the month not being Vaisakha (May).

## \|\| 41.31-32 \|\|

*tatrāpi muktiphaladā kriyā tasmin bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tīrthe ca sarvatīrthānāṃ yasmin snāto dvijottamāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sarvadevairanujñātaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*kāmyakaṃ ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. О great Dvijas! The holy place of places viz. the best holy place Kamyaka-vana is considered. A man receives supreme position as a result of a bath taken there.

## \|\| 41.33 \|\|

*yasmin praviṣṭamātrastu mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ \|*  
*yamāśritya vanaṃ puṇyaṃ savitā prakaṭaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Even an entrance into this place absolves the sins of a man thoroughly. The sun as Pusa has apparently existed in this sacrosanct forest.

## \|\| 41.34 \|\|

*pūṣā nāma dvijaśreṣṭha darśanānmuktimāpnuyāt \|*  
*ādityasya dine prāpte tasmin snātastu mānavaḥ \|*  
*viśuddhadeho bhavati manasā cintitaṃ labhet \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О Brahmins! A sight of Pusa ensures emancipation of the people. The man taking a bath in that place on Sunday receives the pure body and thus he obtains the desired objects.

## Chapter 42. Description of Durga-tirtha and others

## \|\| 42.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*kāmyakasya tu pūrveṇa kuñjaṃ devairniṣevitam \|*  
*tasya tīrthasya saṃbhūtiṃ vistareṇa bravīhi naḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The hermits said- Kindly explain the origin of Kanjatirtha worshipped by the gods in detail which is located at the east of Kamyaka.

## \|\| 42.2 \|\|

*lohamarṣaṇa uvāca*  
*śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāṃ caritaṃ śrutvā mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Lomaharsana said- O hermits! listen to the best magnificence of all holy places. A man is absolved from sins by giving ear to the character of hermits.

## \|\| 42.3 \|\|

*naimiṣeyāśca ṛṣayaḥ kurukṣetre samāgatāḥ \|*  
*sarasvatyāstu snānārthaṃ praveśaṃ te na lebhire \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The hermits of Naimisaranya came to take a bath in Sarasvati at Kuruksetra but they could not enter.

## \|\| 42.4 \|\|

*tataste kalpayāmāsustīrthaṃ yajñopavītikam \|*  
*śeṣāstu munayastatra na praveśaṃ hi lebhire \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. They then constructed a holy place nameiy "yajnopavitika", the rest of hermits could not access even to it.

## \|\| 42.5-6 \|\|

*rantukasyāśramāttāvad yāvattīrthaṃ sacakrakam \|*  
*brāhmaṇaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā devī sarasvatī \|\| 5 \|\|*

*hitārthaṃ sarvaviprāṇāṃ kutvā kuñjāni sā nadī \|*  
*prayātā paścimaṃ mārgaṃ sarvabhūtahite sthitā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Goddess Sarasvati constructed the groves and then she moved towards west for the welfare of all organisms. As the number of devotees living on her banks was increasing, goddess took their comforts in mind and groves were grown there.

## \|\| 42.7-8 \|\|

*pūrvapravāhe yaḥ snāti gaṅgasnānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*pravāhe dakṣiṇe tasyā narmadā saritāṃ varā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*paścime tu diśābhāge yamunā saṃśritā nadī \|*  
*yadā uttarato yāti sindhurbhavati sā nadī \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The people who take a bath at the starting place of this river obtain the fruit equal to a bath in the Ganges. At its south side flows Narmada and Yamuna at the west. It is Sindhu when it flows towards north.

## \|\| 42.9 \|\|

*evaṃ diśāpravāheṇa yāti puṇyā sarasvatī \|*  
*tasyāṃ snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Thus, the sacred river Sarasvati flows in several directions. The man taking a bath in them automatically has taken a bath in all holy places.

## \|\| 42.10 \|\|

*tato gacched dvijaśreṣṭhā madanasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ vihāraṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О great Brahmins! There is another holy place worth visit at Madanavihara as it is addressed. It is famous throughout the world.

## \|\| 42.11 \|\|

*yatra devāḥ samāgamya śivadarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*samāgatā na cāpaśyan devaṃ devyā samanvitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. At this place, the gods desirous of seeing lord Siva mere come but nobody among them could see god Siva conjugally compact to each other in body.

## \|\| 42.12-13 \|\|

*te stuvanto mahādevaṃ nandinaṃ gaṇanāyakam \|*  
*tataḥ prasanno nandīśaḥ kathayāmāsa ceṣṭitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bhavasya umayā sārdhaṃ vihāre krīḍitaṃ mahat \|*  
*tacchratvā devatāstatra patnīrāhūya krīḍitāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. On their failure, an idea emerged and they began to worship Nandi (the gana of Siva cardinal popularly known as carrier to lord Sankara having the body of a bull). Nandi was pleased and described the play of lord Siva with Uma, (daughter of Himalaya) in varied ways in that "Vihara". The gods also called their cows and began to play with them in varied ways.

## \|\| 42.14-15 \|\|

*teṣāṃ krīḍāvinodena tuṣṭaḥ provaca śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*yo 'smiṃstīrthenaraḥ snātivihāre śraddhayānvitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dhanadhānyapriyairyukto bhavate nātra saṃsayaḥ \|*  
*durgātīrthaṃ tato gacched durgayā sevitaṃ mahat \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Lord Sankara was pleased with them and declared that whosoever men take a bath here with observing all serenity shall always be in the company of his beloved and prosperity. One should then visit great holy place Durga.

## \|\| 42.16 \|\|

*yatra snātvā pitṛn pūjya na durgatimavāpḥṛyāt \|*  
*tatrāpi ca sarasvatyāḥ kūpaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The man who takes a bath and worships in pitaras seldom is deteriorated in material as also metaphysical terms. A well famous in the three-world has existed there.

## \|\| 42.17-19 \|\|

*darśanānmuktimāpnoti sarvapātakavarjitaḥ \|*  
*yastatra tarpayet devān pitṝṃś ca śraddhayāntavitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*akṣayyaṃ labhate sarvaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ viśiṣyate \|*  
*mātṛhā pitṛhā yaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*snātvā śuddhimavāpnoti yatra prācī sarasvatī \|*  
*devamārgapraviṣṭā ca devamārgeṇa niḥsṛta \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. A mere visit to this holy place blesses the man with emancipation after cleaning all evils with reverence. The man who does tarpana of gods and Pitrs gets everlasting supply of desired material things. Pitrtirtha has specific magnificence. The heinous evils such as murder of father of mother or courtship with the teacher's wife can be washed forever in the holy water of this place. So, a dip is enough in the water here. The Sarasvati at its course facing east has entered through the divine route and emanated from the divine route also.

## \|\| 42.20-25 \|\|

*pracī sarasvatī puṇyā api duṣkṛtakarmaṇām \|*  
*trirātraṃ ye kariṣyanti prācīṃ prāpya sarasvatīm \|\| 20 \|\|*

*na teṣāṃ duṣkutaṃ kiñcid dehamāśritya tiṣṭhati \|*  
*naranārāyaṇau devau brahmā sthāṇustathā raviḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pracīṃ diśaṃ niṣevante sadā devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|*  
*ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti prācīmāśritya mānavāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ na durlabhaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca \|*  
*tasmāt prācī sadā sevyā pañcamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pañcamyāṃ sevamānastu lakṣmīvān jāyate naraḥ \|*  
*tatra tīrthamauśanaṃ trailokyasyāpi durlabham \|\| 24 \|\|*

*uśanā yatra saṃsiddha ārādhya parameśvaram \|*  
*grahamadhyeṣu pūjyate tasya tīrthasya sevanāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

20-25. Sarasvati with its course at east, gratifies even the evildoers also. The man who observes fast for three nights loses all evils in body. Both gods Nara and Nirayana, Brahma, Sthanu, Sun and Indra including all gods always live in the east. The man doing sraddha in Praci Sarasvati is nothing left of rare thing in this world and in that world also. One should therefore, always and on the day of Pancami (the fifth day of either fortnight) take a bath in Sarasvati taking the flow towards east. The man who takes a bath here on Pancami, obtains wealth in. abundance. Ausavasa is a holy place rare in the three worlds. Sukracarya got here accompaniments in course of praying to Paramesvara. As a result of residing here the people gain so much intelligence as they are worshipped amid the stars.

## \|\| 42.26 \|\|

*evaṃ śukreṇa muninā sevitaṃ tīrthamuttamam \|*  
*ye sevante śraddadhānāste yānti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The best holy place where austerity conducted by Sukra hermit was fulfilled ensures the supreme position in the heaven when a dip is taken in this place.

## \|\| 42.27 \|\|

*yastu śrāddhaṃ naro bhaktyā tasmiṃstīrthe kariṣyati \|*  
*pitarastāritāstena bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. A sraddha with sheer devotion undoubtedly uplifts his pitaras by the inner soul satisfied.

## \|\| 42.28-29 \|\|

*caturmukhaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ saro maryādayā sthitam \|*  
*ye sevante caturdaśyāṃ sopavāsā vasanti ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*aṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya caitre māsi dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*te paśyanti paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. О great Dvijas! A reservoir with four comers cylindrical shaped is called Brahm- tirtha. A bath here on the fourteenth day of eight fortnights and a bath on the eighth day of the dark fortnight with fast and half there at night enables a man to perceive the supreme essence (in its most micro form) and he thus becomes free from the swing of frequent birth and death.

## \|\| 42.30 \|\|

*sthāṇutīrthaṃ tato gacchet sahasraliṅgaśobhitam \|*  
*tatra sthāṇuvaṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. One should then visit Sthanu-tirtha looking magnificent with one thousand lingas. A sight of Sthanu banyan makes the man free from evils.

## Chapter 43. Description of Creation and Religion

## \|\| 43.1-2 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*sthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vaṭasya ca mahāmune \|*  
*sānnihatyasarotpattiṃ pūraṇaṃ pāṃśunā tataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*liṅgānāṃ darśanāt puṇyaṃ sparśanena ca kiṃ phalam \|*  
*tathaiva saramāhātmyaṃ brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. The hermits asked- О great hermit! Tell us in detail about the holy place Sthanuvata and the magnificence of the banyan tree there. How did the reservoir originate, how was it filled with dust? What are the blessings of a visit there to see the lingas and touching them and what magnificence does this reservoir bear?

## \|\| 43.3 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca*  
*śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve purāṇaṃ vāmanaṃ mahat \|*  
*yacchrutvā muktimāpnoti prasādād vāmanasya tu \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Lomaharsana said- О all sages! listen to the great Vamana Purana so magnificent as merely listening to this episode ensures emancipation for a man.

## \|\| 43.4 \|\|

*sanatkumāramāsīnaṃ sthāṇorvaṭasamīpataḥ \|*  
*ṛṣibhirbālakhilyādyairbrahmaputrairmahātmabhiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Sanatkumara once was seated in the company of Balakhilya etc. hermits, the sons of Brahma. It was a site near Sthanu-vata (banyan).

## \|\| 43.5 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeyo munistatra vinayenābhigamya ca \|*  
*papraccha saramāhātmyaṃ pramāṇāṃ ca sthitiṃ tathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The hermit Markandeya went to him and asked humbly about the magnificence attached to the reservoir, its expanse and location etc. in detail.

## \|\| 43.6 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca*  
*brahmaputra mahābhāga sarveśāstraviśārada \|*  
*brūhi me saramāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayāvaham \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Markandeya said- О Sanatkumara! You are skilled in all the scriptures and are the son of revered Brahma. Please, tell us about the magnificence subsiding/effacing the force of evils.

## \|\| 43.7-8 \|\|

*kāni tīrthāni dṛśyāni guhyāni dvijasattama \|*  
*liṅgāni hyatipuṇyāni sthāṇoryāni samīpataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yeṣāṃ darśanāmātreṇa muktiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*vaṭasya darśanaṃ puṇyamutpatti kathayasva me \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. O great Dvija! Tell us further about the number of visible and invisible holy places and the number of lingas existed there. Do these provide one with emancipation? Tell also about the fruit for seeing the banyan tree and its origin.

## \|\| 43.9-11 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇāyāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ tīrthasnānena yatphalam \|*  
*guhyeṣu caiva dṛṣṭeṣu yatpuṇyamabhijāyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

*devadevo yatā sthāṇuḥ saromadhye vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*kimarthaṃ pāṃśunā śakrastīrthaṃ pūritavān punaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ cakratīrthasya yatphalam \|*  
*sūryatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ somatīrthasya brūhi me \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. The fruits of Pradaksnia (round revolving) a visit, the visible and invisible holy places, their observation (a sight at them) and the circumstance in which lord Siva (Sthanu) appeared in the middle of the reservoir are the topics of our curiosity. Further, tell us how god Indra filled again completely this reservoir with dust, the magnificence of Sthanu-tirtha, the fruit of Cakra-tirtha, its magnificence with Surya-tirtha and Soma- tirtha.

## \|\| 43.12 \|\|

*saṃkarasya ca kuhyāni viṣṇoḥ stānāni yāni ca \|*  
*kathayasya mahābhāga sarasvatyāḥ savistaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О learned sage! Tell us in detail about the secret places (spots) of god Sankara and Visnu located on the bank of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 43.13 \|\|

*brūhi devādhidevasya māhātmyaṃ deva tattvataḥ \|*  
*viriñjasya prasādena viditaṃ sarvameva ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. As you know everything by the grace of god Brahma, please tell about the magnificence of the god of gods very clearly .

## \|\| 43.14 \|\|

*lomaharṣaṇa uvāca\|*  
*mārkaṇḍeyavacaḥ śrutvā brahmatmā sa mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*atibhaktyā tu tīrthasya pravaṇīkṛtamānasaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Lomaharsana said- The mind of hermit was impressed by the praise as made by Markandeya about the sheer devotion for the holy place.

## \|\| 43.15 \|\|

*paryaṅkaṃ śithilīkṛtvā namaskṛtvā maheśvaram \|*  
*kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yacchrutaṃ brahmaṇaḥ purā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Не first loosened his posture in which he was seated earlier, bowed his head to god Sankara and described all events pertaining to the long ancient as he had listened from Brahma, his father.

## \|\| 43.16 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca*  
*namaskṛtya mahādevamīśānaṃ varadaṃ śivam \|*  
*utpatti ca pravakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ brahmabhāṣitām \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Sanatkumara said- I bow before the factors blessings, Varadata (who gives as desired) Mahadeva, Isana and start telling about the holy places, as heard from Brahma.

## \|\| 43.17 \|\|

*pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame \|*  
*bṛhadaṇḍamabhūdekaṃ prajānāṃ bījasaṃbhavam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Long ago, a gigantic egg originated in the form of reproduction (seed) when the entire world with the movable as also immovable objects was destroyed.

## \|\| 43.18 \|\|

*tasminnaṇḍe sthito brahmā śayanāyopacakrame \|*  
*sahasrayugaparyantaṃ suptvā sa pratyabudhyata \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Brahma existed within that egg and he wanted to relax in slumber. Thus, he slept for several thousand eras and then awoke.

## \|\| 43.19 \|\|

*suptotthitastadā brahmā śūnyaṃ lokamapaśyata \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ cintayatastasya rajasā mohitasya ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Brahma, on getting back consciousness, looked around him and found nothing in the cosmic world. Rajoguna inserted in his mind suddenly and he began to think of creation.

## \|\| 43.20 \|\|

*rajaḥ sṛṣṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ sattvaṃ sthitiguṇaṃ viduḥ \|*  
*upasaṃhārakāle ca tamogumaḥ pravartate \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Rajoguna (Rajas property) is considered Creative and Sattvaguna is promoter. At the line of devastation, the Tamasa tendency is originated.

## \|\| 43.21 \|\|

*guṇātītaḥ sa bhagavān vyāpakaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*tenadaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ yatkiñciñjīvasaṃjñitam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. (Actually) god is beyond property (guna) and omnipresent. He is called Purusa. All matters considered organisms are spread by virtue of his art.

## \|\| 43.22 \|\|

*sa brahma sa ca govinda īśvaraḥ sa sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yastaṃ veda mahātmānaṃ sa sarvaṃ veda mokṣavit \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He himself is Brahma, Visnu and immortal Mahesvara. The person known to that great soul becomes omniscient and free from bondage.

## \|\| 43.23 \|\|

*kiṃ teṣāṃ sakalaistīrthairāśramairvā prayojanam \|*  
*yeṣāmanantakaṃ cittamātmanyeva vyavasthitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Whose unending citta (mind and heart) is managed in the soul; there is no necessity of visiting holy places and asramas.

## \|\| 43.24 \|\|

*ātmā nadī saṃyamapuṇyatīrthā satyodakā śīlamādhiyuktā \|*  
*tasyāṃ snātaḥ puṇyakarmā punāti na viriṇā suddhyati cāntarātmā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The river constituted by modesty, meditation with realisation of soul is with many holy places in the form of control over the senses and it is filled with water in the form of truth. The man taking a bath in it, gets the pleasure of both purity of heart and mind. Here water cannot purify the river soul.

## \|\| 43.25 \|\|

*etatpradhānaṃ puruṣasya karma yadātmasaṃbodhasukhe praviṣṭam \|*  
*jñeyaṃ tadeva pravadanti santastatprāpya dehī vijahāti kāmān \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. It is the main duty of a man to take entrance in the pleasure of self-knowledge (Atmajnana). The saints consider him the learned. A man with self-knowledge gives up all his wishes.

## \|\| 43.26 \|\|

*naitādṛsaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatā ca \|*  
*śīle sthitirdaṇḍavidhānavarjanamakrodhanaścoparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. There is no other wealth analogous to maintain reluctance from the activities, the virtues like unity, equity, truthfulness, modesty and non-violence through control on temper for a Brahmin in this world.

## \|\| 43.27 \|\|

*etad brahma samāsena mayoktaṃ te dvijottama \|*  
*yajjñātvā brahma paramaṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О great Dvija! I have explained this knowledge in brief to you. You will definitely access to Brahma when you duly understand it.

## \|\| 43.28 \|\|

*idānīṃ śṛṇu cotpattiṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*imaṃ codāharantyeva ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Now listen to the origin of Brahma, the supreme soul. The people reproduce the following hymn about Narayana.

## \|\| 43.29 \|\|

*āpo nārā vai tanava ityevaṃ nāma śuśrumaḥ \|*  
*tāsu śete sa yasmācca tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Ара viz. water is called Nara and (of supreme soul) Tanau. He sleeps on it hence, addressed as Narayana.

## \|\| 43.30 \|\|

*vibuddhaḥ salile tasmin vijñāyāntargataṃ jagat \|*  
*aṇḍaṃ bibheda bhagavāṃstasmādomityajāyata \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. As the god awakened, he understood that the world is shrunk in the egg and he thus, penetrated the egg. "Om" the syllable came out as a result of such penetration.

## \|\| 43.31 \|\|

*tato bhūrabhavat tasmād bhuva ityaparaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*svaḥ śabdaśca tṛtīyo 'bhad bhūrbhuvaḥ sveti saṃjñitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Then it gave birth to Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svaha in an orderly manner. Completely they called "Bhurbhuvah Svahali."

## \|\| 43.32 \|\|

*tasmāttejaḥ samabhavat tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ yat \|*  
*udakaṃ śoṣayāmāsa yattejo 'ṇḍaviniḥsṛtam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The splendour that shows with sun was than originated from it. This splendour so come out of the egg dried the water up.

## \|\| 43.33 \|\|
