*tejasā śoṣitaṃ śeṣaṃ kalalatvamupāgatam \|*  
*kalalād budbudaṃ jñeyaṃ tataḥ kāṭhinyatāṃ gatam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In course when the water was being absorbed, the Sesa converted it in the form of gastrula (kalala); it originated Buda-buda (marrow) and then it was solidified.

## \|\| 43.34 \|\|

*kāṭhinyād dharaṇī jñeya bhūtānāṃ dhāriṇī iha sā \|*  
*yasmin stānesthitaṃ hyaṇḍaṃ tasmin saṃnihitaṃsaraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. This crystallisation gave birth to the earth and it holds all beings on its breasts. Samhita reservoir is located where that egg was originated and observed by Brahma.

## \|\| 43.35 \|\|

*yadādyaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ tejastasmādāditya ucyate \|*  
*aṇḍamadhye samutpanno hrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. As the splendour originated very first (Adi), the sun was called Aditya. Lokapitamaha Brahma was originated from the middle portion of that egg.

## \|\| 43.36-37 \|\|

*ulbaṃ tasyābhavanmerurjarāyuḥ parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*garbhodakaṃ samudrāśca tathā nadyaḥ sahasraśaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*nābhisthāne yadudakaṃ brahmaṇo nirmalaṃ mahat \|*  
*mahatsarastena pūrṇaṃ vimalena varāmbhasā \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. The outer shell of the egg is the Meru mountain and other mountains are considered the Jarayu (internal crust) of that egg. Ocean and several thousand rivers and the garbhodaka the clean water at the navel zone of Brahma, had filled the reservoir with that magnificent water.

## \|\| 43.38-39 \|\|

*tasmin madhye sthāṇurūpī vṛṭavṛkṣo mahāmanaḥ \|*  
*tasmād vinirgatā varṇā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*śūdrāśca tasmādutpannāḥ śuśrūṣārthaṃ dvijanmanām \|*  
*tataścintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|*  
*manasā mānasā jātāḥ sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The banyan tree with its vast trunk has existed just at the middle of it. Brahmin, Ksatriya and Vaisya varnas came out from that tree and Sudras originated for the service of Dvijas. Then the great hermits Sanaka etc. originated from the mind of inexpressible and unborn Brahma.

## \|\| 43.40 \|\|

*punaścintayatastasya prajākāmasya dhīmataḥ \|*  
*utpannā ṛṣayaḥ sapta te prajāpatayo 'bhavan \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The seven hermits were originated from Brahma so doing efforts for creation. The all became Prajapati.

## \|\| 43.41 \|\|

*punaścintayatastasya rajasā mohitasya ca \|*  
*bālakhilyāḥ samutpannāstapaḥsvādhyāyatatparāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. When Brahma under the influence of doing creation again thought for it, Balkhilyas the hermits having great perseverance originated.

## \|\| 43.42 \|\|

*te sadā snānaniratā devārcanaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*upavāsairvrataistīvraiḥ śoṣayanti kalevaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. They always do bath daily, worship gods, observe several fasts and put command on their body through penance.

## \|\| 43.43 \|\|

*vānaprasthena vidhinā agnihotrasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*tapasā parameṇeha śoṣayanti kalevaram \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. They exploit their body for arranging Agnihotra, follow Vanaprastha rite and do strict penance.

## \|\| 43.44 \|\|

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ te kṛśā dhamanisaṃtatāḥ \|*  
*ārādhayanti deveśaṃ na ca tuṣyati śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. They sat on penance for several thousand divine years and became weakest in body and mere breathing was remained with them but god Sankara took no notice of them. He did not appear.

## \|\| 43.45-48 \|\|

*tataḥ kālena mahatā umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*ākāśamārgeṇa tadā dṛṣṭvā devī suduḥkhitāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*prasādya devadeveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ prāha suvratā \|*  
*kliśyante te munigaṇā devadāruvanāśrayāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ kleśakṣayaṃ deva vidhehi kuru me dayām \|*  
*kiṃ vedadharmaniṣṭhanāmanantaṃ deva dṛṣkṛtam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*nādyāpi yena śuddhyanti śuṣkasnāyvasthisoṣitāḥ \|*  
*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ devyāḥ pinākī pātitāndhakaḥ \|*  
*provāca prahasan mūrdhni cārucandrāṃśuśobhitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. After a long lapse of period, god Sankara was on his tour with Uma through the ether. The goddess with great resolutions saw them and said to Sankara- "These hermits are bearing great pains in this forest of Devadara tree. О god! be graceful to me and remove their pains. О god! I ask you if the evils committed by them are so large in account that they could not attain purity even when they exploited their body to the extent that mere bones and some flesh has been left with them." God Sankara laughed at it and said-

## \|\| 43.49 \|\|

*śrīmahādeva uvāca*  
*na vetsi devi tattvena dharmasya gahanā gatiḥ \|*  
*naite dharmaṃ vijānanti na ca kāmavivarjitāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Sri Mahadeva said- О goddess! The position of religion is deepest and you are still alien to it. These people neither know the essence of religion nor are they free from Kama (acts or appeal for sex).

## \|\| 43.50-51 \|\|

*na ca krodhena nirmuktāḥ kevalaṃ mūḍhabuddhayaḥ \|*  
*etacchrutvābravīd devī mā maivaṃ śaṃsitavratān \|\| 50 \|\|*

*deva pradarśayātmānaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me \|*  
*sa ityukta uvācedaṃ devīṃ devaḥ smitānanāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Anger is also affiliated with them. These are merely stupid. The goddess said- "Don't say these words specially for these people who are seated on long penance. О god! Please make your appearance before them. I am in surprise at your statement used for them. Sankara laughed at this and said-

## \|\| 43.52 \|\|

*tiṣṭha tvamatra yāsyāmi yatraite munipuṅgavāḥ \|*  
*sādhayanti tapo ghoraṃ darśayiṣyāmi ceṣṭitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Stop here. I play some art where these hermits are seated in gross penance.

## \|\| 43.53-54 \|\|

*ityuktā tu tato devī śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*gacchasvetyāha muditā bhartaraṃ bhuvaneśvaram \|\| 53 \|\|*

*yatra te munayaḥ sarve kāṣṭhaleṣṭasamāḥ sthitāḥ \|*  
*adhīyānā mahābhāgāḥ kṛtāgnisadanakriyāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The goddess felt happiness and said- "You should go surely to the place where those living hermits well known to Agnihotra, perseverance and who are this time looking as wood and lump of clay.

## \|\| 43.55-56 \|\|

*tān vilokya tato devo nagnaḥ sarvāṅgasundaraḥ \|*  
*vanamālākṛtāpīḍo yuvā bhikṣākapālabhṛt \|\| 55 \|\|*

*āśrame paryaṭan bhikṣāṃ munīnāṃ darśanaṃ prati \|*  
*dehi bhikṣāṃ tataścoktvā hyāśramādāśramaṃ yayau \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. God Sankara converted his body into an ascetic naked fully in body and young. He started asking for alms serially from one asrama to another.

## \|\| 43.57-59 \|\|

*taṃ vilokyāśramagataṃ yoṣito brahmavādinām \|*  
*sakautukasvabhāvena tasya rūpema mohitāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*procuḥ parasparaṃ nārya ehi paśyāma bhiśrukam \|*  
*parasparamiti coktvā gṛhya mūlaphalaṃ bahu \|\| 58 \|\|*

*gṛhāṇa bhikṣāmūcustāstaṃ devaṃ muniyoṣitaḥ \|*  
*sa tu bhikṣākapālaṃ taṃ prasārya bahu sādaram \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. The wives of those Brahma followers attracted towards him, were surprised and with a curiosity to see him more closely they said to each other- "Come with us. We should see this beggar." They collected the fruits and roots, went to the beggar and said- "receive alms." He also stretched the alms pot (kapala) in honour before them.

## \|\| 43.60 \|\|

*dehi dehi śivaṃ vo 'stu bhavatībhyastapovane \|*  
*hasamānastu devosastatra devyā nirīkṣitaḥ \|*  
*tasmai dattvaiva tāṃ bhikṣāṃ papracchustaṃ smarāturāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Parvati was seeing lord Sankara saying О native of this place of penance! give alms. May all you see welfare. He was laughing with words. Some of the ladies asked him as they were incited for courtship.

## \|\| 43.61 \|\|

*nārya ūcuḥ*  
*ko 'sau nāma vratavidhistvayā tāpasa sevyate \|*  
*yatra nagnena liṅgena vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*bhavān vai tāpaso hṛdyo hṛdyāḥ smo yadi manyase \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The ladies said- О ascetic! tell us the purpose for observing so hard penance at the youth and that too with a naked body. If you sanction, we can offer ourselves for courtship.

## \|\| 43.62 \|\|

*ityuktastāpasībhistu provāca hasitānanaḥ \|*  
*idamīdṛg vrataṃ kiñcinna rahasyaṃ prakāśyate \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Sankara laughed again and said- "The purpose of this penance cannot be told as it is mysterious enough."

## \|\| 43.63 \|\|

*śṛṇvanti bahavo yatra tatra vyākhyā na vidyate \|*  
*asya vratasya subhagā iti matvā gamiṣyatha \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О lucky woman! This mystery cannot be explained in the presence of several people. Take this thing as explanation and go on your way to home.

## \|\| 43.64 \|\|

*evamuktāstadā tena tāḥ pratyūcustadā munim \|*  
*rahasye hi gamiṣyāmo mune naḥ kaitukaṃ mahat \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. They replied immediately- О sage! As we are curious enough to know, we shall go at solitude with you.

## \|\| 43.65-66 \|\|

*ityuktvā tāstadā taṃ vai jagṛhuḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ \|*  
*kācit kaṇṭhe sakandarpā bāhubhyāmaparāstathā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*jānubhyāmaparā nāryaḥ keśeṣu lalitāparāḥ \|*  
*aparāstu kaṭīrandhre aparāḥ pādayorapi \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. With these words they all simultaneously gripped his body through arms, some were hung on to his neck, some others gripped him in arms, some gripped his pubic, some began pulling his hair, some wrapped with his loin and certain others caught his feet.

## \|\| 43.67-68 \|\|

*kṣobhaṃ vilokya munaya āśrameṣu svayoṣitām \|*  
*hanyatāmiti saṃbhāṣya kāṣṭhapāṣāṇapāṇayaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*pātayanti sma devasya liṅgamuddhṛtya bhīṣaṇam \|*  
*pātite tu tato liṅge gato 'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. When the sages saw and smelt commotion, they rushed there with stones and logs, made hard blows on his penis and it fell down on the ground and with the falling of linga (penis) god vanished.

## \|\| 43.69-72 \|\|

*devyā sa bhagavān rudraḥ kailāsaṃ nagamāśritaḥ \|*  
*patite devadevasya liṅge naṣṭe carācare \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kṣobho babhūva sumahānṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām \|*  
*evaṃ deve tadā tatra vartati vyākulīkṛte \|\| 70 \|\|*

*uvācaiko munivarastatra buddhimatāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*na vayaṃ vidmaḥ sadbhāvaṃ tāpasasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*viriñciṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmaḥ sa hi jñāsyati ceṣṭitam \|*  
*evamuktāḥ sarva eva ṛṣayo lañjitā bhṛśam \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. God Sankara then returned to Kailasa with goddess Uma then. The entire movable and immovable properties of this nature began to meet destruction on account of the fall of the linga. The innocent hermits were aggrieved at seeing this. One of worst hermits said- "Me do not know the existence of that ascetic. We should go before Brahma to come to a clear position. He only can tell the mystery of this event." All hermits were ashamed to hear this.

## \|\| 43.73 \|\|

*brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ jagmur devaiḥ saha niṣevitam \|*  
*praṇipatyātha deveśaṃ lañjayādhomukhāḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. They reached the abode of Brahma duly filled with gods, saluted him and stood hesitating before him.

## \|\| 43.74-79 \|\|

*atha tān duḥkhitān dṛṣṭvā brahma vacanamabravīt \|*  
*aho mugdhā yadā yūyaṃ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtāḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*na dharmasya kriyā kācijjñāyate mūḍhabuddhayaḥ \|*  
*śruyatāṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ tāpasāḥ krūraceṣṭitaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*viditvā yad budhaḥ kṣipraṃ dharmasya phalamāpnuyāt \|*  
*yo 'sāvātmani dehe 'smin vibhurnityovyavasthitaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*so 'nādiḥ sa mahāsthāṇuḥ pṛthaktve parisūcitaḥ \|*  
*maṇiryathopadhānena dhatte varṇojjvalo 'pi vai \|\| 77 \|\|*

*tanmayo bhavate tadvadātmāpi manasā kṛtaḥ \|*  
*manaso bhedamāśritya karmabhiścopacīyate \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tataḥ karmavaśād bhuṅkte saṃbhogān svarganārakān \|*  
*tanmanaḥ śodhayed dhīmān jñānayogādyupakramaiḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

74-79. Brahma consoled them by saying- "Oh! you all are stupid because your hearts filled with impurity of anger. О idiots! you don’t know the procedure of religion. О cruel ascetics! listen to the mystery of religion that pours immediately with the fruits. The immortal sovereign in our body is unborn and Mahasthanu. It appears more different than the body. As the gem of white colour gets the colour of the metal in which it is studded, the soul too joins with the mind, resorts to the discrimination of mind and exhibited through deed/acts. Then he endures the vicissitudes of life according to his activeness. The wise man should do purification of mind by the applications of knowledge and yoga etc. measures.

## \|\| 43.80-82 \|\|

*tasmin śuddhe hyantarātmā svayameva nirākulaḥ \|*  
*na śarīrasya saṃkleśairapi nirdahanātmakaiḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*śuddhimāpnoti puruṣaḥ saṃśuddhaṃ yasya no manaḥ \|*  
*kriyā hi niyamārthāya pātakebhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*yasmādatyāvilaṃ dehaṃ na śīghraṃ śuddhyate kila \|*  
*tena lokeṣu mārgo 'yaṃ satpathasya pravartitaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

80-82. On being that mind purified the inner soul automatically becomes Nirakula (free from anxiety). The man not purified in mind never becomes pure from the pains exploiting the body. The rituals have been provided for avoiding the evils. The impure soul doesn't become pure shortly. Hence, this true way of loka has been enforced.

## \|\| 43.83 \|\|

*varṇāśramavibhāgo 'yaṃ lokādhyakṣeṇa kenacit \|*  
*nirmito mohamāhātmyaṃ cihnaṃ cottamabhāginām \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Any chairperson (promoter) of loka (world) has made this provision of classification in Varnasrama as a symbol of magnificence of affliction.

## \|\| 43.84 \|\|

*bhavantaḥ krodhakāmābhyāmabhibhūtāśrame sthitāḥ \|*  
*jñānināmāśramo veśma anāśramamayoginām \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. You are filled with anger and sex in spite of living in asrama. The home is like an asrama for scholars and it is not an asrama for the stupid.

## \|\| 43.85 \|\|

*kva ca nyastasamastecchā kva ca nārīmayo bhramaḥ \|*  
*kva krodhamīdṛśaṃ ghoraṃ yenātmānaṃ na jāyatha \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. This illusion of yours in feminine matter ipso facto shows that you are deeply immersed in the well of temptation while a thorough detachment is necessary. Your anger has made you blind to identity with your soul.

## \|\| 43.86 \|\|

*yatkrodhano yajati yad dadāti yad vā tapastapatila yajjuhoti \|*  
*na tasya prāpnoti phalaṃ hi loke moghaṃ phalaṃ tasya hi krodhanasya \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. The yajna arranged, the donation made or the penance or havana whatever is made gives no fruit to him. All fruits go for waste when the man is of loose temperament.

## Chapter 44. Eulogy of Siva by Gods

## \|\| 44.1 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca \|*  
*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te \|*  
*punareva ca papracchurjagataḥ śreyakāraṇam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sanatkumara said- All those hermits asked for the measure for the welfare of the world when they heard the statement of Brahma.

## \|\| 44.2 \|\|

*brahmovāca\|*  
*gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ trilocanam \|*  
*prasādād devadevasya bhaviṣyatha yathā purā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Brahma said- let us go to the shelter of Sulapani Trilocana. All of you will become again as before by the grace of that god.

## \|\| 44.3 \|\|

*ityuktā brahmaṇā sārddha kailāsaṃ girimuttamam \|*  
*dadṛśuste samāsīnamumayā sahitaṃ haram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Those people went to the best mountain of Kailasa in the company of Brahma. They saw there Sankara seated with Uma.

## \|\| 44.4 \|\|

*tataḥ stotuṃ samārabdho brahma lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*devādhidevaṃ varadaṃ trailokyasya prabhuṃ śivam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Lokapitamaha Brahma had then started worshipping god Sankara, the master of three- worlds.

## \|\| 44.5 \|\|

*brahmovāca\|*  
*anantāya namastubhyaṃ varadāya pinākine \|*  
*mahādevāya devāya sthaṇave paramātmane \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma said- I salute Vardata, Pinaka holder, Mahadeva, Sthanu form and unending god.

## \|\| 44.6 \|\|

*namo 'stu bhuvaneśāya tubhyaṃ tāraka sarvadā \|*  
*jñānānaṃ dāyako devastvamekaḥ puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Bhuvanesvara! You ferry this life-boat across the river of this universe. I salute you. You are only Purusottama and knowledge providing god.

## \|\| 44.7 \|\|

*namaste padmagarbhāya padmeśāya namo namaḥ \|*  
*ghoraśāntisvarūpāya caṇḍakrodha namo 'stu te \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Salute to Padmagarbha and Padmesa frequently. О Candakrodha! You are the treasure of peace. I salute you.

## \|\| 44.8 \|\|

*namaste deva viśveśa namaste suranāyaka \|*  
*śūlapāṇe namaste 'stu namaste viśvabhāvana \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О god of the universe! salute to you. О head of gods! salute to you. О Sulapani! salute to you. О Visvabhavana! salute to you.

## \|\| 44.9 \|\|

*evaṃ stuto mahādevo brahmaṇā ṛṣibhistadā \|*  
*uvāca mā bhairvrajata liṅgaṃ vo bhavitā punaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. God Mahadeva on this prayer assured- "Don't be afraid. You should now move. The linga will again be as before."

## \|\| 44.10 \|\|

*kriyatāṃ madvayaḥ śīghraṃ yena me prītiruttamā \|*  
*bhaviṣyati pratiṣṭhāyāṃ liṅgasyātra na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Follow my words immediately. I will undoubtedly feel pleasure of establishing the linga.

## \|\| 44.11 \|\|

*ye liṅgaṃ pūjayiṣyanti māmakaṃ bhaktimāśritāḥ \|*  
*na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kicid bhaviṣyati kadācana \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Nothing shall be rare to the devotees to my linga anytime.

## \|\| 44.12 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ kṛtānāmapi jānatā \|*  
*śuddhyate liṅgapūjāyāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. All evils even if deliberately committed are purified by worshipping the linga. One should not doubt about it.

## \|\| 44.13 \|\|

*yuṣmābhiḥ pātitaṃ liṅgaṃ sārayitvā mahātsaraḥ \|*  
*sāṃnihatyaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ tasmiñśīghraṃ pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Pick up the linga cut-off by you all and establish immediately in the holy place popular with the name of Sannihatya.

## \|\| 44.14 \|\|

*yathābhilaṣitaṃ kāmaṃ tataḥ prapsyatha brāhmaṇāḥ \|*  
*sthāṇurnāmnā hi lokeṣu pūjanīyo divaukasām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О Brahmins! you will see your wishes fulfilled by doing this. This linga popular as Sthanu shall be adorable to gods.

## \|\| 44.15-17 \|\|

*sthāṇvīsvare sthito yasmātstāṇvīśvarastataḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*ye smaranti sadā sthāṇuṃ te muktāḥ sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyanti śuddhadehā darśanānmokṣagāminaḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktā devena ṛṣayo brahmaṇā saha \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tasmād dāruvanālliṅgaṃ netuṃ samupacakramuḥ \|*  
*na taṃ cālayituṃ śaktāste devā ṛṣibhiḥ saha \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. That linga due to being it at Sthanvisvara shall be called Sthanavisvara. The people always remembering Sthanu shall be absolved from their evils attached and the sight at Sthanvisvara with a clean heart will enable them to attain emancipation. All hermits including Brahma then began to state a plan to carry away that linga from Daruvana. But the gods including hermits found them unable to carry the same.

## \|\| 44.18 \|\|

*śrameṇa mahatā yuktā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ śramābhitaptānāmidaṃ brahmābravīd vacaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. They sheltered to Brahma when they sweated in their efforts. Brahma inspired them when he saw them exhausted.

## \|\| 44.19 \|\|

*kiṃ vā śrameṇa mahatā na yūyaṃ vahanakṣamāḥ \|*  
*svecchayā pātitaṃ liṅgaṃ devadevena śūlinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. What purpose is of hard labour? You all cannot pick it up because Mahadeva deliberately has dropped it down.

## \|\| 44.20 \|\|

*tasmāt tameva śaraṇaṃ yāsyāmaḥ sahitāḥ surāḥ \|*  
*prasannaśca mahādevaḥ svayameva nayiṣyati \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Hence, О gods! Let us go to his shelter together. Mahadeva himself will pick up his linga with his pleasure.

## \|\| 44.21 \|\|

*ityevamuktā ṛṣayo devāśca brahmaṇā saha \|*  
*kailāsaṃ girimāsedū rudradarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. All hermits and gods, therefore, reached Kailasa mountain with the intention to see lord Sankara. Brahma also accompanied them.

## \|\| 44.22 \|\|

*na ca paśyanti taṃ devaṃ tataścintāsamanvitāḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇamūcurmunayaḥ kva sa devo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. They didn't see Sankara there. The hermits asked Brahma in a state of worry- "Where is that god Mahesvara?"

## \|\| 44.23 \|\|

*tato brahma ciraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*hastirupeṇa tiṣṭhantaṃ munibhirmānasaiḥ stutam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Brahma then peeped deeply at the master and saw that Mahesvara worshipped and prayed by hermits is in the form of an elephant.

## \|\| 44.24 \|\|

*atha te ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāśca brahmaṇā saha \|*  
*gatā mahatsaraḥ puṇyaṃ yatra devaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. All hermits and gods then reached that sacred reservoir with Brahma where Sankara was himself present.

## \|\| 44.25-26 \|\|

*na ca paśyanti taṃ devamanviṣyantastatastataḥ \|*  
*tataścintānvitā devā brahmaṇā sahitā sthitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pasyanti devīṃ suprītāṃ kamaṇḍaluvibhūṣitām \|*  
*prīyamāṇā tadā devī idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. They tried their best to see god Sankara but could not succeed. Those people worried with Brahma saw a goddess with Kamandala (water-pot) in her hands. The goddess said with grace.

## \|\| 44.27-28 \|\|

*śrameṇa mahatā yuktā anviṣyanto maheśvaram \|*  
*pīyatāmamṛtaṃ devāstato jñāsyatha śaṅkaram \|*  
*etacchratvā tu vacanaṃ bhavānyā samudāhṛtam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sukhopaviṣṭāste devāḥ papustadamṛtaṃ śuci \|*  
*anantaraṃ sukhāsīnāḥ papracchuḥ parameśvarīm \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. All of you are exhausted now in search of Mahesvara. О gods! sip the nectar here. Then only you could see Sankara. The gods sipped that sacred nectar by sitting in comfortable posture as suggested by that goddess (Bharani). Those people then asked that Paramesvari (goddess).

## \|\| 44.29 \|\|

*kva sa deva ihāyāto hastirūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*darśitaśca tadā devyā saromadhye vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The god in elephant form had come here but where is he now? The goddess indicated the middle of the reservoir where Sankara was seated.

## \|\| 44.30 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā devaṃ harṣayuktāḥ sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā idaṃ vacanamabruvan \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. All gods led by Brahma saw happily the god and said-

## \|\| 44.31 \|\|

*tvayā tyaktaṃ mahādeva liṅgaṃ trailokyavanditam \|*  
*tasya cānayane nānyaḥ samarthaḥ syānmaheśvara \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О Mahadeva! the linga once abandoned by you is not easy to bring here. Our effort have failed.

## \|\| 44.32 \|\|

*ityevamukto bhagavān devo brahmādibhirharaḥ \|*  
*jagāma ṛṣibhiḥ sārddha devadāruvanāśramam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. God Mahadeva went to the asrama located in Daruvana in the company of Brahma etc. gods.

## \|\| 44.33 \|\|

*tatra gatvā mahādevo hastirūpadharo haraḥ \|*  
*kareṇa jagrāha tato līlayā parameśvaraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The elephant form god Mahadeva went there and lifted up that linga playfully in his trunk.

## \|\| 44.34 \|\|

*tamādāya mahādevaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ \|*  
*niveśayāmāsa tadā saraḥpārśve tu paścime \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Mahadeva so prayed by hermits established it at the west side of that reservoir.

## \|\| 44.35 \|\|

*tato devāḥ sarva eva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ saphalaṃ daṣṭvā stavaṃ cakrurmaheśvare \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. All gods and the austere hermits then so became successful to pick up the linga from there. Happily they began to pray to Mahadeva. Salute to Parmatman! Anantayoni, Lokasaksina, Parmestina! Bhagavana! omniscient, first god of territory, Paravarajna, Jnanajneya, Sarvesvara, Mahaviranci, Mahavibhuti, Mahaksetrajna, Mahapurusa, Sarvabhutavasa, Manonivasa, Adideva, Mahadeva, Sadasiva, Isana, Durvijneya, Duraradhya, Mahabhutesvara, Paramesvara, Mahayogesvara, Tryambaka, Mahayogin, Parambrahman, Paramajyoti, Brahmavid, Uttama, Omkara, Vasatkara, Svahakara, Svadhakara, Paramakarana, Sarvagata, Sarvadarsin, Sarvasakti, Sarvadeva, Aja, Sahastrarci, Prsarci, Sudhaman, Haradhama, Anantadhama, Samvarta, Sanakarsana, Vadavanala, Agnisomatmaka, Pavitra, Mahapavitra, Mahamegha, Mahamayadhara, Mahakama, Kamahan, Hamsa, Paramahamsa, Maharajika, Mahesvara, Mahakamuka, Mahahamsa, Bhavaksayakara, Sura-siddharcita, Hiranyavaha, Hiranyaretah, Hiranyanabha, Hiranyagrakesa, Munjakesin, Sarvalokavaraprada, Sarvanugrahakara, Kamalesaya, Kusesaya, Hrdayesaya, Jnanodadhi, Sambho, Vibho, Mahayajna, Mahayajnika, Sarvayajnamaya, Sarvayajna- hydaya, Sarvayajnasanstuta, Nirasraya, Samudresaya, Atrisambhava, Bhaktanukampi, Abhagnayoga, Yogadhara, the god glittering face by the great gem of Vasuki, Haritanayana, Trilocana, Jatadhara, Nilakantha, Candrardhadhara, Umasarirardhadhara! Gajacarmadhara, О great god of the destruction. О gracious god to devotees, be merciful to us.

## \|\| 44.36 \|\|

*namaste paramātman anantayone lokasākṣin parameṣṭhin bhagavan mahāviriñca mahāvibhūte mahākṣetrajña mahāpuruṣa sarvabhūtāvāsa manonivāsa ādideva mahādeva sadāśiva (5) īśāna durvijñeya durārādhya mahābhūteścara parameśvara mahāyogeśvara tryambaka mahāyogin parabrahman paramajyotiḥ brahmaviduttama oṅkāra vaṣaṭkāra svāhākāra svadhākāra paramakāraṇa sarvagata sarvadarśin sarvaśakte sarvadeva aja (10) sahasrārciḥ pṛṣārciḥ sudhāman haradhāma anantadhāma saṃvarta saṃkarṣaṇa vaḍavānala agnīṣomātmaka pavitra mahāpavitra mahāmegha mahāmāyādhara mahākāma kāmahan haṃsa paramahaṃsa mahārājika maheśvara mahākāmuka mahāhaṃsa bhavakṣayakara surasiddhārcita (15) hiraṇyavāha hiraṇyaretaḥ hiraṇyanābha hiraṇyāgrakeśa*  
*muñjakeśin sarvalokavaraprada sarvānugrahakara kamaleśaya kuśeśaya hṛdayeśaya jñānodadhe śaṃbho vibho mahāyajña mahāyājñi ka sarvayajñamaya sarvaya5hṛdaya sarvayajñasaṃstuta nirāśraya (20) samudreśaya atrisaṃbhava bhaktānukampin abhagnayoga yogadhara vāsukimahāmaṇi- vidyotitavigraha haritanayana trilocana jaṭādhara nīlakaṇṭha candrārdhadhara umāśarīrārdhahara gajacarmadhara dustarasaṃsāramahāsaṃhārakara(25) prasīda bhaktajanavatsala evaṃ stuto devagaṇaiḥ subhaktyā sabrahāmukhyaiśca pitāmahena \|*  
*tyaktvā tadā hastirūpaṃ mahātmā liṅge tadā saṃnidhānaṃ cakāra \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thus, god Sankara abandoned the elephant form and inserted him into the linga when so prayed to by Brahma in the company of all gods and hermits.

## Chapter 45. Description of Sthanu linga

## \|\| 45.1 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca*  
*athovāca mahādevo devān brahmapurogamān \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva praityakṣaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sanatkumara said- God Mahadeva told about the best magnificence of holy place to Brahma etc. gods in the presence of hermits.

## \|\| 45.2 \|\|

*etat sāṃnihitaṃ proktaṃ saraḥ puṇyatamaṃ mahat \|*  
*mayopasevitaṃ yasmāt tasmānmuktipradāyakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. This reservoir has been considered supremely holy and called Sannihita. As it is enriched with my presence, it renders emancipation.

## \|\| 45.3 \|\|

*iha ye puruṣāḥ kecid brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ \|*  
*liṅgasya darśanādeva paśyanti paramaṃ padam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The people of Brahmana, Ksatriya and Vaisya varna, receive the supreme position by seeing the linga.

## \|\| 45.4 \|\|

*ahanyahani tīrthāni āsamudrasarāṃsi ca \|*  
*sthāṇutīrthaṃ sameṣyanti madhyaṃ prāpte divākare \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. All holy places from the oceans to the reservoir come and mix with Sthanu-tirtha at noon daily.

## \|\| 45.5 \|\|

*stotreṇānena ca naro yo māṃ stoṣyati bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*tasyāhaṃ sulabho nityaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. I will appear and grace the person who, will pray to me with these hymns. I undertake it.

## \|\| 45.6 \|\|

*ityuktvā bhagavān rudro hyantardhānaṃ gataḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarve svāni sthānāni bhehire \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. With these words, god Rudra vanished. All gods and hermits then returned to their respective places.

## \|\| 45.7 \|\|

*tato nirantaraṃ svargaṃ mānuṣairmiśritaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*sthāṇuliṅgasya māhātmya darśanātsvargamāpnuyāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then the entire heaven was filled with people. It is the magnificence of Sthanu-linga that a man gets to heaven by merely seeing it.

## \|\| 45.8 \|\|

*tato devāḥ sarva eva brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*tānuvāca tadā brahmā kimarthamiha cāgatāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then all gods sheltered themselves under god Brahma. Brahma then asked- "For what purpose, have all of you come here?"

## \|\| 45.9 \|\|

*tato devāḥ sarva eva idaṃ vacanamabruvan \|*  
*mānuṣebhyo bhayaṃ tīvraṃ rakṣāsmākaṃ pitāmaha \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then all gods said- О Pitamaha! I am extremely afraid of people. Please, defend us all.

## \|\| 45.10 \|\|

*tānuvāca tadā brahmā surāṃstridaśanāyakaḥ \|*  
*pāṃśunā pūryatāṃ śīghraṃ saraḥ śakre hitaṃ kuru \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then god Brahma said to those gods- "O Indra! fill the reservoir immediately with the dust and fulfil your desire."

## \|\| 45.11 \|\|

*tato vavarṣa bhagavān pāṃśunā pākaśāsanaḥ \|*  
*saptāhaṃ pūrayāmāsa saro devaistadā vṛtaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. God Indra, the killer of Pakaraksasa surrounded by gods, rained dust and filled the reservoir with it.

## \|\| 45.12 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṃśuvarṣaṃ ca devadevo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*kareṇa dhārayāmāsa liṅgaṃ tīrthavaṭaṃ tadā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Mahesvara, the greatest god held linga and tirtha Vata, in his hand when the dust was being filled in it.

## \|\| 45.13 \|\|

*tasmāt puṇyatamaṃ tīrthamādyaṃ yatrodakaṃ sthitam \|*  
*tasmin snātaḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus, the reservoir filled with water earlier has become the holiest place. The man who takes a bath in it, is considered as if he has taken a bath in all holy places.

## \|\| 45.14 \|\|

*yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ vaṭaliṅgasya cāntare \|*  
*tasya prītāśca pitaro dāsyanti bhuvi durlabham \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The devotee doing sraddha in the middle of banyan and linga thus appeases his Pitrs and gets rare things on the earth under their grace.

## \|\| 45.15 \|\|

*pūritaṃ ta caco dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te \|*  
*pāṃśunā sarvagātrāṇi spṛśanti śraddhayā yutāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. All those hermits began to smear dust on their body when they saw the reservoir filled with dust.

## \|\| 45.16 \|\|

*te 'pi nirdhūtapāpāste pāṃśunā munayo gatāḥ \|*  
*pūjyamānāḥ suragaṇaiḥ prayātā brahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Those sages also went to Brahmaloka, praised by gods and became free from evils.

## \|\| 45.17 \|\|

*ye tu siddhā mahātmānaste liṅgaṃ pūjayanti ca \|*  
*vrajanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ punarāvṛttidurlabhām \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The ascetics used to worship that linga began to receive supreme accomplishments making them free from the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 45.18 \|\|

*evaṃ jñātvā tadā brahmā liṅgaṃ śailamayaṃ tadā \|*  
*ādyaliṅgaṃ tadā sthāpya tasyopari dadhāra tat \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Brahma pressed linga a little bit more and kept the linga made of stone in it.

## \|\| 45.19 \|\|

*tataḥ kālena mahatā tejasā tasya rañjitam \|*  
*tasyāpi sparśanāt siddhaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. With the passage of some time the linga made of boulder also became powerful as it had got the influence of the first linga put at its base. Its touch began to lead man for emancipation.

## \|\| 45.20 \|\|

*tato devaiḥ punarbrahmā vijñapto dvijasattama \|*  
*ete yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ liṅgasya darśanānnarāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О great Dvija! The gods then informed Brahma again that the people are receiving greater achievements merely by touching the linga made of stone.

## \|\| 45.21 \|\|

*tacchrutvā bhagavān brahmā devānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|*  
*uparyupari liṅgāni sapta tatra cakāra ha \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. God Brahma took the welfare of gods in mind and established seven lingas one on the other.

## \|\| 45.22 \|\|

*tato ye miktikāmāśca siddhāḥ śamaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*sevya pāṃśuṃ prayatnena prayātāḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The siddhaganas detached by worldly enjoyments and desirous of emancipation then started putting the dust on their head and got emancipation.

## \|\| 45.23 \|\|

*pāṃśavo 'pi kurukṣetre vāyunā samudīritāḥ \|*  
*mahāduṣkṛtakarmāṇaṃ prayānti paramaṃ padam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The dust flown by wind in Kuruksetra too renders even the evil-doers with supreme position.

## \|\| 45.24 \|\|

*ajñānājjñānato vāpi striyo vā puruṣasya vā \|*  
*naśyate duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sthāṇutīrthaprabhāvataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The evils committed either innocently or deliberately are destroyed by the influence of Sthanu-tirtha.

## \|\| 45.25 \|\|

*liṅgasya darśanānmuktiḥ sparśanācca vaṭasya ca \|*  
*tatsaṃnidhau jale snātvā prāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. A sight of the linga and a touch ensures emancipation. The man receives deserved fruit when he takes a bath in the water near to it.

## \|\| 45.26 \|\|

*pitṛṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ yastu jale tasmin kariṣyati \|*  
*bindo bindau tu toyasya anantaphalabhāgbhavet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The person doing tarpana of his ancestors gets unending fruits as countless quantity of drops conglomerated with the river water.

## \|\| 45.27-28 \|\|

*yastu kṛṣṇatilaiḥ sārddha liṅgasya paścime sthitaḥ \|*  
*tarpayecchraddhayā yuktaḥ sa prīṇāti yugatrayam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yāvanmanvantaraṃ proktaṃ yāvalliṅgasya saṃsthitiḥ \|*  
*tāpatprītāśca pitaraḥ pibanti jalamuttamam \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. At the west from linga, tarpana with black sesamum is provided. The person who follows this procedure satiates his Pifrs as long as three ages. Up to the period of Manvanatara and the linga is existed, the Pitragana derive clear water happily.

## \|\| 45.29 \|\|

*kṛte yuge sānnihatyaṃ tretāyāṃ vāyusaṃjñitam \|*  
*kalidvāparayormadhye kūpaṃ rudrahradaṃ smṛtam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The reservoir called Sainnihatya in Krtayuga is supreme to take a bath. The reservoir called Vayu is worth worship in Treta. The well called Rudrahrada is the best to bathe in Kali and Dvapara Yugas.

## \|\| 45.30 \|\|

*caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ narottamaḥ \|*  
*snātvā rudrahrade tīrthe paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A man of purity of heart receives supreme position by taking a bath in Rudrahrada on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Caitra (March).

## \|\| 45.31 \|\|

*yastu vaṭe sthito rātriṃ dhyāyate parameśvaram \|*  
*sthāṇorvaṭaprasādena manasā cintitaṃ phalam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The man who concentrate on god by sitting under a banyan tree, receives the desired fruit by the grace of Sthanu vata.

## Chapter 46. Description of various lingas

## \|\| 46.1 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca*  
*sthāṇorvaṭasyottarataḥ sukratīrthaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*sthāṇorvaṭasya pūrveṇa somatīrthaṃ dvijottama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sanatkumara said- О great Dvija! Sukra- tirtha exists at north from Sthanuvata and Soma-tirtha exists at the east.

## \|\| 46.2 \|\|

*sthāṇorvaṭaṃ dakṣiṇato dakṣatīrthamudāhṛtam \|*  
*sthāṇorvaṭāt paścimataḥ skandatīrthaṃ pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Daksa-tirtha at its south and Skanda-tirtha exists at its west. A mere vision of it ensures supreme position to a man.

## \|\| 46.3 \|\|

*etāni puṇyatīrtāni madhye sthāṇuriti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*tasya darśanamātreṇa prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Sthanu holy place is situated in the middle of these two holy places. A mere vision of it renders the man with emancipation.

## \|\| 46.4 \|\|

*aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yastvetāni parikramet \|*  
*pade pade yajñaphalaṃ sa prāpnoti na śaṃśayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The man who does Parikrama (round turn) on the eighth and fourteenth day of the fortnight (bright and dark both) receives the fruit equal to the yajna counted by steps so taken.

## \|\| 46.5 \|\|

*etāni munibhiḥ sādhyairādityairvasubhistadā \|*  
*marudbhirvahnibhiścaiva sevitāni prayatnataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The sages, sadhyas, adityas, vasus, marutas and fuel have made their dwelling in these holy places.

## \|\| 46.6 \|\|

*anye ye prāṇinaḥ kecit praviṣṭāḥ sthāṇumuttamam \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Other organisms also receive supreme position by their entrance only into this holiest holy place Sthanu.

## \|\| 46.7 \|\|

*asti tatsaṃnidhau liṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*umā ca liṅgarūpeṇa harapārśvaṃ na muñcati \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A linga of the god of gods Mahadeva has existed near it. Uma existed there in the form of linga does not abandon her collateral conduct with Sankara.

## \|\| 46.8-10 \|\|

*tasya darśanamātreṇa siddhiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*vaṭasya uttare pārśve takṣakeṇa mahātmanā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam \|*  
*vaṭasya pūrvadigbhāge viśvakarmakṛtaṃ mahat \|\| 9 \|\|*

*liṅgaṃ pratyaṅmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhimāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*tatraiva liṅgarūpeṇa sthitā devī sarasvatī \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The man by a mere sight of them attains accomplishments. The great soul Taksaka has installed a Mahalinga at the north collateral contact of the banyan tree. A sight of the linga facing west endows supreme position to a devotee.

## \|\| 46.11-13 \|\|

*praṇamya tāṃ prayatnena buddhiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati \|*  
*vaṭapārśve sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmaṇā tat pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā vaṭeśvaraṃ devaṃ prayāti paramaṃ padam \|*  
*tataḥ sthāṇuvaṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pradikṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā \|*  
*sthāṇoḥ paścimadigbāge nakulīśo gaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Goddess Sarasvati has existed there in the form of a linga. The man gets wisdom and knowledge who salutes that place with obeisance. Lord Brahma had installed the linga at the collateral of the banyan tree. A mere sight of Sthanuvata and its pradaksina is considered as if the man has done pradaksina of the entire universe. A gana Nakulisa has existed at the west to this linga.

## \|\| 46.14 \|\|

*tamabhyarcya prayatnena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge tīrthaṃ rudrakaraṃ smṛtam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A man is absolved from all sins by doing worship of it. A holy place Rudrakara has existed at its south.

## \|\| 46.15-16 \|\|

*tasmin snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ \|*  
*tasya cottaradigbhāge rāvaṇena mahātmanā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ gokarṇaṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|*  
*āṣāḍhamāse yā kṛṣṇā bhaviṣyati caturdaśī \|*  
*tasyāṃ yor'cati gokarṇaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. The man taking a bath in it automatically is considered as if he has taken a bath in all holy places. A Mahalinga Gokarna has existed at its north. It has been installed by Ravana. The man who does worship of Gokarna on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Asadha (July) receives the fruits as I am now going to tell you all.

## \|\| 46.17 \|\|

*kāmato 'kāmato vāpi yat pāpaṃ tena saṃcitam \|*  
*tasmād vimucyate pāpāt pūjayitvā haraṃ śuciḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. He by virtue of homage to Hara is absolved from all the sins committed earlier innocently or deliberately.

## \|\| 46.18 \|\|

*kaumārabrahmacaryeṇa yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ \|*  
*tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ tasya aṣṭamyāṃ yor'cayecchivam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The man doing worship of god Siva on the eighth day of any fortnights (with bright or dark) receives the splendour had he received by observing Kaumara Brahmacarya.

## \|\| 46.19 \|\|

*yadīcchet paramaṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyaṃ dhanasaṃpadaḥ \|*  
*kumāreśvaramāhātmyāt siddhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. If the mere wishes were beautiful complexion, luck or wealth and property, the magnificence of Kumaresvara undoubtedly endows it with him.

## \|\| 46.20 \|\|

*tasya cottaradigbāge liṅgaṃ pūjya vibhīṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*ajaraścāmaraścaiva kalpayitvā babhūva ha \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Vibhisana got immortality and freedom from old age pains as he had established linga on the north side of it and duly worshipped it.

## \|\| 46.21 \|\|

*āṣāḍhasya tu māsasya śuklā yā cāṣṭamī bhavet \|*  
*tasyāṃ pūjya sopavāso hyamṛtatvamavāpnuyāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A man attains immortality if he observes fast on the eighth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Asadha (July) and worship.

## \|\| 46.22 \|\|

*khareṇa pūjitaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmin sthāne dvijottama \|*  
*taṃ pūjayitvā yatnena sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. O great Dvija! Here exists a linga which was worshipped by Kara. A worship here fulfils all desired things.

## \|\| 46.23 \|\|

*dūṣaṇastriśirāścaiva tatra pūjya maheśvaram \|*  
*yathābhilaṣitān kāmānāpatustau mudānvitau \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Dusana and Trisira worshipped Mahesvara there, became happy and their desires were fulfilled.

## \|\| 46.24 \|\|

*caitramāse site pakṣe yo narastatra pūjayet \|*  
*tasya tau varadau devau prayacchete 'bhivāñchitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The man who worships there in the bright fortnight of the month Caitra (March) receives desired fruits.

## \|\| 46.25 \|\|

*sthāṇorvaṭasya pūrvoṇa hastipādeśvaraḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpairanyajanmani saṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Hastipadesvara Siva has existed at the east of Sthanuvata. A vision of god Siva there absolves the man from all sins committed by him in his other births.

## \|\| 46.26 \|\|

*tasya dakṣiṇato liṅgaṃ hārītasya ṛṣeḥ sthitam \|*  
*yat praṇaṇya prayatnena siddhiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A linga established by Harlta hermit has existed at its south. A man achieves accomplishment (siddhi) by saluting this linga.

## \|\| 46.27 \|\|

*tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāpītasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*lihgaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. There exists another linga capable to absolve men from evils at its southern collateral contact. It was installed by the renowned hennit Harita.

## \|\| 46.28 \|\|

*kaṅgālarūpiṇā cāpi rudreṇa sumahātmanā \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ sarvapāpapraṇaśanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The great soul Rudra in the form of a skeleton has also established a Mahalinga capable to efface all evils.

## \|\| 46.29 \|\|

*bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam \|*  
*liṅgasya darśanāccaiva agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. That linga renders both enjoyments and emancipation. A man receives the fruits equal to the Agnistoma yajna by a mere sight of that linga.

## \|\| 46.30 \|\|

*tasya paścimadigbhāge liṅgaṃ siddhapratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*siddheśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A linga installed by siddha has existed at its west. It is famous as Siddhesvara and provides all accomplishments.

## \|\| 46.31 \|\|

*tasya dakṣiṇadigbāge mṛkaṇḍena mahātmanā \|*  
*tatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ darśanāt siddhidāyakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The great soul Mrkanda has installed a linga at its southern part. Its vision renders grand success.

## \|\| 46.32 \|\|

*tasya pūrve ca digbhāge ādityena mahātmanā \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgavaraṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The great soul Aditya had also installed a linga at its east. It is also powerful enough to efface the evils piled during one's preceding births.

## \|\| 46.33-34 \|\|

*citrāṅgadastu gandharvo rambhā cāpsarasāṃ varā \|*  
*parasparaṃ sānurāgau sthāṇudarśanakāṅkṣiṇau \|\| 33 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā sthāṇuṃ pūjayitvā sānurāgau parasparam \|*  
*ārādhya varadaṃ devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The gandharva Citrangada and the best nymph Rambha jointly with their mutual love wished to see Sthanu, visited here, worshipped and installed Mahesvara, the great giver here.

## \|\| 46.35 \|\|

*citrāṅgadeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā rambheśvaraṃ dvija \|*  
*subhago darśanīyaśca kule janma samāpnuyāt \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О Dvija! A man receives luck, beauty and meritorious sons doing upliftment of their clan when he sees the Citrangadesvara and Rambhesvara here.

## \|\| 46.36 \|\|

*tasya dabhiṇato liṅgaṃ vajriṇā sthāpitaṃ purā \|*  
*tasya prasādāt prāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ phalam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Indra had established a linga in the distant past at its south. A man gets the desired fruit by the grace of this linga.

## \|\| 46.37 \|\|

*parāśareṇa muninā tataivārādhya śaṅkaram \|*  
*prāptaṃ kavitvaṃ paramaṃ darśanācchaṅkarasya ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Similarly, Parasara worshipped Sankara and got poetic talents by seeing it.

## \|\| 46.38 \|\|

*vedavyāsena muninā ārādhya parameśvaram \|*  
*sarvajñatvaṃ brahmajñānaṃ prāptaṃ devaprasādataḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The hermit Vedavyasa had got omniscience and Brahmajnana, by virtue of worship of Paramesvara and his pleasure.

## \|\| 46.39 \|\|

*sthāṇoḥ paścimadigbhāge vāyunā jagadāyunā \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ darśanāt pāpanāśanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Vayu has also installed a linga at west to Sthanu. As Vayu is in the form of the lifespan, its vision effaces the evils of a man stuck.

## \|\| 46.40 \|\|

*tasyāpi dakṣiṇe bhāge liṅgaṃ himavateśvaram \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ darśanāt siddhikārakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A linga called Himavatesvara has also existed at its south. It gives grand success to a man by merely seeing it.

## \|\| 46.41 \|\|

*tasyāpi paścime bhāge kārtavīryeṇa sthāpitam \|*  
*liṅgaṃ pāpaharaṃ sadyo kārtanāt puṇyamāpnuyāt \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Kartavirya has also installed a linga at its west. It is effacing sins and immediate success is rendered when a man visits here and takes a bath.

## \|\| 46.42 \|\|

*tasyāpyuttaradigbhāgo supārśve sthāpitaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*ārādhya hanumāṃścāpa siddhiṃ devaprasādataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Hanuman had worshipped the linga installed in its collateral at north and achieved grand success in his mission by the grace of god.

## \|\| 46.43 \|\|

*tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*ārādhya varadaṃ devaṃ cakraṃ labdhaṃ sudarśanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. At its eastern direction, lord Visnu had worshipped the god and got Sudarsana-cakra from him.

## \|\| 46.44 \|\|

*tasyāpi pūrvādighbhāge mitreṇa varuṇena ca \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitau liṅgavarau sarvakāmapradāyakau \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Mitra and Varuna had installed two lingas at its east direction. These fulfil all desires of devotees.

## \|\| 46.45 \|\|

*etāni munibhiḥ sādhyairādityairvasubhistathā \|*  
*sevitāni prayatnena sarvapāpaharāṇi vai \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. All these lingas are duly surrounded by sages, Sadhyas, Adityas and Vasus and these efface all sins.

## \|\| 46.46-47 \|\|

*kharṇaliṅgasya paścāttu ṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitāni liṅgāni yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tathā hyuttaratastasya yāvadoghavatī nadī \|*  
*sahasramekaṃ liṅgānāṃ devapaścimataḥ sthitam \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Uncountable lingas have been installed at the back side of the linga made of gold by the hermits having knowledge in depth (tattvadarsi). Similarly, one thousand lingas are installed at the rear to god up to the river Oghavati.

## \|\| 46.48 \|\|

*tasyāpi pūrvadigbhāge bālakhilyairmahātmabhiḥ \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitā rudrakoṭiryāvatsaṃnihitaṃ saraḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The great soul Balakhilyas had installed one crore Rudra at the east direction up to Sannhita reservoir.

## \|\| 46.49 \|\|

*dakṣiṇena tu devasya gandharvairyakṣakinnaraiḥ \|*  
*pratiṣṭhitāni liṅgāni yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The gandharvas, yaksas and kinnaras have installed numerous lingas at the south direction from here.

## \|\| 46.50 \|\|

*tisraḥ koṭyor'dhakoṭī ca liṅgānāṃ vāyurabravīt \|*  
*asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrāḥ sthāṇumāśritāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Vayu has described three and a half crore lingas. Numerous thousand lingas of Rudra have existed in Sthanu-tirtha.

## \|\| 46.51 \|\|

*etajjñātvā śraddadhānaḥ sthāṇuliṅgaṃ samāśrayet \|*  
*yasya prasādāt prāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ phalam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Taking in notice the above points about Sthanu linga one should follow the procedure systematically provided for worship and visit. A man doing this always receives the desired fruit.

## \|\| 46.52 \|\|

*akāmo vā sakāmo vā praviṣṭaḥ sthāṇumandiram \|*  
*vimuktaḥ pātakairghoraiḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The man getting entrance into Sthanu temple either with or without a desire receives supreme position after liberty from the bondage of gross sins.

## \|\| 46.53-54 \|\|

*caitre māse trayodaśyāṃ divyanakṣatrayogataḥ \|*  
*śukrārkacandrasaṃyoge dine puṇyatame śubhe \|\| 53 \|\|*

*pratiṣṭhitaṃ sthāṇuliṅgaṃ brahmaṇā lokadhāriṇā \|*  
*ṛṣibhirdevasaṃghaiśca pūjitaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The lokapitamaha Brahma had installed Sthanu linga on the thirteenth day of Caitra (March) month. When divine constellations were taking sextile and the days so falling are Friday, Sunday and Monday on a supreme selected best day. The hermits and gods worship it always or for everlasting period.

## \|\| 46.55 \|\|

*tasmin kāle nirāhārā mānavāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti śivaṃ ye vai te yānti paramaṃ padam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The people observing fast and worshipping god Siva with reverence definitely obtain supreme position.

## \|\| 46.56 \|\|

*tadārūḍhamidaṃ jñātvā ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*pradakṣiṇīkṛtā taistu saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Under an assumption that siva himself is seated in the form of a linga, a parikrama (round turn) so made is considered as if the devotee has done parikrama of the entire earth.

## Chapter 47. The legend of the king Vena

## \|\| 47.1 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca*  
*sthāṇutīrthaprabhāvaṃ tu śrotumicchāmyahaṃ mune \|*  
*kena siddhiratha prāptā sarvapāpabhayāpahā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Markandeya said- О sage! I want to listen to the magnificence of Sthanu-tirtha who had obtained here an accompaniment effacing the fear of all evils.

## \|\| 47.2 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca\|*  
*śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa sthāṇumāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mukto bhavati mānavaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sanatkumara said- Listen to the magnificence of Sthanu. The people are liberated fully from the cruel clutches of evils.

## \|\| 47.3 \|\|

*ekārṇave jagatyasmin naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame \|*  
*viṣṇornābhisamudbhūtaṃ padmamavyaktajanmanaḥ \|*  
*tasmin brahma samudbhūtaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A lotus was originated from the navel of god Visnu when this movable and immovable world was destroyed and immersed in the great ocean.

## \|\| 47.4 \|\|

*tasmānmarīcirabhavanmarīceḥ kaśyapaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*kaśyapādabhavad bhāsvāṃstamānmanurajāyata \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Marici was bom from Lorn. Kasyapa was the son of Marici. Surya was originated from Kasyapa and Manu originated from Surya.

## \|\| 47.5 \|\|

*manostu kṣuvataḥ putra utpanno mukhasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*pṛthivyāṃ caturantāyāṃ rājāsīd dharmarakṣitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. A son was bom from the sneezing of Manu. He became a king defending religion on this whole earth.

## \|\| 47.6 \|\|

*tasya patnī babhūvātha bhayā nāma bhayāvahā \|*  
*mṛtyoḥ sakāśādutpannā kālasya duhitā tadā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Bhaya was his fierce wife. She was bom from Mrtyu, the daughter of Kala.

## \|\| 47.7 \|\|

*tasyāṃ samabhavad veno durātmā vedanindakaḥ \|*  
*sa dṛṣṭvā putravadanaṃ kruddho rājā vanaṃ yayau \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Vena, the mde condemning the Veda was bom from her. The king became angry on looking at the face of his son and went into the forest.

## \|\| 47.8 \|\|

*tatra kṛtvā tapo ghoraṃ dharmeṇāvṛtya rodasī \|*  
*prāptavān brahmasadanaṃ puranāvṛttidurvabham \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The king observed gross penance there, covered the middle part of the earth and ether with religion and departed to Brahmaloka from where nobody returns to the world consisting of the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 47.9-10 \|\|

*veno rājā samabhavat samaste kṣitimaṇḍale \|*  
*sa mātāmahadoṣeṇa tena kālātmajātmajaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ghoṣayāmasa nagare durātmā vedanindakaḥ \|*  
*na dātavyaṃ na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyaṃ kadācana \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Vena then became the king of the entire earth. On account of inspiration he got from the defects of his grandfather (maternal) that mde opponent to the Vedas declared that "people are strictly prohibited for arranging donation, yajna and havana." He was the son of Bhaya, the daughter of Kala.

## \|\| 47.11 \|\|

*ahameko 'tra vai vandyaḥ pūjyo 'haṃ bhavatāṃ sadā \|*  
*mayā hi pālitā yūyaṃ nivasadhvaṃ yathāsukham \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Only I alone am worth worship for you in this world; live happily under my defence and maintenance.

## \|\| 47.12-13 \|\|

*tanmatto 'nyo na devo 'sti yuṣmākaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam \|*  
*etacchratvā tu vacanamṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te \|\| 12 \|\|*

*parasparaṃ samāgamya rājānaṃ vākyamabravan \|*  
*śrutiḥ pramāṇaṃ dharmasya tato yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. There is no other god except me who could be worth worship by you all. All hermits together made a representation before the king and said- "The Vedas are the only authority for religion. The yajna gets fulfilment or perfection when the Vedas are duly perused and followed."

## \|\| 47.14 \|\|

*yajñairvinā no prīyante devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ \|*  
*aprītā na prayacchanti vṛṣṭiṃ sasyasya vṛddhaye \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The gods living in heaven do not please if yajnas are not performed and they do not rain for the proper growth of cereals.

## \|\| 47.15 \|\|

*tasmād yajñaiśca devaiśca dhāryate sacarācaram \|*  
*etacchrutvā krodhadṛṣṭirvenaḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The movable and immovable entire world is held by yajnas and gods. Vena became angry on this and declared frequently.

## \|\| 47.16-19 \|\|

*na yaṣṭavyaṃ na dātavyamityāha krodhamūrcchitaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te \|\| 16 \|\|*

*nijaghnurmantrapūtaiste kuśairvajrasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*tatastvarājake loke tamasā saṃvṛte tadā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dasyubhiḥ pīḍyamānāstān ṛṣīṃste śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ \|*  
*tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve mamanthustasya vai karam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*savyaṃ tasmāt samuttasthau puruṣo hrasvadarśanaḥ \|*  
*tamūcurṛṣayaḥ sarve niṣīdatu bhavāniti \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. With words- "yajna and donations are worthless to perform", he became blind with fury. All those hermits also lost their temper on such criticism to the Vedas and they killed him by shooting kusa made strong like thunderbolt by reciting hymns. As the state thereafter became without a king, a chaotic situation prevailed. Decoity and other crimes spurted up rapidly. The people aggrieved of the situation, once visited those great hermits. They churned the left hand of Vena and thus appeared a dwarf man. He said to the hermits- "Please, be seated."

## \|\| 47.20 \|\|

*tasmānniṣādā utpannā venakalmaṣasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve manmathurdakṣiṇaṃ karam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Nisada were originated representing the evils committed by Vena. All hermits then churned the right hand of that corpse.

## \|\| 47.21 \|\|

*mathyamāne kare tasmin utpannaḥ puruṣo 'paraḥ \|*  
*bṛhatsālapratīkāśo divyalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A man tallest like the Sala tree having divine characteristics was bom as a result of so much churning.

## \|\| 47.22-23 \|\|

*dhanurbāṇāṅkitakaraścaścakradhvasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tamutpannaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*abhyaṣiñcan pṛthivyāṃ taṃ rājānaṃ bhūmipālakam \|*  
*tataḥ sa rañjayāmāsa dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ tadā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. All gods including Indra encoronated him as king to the earth. He then ruled properly on the earth. The marks of bow-arrows, discus and flag etc. were found on his body.

## \|\| 47.24 \|\|

*pitrāḥ'parañjitā tasya tena sā paripālitā \|*  
*tatra rājetiśabdo 'sya pṛthivyā rañjanādabhūt \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. His father had made the subject upset in varied ways while he ruled very generously and provided maintenance to him. As he ruled judiciously, he was called Raja.

## \|\| 47.25-26 \|\|

*sa rājyaṃ pāpya tebhyastu cintayāmāsa pārthivaḥ \|*  
*pitā mama adharmiṣṭho yajñavyucchittikārakaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kathaṃ tasya kriyā kāryā paralokasukhāvahā \|*  
*ityevaṃ cintayānasya nārado 'bhyājagāma ha \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Having rode on throne, he thought on the measures keeping the soul of his father satiated in heaven. He was known to the fact that on account of infringement on the Vedas and prohibitions on yajna as he exercised, his soul would not find pleasure in heaven. When he was just thinking on this topic, Narada appeared there.

## \|\| 47.27-28 \|\|

*tasmai sa cāsanaṃ dattvā praṇipatya ca pṛṣṭavān \|*  
*bhagavan sarvalokasya jānāsi tvaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 27 \|\|*

*pitā mama durācāro devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ \|*  
*svakarmarahito vipra paralokamavāptavān \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. He offered a seat, saluted and then asked him- О lord! You know all the good and bad of these worlds. О Brahmin! Do you know, my atheist father, critic of the Vedas and Brahmins and just reverse to as expected from a king, had gone to heavenly abode.

## \|\| 47.29 \|\|

*tato 'bravīnnāradastaṃ jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā \|*  
*mlecchamaghye samutpannaṃ kṣayakuṣṭhasamanvitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Narada looked at him thoughtfully and said- "He was bom in a community of Mleccha and suffering from ailments like leprosy and T.B.

## \|\| 47.30 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*cintayāmāsa dukhārtaḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ mayā bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The prediction as made by Narada, shocked Raja deep and he thought on the appropriate act to do for bringing back some comforts to him.

## \|\| 47.31 \|\|

*ityevaṃ cintayānasya matirjātā mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*putraḥ sa kathyate loke yaḥ pitṝṃstrāyate bhayāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The great soul arrived finally at an idea that the son is one who makes free his Pitrs from fear.

## \|\| 47.32 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃcintya sa tadā nāradaṃ pṛṣṭavān munim \|*  
*tāraṇaṃ matpitustasya mayā kāryaṃ kathaṃ mune \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Не then asked Narada- "О sage! Tell me the measure to bring some comforts for my father who is so suffering in his rebirth.

## \|\| 47.33 \|\|

*nārada uvāca*  
*gaccha tvaṃ tasya taṃ dehaṃ tīrtheṣu kuru nirmalam \|*  
*yatra sthāṇormahattīrthaṃ saraḥ saṃnihitaṃ prati \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Narada said- "go at Sahnihita (reservoir) tirtha of Sthanu and give him a physical bath there.

## \|\| 47.34 \|\|

*etacchratvā tu vacanaṃ nāradasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*sacive rājyamādhāya rājā sa tu jagāma ha \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Raja assigned the stately affairs to his minister and left the palace to exercise the measures suggested by Narada.

## \|\| 47.35 \|\|

*sa gatvā cottarāṃ bhūmiṃ mlecchamadhye dadarśa ha \|*  
*kuṣṭharogeṇa mahātā kṣayeṇa ca samanvitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. He saw his father suffering from leprosy and T.B. in the family of Mlecchas at north direction of his empire.

## \|\| 47.36 \|\|

*tataḥ śokena mahatā saṃtapto vākyamabravīt \|*  
*ha mlecchā naumi puruṣaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca nayāmyaham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. He was filled with agony and said- "O Mleccha! I salute all of you and carry this man to my home."

## \|\| 47.37-41 \|\|

*tatrāhamenaṃ nirujaṃ kariṣye yadi manyatha \|*  
*tatheti sarve te mlecchāḥ puruṣaṃ taṃ dayāparam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṅgā yathā jānāsi tatkuru \|*  
*tata ānīya puruṣān śivikāvāhanocitān \|\| 38 \|\|*

*dattvā śulkaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ sukhena nayata dvijam \|*  
*tataḥ śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rājño dayāvataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā śivikāṃ kṣipraṃ kurukṣetreṇa yānti te \|*  
*tatra nītvā sthāṇutīrthe avatārya ca te gatāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tataḥ sa rājā madhyāhne taṃ snāpayati vai tadā \|*  
*tato vāyurantarikṣe idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 41 \|\|*

37-41. I will cure the ailments under my care if so allowed by you all. All Mlecchas put their heads on his feet in honour to his generosity and replied- "Very well. Do as you like." He then called the palanquin bearers and ordered them- "Bring this Dvija carefully to my residence. They lifted-up the palanquin, brought him Sthanu-tirtha through the route of Kuruksetra, put the palanquin comfortably down and then returned to their home. They were given remuneration just double than usual by the Raja.

## \|\| 47.42-44 \|\|

*mā tāta sāhasaṃ kārṣistīrtha rakṣa prayatnataḥ \|*  
*ayaṃ pāpena ghorema atīva pariveṣṭitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vedanindā mahatpāpaṃ yasyānto naiva labhyate \|*  
*so 'yaṃ snānānmahattīrthaṃ nāśayiṣyati tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 43 \|\|*

*etad voyarbacaḥ śrutvāduḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ \|*  
*uvāca śokasaṃtaptastasya duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*eṣa ghoreṇa pāpena atīva pariveṣṭitaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. When the king was putting off his clothes to give a bath on a fine noon, Vayu wamed- "O king! Don't so dare. Keep in mind the importance of the holy place. Defend its magnificence. This man is stuck with grown evils. Remember that criticising the Vedas is a heinous crime and it is beyond the cure by giving a bath at this great holy place. Instead of any success to your effort, the honour everlasting of this holy place shall be subsided."

## \|\| 47.45 \|\|

*prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye 'haṃ yadvadiṣyanti devatāḥ \|*  
*tatastā devatāḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabruvan \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The Raja became very anxious when he heard the warning so given by Vayu. He said- "This man is badly suffering from a heinous offence."

## \|\| 47.46-55 \|\|

*snātvā snātvā ca tīrtheṣu abhiṣiñcasva vāriṇā \|*  
*ojasā culukaṃ yāvat pratikūle sarasvatīm \|\| 46 \|\|*

*snātvā muktimavāpnoti puruṣaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*eṣa svapoṣaṇaparo devadūṣaṇatatparaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaiśca parityakto naiṣa śuddhyati karhicit \|*  
*tasmādenaṃ samuddiśya snātvā tīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*abhiṣiñcasva toyena tataḥ pūto bhaviṣyati \|*  
*ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā tasyāśramaṃ tataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tīrthayātrāṃ yayau rājā uddiśya janakaṃ svakam \|*  
*sa teṣu plāvanaṃ kurvastīrtheṣu ca dine dine \|\| 50 \|\|*

*abhyaṣiḍhcat svapitaraṃ tīrthatoyena nityaśaḥ \|*  
*etasminneva kāle tu sārameyo jagāma ha \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sthāṇormaṭhe kaulapatirdevadravyasya rakṣitā \|*  
*parigrahasya dravyasya paripālayitā sadā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*priyaśca sarvasokeṣu devakāryaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya dharmamārge sthitasya ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kālena calitā buddhirdevadravyasya nāśene \|*  
*tenādharmeṇa yuktasya paralokagatasya ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā yamo 'bravīd vākyaṃ śvayoniṃ va3ja mā ciram \|*  
*tadvākyānantaraṃ jātaḥ śva vai saugandhike vane \|\| 55 \|\|*

46-55. I will do everything suggested by gods for regrettal of this offence. All gods then suggested - "Take a bath in all holy places, bring water from there and then clean his body with so accumulated waters. A bath in each holy place found from Ojasa to Culuka on the bank of Sarasvati river ensures the emancipation for a man. This man indulged in self-satisfying acts and used to criticise the gods. The Brahmins had, therefore, abandoned him. It never be purified. Hence, you first take a bath in all holy places, bring water from there and then sprinkle that water on his body . The sprinkling of so accumulated water shall definitely purify him. Raja constructed an asrama there, kept him there and went on a pilgrimage on behalf of his father (the man so suffering). The began to take bath of holy places and then wash his body continuously. In that course, a dog came there. He was a Mahanta (the priest) on a convent located in Sthanu-tirtha in his previous life and responsible for keeping the money offered by devotees, the worship and for protection of the donated wealth. No doubt he was surviving an ideal life and taking all judicious measures to defend the wealth and worship punctually but at a certain phase of period, he deviated himself from religion. He began to squander the wealth offered to the temple. On his death, his evil acts produced him before Yama and he ordered- "go back in birth as a dog. Don’t stay here anymore." He thus was bom in the yoni of a dog in Saugandhika Vana.

## \|\| 47.56 \|\|

*tataḥ kālena mahatā śvayūthaparivāritaḥ \|*  
*paribhūtaḥ saramayā duḥkhena mahatā vṛtaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. After a long lapse of time, one day he was in a herd of dogs chasing a bitch. She offered her for courtship with other dogs but humiliated him. It caused deep shock in his mind.

## \|\| 47.57-58 \|\|

*tyaktvā dvaitavanaṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihatyaṃ yayau saraḥ \|*  
*tasmin praviṣṭamātrastu sthāṇoreva prasādataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*atīva tṛṣayā yuktaḥ sarasvatyāṃ mamañja ha \|*  
*tatra saṃplutadehastu vimuktaḥ sarvākilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. Burning in the fire of humiliation so made, he left immediately Daivata-vana and reached near holy reservoir of Sannihatya. As he had raced long distance, he jumped into Sarasvati river in order to satisfy his thirst and to refresh his tired body. All his evils were effaced due to the specific grace of the holy water.

## \|\| 47.59-61 \|\|

*āhāralobhena tadā praviveśa kuṭīrakam \|*  
*praviśantaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā śvānaṃ bhayasamanvitaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sa taṃ pasparśa śanakaiḥ sthāṇutīrthe mamañja ha \|*  
*patataḥ pūrvatīrtheṣu vipruṣaiḥ pariṣiñcataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*śuno 'sya gātrasaṃbhūtairabbindubhiḥ sa siñcitaḥ \|*  
*viraktadṛṣṭiśca śunaḥ kṣepeṇa ca tataḥ param \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. He then entered into a hermitage to satisfy his hunger. As the man (Vena in previous birth) feared of his sudden entrance in cottage his body was touched by him. As he was frightened, his body rolled on and he fell in the reservoir of Sthanu-tirtha. By virtue of regular bath given by his son, the water of all holy places so used, the water drops so poured on his body from that dog and his fall suddenly in Sthanu-tirtha all combindly made him detach himself from the worldly affairs.

## \|\| 47.62 \|\|

*sthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyāt sa putreṇa ca tāritaḥ \|*  
*niyatastatkṣaṇāñjāto stutiṃ kartuṃ pracakrame \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. As he had gained an innovated healthy body under the grace of that holy place and the service rendered by his son, he was now a pure soul. He therefore, saluted Sthanu god (Siva) and began praying.

## \|\| 47.63 \|\|

*vena uvāca*  
*prapadye devamīśānaṃ tvāmajaṃ candrabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ viśvasya jagataḥ patim \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Vena prayed- "I take shelter of Aja, Candrabhusana (who holds moon on head as ornament), Isana, Deva, Mahatma (the great soul), Mahadeva and the master of this entire world.

## \|\| 47.64 \|\|

*namaste devadeveśa sarvaśatruniṣūdana \|*  
*deveśa baliviṣṭambhadevadaityaiśca pūjita \|\| 64 \|\|*

110\. You yourself are Brahmana, Ksatriya, Vaisya, Sudra and the varna most inferior, cluster of clouds, lightning and thundering.

111\. You are light year (samvatsara), the season, months, fortnight, era, movements, Katha (a measure of time), constellation, stars and kalas.

113\. You are Ksirasagara among oceans, bow among weapons, thunderbolt among arms and truth among the resolutions.

## \|\| 47.114 \|\|

*tvameva dveṣa icchā ca rāgo mohaḥ kṣamākṣame \|*
