114\. You are envy, passion, affection, forgiveness, cruelty/revenge, occupation, patience, greed, appeal, anger, victory and defeat.

## \|\| 47.115 \|\|

*tvaṃ śarī tvaṃ gadī cāpi khaṭvāṅgī ca śarāsanī \|*  
*chettā mettā prahartāsi mantā netā sanātanaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. You hold arrows, mace, khatvanga and bow. You are penetrator, driller, snatcher, thinker, leader and immortal.

## \|\| 47.116 \|\|

*daśalakṣaṇasaṃyukto dharmor'thaḥ kāma eva ca \|*  
*samudrāḥ sarito gaṅgā parvatāśca sarāṃsi ca \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. You are the religion consisting of ten characteristics; you are wealth (essence), Kama (sex), all oceans, rivers, the Ganges, mountains and reservoir.

## \|\| 47.117 \|\|

*latāvallyastṛṇauṣadhyaḥ paśavo mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*dravyakarmaguṇārambhaḥ kālapuṣpaphalapradaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. You render with life the creepers, tendrils, straws, medicines, animals, stag, birds, promoter of the use and investment of matter (Dravya) and timely giver of flowers.

## \|\| 47.118-119 \|\|

*ādiścantaśca vedānāṃ gāyatrī praṇavastathā \|*  
*lohito harito nīlaḥ kuṣṇaḥ pītaḥ sitastathā \|\| 118 \|\|*

*kadruśca kapilaścaiva kapoto mecakastathā \|*  
*savarṇaścāpyavarṇāśca kartā hartā tvameva hi \|\| 119 \|\|*

118-119. You are the beginning and end of the Vedas; you are Gayatri and Pranava. You yourself are the colours like red, green, blue, dark yellow, white, dark black, pale, grey, violet, coloured, colourless, maker and destroyer.

## \|\| 47.120 \|\|

*tvamindraśca yamaścaiva varuṇo dhanado 'nilaḥ \|*  
*upaplavaścitrabhānuḥ svarbhānureva ca \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. You are Indra, Yama, Varuna, Kubera, Vayu, Upaplava (Rehu), Citrabhanu (Agni), Svarbhanu (Sun) and Bhanu.

## \|\| 47.121 \|\|

*śikṣāhaitraṃ trisauparṇaṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam \|*  
*pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. You are learning, Hotra, Trisauparna, Satarudriya of Yajurveda, sacred among sacred things, purest and in the form of most benevolence.

## \|\| 47.122-123 \|\|

*tinduko girijo vṛkṣe mudgaṃ cākhilajīvanam \|*  
*prāṇāḥ sattvaṃ rajaścaiva tamaśca pratipatpitiḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*prāṇo 'pānaḥ masānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca \|*  
*unmeṣaśca nimeṣaśca kṣutaṃ jṛmbhitameva ca \|\| 123 \|\|*

122-123. You are Tinduka, Girija (Silajatu) tree, Mudga, Akhilajivana, Prana, Sattva, Raja, Tama and Pratipatpati. You are Prana, Арanа, Samana, Udana, Vyana, Unmesa, Nimesa, Ksuta (sneezing) and yawning.

## \|\| 47.124 \|\|

*lohitāntargato dṛṣṭirmahāvaktro mahodaraḥ \|*  
*śuciromā hariśmaśrurūrdhvakeśaścalācalaḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. You are Lohitantargata, Drsti, Mahavaktra, Mahodara, Suciroma, Harismasru, Urdhvakesa, Cala and Acala (moveable and unmoveable).

## \|\| 47.125 \|\|

*gītavāditranṛtyajño gītavāditrakapriyaḥ \|*  
*matsyo jālo jalaukāśca kālaḥ kelikalā kaliḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. You are known to songs, musical instruments, dance and you have a great liking for them. You are fish, its net, whirlpool, death (Kala), expert at erotics and quarrel.

## \|\| 47.126 \|\|

*akālaśca vikālaśca duṣkālaḥ kāla eva ca \|*  
*mṛtyuśca mṛtyukartā ca yakṣo yakṣabhayaṅkaraḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

126\. You are in the form of famine, Vikala, adversity and Kala (time or death). You are death, the death-maker, Yaksa and terrible for Yaksas.

## \|\| 47.127 \|\|

*saṃvartako 'ntakaścaiva saṃvartakabalāhakaḥ \|*  
*ghaṇṭo ghaṇṭī māhaghaṇṭī cirī mālī ca mātaliḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. You are Samvartaka, Antaka (Yama), Samvartaka and Balahaka clouds. You are Ghanta, Ghanti, Mahaghanti, Ciri, Mall and Matali.

## \|\| 47.128 \|\|

*brahmakālayamāgnīnāṃ daṇḍī muṇḍī trimuṇḍadhṛk \|*  
*caturyugaścaturvedaścāturhetrapravartakaḥ \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. You are Mundi, Dandi and Trimundadhari who punish Brahma, Kala, Yama and Agni. You are the promoter of the four eras, the Vedas and yajnas.

## \|\| 47.129 \|\|

*cāturāśramyanetā ca cāturvarṇyakarastathā \|*  
*nityamakṣapriyo dhūrto gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇādhipaḥ \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. You are the leader of four asramas and creator of four varnas. You always love gambling, you are shrewd, Ganadhyaksa and Ganadhipa (chief and master of Ganas).

## \|\| 47.130 \|\|

*raktamālyāmbaradharo giriko girikapriyaḥ \|*  
*śilpaṃ ca śilpināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvaśilpapravartakaḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. You hold a red garland and garment, you are dweller on mountain, you have a great liking for mountains, you are craft, the best craftsman and promoter of all crafts.

## \|\| 47.131 \|\|

*bhaganetrāṅkuśaścaṇḍaḥ pūṣṇo dantavināśanaḥ \|*  
*svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkāro namaskāro namo namaḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. You are the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, the teeth of Caruja and Pusa. You are Svaha, Svadha, Vasatkara and Namaskara (salutation). I salute you frequently.

## \|\| 47.132 \|\|

*gūḍhavrato guhyatapāstārakāstārakāmayaḥ \|*  
*dhātā vidhātā saṃdhātā pṛthivyā dharaṇo 'paraḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. You are Gudhavrata, Guhyatapa, Taraka and Тaгакатауа. You are Dhata, Vidhata, Sandhata and the best holder of this earth.

## \|\| 47.133 \|\|

*brahma tapaśca satyaṃ ca vratacarya mathārjavam \|*  
*bhūtātmā bhūtakṛd bhūtirbhūtabhavyabhavodbhavaḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. You are Brahma, austerity, truth, celibacy and Arjava. You are the soul of organisms, the result of the acts executed by them and the origin of this world so wide for living creatures.

## \|\| 47.134 \|\|

*bhūrbhuvaḥ svarṛtaṃ caiva dhruvo dānto maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*dīkṣito 'dīkṣitaḥ kānto durdānto dāntasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. You are Bhuh Bhuvah, Svah, Rta (divine), Dhruva, Danta (restrained) and Mahesvara. You are Diksita (consecrated), Adiksita, Kanta (lovely), Durdanta and Dantasambhava.

## \|\| 47.135 \|\|

*candrāvarto yugāvartaḥ saṃvartakapravartakaḥ \|*  
*binduḥ kāmo hyaṇuḥ sthūlaḥ karṇikārasrajapriyaḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. You are Candravartta, Yugavartta, Samvartaka and Pravarta. You are fond of Bindu (drop), Kama, Anu (atom), Sthula and a garland of Karnikara.

## \|\| 47.136 \|\|

*nandīmukho bhīmamukaḥ sumuko durmukhastathā \|*  
*hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śakunirmahoragapatirvirāṭ \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. You are Nandimukha, Bhimamukha, Sumukha and Durmukha. You are Hiranyagarbha, Sakuni, Mahoragapati and Virat.

## \|\| 47.137 \|\|

*adharmahā mahādevo daṇḍadhāro gaṇotkaṭaḥ \|*  
*gonarde gopratāraśca govṛṣeśvaravāhanaḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. You are the killer of sons, Mahadeva, Dandadhara (the wearer of Rod), Ganotkata, Gonarda, Gopratara and Govrsesvaravahana.

## \|\| 47.138 \|\|

*trailokyagoptā govindo gomārgo mārga eva ca \|*  
*sthiraḥ śreṣṭhaśca sthāṇuśca vikrośaḥ krośa eva ca \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. You are Trailokyagopta, Govinda, Gomarga and Marga. You are Sthira, Srestha, Sthanu, Vikrosa and Krosa.

## \|\| 47.139 \|\|

*durvāraṇo durviṣaho duḥsaho duratikramaḥ \|*  
*durddharṣo duṣprakāśaśca durdurśo durjayo jayaḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. You are Durvarana, Durvisaha, Duhsaha, Duratikrama, Durdharsa, Dusprakasa, Durdarsa, Durjaya and Jaya.

## \|\| 47.140 \|\|

*śaśāṅkānalaśītoṣṇaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇā ca nirāmayaḥ \|*  
*ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva vyādhihā vyādhināśanaḥ \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. You are moon, fire, cold, warmth, hunger, temptation, health, adversity, ailment, cure to ailment and eradicator of disease.

## \|\| 47.141 \|\|

*samūhaśca samūhasya hantā devaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*śikhaṇḍī puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ puṇḍarīkavanālayaḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. You are group of the groups, destroyer and everlasting god. You are Sikhandi, Pundarikaksa and Pundarikavanalaya.

## \|\| 47.142 \|\|

*tryambako daṇḍadhāraśca ugradaṃṣṭraḥ kulāntakaḥ \|*  
*viṣāpahaḥ suraśreṣṭhaḥ somapāstvaṃ marutpate \|*  
*amṛtāśī jagannāto devadeva gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. О the master of Maruts! О god of gods! You are Tryambaka, Dandadhara, Urgradanstra, Kulantaka, Visapaha, Surasrestha, Somapayi, Amrtasi, Jagannatha and Ganesvara.

## \|\| 47.143 \|\|

*madhuścyutānāṃ madhupo brahmavāk tvaṃ ghṛtacyutaḥ \|*  
*sarvalokasya bhoktā tvaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. You are honey drinking bee for the honey- suckers, Brahmavak, Ghrtacyuta, Sarvalokabhokta and Sarvalokapitamaha.

## \|\| 47.144 \|\|

*hiraṇyaretāḥ puruṣastvamekaḥ tvaṃ strī pumāṃstvaṃ hi napuṃsakaṃ ca \|*  
*bālo yuvā sthaviro devadaṃṣṭrā tvanno girirviśvakṛd viśvahartā \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. You are Hiranyareta Purusa. You are woman, man and eunuch too. You are with form of children, youth, aged, the divine elephant. You are the venerable creator of all things and the destroyer of all worlds.

## \|\| 47.145 \|\|

*tvaṃ vai dhātā viśvakṛtāṃ vareṇyas tvāṃ pūjayanti praṇatāḥ sadaiva \|*  
*candrādityau cakṣuṣī te bhavān hi tvameva cāgniḥ prapitāmahaśca \|*  
*ārādhya tvāṃ sarakhatīṃ vāglabhante ahorātre nimiṣonmeṣakartā \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. You are the best architect among architects. The people suffering always worship you for defence. Moon and sun are like your eyes. You are Agni and Brahman. You are in Sarasvati form too. People adore you and receive power of speech. You are day and night and shutting and opening of the eyes.

## \|\| 47.146 \|\|

*na brahmā na ca govindaḥ paurāṇā ṛṣayo na te \|*  
*māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yātātathyena śaṅkara \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. О god Sankara! Brahma, Govinda and ancient hermits too cannot know the actual magnificence that you hold.

## \|\| 47.147 \|\|

*puṃsāṃ śatasahasrāṇi yatsamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati \|*  
*mahatastamasaḥ pāre goptā mantā bhavān sadā \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. You have incorporated several lakhs of people within. You always maintain yourself beyond to the great illusion. You are secret and the key to such mystery.

## \|\| 47.148 \|\|

*yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ sattvasthāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ \|*  
*jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Salute to that Yogi form observed by sages devoting their time in abstract contemplation, sleepless, gaining power over the act of breathing, characterized by goodness, controlled in senses, perceive with the mind as light.

## \|\| 47.149 \|\|

*yā mūrtayaśca sūkṣmāste na śakyā yā nidarśitum \|*  
*tābhirmāṃ satataṃ rakṣa pitā putramivaurasam \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. The feature being so macro as one cannot express them through words are saluted and expect defence through them as the father defends his wedlock son.

## \|\| 47.150 \|\|

*rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo 'haṃ tavānagha namo 'stu te \|*  
*bhaktānukampī bhagavān bhaktaścāhaṃ sadā tvayi \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. О innocent! Defend me. I am worth given defence. I salute you. You are the devotee- loving god and I am always your devotee.

## \|\| 47.151 \|\|

*jaṭine daṇḍine nityaṃ lambodaraśārīriṇe \|*  
*kamaṇḍaluniṣaṅgāya tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. Salute to Jati, Dandi, Lambodara Hariri and Kamandalu (water pot) holder Rudratma.

## \|\| 47.152 \|\|

*yasya keśeṣu jīmūtā nadyāḥ sarvāṅgasandhiṣu \|*  
*kukṣau samudraścatvārastasmai toyātmane namaḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. Salute to Toyatma, in whose hairs are the clouds, all rivers in joints of whose body and four oceans in armpits.

## \|\| 47.153 \|\|

*saṃbhakṣya sarvabhūtāni yugānte paryupasthite \|*  
*yaḥ śete jalamadhyasthastaṃ prapadye 'mbuśāyinam \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. I go for shelter to the god sleeping on water bed, who gathers all organisms in his belly at the time of the great devastation (Pralaya) and then sleeps there.

## \|\| 47.154 \|\|

*praviśya vadanaṃ rāhoryaḥ somaṃ pibate niśi \|*  
*grasatyarkaṃ ca kharbhānū rakṣitastava tejasā \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. You sip Soma by getting in the mouth of demon head at night and this demon head grips the sun by the power given by you. Your are saluted.

## \|\| 47.155 \|\|

*ye cātra patitā garbhā rudragandhasya rakṣeṇa \|*  
*namaste 'stu khadhā khāhā prāpnuvanti tadadbhute \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. Salute to the wombs fallen here under defence of Rudragandha. Svaha and Svadha attain that magnificently.

## \|\| 47.156 \|\|

*ye 'ṅguṣṭhamātrāḥ puruṣā dehasthāḥ sarvadehinām \|*  
*rakṣantu te hi māṃ nityaṃ te māmāpyāyayantu vai \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. May the Purusa existed in the bodies of all organisms defend me daily and always be gracious. They are thumb like in size.

## \|\| 47.157-160 \|\|

*ye nadīṣu samudreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca \|*  
*vṛbhamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca \|\| 157 \|\|*

*catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca \|*  
*hastyaśvarathaśālāsu jīrṇodyānālayeṣu ca \|\| 158 \|\|*

*ye ca pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca \|*  
*candrārkayormadhyāgatā ye ca candrārkaraśmiṣu \|\| 159 \|\|*

*rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmāt paraṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*namastebhyo namastebhyo namastebhyaśca nityaśaḥ \|\| 160 \|\|*

157-160. I do frequently salute the god who resides in rivers, oceans, mountains, caves, tree, roots, cowsheds, deep trenches, roundabouts, streets, compounds, assemblies, elephant and horse sheds, depredated gardens, houses, five elements, directions and sub-directions, at the middle of sun and moon, on their rays, nether and more in depth than nether.

## \|\| 47.161 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ na vidyate saṃkhyā pramāṇaṃ rūpameva ca \|*  
*asaṃkhyeyagaṇā rudrā namastebhyo 'stu nityaśaḥ \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. Salute to Rudraganas who are uncountable, no symbol or mark to perceive and no complexion.

## \|\| 47.162 \|\|

*prasīda mama bhadraṃ te tava bhāvagatasya ca \|*  
*tvayi me hṛdayaṃ deva tvayi buddhirmatistvayi \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. Be good all of you. Be gracious on me as I am in depth of thinking on you. О god! My heart, mind and aspiration-all are engrossed in you.

## \|\| 47.163 \|\|

*stutvaivaṃ sa mahādevaṃ virarāma dvijottmaḥ \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. Thus, that best Dvija recited for the pleasure of Mahadeva and then relaxed.

## Chapter 48. Boon-providing to Vena

## \|\| 48.1 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvacā \|*  
*athainamabravīd devastrailokyādhipatirbhavaḥ \|*  
*āśvāsanakaraṃ cāsya vākyavid vākyamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sanatkumara said- The master of three- worlds and supreme orator then was pleased and said to Vena-

## \|\| 48.2 \|\|

*aho tuṣṭo 'smi te rājan stavenānena suvrata \|*  
*bahunātra kimuktena matsamīpe vasiṣyasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O king! О great resolute! I am satisfied with the psalm. No need to say anything more in praise. You will reside near me.

## \|\| 48.3 \|\|

*uṣitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ mama gātrodbhavaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*asuro hyandhako nāma bhaviṣyasi surāntakṛt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. After the long passage of time you will become Andhaka and kill the gods originated from my body.

## \|\| 48.4 \|\|

*hiraṇyākṣagṛhe janma prāpya vṛddhiṃ gamiṣyasi \|*  
*pūrvādharmeṇa ghoreṇa vedanindākṛtena ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. As you have criticised the Vedas, you would have to be bom as the son of Hiranyaksa and thus, you will be brought up there.

## \|\| 48.5 \|\|

*sābhilāṣo jaganmāturbhaviṣyasi yadā tadā \|*  
*dehaṃ śulena hatvāhaṃ pāvayiṣyāmi samārbudam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. When you will then expect Parvati to accompany and enjoy carnal temptations, I will kill you through Sula and thus, your body so slaughtered will avail of purity up to several billion years.

## \|\| 48.6 \|\|

*tatrāpyakalmaṣo bhūtvā stutvā māṃ bhaktitaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*khyātogaṇādhipo bhūtvā nāmnā bhṛṅgiriṭiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. You will, on rebirth, worship me with strict penance and then become a popular commander of ganas and addressed as Bhrngiriti.

## \|\| 48.7-9 \|\|

*matsannidhāne sthitvā tvaṃ tataḥ siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi \|*  
*venaproktaṃ stavamimaṃ kīrtayed yaḥ śṛṇoti ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiñcid dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt \|*  
*yathā sarveṣu deveṣu viśiṣṭo bhagavāñśivaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tathā stavo variṣṭho 'yaṃ stavānāṃ venanirmitaḥ \|*  
*yaśorājyasukhaiśvaryadhanamānāya kīrtitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. You will then live near me and obtain grand success (siddhi). The psalm offered by Vena here shall ensure longevity and enjoy all good for a man who will recite and listen to it. As Mahadeva is the greatest among gods, the psalm framed and recited here by Vena is the best among all other prayers. Its recital endows fame, state, pleasure, luxury, wealth and honour.

## \|\| 48.10-16 \|\|

*śrotavyo bhaktimāsthāya vidyākāmaiśca yatnataḥ \|*  
*vyādhito duḥkhito dīnaścaurarājabhayānvitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*rājakāryavimukto vā mucyate mahato bhayāt \|*  
*anenaiva tu dehena gaṇānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tejasā yaśasā caiva yukto bhavati nirmalaḥ \|*  
*na rākṣasāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vighnaṃ kuryurgṛhe tatra yatrāyaṃ paṭhyate stavaḥ \|*  
*śruṇuyād yā stavaṃ nārī anujñāṃ prāpya bhartṛtaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mātṛpakṣe pituḥ pakṣe pūjyā bhavati devavat \|*  
*śruṇuyād yaḥ stavaṃ divyaṃ kīrtayed vā samāhitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇa siddhiṃ gacchanti nityaśaḥ \|*  
*manasā cintitaṃ yacca yacca vācānukīrtitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ saṃpadyate tasya stavanasyānukīrtanāt \|*  
*manasā karmaṇā vācā kṛtameno vinaśyati \|*  
*varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yattvayā manasepsitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

10-16. The men desirous of learning should listen to this psalm with sheer reverence. The ailing persons, grievous, pauper, feared of thief or king or the man expelled from empire get fearlessness attains the supreme position among ganas in this life and their heart get purity and splendour thereby popularity assured. Wherever this psalm is recited, the monsters, devils, ghosts or Vinayakas do not create any hurdle there. The woman listening to it with due permission of her husband, definitely receives honour not lesser than god in her fathers side and father-in-law side. All arrows of the man get fulfilment on a day-to- day basis who either listens to or recites this psalm in perfect meditation. The evils committed by his mind, speech and acts are destroyed. Be your all good. Ask me whatever you desire.

## \|\| 48.17 \|\|

*vena uvāca*  
*asya liṅgasya māhātmyāt tathā liṅgasya darśanāt \|*  
*mukto 'haṃ pātakaiḥ sarvaistava darśanataḥ kila \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Vena said- I have been absolved from all sins due to the magnificence of this linga, its look and your own presence has made me free from the clutches of all evils.

## \|\| 48.18-20 \|\|

*yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama \|*  
*devasvabhakṣaṇāñjātaṃ śvayonau tava sevakam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*etasyāpi prasādaṃ tvaṃ kartumarhasi śaṅkara \|*  
*etasyāpi bhayānmadhye saraso 'haṃ nimañjitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*devairnivāritaḥ pūrvaṃ tīrthe 'smin snānakāraṇāt \|*  
*ayaṃ kṛtopakāraśca etadarthe vṛṇomyaham \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. О god! If you are pleased with me and willing to give me desired, please, then take of notices your devotee who was bom as a dog on account of punishment for misappropriation of deity account /the fund. Gods had prohibited me to take a bath earlier but it is his grace that I could fall in this reservoir under influence of fear. He has done good for me. I therefore, ask your grace for him.

## \|\| 48.21-23 \|\|

*tasyaitad vacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*eṣo 'pi pāpinirmukto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*prasādānme mahābāho śivalokaṃ gamiṣyati \|*  
*tathā stavamimaṃ śrutvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kurukṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ saraso 'sya mahīpate \|*  
*mama liṅgasya cotpattiṃ śrutvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. God Siva was satisfied to listen to this statement and said- О great arm god! He too will be undoubtedly absolved from the evils. He will thus receive the abode of Siva. The man listening to this psalm will escape from all evils. О king! The magnificence of Kuruksetra and the reservoir and the origin of linga will absolve the people from evils whosoever will listen to it.

## \|\| 48.24 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca*  
*ityevamuktvā bhagavān sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Sanatkumara said- with these words, the god suddenly vanished from there.

## \|\| 48.25 \|\|

*sa ca śvā tatkṣaṇādeva smṛtvā janma purātanam \|*  
*divyamūrtidharo bhūtvā taṃ rājānamupasthitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. That dog too appeared before that king when his consciousness was returned to his memory about his previous life and got a healthy human body.

## \|\| 48.26 \|\|

*kṛtvā snānaṃ tato vainyaḥ pitṛdarśanalālasaḥ \|*  
*sthāṇatīrthe kuṭīṃ śūnyāṃ dṛṣṭvā śokasamanvitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. When Vena's son Prthu returned from the holy place after a bath and with water for cleaning the body of his father, he saw the cottage deserted. It spurted-up his sorrow and he began wailing.

## \|\| 48.27 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā veno 'bravīd vākyaṃ harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ \|*  
*satputreṇa tvayā vatsa trāto 'haṃ narakārmavāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Vena saw his son, became happy and said to Prthu, О son! You have defended me from falling into hell.

## \|\| 48.28-32 \|\|

*tvayābhiṣiñcito nityaṃ tīrthasthapuline sthitaḥ \|*  
*asya sādhoḥ prasādena sthāṇordevasya darśanāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

*muktāpāpaśca svarlokaṃ yāsye yatra śivaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā rājānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sthāṇutīrthe yayau siddhiṃ tena putreṇa tāritaḥ \|*  
*sa ca śvā paramāṃ siddhiṃ sthāṇutīrthaprabhāvataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvairjagāma bhavamandiram \|*  
*rājā pitṛṛṇairmuktaḥ paripālya vasundharām \|\| 31 \|\|*

*putrānutpādya dharmeṇa kṛtvā yajñaṃ nirargalam \|*  
*dattvākāmāṃścaviprebhyo bhuktvā bhogān pṛthagvidhān \|\| 32 \|\|*

28-32. By virtue of living at the bank of this holy place, the pure water you sprinkled daily on me, the grace of this gentleman and a vision of Sthanudeva compoundly enabled me to be free from the evils committed. I am now going to that heavenly abode where Siva himself lives. The Raja thereafter installed a linga of Mahesvara in Sthanu-tirtha and thus, got grand success (siddhi) in his life. The dog was also freed from the account of evils and went to the abode of Siva. After being free from the debts of Pity, Raja ruled happily, reproduced sons and perpetually performed yajna during his life-time. He gave in donation the desired things to Brahmins and enjoyed luxury throughout his life.

## \|\| 48.33 \|\|

*suhṛdo 'tha ṛṇairmuktvā kāmaiḥ saṃtarpya ca striyaḥ \|*  
*abhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye kurukṣetraṃ yayau nṛpaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. After making his friends free from debts and satiating the temptations of his queens, he throned his son and then went to Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 48.34 \|\|

*tatra taptvā tapo ghoraṃ pūjayitvā ca śaṅkaram \|*  
*ātmecchayā tanuṃ tyaktvā prayātaḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He observed gross penance, worshipped god Sankara, took his last breath voluntarily and thus, got supreme position in the heaven.

## \|\| 48.35 \|\|

*etatprabhāvaṃ tīrthasya sthāṇoryaḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The man listening to the magnificence of this Sthanu-tirtha approaches supreme position after coming out from the cumbersome net of evils.

## Chapter 49. Formation of the Caturmukha-lingas and Siva’s eulogy by Brahma

## \|\| 49.1 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca- caturmukhānāmutpattiṃ vistareṇa mamānagha \|*  
*tathā brahmeśvarāṇāṃ ca śrotumicchā pravarttate \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Markandeya said- О innocent! I am curious to listen about the origin of four mouthed Brahma and Brahmeavara.

## \|\| 49.2 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca- śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa kathayiṣyāmi te'nagha \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ sraṣṭhakāmasya yad vṛttaṃ padmajanmanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sanatkumara said- О innocent! Listen now to the complete detail on Brahma, the god bom from the lotus flower. I am going to explain it.

## \|\| 49.3 \|\|

*utpanna eva bhagavānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*sasarja sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Brahma with his birth created immediately the movable and immovable organisms.

## \|\| 49.4 \|\|

*punaścintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ jajñe kanyā manoramā \|*  
*nīlotpaladalaśyāmā tanumadhyā sulocanā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In next turn, a beautiful virgin, having a dark complexion analogous to a blue petal lotus, thin loins and attractive eyes.

## \|\| 49.5 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvābhimatāṃ brahmā maithunāyājuhāva tām \|*  
*tena pāpena mahatā śiro'śīryata vedhasaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma called her for coition. It being an evil, Brahma lost his head immediately.

## \|\| 49.6 \|\|

*tena śīrṇena sa yayau tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*sāntrihatyaṃ saraḥ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayā vaham \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He picked up that fallen head and visited Sannihatya reservoir, a place capable to absolve all evils.

## \|\| 49.7-8 \|\|

*tatra puṇye sthāṇutīrthe ṛvisiddhanivevite \|*  
*sarasvatyuttare tīre pratiṣṭhāpya caturmukhaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ārādhayāmāsa tadā dhūpairgandhairmanoramaiḥ \|*  
*upahāraistathā hṛdyai saudrasūktairdine dine \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. In that sacred place Sthanu surrounded by hermits and siddhas, he installed a Siva-linga having four mouths at the north facing bank of Sarasvati. He then began worship regularly by offering Dhupa, fragrance, beautiful gifts and chanting Rudra Sutkas.

## \|\| 49.9 \|\|

*tasyaivaṃ bhaktiyuktasya śivapūjāparasya ca \|*  
*svayamevājagāmātha bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Impressed by the worship so made, god Nilalohita Siva himself appeared there.

## \|\| 49.10-11 \|\|

*tamāgataṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā bhūmau stuti tasya cakāra ha \|\| 10 \|\|*

*brahmovāca- namaste'stu mahādeva bhūtabhavya bhavāśraya \|*  
*namaste stutinityāya namastrailokyapāline \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Brahma saluted Siva and started praying him- О Mahadeva! You are the only shelter for the past, present and future. I salute you. Salute to the nourisher of this entire world and you are worshipped daily.

## \|\| 49.12 \|\|

*namaḥ pavitradehāya sarvakalmaṣanāśine \|*  
*carācaraguro guhyaguhyānāṃ ca prakāśakṛt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Salute to the god having pure body and who efface the evils of the devotees. О preceptor of the movable and immovable world! You disclose even the mystery of mysteries.

## \|\| 49.13 \|\|

*rogā na yānti bhiṣajaiḥ sarvarogavināśana \|*  
*rauravājinasaṃvīta vītaśoka namo'stu te \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You eradicate the ailments so chronic as recovery not possible by the physicians. О god you put the hide of Ruru stag on body. You are free from the agony. I salute you.

## \|\| 49.14 \|\|

*vārikallolasaṃkṣubdhamahābuddhivighaṭṭine \|*  
*tvannāmajāpino deva na bhavanti bhavāśrayāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O organiser of great wisdom! The Ganges water flows with musical tone from your matted hair. The people chanting your name never fall dump in the world sea.

## \|\| 49.15 \|\|

*namaste nityanityāya namastrailokyapālana \|*  
*śaṃkarāyāpremayāya vyādhīnāṃ śamanāya ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Salute to everlasting god. Salute to the nourisher of three-worlds, Sankara, Aprameya (Immeasurable) and destroyer of ills.

## \|\| 49.16 \|\|

*parāyāparimeyāya sarvabhūtapriyāya ca \|*  
*yogeśvarāya devāya sarvapāpakṣayāya ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Salute to Para (Supreme), Illimitable, dear to all creatures, master in yoga, god and the remover of all evils.

## \|\| 49.17 \|\|

*namaḥ sthāṇave siddhāya siddhavandistutāya ca \|*  
*bhūtasaṃsāradurgāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Salute to god worshipped by Sthanu, siddha an the people chanting hymns. You are first to the world of organisms and you are in universal form.

## \|\| 49.18 \|\|

*phaṇīndroktamahimne te phaṇīndrāṅgadadhāriṇe \|*  
*phaṇīndravarahārāya bhāskarāya namo namaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O magnificent as described by the king serpent, you hold the Angada of serpent king, garland of serpent king and the form of Bhaskara (the Sun).

## \|\| 49.19 \|\|

*evaṃ stuto mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*na ca manyustvayā kāryo bhāvinyarthe kadācana \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Sankara said to Brahma when he was pleased by virtue of worship- "You should not weep for the things about which preponderance of possibility has existed."

## \|\| 49.20 \|\|

*purā varāhakalpe te yanmayā'pahṛtaṃ śiraḥ \|*  
*caturmukhaṃ ca tadabhūnna kadācinnaśiṣyati \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I had cut off your head during Varahakalpa. It has now been replaced by four mouths and it will never destroy.

## \|\| 49.21 \|\|

*asminsannihite tīrthe liṅgāni mama bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*pratiṣṭhāpya vimuktastvaṃ sarvapāpairbhaviṣyasi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. By installing my lingas with devotion in this Sannihita Tirtha, you will escape from all evils.

## \|\| 49.22-23 \|\|

*sṛṣṭikāmena ca purā tvayā'haṃ preritaḥ kila \|*  
*tenāhaṃ tvāṃ tathetyuktvā bhūtānāṃ deśavarttivat \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dīrghakālaṃ tapastaptvā magnaḥ saṃnihite sthitaḥ \|*  
*sumahāntaṃ tataḥ kālaṃ tvaṃ pratīkṣāṃ mamākaroḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. You had inspired me during ancient period for the creation of this universe. I had undertaken the responsibility. I observed prolonged penance like an organism and then engrossed in Sannihita reservoir with thoughts about creation. You had waited on me for a longer period.

## \|\| 49.24 \|\|

*sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manasā kalpitaṃ tvayā \|*  
*so'bravīttvāṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā māṃ magnaṃ tatra cāmbhasi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. You then concentrated on the creator of all creatures in mind. He saw me immersed in water and said to you.

## \|\| 49.25 \|\|

*yadi me nāgrajastvanyastataḥ srakṣyāmahaṃ prajāḥ \|*  
*tvayaivoktaśca naivāsti tvadanyaḥ puruṣo'grajaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. If nobody other is senior to me, I will do creation. You said- "no other person than him was there."

## \|\| 49.26 \|\|

*sthāṇureṣa jale magno vivaśaḥ kuru maddhitam \|*  
*sa sarvabhūtānasṛjaddakṣādīṃśca prajāpatīn \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. This Sthanu is immersed in water and not in position to do any act. Do a good for me. He created Daksa etc. Prajapatis and all creatures.

## \|\| 49.27-30 \|\|

*yairimaṃ prakarotsarvaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham \|*  
*tāḥ sṛṣṭamātrāḥ kṣudhitāḥ prajāḥ prajāpatim \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bibhakṣayiṣadho brahmansahasā prādravaṃstadā \|*  
*sarvāḥ sa bhakṣyamāṇastrāṇārthī pitāmahamupādravat \|\| 28 \|\|*

*athāsāṃ ca mahāvṛttiḥ prajānāṃ saṃvidhīyatām \|*  
*dattaṃ tābhyastvayā hyantraṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ mahauṣadhīḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*jaṅgamāni ca bhūtāni durbalāni balīyasām \|*  
*vihitānnāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ punarjagmuryathāgatam \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. Thus, he made him to originate the Bhutagrama. О Brahman! The subject of their generation, he felt hunger and ran to gobble up even Prajapati on account of starring. He ran to Pitamaha for giving defence and said- "Make provision for the profession of subjects. You have provided them food. The medicines became food for immovable and the weak movable became the food for the strongly built creatures, when the subject got food they returned to their respective places.

## \|\| 49.31-33 \|\|

*tato vavṛdhire sarvāḥ prītiyuktāḥ parasparam \|*  
*bhūtagrāme vivṛddhe tu tuṣṭe lokagurau tvayi \|\| 31 \|\|*

*samuttiṣṭhañjalāttasmātprajāḥ saṃdṛṣṭavānaham \|*  
*tato'haṃ tāḥ prajā dṛṣṭvā vihitāḥ svena tejasā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*krodhena mahatā yukto liṅgamutpāṭya cākṣipam \|*  
*tatkṣiptaṃ saraso madhye ūrdhvameva yadā sthitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Then they all began to prosper in a mutually loving and cordial atmosphere. The created beings attaining prosperity, and you the Lord of the Universe being pleased, I emerged out of the water and saw the progeny, and seeing them, I endowed them with my own splendour. Then seeing the subject, I eradicated Linga and hurled it down immediately into the lake, and it stood there erect.

## \|\| 49.34-36 \|\|

*tadā prabhṛti lokeṣu sthāṇurityeṣa viśrutaḥ \|*  
*sakṛddarśanamātreṇa vimuktaḥ sarvakilviṣaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*prayāti mokṣaṃ paramaṃ yasmānnā varttate punaḥ \|*  
*yaśceha tīrthe nivasetkṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sa muktaḥ pāttakaiḥ sarvairamyāgamanodbhavaiḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā bhagavāndevastatraivāntaradhīyata \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. Since then the linga became famous as Sthanu. A man at a mere vision is absolved from all sins and attains emancipation. He does not return again to the cycle of birth and death. The person residing in his holy place with well controlled mind and heart on the eighth day of dark fortnight is absolved from all evils causing on account of irregularity in diet and arbitrary actions. With these words, Mahadeva vanished from there.

## \|\| 49.37 \|\|

*brahmā viśuddhapāpastu pūjya devaṃ caturmukham \|*  
*liṅgāni devadevasya sasṛje saramadhyataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Brahma purified from sins, worshipped Mahadeva and installed lingas of the god of gods in the middle of the reservoir.

## \|\| 49.38 \|\|

*ādyaṃ brahmasaraḥ puṇyaṃ haripārśve pratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*dvitīyaṃ brahmasadanaṃ svakīce hyāśrame kṛtam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. He first installed Brahmasara collateral to Hari and then constructed Brahmasadana in this asrama.

## \|\| 49.39 \|\|

*tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge tṛtīyaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*caturthaṃ brahmaṇā liṅgaṃ sarasvatyāstaṭe kṛtam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Brahma installed the third linga at its east and installed the fourth linga on the bank of Sarasvati.

## \|\| 49.40 \|\|

*etāni brahmatīrthāni puṇyāni pāvanāni ca \|*  
*ye paśyanti nirāhārāste yānti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The people observing fast and seeing these holy places of Brahma receive supreme position. All these places are capable of removing evils.

## \|\| 49.41-42 \|\|

*kṛte yuge hareḥ pārśve tretāyāṃ brahmaṇāśrame \|*  
*dvāpare tasya pūrveṇa sarasvatyāstaṭe kalau \|\| 41 \|\|*

*etāni pūjayitvā tu dṛṣṭvā bhaktisamanvitāḥ \|*  
*vimuktāḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The people who merely see the linga installed at collateral to Hari in Krtayuga, at Brahma's asrama in Treta, at its east in Dvapara and on the bank of Sarasvati in Kaliyuga and who worship them, achieve supreme position by making them free from the net of all evils.

## \|\| 49.43 \|\|

*sṛṣṭikāle bhagavatā pūjitastu maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*sarasvatyuttare tīre nāmnā khyātaścaturmukhaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. At the time of creation Mahesvara was worshipped by the Lord on the northern bank of Sarasvati, popularly known as Caturmukha.

## \|\| 49.44 \|\|

*taṃ praṇamya śraddadhāno mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|*  
*līlāsaṃkarasaṃbhūtaistathā vaibhāṇḍasaṃkaraiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The man saluting him gets absolved from all sins originated from Lolasankarya and Vaibhandasankarya.

## \|\| 49.45 \|\|

*tathaiva dvāpare prāpte svāśrame prārcya śaṃkaram \|*  
*vimukto rājasairbhāvairvarṇasaṃkarasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Similarly, Brahma freed him from the Rejasatic temperament originated from Varnasankarya by worshipping Sankara in his asrama at the advent of Dvapara.

## \|\| 49.46 \|\|

*tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā tu mānavaḥ \|*  
*vimuktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairabhojyasyānnasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The man worshipping there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight is absolved from the evils stuck due to taking the food not eatable.

## \|\| 49.47 \|\|

*kalikāle tu saṃprāpte vasiṣṭhāśramamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*caturmukhaṃ sthāpayitvā yayau siddhimanuttamām \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Brahma got grand success (siddhi) by installing Caturmukha at Vasisthasrama when there entered the Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 49.48 \|\|

*tatrāpi ye nirāhārāḥ śraddavānā jitendriyāḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti mahādevaṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The people who worship Mahadeva by observing fast, with reverence and by putting strong control on their senses definitely attain the supreme position.

## \|\| 49.49 \|\|

*ityetatsthāṇutīrthasya māhātmyaṃ kīrttitaṃ tava \|*  
*bacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mukto bhavati mānavaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. I have explained the magnificence of Sthanu-tirtha to you. The person hearing it is absolved from all sins.

## Chapter 50. Description of Prthudaka-tirtha

## \|\| 50.1-2 \|\|

*devadeva uvāca tato'vadaddevavarastu tīrthaṃ vasmādbhavānekatayā prayāti \|*  
*pṛthūdaketyeva ca nāma tubhyaṃ bhaviṣyate tīrthavaraḥ pṛthivyāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*evaṃ pṛthūdako devāḥ puṇyaṃ pāpabhayāpahaḥ \|*  
*taṃ gacchadhvaṃ mahātīrtha yāvat saṃnidhibodhata \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. The god of gods said- the great holy places of the world shall be of the name “Prthudaka” where you performs the meditation. О gods! Thus, the holy place Prthudaka is sacrosanct and destroyer of evils and fear together. Go at the great holy places falling till Sannidhi reservoir is arrived.

## \|\| 50.3 \|\|

*yadā mṛgaśiroṛkṣe śaśisūryau bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭhanti sā tithiḥ puṇyā tvakṣayā parigīyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The sacred day when moon, sun and Jupiter come in the constellation Mrgasira is called an Aksaya Tithi.

## \|\| 50.4 \|\|

*taṃ gacchadhvaṃ suraśreṣṭhā yatra prācī sarasvatī \|*  
*pitṛnārādhayadhvaṃ ca tatra śrāddhena bhaktitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O the best gods! Where Sarasvati river flows at the east direction go there and do worship of your Pitrs by performing sraddha.

## \|\| 50.5 \|\|

*tato murārivacanaṃ śrutvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|*  
*samājagmuḥ kurukṣetre puṇyatīrthaṃ pṛthūdakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. All gods including Indra went to Prthudaka existed in Kuruksetra, the holy place when so suggested by Murari.

## \|\| 50.6 \|\|

*tatra snātvā surāḥ sarve bṛhaspatimacodayan \|*  
*viśasva bhagavan ṛkṣamidaṃ mṛgaśiraḥ kuru \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. All gods said to Brhaspati (Jupiter) after taking bath there- "O lord! Enter in this Mrgasira constellation and make it a sin absolving Tithi holy. The appropriate time has come now.

## \|\| 50.7 \|\|

*puṇyāṃ tithiṃ pāpaharāṃ tava kālo'yamāgataḥ \|*  
*pravarttate ravistatra candramā'pi viśatyasau \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Sun is existed there and moon is also entering into it. О preceptor! The divine work is in your hands. Please, complete this assignment.

## \|\| 50.8-9 \|\|

*tavāyattaṃ guro kārya surāṇāṃ tatkuruṣva vaḥ \|*  
*ityevamukto devaistu devācāryo'bravīdidam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yadi varṣādhipo'haṃ syāṃ tato yāsyāmi devatāḥ \|*  
*bāḍhamūcuḥ surāḥ sarve tato'sau prākramanmṛgam \|\| 9 \|\|*

Prohibit him from advancing as his lips indicate that he will again say something wrong for Siva. The person criticising is not considered so evildoer as who listens it.

## \|\| 51.68 \|\|

*bhikṣuruvāca- vadāmi te pārvati vākyamevaṃ kena pradattā tava buddhirevā \|*  
*ityevamuktvā varadā samutthātumathaicchata \|*  
*tato'tyajadbhikṣurūpaṃ svarūpastho'bhavacchivaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Pulastya said- With these word, Parvati wished to go anywhere. God Siva in the meantime, abandoned his disguised form and appeared there.

## \|\| 51.69 \|\|

*bhūtvovāca priye gaccha svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ \|*  
*tavārthāya praheṣyāmi maharṣīn himavadgṛhe \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. He said- О beloved! Go back to your father's mansion. I will send the great hermits to the home of Himavat.

## \|\| 51.70 \|\|

*yaceha rudramīhantyā mṛnmayaśveśvaraḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*asau bhadreśvaretyevaṃ khyāto loke bhaviṣyati \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. This clay icon made by you were in order to focus your mind for, Sankara shall gain popularity in the world as Bhadresvara.

## \|\| 51.71 \|\|

*devadānavagandharvā yakṣāḥ kiṃpuruvoragāḥ \|*  
*pūrjāyaṣyanti satataṃ mānavāśca śubhepsavaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The gods, demons, gandharva, yaksa, kinnaras (eunuch), serpent and human-beings will worship this icon for fulfilment of their desires.

## \|\| 51.72 \|\|

*ityevamuktā devena girirājasutā mune \|*  
*jagāmāmbaramāviśya svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О sage! Parvati immediately complied with the instructions of Siva and went back through sky route at Himalaya.

## \|\| 51.73 \|\|

*śaṅkaro'pi mahātejā visṛjya girikanyakām \|*  
*pṛthūdakaṃ jagāmātha snānaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. The great god Sankara too visited at Prthudaka and took bath after seeing up the daughter of mountain king.

## \|\| 51.74 \|\|

*tatastu devapravaro maheśvaraḥ pṛthūdake snānamapāstakalmaṣaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā sanandiḥ sagaṇaḥ savāhano mahāgiri mandaramājagāma \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The god of gods Mahesvara absolved from impurity by virtue of bath in Prthudaka and then returned to the great mountain Mandara with his Nandi, ganas and carrier (vahana).

## \|\| 51.75 \|\|

*āyāti tripurāntake saha gaṇairbrahmarṣibhiḥ saptabhi- rārohatpulako babhau girivaraḥ saṃhṛṣṭacittaḥ kṣaṇāt \|*  
*cakre divyaphalairjalena śucinā mūlaiśca kandādibhiḥ pūjāṃ sarvagaṇeśvaraiḥ saha vibhoradristrinetrasya tu \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The mountain king was exhilarated seeing seven hermits, the ganas and Sankara came at his abode. He entertained them by offering divine fruits, roots, tubers (kanda) and clean water.

## Chapter 52. Prayer of Gods to Himalaya for settlement of marriage of Uma with Siva

## \|\| 52.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tataḥ saṃpūjito rudraḥ śailena prītimānabhūta \|*  
*sasmāra ca maharṣīstu arundhatyā sarma tataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Rudra pleased on getting such entertainment from the mountain king and he then remembered all hermits including Arundhati.

## \|\| 52.2 \|\|

*te saṃsmṛtāstu ṛṣayaḥ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*samājagmurmahāśailaṃ mandaraṃ cārukandaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. On so summoned by Sankara, those hermits came at the great mountain Mandara where beautiful caves were existing.

## \|\| 52.3 \|\|

*tānāgatānsamīkṣyaiva devastripuranāśanaḥ \|*  
*abhyutthāyābhipūjyaitānidaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Mahadeva, the killer of Tripura monster, stood up in their honour, saluted and then said.

## \|\| 52.4 \|\|

*dhanyo'yaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaḥ ślāghyaḥ pūjyaśca daivataiḥ \|*  
*dhūtapāpastathā jāto bhavatāṃ pādapaṅkajaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. This best mountain is graced, appreciated by gods and adorable but now with your lotus feet here, it has been absolved of all sins.

## \|\| 52.5 \|\|

*sthīyatāṃ vistṛte ramye giriprasthe same śubhe \|*  
*śilāsu padmavarṇāsu ślakṣṇāsu ca mṛduṣvapi \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Please, be seated on the lotus colour, smooth and soft boulders of this huge, attractive, plain and beautiful ridge.

## \|\| 52.6 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamuktā devena śaṃkareṇa maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*samavetya tvarundhatyā viviśuḥ śailasānuni \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Pulastya said- the hennits seated on ridge with Arundhati when so suggested by god Sankara.

## \|\| 52.7 \|\|

*upaviṣṭeṣu ṛṣiṣu nandī devagaṇāgraṇīḥ \|*  
*ardhyādinā samabhyarcya sthitaḥ prayatamānasaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. When the hermits so seated comfortably, the pioneer gana Nandi stood up after offering arghya etc. to them.

## \|\| 52.8 \|\|

*tato'bravītsurapatirdharmya vākyaṃ hitaṃ surān \|*  
*ātmano yaśaso vṛddhayai saptarṣīnvinayānvitān \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Siva then most humbly said illustrious, benevolent and religion abiding words.

## \|\| 52.9-10 \|\|

*hara uvāca- kaśyapātre vāruṇeya gādheya śṛṇu gautama \|*  
*bharadvāja śṛṇuṣva tvamaṅgirastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mamāsīddakṣatanujā priyā sā dakṣakopataḥ \|*  
*utsasarja satī prāṇān yoga dṛṣṭyā purā kila \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Sankara said- “Listen, О Kasyapa! О Atri! О Vasistha! О Visvamitra! О Gautama! О Bharadvaja! О Angira!” You all know, Sati, the daughter of Daksa was my beloved during ancient period. She abandoned her life by practising profound and abstract contemplation in the past.

## \|\| 52.11 \|\|

*sā'dya bhūyaḥ samuddhatā śailarājasutā umā \|*  
*sā madarthāya śailendro yācyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. She has bom as daughter of Himalaya now. О great Dvijas! I therefore, request you all to ask her hand for me from Himalaya.

## \|\| 52.12 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- saptarṣayaścaivamuktā bāḍhamityabbruvanvacaḥ \|*  
*oṃ namaḥ śaṃkarāyeti proktvā jagmurhimālayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Pulastya said- "On these words, the seven hermits said- ’Very good' and visited at Himalaya with 'Om Namah Sankaraya' on their lips."

## \|\| 52.13 \|\|

*tato'pyarundhatīṃ śarvaḥ prāha gacchasva sundari \|*  
*purandhroṃ hi purandhrīṇāṃ gati dharmasya vai viduḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Siva then instructed Arundhati! О beautiful lady! Accompany them to Himalaya as the women only know the feminine maters better than the men.

## \|\| 52.14 \|\|

*ityevamuktā durlaṅghayaṃ lokācāraṃ tvarundhatī \|*  
*namaste rudra ityuktvā jagāma patinā saha \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Arundhati, the most popular chest woman in this world, chanted "salute to Rudra" and accompanied with her husband.

## \|\| 52.15 \|\|

*gatvā himādriśikharamoṣadhiprasthameva ca \|*  
*dadṛśuḥ śailarājasya purīṃ surapurīmiva \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. They all saw the city of Himalaya analogous to the heaven from one of its ridges. It was covered by the medicinal plants grown everywhere.

## \|\| 52.16-17 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjyamānāste śailayovidbhirādarāt \|*  
*sunābhādibhiravyagraiḥ pūjyamānāstu parvataiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gandharvaiḥ kiṃnarairyakṣaistathā'nyaistatpurassaraiḥ \|*  
*viviśurbhuvanaṃ ramyaṃ himādrerhāṭakojjvalam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The wives of Himalaya, Sunabha etc. stable mountains, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas and other gave them due entertainment and they entered finally in the golden shade palace of Himalaya.

## \|\| 52.18 \|\|

*tataḥ sarve mahātmānastapasā dhautakalmaṣāḥ \|*  
*samāsādya mahādvāraṃ saṃtasthurdrāḥ sthakāraṇāt \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then the high-souled ones who had shaken off their sins by penance, reaching the principal gate had to stop at the gate for enquiry of the gate-keeper.

## \|\| 52.19 \|\|

*tatastu tvarito'bhyāgād dvāḥstho'drirgandhamādanaḥ \|*  
*dhārayanvai kareṃ daṇḍaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ mahat \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The door-keeper Gandhamadana mountain with a huge log of Padmaraga immediately came there.

## \|\| 52.20 \|\|

*tatastamūcurmunayo gatvā śailapatiṃ śubham \|*  
*nivedayāsmān saṃprāptān mahatkāryārthino vayam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The hermits said- "Give message to the king mountain that we have come with important matter to discuss."

## \|\| 52.21 \|\|

*ityevamuktaḥ śailendro ṛṣibhirgandhamādanaḥ \|*  
*jagāma tatra yatrāste śailarājo'dribhirvṛtaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Complying with their message, Gandhamadana went to Himalaya, surrounded by several mountains.

## \|\| 52.22 \|\|

*niṣaṇṇo bhuvi jānubhyāṃ dattvā hastau mukhe giriḥ \|*  
*daṇḍaṃ nikṣipya kakṣāyāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He knelt down on the ground, placed both hands near mouth, putting the stick in the armpit replied as follows:

## \|\| 52.23 \|\|

*gandhamādana uvāca- ime hi ṛṣayaḥ prāptā śailarāja tavārthinaḥ \|*  
*dvāre sthitāḥ kāryiṇaste tava darśanalālasāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Gandhamadana said- "O king mountain! Some hermits have come with some important mater to discuss with you and they are stood at the gate waiting to see you.

## \|\| 52.24 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- dvāḥsthavākyaṃ samākarṇya samutthāyācaleśvaraḥ \|*  
*svayamabhyāgamadvāri samādāyārdhvamuttamam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Pulastya said- Himalaya stood up, pick-up arghya in hands and approached himself at the gate.

## \|\| 52.25 \|\|

*tānardhyārdhyādinā śailaḥ samānīya sabhātalam \|*  
*uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ kṛtāsanaparigrahān \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He gave arghya, pay homage, brought them in assembly and said when they seated comfortably.

## \|\| 52.26 \|\|

*anabhravṛṣṭiḥ kimiyamutāho'kusumaṃ phalam \|*  
*apratarvyamacintyaṃ ca bhavadāgamanaṃ tvidam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Himalaya said- "How this sudden visit have you taken today as your arrival here is beyond imagination and unexpected."

## \|\| 52.27-28 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti dhanyo'smi śailarāḍadya sattamāḥ \|*  
*saṃśuddhadeho'smyadyaiva yadbhavanto mamājiram \|\| 27 \|\|*

*ātmasaṃsargasaṃśuddhaṃ kṛtavanto dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭipūtaṃ padākrāntaṃ tīrthaṃ sārasvataṃ yathā \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. О great hermits! I am graced today and for my real position as king mountain. As you have purified my palace by your sight, feet and by contact of your great soul like a bath in Sarasvata holy place; my body is purified today.

## \|\| 52.29 \|\|

*dāso'haṃ bhavatāṃ viprāḥ kṛtapuṇyaśca sāmpratam \|*  
*yenārthino hi te yūyaṃ tanmā'nujñātumarhatha \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О Brahmins! I am slave to you all. I have got the fruit for noble deeds today. Please, order me what should I do for you all.

## \|\| 52.30 \|\|

*sadāro'haṃ samaṃ putrairbhṛtyairnaptṛbhiravyayāḥ \|*  
*kiṃkaro'smi sthito yuṣmadājñākārī taducyatām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О hermits! I am mere servant to you with wife, sons, grandsons and all servants. Hence, please, order me.

## \|\| 52.31 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śailarājavacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ \|*  
*ūcuraṅgirasaṃ vṛddhaṃ kāryamadrau nivedaya \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Pulastya said- The hermits said Angira, the renowned sage- "Please, tell the purpose of our arrival here to Himalaya."

## \|\| 52.32 \|\|

*ityevaṃ coditaḥ sarvaiṛṣibhiḥ kaśyapādibhiḥ \|*  
*pratyuvāca paraṃ vākyaṃ girirājaṃ tamaṅgirāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Angira so requested by all Rsis with Kasyapa etc. spoke the most excellent words to the king of mountains Himalaya.

## \|\| 52.33 \|\|

*aṅgirā uvāca- śrūyatāṃ parvataśreṣṭha yena kāryeṇa vai vayam \|*  
*samāgatāstvatsadanamarundhatyā samaṃ gire \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Angira said- О king of mountains! Listen to the purpose of our arrival at your home with Arundhati.

## \|\| 52.34-36 \|\|

*yo'sau mahātmā sarvātmā dakṣayajñakṣayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*śaṃkaraḥ śūladhṛk śarvastrinetro vṛṣavāhanaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*jīmūtaketuḥ śatrughno yajñabhoktā svayaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*yamīśvaraṃ vadantyeke śivaṃ sthāṇu bhavaṃ haram \|\| 35 \|\|*

*bhīmamugraṃ maheśānaṃ mahādevaṃ paśoḥ patim \|*  
*vayaṃ tena preṣitāḥ smastvatsakāśaṃ girīśvara \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. О king mountain! The great soul, universal soul, destroyer of Daksa's yajna, Sula holder, Sarva, three eyed, bull rider, Jimutaketu, enemy killer, consumer to yajna, god Sankara known by a few people as Siva, Sthanu, Bhava, Hara, Bhima, Ugra, Mahesana, Mahadeva and Pasupati has sent us to you.

## \|\| 52.37 \|\|

*iyaṃ yā tvatsutā kālī sarvalokeṣu sundarī \|*  
*tāṃ prārthayati deveśastāṃ bhavāndātumarhati \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Your most beautiful daughter Kali is wished as bride by Devesa (Sankara). Please, give your consent.

## \|\| 52.38 \|\|

*sa eva dhanyo hi pitā yasya putrī śubhaṃ patim \|*  
*rūpābhijanasaṃpattyā prāpnoti girisattama \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О great mountain! Only the father is graced whose daughter gets a man bom in noble family, rich in earning and of good complexion as her husband.

## \|\| 52.39 \|\|

*yāvanto jaṅgamāgamyā bhūtāḥ śaila caturvidhāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ mātā tviyaṃ devī yataḥ proktaḥ pitā haraḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О mountain! As Hara is considered the father of all creatures, this goddess is the mother of this movable and immovable world.

## \|\| 52.40 \|\|

*praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ devāḥ praṇamantu sutāṃ tava \|*  
*kuruṣva pādaṃ śatrūṇāṃ mūrdhni bhasmapariplutam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. May all gods salute your daughter after Sankara. Put your foot with ash on the head of your enemies.

## \|\| 52.41 \|\|

*yācitāro vayaṃ śarvo varo dātā tvamapyumā \|*  
*vadhūḥ sarvajaganmātā kuru yacchreyase tava \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. We are donee, Sankara is bridegroom, you are donor and Uma, the mother of entire world is bride. Do as do deem fit.

## \|\| 52.42 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tadvaco'ṅgirasaḥ śrutvā kālī tasthāvadhomukhī \|*  
*harṣamāgamya sahasā punardainyamupāgatā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Pulastya said- Kali bowed her head down when she heard the plea of Angira. She suddenly gleamed with joy but on next moment became sad again.

## \|\| 52.43 \|\|

*tataḥ śailapatiḥ prāha parvataṃ gandhamādanam \|*  
*gaccha śailānupāmantrya sarvānāhartumarhasi \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The king mountain ordered Gandhamadana- "Go and invite here all moutains."

## \|\| 52.44 \|\|

*tataḥ śīghrataraḥ śailo gṛhāṅkahamagājjavī \|*  
*mervādīn parvataśreṣṭhānājuhāva samantataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Gandhamadana (the mountain) moved to the places of other mountains are brought there all of them including Meru etc.

## \|\| 52.45 \|\|

*te'pyājagmustvarāvantaḥ kāryaṃ matvā mahattadā \|*  
*viviśurvismayāviṣṭāḥ sauvarṇeṣvāsaneṣu ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. All these mountains came immediately calculating any urgency of the matter. They seated with surprise on the gold made chairs.

## \|\| 52.46-49 \|\|

*udayo hemakūṭaśca ramyako mandarastathā \|*  
*uddālako vāruṇaśca varāho garuḍāsanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śuktimān vegasānuśca dṛḍhaśṛṅgo'pi śṛṅgacān \|*  
*citrakūṭastrikūṭaśca tathā mandarakācalaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*viśyaśca malayaścaiva pāriyā tro'tha durdaraḥ \|*  
*kailāsādrirmahendraśca niṣadho'ñjanaparvataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*ete pradhānā girasyathā'nye kṣudraparvatāḥ \|*  
*upaviṣṭāḥ sabhāyāṃ vai praṇipatya ṛṣīṃśca tān \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. The prominent mountains like Udaya, Hemakuta, Ramayak, Mandara, Uddalaka, Varuna, Varaha, Garudasana, Suktiman, Vegasanu, Drdasrnga, Srigavan, Citrakuta, Trikuja, Mandaracala, Vindhya, Malaya, Pariyatra, Durdara, Kailasa, Mahendra, Nisadha, Anjana and other small mountains saluted hermits and took their place in the assembly.

## \|\| 52.50 \|\|

*tato girīśaḥ svāṃ bhāryāṃ menāmāhūtavāṃśca saḥ \|*  
*samāgacchatu kalyāṇī samaṃ putreṇa bhāminī \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The king mountain then called his wife Mena. “Come, blessed lady, together with your son.”

## \|\| 52.51 \|\|

*sā'bhivandya ṛṣīṇāṃ ca caraṇāṃśca tapasvinī \|*  
*sarvānjñātīnsamābhāṣya viveśa sasutā tataḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. She then bowed her head before the hermits, saw for permission from courtiers and took seat with her son.

## \|\| 52.52 \|\|

*tato'driṣu mahāśaila upaviṣṭeṣu nārada \|*  
*uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ sarvānābhāṣya susvaram \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О Narada! When all mountains seated comfortably, Himalaya sought their permission and said-

## \|\| 52.53 \|\|

*himavānuvāca- ima saptarṣayaḥ puṇyā yācitāraḥ sutāṃ mama \|*  
*maheśvarārthaṃ kanyāṃ tu tacāvedya bhavatsu vai \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Himavan said- these noble soul seven hermits are begging hand of my daughter for god Sankara. I have to put this only matter before you all.

## \|\| 52.54 \|\|

*tadvadadhvaṃ yathā prajñaṃ jñātayo yūyameva me \|*  
*nollaṅgya yuṣmāndāsyāmi tatkṣamaṃ vaktumarhatha \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. You all are my sanguine and siblings. Please, forward your well thought submissions. I will not offer my daughter in violation to your opinion. Hence, please, give your valuable suggestion on the matter.

## \|\| 52.55 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- himavadvacanaṃ śrutvā mervādyāḥ sthāvarottamāḥ \|*  
*sarva evābruvan vākyaṃ sthitāḥ svevvāsaneṣu te \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Pulastya said : Listening to the words of Himavata, Meru and all other great mountains suggested happily.

## \|\| 52.56 \|\|

*yācitāśca munayo varastripurahā haraḥ \|*  
*dīyatāṃ śaila kālīyaṃ jāmātā'bhimato hi naḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. . When Saptarsis are begging Kali for Sankara, the killer of Tripura monster, there should be no delay in saying O.K. we request you king to give the hand of your daughter in the hand of Sankara. We give our consent to see Sankara as son-in-law.

## \|\| 52.57-58 \|\|

*menāpyathāha bharttāraṃ śṛṇu śailendra madvacaḥ \|*  
*pitṛnārādhya davaistairdattā'nenaiva hetunā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yastvasyāṃ bhūtapatinā putro jāto bhaviṣyati \|*  
*sa haniṣyati daityendra mahiṣaṃ tārakaṃ tathā \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. Mena said to her husband- О king mountain! Listen to me. The gods had offered me to you by paying homage to ancestors with a purpose that my daughters son will take birth from Sankara and he shall kill the demon king Mahisa and Тaгака.

## \|\| 52.59 \|\|

*ityevaṃ menayā proktaḥ śailaiḥ śaileśvaraḥ sutām \|*  
*provāca putri dattā'si śarvāya tvaṃ mayā'dhunā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. When so suggested by Mena and mountains, Himavan said to his daughter- О daughter! I have given you this day to Sankara.

## \|\| 52.60 \|\|

*ṛṣīnuvāca kālīyaṃ mama putrī tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*praṇāmaṃ śaṃkaravadhūrbhaktinamrā karoti vaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. He said to hermits- О austere sages! My daughter and now Sankara's bride humbly salutes you all.

## \|\| 52.61 \|\|

*tato'pyarundhatī kālīmaṅkamāropya cāṭukaiḥ \|*  
*lajjamānāṃ samāśvāsya haranāmoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Arundhati picked up Kali in her lap and effaced her hesitation with chanting the noble names of Sankara.

## \|\| 52.62-63 \|\|

*tataḥ saptarṣayaḥ procuḥ śailarāja niśāmaya \|*  
*jāmitraguṇasaṃyuktāṃ tithiṃ puṇyāṃ sumaṅgalām \|\| 62 \|\|*

*uttarāphālgunīyogaṃ tṛtīye'hni himāṃśumān \|*  
*gamiṣyati ca tatrokto muhūrttā maitranāmakaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. Saptarsis then said- О king mountain! Listen to now the auspicious day matching with the quality of Jamata. On the third day from today, the moon will join the constellation Uttaraphalguni. It is called "Maitra" ceremony.

## \|\| 52.64 \|\|

*tasyāṃ tithyāṃ haraḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyati samantrakam \|*  
*tava putryā vayaṃ yāmastadanujñātumarhasi \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. God Sankara will accept the hand of your daughter with Vedic procedure on that day. Now, we ask your permission to return from here.

## \|\| 52.65 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā phalamūlādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*visarjayāmāsa śanaiḥ śailarāḍ ṛṣipuṃgavān \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. After worshipping them, the king mountain then bade farewell to those hermits by offering tasty fruits and roots.

## \|\| 52.66-67 \|\|

*te'pyājagmurmahāvegāttvākramya marudālayam \|*  
*āsādya phandaragiriṃ bhūyo'paśyanta śaṃkaram \|\| 66 \|\|*

*praṇamyocurmaheśānaṃ bhavān bhartā'drijā vadhūḥ \|*  
*sabrahmakāstrayo lokā drakṣyanti ghanavāhanam \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. They came at Mandaragiri through sky route, saluted Sankara and said- "You are bridegroom and Girija is your bride from now. The creatures of three worlds including Brahma will see Ghanavahana (Siva).

## \|\| 52.68 \|\|

*tato maheśvaraḥ prīto ṛṣīn sarvānanukramāt \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa vidhinā arundhatyā samaṃ haraḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Sankara then happily provided entertainment and honour in orderly manner to Saptarsis including Arundhati.

## \|\| 52.69 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjitā jagmuḥ surāṇāṃ mantraṇāya te \|*  
*te'pyājagmurharaṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmaviṣṇivandrabhāskarāḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. They went to invited all gods after getting worship from Siva so decent. Brahma, Visnu, Indra and sun etc. gods to came to see Siva.

## \|\| 52.70 \|\|

*gehaṃ tato'bhyetya maheśvarasya kṛtapraṇāmā viviśurmaharṣe \|*  
*sasmāra nandipramukhāṃśca sarvā- nabhyetya te vandya haraṃ niṣaṇṇāḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. O great sage! Having visited there, they all saluted Siva and entered into the home. Siva summoned Nandi etc. ganas. They came, saluted and then seated there.

## \|\| 52.71 \|\|

*devairgaṇaiścāpi vṛto girīśaḥ sa śobhate muktajaṭāgrabhāraḥ \|*  
*yathā vane sarjakadambamadhye prarohamūlo'tha vanaspatirvā \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Sankara surrounded by gods and ganas with his opened matted hair was seen as banyan tree grown between the- Sarjja and Kadamba trees in the forest.

## Chapter 53. The marriage of Parvati and Siva

## \|\| 53.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- samāgatānsurāndṛṣṭvā nandirākhyātavānvibhoḥ \|*  
*athotyāya hariṃ bhaktyā pariṣvajya nyapīḍayat \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Nandi informed Sankara about the arrival of all gods there. Sankara stood up and embraced god Visnu with sheer obeisance.

## \|\| 53.2 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ śirasā natvā samābhāṣya śatakratum \|*  
*ālokyānyān suragaṇān saṃbhāvayat sa śaṃkaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sankara bowed before Brahma in salute, asked Indra his well being and expressed honour for other gods by turning towards them.

## \|\| 53.3 \|\|

*gaṇāṣśa jaya deveti vīrabhadrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*śaivāḥ pāśupatādyāśca viviśurmandarācalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The followers of Siva Virabhadra etc. the Pasupatas, entered in Mandaracala with pronounciating "victory to god".

## \|\| 53.4 \|\|

*tatastasmānmahāśailaṃ kailāsaṃ saha daivataiḥ \|*  
*jagāma bhagavān śarvaḥ kartuṃ vaivāhikaṃ vidhim \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. God Siva then climbed on Kailasa, the great mountain for performing the rituals of marriage. All gods were also present there.

## \|\| 53.5 \|\|

*tatastasmin mahāśaile devamātā'ditiḥ śubhā \|*  
*surabhiḥ suramā cānyāṣścakrurmaṇḍanamākulāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Aditi, the revered mother of gods, Surabhi, Surasa and other women then decorated Siva there.

## \|\| 53.6-7 \|\|

*mahāsthiśekharī cārurocanātilako haraḥ \|*  
*siṃhājinī cālinīlabhujaṃgakṛtakuṇḍalaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mahāhiratnavalayo hārakeyūranūpuraḥ \|*  
*samunnatajaṭābhāro vṛṣabhastho virājate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Sankara with skull, gorocana tilaka on forehead, tiger's hide on body, ear-ring of serpent blue (black) like bee, bangle of serpents gem, garland, keyura and nupura and long ascending matted hair then rode on bull.

## \|\| 53.8 \|\|

*tasyāgrato gaṇāḥ svaiḥ svairārūḍhā yānti vāhanaiḥ \|*  
*devāśca pṛṣṭhato jagmuhuṃtāśanapurogamāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. His ganas were marching ahead on their respective carriages (vahana) with Agni as their leader and other gods followed him.

## \|\| 53.9 \|\|

*vainateyaṃ samārūḍhaḥ saha lakṣmyā janāīnaḥ \|*  
*prayāti devapārśvastho haṃsena ca pitāmahaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. On both collateral's of Siva, there were Visnu on eagle and Brahma on swan.

## \|\| 53.10 \|\|

*gajādhirūḍho devendraśchatraṃ śuklapaṭaṃ vibhoḥ \|*  
*dhārayāmāsa vitataṃ śacyā saha sahasradṛk \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Indra, the thousand eyed god rode on elephant and held a wide umbrella of white cloth.

## \|\| 53.11 \|\|

*yamunā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā bālavyajanamuttamam \|*  
*śvetaṃ pragṛhya hastena kacchape saṃsthitā yayau \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Yamuna, the best river rode on tortoise and began to walk with white fan (camvara) in her hand.

## \|\| 53.12 \|\|

*haṃsakundendusaṅkāśaṃ bālavyajanamuttamam \|*  
*sarasvatī saricchreṣṭhā gajārūḍhā samādadhe \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The holiest river Sarasvati too rode on elephant with fan (camvara) analogous to Hamsa, Kunda and Indu.

## \|\| 53.13 \|\|

*ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ samādāya kusumaṃ gandhasaṃyutam \|*  
*pañcavarṇaṃ maheśānaṃ jagmuste kāmacāriṇaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The six seasons began to walk with procession with five-coloured fragrant flowers.

## \|\| 53.14 \|\|

*mattamairāvata nirbha gajamāruhya vegavān \|*  
*anulepanamādāya yayau tatra pṛthūdakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Prthudaka rode on elephant intoxicant as Airavata and began walking with smearing items (anulepana).

## \|\| 53.15 \|\|

*gandharvāstumbarumukhā gāyanto madhurasvaram \|*  
*anujagmurmahādevaṃ vādayantaśca kiṃnarāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Gandharvas including Tumbaru moved with singing melodious songs and Kinnara with plying on musical instruments. They were at the back side of Siva.

## \|\| 53.16 \|\|

*nṛtyantyo'psarasacaiva stuvanto munayaśca tam \|*  
*gandharvā yānti deveśaṃ triṇetraṃ śūlapāṇinam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The nymphs moved dancing and sages and Gandharva moved with chanting psalms on Stilapani Trilocana.

## \|\| 53.17-18 \|\|

*ekādaśa tathā koṭyo rudrāṇāṃ tatra vai yayuḥ \|*  
*dvādaśaivāditevānāmaṣṭau koṭyo vasūnapi \|\| 17 \|\|*

*saptaṣaṣṭistathāā koṭyo gaṇānāmṛṣisattama \|*  
*caturviṃśattathā jagmurṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. O great sages! Thus, eleven crore Rudras, twelve crore Adityas, eight crore Vasus, Sixty seven crore ganas and twenty four crore Udhrvareta hermit took departure from there.

## \|\| 53.19 \|\|

*asaṃkhyātāni yūthāni yakṣakinnararakṣasām \|*  
*anujagmurmaheśānaṃ vivāhāya samākulāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Yaksa, Kinnara and monsters were in uncountable groups and all were moved impatiently for the marriage of Siva. They were following god Sankara.

## \|\| 53.20 \|\|

*tataḥ kṣaṇena deveśaḥ kṣmādharādhipatestalam \|*  
*saṃprāptastvāgaman śailāḥ kuñjarasthāḥ samantataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The god of gods reached on Himalaya within second. The mountains rode on elephants had surrounded him from four sides.

## \|\| 53.21 \|\|

*tato nanāma bhagavāṃstriṇetraḥ sthāvarādhipam \|*  
*śailāḥ praṇemurīśānaṃ tato'sau mudito'bhavat \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. God Sankara saluted the king mountain and other mountains saluted Siva. He was filled with you.

## \|\| 53.22 \|\|

*samaṃ suraiḥ pārṣadaiśca viveśa vṛṣaketanaḥ \|*  
*nandinā darśite mārge śailarājapuraṃ mahat \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. God Sankara on bull entered in the grand palace of king mountain with gods and counsellors following Nandi the guide.

## \|\| 53.23 \|\|

*jīmūtaketurāyāta ityevaṃ nagarastriyaḥ \|*  
*nijaṃ karma parityajya darśanavyāpṛtābhavan \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The women living in city left their respective works and engrossed in seeing Jimutaketu Sankara, when the heard commotion of his arrival.

## \|\| 53.24 \|\|

*mālyarddhamanyā cādāya kareṇaikena bhāminī \|*  
*keśapāśaṃ dvitīyena śaṃkarābhimukhī gatā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A woman with half made garland in one hand and scattered hair on other, rushed towards Sankara.

## \|\| 53.25 \|\|

*anyā'laktakarāgāḍhyaṃ pādaṃ kṛtvākulekṣaṇā \|*  
*analaktakamekaṃ hi haraṃ draṣṭumupāgatā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Another woman was smearing mahavara on her feet but when she heard the commotion, forgot that she had smeared mahavara on a single foot.

## \|\| 53.26 \|\|

*ekenākṣṇā'ñjitenaiva śrutvā bhīmamupāgatam \|*  
*sāñjanāṃ ca pragṛhyānyā śalākāṃ suṣṭhu dhāvati \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. One more woman rushed towards Siva with Anjana on a eye and the pouch and splint for other eye.

## \|\| 53.27 \|\|

*anyā sarasanaṃ vāsaḥ pāṇinādāya sundarī \|*  
*unmattevāgamannagnā haradarśanalālasā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. In a passion to see Sankara, another woman had forgotten that she was changing apparels. She rushed naked with clothes on her hand.

## \|\| 53.28 \|\|

*anyā'tikrānta mīśānaṃ śrutvā stanabharālasā \|*  
*anindata ruṣā bālā yauvanaṃ svaṃ kṛśodarī \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. On thin loin virgin with heavy breasts felt uneasiness due to mature youth while running and began to condemn her youth for such disturbance in seeing Sankara.

## \|\| 53.29 \|\|

*itthaṃ sa nāgarastrīṇāṃ kṣobhaṃ saṃjanayan haraḥ \|*  
*jagāma vṛṣabhārūḍho divyaṃ śvaśuramandiram \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Sankara on bull thus, entered in the divine palace of his father-in-law by arousing passions in the heart of the women living in that city.

## \|\| 53.30 \|\|

*tataḥ praviṣṭaṃ prasamīkṣya śaṃbhuṃ śailendraveśmanyabalā bruvanti \|*  
*sthāne tapo duścaramambikāyā- śrīrṇaṃ mahāneva surastu śaṃbhuḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The women present in the palace said king mountain that the penance has been rightly observed as Sankara is indeed, a great god.

## \|\| 53.31 \|\|

*sa eṣa yenāṅgamanaṅgattāṃ kṛtaṃ kandarpanāmnaḥ kusumāyudhasya \|*  
*kratoḥ kṣayī dakṣavināśakarttā bhagākṣihā śūladharaḥ pinākī \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. This Sankara had once set in fire Kandarpa (god of sex). He is Kratuksayi, Daksa destroyer, Bhagaksi hanta, Suladhara and Pinaki.

## \|\| 53.32 \|\|

*namo namaḥ śaṃkara śūlapāṇe mṛgāricarmāmbara kālaśatro \|*  
*mahāhihārāṅgitakuṇḍalāya namo namaḥ pārvativallabhāya \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Sankara, the holder of trident, the wearer of the tiger’s skin, the subduer of Kala, the god of death, the wearer of the necklace and Kun

## \|\| 53.33 \|\|

*itthaṃ saṃstūyamānaḥ surapatividhṛtenātapatreṇa śaṃbhuḥ siddhairvandhaḥ sayakṣairahikṛtavalayī cārubhasmopaliptaḥ \|*  
*aggrasthenāggrajena pramuditamanasā viṣṇunā cānugena vaivāhīṃ maṅgalāḍhyāṃ hutavahamuditāmārurohātha vedīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. So propitiated and shadowed by umbrella held by Indra, adorable to Siddhas and Yaksas, with the bracelet of a snake, ash- smeared body, with Brahma delighted at heart before him, followed by Visnu, Siva went at the marital altar where sacred fire was blazing.

## \|\| 53.34 \|\|

*āyāti tripurāntake sahacaraiḥ sārdhaṃ ca saptarṣibhi vrvyagro'bhūgirirājaveśmani janaḥ kālyāḥ samālaṃkṛtau \|*  
*vyākulyaṃ samupāgatāśca girayaḥ pūjādinā devatāḥ prāyo vyākulitā bhavanti suhṛdaḥ kanyāvivāhotsukāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The citizen and inhabitants of palace were busy with making-up Kali, giving proper entertainment to gods when Siva visited there with his attendants and Saptarsis. The gentlemen usually keep them busy with serving the guests so came.

## \|\| 53.35 \|\|

*prasādhya devīṃ girijāṃ tataḥ striyo dukūlaśukkābhivṛtāṅgayaṣṭikām \|*  
*bhrātrā sunābhena tadotsave kṛte sā śaṃkarābhyāśamathopapāditā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The women decorated Parvati with white silk garments and her brother Sunabha took her to Sankara for marital rituals to be performed.

## \|\| 53.36 \|\|

*tataḥ śubhe harmyatale hiraṇmaye sthitāḥ surāḥ śaṃkarakāliceṣṭitam \|*  
*paśyanti devo'pi samaṃ kṛśāṅgayā lokānujuṣṭuṃ padamāsasāda \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The gods seated in gold studded palace began to see the marital rituals of Sankara and Parvati. Mahadeva too seated at the sacred place with thin body Parvati.

## \|\| 53.37 \|\|

*yatra krīḍā vicitrāḥ sukusumataravo vāriṇo bindupātai- rgandhānyairgandhacūrṇaiḥ praviralamavanau guṇṭhitau guṇḍikāyām muktādāmaiḥ prakāmaṃ haragiritanayā krīḍanārthaṃ tadā'ghnat paścāt sindūrapuñjaraviratavitataiścakratuḥ kṣmāṃ suraktām \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In a circled land duly decorated by beautiful flowers, Sankara and Parvati sprinkled water and fragrant scents on each other. They hit each other by Muktadama and then made the earth red by pouring vermilion.

## \|\| 53.38 \|\|

*e vaṃ krīḍāṃ haraḥ kṛtvā samaṃ ca girikanyayā \|*  
*āgacchad dakṣiṇāṃ vedimṛṣibhiḥ sevitāṃ dṛḍhām \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thus, Sankara with the daughter of Himalaya came at the south altar surrounded by Rsis when such playing was over.

## \|\| 53.39 \|\|

*athājagāma himavān śukkāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*pavitrapāṇirādāya madhuparkamathojjvalam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Then Himavan came there with white madhuparka. He had put Pavitrl and white garments on body.

## \|\| 53.40 \|\|

*upaviṣṭastrinetrastu śākrīṃ diśamapaśyata \|*  
*saptarṣikāṃśca śailendraḥ sūpaviṣṭo'valokayan \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Sankara was looking at east direction while seated and the king mountain took seat properly facing Saptarsis.

## \|\| 53.41 \|\|

*sukhāsīnasya śarvasya kṛtāñjalipuṭo giriḥ \|*  
*provāca vacanaṃ śrīmān dharmasādhanamātmanaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The mountain (Himalaya) with folded hands spoke words leading to virtue and merit to Sankara-

## \|\| 53.42 \|\|

*himavānuvāca- matputroṃ bhagavān kālīṃ pautrīṃ ca pulahāgraje \|*  
*pitṛṇāmapi dauhitrīṃ pratīcchemāṃ mayoditām \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Himavan said- О god! Please, accept the grand daughter of Pulahagraja, Pitara's daughter's daughter and my daughter being so given to you.

## \|\| 53.43 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamuktvā śailendro hastaṃ hastena yojayan \|*  
*prādāt pratīccha bhagavan idamudyairudīrayan \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Pulastya said- "With these words the king mountain joined the hand of Parvati with that of Sankara and pronounced loudly- О god! Accept her."

## \|\| 53.44 \|\|

*hara uvāca- na me'sti mātā na pitā tathaiva na jñātayo vā'pi ca bāndhavādyāḥ \|*  
*nirāśrayo'haṃ giriśṛṅgavāsī sutāṃ pratīcchāmi tavādrirāja \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Sankara said- О king mountain! I am without father, mother, coparceners or siblings. I live on the peak of a mountain lonely. I accept your daughter.

## \|\| 53.45 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā varado'vapīḍayat karaṃ kareṇādikumārikāyāḥ \|*  
*sā cāpi saṃsparśamavāpya śaṃbhoḥ parāṃ mudaṃ labdhavatī surarṣe \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. With these words, Sankara took the hand of Parvati in his hand. О divine hermit! A touch with Sankara's hand pleased her also.

## \|\| 53.46 \|\|

*tathā'dhirūḍho varado'tha vediṃ sahādriputryā madhuparkamaśnan \|*  
*dattvā ca lājān kalamasya śukkāṃ- stato viraccī girijāmuvāca \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Then Sankara seated on altar with mountain daughter while eating madhuparka. Then Brahma gave white fried paddy (khila) to Parvati and said-

## \|\| 53.47 \|\|

*kāli paśyasva vadanaṃ bhartu śaśadharaprabham \|*  
*samadṛṣṭiḥ sthirā kuruṣvāgneḥ pradakṣiṇam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О Kali look at the moon like face of your husband and do pradaksina (round turn) of fire by maintaining all equity in mind.

## \|\| 53.48 \|\|

*tato'mbikā haramukhe dṛṣṭe śaityamupāgatā \|*  
*yathā'rkaraśmisaṃtapta \|*  
*prāpya vṛṣṭimivāvanī \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. When Parvati looked at the face of Sankara, she felt herself so satiated as the earth satiates with water of rain after excessive warm by the sun.

## \|\| 53.49 \|\|

*bhūyaḥ prāha vibhorvaktramīkṣasveti pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*lajjayā sā'pi dṛṣṭeti śanairbrahmāṇamabravīt \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Pilamaha said again- "Look at the face of Vibhu." She hesitatingly replied- "I have seen".

## \|\| 53.50 \|\|

*samaṃ girijayā tena hutāśastriḥ pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*kṛto lājāśca haviṣā samaṃ kṣiptā hutāśane \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Parvati then made three Parikramas of fire and offered lava (khila) with the oblation (havisya) to fire.

## \|\| 53.51 \|\|

*tato harāṅghrirmālinyā gṛhīto dāyakāraṇāt \|*  
*kiṃ yācasi ca dāsyāmi muñcasveti haro'bravīt \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Malini caught the feet of Sankara with demand of Nega (reward). Sankara asked- " Leave my feet and ask what do you want. I will certainly give it to you."

## \|\| 53.52 \|\|

*mālinī śaṃkaraṃ prāha matsakhyā dehi śaṃkara \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ nijagotrīyaṃ tato mokṣamavāpsyasi \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Malini said- О Sankara! Give my friend the pleasure of your gotra. Only the, I will leave your feet.

## \|\| 53.53 \|\|

*athovāca mahādevo dattaṃ mālini muñca mām \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ nijagotrīyaṃ yo'syāstaṃ śṛṇu vacmi te \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Mahadeva said- О Malini! I have given it and please, leave my feet. I tell you her pleasure of gotra. Listen to it.

## \|\| 53.54 \|\|

*yo'sau pītāmbaradharaḥ śaṅkhadhṛṅ madhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*etadīyo hi saubhāgyo datto'madgotrameva hi \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. I give the prosperity of Madhusudana holding Pitambara and conch and my own gotra.

## \|\| 53.55 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane pramumoca vṛṣadhvajam \|*  
*mālinī nijagotrasya śubhacāritramālinī \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thus, the high conduct Malini left the feet of Sankara when he undertook properly and in expressive words.

## \|\| 53.56 \|\|

*yadā haro hi mālinyā gṛhītaścaraṇe śubhe \|*  
*tadā kālīmukhaṃ brahmā dadarśa śaśino'dhikam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Brahma saw the face of Kali, more beautiful than the moon when Malini had suddenly caught the feet of Sankara.

## \|\| 53.57 \|\|

*tad dṛṣṭvā kṣobhamagamat śukracyutimavāpa ca \|*  
*tacchukraṃ bālukāyāṃ ca khilīcakre sasādhvasaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. An attractive sight of Kali excited Brahma and his semen ejaculated. On account of fear, he covered the semen by throwing lump of sand on it.

## \|\| 53.58 \|\|

*tato'bravīddharo brahmanna dvijān hantumarhasi \|*  
*amī maharṣayo dhanyā bālakhilyāḥ pitāmaha \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Sankara knew the fact and said- О Brahman! Don’t slaughter Brahmins. These all are Balkhilya hermits, so graced by you.

## \|\| 53.59 \|\|

*tato maheśavākyānte samuttasthustapasvinaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi bālakhilyā iti smṛtāḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. As the statement of Sankara could over, there originated eighty eight thousand Balkhilya ascetics from the sand.

## \|\| 53.60 \|\|

*tato vivāhe nirvṛtte praviṣṭaḥ kautukaṃ haraḥ \|*  
*reme sahomayā rātri prabhāte punarutthitaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Sankara went Kautukagara (isolated place) when marriage was fully solemnised. He enjoyed courtship with Parvati at night and got up early in the next morning.

## \|\| 53.61 \|\|

*tato'driputrīṃ samavāpya śaṃbhuḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃ bhūtagaṇaiśca hṛṣṭaḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjitaḥ parvatapārthivena sa mandaraṃ śīghghramupājagāma \|\| 61 \|\|*

## \|\| 54.71-72 \|\|

*mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya tataḥ śarvo'bravīdumām \|*  
*nāyakena vinā devi mayā bhūto'pi putrakaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*yasmājjātastato nāmnā bhaviṣyati vināyakaḥ \|*  
*eṣa vighnasahasrāṇi surādīnāṃ kariṣyati \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. Sambhu smelt his head and said- О goddess! You son has bom without Nayaka (womb). Hence, he will be addressed as Vinayaka. He will remove the several hundred types of hurdles usually appearing while executing noble deeds.

## \|\| 54.73-75 \|\|

*pūjayivyanti caivāsya lokā devi carācakarāḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā devyāstu dattavāṃstanayāya hi \|\| 73 \|\|*

*sahāyaṃ tu gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ ghaṭodaram \|*  
*tathā mātṛgaṇā ghorā bhūtā vighnakararāṣśca ye \|\| 74 \|\|*

*te sarve parameśena devyāḥ prītyopapāditāḥ \|*  
*devī ca svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā parāṃ mudamavāpa ca \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. О goddess! The entire movable and immovable world will adore him. With these words, Sambhu nominated Vinayaka as Ghatodara, the principal gana and gross Matrganas and Bhutas responsible for hurdles were made his assistants. In order to win the heart of Uma, god Sankara originated all of them. They goddess too pleased to see her son so honoured.

## \|\| 54.76 \|\|

*reme'tha śaṃbhunā sārddha mandire cārukandare \|*  
*evaṃ bhūyo'bhavaddevī iyaṃ kātyāyanī vibho \|*  
*yā jaghāna mahādaityau purā śumbhaniśumbhakau \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The goddess then began to enjoy sex with Sambhu on Mandaracala having a number of beautiful cares. О Vibhu! Similarly, the goddess Katyayani was originated who had killed two fierce demons Sumbha and Nisumbha during long past.

## \|\| 54.78 \|\|

*etattavoktaṃ vacanaṃ śubhāṣyaṃ yathodbhavaḥ parvatato mṛḍānyāḥ \|*  
*svaryaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca tathā'ghahāri ākhyānamūrjaskaramadriputryāḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. I have explained the sacred episode pertaining to birth of Mrdani from a mountain. This episode renders with heaven and fame, It is sin absolving and glorious.

## Chapter 55. The story of Sumbha-Nisumbha and slaying of Canda and Munda

## \|\| 55.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- kaśyapasya danurnāmnā bhāryāsīd dvijasattama \|*  
*tasyāḥ putratrayaṃ cāsīt sahasrākṣād balādhikam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О great dvija! Danu was the wife of Kasyapa. She gave birth to three sons who were mightier than Indra.

## \|\| 55.2 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhaḥ śumbha iti khyāto niśumbhaścāparo'suraḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyo namucirnāma mahābalasamanvitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The eldest among them was Kumbha, the middle was Nisumbha and the youngest and third number son was Namuci.

## \|\| 55.3 \|\|

*yo'sau namucirityevaṃ khyāto danusuto'suraḥ \|*  
*taṃ hantumicchati hariḥ pragṛhya kuliśaṃ kare \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Indra wished killing Namuci, the famous son of Danu by a hard blow of thunderbolt.

## \|\| 55.4 \|\|

*tridiveśaṃ samāyāntaṃ namucistadbhayādatha \|*  
*praviveśa rathaṃ bhānostato nāśakadacyutaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. When Indra was proceeding ahead, Namuci saw him and entered in the sun chariot under influence of fright. Due to this cause, he could not kill him.

## \|\| 55.5 \|\|

*śakrastenātha samayaṃ cakre saha mahātmanā \|*  
*avadhyatvaṃ varaṃ prādācchastrairastraiśca nārada \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Narada! The great soul Indra then established an alliance with him and booned him that the arms and weapons will prove futile to kill him.

## \|\| 55.6 \|\|

*tato'vadhyatvamājñāya śastrādastrāca nāradaḥ \|*  
*saṃtyajya bhāskararathaṃ pātālamudayādatha \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Narada! When that monster was confirmed of the fact that he cannot be kill by arms and weapons, he left the shelter of sun's chariot and entered into nether.

## \|\| 55.7 \|\|

*sa nimajjannapi jale sāmudraṃ phenamuttamam \|*  
*dadṛśe dānavapatistaṃ pragṛhyedamabravīt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. That demon saw the best white foam of the sea while immersed in water. He got hold of it and wished-

## \|\| 55.8-9 \|\|

*yaduktaṃ devapatinā vāsavena vaco'stu tat \|*  
*ayaṃ spṛśatu māṃ phenaḥ karābhyāṃ gṛhya dānavaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*mukhanāsākṣikarṇādīn saṃmamārja yathecchayā \|*  
*tasmiñchakro'sṛjad vajramantarhitamapīśvaraḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. May that all fructify as king god Indra has booned. May this froth touch me. With these words, the monster took froth in his both hands and started smearing it on his mouth, nose and ears etc. God Indra originated secretly his thunderbolt within that froth.

## \|\| 55.10 \|\|

*tenāsau bhagnanāsāsyaḥ papāta ca mamāra ca \|*  
*samaye ca tathā naṣṭe brahmahatyā' spṛśanddharim \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Не fell down dead as his nose and mouth both were split. Indra fell in sin of Brahmins murder as his promise was breached.

## \|\| 55.11 \|\|

*sa vai tīrthaṃ samāsādya snātaḥ pāpādamucyata \|*  
*tato'sya bhrātarau vīrau kruddhau śumbhaniśumbhakau \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Не could efface his sins when visited at holy places and took bath there. When his elder brothers sumbha and Nisumbha heard this mystery, they filled with anger.

## \|\| 55.12 \|\|

*udyogaṃ sumahatkṛtvā surān bādhitumāgatau \|*  
*surāste'pi sahasrākṣaṃ puraskṛtya viniryayuḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*
