12\. Both of them raided on the gods with intention to kill them all. The gods under leadership of Indra also marched forward to face them.

## \|\| 55.13-14 \|\|

*jitāstvākramya daityābhyāṃ sabalāḥ sapadānugāḥ \|*  
*śakrasyāhṛtya ca gajaṃ yāmyaṃ ca mahiṣaṃ balāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

*varuṇasya maṇicchatraṃ gadāṃ vai mārutasya ca \|*  
*nidhayaḥ padmaśaṅkhadyā hṛtāstvākramya dānavaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Both those monsters gave a hard defeat to all gods including their army and the major commanders. They seized the elephant from Indra, buffalo from Yama, gem-studded umbrella from Varuna, Gads from Vayu and tolus, conch etc. rare wealth of gods by a fierce attack.

## \|\| 55.15-16 \|\|

*trailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ cāste tābhyāṃ nārada sarvataḥ \|*  
*tadājagmurmahīpṛṣṭhaṃ dadṛśuste mahāsuram \|\| 15 \|\|*

*raktabījamathocuste ko bhavāniti so'bravīt \|*  
*sa cāha daityo'smi vibho sacivo mahiṣasya tu \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. О Narada! Both of them enslaved the three- worlds. They then came down on the earth, saw Raktabija and asked him- "Who are you?" He replied- О sovereign king! I am a demon and minister to Mahisisura.

## \|\| 55.17-19 \|\|

*raktabījeti vikhyāto mahāvīryo mahābhujaḥ \|*  
*amātyau rucirau vīrau caṇḍamuṇḍāviti śrutau \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tāvāstāṃ salile magnau bhayāddevyā mahābhujau \|*  
*yastvāsīt prabhurasmākaṃ mahiṣo nāma dānavaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nihataḥ sa mahādevyā vidhyaśaile suvistṛte \|*  
*bhavantau kasya tanayau kau vā nāmnā pariśrutau \|*  
*kiṃvīryo kiṃprabhāvau ca etacchaṃsiturmahathaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. I am most valorous and huge armed demon and famous as Raktabija in the world. The two ministers of Mahisasura named Canda and Munda have immersed deep in water as they feared of goddess. Mahadevi has also killed our king Mahisa at Vindhya mountain. Tell me that who is your father and what is your popular name? To what extent you are valorous and influencive in term of physical power?

## \|\| 55.20 \|\|

*śumbhaniśumbhāvūcatuḥ ahaṃ śumbha iti khyāto danoḥ putrastathaurasaḥ \|*  
*niśumbho'yaṃ mama bhrātā kanīyān śatrupūgahā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Sumbha and Nisumbha replied- I am wedlock son of Danu and popularly addressed as Sumbha. This is my younger brother popularly known as Nisumbha. He is killer of enemies.

## \|\| 55.21 \|\|

*anena bahuśo devāḥ sendrarudradivākarāḥ \|*  
*sametya nirjitā vīrā ye'nye ca balavattarāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. This Nisumbha has defeated several times the great gods like Indra, Rudra, Divakara etc. and many other powerful warriors.

## \|\| 55.22 \|\|

*taducyatāṃ kayā daityo nihato mahiṣāsuraḥ \|*  
*yāvattāṃ ghātayiṣyāvaḥ svasainyaparivāritau \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Tell me now that who is the woman you say killed Mahisasura. Both of us will go with our army and kill that woman.

## \|\| 55.23 \|\|

*itthaṃ tayostu vadatornarmadāyāstaṭe mune \|*  
*jalavāsādviniṣkāntau caṇḍamuṇḍau ca dānavau \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О sage! When these monster were talking mutually, the monster Canda and Munda came out from the river.

## \|\| 55.24-25 \|\|

*tato'bhyetyā suraśreṣṭhau raktabījaṃ samāśritau \|*  
*ūcaturvacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ ko'yaṃ tava purassaraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sa cobhau prāha daityo'sau śumbho nāma surārddanaḥ \|*  
*kanīyānasya ca bhrātā dvitīyo hi niśumbhakaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. They went near Raktabija and asked humbly- "Who is this stood beside you? He replied- It is Kumbha and that is Nisumbha, his younger brother. These have defeated the gods several times.

## \|\| 55.26 \|\|

*etāvāśritya tāṃ duṣṭāṃ mahiṣaghnoṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ vivāhayiṣyāmi ratnabhūtāṃ jagattraye \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. I will undoubtedly make that wicked Mahisasura killer but beautiful woman with assistance of these two monsters.

## \|\| 55.27 \|\|

*caṇḍa uvāca- na samyaguktaṃ bhavatā ratnārho'si na sāmpratam \|*  
*yaṃ prabhuḥ syātsa ratnārhastasmācchumbhāya yojyatām \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Canda said- "You have not said right. You are still incompetent to get that gem. Only a king is able to receive such gem. Hence, think this only for Kumbha.

## \|\| 55.28 \|\|

*tadācacakṣe śumbhāya niśumbhāya ca kauśikīm \|*  
*bhūyo'pi tadvidhāṃ jātāṃ kauśikī rūpaśālinīm \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. They described then Kausiki so originated before Kumbha and Nisumbha.

## \|\| 55.29 \|\|

*tataḥ śumbho nijaṃ dūtaṃ sugrīvaṃ nāma dānavam \|*  
*daityaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa sakāśaṃ vindhyavāsinīm \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Then Kumbha sent his messenger, the demon Sugriva to Vindhyavasini.

## \|\| 55.30 \|\|

*sa gatvā tadvacaḥ śrutvā devyāgatya mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*niśumbhaśumbhāvāhedaṃ manyunābhipariplutaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. That monster went there, became furious when heard otherwise from goddess and with burning in anger he said to Kumbha and Nisumbha.

## \|\| 55.31-34 \|\|

*sugrīva uvāca- yuvayorvacanāddevī pradeṣṭuṃ daityanāyakau \|*  
*gatavānahamadyaiva tāmahaṃ vākyamabruvam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*yathā śumbho'tivikhyātaḥ kakudmī dānavevvapi \|*  
*sa tvāṃ prāha mahābhāge prabhurasmi jagattraye \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yāni svarge mahīpṛṣṭhe pātāle cāpi sundari \|*  
*ratnāni santi tāvanti mama veśmani nityaśaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tvamuktā caṇḍamuṇḍābhyāṃ ratnabhūtā kṛśodari \|*  
*tasmādbhajasva māṃ vā tvaṃ niśumbhaṃ vā mamānujam \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. Sugriva said- О commanders of monster! I had gone to goddess as suggested by you all. I said to her- О luckiest virgin! Kumbha, the greatest monster has communicated to you- "I am the ruler of three-worlds. О beautiful lady! All gems once had with heaven, earth and nether are always stored in my treasure. О thin loin lady! Canda and Munda have told you a gem. Hence, choose either me or my younger brother for being your husband.

## \|\| 55.35 \|\|

*sā cāha māṃ vihasatī śṛṇu sugrīva madvacaḥ \|*  
*satyamuktaṃ trilokeśaḥ śumbho ratnāī eva ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. She laughed and replied me- О Sugriva! Listen to me. You have truly said that the ruler of three-world Sumbha is capable to keep gem with him.

## \|\| 55.36 \|\|

*kiṃ tvasti durvinītāyā hṛdaye me manorathaḥ \|*  
*yo māṃ vijayate yuddhe sa bhartā syānmahāsura \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. But О great monster! I have promised to marry with a man who will defeat me in battle. I cannot deviate from this promise.

## \|\| 55.37 \|\|

*mayā coktā'valiptā'si yo jayet sasurāsurān \|*  
*sa tvāṃ kathaṃ na jayate sā tvamuttiṣṭha bhāmini \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. I said to her- "You have become proudy. The monster who has conquered all gods and demons will in fact, conquer you also. Hence, О beautiful spinster! "Please stand-up."

## \|\| 55.38 \|\|

*sā'tha māṃ prāha kiṃ kurmiṃ yadanālocitaḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*manorathastu tadgaccha śumbhāya tvaṃ nivedaya \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. She then said to me- "What should I do? I have resolved without giving mind to the possibilities otherwise. Hence, go and report Sumbha as stated by me.

## \|\| 55.39 \|\|

*tayaivamuktastvabhyāgāṃ tvatsakāśaṃ mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*sā cāgnikoṭisadṛśī matvaivaṃ kuru yatkṣamam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Hence, О great monster! I have come to you for reporting the same as she said. She is like blazing flame. Please, take in notice the report and do as you think good.

## \|\| 55.40 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- iti sugrīvavacanaṃ niśamya sa mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*prāha dūrasthitaṃ śumbho dānavaṃ dhūmralocanam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Pulastya said- Having heard the report, that great monster Sumbha, said Dhumralocana who was at some distance from him.

## \|\| 55.41 \|\|

*śumbha uvāca- dhūmrākṣa gaccha tāṃ duṣṭāṃ keśākarṣaṇavihvalām \|*  
*sāparādhāṃ yathā dāsīṃ kṛtvā śīghramihānaya \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Kumbha said- О Dhumraksa! go there immediately and bring here that rude like slave by catching her hair in fist.

## \|\| 55.42 \|\|

*yaścāsyāḥ pakṣakṛt kaścidbhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ \|*  
*sa hantavyo'vicāryaiva yadi hi syātpitāmahaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. If any powerful man would stand on his favour, kill him without thinking otherwise. Don't care even if that man would Brahma himself.

## \|\| 55.43 \|\|

*sa evamuktaḥ śumbhena dhūmrākṣo'kṣauhiṇīśataiḥ \|*  
*vṛtaḥ vadbhirmahātejā vindhyaṃ girimupādravat \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Dhumraksa endowed with great splendour, went at Vindhya mountain with an army numbered as six hundred Aksauhini.

## \|\| 55.44 \|\|

*sa tatra dṛṣṭvā tāṃ durgā bhrāntadṛṣṭiruvāca ha \|*  
*ehohi mūḍhe bhartāraṃ śumbhamicchasva kauśiki \|*  
*na ced balānnayiṣyāmi keśākarṣaṇavihvalām \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. On seeing Kausiki he fell in illusion and said- О Idiot! Come immediately. Kausiki! Penetrate a wish to see Kumbha your husband. In case, you deny, I will grip your hair forcibly and carry there."

## \|\| 55.45 \|\|

*śrīdevyuvāca- preṣito'sīha śumbhena balānnetuṃ hi māṃ kila \|*  
*tatra kiṃ hyabalā kuryādyathecchasi tathā kuru \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Srldevi said- It is certain that Sumbha has sent you for carrying me forcibly. What can a weak woman do now? Do as you wish.

## \|\| 55.46 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- evamukto vibhāvaryā balavān dhūmralocanaḥ \|*  
*samabhyadhāvat tvarito gadāmādāya vīryavān \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Pulastya said- Dhumralocana rushed with mace towards here when he heard such reply

## \|\| 55.47 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ sagadaṃ huṃkāreṇaiva kauśikī \|*  
*sabalaṃ bhasmasāccakre śuṣkamagnirivendhanam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Kausiki made a ear-piercing voice from her mouth and burnt him with army as the fire burns the dry fuel into ash.

## \|\| 55.48 \|\|

*tato hāhākṛtamabhūjjagatyasmiñcarācare \|*  
*sabalaṃ bhasmasāntrītaṃ kauśikyā vīkṣya dānavam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Having observed the scene so created by Kausiki by burning that mighty monster with his army, the entire universe including movable and immovable organisms frightened severally.

## \|\| 55.49-54 \|\|

*taca śumbho'pi śuśrāva mahacchabdamudīritam \|*  
*athādideśa balinau caṇḍamuṇḍau mahāsurau \|\| 49 \|\|*

*ruruṃ ca balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathā jagmurmudā'nvitāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ ca sainyamatulaṃ gajāśvarathasaṃkulam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*samājagāma sahasā yatrāste kośasaṃbhavā \|*  
*tadāyāntaṃ ripubalaṃ dṛṣṭvā koṭiśatāvaram \|\| 51 \|\|*

*siṃho'dravad dhutasaṭaḥ pāṭayan dānavān raṇe \|*  
*kāṃścit karaprahāreṇa kāṃścidāsyena līlayā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*nakharaiḥ kāṃścidākramya urasā pramamātha ca \|*  
*te vadhyamānāḥ siṃhena girikandaravāsinā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*bhūteśca devyanucaraiścaṇḍamuṇḍau samāśrayan \|*  
*tāvārtta svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kopaprasphuritādharau \|\| 54 \|\|*

49-54. Surnbha also heard that loud voice. He then ordered marching Canda and Munda with powerful monsters as also the mightiest monster Ruru. They marched happily. Their unique army with elephants, horses and chariots shortly got that place where Kausiki was present. When the lion running fast and piercing their bodies. He very artfully knocked down some soldiers by slapping, some other by mouth, some with nails and some others with hitting by his chest. They all so being killed by the care dwelling lion and the ghost assisting goddess ran away to Canda and Munda. When they saw their army so troubled they became dangerous with fury and their lips began oscillation.

## \|\| 55.55 \|\|

*samādravetāṃ durgā vai pataṅgāviva pāvakam \|*  
*tāvāpatantau raudrau vai dṛṣṭvā krodhapariplutā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Both monsters rushed fast towards goddess as moth rushes towards flame. The goddess became angry to see those fierce monsters forwarding.

## \|\| 55.56 \|\|

*triśikhāṃ bhukuṭīṃ vaktre cakāra parameśvarī \|*  
*bhukuṭīkuṭilāddevyā lalāṭaphalakād drutam \|*  
*kālī karālavadanā niḥsṛttā yoginī śubhā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The goddess raised her three lined brow up. From the curved brow in forehead, Yogini Kali came out immediately. Her mouth was looking most dangerous.

## \|\| 55.57 \|\|

*khaṭvāṅgamādāya kareṇa raudra- masiñca kālāñjanakośamugram \|*  
*saṃśuṣkagātrā rudhirāplutāṅgī narendra mūrdhyā srajamudvahantī \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. A fierce Khatvanga and aggressive sword with holder like Kalanjana were in her hands. Her body was dried and blood strained and there was a garland of the kings heads on her neck.

## \|\| 55.58 \|\|

*kāṃścit khaṅgena ciccheda khaṭvāṅgena parān raṇe \|*  
*nyaṣūdavad bhṛśaṃ kruddhā sarathāśvagajān ripūn \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. She furiated and killed some of the enemies consisting of elephant, chariot and horses by blows of sword and some other by Khatvanga.

## \|\| 55.59 \|\|

*carmāḍkuśaṃ mudgaraṃ ca sadhanuṣkaṃ saghaṇṭikam \|*  
*kuñjaraṃ saha yantreṇa pracikṣepa mukhe'mbikā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Then Ambika began to throw in her mouth the elephant with carma, goad, Mudgara, bow, gongs and yantra.

## \|\| 55.60 \|\|

*sacakrakūbararathaṃ sasārathituraṅgamam \|*  
*samaṃ yodhena vadane kṣipya carvayate'mbikā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. She put in her mouth the chariot with its wheels and structure, the horses and warriors and began chewing.

## \|\| 55.61 \|\|

*ekaṃ jagrāha keśeṣu grīvāyāmaparaṃ tathā \|*  
*pādenākramya caivānyaṃ preṣayāmāsa mṛtyave \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. She called death for some by gripping hair, some by pressing neck and some others by hitting hard through feet.

## \|\| 55.62-63 \|\|

*tatastu tadbalaṃ devyā bhakṣitaṃ sabalādhipam \|*  
*rururdṛṣṭvā pradudrāva taṃ caṇḍī dadṛśe svayam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*ājaghānātha śirasi khaṭvāṅgena mahāsuram \|*  
*sa papāta hato bhūmyāṃ chinnamūla iva dumaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. When Ruru saw that dreadful scene in which the entire army was being so churned by goddess, he immediately rushed there Candl saw him forwarding and gave a hard blow of Khatvanga on his head. He fell down on ground like a fallen tree cut-off at root. Thus, he was dead.

## \|\| 55.64 \|\|

*tatastaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā paśoriva vibhāvarī \|*  
*kośamutkartayāmāsa karṇādicaraṇāntikam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The goddess cut-off the portion of his body from ears to the feet when saw him on the ground. It was done just as hide of a dead animal is pulled out.

## \|\| 55.65 \|\|

*sā ca kośaṃ samādāya babandha vimalā jaṭāḥ \|*  
*ekā na bandhamagamattāmutpāṭyākṣipadbhuvi \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. She tied her matted hair with that hide (skin). A matted hair was escaped from tie-up. Hence, she pulled in from root and threw on the ground.

## \|\| 55.66 \|\|

*sā jātā sutarāṃ raudrī tailābhyaktaśiroruhā \|*  
*kṛṣṇārthamarthaśuklaṃ ca dhārayantī svakaṃ vapuḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. That portion of her matted hair turned into a fierce goddess. Her hair were soaked in oil and her half body was dark while another half was fair (white).

## \|\| 55.67 \|\|

*sā'bravīdvaramekaṃ tu mārayāmi mahāsuram \|*  
*tasyā nāma tadā cakre caṇḍamārīti viśrutam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. She said- “I shall rather kill atleast one great monster.” The goddess had since then addressed by the name, Candamari.

## \|\| 55.68 \|\|

*prāha gacchasva subhage caṇḍamuṇḍāvihānaya \|*  
*svayaṃ hi mārayiṣyāmi tāvānetuṃ tvamarhasi \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The goddess said- О Subhage! Bring her Canda and Munda. I will kill them myself. You are capable to bring them here.

## \|\| 55.69 \|\|

*śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ devyāḥ sā'bhyadravata tāvubhau \|*  
*pradudruvaturbhayāttau diśamāśritya dakṣiṇām \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. She rush there when so ordered by the goddess. Both of them ran away in fear towards south.

## \|\| 55.70 \|\|

*tatastāvapi vegena prādhāvattyaktvāsasau \|*  
*sā'dhiruhya mahāvegaṃ rāsabhaṃ garuḍopamam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Candamari then rode on donkey as fast as eagle in running, chased them fiercely. She was naked in body.

## \|\| 55.71 \|\|

*yato gatau hi tau daityau tatraivānuyayau śivā \|*  
*sā dadarśa tadā pauṇḍraṃ mahiṣaṃ vai yamasya ca \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Goddess chased them at every place wherever they go. Finally, she saw Paundra buffalo on Yama there.

## \|\| 55.72 \|\|

*sā tasyotpāṭayāmāsa viṣāṇaṃ bhujagākṛtim \|*  
*taṃ pragṛhya kareṇaiva dānavānanvagājjavāt \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. She pulled up the serpentine horn of that buffalo and rushed after those monsters with that horn in her hand.

## \|\| 55.73 \|\|

*tau cāpi bhūmi saṃtyajya jagmaturgagarne tadā \|*  
*vegenābhisṛtā sā ca rāsabhena maheśvarī \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Both monsters left the earth then and approached to the ether. Mahesvari chased them rapidly there also.

## \|\| 55.74 \|\|

*tato dadarśa garuḍaṃ pannagendraṃ ciṣādiṣum \|*  
*karkoṭakaṃ sa dṛṣcaiva ūrdhvaromā vyajāyata \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The goddess saw Garuda, a predator of Karkotaka the serpent king. He was stunned when saw the goddess in such fierce form.

## \|\| 55.75 \|\|

*bhayānmāryāśca garuḍo māṃsapiṇḍopamo babhau \|*  
*nyapataṃstasya patrāṇi raudrāṇi hi patattriṇaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The Garuda became as dull as a piece of flesh an account of fear. His wings were fell in sheer fright.

## \|\| 55.76 \|\|

*khagendrapatrāṇyādāya nāgaṃ karkoṭakaṃ tathā \|*  
*vegenānusarahevī caṇḍamuṇḍau bhayāturau \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. With wings of Garuda and serpent Karkot aka, the goddess continuously chased the frightened Canda and Munda.

## \|\| 55.77 \|\|

*saṃprāptau ca tadā devyā caṇḍamuṇḍau mahāsurau \|*  
*baddhau karkoṭakenaiva baddhavā vindhyamupāgamat \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The goddess then reached at Canda and Munda, the great monsters she fastened them by the serpent Karkotaka and brought at the mountain of Vindhya.

## \|\| 55.78-79 \|\|

*nivedayitvā kauśikyaiḥ kośamādāya bhairavam \|*  
*śirobhirdānvendrāṇāṃ tārśvapatraiśca śobhanaiḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*kṛtvā srajamanaupamyāṃ caṇḍikāyai nyavedayat \|*  
*ghargharāṃ ca mṛgendrasya carmaṇaḥ sā samārpayat \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. She offered these monsters to the goddess Kausiki, made an excellent garland of the monsters' heads and Garuda's wings intertwined in the thread made of their skin and offered it also to goddess Kausiki. She further offered a Ghaghara made of tiger's hide to her.

## \|\| 55.80 \|\|

*srajamanyāṃ khagendrasya patrairmūrdhni nibadhya ca \|*  
*ātmanā sā papau pānaṃ rudhiraṃ dānaveṣvapi \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. She made another garland from the wings of Garuda, tied it around her head and began to suck the blood of monsters.

## \|\| 55.81 \|\|

*caṇḍaṃ tvādāya caṇḍaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ cāsuranāyakam \|*  
*cakāra kupitā durgā viśiraskau mahāsurau \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The Pracanda Durga then gripped Canda and the commander of monster's army Munda and cut-off their heads in a fit of anger.

## \|\| 55.82 \|\|

*tayorevāhinā devī śekharaṃ śuṣkarevatī \|*  
*kṛtvā jagāma kauśikyāḥ sakāśaṃ māryayā saha \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The goddess 3uskarevatl approached to Kausiki with Candamari and an ornament for her which was a garland made up of their heads intertwined with the thread of serpent.

## \|\| 55.83 \|\|

*sametya sā'bravīddevi gṛhyatāṃ śekharottamaḥ \|*  
*grathito daityaśīrṣābhyā nāgarājena veṣṭitaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. They said when approached there- О goddess! Accept this best head ornament intertwined with the serpent king in which heads are fixed.

## \|\| 55.84 \|\|

*taṃ śekharaṃ śivā gṛhya cāmuṇḍā mūrdhni vistṛtam \|*  
*babandha prāha caivaināṃ kṛtaṃ karma sudāruṇam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The goddess Siva fastened that head ornament around Camunda's head and said- "You have really executed the most fierce work."

## \|\| 55.85 \|\|

*śekharaṃ caṇḍamuṇḍābhyāṃ yasmāddhārayase śubham \|*  
*tasmālloke tava khyātiścāmuṇḍeti bhaviṣyati \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. As you have put a good head ornament of Canda and Munda's head, you will gain popularity as Camunda in this world.

## \|\| 55.86 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ trinetrā sā caṇḍamuṇḍasrajadhāriṇīṃ vai \|*  
*digvāsasaṃ cābhyavadat pratītā niṣūdaya svāribalānyamūni \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. That goddess holding the garland of Canda and Munda's heads was so address by Kausiki and then said to Digambara- "Kill your these armies of enemy."

## \|\| 55.87 \|\|

*sā tvevamuktā'tha viṣāṇakoṭyā suvegayuktena ca rāsanena \|*  
*niṣūdayantī ripusainyamugraṃ cacāra cānyanasurāṃścakhādā \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Accepting this order, that goddess with fast running Rasahha began to kill the aggressive army of enemy from the fore-point of Visana and started eating the bodies of monsters-.

## \|\| 55.88 \|\|

*tato'mbikāyāstvatha caṇḍamuṇḍā māryā ca siṃhena ca bhūtasaṃdhaiḥ \|*  
*nipātyamānā danupuṃgavāste kakudminaṃ śumbhamupāśrayantam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The warrior monsters sheltered to their commander Sumbha when Ambika, her attendants, Carmamunda Mari, lion and Bhutas had began thrashing them so badly.

## Chapter 56. Killing of Rakta-bija, Nisumbha and Sumbha

## \|\| 56.1-2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- caṇḍamuṇḍau ca nihatau dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ ca vidrutam \|*  
*samādideśātivalaṃ raktabījaṃ mahāsuram \|*  
*akṣauhiṇīnāṃ triṃśadbhiḥ koṭibhiḥ parivāritam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tamāpatantaṃ daityānāṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva caṇḍikā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Pulastya said- When Kumbha saw Canda and Munda dead and the soldiers so anxious and troubled, he ordered Raktabija to attack on the goddess. When Mahesvari Candika saw the thirty crore Aksauhini army marching forward for attack, she along with those other goddesses made a loud voice as roaring of a lion.

## \|\| 56.3-4 \|\|

*mumoca siṃhanādaṃ vai tābhyā saha maheśvarī \|*  
*ninadatyāstato devyā brahmāṇī mukhato'bhavat \|*  
*haṃsayuktavimānasthā sākṣasūtra kamaṇḍaluḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*māheśvarī trinetrā ca vṛṣārūḍhā triśūlinī \|*  
*mahāhivalayā raudrā jātā kuṇḍalinī kṣaṇāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. At the time of so mouth opening for loud roaring, Brahmani rode on swan with basil garland and Kamandalu in hands as also Mahesvari rode on bull, three eyed, with trident, serpent bangle and earring were originated from other.

## \|\| 56.5 \|\|

*kaṇṭhādatha ca kaumārī barhipatrā ca śaktinī samudbhūtā ca devarṣe mayūravaravāhanā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O divine sage! Kaumari decorated with peacock wings, holding sakti, riding on peacock was originated from her throat.

## \|\| 56.6 \|\|

*bāhubhyāṃ garuḍārūḍhā śaṅkhacakragadāsinī \|*  
*śārṅgabāṇadharā jātā vaiṣṇavī rūpaśālinī \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The Vaisnavi sakti originated from both arms of the goddess. She was on Garuda and conch, discus, mace, sword and bow and arrows were in her hands.

## \|\| 56.7 \|\|

*mahogramuśalā raudrā daṃṣṭrollikhitabhūtalā \|*  
*vārāhī pṛṣṭhato jātā śeṣanāgopari sthitā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. From the back of Kausiki, there originated Varahi sakti. She was on Sesanaga, musala in her hand and he jaws began piercing the earth.

## \|\| 56.8 \|\|

*vajrāṅkaśodyatarā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā \|*  
*jātā gajendrapṛṣṭhasthā māhendrī stanamaṇḍalāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. From her breasts, there appeared Mahendri sakti. She was on elephant thunderbolt and goad on her hands and decorated by varied variety of ornaments.

## \|\| 56.9 \|\|

*vikṣipantī saṭākṣaipairgrahanakṣatratārakāḥ \|*  
*nakhinī hṛdayājjātā nārasiṃhī sudāruṇā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. From her heart there appeared fierce Narsimhi sakti goddess. She was originated through the heart beating of goddess Kausiki. She began frightening the stars, constellations and galaxy with her acute and lengthy nails.

## \|\| 56.10-14 \|\|

*tābhirnipātyamānaṃ tu nirīkṣya balamāsuram \|*  
*nanāda bhūyo nādānvai caṇḍikā nirbhayā ripūn \|*  
*tanninādaṃ mahacchrutvā trailokyapratipūrakam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*samājagāma deveśaḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ \|*  
*abhyetya vandya caivaināṃ prāha vākyaṃ tadā'mbike \|\| 11 \|\|*

*samāyāto'smi vai durge dehyājñāṃ kiṃ karomi te \|*  
*tadvākyasamakālaṃ ca devyā dehodbhavā śivā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*jātā sā cāha deveśaṃ gaccha dautyena śaṃkara \|*  
*brūhi śumbhaṃ niśumbhaṃ ca yadi jīvitumicchya \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tadgacchadhvaṃ durācārāḥ saptamaṃ hi rasātalam \|*  
*vāsavo labhatāṃ svargaṃ devāḥ santu gatavyathāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. Candika made an hear piercing roar when see saw that the goddess (saktis) killing enemies and the monsters army. When Mahadeva, the three eyed god with trident in his hand, heard such sound shivering three- worlds, he came to goddess, saluted her and said- "О Ambika! О Durga! I have come. What good should I do for you? Order me." As the words could over, there appeared suddenly Siva from the body of Kausiki. She said to Mahadeva- "O Sankara! Go as a messenger to Kumbha and Nisumbha say them to enter into nether if they want to live anymore. It will facilitate Indra to regain the heaven and it will abolish the pains of gods.

## \|\| 56.15-17 \|\|

*yajantu brāhmaṇādyāmī varṇā yajñāṃśca sāmpratam \|*  
*nocedbalāvalepena bhavanto yoddhamicchtha \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tadāgacchadhvamavyagrā eṣā'haṃ viniṣūdaye \|*  
*yatastu sā śivaṃ dautye nyayojayata nārada \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tato nāma mahādevyāḥ śivadūtītyajāyata \|*  
*te cāpi śaṃkaravacaḥ śrutvā garvasamanvitam \|*  
*huṃkṛtvā'bhyadravansarve yatra kātyāyanī sthitā \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. These Brahmins will then able to perform their yajna. In case, they still want fighting them say then to proceed forward immediately. I will kill them without any more inconvenience. О Narada! As the goddess made Siva her messenger, she was called Sivaduti. When those monsters heard the proudy averment of goddess from Siva. They all rushed with a loud noise toward Katyayani.

## \|\| 56.18 \|\|

*tataḥ śaraiḥ śaktibhiraṅkuśaivaraiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ śūlabhuśuṇḍipaṭṭiśaiḥ \|*  
*prāsaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ paridhaiśca vistṛtai- rvavarṣaturdaityavarau sureśvarīm \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Both monsters then attacked on goddess with arrows, sakti, goad, axe, sula, Bhusundi, Pattisa, acute Prasa and huge Parigha etc. weapons.

## \|\| 56.19 \|\|

*sā cāpi bāṇairvarakārmukacyutaiś ciccheda śastrāṇyaya bāhubhiḥ saha \|*  
*jaghāna cānyān raṇacaṇḍavikramā mahāsurān bāṇaśatairmaheśvarī \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. And Mahesvara, most valorous in battle too cut-off the weapons of monsters by her arrows and chopped off their arms together with the missiles they held. She killed other mighty demons by several hundreds of arrows.

## \|\| 56.20 \|\|

*mārī triśūlena jaghāna cānyān khaṭvāṅgayātairaparāṃśca kauśikī \|*  
*mahājalakṣepahataprabhāvān brāhmī tathānyānasurāṃścakāra \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Mari killed a numerous monsters, Kausiki slaughtered several of them by Khatvanga and Brahmi killed many other monsters by sprinkling water on them.

## \|\| 56.21 \|\|

*māheśvarī śūlavidāritorasaś cakāra dagdhānaparāṃśca vaiṣṇavī \|*  
*śaktyā kumārī kuliśena caindrī tuṇḍena cakreṇa varāharūpiṇī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Mahesvari penetrated the heart of a number of monsters by her Sula. Vaisnavi bum to many monsters in fire. Kumari killed monsters by sakti, Aindri by thunderbolt, Varahi by mouth and discus.

## \|\| 56.22 \|\|

*nakhairvibhinnānapi nārasiṃhī aṭṭāṭṭahāsairapi rudradūtī \|*  
*rudrastriśūlena tathaiva cānyān vināyakaścāpi paraśvadhena \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Narsimhi killed several monsters by giving hard blows through her nails, Sivaduti by peal of laughter, Rudra by trident and Vinayaka by giving hard blow from axe.

## \|\| 56.23 \|\|

*evaṃ hi devyā vividhaistu rūpai- nipātyamānā danupuṃgavāste \|*  
*petuḥ pṛthivyāḥ bhuvi cāpi bhūtai- ste bhakṣyamāṇāḥ pralayaṃ prajagmuḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus, the varied forms goddess began to kill monsters and their bodies continuously fell down on the earth. The ghosts began to eat their flesh as soon as they fell down on the ground.

## \|\| 56.24 \|\|

*te vadhyamānāstvatha devatābhi- rmahāsurā mātṛbhira \|*  
*kulāśca \|*  
*vimuktakeśāstaralekṣaṇā bhayāt te raktabījaṃ śaraṇaṃ hi jagmuḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. All those monsters badly frightened of the gods and Matr-saktis as continuos devastation they saw there. Hence, frightened those became pala, lost courage to continue fight and ran to shelter of Raktabija.

## \|\| 56.25 \|\|

*sa raktabījaḥ sahasā'bhyupetya varāstramādāya ca mātṛmaṇḍalam \|*  
*vidrāvayan bhūtagaṇān samantād viveśa kopāt sphuritādharaśca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Suddenly Raktabija appeared there for battle. He was fiiriated and on account of excess anger, his lips were moving up and down frequently. He drove away the herd of ghosts and entered into the orbit where goddess were killing the monsters so brutally.

## \|\| 56.26 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ prasamīkṣya mātaraḥ śastraiḥ śitāgrairditijaṃ vavarṣaḥ \|*  
*yo raktabindurvyapatatpṛthivyāṃ sa tatpramāṇastvaparo'pi jajñe \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. When Matrsaktis saw him coming forward, they shot a volley of arrows on him. Each blood drops fell from his body on the ground was being turned into one more monster.

## \|\| 56.27 \|\|

*tatastadascaryamayaṃ nirīkṣya sā kauśikī keśinimabhyuvāca \|*  
*pibasva caṇḍe rudhiraṃ tvarāte- rvitatya vaktraṃ vaḍavānalābham \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Kausiki said to Kesini when saw such surprising scene- О Candika! Spread your mouth with full length like Vadavanala and sip the blood of enemy.

## \|\| 56.28 \|\|

*sā tvevamuktā varadā'mbikā hi vitatya vaktraṃ vikarālamugram \|*  
*oṣṭhaṃ nabhaspṛk pṛthivīṃ spṛśantaṃ kṛtvā'dharaṃ tiṣṭhati carmamuṇḍā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Ambika opened then her fierce mouth. Her upper lip was touching the sky and lower was touching the earth. In such form she was addressed as Carmamunda.

## \|\| 56.29 \|\|

*tato'mbikā keśavikarṣaṇākulaṃ kṛtvā ripuṃ prākṣipata svavaktre \|*  
*bibheda śūlena tathā'pyurastaḥ kṣatodbhavānye nyapataṃñca vaktre \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Ambika then caught the enemy with hair, dragged him, pressed by teeth and hit hard on his chest. Thus, the other monsters generating from blood drops also fell in her mouth.

## \|\| 56.30 \|\|

*tatastu śoṣaṃ prajagāma rakta raktakṣaye hīnabalo babhūva \|*  
*taṃ hīnavīryaṃ śatadhā cakāra cakreṇa cāmīkarabhūṣitena \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Her blood dried and on account of nonfertility of blood drops, he got weakness. When the goddess saw him so weak, his body was cut in one hundred pieces of discus which was gold studded.

## \|\| 56.31 \|\|

*tasmin viśaste danusainyanāthe te dānavā dīnataraṃ vineduḥ \|*  
*hā tāta hā bhrātariti buvantaḥ kva yāsi tiṣṭhasva muhūrtamehi \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The monsters began availing for Raktabija by saying О brother! О dear! Where are you going? Stop for a moment. Come to us.

## \|\| 56.32 \|\|

*tathā'pare vilulitakeśapāśā viśīrṇavarmābharaṇā digambarāḥ \|*  
*nipātitā dharaṇitale mṛḍānyā praduduvurgirivaramuhya daityāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Mrdani knocked down brutally, rumours monsters who were deformed by garments, weapons and whose hair were scattered in such chaotic condition. Some among them were naked as their garments fully tom.

## \|\| 56.33 \|\|

*viśīrṇavarmāyudhabhūṣaṇaṃ tat balaṃ nirīkṣyaiva hi dānavendraḥ \|*  
*vikīrṇacakrākṣarathe niśumbhaḥ krodhānmṛḍānīṃ samupājagām \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The monster king Nisumbha forwarded to Mrdani when he saw that devastated scene in which his army had lost its shield, weapons and garments. He was on a chariot which wheels were broken and axis deviated.

## \|\| 56.34 \|\|

*khaṅgaṃ samādāya ca carma bhāsvaraṃ dhunvan śiraḥ prekṣya ca rūpamasyāḥ \|*  
*saṃstambhamohajvarapīḍito'tha citre yathā'sau likhito babhūva \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He had sword and a shining shield and tried to make a severe attack on goddess but when he stared at her face, his mind, heart and body stunned in sheer excitement. He stood like a lifeless state.

## \|\| 56.35 \|\|

*taṃ stambhitaṃ vīkṣya surārimagre provāca devī vacanaṃ vihasya \|*  
*anena vīryeṇa surāstvayā jitā anena māṃ prārthayase balena \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. When the goddess saw so stunned monster, she smiled and said- Have you conquered the gods with this very valour and whether on the basis of very power, you request me to accept as husband?

## \|\| 56.36 \|\|

*śrutvā tu vākyaṃ kauśikyā dānavaḥ sucirādiva \|*  
*provāca cintayitvā'tha vacanaṃ vadatāṃ varaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The monster peeped into the scorn inflicted by goddess for several minutes and then replied-

## \|\| 56.37 \|\|

*sukumāraśarīro'yaṃ macchastrapatanādapi \|*  
*śatadhā yāsyate bhīru āmapātramivāmbhasi \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О caprice lady! Your most delicate body shall break in several hundred pieces like an unbaked clay pot in water if I blow hard my weapon on you.

## \|\| 56.38 \|\|

*etad vicintayannarthaṃ tvāṃ prahartuṃ na sundari \|*  
*karomi buddhiṃ tasmāttvaṃ māṃ bhajasvāyatekṣaṇe \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О nice virgin! This only thought is resisting me from attack. Hence, О huge eyed lady! I submit again myself for your acceptance.

## \|\| 56.39 \|\|

*mama khaṅganipātaṃ hi nendro dhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*nivarttaya matiṃ yuddhādbhāryā me bhava sāmpratam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The severe blow made by my sword is unbearable even for indra. Spit therefore, on idea of battle and please, be my bride.

## \|\| 56.40 \|\|

*itthaṃ niśumbhavacanaṃ śrutvā yogīśvarī mune \|*  
*vihasya bhāvagambhīraṃ niśumbhaṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О sage! Yogisvari heard the submission of monster she smiled said in cryptic tone-

## \|\| 56.41 \|\|

*nājitā'haṃ raṇe vīra bhave bhāryā hi kasyacit \|*  
*bhavānyadīha bhāryārthī tato māṃ jaya saṃyuge \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O warrior! I cannot accept anyone my husband unless he defeats me in battle. In case, you desire so, come and defeat me.

## \|\| 56.42 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane khaṅgamudyamya dānavaḥ \|*  
*pracikṣepa tadā vegātkauśikīṃ prati nārada \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О Narada! That monster attacked with sword on goddess with full might when so neglected by her.

## \|\| 56.43 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ nistriṃśaṃ ṣaḍbhirbarhaṇarājitaiḥ \|*  
*ciccheda carmaṇā sārddhaṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. When the goddess saw that sword with shield forwarding towards her, she put six arrows having shape of peacocks tail on bow and split it in pieces. This scene was rare indeed.

## \|\| 56.44 \|\|

*khaṅge sacarmaṇi chinne gadāṃ gṛhya mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*samādravat kośabhavāṃ vāyuvegasamo jave \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. When the monster saw his sword so failed in target he immediately took mace and pounced on goddess fiercely.

## \|\| 56.45 \|\|

*tasyāpatata evāśu karau śliṣṭau samau dṛḍhau \|*  
*gadayā saha ciccheda kṣurapreṇa raṇe'mbikā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Ambika cut-off this sturdy and strong built arms through her Ksurapra (arrows) immediately when she saw that commotion of attack.

## \|\| 56.46 \|\|

*tasminnipatite raudre suraśatrau bhaṃyakare \|*  
*caṇḍādyā mātaro hṛṣṭāṣcakruḥ kilakilādhvanim \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. On so falling of that monster on ground made Candi etc. Matrkas exhilarated and they expressed this mirth by making loud voice.

## \|\| 56.47 \|\|

*gaganasthāstato devāḥ śatakratupurogamāḥ \|*  
*jayasva vijayetyūcurddaṣṭāḥ śatrau nipātite \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Indra etc. gods who were seeing at this battle, became happy to see the fall of their enemy. They energised the goddess by saying- "O victorious goddess! Victory to you."

## \|\| 56.48 \|\|

*tatastūryāṇyavādyanta bhūtasaṃdhaiḥ samantataḥ \|*  
*puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca mumucuḥ surāḥ kātyāyanīṃ prati \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The ghosts then piped trumpets from all sides and the gods showered flowers on goddess from above.

## \|\| 56.49 \|\|

*niśumbhaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śumbhaḥ krodhānmahāmune \|*  
*vṛndārakaṃ samāruddha pāśapāṇiḥ samabhyagāt \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О great sage! When Kumbha saw his brother so fell down on the ground, he furiated, took Pasa in hand and marched forward on elephant's back.

## \|\| 56.50 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭrā'tha sagajaṃ dānaveśvaram \|*  
*jagrāha caturo bāṇāṃścandrārdhākāravarcasaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When the goddess saw him coming forward, she took out four half-moon shape arrows from holder.

## \|\| 56.51 \|\|

*kṣuraprābhyāṃ samaṃ pādau dvau ciccheda dvipasya sā \|*  
*dvābhyāṃ kumbhe jaghānātha hasantī līlayā'mbikā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. That Ambika cut-off two fore-legs of elephant through two acute arrows and attacked at his belly with two other arrows. She was smiling that time.

## \|\| 56.52 \|\|

*nikṛttābhyāṃ gajaḥ padbhyāṃ nipapāta yathecchayā \|*  
*śakravajrasamākrāntaṃ śailarājaśiro yathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The elephant fell down on ground like the ridge of a mountain on which thunderbolt has befallen as his forelegs were cut-off.

## \|\| 56.53 \|\|

*tasyāvarjitanāgasya śumbhasyāpyutpatiṣyataḥ \|*  
*śiraściccheda bāṇena kuṇḍalālaṃkṛtaṃ śivā \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Siva cut-off the head of Kumbha with earrings through an arrow when he leapt from the back of so fallen elephant.

## \|\| 56.54 \|\|

*chinne śirasi daityendro nipapāta sakuñjaraḥ \|*  
*yathā samahiṣaḥ krauñco mahāsenasamāhataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The demon king fell down with elephant as Kraunca was fallen with buffalo when Mahasena Kartikeya had hit hard on him. He had thus, lost his head.

## \|\| 56.55 \|\|

*śrutvā surāḥ suraripū nihatau mṛḍānyā sendrāḥ sasūryamarudaścivasutradhānāḥ \|*  
*āgatya taṃ girivaraṃ vinayāvanamrā devyāstadā \|*  
*stutipadaṃ tvidamīrayantaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. When the Sun, Marut, Asvinikumara including Indra and Vasus heard the slaughter of both enemies by goddess, they all approached at that mountain and began to worship the goddess.

## \|\| 56.56 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ namo'stu te bhagavati pāpanāśini namo'stu te suraripudarpaśātani \|*  
*namo'stu te harihararājyadāyini namo'stu te mukhabhujakāryakāriṇi \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The gods prayed. We all salute goddess Bhagavati and the goddess who absolves all sins of human beings. Salute to the goddess suppressing the ego of enemies. Salute to the goddess who has given empire to Visnu and Sankara. Salute to yajnabhokta and defender of gods.

## \|\| 56.57 \|\|

*namo'stu te tridaśaripukṣayaṃkari namo'stu te śatamakhapādapūjite \|*  
*namo'stu te mahiṣavināśakāriṇi namo'stu te harihayabhāskarastute \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Salute to the killer of gods' enemy. Salute to goddess worshipped by Indra. Salute to Mahisasura killer. Salute to goddess duly worshipped by Visnu, Sankara and the sun god.

## \|\| 56.58 \|\|

*namo'stu te'ṣṭādaśa bāhuśālini namo'stu te śumbhaniśumbhaghātini \|*  
*namo'stu te cārttihare triśūlini namo'stu nārāṇi cakradhāriṇi \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O goddess having eighteen arms! We salute you. Salute to killer of Kumbha and Nisumbha. О goddess you efface the miseries of all beings. О goddess you hold trident. We salute you. О discus holding goddess! О Narayani! Salute to you.

## \|\| 56.59 \|\|

*namo'stu vārāhi sadā dharādhare tvāṃ nārasiṃhi praṇatā namo'stu te \|*  
*namo'stu te vajradhare gajabvaje namo'stu kaumāri mayūravāhini \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О Varahi! О earth holding goddess! Salute to you. О Narasimhi! We bow down our head and salute you. О thunderbolt holding! О Gajadhavaje! Salute to you. О Kaumari! О goddess having peacock vehicle! We salute you.

## \|\| 56.60 \|\|

*namo'stu paitāmahahaṃsavāhane namo'stu mālāvikaṭe sukeśini \|*  
*namo'stu te rāsabhapṛṣṭhavāhani namo'stu sarvārtihare jaganmaye \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O goddess you sit on swan of Brahma. Salute to you. You hold fierce garland and you have decent hair. We salute you. О goddess! You ride on donkey. We salute you. О goddess absolving human beings from evils! О universal form goddess! We salute you.

## \|\| 56.61 \|\|

*namo'stu viśveśvari pāhi viśvaṃ niṣūdayārīn dvijadevatānām \|*  
*namo'stu te sarvamayi trinetre namo namaste varade prasīda \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О ruler of entire universe! Salute to you. Defend this entire universe and slaughter the enemies of Brahmins and gods. О three eyed! О omnipresent! Salute to you. О boon giving goddess! Frequent salute to you. Be graced, please.

## \|\| 56.62 \|\|

*brahmāṇī tvaṃ mṛḍānī varaśikhigamanā śaktihastā kumārī vārāhī tvaṃ suvaktrā khagapatigamanā vaiṣṇavī tvaṃ saśārkī \|*  
*durdaśyā nārasiṃhī ghuraghuritaravā tvaṃ tathaindrī savajrā tvaṃ mārī carmamuṇḍā śavagamanaratā yoginīyogasiddhā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. You yourself are Brahmani and Mrdani. You move on beautiful peacock and you hold sakti in hand. You are Varahi with attractive face. You move by riding on Garuda, holding Sarnga bow and called Vaisnavi. You are fierce Narasimhi with ghura-ghura sound making. You hold thunderbolt and called Aindri as also Mahamarl Carmamunda. You move on corpse and you are Yogasiddha Yogini.

## \|\| 56.63 \|\|

*oṃ namaste trinetre bhagavati tavacaraṇānuṣitā ye aharaharvinataśiraso'vanatāḥ \|*  
*nahi nahi paribhavamastyaśubhaṃ ca stutibalakusumakarāḥ satataṃ ye \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О three eyed Bhagavati! Salute to you. The people who take shelter of your feet and bow their heads at your feet daily and who chant psalm always with flowers in their hands never defeated and always receive welfare.

## \|\| 56.64 \|\|

*oṃ evaṃ stutā suravaraiḥ suraśatrunāśī prāha prahasya surasiddhamaharṣivaryān \|*  
*prāpto mayā'dbhutatamo bhavartā prasādāt saṃgrāmamūrdhni suraśatrujayaḥ pramardāt \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The goddess killing enemies of gods on psalm so chanted smiled and said to gods, siddhas and great hermits. I have gained excellent victory on enemies of gods by suppressing them in battle with your good wishes.

## \|\| 56.65 \|\|

*imāṃ stutiṃ bhaktiparā narottamā bhavadbhiraktāmanukīrttayanti \|*  
*duḥsvapnanāśo bhavitā na saṃśayo varastathā'nyo vriyatāmabhīpsitaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The people chanting this psalm offered by you all this time will definitely see the abolition of their nightmares. Ask anything other desired by you.

## \|\| 56.66 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ yadi varadā bhavatī tridaśānāṃ dvijaśiśugoṣu yatasva hitāya \|*  
*punarapi devaripūnaparāṃstvaṃ pradaha hutāśanatulyaśarīre \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The gods said- "If you want to boon the gods, do good for Brahmins, children and cows. О goddess! Your body is having a fire complexion. Bum all gods enemies again in the prospective days.

## \|\| 56.67 \|\|

*devyuvāca- bhūyo bhaviṣyāmyasṛgukṣitānanā harānanasvedajalodbhavā surāḥ \|*  
*andhāsurasyāpratipoṣaṇo ratā nāmnā prasiddhā bhuvaneṣu carcikā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The goddess! О gods! I shall slaughter Andhasura and gods will address me as Carcika in this world. I shall bom from the perspiration of Sankara's mouth. My mouth will be strained with blood.

## \|\| 56.68 \|\|

*bhūyo vadhiṣyāmi surārimuttamaṃ saṃbhūya nandasya gṛhe yaśodayā \|*  
*taṃ vipracitti lavaṇaṃ tathā'parau śumbha niśumbhaṃ daśanaprahāriṇī \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. I will slaughter the enemy of gods by taking birth from the womb of Yasoda in the home of Nanda. I will slaughter Vipracitti, Lavanasura and other Sumbha and Nisumbha after getting incarnation there.

## \|\| 56.69 \|\|

*bhūyaḥ surāstiṣyayuge nirāśanī nirīkṣya mārī ca gṛhe śatakratoḥ \|*  
*saṃbhūya devyā'mitasatyadhāmayā surā bhariṣyāmi ca śākambharī vai \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. O gods! I will provide maintenance to whole world by taking birth as Sakambharш in the house of Indra with Amitasatyadhama goddess. This will be done when the famine will grip the creatures and they will strive.

## \|\| 56.70 \|\|

*bhūyo vipakṣakṣapaṇāya devā vindhye bhaviṣyāmyṛṣirakṣaṇārtham \|*  
*durvṛttaceṣṭānvinihatya daityān bhūyaḥ sameṣyāmi surālayaṃ hi \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. О gods! I will again take birth at Vindhya mountain for killing the enemies and defending the hermits. О gods! I will go again to heaven after destruction of the evil doing monsters.

## \|\| 56.71 \|\|

*yadā'ruṇākṣo bhaṣitā mahāsuraḥ tadā bhaviṣyāmi hitāya devatāḥ \|*  
*mahālirūpeṇa vinaṣṭajīvitaṃ kṛtvā sameṣyāmi punastriviṣṭapam \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О gods! I will again take birth in the form of a Bee (Bramara) when the great demon Arunaksa with take birth. I will kill him and then again go to the heaven.

## \|\| 56.72 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamuktvā varadā surāṇāṃ kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ dvijapuṃgavānām \|*  
*visṛjya bhūtāni jagāma devī khaṃ siddhasaṃdhairanugamyamānā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Pulastya said- with these word, salute to the Brahmins and bidding farewell to other creatures (beings) that goddess took a departure to the heaven.

## \|\| 56.73 \|\|

*idaṃ purāṇaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ devyā jayaṃ maṅgaladāyi puṃsām \|*  
*śrotavyametantriyataiḥ sadaiva rakṣoghnametadbhagavānuvāca \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. The balanced mind people should listen this ancient, supreme sacrosanct and benevolent episode on victory of them. The god has said it Raksoghna.

## Chapter 57. Birth of Kartikeya

## \|\| 57.1 \|\|

*Narada uvāca kathaṃ samhiṣaḥ krauñco bhinnaḥ skandena suvrata. etanme vipatarād brahman kathaysvāmityadūte \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada asked- О great resolute Brahmin! Tell me in detail that how Skanda had killed Kraunca with Mahisa.

## \|\| 57.2 \|\|

*Pulastya uvāca śṛṇuṣva kathayişyāmi kathāṃ puṇyāṃ purātanim. yaśovṛddhiṃ kumārasya kārtikeyasya nārada \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- О Narada! I explain the ancient story of Kumara Kartikeya. Please listen to it. It enhances the fame of the devotee.

## \|\| 57.3 \|\|

*yat tat pītaṃ hutāśena skandrasya śukraṃ pinākinah. tenākranto'bhavad brahman mandatejā hutāśanah \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О Brahmin! The fire had sipped that ejaculated semen of god Sankara. The splendour of fire became dull due to impact of it.

## \|\| 57.4 \|\|

*tato jagāma devānāṃ sakāśamitadyutiḥ. teścāpi prahitastūrṇaṃ brahmālokṃ jagāma ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Then the most splendour for fire went to the gods and he on being sent by them it immediately went to the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 57.5 \|\|

*sa macchakutilāṃ devīṃ dadarśa pathy pāvakah. tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha kuțile teja etat sudurdharam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The fire saw the goddess named Kutila on his way to abode of Brahma. Having seen in the fire said- О Kutila! This splendour is unbearable.

## \|\| 57.6 \|\|

*maheśvareṇa saṁtyaktaṃ nirdahedḥ bhuvanānyapi. tasmāat pratīcch putro'yaṃ tava dhanyo bhavisyati \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. This splendour (semen) ejaculated by Sankara will bum all lokas. Hence, please, hold it. You will receive a meritorious son from it.

## \|\| 57.7 \|\|

*ityāgninā sā kuṭilā smṛtvā svamatamuttamam. prakṣipasvāmbhasi mama prāha vahni mahāpagā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The great river Kutila said to Agni as she recollected her mission in mind- "Drop it on my water."

## \|\| 57.8 \|\|

*tatas tvadhārayaṃ devī śārvaṃ tejas tvapūpuṣat. hutāśano'pi bhagavān kāmacārī paribhraman \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. That goddess then held the semen of Sankara and began providing nutrition. God fire also began to make tour voluntarily.

## \|\| 57.9-10 \|\|

*pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi dhṛtavāṃ hāvyabhuktatạ. māṃsamastīni rudhiram medhontraretasi tvacah. \|\| 9 \|\|*

*rōmaśmaśrukshikesādyāḥ sarve jāta hiraṇmayāh. hiraṇyaretā lokẹṣu tena gītasca pāvakah \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The fire had held that semen for fire thousand years. Due to such long pregnancy, the flesh, bone, blood, marrow, intestine, skin, furs, share, moustache, eyes and hair etc. turned into golden colour. This is the reason, the fire is called as Hiranyareta.

## \|\| 57.11 \|\|

*pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi kuṭilā jvalanopam. dhārayantī tadā gaṁ brahmaṇaḥ sthānamāgatā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Kutila went at the abode of Brahma by holding that fire like womb for five thousand years.

## \|\| 57.12 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā padmajanmā saṁtapyantī mahāpagām. dṛṣṭvā papraccha kenāyaṃ tava garbhah samāhitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Brahma, the god lotus saw that great river very sad and asked- "Tell me that how had you conceived?"

## \|\| 57.13 \|\|

*sā cāha śańkaraṃ yat taccukram pītaṃ hi vahninā. tadạśaktena tenādy nikkṣiptaṃ mayi sattama \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. She replied- О great Brahmana! as the fire who had once sipped that semen of Sankara but on account of being unable to bear, he dropped it on me.

## \|\| 57.14 \|\|

*pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi dhārayantyā pitāmah. garbhasya vartate kālo nāyaṃ papāt kahrhicit \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. She said-0 great Brahma! A period of five thousand years have been lapsed since I conceived, but the delivery is still awaited."

## \|\| 57.15 \|\|

*tacchrutvā bhagavānāha gaccha tvamudayaṃ girim \|*  
*tatrāsti yojanaśataṃ raudraṃ śaravaṇaṃ mahat \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Lord Brahma said- "Go at Udayacala. A huge forest of Sarpata measuring one hundred yojana is existed there."

## \|\| 57.16 \|\|

*tatrainaṃ kṣipa suśroṇi vistīrṇe girisānuni \|*  
*daśavarṣasahasrānte tato bālo bhaviṣyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O the lady of thin loin! Drop it on that extended mountain ridge. It will turn in child form after ten thousand years.

## \|\| 57.17 \|\|

*sā śrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ rūpaṇī girimāgatā \|*  
*āgatya garbha tatyāja mukhenaivādrinandinī \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. That great river went on the mountain after hearing to the statement of Brahma and did abortion through her mouth.

## \|\| 57.18 \|\|

*sā tu saṃtyajyaṃ taṃ bālaṃ brahmāṇaṃ sahasā'gamat \|*  
*āpomayī mantravaśātsaṃjātā kuṭilā satī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. She went back immediately near Brahma by leaving that child there. The Sati Kutila turned into river due to curse.

## \|\| 57.19 \|\|

*tejasā cāpi śārveṇa raukmaṃ śaravaṇaṃ mahat \|*  
*tanniva \|*  
*saratāścānye pādapā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On account of splendour of Sankara, that forest of Sarapata turned into gold radiance. The trees, stags and birds residing there also turned into gold.

## \|\| 57.20 \|\|

*tato daśasu pūrṇeṣu śaraddaśaśateṣvatha \|*  
*bālārkadīptiḥ saṃjāto bālaḥ kamalalocanaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. When thus, ten thousand years passed, a child having eyes lotus-like and full of splendour like a sun was bom there.

## \|\| 57.21 \|\|

*uttānaśāyī bhagavāndivye śaravaṇe sthitaḥ \|*  
*mukhe'ṅguṣṭhaṃ samākṣipya ruroda ghanarāḍiva \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The gods sleeping on his back, with thumb in mouth began weeping like a cloud in that divine Saravana.

## \|\| 57.22 \|\|

*etasminnantare divyaḥ kṛttikāḥ ṣaṭ sutejasaḥ \|*  
*dadṛśuḥ svecchayā yāntyo bālaṃ śaravaṇe sthitam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In the meantime, the all six Krttikas saw that child in Saravapa when they were walking voluntarily on their way.

## \|\| 57.23 \|\|

*kṛpāyuktāḥ samājagmuḥ yatra skandaḥ sthito'bhavat \|*  
*ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ tasmai stanye'bhicukruśuḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. These Krttikas fell in pity and went there where Skanda was lying. In order to feed him milk, each of them wanted her turn first than others. They raised a dispute saying- "I will feed first the baby."

## \|\| 57.24 \|\|

*vivadantīḥ sa tā dṛṣṭvā ṣaṇmukhaḥ samajāyata \|*  
*abībharaṃśca tāḥ sarvāḥ śiśuṃ snehāca kṛttikāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. That Kumara suddenly turned into six mouthed child when he saw that those are disputing with each other. Thus, he fulfilled the desire of all of them. Those Krttikas then brought up properly that child with them.

## \|\| 57.25 \|\|

*bhriyamāṇaḥ sa tābhistu bālo vṛddhimagānmune \|*  
*kārttikeyeti vikhyāto jātaḥ sa balināṃ varaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О sage! That child was grown in their custody. He became famous as Karttikeya among the strong built people.

## \|\| 57.26 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahmanpāvakaṃ prāha padmajaḥ \|*  
*kiyatpramāṇaḥ putraste varttate sāmprataṃ guhaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О Brahmin! Brahma in the meantime, asked the fire- "What age has your son Guha attained this time?"

## \|\| 57.27 \|\|

*sa tadvacanamākarṇya ajānaṃstaṃ harātmajam \|*  
*provāca putraṃ deveśa na vedmi katamo guhaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The fire being unfamiliar to that child as Sankara's son, then enquired- О god! I am not familiar to Sankara's son. Tell me that who is Guha?

## \|\| 57.28 \|\|

*taṃ prāha bhagavān yattu tejaḥ pītaṃ purā tvayā \|*  
*traiyambakaṃ trilokeśa jātaḥ śaravaṇe śiśuḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The god said to him- О the god of three- world! The semen sipped by you once during long ago has now bom in the form of a child.

## \|\| 57.29 \|\|

*śrutvā pitāmahavacaḥ pāvakastvarito 'bhyagāt \|*  
*veginaṃ meṣamāruhya kuṭilā taṃ dadarśa ha \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. On hearing to the statement of Brahma, the god fire went there rapidly by riding on the goat. Kutila saw him going there.

## \|\| 57.30 \|\|

*tataḥ papraccha kuṭilā śīghraṃ kva vrajase kave \|*  
*so'bravīt putradṛṣṭyarthaṃ jātaḥ śaravaṇe śiśum \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Kutila then asked- О god fire! Where are you going? He said- "I am going to see a child bom in Saravana."

## \|\| 57.31 \|\|

*sā'bravīttanayo mahāṃ mametyāha ca pāvakaḥ \|*  
*vivadantau dadarśātha svecchācārī janārddanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. She said that child is mine and the fire said it is mine. Janardana who was walking voluntarily saw them disputing with each other.

## \|\| 57.32 \|\|

*tau papraccha kimarthaṃ vā vivādamiha cakrathaḥ \|*  
*tāvūcatuḥ putraheto rudraśukrodbhavāya hi \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Janardana asked both of them- "Why are you disputing? They replied- "For the son bom from the semen of Rudra."

## \|\| 57.33 \|\|

*tāvuvāca harirdevo gaccha taṃ tripurāntakam \|*  
*sa yadvakṣyati deveśastatkurudhvamasaṃśayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Visnu advised them- "Go at Tripuarantaka. Do then whatever is suggested by that god."

## \|\| 57.34 \|\|

*ityuktau vāsudevena kuṭilāgnī harāntikam \|*  
*samabhyetyocatustathyaṃ kasya putreti nārada \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O Narada! Kutila and fire both went to Sankara when so advised by Vasudeva and asked the fact that whose son was that child?

## \|\| 57.35 \|\|

*rudrastadvākyamākarṇya harṣanirbharamānasaḥ \|*  
*diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti girijāṃ prodbhutapulako'bravīt \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The mind of Sankara was filled with pleased. He pleased and said to Girija- "It is the chance. It is a chance."

## \|\| 57.36 \|\|

*tato'mbikā prāha haraṃ deva gacchāva taṃ śiśum \|*  
*praṣṭuṃ samāśrayedyaṃ sa tasya putro bhaviṣyati \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Ambika then said to Sankara- О god! We should go there and ask that child. He will be the son of the person whose shelter is preferred by him.

## \|\| 57.37 \|\|

*bāḍhamityeva bhagavān samuttasthau vṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*sahomayāma kuṭilaya \|*  
*pāvakena ca dhīmatā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. God Sankara Parvati, Kutila and fire god said- "very good" and stood up together.

## \|\| 57.38 \|\|

*saṃprāptāste śaraṃvaṇaṃ harāgnikuṭilāmbikāḥ \|*  
*dadṛśuḥ śiśukaṃ taṃ ca kṛttikotsaṅgaśāyinam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Sankara, Parvati, Kutila and fire went together in saravana. They saw that child looping on the lap of Krttika.

## \|\| 57.39 \|\|

*tataḥ sa bālakasteṣāṃ matvā cintitamādarāt \|*  
*yogī caturmūrtirabhūt ṣaṇmukhaḥ sa śiśustvapi \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. That six mouthed child understood their intention and in spite of being Yogi, he turned into four bodies.

## \|\| 57.40 \|\|

*kumāraḥ śaṃkaramagādviśākho gaurimāgamat \|*  
*kuṭilāmagamacchākho maha \|*  
*seno''gnimabhyayāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Kumara went to Sankara, Visakha went to Girija, Sakha went to Kutila and fire god became happiest

## \|\| 57.41 \|\|

*tataḥ prītiyuto rudra umā ca kuṭilā tathā \|*  
*pāvakaścāpi deveśaḥ parāṃ mudamavāpa ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Then Rudra, Uma, Kutila and fire god became happiest.

## \|\| 57.42 \|\|

*tato'bruvan kṛttikāstāḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ kiṃ harātmajaḥ \|*  
*tā abravīddharaḥ prītyā vidhivad vacanaṃ mune \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Then those Krttikas asked- whether sadanama is the son of Sankara? О sage! Sankara said them all-

## \|\| 57.43 \|\|

*nāmnā tu kārttikeyo hi yuṣmākaṃ ca tanayastvasau \|*  
*kuṭilāyāḥ kumāreti putro'yaṃ bhavitā'vyayaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О Krttikas! He will be your son and addressed as Karttikeya and this immortal Kumara will be the son of Kutila.

## \|\| 57.44 \|\|

*skanda ityeva vikhyāto gaurīputro bhavatvasau \|*  
*guha ityeva nāmnā ca mamāsau tanayaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Skanda. He will be my son also and addressed as Guha.

## \|\| 57.45 \|\|

*mahāsena iti khyāto hutāśasyāstu putrakaḥ \|*  
*śāradvata iti khyātaḥ sutaḥ śaravaṇasya ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. He will be a popular son of fire as Mahasena. As Saradvata, he will be the son of Saravana.

## \|\| 57.46 \|\|

*evameṣa mahāyogī pṛthivyāṃ khyātimeṣyati \|*  
*ṣaḍāsyatvān mahābāhuḥ ṣaṇmukho nāma gīyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thus, this Mahayogi will gain popularity on the earth. Being his six mouths he will be famous as Sanmukha.

## \|\| 57.47 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā bhagavān śūlapāṇiḥ pitāmaham \|*  
*sasmāra daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ te'pyājagmustvarānvitāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Sulapani Sankara brought in memory Pitamaha Brahma including all gods. They all came there quickly.

## \|\| 57.48-49 \|\|

*praṇipatya ca kāmārimumāṃ ca girinandinīm \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā hutāśanaṃ prītyā kuṭilāṃ kṛttikāstathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*dadṛśurvālamatyugraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ sūryasannibham \|*  
*muṣṇantamiva cakṣūṣi tejasā svena devatāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Those gods saluted Kamari Sankara and Parvati. They saw the fire god, Kutila and Krttikas very happy and saw there further the most aggressive, sun like glittering and dazzling all eyes with radiance a child having six mouths.

## \|\| 57.50 \|\|

*kautukābhivṛtāḥ sarve evamūcuḥ surottamāḥ \|*  
*devakāryaṃ tvayā deva kṛtaṃ divyā'gninā tathā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Those great gods said amazingly- О god! You including goddess and fire have performed the assignment which should be executed by the gods.

## \|\| 57.51 \|\|

*taduttiṣṭha vrajāmo'dya tīrthamaujasamavyayam \|*  
*kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatyāmabhiṣiñcāma ṣaṇmukham \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Hence, please, stand-up we should now go at Aujasa, the everlasting holy place. We should sprinkle water on this six mouthed child in Sarasvati by taking a visit at Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 57.52 \|\|

*senāyāḥ patirastveṣa devagandharvakiṃnarāḥ \|*  
*mahiṣaṃ ghātayatveva tārakaṃ ca sudāruṇam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O gods, gandharvas and kinnaras! May he become our commander and kill the Mahisa and the fierce Taraka.

## \|\| 57.53 \|\|

*bāḍhamityabravīccharvaḥ samuttasyuḥ surāstataḥ \|*  
*kumārasahitā jagmuḥ kurukṣetraṃ mahāphalam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Sankara said- "very good". All gods then stood up and went at Kuruksetra with Kumara.

## \|\| 57.54 \|\|

*tatraiva devatāḥ sendrā rudrabrahmajanārddanāḥ \|*  
*yatnamasyābhiṣekārthaṃ cakrurmunigaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Indra, Rudra, Brahma, Janardana etc. all gods including hermits then did Abhiseka of that Kumara.

## \|\| 57.55 \|\|

*tato'mbunā saptasamudravāhinā nadījalenāpi mahāphalena \|*  
*varauṣadhībhiśca sahastramūrtibhi- stadābhyaṣiñcan guhamacyutādyāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Then Acyuta etc. gods did Abhiseka of Guha by mixing the pure water of Sarasvati and the rivers flowing down into seven seas as also with the best medicines.

## \|\| 57.56 \|\|

*abhiṣiñcati senānyāṃ kumāre divyarūpiṇi \|*  
*jagurgandharvapatayopattayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. When Kumara got Abhiseka for the designation of army commander, the king gandharvas did singing and the nymphs started dancing.

## \|\| 57.57 \|\|

*abhiṣiktaṃ kumāraṃ hi giriputrī nirīkṣya hi \|*  
*snehādutsaṅgagaṃ skandaṃ mūrdhyajighranmuhurmuhuḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Girija picked up Kumara with affection in her lap when he saw that he has been selected as commander of the army. She began to smell his head again and again.

## \|\| 57.58 \|\|

*jighratī kārttikeyasya abhiṣekārdramānanam \|*  
*bhātyadrijā yathendrasya devamātā'ditiḥ purā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Parvati looked like Aditi, the mother of gods who smelt head of Indra during ancient period when she also smelt the face of Kartikeya, which was soaked in water.

## \|\| 57.59 \|\|

*tadābhiṣiktaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śarvo mudaṃ yayau \|*  
*pāvakaṃ kṛttikāścaiva kuṭilā ca yaśasvinī \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Then Sankara, the fire, Krttikas and illustrious Kutila became happy to see their son so appointed on the higher position.

## \|\| 57.60-61 \|\|

*tato'bhiṣiktasya haraḥ senāpatye guhasya tu \|*  
*pramathāṃścaturaḥ prādācchakratulyaparākramān \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ lohitākṣaṃ nandisenaṃ ca dāruṇam \|*  
*caturthaṃ balināṃ mukhyaṃ khyātaṃ kumudamālinam \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Then Sankara assigned Kumudamali the best among four Pramathas- Ghanfakarna, Lohitaksa, Daruna Nandisena and Kumudamali himself.

## \|\| 57.62 \|\|

*haradattān gaṇān dṛṣṭvā devāḥ skandasya nārada \|*  
*pradaduḥ pramathān svāṃn svān sarve brahmapurogamāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О Narada! Having seen the ganas given by Sankara, all gods including Brahma etc. gave their Pramathas for Skanda.

## \|\| 57.63 \|\|

*sthāṇuṃ brahmā gaṇaṃ prādādviṣṇuḥ prādādraṇatrayam \|*  
*saṃkramaṃ vikramaṃ caiva tṛtīyaṃ ca parākramam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Brahma gave his gana sthanu and Visnu gave three ganas i.e. Samkrama, Vikrama and Parakrama.

## \|\| 57.64 \|\|

*utkeśa paṅkajau śakro ravirdaṇḍakapiṅgalau \|*  
*candro maṇiṃ vasumaṇimaśvinau vatsanandinau \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Indra gave Utkesa and Pankaja, the sun gave Dandaka and Pingala, the moon gave Mani and Vasumani and Asvinikumaras gave Vatsa and Nandi.

## \|\| 57.65 \|\|

*jyotirchutāśanaḥ prādājjvalajjihva tathā puram \|*  
*kundaṃ mukundaṃ kusumaṃ trīn dhātā'nucarāndadau \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The fire gave Jyoti and Jvalajjihva and Dhata gave three servants i.e. Kunda, Mukunda and Kusuma.

## \|\| 57.66 \|\|

*cakrānucakrau tvaṣṭā ca vedhātisthira susthirau \|*  
*pāṇityajaṃ kālakañca prādāt pūṣā mahābalau \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Tvasta gave Cakra and Anucakra, Vedha gave Atisthira and Susthira while Pusa gave the mighty Panityaja and Kalaka.

## \|\| 57.67 \|\|

*svarṇamālaṃ ghanāddhaṃ ca himavānpramathottamau \|*  
*prādāddevocchrito vicyastvatiśṛṅgaṃ ca pārṣadam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Himalaya gave Svarnmala, the best among Pramathas as also Ghanahva and the highest Vindhyancala gave a member (Parsada) Atisrnga.

## \|\| 57.68 \|\|

*suvarcasaṃ ca varuṇaḥ pradadau cātivarcasam \|*  
*saṃgrahaṃ vigrahaṃ cābdhirnāgā jayamahājayau \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Varuna gave Suvarca and Ativarca, the sea gave Samgraha and Vigraha and the serpents gave Jaya and Mahajaya.

## \|\| 57.69 \|\|

*unmādaṃ śaḍkukarṇaṃ ca puṣpadantaṃ tathā'mbikā \|*  
*ghasaṃ- cātighasaṃ vāyuḥ prādādanucarāvubhau \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Ambika gave Unmada, Sankukarna and Puspadanta, while Pavana gave two attendants i.e. Ghasa and Atighasa.

## \|\| 57.70 \|\|

*parighaṃ caṭakaṃ bhīmaṃ dāhātidahanau tathā \|*  
*pradadāvaṃśumānyañca pramathānvaṇmukhāya hi \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Arhsuman gave five Pramathas i.e. Parigha, Cafaka, Bhima, Dahati and Dahana.

## \|\| 57.71 \|\|

*yamaḥ pramāthamunmārtha kālasenaṃ mahāmukham \|*  
*tālapatraṃ nāḍijaḍyaṃ ṣaḍevānucarāndadau \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Yama gave six attendants i.e. Pramatha, Unmatha, Kalasena, Mahamukha, Talapatra and Nadijangha.

## \|\| 57.72 \|\|

*suprabhaṃ ca sukarmāṇaṃ dadau dhātā gaṇeśvarau \|*  
*suvrataṃ satyasandhaṃ ca mitraḥ prādāddivajottama \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О great Dvija! Dhata gave Suprabha and Sukarma, Ganesvara, Mitra gave his two attendants i.e. Suvrata and Satyasandha.

## \|\| 57.73-74 \|\|

*anantaḥ śaṅkupīṭhaśca nikumbhaḥ kumudo'mbujaḥ \|*  
*ekākṣaḥ kunaṭī cakṣuḥ kirīṭī kalaśodaraḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*sūcīvaktraḥ kokanadaḥ prahāsaḥ priyako'cyutaḥ \|*  
*gaṇāḥ pañcadaśaite hi yakṣairdattā guhasya tu \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. Yaksas gave Kartikeya fifteen ganas. These were Ananta, Sankupitha, Nikumbha, Kumuda, Ambuja, Aikaksa, Kunati, Caksu, Kiriti, Kalasodara, Sucivaktra, Kokanada, Prahasa, Priyaka and Acyuta.

## \|\| 57.75 \|\|

*kālindhā kalakandaśca narmadāyā raṇotkaṭaḥ \|*  
*godāvaryāḥ siddhayātrastamasāyādrikampakau \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Kalindi gave Kalakanda, Narmada gave Ranotkata, Godavari gave Siddhayatra and Tamasa gave Adrikampaka.

## \|\| 57.76 \|\|

*sahasrabāhuḥ sītāyā vañjalāyāḥ sitodaraḥ \|*  
*mandākinyāstathā gando vipāśāyāḥ priyaṃkaraḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Sita gave Sahastrabahu, Vanjula gave Sitodara, Mandakini gave Nanda and Vipasa gave Priyankara.

## \|\| 57.77 \|\|

*airāvatyāścaturddaṣṭraḥ ṣoḍaśākṣo vitastayā \|*  
*mārjāraṃ kauśikī prādātkrayakrauñchau ca gautamī \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Airavati gave Catudanstra, Vitasta gave Sodasaksa, Kausiki gave Marjara and Gomati gave Kratha and Krauaca.

## \|\| 57.78 \|\|

*bāhudā śataśīrṣaṃ ca vāhā gonandanandikau \|*  
*bhīmaṃ bhīmarathī prādādvegāriṃ sarayūrdadau \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Bahuda gave Sataslisa, Vaha gave Gonanda and Nandika, Bhimarathi gave Bhima and Sarayti gave Vegari.

## \|\| 57.79 \|\|

*aṣṭabāhuṃ dadau kālī subāhumapi gaṇḍakī \|*  
*mahānadī citradevaṃ citrā citrarathaṃ dadau \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Kasi gave Astabahu, Gandaki gave Subahu, Mahanadi gave Citradeva and Citra gave Citraratha.

## \|\| 57.80 \|\|

*kuḍūḥ kuvalayaṃ prādānmadhuvarṇaṃ madhūdakā \|*  
*jambūkaṃ dhūtapāpā ca veṇā śvetānanaṃ dadau \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Kuhu gave Kuvalaya, Madhudaka gave Madhuvarna, Dhutapapa gave Jambuka and Vena gave Svetanana.

## \|\| 57.81 \|\|

*śrutavarṇāṃ ca parṇāsā revā sāgaraveginam \|*  
*prabhāvā'rtha sahaṃ prādāt kāñcanā kanakekṣaṇam \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Parnasa gave Srutavarna, Reva gave Sagaravegi, Prabhava gave Artha and Saha while Kahcana gave Kanakeksana.

## \|\| 57.82 \|\|

*gṛdhrapatraṃ ca vimalā cāruvaktraṃ manoharā \|*  
*dhūtapāpā mahārāvaṃ karṇā vidrumasannibhama \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Vimala gave Grdhrapatra, Manohara gave Caruvaktra, Dhutapapa gave Maharava and Kama gave Vidrumasannibha.

## \|\| 57.83 \|\|

*suprasādaṃ suveṇuśca jiṣṇumoyavatī dadau \|*  
*yajñabāhuṃ viśālā ca sarasvatyo dadurgaṇān \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Suvenu gave Suprasada and Oghavati gave Jisnu, Visala gave yajnabahu. Thus, these rivers gave numerous ganas (or Sarasvati etc. rivers gave numerous ganas).

## \|\| 57.84-85 \|\|

*kuṭilā tanayāsyādād daśa śakrabalān gaṇān \|*  
*karālaṃ sitakośaṃ ca kṛṣṇakeśaṃ jaṭādharām \|\| 84 \|\|*

*meghanādaṃ caturdaṣṭra vidyujjihūṃ daśānanam \|*  
*somāpyāyanamevograṃ devayā jinameva ca \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Kutila gave her son ten ganas. These were Karala, Sitakesa, Krsnakesa, Jatadhara, Meghanada, Caturdanstra, Vidhujjihva, Dasanana, Somapyayana and Ugra Devayaji.

## \|\| 57.86 \|\|

*haṃsāsyaṃ kuṇḍajaṭharaṃ bahugrīvaṃ hayānanam \|*  
*kūrmagrīvaṃ ca pañcaitāndaduḥ putrāya kṛttikāḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Krttikas gave fire attendants to their so. These were Hamsasya, Kundajathara, Bahugriva, Науananа and KOumagriva.

## \|\| 57.87 \|\|

*sthāṇujaṅgha kumbhavaktraṃ lohajaḍyaṃ mahānanam \|*  
*piṇḍākāraṃ ca pañcaitāndaduḥ skandāya carṣayaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. The hermits gave Skanda their fire attendants. These were Sthanujahgha, Kumbhavaktra, Lohajangha, Mahanana and Pindakara.

## \|\| 57.88 \|\|

*nāgajihva candrabhāsaṃ pāṇikūrmamaśikṣakam \|*  
*cāṣavaktraṃ ca jambūkaṃ dadau tīrthaṃ pṛthūdakam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Prthudaka, the holy place gave the attendants i.e. Nagajihva, Candrabhasa, Panikurma, Sasiksa, Casavaktra and Jambuka.

## \|\| 57.89 \|\|

*cakratīrthaṃ sucakrākṣaṃ makarākṣaṃ gayāśiraḥ \|*  
*gaṇaṃ pañcaśivaṃ nāma dadau kanakhalaṃ svakam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Cakratirtha gave Sucakraksa, Gayasira gave Makaraksa and Kanakhala gave his gana Pancasikha.

## \|\| 57.90 \|\|

*bandhudattaṃ vājiśirā bāhuśālaṃ ca puṣkaram \|*  
*sarvojasaṃ māhiṣakaṃ mānasaḥ piṅgalaṃ tathā \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Vajisira gave Bandhudatta, Puskara gave Bahusala and Manasa gave Sarvaujasa, Mahisaka and Pihgala.

## \|\| 57.91-93 \|\|

*rudramauśanasaḥ prādāttato'nyānmātaro daduḥ \|*  
*vasudāmāṃ somatīrthaḥ prabhāso nandinīmapi \|\| 91 \|\|*

*indratīrthaṃ viśokāṃ ca udapāno ghanasvanām \|*  
*saptasārasvataḥ prādānmāta caturodbhutāḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*gītapriyāṃ mādhavīṃ ca tīrthanemi smitānanām \|*  
*ekacūḍāṃ nāgatīrthaḥ kurukṣetraṃ palāsadām \|\| 93 \|\|*

91-93. Ausanasa gave Rudra and others gave Matrkas. Somatirtha gave Vasudama, Prabhasa gave Nandini and Indra-tirtha gave Visoka. Udpana gave Ghanasvana and Saptasaravata gave four excellent Matrkas. These were- Gitapriya, Madhavi, Tirthanemi and Smitanana. Nagatirtha gave Aikacuda and Kuruksetra gave Palasada.

## \|\| 57.94 \|\|

*brahmayoniścaṇḍaśilāṃ bhadrakālī triviṣṭapaḥ \|*  
*cauṇaḍīṃ bhaiṇḍīṃ yogamaiṇḍauṃ prādācaraṇapāvanaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Brahmayoni gave Candasila, Trivistipa gave Bhadrakali and Caranapavana gave Cauruji, Baindi and Yogabhaindi.

## \|\| 57.95-100 \|\|

*sopānīyāṃ mahī prādācchālikāṃ mānaso hṛdaḥ \|*  
*śataghaṇṭāṃ śatānandāṃ tatholūkhalamekhalām \|\| 95 \|\|*

*padmāvatīṃ mādhavīṃ ca dadau badarikāśramaḥ \|*  
*suṣamāmekacūḍāṃ ca devī dhamadhamāṃ tathā \|\| 96 \|\|*

*utkrāthannīṃ vedamitrāṃ kedāro mātaro dadau \|*  
*sunakṣatrāṃ kadūlāṃ ca suprabhātaṃ sumaṅgalām \|\| 97 \|\|*

*devamitrāṃ citrasenāṃ dadau rudramahālayaḥ \|*  
*koṭarāmūrddhaveṇīṃ ca śrīmatīṃ bahuputrikām \|\| 98 \|\|*

*patitāṃ kamalākṣīṃ ca prayāgo mātaro dadau \|*  
*supalāṃ madhukumbhāṃ ca khyāti dahadahāṃ parām \|\| 99 \|\|*

*prādāt khaṭakaṭāṃ cānyāṃ sarvapāpavimocanaḥ \|*  
*saṃtānikāṃ vikalikāṃ kramaścatvaravāsinīm \|\| 100 \|\|*

95-100. Mahi gave Sopaniya, Manasohrda gave Malika and Badarikasrama gave Satananda, Sataghanta, Ulukhalamekhala, Padmavati and Madhavi. Kedaratirtha gave Matrkas. These were- Susama, Aikacuda, Dhamadhama, Devi Utkrathani and Vedamitra. Rudramahalalya gave Sunaksatra, Kadrula, Suprabhata, Sumangala, Devamitra and Citrasena. Prayaga gave Matrkas i.e. Kojara Urdhrvaveni, Srimati, Bahuputrika, Palita and Kamalaksi. Sarvapapavimocana gave Supala, Madhukumbha, Khayati, Dahadaha, Para and Khatakata. Krama gave Santanika, Vikalika and Catvaravasini.

## \|\| 57.101 \|\|

*jaleśvarīṃ kukkuṭikāṃ sudāmāṃ lohamekhalām \|*  
*vapuṣmatyulyukākṣī ca kokanāma \|*  
*mahāśanī \|*  
*raudrākarkaṭikātuṇḍā śvetatīrtho dadau tvimāḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Svetatirtha gave his attendants Jalesvari, Kukutika, Sudama, Lohamekhala, Vapusmati, Ulmukaksi, Кокаnamа, Mahasani Raudra, Karkatika and Tunda.

## \|\| 57.102 \|\|

*etāni bhūtāni gaṇāṃśca mātaro dṛṣṭvā mahātmā vinatātanūjaḥ \|*  
*dadau mayūraṃ svasutaṃ mahājavaṃ tathā' ruṇastā pracūḍaṃ ca putram \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Having seen these ghosts, ganas and Matrkas, Garuda, the son of Vinata offered his peacock a speedy vehicle and Aruna gave his son Tamracuda.

## \|\| 57.103 \|\|

*śaktiṃ hutāśo'drisutā ca vastraṃ daṇḍaṃ guruḥ sā kuṭilā kamaṇḍalum \|*  
*mālāṃ hariḥ śūladharaḥ patākaṃ kaṇṭhe ca hāraṃ maghavānurastaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. The five gave Kartikeya sakti, Parvati gave garments, Brhaspati gave Danda, Kutila gave Kamandalu, Visnu gave garland, Sankara gave flag and Indra offered his garland to him.

## \|\| 57.104 \|\|

*gaṇairvṛto mātṛbhiranvayāto mayūrasaṃstho varaśaktipāṇiḥ \|*  
*sainādhipatye sa kṛto bhavena rarāja sūryeva mahāvapuṣmān \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. Kartikeya began luminating as the sun god with ganas, Matrkas, peacock with sakti in his hand when he waj appointed as connnander of army.

## Chapter 58. Killing of Taraka and Mahisa

## \|\| 58.1-2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca senāpatye'bhiṣiktastu kumāro daivatairatha \|*  
*praṇipatya bhavaṃ bhaktyā girijāṃ pāvakaṃ śucim \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ṣaṭ kṛttikāśca śirasāṃ praṇamya kuṭilāmapi \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ ca namaskṛtya idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Pulastya said- So appointed on commander post by gods, Kurnara saluted Sankara, Parvati and the sacred fire. He then bowed his head before six Krttikas and Kutila. Finally, he saluted Brahma and said-

## \|\| 58.3 \|\|

*kumāra uvāca namo'stu bhavatā devā oṃ namo'stu tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*yuṣmatprasādājjeṣyāmi śatrū mahiṣatārakau \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Кumarа said- О gods! I salute you all. О great austere! I salute you with chanting "Om" the supreme syllable. I will conquer Mahisa and Taraka both enemies.

## \|\| 58.4 \|\|

*śiśurasmi na jānāmi vaktuṃ kiṃcana devatāḥ \|*  
*dīyatāṃ brahmaṇā sārddhamanujñā mama sāmpratam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О gods! I am merely a child and alien to art of speaking. Please allow me to submit this time you all including Brahma.

## \|\| 58.5 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane kumāreṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*mukhaṃ nirīkṣanti surāḥ sarve vigatasādhvasāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. All gods began to gaze at him when the great soul Kumara so stated.

## \|\| 58.6 \|\|

*śaṃkaro'pi sutasnehāt samutthāya prajāpatim \|*  
*ādāya dakṣiṇe pāṇau skandāntikamupāgamat \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Sankara stood up affectionately for his son, gave Brahma support of his right hand and came to Skanda.

## \|\| 58.7 \|\|

*athomā prāha tanayaṃ putra ehohi śatruhan \|*  
*vandasva caraṇau divyau viṣṇorlokanamaskṛtau \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Uma then said to her son- О every killer son! Come here. Do pray and salute of Visnu the world's adorable god.

## \|\| 58.8 \|\|

*tato vihasyāha guhaḥ ko'yaṃ mātarvadasva mām \|*  
*yasthādarāt praṇāmo'yaṃ kriyate madvidhairjanaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Guha then said smiling- О Mother! tell me that who is he? Explain his great fullness that even make the people of higher status like us to bow before him.

## \|\| 58.9 \|\|

*taṃ mātā prāha vacanaṃ kṛte karmaṇa padmabhūḥ \|*  
*vakṣyate tava yo'yaṃ hi mahātmā garuḍadhvajaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. His mother said- "Brahma will tell you when the work is over that who is this Garuda riding greatman?"

## \|\| 58.10 \|\|

*kevalaṃ tviha māṃ devastvatpitā prāha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*nānyaḥ parataro'smāddhi vayamanye ca dehinaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. You father, god Sankara has told me only that nobody among us and among the creatures is not greater than him.

## \|\| 58.11 \|\|

*pārvatyā gadite skandaḥ praṇipatya janārdanam \|*  
*tasthau kṛtāñjalipuṭastvājñāṃ prārthayate'cyutāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Skanda did salute to Janardana and stood- up with folded hands and asked the permissible from Acyuta.

## \|\| 58.12 \|\|

*kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ skandaṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā svastyayanaṃ devo hyanujñāṃ pradadau tataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Lord Visnu, having bestowed his benedictions on Kartikeya who stood foldedhanded in benediction gave him order.

## \|\| 58.13 \|\|

*nārada uvāca yattat svastvacanaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtavān garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*śikhidhvajāya viprarṣe tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Narada said- О great Brahmin! Please, explain that what did the wish made by Garuda riding god Visnu for peacock riding Kartikeya.

## \|\| 58.14 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca śṛṇu svastyayanaṃ puṇyaṃ yatprāha bhagavānhariḥ \|*  
*skandasya vijayārthāya mahiṣasya vadhāya ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Pulastya said- Listen to the blessing made by god Visnu for the victory of Skanda and killing of Mahisa.

## \|\| 58.15 \|\|

*svasti te kurutāṃ bahyā padmayonī rajoguṇaḥ \|*  
*svasti cakrāṅkittakaro viṣṇuste vidadhātvajaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. May! Lotus bom, Rajas Brahma do good for you. May! Unborn Visnu with discus in hand do all good for you.

## \|\| 58.16 \|\|

*svasti te śaṃkaro bhaktyā sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*pāvakaḥ svasti tubhyaṃ ca karotu śikhivāhanaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. May! Sankara, the bull rider do all good for you gracefully. О Peacock rider! May! God fire do all good for you.

## \|\| 58.17 \|\|

*divākaraḥ svasti karotu tubhyaṃ somaḥ sabhaumaḥ sabudho guruva \|*  
*kāvyaḥ sadā svastikarotu tubhyaṃ śanaiścaraḥ svastyayanaṃ karotu \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. May! The stars like sun, mars, mercury and Jupiter do good for you. May the Venus and Saturn do all good for you.

## \|\| 58.18 \|\|

*marīciratriḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ ṛturvasiṣṭho bhṛguraṅgirāśca \|*  
*mṛkaṇḍujaste kurutāṃ hi svasti svasti sadā sapta maharṣayaśca \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Vasistha, Bhrgu, Angira, Markandeya hermit do good for you and may! Saptarsi do always good for you.

## \|\| 58.19 \|\|

*viśve'śvinau sādhyama rudraṇāgnayo divākarāḥ śūladharā maheśvarāḥ \|*  
*yakṣāḥ piśācā vasavo'tha kinnara \|ḥ te svasti kurvantu sadodyatāstvamī \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. May! Visvedeva, Asvinikumara, Sadhya, Marutas, fire, sun, Suladhara, Mahesvara, Yaksa, devils, Vasu and Kinnaras be always prepared to do good for you.

## \|\| 58.20 \|\|

*nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi tīrthāni puṇyāyatanāḥ samudrāḥ \|*  
*mahābalā bhūtagaṇā gaṇendrāḥ te svasti kurvantu sadā samudyatāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. May! The serpent, birds, rivers, reservoir, the holy places, the seas, the mighty ghosts and Vinayakas always prepared to do good for you.

## \|\| 58.21 \|\|

*svasti dvipādikebhyaste catuṣyādebhya eva ca \|*  
*svasti te bahupādebhyastvapādebhyo'pyanāmayam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. May! You receive all good from the human beings and cattle's. May! You receive all good from the organisms having several feet and may the organism without feet bless you for victory.

## \|\| 58.22 \|\|

*prācīṃ dig rakṣatāṃ vajrī dakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍanāyakaḥ \|*  
*pāśī pratīcīṃ rakṣatu lakṣmāṃśuḥ pātu cottarām \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. May! The thunderbolt holding god (Indra) defend the east, the god with Danda (Yama) defend the south, the god holding Pasa (Varuna) defend the west and the moon defend the north.

## \|\| 58.23 \|\|

*vahnirdakṣiṇapūrvī tu kubero dakṣiṇāparām \|*  
*pratīcīmuttarāṃ vāyuḥ śivaḥ pūrvottarāmapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. May! The fire defend Agnikona, Kubera defend Nairtya, Pavana defend Vayavya and Siva defend Isana.

## \|\| 58.24 \|\|

*upariṣṭād dhruvaḥ pātu adhastāca dharādharaḥ \|*  
*musalī lāṅgalī cakrī dhanuṣmānantareṣu c \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. May! Dhruva defend upside, Dharadhara defend downside and Visnu, holding musala, plough, discus and bow defend in the intervals.

## \|\| 58.25 \|\|

*vārāho'mbunidhau pātu durge pātu nṛkesarī \|*  
*sāmavedardhvānaḥ śrīmān sarvataḥ pātu mādhavaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. May! Varaha defend while in the sea, Narasimha in inaccessible place and Sriman Madhava in the form Samaveda sound defend you from all sides.

## \|\| 58.26 \|\|

*Pulastya uvācha Evaṃ kṛtasvastiyanā guhaḥ śaktidharāgraṇiḥ \|*  
*Praṇipatya surān sarvān samutpatata bhūtanāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Pulastya said- When blessing was over, the mighty commander Guha flew up from the land after saluting all gods.

## \|\| 58.27 \|\|

*Tamanveva gajāḥ sarve dattā ye muditai suraih \|*  
*Anujagmuḥ kumāraṁ te kāmarūpā vihaṅgamāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The ganas given by the pleased gods followed Kumara in disguise of birds they converted them voluntarily.

## \|\| 58.28 \|\|

*Mātaye tatha sarvāḥ samutpeturnabhastalam \|*  
*Samaṁ skandena balinā haṁtukāmā mahāsurān \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. All mothers too flew up in the sky in order to support Skanda in killing the monsters.

## \|\| 58.29 \|\|

*Tataḥ sudīrghāmadvānaṁ gatvā skando'bravīdgaṇān \|*  
*Bhūmyāṁ tūrṇaṁ mahāviryāḥ kurudhvam avatāraṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Skanda said ganas when he marched at some distance- О great warriors! Descend on earth immediately.

## \|\| 58.30 \|\|

*Gaṇā guhavachaḥ śrutvā avatīrya mahitalam \|*  
*Ārāt patantas taddēśaṁ nādaṁ cakurbhayaṁkaraṁ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. All ganas descended on the earth and made a loud noise while descending at a distance.

## \|\| 58.31 \|\|

*Tanninādo mahīṁ sarvāṁ āpūrva cha nabhastalam \|*  
*Viśeśārṇavandhrana pātālaṁ dānavalayam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Such loud noise entered in nether, the dwelling place of Danavas by covering the entire earth and ether from the great holes in the bottom of sea.

## \|\| 58.32 \|\|

*Śrutaḥ sa mahiṣeṇātha tārēṇa cha dhīmata \|*  
*Virōcaneṇa jambheṇa kujambhenāsurena cha \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The wise Mahisa, Taraka, Virocana, Jambha and Kujambha etc. monsters heard that sound.

## \|\| 58.33 \|\|

*Te śrutvā sahasā nādaṁ vajrapatōpamaṁ dṛḍham \|*  
*Kimetad iti saṁcintya tūrṇaṁ jagmustadāśrakam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Having heard the gross thud like thunderbolt, they all went to Andhaka in order to know what it was.

## \|\| 58.34 \|\|

*Te sametyānkkenaiva samaṁ dānavapuṁgavāḥ \|*  
*Mantraymāsarudvignāstaṁ śabdaṁ prati nārada \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О Narada all those mighty monsters became sad and began to think over that loud noise.

## \|\| 58.35 \|\|

*Mantra yatsu cha daityeṣu bhūtalāt sūkarānanah \|*  
*Pātālakēturdaityeṁdraḥ saṁprāpto'tha rasātalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. When these monsters were deliberating, the demon king Patalaketu having pig like mouth came up on ground from the nether world.

## \|\| 58.36 \|\|

*Sa bāṇaviddho vyathitaḥ kampamāno muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*Abravīdvachaṁ dīnaṁ samabhyetyāndhakāsuram \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The arrows were stabbed on his body causing pain and he was shivering. So, he came anyhow before Andhakasura and spoke in fear of the event.

## \|\| 58.37 \|\|

*Pātālaketuruvācha Gatō'hamāsaṁ daityendra gālavasyāśramaṁ prati \|*  
*Taṁ vidhvaṁsayituṁ yatnaḥ samārabdhaṁ balānmāya \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Patalaketu said- О the king of monsters! I had gone to the asrama of Galava. I forcibly began to destroy him.

## \|\| 58.38 \|\|

*Yāvat sūkararūpeṇa praviśāmi tamāśramam \|*  
*Na jāne taṁ naraṁ rājannyena me prahitaḥ śaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О king! Just when I went that asrama in disguise of a pig, suddenly a man shot arrow at me.

## \|\| 58.39 \|\|

*Śarasambhinnajatruścha bhayāt tasya mahājavaḥ \|*  
*Praṇaṣṭa āśramāttasmāts cha māṁ pṛṣṭhatō'navagāt \|\| 39 \|\|*
