39\. As the arrow had broken in jaw, I ran fastly from that asrama. He chased me to a longer distance.

## \|\| 58.40 \|\|

*Turaṅgakhuraniṛdōṣaḥ śrūyate paromāsura \|*  
*Tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti vadatas tasya śūrasya cha pṛṣṭhataḥ \|*  
*Tadbhayād asmi jaladhi saṁprāpto dakṣiṇāṛṇavam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О monster! He was chasing and his words- "Stop, stop" were ringing in my ears. The sound of hoof of the horse on which he was rode coming nearer. Due to fear of him, I came at the southern sea.

## \|\| 58.41 \|\|

*yāvatpaśyāmi tatrasthānnānāvevākṛtīnnarān \|*  
*kecidgarjanti ghanavat pratigarjanti cāpare \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. I saw there the people having several forms and sizes. Some among them were making sound like cloud thundering and others were reciprocating them.

## \|\| 58.42 \|\|

*anye cocurvayaṃ nūnaṃ nighnāmo mahiṣāsuram \|*  
*tārakaṃ ghātayāmo'dya vadantyanye sutejasaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Others were saying that we will definitely kill Mahisasura. The other people of sturdy limbs were saying that they will kill Taraka.

## \|\| 58.43-47 \|\|

*tacchrutvā suttarāṃ trāso mama jāto' sureśvara \|*  
*mahārṇavaṃ parityajya patito'smi bhayāturaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*dharaṇyāṃ vivṛtaṃ gartaṃ sa māmanvapatadbalī \|*  
*tadbhayāt saṃparityajya hiraṇyapuramātmanaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tavāntikamanuprāptaḥ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*tacchrutvā cāndhako vākyaṃ prāha meghasvanaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*na bhetavyaṃ tvayā tasmāt satyaṃ goptāsmi dānava \|*  
*mahiṣastārakakṣobhau bāṇaśca balināṃ varaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*anākhyāyaiva te vīrāstvanyakaṃ mahiṣādayaḥ \|*  
*svaparigrahasaṃyuktā bhūmi yuddhāya niryayuḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

43-47. О king monster! I was feared of listening their declaration. I ran to the open trench (hole) on the earth in fright. That warrior chased me. On account of his fear, I have come to you and abandoned my own Hiranyapura. Please, be gracious to me. Andhaka declared in cloud thundering voice in reply to him- "O monster! Don't fear of him. I am your defender. Then Mahisa and Taraka including Bana set out on battle with their attendants without seeing for the permission from Andhaka."

## \|\| 58.48 \|\|

*yatra te dāruṇākārā gaṇāścakrurmahāsvanam \|*  
*tatra daityāḥ samājagmuḥ sāyudhāḥ sabalā mune \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О hermit! These monsters with their army went at the place where the ganas of fierce size making noise.

## \|\| 58.49 \|\|

*daityānāpatato dṛṣṭvā kārttikeyagaṇāstataḥ \|*  
*abhyadravanta sahasā sa cogro mātṛmaṇḍalaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The ganas of Kartikeya and the group of aggressive Matrkas suddenly raided on the monsters when they saw them.

## \|\| 58.50 \|\|

*teṣāṃ purassaraḥ sthāṇuḥ pragṛhya parighaṃ balī \|*  
*niṣūdayat parabalaṃ kruddho rudraḥ paśūniva \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The mighty Sthanu-Rudra at their front began thrashing the army of enemy like animals in a fit of anger by giving hard blows through Parigha.

## \|\| 58.51 \|\|

*taṃ nighnantaṃ mahādevaṃ nirīkṣya kalaśodaraḥ \|*  
*kuṭhāraṃ pāṇinādāya hanti sarvān mahāsurān \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Kalasodara began killing the monsters by taking axe in his hand when he saw Mahadeva so killing the monsters.

## \|\| 58.52 \|\|

*jvālāmukho bhayaṃkaraḥ kareṇādāya cāsuram \|*  
*sarathaṃ sagajaṃ sādhaṃ vistṛte vadane'kṣipat \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The fierce Jvalamukha began to press the bodies of monsters with horses, chariots and elephants after gripping them through hands.

## \|\| 58.53 \|\|

*daṇḍakacāpi saṃkruddhaḥ prāsapāṇirmahāsuram \|*  
*savāhanaṃ prakṣipatti samutpāṭya mahārṇave \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The furiated Darujaka began to throw the monsters into sea by picking up them with their carriage (vahana). A sword was in his hand.

## \|\| 58.54 \|\|

*śaṅkukarṇaśca musalī halenākṛṣya dānavān \|*  
*saṃcūrṇayati mantrīva rājānaṃ prāsabhṛd vaśī \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. As the minister becomes cause for destruction of unjust king, Sankukarna holding musala and Prasa began churning monsters through the plough.

## \|\| 58.55 \|\|

*khaṅgacarmadharo vīraḥ puṣpadanto gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*dvidhā trithā ca bahudhā cakre daiteyadānavān \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The bold Puspadanta, heard of ganas, holding sword and shield, began to cut-off the monsters in two, three and numerous pieces.

## \|\| 58.56 \|\|

*piṅgalo daṇḍamudyamya yatra yatra pradhāvati \|*  
*tatra tatra pradṛśyante rāśayaḥ śāvadānavaiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Whenever Pingala rushed with danda in his hand, a pile of monsters corpse was seen there.

## \|\| 58.57 \|\|

*sahastranayanaḥ śūlaṃ bhrāmayanvai gaṇāgraṇīḥ \|*  
*nijaghānāsurānvīraḥ savājirathakuñjarān \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The chivalrous Sahasranayana, the best among ganas was killing monsters with horse, chariots and elephants.

## \|\| 58.58 \|\|

*bhīmo bhīmaśilāvarṣeḥ sa purassarato'surān \|*  
*nijaghāna yathaivendro vajravṛṣṭyā nagottamān \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Bhima was killing the forwarding monsters like a rain of boulders, as if Indra was destroying the great mountains through thunderbolt.

## \|\| 58.59 \|\|

*raudraḥ śakaṭacakrākṣo gaṇaḥ pañcaśikho balī \|*  
*bhrāmayanmudgaraṃ vegānnijaghāna balādripūn \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The mighty gana Pancaksa having eyes like axle to chariot wheel was slaughtering the mighty enemies through the hard blows made by Mudgara.

## \|\| 58.60 \|\|

*giribhedī talenaiva sārohaṃ kuñjaraṃ raṇe \|*  
*bhasma cakre mahāvego rathaṃ ca rathinā saha \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Giribhedi, the fast racer began to destroy the elephant with its rider and charioteer with chariot by blowing merely his slaps.

## \|\| 58.61 \|\|

*nāḍījaḍyo'ḍyipātaiśca muṣṭibhirjānunā'surān \|*  
*kolābhirvajratulyābhirjaghāna balavānmune \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О sage! The mighty Nadijangha began to thrash the monsters with blows from feet, fist, legs and thunderbolt like elbows.

## \|\| 58.62 \|\|

*kūrmagrīvo grīvayaiva śirasā caraṇena ca \|*  
*luṇṭhanena tadā daityāgnijaghāna savāhanān \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Kurmagriva began to kill the monsters by blows from neck, head and feet and by pursing the vehicles.

## \|\| 58.63 \|\|

*piṇḍākarastu tuṇḍena śṛṅgābhyāṃ ca kalipriya \|*  
*vidārayati saṃgrāme dānavān samaroddhatān \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О Narada! Pindaraka began to penetrate the monsters aggressive to war by giving blows from teeth and Srnga.

## \|\| 58.64 \|\|

*tatastatsainyamatulaṃ vadhyamānaṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ \|*  
*pradudrāvātha mahiṣastārakaśca gaṇāgraṇīḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Mahisa and Taraka marched forward aggressively when they saw Ganesvaras killing that uncountable army.

## \|\| 58.65 \|\|

*te hanyamānāḥ pramathā dānavābhyāṃ varāyudhaiḥ \|*  
*parivārya samantātte yuyudhuḥ kupitāstadā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. All those Pramathaganas covered both monsters vyho were blowing special arms from all sides and began fighting fiercely.

## \|\| 58.66 \|\|

*haṃsāsyaḥ paṭṭiśenātha jaghāna mahiṣāsuram \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāsyastriśūlena śataśīrṣo varāsināḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Hamsaya began to blow Pattisa, Sodasaksa from trident and Satasirya by sword gave blows on Mahisasura.

## \|\| 58.67 \|\|

*śrutāyudhastu gadayā viśoko musalena ca \|*  
*bandhudattastu śulena mūrchina daityamatāḍayat \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Srutayudha gave blows from mace, visoka from musala and Bandhudatta from Sula on the head of that monster.

## \|\| 58.68 \|\|

*tathānyaiḥ pārvadairyuddhe śūlaśaktyṛṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ \|*  
*nākampat tāḍyamāno'pi maināka iva parvataḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Similarly, the other members (Parsadas) gave him sharp blow of Sula, Rsti and Pattisa but he stood undeviated like Mainaka mountain.

## \|\| 58.69 \|\|

*tārako bhadrakālyā ca tatholūkhalayā raṇe \|*  
*vadhyate caikacūḍāyā dāryate paramāyudhaiḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Bhadrakali, Ulukhala and Aikacuda blew hard on Taraka with the specific weapons.

## \|\| 58.70 \|\|

*tau tāḍyamānau pramathairmātṛbhiśca mahāsuraiḥ \|*  
*na kṣobhaṃ jagmaturvīrau kṣobhayantau gaṇānapi \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Both these monsters were putting in excitement to ganas without getting excited by Parsadas and Matrsaktis.

## \|\| 58.71 \|\|

*mahiṣo gadayā tūrṇaṃ prahāraiḥ pramathānatha \|*  
*parājitya prarādhāvat kumāraṃ prati sāyudhaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Mahisasura then rushed to Kumara with weapons in his hands after giving a bitter defeat to Pramathas by blowing mace etc. weapons.

## \|\| 58.72 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ mahiṣaṃ sucakrākṣo nirīkṣya hi \|*  
*cakramudyamya saṃkruddho rurodha danunandanam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Sucakraksa picked up discus and prevented that Mahisa while saw his marching forward.

## \|\| 58.73 \|\|

*gadācakrāṅkittakarau gaṇāsuramahārathau \|*  
*ayudhyetāṃ tadā brahman laghu citraṃ ca suṣṭhu ca \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О Brahmana! the monsters and ganas both great warriors (charioteers) began to fight varied ways that time.

## \|\| 58.74 \|\|

*gadāṃ mumoca mahiṣaḥ samāvidhya gaṇāya tu \|*  
*sucakrākṣo nijaṃ cakramutsarjāsuraṃ prati \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Mahisa threw his mace on Sucakraksa after giving it a turn. Sucakraksa also threw his discus on that monster.

## \|\| 58.75 \|\|

*gadāṃ chitvā sutīkṣṇāraṃ cakraṃ mahiṣamādravata \|*  
*tata ughukruśurdaityāsa hā hato mahiṣastviti \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. That discus with spikes very acute was thrown on Mahisa. It split in pieces the mace so thrown. Then the monsters began to cry with words "Oh! Mahisa has been killed."

## \|\| 58.76 \|\|

*tacchrutvā'bhyadravadvāṇaḥ prāsamāvidhya vegavān \|*  
*jaghāna cakraṃ raktākṣaṃ pañcamuṣṭiśatena hi \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Banasura with reddened eyes in anger, rushed just with Prasa in his hand and gave a blow to discus with five hundred fists (mustis).

## \|\| 58.77 \|\|

*pañcabāhuśatenāpi sucakrākṣaṃ babandha saḥ \|*  
*balavānapi bāṇena nivprayatna gatiḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. He then fastened Sucakraksa with his fire hundred arms. Sucakraksa was made actionless by Banasura however he was mighty enough to fight.

## \|\| 58.78 \|\|

*sucakrākṣaṃ sacakraṃ hi baddhaṃ bāṇāsureṇa hi \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā'dravadgadāpāṇirmakarākṣo mahābalaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. When the mighty Makaraksa saw Sucakraksa so fastened by Banasura, he rushed with a mace in his hands.

## \|\| 58.79-80 \|\|

*gadayā mūrdhni bāṇaṃ hi nijaghāna mahābalaḥ \|*  
*vedanārttā mumocātha sucakrākṣa mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*sa cāpi tena saṃyukto vrīḍāyukto mahāmanāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*sa saṃgrāmaṃ parityajya sāligrāmamupāyayau \|*  
*bāṇo'pi makārākṣeṇa tāḍito'bhūtparāṅmukhaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. The mighty Makaraksa gave a sharp blow on the head of Banasura by his mace. Bana left Sucakraksa free on account to severe pain on his head. That chivalrous ashamed after seeing his free from his grip. In vagary of so depression, he Went to Saligrama. Bana too left continuing the fight because of injury.

## \|\| 58.81 \|\|

*prabhajyata balaṃ sarvaṃ daityānāṃ suratāpasa \|*  
*tataḥ svabalnamīkṣyaiva prabhagnaṃ tārako balī \|*  
*khaṅgodyatakaro daityaḥ pradudrāva gaṇeśvarān \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. О Narada! The hole army of demons was scattered. That chivalrous demon Taraka rushed towards Ganesvaras with a sword in his hand.

## \|\| 58.82 \|\|

*tatastu tenāpratimena sāsinā te haṃsavaktrapramukhā gaṇeśvarāḥ \|*  
*samātakhścāpi parājitā raṇe skandaṃ bhayārttāḥ śaraṇaṃ prapedire \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. That unique warrior holding sword had then defeated the Ganesvaras including Matrkas and Hamsavaktra etc. They all sheltered to Skanda due to severe fear.

## \|\| 58.83 \|\|

*bhagnān gaṇān vīkṣya maheśvarātmaja staṃ tārakaṃ sāsinamāpatantam \|*  
*dṛṣṭva śaktyā hṛdaye bibheda sa bhinnamarmā nyapatat pṛthivyām \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Kumara, the son of Mahesvara pierced Tarakas heart by his acute blow of sakti when he saw his forwarding with sword and when ganas were seen frightened. He fell on the ground due to such sharp blow.

## \|\| 58.85 \|\|

*tasminhate bhrātari bhagnadarpo bhayāturo'bhūnmahiṣo maharṣe \|*  
*saṃtyajya saṃgrāmaśiro durātmā jagāma śailaṃ sa himācalākhyam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. О Maharsi! The proud of Mahisasura licked dust on the death of his brother Taraka. That rude became anxious, showed back to the battle and ran toward Himalaya.

## \|\| 58.86 \|\|

*bāṇo'pi vīre nihate'tha tārake gate himādriṃ mahiṣe bhayārte \|*  
*bhayādviveśogramapāṃ nidhānaṃ gaṇairbale vadhyati sāparādhe \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. When chivalrous Taraka was killed, frightened Mahisa ran to Himalaya and the miscreant army was slaughtered by ganas, Bana also entered into the deep ocean in vagary of fright.

## \|\| 58.87 \|\|

*hatvā kumāro raṇamūrdhni tārakaṃ pragṛhya śaktiṃ mahatā javena \|*  
*mayūramāruhya śikhaṇḍamaṇḍitaṃ yayau nihantuṃ mahivāsurasya \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Kumara rode on peacock having Sikhanda and rushed to kill Mahisasura after he so killed Taraka in the battle.

## \|\| 58.88 \|\|

*sa pṛṣṭhataḥ prekṣya śikhaṇḍiketanaṃ samāpatantaṃ varaśaktipāṇinam \|*  
*kailāsamutsṛjya himācalaṃ tathā krauñcaṃ samabhyetya guhāṃ viveśa \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. When Mahisasura saw the rider of peacock (Kumara) with particular sakti chasing him, he immediately left behind Kailasa and Himalaya, reached at the Kraunca mountain and entered into a care there.

## \|\| 58.89 \|\|

*daityaṃ praviṣṭaṃ sa pinākisūnu- rjugopa yatnādbhagavān guho'pi \|*  
*svabandhuhantā bhavitā kathaṃ tvahaṃ saṃcintayanneva tataḥ sthito'bhūt \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. God Guha, the son of Mahadeva began to keep a vigil on the monster so entered into the care. He stood there thinking that how to kill his brother.

## \|\| 58.90 \|\|

*tato'bhyagāt puṣkarasaṃbhavastu haro murāristridaśeśvakhśca \|*  
*abhyetya cocurmahivaṃ saśailaṃ bhindasva śaktyā kuru devakāryam \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Then lotus bom Brahma, god Sankara, Visnu and Indra came there and said- "Kill Mahisa with mountain by blowing your sakti. Thus, complete the divine assignment."

## \|\| 58.91 \|\|

*tat kārtikayaḥ priyameva tathyaṃ śrutvā vacaḥ prāha surānvihasya \|*  
*kathaṃ hi mātāmahanapṭhakaṃ vadhe svabhrātaraṃ bhrātṛsutaṃ ca mātuḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Kartikeya smiled on this factual and pleasing instruction and said to gods- "How can I kill the grandson of my grandfather (mother's father), my brother and the nephew of my mother?"

## \|\| 58.92 \|\|

*eṣā śrutiścāpi purātanī kila gāyanti yāṃ vedavido maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā ca yasyāṃ matamuttamāyāḥ svargaṃ vrajanti tvatipāpino'pi \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. (In this context) an ancient Sruti (dictum) is spoken. It has been applied by the learned persons in Vedas called Abhapaka. According to this best dictum, even heinous miscreants go to the heaven.

## \|\| 58.93 \|\|

*gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vṛddhamathāptavākyaṃ bālaṃ svabandhuṃ lalanāmaduṣṭām \|*  
*kṛtāparādhā api naiva vadhyā ācāryamukhyā guravastathaiva \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. The cow, Brahmin, old people, realistic, child, one's relative, a chaste woman and Acarya etc. preceptors are not worth giving sentence of death even if any offence is committed by them.

## \|\| 58.94 \|\|

*evaṃ jānandharmamagryaṃ surendrā nāhaṃ hanyāṃ bhrātaraṃ mātuleyam \|*  
*yathā daityo nirgamiṣyad guhāntaḥ tadā śaktyā ghātayiṣyāmi śatrum \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. О great gods! I will not kill my own brother as I am known to that dictum. I will kill that demon by using my sakti as and when he comes out from the care.

## \|\| 58.95 \|\|

*śrutvā kumāravacanaṃ bhagavānmaharṣe kṛtvā mataṃ svahṛdaye guhamāha śakraḥ \|*  
*matto bhavānna matimān vadase kimartha vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣva hariṇā gaditaṃ hi pūrvam \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. О great hermit! Indra pondered upon the statement given by Kumara and said- "You are not wiser than me. Why are you speaking? Listen to what Hari had said long ago."

## \|\| 58.96 \|\|

*naikasyārthe bahūn hanyāditi śāstreṣu niścayaḥ \|*  
*ekaṃ hanyādbahūnāṃ hi na pāpī tena jāyate \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. It is quoted specifically on scriptures that one should not kill many for one person. However, the man is unstuck to the evil when he kills one for safeguards of the interests of others.

## \|\| 58.97 \|\|

*etacchrutvā mayā pūrva samayasthena cāgnija \|*  
*nihato namuciḥ pūrva sodaro'pi mamānujaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. О son of fire! Having heard this theorem I had long ago killed my sibling Namuci in spite of alliance and amicable relations between us.

## \|\| 58.98 \|\|

*tasmādbahūnāmarthāya sakrauñca mahiṣāsuram \|*  
*ghātayasva padākramya śaktyā pāvakadattayā \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Hence, kill Mahisasura with Kraunca by blowing will valour, the sakti given by fire god.

## \|\| 58.99 \|\|

*puraṃdaravacaḥ śrutvā krodhādāraktalocanaḥ \|*  
*kumāraḥ prāha vacanaṃ kampamānaḥ śatakratum \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Having heard, this Kumara's eyes became red with anger. He said to Indra slightly shivering in excitement.

## \|\| 58.100 \|\|

*mūḍha kiṃ te balaṃ bāhvoḥ śārīraṃ cāpi vṛtrahan \|*  
*yenādhikṣipase māṃ tvaṃ dhruvaṃ na matimānasi \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. О stupid enemy of Vrtra! To what extent you have power in body and arms. Whether it is worth challenging me. You, falsely boosting like a man lost of wisdom.

## \|\| 58.101 \|\|

*tamuvāca sahasrākṣastvatto' hai balavānguha \|*  
*taṃ guhaḥ prāha ehyehi yuddhyasva balavānyadi \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. The thousand eyed Indra said to him- О Guha! I am stronger than you. Guha challenged Indra- "If you think so, then come and fight."

## \|\| 58.102 \|\|

*śakraḥ prāhātha balavān jñāyate kṛttikāsuta \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ śīghrataraṃ yaḥ kuryātkrauñcameva hi \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Indra replied- О son of Krttika! The person coming first in round-turn (pradaksina) of Kraunca mountain, shall be deemed mightier.

## \|\| 58.103 \|\|

*śrutvā tadvacanaṃ skando mayūraṃ prohya vegavān \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ pādacārī kartuṃ tūrṇataro'bhyagāt \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Skanda stood up and went very fast on foot to do Parikrama of the Kraunca mountain. He did not ride on peacock.

## \|\| 58.104 \|\|

*śakro'vatīrya nāgendrāt pādenātha pradakṣiṇām \|*  
*kṛtvā tasthau guho'bhyetya mūḍhaṃ kiṃ saṃsthito bhavān \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. Indra to came there after Parikrama he made bare-foot and left his elephant behind. Skanda approached to Skanda and said- "O idiot! Why are you seated here?"

## \|\| 58.105 \|\|

*tamindraḥ prāha kauṭilyaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ pradakṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*kṛtā'sya na tvayā pūrvaṃ kumāraḥ śakramabravīt \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Indra replied- "I have done Pradaksina earlier than you. Kumara protested and said- "You have not made it first."

## \|\| 58.106 \|\|

*mayā pūrvaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ vivadantau parasparam \|*  
*prāpyocaturmaheśāya brahmaṇe mādhavāya ca \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Both of them began disputing on this issue by saying he was first- he was first. Thus, they went to Sankara, Brahma and Visnu and reported it before them.

## \|\| 58.107 \|\|

*athovaca hariḥ skandaṃ praṣṭumarhasi parvatam \|*  
*yo'yaṃ vakṣyati pūrvaṃ sa bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Visnu said to Skanda- "Ask the mountain Kraunca. The man named by mountain shall be considered the first who made parikrama.

## \|\| 58.108 \|\|

*tanmādhavavacaḥ śrutvā krauñcamabhyetya pāvakiḥ \|*  
*papracchādrimidaṃ kena kṛtaṃ pūrva pradakṣiṇam \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Hearing the words of Narayana, the fire- bom God reached to Kraunca mountain and asked him that “Eho circumambulated first?”

## \|\| 58.109 \|\|

*ityevamuktaḥ krauñcastu prāha pūrva mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*cakāra gotrabhit paścāttvayā kṛtamatho guha \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Kraunca, the wise mountain said- "O Guha! Indra had done it first and then you had made it."

## \|\| 58.110 \|\|

*evaṃ buvantaṃ krauñcaṃ sa krodhātprasphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*bibheda śaktyā kauṭilyo mahiṣeṇa samaṃ tadā \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Kumara furiated on mountain, he blew the sakti and the entire mountain along with Mahisasura penetrated in pieces. It was completely collapsed.

## \|\| 58.111 \|\|

*tasminhate'tha tanaye balavān sunābho vegena bhūmidharapārthivajastathā'gāt \|*  
*brahmendra rudramarudaśviva supradhānā jagmurdivaṃ mahiṣamīkṣya hataṃ guhena \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. On the death of his son, the might Sunabha, son of Himalaya came there very fast. Brahma, Indra, Rudra, Vayu, Asvinikumara, Vasu etc. gods, returned to heaven when they conformed of the death of Mahisasura by Guha.

## \|\| 58.112 \|\|

*svamātulaṃ vīkṣya balī kumāraḥ śakti samutpāṭya nihantukāmaḥ \|*  
*nivāritaścakradhareṇa vegā- dāliṅgaya dorthyāṃ gururityudīrya \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Mighty Kumara intended to kill his maternal uncle through the hard blows of sakti. However, Visnu appeared in the meantime, embraced him and prohibited him by saying that he was Guha's preceptor.

## \|\| 58.113 \|\|

*sunābhamabhyetya himācalastu pragṛhma haste'nyata eva nītavān \|*  
*hariṃ kumāraṃ saśikhaṇḍinaṃ navanvegāddivaṃ pannagaśatrupatraḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Himalaya came to Sunabha, took him with hand, brought towards other side and Hari, the rider on Garuda took Kumara with peacock to heaven very fast.

## \|\| 58.114 \|\|

*tato guhaḥ prāha hariṃ sureśaṃ mohena naṣṭo bhagavanvivekaḥ \|*  
*bhrātā mayā mātuleyo nirasta- stasmātkariṣye svaśarīraśoṣam \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Guha than said to Suresvara Hari- "O god! My discretion suffered due to excessive affection. I have killed my maternal brother. Hence, I will put my body on fasts.

## \|\| 58.115 \|\|

*taṃ prāha viṣṇurvaja tīrthavaryaṃ pṛthūdakaṃ pāpataroḥ kuṭhāram \|*  
*snātvaughavatyāṃ haramīkṣya bhaktyā bhaviṣyase sūryasamaprabhāvaḥ \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Visnu said to him- "O Kumara! Go at the holy place Prthudaka in order to absolve from sin. That place is like an axe to the tree of evils.

## \|\| 58.116 \|\|

*ityevamukto hariṇā kumāra- stvabhyetya tīrthaṃ prasamīkṣya śaṃbhum \|*  
*snātvā'rcya devānsaṃ raviprakāśo jagāma śailaṃ sadanaṃ harasya \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Following the words of Hari, Kumara went at Prthudaka. He saw Mahadeva there. He took bath, worshipped gods, regained the splendour like sun and then returned to the residential mountain of Mahadeva.

## \|\| 58.117 \|\|

*sucakranetro'pi mahāśrame tapa- ścacāra śaile pavanāśanastu \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa vṛṣadhvajaṃ tadā haro'sya tuṣṭo varado babhūva \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. The Ganesvara Sucakranetra began to observe penance for the pleasure of god Sankara in Mahasrama situated on the mountain. Sankara pleased on such strict penance and prepared to give him desired.

## \|\| 58.118 \|\|

*devāt sa vane varamāyudhārthe cakraṃ tathā vai ripubāhukhaṇḍam \|*  
*chindyādyathā tvatpratimaṃ kareṇa bāṇasya tanme bhagavān dadātu \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. He asked for having special weapon with him. "O god! Please, give me an excellent discus which may tom into pieces the multitude of the arms of the enemy Bana in a matchless fashion.

## \|\| 58.119 \|\|

*tamāha śaṃbhuvraja dattametad varaṃ hi cakrasya tavāyudhasya \|*  
*bāṇasya tadvāhuvanaṃ pravṛddhaṃ saṃchetsyase nātra vicāvaṇā'sti \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Mahadeva said to him- "Go now. I have given discus for which you asked. It shall definitely, suppress the over grown arms power of Banasura.

## \|\| 58.120 \|\|

*vare pradatte tripurāntakena gaṇeśvaraḥ skandamupājagāma \|*  
*nipatya pādau prativandha iṣṭau nivedayāmāsa haraprasādam \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. When Skanda so received the discus, Ganesvara went to him, bowed on his feet, prayed and described the grace of Mahadeva before him.

## \|\| 58.121 \|\|

*evaṃ tavoktaṃ mahiṣāsurasya vadhaṃ trinetrātmajaśaktibhedāt \|*  
*krauñcasya mṛtyuḥ śaraṇāgatārtha pāpāpahaṃ puṇyavivardhanaṃ ca \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Thus, I have completely described the episode pertaining to the slaughter of Mahisasura by the son of Sankara. Kraunca was spoiled as he had sheltered the sinner. This episode effaces the evils and increases the account of noble deeds.

## Chapter 59. Defeat of demon Andhaka

## \|\| 59.1 \|\|

*yo'sau mantrayatāṃ prāpto daityānāṃ śaratāḍitaḥ \|*  
*sa kena vada nirbhinnaḥ śareṇa ditijeśvaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- Please, tell us that the demon suddenly. Killed by an arrow thrown on him while he was busy in discussing matters in a meeting, who was that person who attacked so fiercely?

## \|\| 59.2-3 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca āsīnnṛpo raghukule ripujinmaharṣe tasyātmajo guṇagaṇaikanidhirmahātmā \|*  
*śūro'risainyadamano balavān suhatsu viprāndhadīnakṛpaṇeṣu samānabhāvaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ṛtadhvajo nāma mahān mahīyān sa gālavārthe turagādhirūḍhaḥ \|*  
*pātālaketuṃ nijaghāna pṛṣṭhe bāṇena candrārdhanibhena vegāt \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Pulastya said- О great hermit! Ripujita was the king in Raghu dynasty. He had a son meritorious, great soul chivalrous, enemy killer; mighty and generous to do equal with friends, Brahmins, blinds, paupers and misers.

## \|\| 59.4 \|\|

*nārada uvāca kimarthaṃ gālavasyāsau sādhayāmāsa sattama \|*  
*yenāsau patriṇā daityaṃ nijaghāna nṛpātmajaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narada said- What work in favour of the hermit Galava, had performed by that son of king by throwing that arrow?

## \|\| 59.5 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca purā tapastapyati gālavarṣi- rmahāśrame sve satataṃ niviṣṭe \|*  
*pātālaketustapaso'sya vighnaṃ karoti maukyāt sa samādhibhaṅgam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Pulastya said- The hermit Galava was doing penance at asrama during long ago. The demon Patalaketu used to create hurdles in his penance and disturbances to his meditation. He was doing this all under influence of ignorance.

## \|\| 59.6 \|\|

*na ceṣyate'sau tapaso vyayaṃ hi śakto'pi kartuṃ tvatha bhasmasāttam \|*  
*ākāśamīkṣyātha sa dīrghamuṣṇaṃ mumoca niḥśvāsamanuttamaṃ hi \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In spite of being capable to turn his body into ashes, he was not intended to misuse the power so acquired. He looked at sky and expirated long, hot and bitter air.

## \|\| 59.7 \|\|

*tato'mbarādvājivaraḥ papāta babhūva vāṇī tvaśarīriṇī ca \|*  
*asau turaṅgo balavānkrameta ahnā sahastrāṇi tu yojanānām \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then there fell a horse beautiful down from the ether. It had been declared by an invisible sound simultaneously that the horse so dropped down can cross a distance of one thousand yojana in a day.

## \|\| 59.8 \|\|

*sa taṃ pragṛhyāśvavaraṃ narendra ṛtavyajaṃ yojya tadāttaśastram \|*  
*sthitastapasyeva tato mahirṣi- daityaṃ sametya viśikhairnṛpajo bibheda \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The hermit assigned that horse to king Rtadhvaja and continued his penance. The prince thereafter went to that demon and injured him by an arrow.

## \|\| 59.9 \|\|

*nārada uvāca kenāmbaratalādvājī nisṛṣṭo vada suvrata \|*  
*vākkasyādehinī jātā paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Narada said- О great resolute! Please tell us who had dropped that horse down on earth and who made that intangible declaration? I am curious to listen about all this.

## \|\| 59.10 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca viśvāvasurnāma mahendragāyano gandharvarājo balavānyaśasvī \|*  
*nisṛṣṭavān bhūvalaye turaṅgaṃ ṛtabvajasyaiva sutārthamāśu \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Pulastya said- The illustrious and mighty chief of the Gandharva, the musician to lord Indra named Visvavasu had dropped the horse down on the earth for his daughter on behalf of Rtadhvaja.

## \|\| 59.11 \|\|

*nārada uvāca ko'rtho gandharvarājasya yenāpraiṣīnmahājavam \|*  
*rājñaḥ kuvalāyāśvasya ko'rtho nṛpasutasya ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Narada said- "What was the purpose of that Gandharva in sending that horse and what purpose was of the king Kuvalayasva?"

## \|\| 59.12 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca viśvāvasoḥ śīlaguṇopapannā āsītpurandhrīṣu varā triloke \|*  
*lāvaṇyarāśiḥ śaśikāntitulyā madālasā nāma madālasaiva \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Pulastya said- Visvavasu had a daughter Madalasa. She was fllled with intoxication. She was modest, the best among all women in three-worlds, a beautiful one and her radiance was like moon-light.

## \|\| 59.13 \|\|

*tāṃ nandano devaripustarasvī saṃkrīḍantīṃ rūpavatīṃ dadarśa \|*  
*pātālaketustu jahāra tanvīṃ tasyārthataḥ so'śvavaraḥ pradattaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Patalaketu, an enemy of gods saw her enjoying at Nandana forest and abducted her. That special horse was given for her defence.

## \|\| 59.14 \|\|

*hatvā ca daityaṃ nṛpatestanūjo labvā varorūmapi saṃsthito'bhūt \|*  
*dṛṣṭo yathā devapatirmahendraḥ śacyā tathā rājasuto mṛgākṣyā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. After killing that demon, the prince got that virgin having the best thighs and married her. The prince with that deer eyed virgin was looking as if Indra is there with his wife Indrani.

## \|\| 59.15 \|\|

*nārada uvāca evaṃ niraste mahiṣe tārake ca mahāsure \|*  
*hiraṇyākṣasuto dhīmānkimaceṣṭata vai punaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Narada said- What had Andhaka done when the great demon Тarака and Mahisa were killed? Andhaka was the son of notorious demon Hiranyaкsа.

## \|\| 59.16 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca tārakaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣaṃ ca raṇe'nyakaḥ \|*  
*krodhaṃ cakre sudurbuddhirdaityānāṃ devasainyahā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Pulastya said- When Andhaka saw Тaraка and Mahisa both killed in battle, he filled with anger. He was destroyer of divine army and most cunning demon.

## \|\| 59.17 \|\|

*tataḥ svalpaparīvāraḥ pragṛhya parighaṃ kare \|*  
*nirjagāmātha pātālādvicacāra ca medinīm \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. He then took Parigha in hand and came out from nether with a few soldiers. He came upon earth and began strolling.

## \|\| 59.18 \|\|

*tato vicaratā tena mandare cārukandare \|*  
*dṛṣṭā gaurī ca girijā sakhīmadhye sthitā śubhā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. While so strolling, he saw Gauri, the daughter of Himalaya on mountain Mandara covered by the caves.

## \|\| 59.19 \|\|

*tato'bhūt kāmabāṇārttaḥ sahasaivāndhakosuraḥ \|*  
*tāṃ dṛṣṭā cārusarvāṅgīṃ girirājasutāṃ vane \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Having seen that beautiful daughter of Himalaya, Andhaka suddenly filled with sensuous feeling.

## \|\| 59.20 \|\|

*athovācāsuro mūḍho vacanaṃ manmathānyakaḥ \|*  
*kasyeyaṃ cārusarvāṅgī vane carati sundarī \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Then Andhaka, that idiot and sensuous demon said- whose daughter is this beautiful virgin?

## \|\| 59.21 \|\|

*iyaṃ yadi bhavennaiva mamāntaḥ puravāsinī \|*  
*tanmadīyena jīvena kriyate niṣphalena kim \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. If I could not make her my bride it is but useless living for me? (viz. I should get her at any cost as my bride).

## \|\| 59.22 \|\|

*yadasyāstanumadhyāyā na pariṣvaṅgavānaham \|*  
*ato dhiṅ mama rūpeṇa kiṃ sthireṇa prayojanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Condemn to my formidable complexion being its useless if I could not get the pleasure of embracing this thin loin virgin.

## \|\| 59.23 \|\|

*sa me bandhuḥ sa sacivaḥ sa bhrātā sāmparāyikaḥ \|*  
*yo māmasitakeśīṃ tāṃ yojayen mṛgalocanām \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. He would only be my brother, secretary, sibling and the comrade in war who would make my meeting with that beautiful virgin.

## \|\| 59.24 \|\|

*itthaṃ vadati daityendre prahlādo buddhisāgaraḥ \|*  
*pidhāya karṇo hastābhyāṃ śiraḥ kampaṃ vaco'bravīt \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The wise Prahlada covered his ears with both hands, nodded his head in rejection when he heard this averment from the demon king Andhaka. He said-

## \|\| 59.25 \|\|

*mā maivaṃ vada daityendra jagato jananī tviyam \|*  
*lokanāthasya bhāryeyaṃ śaṃkarasya triśūlinaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О demon king! Don't say this. She is the mother of world and wife of Sankara, the trident holder and monster of this whole universe.

## \|\| 59.26 \|\|

*mā kuruṣva sudurbuddhiṃ sadyaḥ kulavināśinīm \|*  
*bhavataḥ paradāreyaṃ mā nimajja rasātale \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Don't do such act as this will immediately destroy die whole clan. She is other's wife for you. Hence, don't fall in nether, (viz. Don't be so cunning).

## \|\| 59.27 \|\|

*satsu kutsitamevaṃ hi asatsvapi hi kutsitam \|*  
*śatravaste prakurvantu paradārāvagāhanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. May! Such act condemned by gentlemen as also the wicked to perform by your enemies.

## \|\| 59.28 \|\|

*kiṃcit tvayā na śrutaṃ daityanātha gītaḥ ślokaṃ gādhinā pārthivena \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ vipradhenuprasakta tathyaṃ pathyaṃ sarvaloke hitaṃ ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О king demon! Whether have you not heard the benevolent, factual and preventive hymn chanted by Gadhi king when he saw his son Visvamitra applying force to snatch the Brahmin's cow.

## \|\| 59.29 \|\|

*varaṃ prāṇāstyājyā na ca piśunavādevvabhiratiḥ varaṃ maunaṃ kāryaṃ na vacanamuktaṃ yadanṛtam \|*  
*varaṃ klīvairbhāvyaṃ na ca parakalatrābhigamanaṃ varaṃ bhikṣārthitvaṃ na ca paradhanāsvā dama sakṛt \|*  
*\|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. It is good to abandon the life but not good to fall in affection when anything has been brought forward by any back-biter. Better to keep silence then to tell a lie. It is good to live impotent but courtship with other's wife is always prohibited. Better to ask for alms than using other's money frequently.

## \|\| 59.30 \|\|

*sa prahlādavacaḥ śrutvā krodhāndho madanārditaḥ \|*  
*iyaṃ sā śatru jananītyevamuktvā pradudruve \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The sensuous Andhaka rushed toward that virgin saying that she is the mother of that enemy. He became furious on bearing this averment of Prahlada.

## \|\| 59.31 \|\|

*tato'nvadhāvan daiteyā yantramuktā ivopalāḥ \|*  
*tān rurodha balānnandī vajrodyatakaro'vyayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The other demons then chased him like a stone threw from an apparatus. Imperishable Nandi took thunderbolt in his hand and resisted him forcibly.

## \|\| 59.32 \|\|

*mayatārapurogāste vāritā drāvitāstathā \|*  
*kuliśenāhatāstūrṇa jagmurbhītā diśo daśa \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. All those demons including Maya and Тarака etc. so resisted and driven, departed to the ten directions.

## \|\| 59.33 \|\|

*tānarditānnaṇe dṛṣṭvā nandinā'ndhakadānavaḥ \|*  
*parigheṇa samāhatya pātayāmāsa nandinam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. When Andhaka saw all of them so suffered, he hit hard by Parigha on Nandi and knocked him down.

## \|\| 59.34 \|\|

*śaileyaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhāvamānaṃ tathā'ndhakam \|*  
*śatarūpā'bhavadgaurī bhayāttasya durātmanaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. When Gauri saw Nandi knocked down and Andhaka coming rapidly. She bursted him into several thousand forms due to his fear.

## \|\| 59.35 \|\|

*tataḥ sa devīgaṇamadhyasaṃsthitaḥ paribhraman bhāti mahāsurendraḥ \|*  
*yathā vane mattakarī paribhraman kareṇumadhye madaloladṛṣṭiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The fierce demon moving among goddesses was looked as if an intoxicated elephant moves among the several feminine elephants.

## \|\| 59.36 \|\|

*na parijñātavāṃstatra kā tu sā girikanyakā \|*  
*nātrāścaryaṃ na paśyanti catvāro'mī sadaiva hi \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. He could not understand that who is the daughter of mountain? The four type people are not seen always hence, there is no surprise if he could not recognise the daughter of mountain, Gauri.

## \|\| 59.37 \|\|

*na paśyatīha jātyandho rāgāndho'pi na paśyati \|*  
*na paśyati madonmatto lobhākrānto na paśyati \|*  
*so'paśyamāno girijāṃ paśyannapi tadā'ndhakaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. These people are- (1) the blind by birth, (2) the man blind of affection, (3) the intoxicant and (4) the greedy man. This was the reason, Andhaka could not see Girija while she was present there.

## \|\| 59.38 \|\|

*prahāraṃ nāādadattāsāṃ yuvatya iti cintayan \|*  
*tato devyā sa duṣṭātmā śatāvaryā nirākṛtaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. That demon did not attack on them considering them all the women. It was the goddess Satavarl who hit hard on him.

## \|\| 59.39-41 \|\|

*kuṭṭitaḥ pravaraiḥ śastrairnipapāta mahītale \|*  
*vīkṣyāndhakaṃ nipatitaṃ śatarūpa \|*  
*vibhāvarī \|\| 39 \|\|*

*tasmāt sthānādapākramya gatā'ntardhānamambikā \|*  
*patitaṃ cāndhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityadānavayūthapāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kurvantaḥ sumahāśabdaṃ prādravanta raṇārthinaḥ \|*  
*teṣāmāpatatāṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā tasthau gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. He fell down on the earth when crushed body by the specific weapons. The hundred form goddess Ambika vanished suddenly from there when she saw Andhaka so knocked down. The commanders of army in demons and monsters simultaneously made a tumult and rushed to attack on goddess. When Ganesvara heard the commotion so made by monsters, he suddenly stood up.

## \|\| 59.42-46 \|\|

*ādāya vajraṃ balavān maghavāniva kopittaḥ \|*  
*dānavān samayān vīraḥ parājitya gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*samabhyetyāmbikāṃ dṛṣṭvā vavande caraṇau śubhau \|*  
*devī ca tā nijā mūrtīḥ prāha gacchadhvamicchayā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*viharadhvaṃ mahīpṛṣṭhe pūjyamānā narairiha \|*  
*vasatirbhavatīnāṃ ca udyāneṣu vaneṣu ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*vanaspatiṣu vṛkṣeṣu gacchadhvaṃ vigatajvarāḥ \|*  
*tāstvevamuktāḥ śaileyyā praṇipatyāmbikāṃ kramāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

*dikṣu sarvāsu jagmustāḥ stūyamānāśca kinnaraiḥ \|*  
*andhako'pi smṛtiṃ labdhvā apaśyannadrinandinīm \|*  
*svabalaṃ nirjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ pātālamādravat \|\| 46 \|\|*

42-46. Furiated Ganesvara took thunderbolt analogous to Indra's weapon, defeated all monsters including Maya, went to Ambika and bowed his head on her feet. The goddess also instructed her varied forms- "Go whenever you like. Stole on the earth and receive worship from the human beings there. You all will reside in orchards, forests, regetations and trees. Be fearless and now move from here. All of them kept the words of Ambika, bowed their heads, received honour from eunuchs (Kinnaras) and then moved to all directions. Andhaka got conscious after sometime, but could not see Girija there. He saw that his whole army was badly crushed so, he returned back to the nether.

## \|\| 59.47 \|\|

*tato durātmā sa tadā'nyako mune pātālamabhyetya divā na bhuṅkte \|*  
*rātrau na śete madaneṣutāḍito gaurīṃ smarankāmabalābhipannaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О sage! Andhaka could not forget the beauty of Gauri, became sensuous and anxious to get her. His mind was stuck to Gauri so severely that neither he used to take food in the day nor slept for seconds at the night.

## Chapter 60. The story of Demon Mura

## \|\| 60.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca kva gataḥ śaṃkaro hyāsīdyenāmbā nandinā saha \|*  
*andhakaṃ yodhayāmāsa etanme vaktumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- "Tell me please where Sankara was at the time Gauri and Nandi fought against Andhaka?"

## \|\| 60.2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca yadā varṣasahasraṃ tu mahāmohe sthito'bhavat \|*  
*tadāprabhṛti nistejāḥ kṣīṇavīryaḥ pradṛśyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- After the end of great affection for one thousand years, god Sankara had lost splendour and felt him very weak.

## \|\| 60.3 \|\|

*svamātmānaṃ nirīkṣyātha nistejo'śaṃ maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*tapo'rthāya tadā cakre matiṃ matimatāṃ varaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. When wisest Sankara guessed of his power loss, he decided to observe penance in order to regain the power and splendour.

## \|\| 60.4 \|\|

*sa mahāvratamutpādya samāśvāsyāmbikāṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*śailārdi sthāpya goptāraṃ vicacāra mahītale \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. That sovereign Sankara resorted to great fast (resolution), assured Ambika of his decision, handed over the security to Nandi (Saila etc.) and started walking on the earth.

## \|\| 60.5 \|\|

*mahāmudrārthitagrīvo mahāhikṛtakuṇḍalaḥ \|*  
*dhārayāṇaḥ kaṭīdeśe mahāśaṅkhasya mekhalām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He put Mahamudra in neck, earrings of great serpents and Mekhala of Mahasankha (conch) on his loin region.

## \|\| 60.6 \|\|

*kapālaṃ dakṣiṇe haste savye gṛhya kamaṇḍalum \|*  
*ekāhavāsī vṛkṣe hi śailasānunadīṣvaṭan \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He began to stroll around the trees in plains, climb on the mountain peaks and on the river banks with Narakapala in his right hand and Kamandalu in left hand.

## \|\| 60.7 \|\|

*sthānaṃ trailokyamāsthāya mūlāhāro'mbubhojanaḥ \|*  
*vāyvāhāra stathā tasthau navavarṣaśataṃ kramāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He passed nine hundred years in tour around three worlds and lived on roots, water and air as his diet during this period.

## \|\| 60.8 \|\|

*tato vīṭāṃ mukhe kṣipya nirucchvāso'bhavad yatiḥ \|*  
*vistṛte himavatpṛṣṭhe ramye samaśilātale \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. That ascetic then took a seat on upper Himalaya at an attractive and plain surface of the ridge and controlled his breathing by putting Vita on his mouth.

## \|\| 60.9 \|\|

*tato vīṭāṃ vidāryaiva kapālaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*sā'rciṣmatī jaṭāmadhyānniṣaṇṇā dharaṇītale \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. That Vita blazing with flames later on entered into the skull, penetrated the forehead, came out from the middle portion of matted hair and fell down on the earth.

## \|\| 60.10 \|\|

*vīṭayā tu patantyā'drirdāritaḥ kṣmāsamo'bhavat \|*  
*jātastīrthavaraḥ puṇyaḥ kedāra iti viśrutaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. On account of such sudden fall of Vita, the mountain burst and turned into plain land. The holy place Kedara became famous at that part of the land.

## \|\| 60.11 \|\|

*tato haro varaṃ prādāt kedārāya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ \|*  
*puṇyavṛddhikaraṃ brahman pāpaghnaṃ mokṣasādhanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О Brahmin! Mahadeva, the bull rider then endowed Kedara with power to absolve sin, enhance noble deed (punya) and ensure emancipation to the devotees.

## \|\| 60.12-13 \|\|

*ye jalaṃ tāvake tīrthe pītvā saṃyamino narāḥ \|*  
*madhumāṃsanivṛttā ye brahmacārivrate sthitāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ṣaṇmāsāddhārayiṣyanti nivṛttāḥ parapākataḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ hatpaṅkajevveva malliṅga bhavitā dhruvam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Those self-controlled men who would drink your water and practise a vow of celibacy for six months without eating flesh, liquor and the food prepared and offered by others, shall surely have my linga appeared on the lotus of their hearts.

## \|\| 60.14 \|\|

*na cāsya pāpebhiratirbhaviṣyati kadācana \|*  
*pitṛṇāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavivyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. They will never indulge them in sins and the sraddha made by them for ancestors shall be undepleting and keep all in satiation.

## \|\| 60.15 \|\|

*snānadānatapāṃsīha homajapyādikāḥ kriyāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyantyakṣayā nṛṇāṃ mṛtānāmapunarbhavaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A bath, donation, penance, offering (Ноmа) and Japa etc. performed here shall be undepleting and the devotees shall never fall in the trap of birth and death again.

## \|\| 60.16 \|\|

*etadvaraṃ harāttīrthaṃ prāpya puṣṇati devatāḥ \|*  
*punāti puṃsāṃ kedārastrinetravacanaṃ yathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. That Kedara, the holy place since then began to render people with purity and gods with satiations by virtue of Mahadeva's grace.

## \|\| 60.17 \|\|

*kedārāya varaṃ dattvā jagāma tvarito haraḥ \|*  
*snātuṃ bhānusutāṃ devīṃ kālindīṃ pāpanāśinīm \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Mahadeva having so blessed Kedara, immediately went to Yamuna known as Kalindi and daughter of sun god for bath.

## \|\| 60.18 \|\|

*tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā jagāmātha sarasvatīm \|*  
*vṛtāṃ tīrthaśataiḥ puṇyaiḥ plakṣajāṃ pāpanāśinīm \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. After bath there, god Sankara went Sarasvati a river emanating from Plaksa tree, surrounded by several hundred holy places with fresh and pure body.

## \|\| 60.19 \|\|

*avatīrṇastataḥ snātuṃ nimagnaśca mahāmbhasi \|*  
*drupadāṃ nāma gāyatrīṃ jajāpāntarjale haraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He descended for bath, took a dip and began chanting Drupada Gayatri in the water of that holy river.

## \|\| 60.20 \|\|

*nimagne śaṃkare devyāṃ sarasvatyāṃ kalipriya \|*  
*sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro jāto na conmajjatta īśvaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O favourite to Kali (Narada)! God Sankara took so deep dip in that river that he did not come up while period of a complete year passed since that day.

## \|\| 60.21 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahman bhuvanāḥ sapta sārṇavāḥ \|*  
*celuḥ peturvaraṇyāṃ na nakṣatrāstārakaiḥ saha \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О Brahmin! The seven bhuvanas began to shiver with meantime and constellations with stars began falling on the earth.

## \|\| 60.22 \|\|

*āsanebhyaḥ pracalitā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*svastyastu lokebhya iti japantaḥ paramarṣayaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The prominent gods including Indra, trembled on their seats and the hermits in such amazing circumstance began enchanting- "May! The universe be defended."

## \|\| 60.23 \|\|

*tataḥ kṣubdheṣu lokeṣu devā brahmāṇamāgaman \|*  
*dṛṣṭvocuḥ kimidaṃ lokāḥ kṣubdhāḥ saṃśayamāgatāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The gods came to Brahma when all worlds was seen so excited. They saluted him and asked- "Why the lokas have been so excited and filled with doubts?"

## \|\| 60.24 \|\|

*tānāha padmasaṃbhūto naitad vedyi ca kāraṇam \|*  
*tadāgacchata vo yuktaṃ draṣṭuṃ cakragadādharam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Lotus bom Brahma replied- "I don't know why is this being. Come you all with me. It is good to see lord Visnu who holds Cakra and Gada."

## \|\| 60.25 \|\|

*pitāmahenaivamuktā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*pitāmahaṃ puraskṛtya murārisadanaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus addressed by Brahma, Indra and all other gods followed Brahma and they visited at the abode of Murari under his lead.

## \|\| 60.26 \|\|

*nārada uvāca ko'sauṃ murārirdevarṣe devo yakṣo nu kiṃnaraḥ \|*  
*daityo vā rākṣaso vāpi pārthivo vā taducyatām \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Narada said- О divine hermit! Please, tell me who is this Murari? Whether he is any god, yaksas, kinnara, demon, monster or any man?

## \|\| 60.27 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca yo'sau rajaḥ sattvamayo guṇavāṃśca tamomayaḥ \|*  
*nirguṇaḥ sarvago vyāpī murārirmadhusūdanaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Pulastya said- Omnipresent, holder of three property (viz. sattva, rajas and tamas), tangible and intangible Madhusudana is popular as Murari.

## \|\| 60.28 \|\|

*nārada uvāca yo'sau mura iti khyātaḥ kasya putraḥ sa gīyate \|*  
*kathaṃ ca nihataḥ saṃkhye viṣṇunā tadvadasva me \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Narada said- "Please, tell me that who was Mura? Whose son was he? How did Visnu kill him in the battle?"

## \|\| 60.29 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi murāsuranibarhaṇam \|*  
*vicitramidamākhyānaṃ puṇyadaṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Pulastya said- “Listen! I am going to describe that eccentric, holy and sin effacing episode.”

## \|\| 60.30 \|\|

*kaśyapasyaurasaḥ putro muro nāma danūdbhavaḥ \|*  
*sa dadarśa raṇe śastān ditiputrān surottamaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Kasyapa got his son Mura from the womb of Danu. He saw all demons defeated by gods in the battle.

## \|\| 60.31 \|\|

*tataḥ sa maraṇādbhītastaptvā varṣagaṇānbahūn \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ brahmāṇamaparājitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He was frightened to see that dreadful scene, observed penance for several years in deserted place and focused his mind on exclusive worship of sovereign Brahma.

## \|\| 60.32 \|\|

*tato'sya tuṣṭo varadaḥ prāha vatsa varaṃ vṛṇu \|*  
*sa ca vavre varaṃ daityo varamenaṃ pitāmahāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Brahma pleased and said- "O dear! Ask for your pleasure. That demon asked from Pitamaha.

## \|\| 60.33 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ karatalenāhaṃ spṛśeyaṃ samare vibho \|*  
*sa sa maddhastasaṃspṛṣṭastvamaro'pi maratvataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О sovereign god! The man touched by me through the palm should die irrespective of his being mortal or immortal.

## \|\| 60.34 \|\|

*bāḍhamityāha bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tato'bhyāgānmahātejā muraḥ suragiri balī \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. God Brahma said- "Be it as you desired." That mighty demon Mura then reached at Surgiri hill (abode of the gods).

## \|\| 60.35 \|\|

*sametyāhvayate devaṃ yakṣa kinnarameva vā \|*  
*na kaścidyuyudhe tena samaṃ daityena nārada \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О Narada! He challenged the gods, yaksa, kinnara etc. there for battle but nobody came up for fight against him.

## \|\| 60.36 \|\|

*tato'marāvatī kruddhaḥ sa gatvā śakramāhvayat \|*  
*na cāsya saha yoddhaṃ vai matiṃ cakre puraṃdaraḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. He then visited at Amaravati in a furious mood. He challenged god Indra there. Indra too gave up idea to fight against him.

## \|\| 60.37 \|\|

*tataḥ sa karamudyamya praviveśāmarāvatīm \|*  
*praviśantaṃ na taṃ kaścinnivārayitumutsahet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. He then entered in Amaravati with his hand lifted up. Nobody could dare to impose restriction on his such entrance.

## \|\| 60.38 \|\|

*sa'gatvā śakrasadanaṃ provācendraṃ murastadā \|*  
*dehi yuddhaṃ sahasrākṣa no cet svargaṃ parityaja \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. He thus, reached at the palace of Indra and said- "O thousand eyed! Do battle with me or give up the heaven immediately."

## \|\| 60.39 \|\|

*ityevamukto muruṇā brahman harihayastadā \|*  
*svargarājyaṃ parityajya bhūcaraḥ samajāyata \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O Brahmin! Following the words of Mura, Indra left the throne at once and stalled moving on the earth.

## \|\| 60.40-41 \|\|

*tato gajendrakuliśau hatau śakrasya śatruṇā \|*  
*sakalatro mahātejā devaiḥ saha sutena ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kālindyā dakṣiṇe kūle niveśya svapuraṃ sthitaḥ \|*  
*mukhścāpi mahābhogān bubhuje svargasaṃsthitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The demon Mura seized Indra’s elephant and thunderbolt. Indra settled at the southern bank of Yamuna with his wife, son and gods and Mura enjoyed the pleasure of heaven since then.

## \|\| 60.42 \|\|

*dānavāścāpare raudrā mayatārapurogamāḥ \|*  
*muramāsādya modante svarge sukṛtino yathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Other fierce monsters like Maya and Turaka too accessed to Mura in heaven and began enjoying all luxuries like the people who receive them as a result of noble deeds performed earlier.

## \|\| 60.43 \|\|

*sa kadācinmahīpṛṣṭhaṃ samāyāto mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*ekākī kuñjarārūḍhaḥ sarayūṃ nimnagāṃ prati \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Later-on that monster descended any day on the earth, rode on elephant and thus, reached at the bank of Sarayu.

## \|\| 60.44 \|\|

*sa sarayvāstaṭe vīraṃ rājānaṃ sūryavaṃśajam \|*  
*dadṛśe raghunāmānaṃ dīkṣitaṃ yajñakarmaṇi \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He saw a mighty king Raghu of solar dynasty performing sacrifices on the bank of Sarayu river.

## \|\| 60.45 \|\|

*tamupetyābravīddatyo yuddhaṃ me dīyatāmiti \|*  
*no cennivartatāṃ yajño neṣṭavyā devatāstvayā \|*  
*\|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. That monster went to him and said- "do battle with me or stop the yajna. You cannot worship gods.

## \|\| 60.46 \|\|

*tamupetya mahātejā mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*provāca buddhimān brahman vasiṣṭhastapatāṃ varaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O Brahmin! Vasistha, the son of Mitra and Varuna, the wise ascetic went to him and said-

## \|\| 60.47 \|\|

*kiṃ te jitairnarairdaitya ajitānanuśāsaya \|*  
*prahartumicchasi yadi taṃ nivāraya cāntakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О monster! What will be the benefit of your accomplishment if consumed on defeating the human beings? Defeat those who are still undefeated. In case, you are so prepared, do an attack on Yama, the death god.

## \|\| 60.48 \|\|

*sa balī śāsanaṃ tubhyaṃ na karoti mahāsura \|*  
*tasmiñjite hi vijitaṃ sarva manyasva bhūtalam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О fierce monster! He is mighty and do not follow your order. In case, you won him, consider that you have then won this entire earth,

## \|\| 60.49 \|\|

*sa tadvasiṣṭhavacanaṃ niśamya danupuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*jagāma dharmarājānaṃ vijetuṃ daṇḍapāṇinam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Having heard these words from Vasistha, that demon marched to vanquish Dandapuni, the lord of virtues.

## \|\| 60.50 \|\|

*tamāyāntaṃ yamaḥ śrutvā matvā'vadhyaṃ ca saṃyuge \|*  
*sa samāruhya mahiṣaṃ keśavāntikamāgamat \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Having heard the march of that monster and being known him undefeated, Yama immediately rode on buffalo and went to see god Kesava.

## \|\| 60.51 \|\|

*sametya cābhidhādyainaṃ provāca muraceṣṭitam \|*  
*sa cāha gaccha māmadya preṣayasva mahāsuram \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. He reached there, bowed his head and then reported the strategy of Mura. He said- "Go at once to that monster and send him to me."

## \|\| 60.52 \|\|

*sa vāsudevavacanaṃ śrutvā'bhyāgāt tvarānvitaḥ \|*  
*etasminnantare daityaḥ saṃprāpto nagarīṃ puraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Following Vasudeva's statement, he returned immediately. Just then Mura, the demon entered into his city.

## \|\| 60.53 \|\|

*tamāgataṃ yamaḥ prāha kiṃ mure kartumicchasi \|*  
*vadasva vacanaṃ karttā tvadīyaṃ dānaveśvara \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Yama said to him- О Mura! Tell me your intention first. О demon king! I follow you.

## \|\| 60.54 \|\|

*mura uvāca yama prajāsaṃyamanānnivṛttiṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*no cet tavādya chitvā'haṃ mūrdhānaṃ pāttaye bhuvi \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Mura said- О Yama! Stop the regulation imposed on the subject with immediate effect nonetheless you will be beheaded.

## \|\| 60.55 \|\|

*tamāha dharmarāḍ vākyaṃ yadi māṃ saṃyamād bhavān \|*  
*gopiyati muro satyaṃ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. О Brahmin! Dharmaraja replied- "I will certainly follow you if you could defend me from the power that regulates me."

## \|\| 60.56 \|\|

*murastamāha bhavataḥ kaḥ saṃyantā vadasva mām \|*  
*ahamenaṃ parājitya vārayāmi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Mura said to him-"Tell me that who is your regulating god? I will undoubtedly, put check on him and subjugate.”

## \|\| 60.57 \|\|

*yamastaṃ prāha me viṣṇurdevaścakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ sa māṃ saṃyamate'vyayaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Yama replied- God Visnu, the holder of cakra, mace, resident of white island, the imperishable is my regulating god. I work under his orders.

## \|\| 60.58 \|\|

*tamāha daityaśārdūlaḥ kvāsau vasati durjayaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi tasya saṃyamanodyataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The lion monster Mura said to Yama- "Where does that sovereign live? I myself will go there to subjugate him.

## \|\| 60.59 \|\|

*tamuvāca yamo gaccha kṣīrodaṃ nāma sāgaram \|*  
*tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurlokanātho jaganmayaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Yama, the god of death said to him “Go at the ocean of milk (Ksirasagara). God Visnu, the master of universe lives there.”

## \|\| 60.60 \|\|

*purastadvākyamākarṇya prāha gacchāmi keśavam \|*  
*kiṃtu tu tvayā na tāvaddhi saṃyamyā dharma mānavāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Mura heard this and said- О Dharmaraja! I go to Kesava but instruct you not regulating the human beings until I return.

## \|\| 60.61 \|\|

*sa prāha gaccha tvatto vā pravarttiṣye jayaṃ prati \|*  
*saṃyanturvā yathā syāddhi tato yuktaṃ samācara \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. He said to Mura- "Go now. I will do effort to win your regulating authority. Do battle only thereafter."

## \|\| 60.62 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ dugdhābdhimagamanpuraḥ \|*  
*yatrāste śeṣaparyaṅke catumūrtirjanārdanaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. With these words, Mura reached at Ksira-sagara. Janardana, the four-formed god was there on the bed of Anantanaga.

## \|\| 60.63 \|\|

*nārada uvāca caturmūrttiḥ kathaṃ viṣṇureka eva nigadyate \|*  
*sarvagatvātkathamapi avyaktatvācca tadvada \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Narada asked- Please, explain that why does god Visnu consider Caturmurti while he is one? Whether he is so address due to being his omniscient and inexpressible.

## \|\| 60.64 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca avyaktaḥ sarvago'pīha eka eva mahāmune \|*  
*catumūrtirjagannātho yathā brāṃstathā śṛṇu \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Pulastya said- О Brahmin! He is one in spite of being inexpressible and omniscient. Listen to the reason for being him addressed as Caturmurti.

## \|\| 60.65 \|\|

*apratarvyamanirdeśyaṃ śuklaṃ śāntaṃ paraṃ padam \|*  
*vāsudevākhyamavyaktaṃ smṛtaṃ dvādaśapatrakam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The best position as Vasudeva has been said Apratarkya, Anirdesya, white, tender, inexpressible and Dvadasapatraka.

## \|\| 60.66 \|\|

*nārada uvāca kathaṃ śuklaṃ kathaṃ śāntamapratarvyamaninditam \|*  
*kānyasya dvādaśaivoktā patrakā tāni me vada \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Narada asked- How is he Sukla, Santa, Apratarkya and Anindita? Please, explain the so called Dvadaspatraka of him.

## \|\| 60.67 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca śṛṇuṣva guhyaṃ paramaṃ parameṣṭhiprabhāṣitam \|*  
*śrutaṃ sanatkumāreṇa tenākhyātaṃ ca yanmama \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Pulastya said- Listen to the secret statement laid down by god Brahma. Sanatkumara had heard the same and told to me.

## \|\| 60.68 \|\|

*nārada uvāca ko'yaṃ sanatkumāreti ya brahmaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*tavāpi tena gaditaṃ vada māmanupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Narada said- Kindly, tell me in orderly manner about Sanatkumara to whom Brahma addressed and from whom you came to know those secret words.

## \|\| 60.69 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca dharmasya bhāryā'hiṃsākhyā tasyāṃ putracatuṣṭayam \|*  
*saṃjātaṃ muniśārdūla yogaśāstravicārakam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Pulastya said- Ahimsa (non-violence) is the wife of Dharma. She gave birth to four sons. О great sage! All of them were expert in Yogasastra.

## \|\| 60.70 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhaḥ sanatkumāro'bhūd dvitīyaśca sanātanaḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyaḥ sanako nāma caturthaśca sanandanaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Sanatkumara was the eldest, Sanatana was the next, Sanaka was the third and Sanadana was the fourth son.

## \|\| 60.71 \|\|

*sāṃkhyavettāramaparaṃ kapilaṃ voḍhumāsurim \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā pañcaśikhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yogayuktaṃ taponidhim \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. They all visited to Kapila (expert in Samkhya Sastra), Vodhu, Asuri and Pancasikha (expert in Yoga).

## \|\| 60.72 \|\|

*jñānayogaṃ na te dadyurjyāryaso'pi kanīyasam \|*  
*mānamuktaṃ mahāyogaṃ kapilādīnupāsataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. They never imparted spiritual knowledge to the juniors. The people worshipping Kapila etc. were said mere quantum to Mahayoga as he was not interested to preach everything so known to him.

## \|\| 60.73 \|\|

*sanatkumāraścābhyetya brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam \|*  
*apṛcchad yogavijñānaṃ tamuvāca prajāpatiḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Sanatkumara went to lotus bom Brahma and asks science on Yoga. Prajapati said to him.

## \|\| 60.74 \|\|

*brahmovāca kathayiṣyāmi te sādhya yadi putratvamicchasi \|*  
*yasya kasya na vaktavya tatsatyaṃ nānyatheti hi \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О Sadhya! I will tell you only when you wish to be my son. As it is true, not otherwise, it should not be made common to know for all.

## \|\| 60.75 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca putra evāsmi deveśa yataḥ śiṣyo'smyahaṃ vibho \|*  
*na viśeṣo'sti putrasya śiṣyasya ca pitāmaha \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Sanatkumara said- О god of gods! I am your son as I am your pupil. О Pitamaha! There is no difference between a son and pupil.

## \|\| 60.76 \|\|

*brahmovāca viśeṣaḥ śiṣyaputrābhyāṃ vidyate dharmanandana \|*  
*dharmakarmasamāyoge tathāpi gadataḥ śṛṇu \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Brahma said- О son of Dharma! There is no difference between a son and pupil particularly when religious ceremony and noble deeds and executed. I tell you that thing,

## \|\| 60.77 \|\|

*punnāmno narakāt trāti putrasteneha gīyate \|*  
*śeṣapāpaharaḥ śiṣya ittīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. It is a Vedic dictum that the son saves his father from falling in the hell called Pum, he therefore is called "Putra". The pupil on other side, absolves the remaining sins and called Sisya.

## \|\| 60.78 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca ko'yaṃ punnāmako deva narakāt trāti putrakaḥ \|*  
*kasmāccheṣaṃ tataḥ pāpaṃ harecchiṣyaśca tadvada \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Sanatkumara said- О god! Please, tell that what is the hell addressed as Pum from which the son defends his father. Further, what are the residual sins from which the pupil (Sisya) defends,

## \|\| 60.79 \|\|

*brahmovāca etat purāṇaṃ paramaṃ maharṣe yogāṅgayuktaṃ ca sadaiva yaca \|*  
*tathaiva cograṃ bhayahāri mānavaṃ vadāmi te sādhya niśāmayainam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Brahma said- О great sage! I am going to tell you an episode, most ancient, defending from fear and pertaining to the components of Yoga. О Sadhya! Listen it carefully.

## Chapter 61. The story of Demon Mura

## \|\| 61.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca paradārābhigamanaṃ pāpīyāṃsopasevanam \|*  
*pāruṣyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prathamaṃ narakaṃ matam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said- Courtship with other's wife, acquaintance of the evildoers and harsh attitude for all living organisms is addressed as the first hell.

## \|\| 61.2 \|\|

*phalasteyaṃ mahāpāpaṃ phala hīnaṃ tathā'ṭanam \|*  
*chedanaṃ vṛkṣajātīnāṃ dvitīyaṃ narakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Thefling of fruits, wandering and uprooting trees is heinous evil. It is addressed as the second hell.

## \|\| 61.3 \|\|

*varjyādānaṃ tathā duṣṭamavadhyavadhabandhanam \|*  
*vivādamarthahetūtyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ narakaṃ smatam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Consumption of prohibited things, killing organisms prohibited and the dispute for bondage and wealth (artha) is the third vicious hell.

## \|\| 61.4 \|\|

*bhayadaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ bhavabhūtivināśanam \|*  
*bhraṃśanaṃ nijadharmāṇāṃ caturthaṃ narakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Coercion to all organisms, an attitude of destruction for the outstanding of world and breach of one's own religion is called the fourth hell.

## \|\| 61.5 \|\|

*māraṇaṃ mitrakauṭilyaṃ mithyābhiśapanaṃ ca yat \|*  
*miṣṭaikāśanamityuktaṃ pañcamaṃ tu nṛyātanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thrashing (Мaranа), rude behave for friend, false oath and consumption of sweet lonely is called the fifth Nrpacana hell

## \|\| 61.6 \|\|

*yantraḥ phalādiharaṇaṃ yamanaṃ yoganāśanam \|*  
*vānayugmasya haraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhamuktaṃ nṛyātanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Thefling of apparatus, fruits etc., fastening any person, destruction of the thing belonging to others when failed to receive under manipulation (Yoganasana) and the stealing of an yoke to Yana (chariot) is called the sixth Nrpacana hell.

## \|\| 61.7 \|\|

*rājabhāgaharaṃ mūḍhaṃ rājajāyāniṣevaṇam \|*  
*rājye tvahitakāritvaṃ saptamaṃ nirayaṃ smṛtam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Withholding of the state's share under ignorance, courtship with the queen and doing unfavour to state is called the seventh hell.

## \|\| 61.8 \|\|

*lubdhatvaṃ lolupatvaṃ ca labdhadharmārthanāśanam \|*  
*lālāsaṃkīrṇamevoktamaṣṭamaṃ narakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Greed, temptation, sensuality, spend thrift of the wealth earned with toil and the speech mixed with getting intention is called the eighth hell.

## \|\| 61.9 \|\|

*viproṣya brahmaharaṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vinindanam \|*  
*virodhaṃ bandhubhiścoktaṃ navamaṃ narapācanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The acts like expelling Brahmin from the country, stealing of the Brahmin's wealth, criticising Brahmins and protesting siblings is the ninth Narapacana hell.

## \|\| 61.10 \|\|

*śiṣṭācāravināśaṃ ca śiṣṭadveṣaṃ śiśorvadham \|*  
*śāstrasteyaṃ dharmanāśaṃ daśamaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Rude behave, envy against civilised people, infanticide, stealing of scriptures and dissolution of one's own religion is called the tenth hell.

## \|\| 61.11 \|\|

*vaḍaṅganidhanaṃ ghoraṃ ṣāḍguṇyapratiṣedhanam \|*  
*ekādaśamamevoktaṃ narakaṃ sadbhiruttamam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Destroying attitude towards Vedic learning consisting of six components and prohibition of royal-properties (gunas) viz., alliance, war etc. is said by scholars as the eleventh gross hell.

## \|\| 61.12 \|\|

*satsu nindā sadā vairamanācāramasatkriyā \|*  
*saṃskāraparihīnatvamidaṃ dvādaśamaṃ smṛtam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Always envious of gentlemen, evil-doing, nuisance and uncultured living is called the twelfth hell.

## \|\| 61.13 \|\|

*hānirdhamārthakāmānāmapavargasya hāraṇam \|*  
*saṃbhedaḥ saṃvidāmetat trayodaśamamucyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Loss of Dharma (noble deed), Artha (essence, wealth) and Kama (worldly desires), denial of emancipation and an attitude to create discrimination among these is called the thirteenth hell.

## \|\| 61.14 \|\|

*kṛpaṇaṃ dharmahīnaṃ ca yadvarjya yaca vahnidam \|*  
*caturdaśamamevoktaṃ narakaṃ tadvigarhitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Miser, atheist (evildoer), wicked (denied by society) and one who sets things on fire is called the fourteenth hell (Vigarhita).

## \|\| 61.15 \|\|

*ajñānaṃ cāpyasūyatvamaśaucamaśubhāvaham \|*  
*smṛtaṃ tatpañcadaśakamasatyavacanāni ha \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. .The ignorance, impurity, envy, evil-doing, dirty and the untrue statements is called the fifteenth hell.

## \|\| 61.16 \|\|

*ālasyaṃ vai ṣoḍaśamamākrodhaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sarvasya cātatāyitvamāvāseṣvagnidīpanam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Laziness, excess fury, coercive attitude for all and setting home on fire is called the sixteenth hell.

## \|\| 61.17 \|\|

*icchā ca paradāreṣu narakāya nigadyate \|*  
*īrṣyābhāvaśca satyeṣu uddhattaṃ tu vigarhitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Attachment for other's wife, jealous attitude for truth and a behave stubborn and worth condemning has been said as renderer of hell very certain.

## \|\| 61.18 \|\|

*etaistu pāpaiḥ puruṣaḥ putrāmādyairna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*saṃyuktaḥ prīṇayeddevaṃ saṃtatyā jagataḥ patim \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The man stuck with these Punnama etc. sins pleases Janardana, the master of universe through his son.

## \|\| 61.19 \|\|

*prītaḥ sṛṣṭyā tu śubhayā pāpādyena mucyate \|*  
*puṃnāmanarakaṃ ghoraṃ vināśayati sarvataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Janardana pleased on the meritorious children, destroy the hell addressed as Punnama as a result of the noble acts performed by such children.

## \|\| 61.20 \|\|

*etasmāt kāraṇāt sādhya sutaḥ putreti gadyate \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śeṣapāpasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О Sadhya! This the reason ‘Suta’ is called Putra. I now tell the characteristics of residual sin.

## \|\| 61.21-22 \|\|

*ṛṇaṃ devarṣibhūtānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pitṛṇāṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭha sarvavarṇeṣu caikattā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*oṃkārādapi nirvṛtiḥ pāpakāryakṛtaśca yaḥ \|*  
*matsyādaśca mahāpāpamagamyāgamanaṃ tathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. О great Dvija! The heinous offences are debt of gods, hermits, organisms particularly the debts of human beings and ancestors, unity among all Varnas, abandon of chanting ‘Om’, evil-doing, eating fish and courtship with a woman prohibited.

## \|\| 61.23 \|\|

*ghṛtādivikrayaṃ ghoraṃ caṇḍālādiparigrahaḥ \|*  
*svadoṣacchādanaṃ pāpaṃ paradoṣaprakāśanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Sale of ghee etc., receiving donation from Candala etc., hiding one's own fault and revealing the defects of others are the gross offences.

## \|\| 61.24-28 \|\|

*matsaritvaṃ vāgduṣṭatvaṃ niṣṭhuratvaṃ tathā param \|*  
*ṭokitvaṃ tālavāditvaṃ nāmnā vācā'pyadharmajam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dāruṇatvamadhārmitvaṃ narakāvahamucyate \|*  
*etaiśca pāpaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ prīṇayedyadi śaṃkaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

*jñānādhikamaśeṣeṇa śeṣaṃ pāpaṃ jayettataḥ \|*  
*śārīraṃ vācikaṃ yattu mānasaṃ kāyikaṃ tathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*pitṛmātṛkṛtaṃ yacca kṛtaṃ yaccāśritairnaraiḥ \|*  
*bhrātṛbhirbāndhavaiścāpi tasmiñjanmani dharmaja \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti sa dharmaḥ sutaśiṣyayoḥ \|*  
*viparīte bhavetsādhya viparītaḥ padakramaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. Manipulation, harsh speech, cruelty, comments and criticism abruptly on mere name telling, fierce attitude and the activities not permitted under law (religion) are the cause for hell. If a man filled with these evils worships Sankara, he can control on residual evils completely by virtue of his grace. О the son of Dharma! All activities executed by body, speech and mind in previous life, the activities performed by father, the dependants and siblings are merged with. О Sadhya! It is the religion of the son and the pupil. Reverse position is to avail if these are executed wrongly.

## \|\| 61.29 \|\|

*tasmāca putraśca śiṣyaśca hi vidhātavyau vipaścitā \|*  
*etadarthamabhidhyāya śiṣyācchreṣṭhataraḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*śevāt tārayate śiṣyaḥ sarvatto'pi hi putrakaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The scholar should therefore, establish the tradition of son and the pupil. The son is better than the pupil on the basis of very purpose. The pupil absolves from the residual sins while the son defends from all evils.

## \|\| 61.30 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā sādhyaḥ prāha tapodhanaḥ \|*  
*triḥ satyaṃ tava putro'haṃ deva yogaṃ vadasva me \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Pulastya said- The ascetic Sanatkumara said to Brahma- О god! I give statement on oath that I am your son. Hence, please preach me Yoga.

## \|\| 61.31 \|\|

*tamuvāca mahāyogī tvanmātāpitarau yadi \|*  
*dāsyete ca tataḥ sūnardāyādo me'si putraka \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Mahayogi Brahma then said- О son! You will be may Dayada (adopted) son if your parent voluntarily offer you to me.

## \|\| 61.32 \|\|

*sanatkumāraḥ provāca dāyādaparikalpanā \|*  
*yeyaṃ hi bhavatā proktā tāṃ me tvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Sanatkumara said- О god! What is meant by the term Dayada (adopted) son? Please, explain the same to me.

## \|\| 61.33 \|\|

*taduktaṃ sādhyamukhyena vākyaṃ śrutvā pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*prāha prahasya bhagavāñchṛṇu vatseti nārada \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О Narada! Brahma laughed on the words from the foremost of Sadhyas and said- О son! Listen now.

## \|\| 61.34 \|\|

*brahmovāca aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva dattaḥ kṛtrima eva ca \|*  
*gūḍhotpanno'paviddhaśca dāyādā bāndhavāstu ṣaṭ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Brahma said- there are six Dayada- Aurasa, Ksetraja, Datta, Krtrima, Gudhotpanna and Apaviddha.

## \|\| 61.35 \|\|

*amīṣu ṣaṭsu putreṣu ṛṇapiṇḍadhanakriyāḥ \|*  
*gotrasāmyaṃ kule vṛttiḥ pratiṣṭhā śāśvatī tathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By these six sons, the debt, Pinda, Gotrasamya, wealth transactions, Kulavrtti and stable prestige is established.

## \|\| 61.36 \|\|

*kānīnaśca sahoḍhaśca krītaḥ paunarbhavastathā \|*  
*svayaṃ dattaḥ pāraśavaḥ ṣaḍadāyādabāndhavāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. There are similarly six Adayada. These are- Kanina, Sahodha, Krita, Paunarbhava, Svayamdatta and Parasava.

## \|\| 61.37 \|\|

*amībhirṛṇapiṇḍādikathā naiveha vidyate \|*  
*nāmadhāraka eveha na gotrakulasaṃmataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. These cannot perform the Pinda etc. rituals and absolve from the debt. These are merely nominees. These are not conformed by Gotra and Kula.

## \|\| 61.38 \|\|

*tattasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇaḥ sanakāgrajaḥ \|*  
*uvācaiṣāṃ viśeṣaṃ me brahman vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Hearing the words of Brahma, Sanatkumara said- О Brahman! Please, tell me the specific characteristic of all them.

## \|\| 61.39 \|\|

*tato'bravīt surapatirviśeṣaṃ śṛṇu putraka \|*  
*auraso yaḥ svayaṃ jātaḥ pratibimbamivātmanaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Brahma said- О son! I tell you specifically. Please, listen to it. The son bom by one's own participation in courtship is called Aurasa (wedlock). He is one's own image (pratibimba).

## \|\| 61.40 \|\|

*klībonyatte vyasanini patyau tasyājñayā tu yaḥ \|*  
*bhāryā hyanāturā putraṃ janayetkṣetrajastu saḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The son bom from the womb of one's own wife as a result of her intercourse by other person but under his permission and on account of his being impotent, intoxicant or eccentric is called Ksetraja.

## \|\| 61.41 \|\|

*mātāpitṛbhyāṃ yo dattaḥ sa dattaḥ parigīyate \|*  
*mitraputraṃ mitradattaṃ kṛtrimaṃ prāhuruttamāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. If the parents give their son to other person, he is called Dattaka (adopted). The scholars call the son of a friend and the son given by friend as artificial son.

## \|\| 61.42 \|\|

*na jñāyate gṛhe kena jātastviti sa gūḍhakaḥ \|*  
*bāhyataḥ svayamānītaḥ so'paviddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The son about whose birth by whom remains in doubt in a family is called Gudha (cryptic). A son brought in from outside is called Apaviddha.

## \|\| 61.43 \|\|

*kanyājātastu kānīnaḥ sagarbhoḍhaḥ sahoḍhakaḥ \|*  
*mūlyairgṛhītaḥ krītaḥ syādvividhaḥ syātpunarbhavaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. A son bom from the womb of spinster is called Kanina. The virgin pregnant at the time of marriage when gives birth to a son thereafter, so bom son is called Sahodha. The son got from market (by purchase) is called Krita. Punarbhava sons are of two types.

## \|\| 61.44 \|\|

*dattvaikasya yā kanyā hṛtvā'nyasya pradīyate \|*  
*tajjātastanayo jñeyo loke paunarbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The son bom from a virgin first given to a man and then given to another after divorce or anyway by snatching rights is called Punarbhava.

## \|\| 61.45 \|\|

*durbhikṣe vyasane cāpi yenātmā viniveditaḥ \|*  
*sa svayaṃdatta ityuktastathānyaḥ kāraṇāntaraiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Who surrenders himself as son to others due to famine, dmg addiction or other reasons is called Svayamdatta son.

## \|\| 61.46 \|\|

*brāhmaṇasya sutaḥ śūdrayāṃ jāyate yastu suvrata \|*  
*ūḍhāyāṃ vāpyanūḍhāyāṃ sa pāraśava ucyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O resolute! A son bom from the womb of Sudra either married or unmarried as a result of coition with Brahmin is called Parasava.

## \|\| 61.47 \|\|

*etasmāt kāraṇāt putra na svayaṃ dātumarhasi \|*  
*svamātmānaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ pitarau samupāhvaya \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O son! Due to these reasons you cannot surrender yourself. Hence, go to your parent and call them here immediately.

## \|\| 61.48 \|\|

*tataḥ sa mātāpitarau sasmāra vacanādvibhoḥ \|*  
*tāvājagmaturīśānaṃ draṣṭuṃ vai dampatī mune \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О sage! Sanatkumara then remembered his parent. О sage! Those couple came there to see Brahma.

## \|\| 61.49 \|\|

*dharmo'hiṃsā ca deveśaṃ praṇipatya nyaṣīdatām \|*  
*upaviṣṭau sukhāsīnau sādhyo vacanamabravīt \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Dharma and Ahimsa both saluted Brahma and seated there. Sanatkumara when they seated conformably said-

## \|\| 61.50 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca yogaṃ jigamiṣustāta brahmāṇaṃ samacūcudam \|*  
*sa coktvān māṃ putrārtha tasmāttvaṃ dātumarhasi \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Sanatkumara said- О father! I requested Brahma to impart knowledge on Yoga. He said me to be his son. Hence, I wish you would surrender me to him.

## \|\| 61.51 \|\|

*tāvevamuktau putreṇa yogācāryaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*uktavantau prabho'yaṃ hi āvayostanayaratavaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Both of them on statement from their son said to Brahma- О god! May this son of ours be your from this day.

## \|\| 61.52 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛtyayaṃ putrastava brahmanbhaviṣyati \|*  
*ityuktvā jagmatustūrṇaṃ yenaivābhyāgatau yathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О Brahman! this son will be yours from today. With these words they returned to from where they came.

## \|\| 61.53 \|\|

*pitāmaho'pi taṃ putraṃ sādhyaṃ ca sadvinayānvitam \|*  
*sanatkumāraṃ provāca yogaṃ dvādaśapatrakam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Brahma too initiated the son, the Sadhya Sanatkumara, endowed with humility as he was, into the ‘Dvadasapatraka’ Yoga.

## \|\| 61.54 \|\|

*śikhāsaṃsthaṃ tu oṃkāraṃ meṣo'sya śirasi sthitaḥ \|*  
*māso vaiśākhamāsā ca prathamaṃ patrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The Om syllable existed on the braid of Vasudeva, the zodiac Aries existed on head and the month of Vaisakha (April) are the first petal (patra) of it.

## \|\| 61.55 \|\|

*nakāro mukhasaṃstho hi vṛṣastatra prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*jyeṣṭhamāsaśca tatpatraṃ dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Nakara as existed in mouth, the zodiac Taurus at very place and Jyestha month (May) are called his second petal.

## \|\| 61.56 \|\|

*mokāro bhujayoryugmaṃ mithunastatra saṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*māso āṣāḍhanāmā tṛtīyaṃ patrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Mokara existed on both arms, the zodiac Gemini and Asadha month (June) are his third petal.

## \|\| 61.57 \|\|

*bhakāraṃ netrayugalaṃ tatra karkaṭakaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*māsaḥ śrāvaṇa ityuktañcaturtha patrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Bhakara existed in his both eyes, the zodiac Cancer and the month of Havana (July) are his forth petal.

## \|\| 61.58 \|\|

*gakāraṃ hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ siṃho vasati tatra ca \|*  
*māso bhādrastathāḥ proktaḥ pañcamaṃ patrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Gakara existed on his chest, the zodiac Leo and the month of Bhadrapada (August) are his fifth petal.

## \|\| 61.59 \|\|

*vakāraṃ kavacaṃ vidyāt kanyā tatra pratiṣṭhitā \|*  
*māsaścāśvayujo nāma ṣaṣṭhaṃ tatpatrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Vakara existed as his shield, the zodiac Virgo and the month of Asvina (September) are his sixth petal.

## \|\| 61.60 \|\|

*tekāramastragrāmaṃ ca tulārāśiḥ kṛtāśrayaḥ \|*  
*māsaśca kārttiko nāma saptamaṃ patrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Tekara existed in the form of his weapons, the zodiac Libra and the month of Kartika (October) are his seventh petal.

## \|\| 61.61 \|\|

*vākāraṃ nābhisaṃyuktaṃ sthitastatra tu vṛścikaḥ \|*  
*māso mārgaśirā nāma tvaṣṭakaṃ patrakaṃ smṛtam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О sage! Vakara existed in the form of his navel, the zodiac Scorpio and the month of Margasirsa (November) are his eighth petal.

## \|\| 61.62 \|\|

*sukāraṃ jadhanaṃ proktaṃ tatrasthaśca dhanurdharaḥ \|*  
*pauṣo gadito māso navamaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Sukara existed in the form of his pubic, the zodiac Sagittarius and the month of Pausa (December) are his ninth petal.

## \|\| 61.63 \|\|

*dekākhyo ruyugale makaro'pyatra saṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*māgho nigadito māsaḥ patrakaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Dekara existed in the form of his couple thigh, the zodiac Capricorn and the month of Magha (January) are his tenth petal.

## \|\| 61.64 \|\|

*vākāro jānuyugmaṃ ca kumbhastatrādisaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*patrakaṃ phālganuḥ proktaṃ tadekādaśamuttamam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Vakara existed in the form of his couple knees, the zodiac Aquarius and the month of Phalguna (February) are his eleventh petal.

## \|\| 61.65 \|\|

*pādau yakārau mīno'pi sa caitre vasate mune \|*  
*idaṃ dvādaśaṃ proktaṃ patraṃ vai keśavasya hi \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Yakara existed as his couple feet, the zodiac Pisces and the month of Caitra (March) are his twelfth petal. These are the twelve petals of Kesava.

## \|\| 61.66 \|\|

*dvādaśāraṃ tathā cakraṃ ṣaṇṇābhi dviyutaṃ tathā \|*  
*trivyūhamekamūrtiśca tathoktaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. His discus is consisting of twelve spikes, twelve navels and Trivyuha. Thus, is the single feature (image) of that supreme god.

## \|\| 61.67 \|\|

*ettat tavoktaṃ devasya rūpaṃ dvādaśapatrakam \|*  
*yasmin jñāte muniśreṣṭha na bhūyo maraṇaṃ labhet \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О great sage! I have described this twelve petal form of god. A knowledge on it defends the man from the frequent cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 61.68 \|\|

*dvitīyamuktaṃ sattvākyaṃ caturvarṇaṃ caturmukham \|*  
*caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ śrīvatsavaramavyayam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. His second immortal, Sattvamaya, Srivatsadhari form is consisting of Caturvarna, Caturbahu and liberal parts.

## \|\| 61.69 \|\|

*tṛtīyastāmaso nāma śeṣamūrtiḥ sahasrapāt \|*  
*sahasravadanaḥ śrīmān prajāpralayakārakaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. His third Sesamurti consisting of one thousand feet, one thousand mouth is Tamoguna with Sri. It brings destruction to the organisms.

## \|\| 61.70 \|\|

*caturtho rājaso nāma raktavarṇaścaturmukhaḥ \|*  
*dvibhujo dhārayan mālāṃ sṛṣṭikṛcyādipūruṣaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. His fourth form is Rajas. This form is decorated with red tint, four mouth, two arms and garlands on the necks. This very form is of creator Adipurusa.

## \|\| 61.71 \|\|

*avyaktāt saṃbhavantyete trayo vyaktā mahāmune \|*  
*ato marīcipramukhāstathā'nye'pi sahasraśaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О great sage! These three expressive murtis originate from the inexpressive. Marici etc. hermits and other several thousand persons have been bom from this form.

## \|\| 61.72 \|\|

*etat tavoktaṃ munivarya rūpaṃ vibhoḥ purāṇaṃ matipuṣṭivardhanam \|*  
*caturbhujaṃ cāpi mururdurātmā kṛtāntavākyāt punarāsasāda \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О sage! I have described the most ancient and wisdom enhancing form of god Visnu before you. The wicked Muru visited to Visnu when so suggested by Yama.

## \|\| 61.73 \|\|

*tamāgataṃ prāha mune madhughnaḥ prāpto'si kenāsurakāraṇena \|*  
*sa prāha yoddhaṃ saha vai tvayā'dya taṃ prāha bhūyaḥ suraśūtrahantā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О sage! Madhusudana asked him- О monster! What purpose is for your arrival here? He said- I have come here to battle against you. God Visnu again said to him-

## \|\| 61.74 \|\|

*yadīha māṃ yoddhamupāgato'si tatkampate te hṛdayaṃ kimartham \|*  
*jvarāturasyeva muhurmuhurvai tannāsmi yotsye saha kātareṇa \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. If you really have come for fight, why then your heart is throbbing frequently as it happens when a man suffers from fever. Hence, I will not fight against a coward.

## \|\| 61.75 \|\|

*ityevamukto madhusūdanena murastadā sve hṛdaye svahastam \|*  
*kathaṃ kva kasyeti muhurastathoktvā nipātayāmāsa vipannabuddhiḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. When god Visnu asked Muru, he said how? Where? Whose? Frequently and best conscious of the magnificence of his touch. He put his hand on heart.

## \|\| 61.76 \|\|

*hariśca cakraṃ mṛdulāghavena mumoca taddhṛtkamalasya śatroḥ \|*  
*ciccheda devāstu gatavyathābhavan devaṃ praśaṃsanti ca padmanābham \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Hari Took his discus and penetrated the heart of that enemy. All gods then began to pray god Padmanabha as their worry is now over.

## \|\| 61.77 \|\|

*etattavoktaṃ muradaityanāśanaṃ kṛtaṃ hi yuktyā śitacakrapāṇinā \|*  
*ataḥ prasiddhaṃ samupājagāma murārirityeva vibhurnṛsiṃhaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. I have thus, told you the destruction of Mura demon by god Visnu, the holder of sharp discus. Sovereign Nrsimha on account of this event became famous as Murari.

## Chapter 62. The story of Demon Mura

## \|\| 62.1 \|\|
