*ghṛtācī tāṃ samabhyetya prāha citrāṅgadāṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*putri tyajasva śokaṃ tvaṃ māsairdaśabhirātmajaḥ \|\| 150 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyati pitustubhyaṃ matsakāśānna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktā saṃhṛṣṭā babhau citrāṅgadā tadā \|\| 151 \|\|*

150-151. Ghrtaci then went to Citrangada and said- “O daughter! Give up agony.” There is no doubt that I shall give birth to a son from courtship with your father within forthcoming ten months. Citrangada became happy when it was said by Ghrtaci.

## \|\| 65.152-153 \|\|

*pratīkṣantī sucārvaṅgī vivāhe pitṛdarśanam \|*  
*sarvāstā api tāvantaṃ kālaṃ sutanukanyakāḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

*pratyaikṣanta vivāhaṃ hi tasyā eva priyepsayā \|*  
*tato daśasu māseṣu samatītevvathāpsarāḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

152-153. Citrangada waited to see her father at the time of her marriage. Those beautiful maidens were also eager for her pleasure waited during that period for her marriage.

## \|\| 65.154 \|\|

*tasmin godāvarītīrthe prasuptā tanayaṃ nalam \|*  
*jāte'patye kapitvācca viśvakarmā'pyamucyata \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. That nymph gave birth to a son Nala at Godavari-tirtha when ten month's period was over. With this birth of a son, Visvakarma was also liberated from his monkey-hood.

## \|\| 65.155-157 \|\|

*samabhyetya priyāṃ putrī paryaṣvajata cādarāt \|*  
*tataḥ prītena manasā sasmāra suravarddhakiḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

*surāṇāmadhipaṃ śakraṃ sahaiva surakinnaraiḥ \|*  
*tvaṣṭrā'tha saṃsmṛtaḥ śakro marudgagaṇavṛstadā \|\| 156 \|\|*

*suraiḥ sarudraiḥ saṃprāptastattīrthaṃ hāṭakāhvayam \|*  
*samāyāteṣu deveṣu gandharveṣvapsarassu ca \|\| 157 \|\|*

155-157. He went to his beloved daughter and embraced her. Visvakarma then summoned the king of gods Indra, the lord of gods and Kinnaras happily. Remembered by Visvakarma, Indra surrounded by the multitude of Maruts, and together with gods accompanied by Rudras came at the holy place Hataka.

## \|\| 65.158 \|\|

*indradyumno muniśreṣṭhamṛtadhvajamuvāca ha \|*  
*jābālerdīyatāṃ brahman sutā kandaramālinaḥ \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. Indradyumna said to Rtadhvaja when gods, gandharvas and apsarases came there- “O Brahmana! give Jabali the daughter of Kandaramali.”

## \|\| 65.159 \|\|

*gṛhṇātu vidhivatpāṇiṃ daitevyāstanayastava \|*  
*nandayantīṃ ca. śakuniḥ pariṇetuṃ svarūpavān \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. Your son should solemnise the marriage with the daughter of demon. Sakuni, the beautiful prince should be wed to Nandyanti.

## \|\| 65.160 \|\|

*mameyaṃ vedavatyastu tvāṣṭreyī surathasya ca \|*  
*bāḍhamityabravīdṛṣṭo munirmanusutaṃ nṛpam \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. May this Vedavati remain as my spouse, while the daughter of Visvakarma (Citrangada) be the wife of Suratha. The sage said to the king- "Be it so".

## \|\| 65.161 \|\|

*tato'nucakruḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vivāhavidhimuttamam \|*  
*ṛtvijo'bhūd gālavastu hutvā havyaṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. Then those all people solemnised the marriage happily and followed the due procedure. Galava became Rtvika and offered havya (oblations) in a ritual manner.

## \|\| 65.162 \|\|

*gāyante tatra gandharvā nṛtyante'psarasastathā \|*  
*ādau jābālinaḥ pāṇigṛhīto daityakanyayā \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. The gandharvas sang songs that time and the nymphs began to dance. The daughter of demon first give her hand in the hand of Jabali.

## \|\| 65.163-164 \|\|

*indradyumnena tadanu vedavatyā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śakuninā pāṇigṛhīto yakṣakanyayā \|\| 163 \|\|*

*citrāṅgadāyāḥ kalyāṇi surathaḥ pāṇimagrahīt \|*  
*evaṃ kramādvivāhastu nirvṛttastanumadhyame \|*  
*\|\| 164 \|\|*

163-164. Following this, Indradyumna then accepted Vedavati, Sakuni accepted the daughter of Yaksa and Suratha accepted the hand of Citrangada as his wife. In this order, О slender-waisted one, they all were married in a systematic manner.

## \|\| 65.165-166 \|\|

*vṛtte munirvivāhe tu śakrādīngrāha daivatān \|*  
*asmistīrthe bhavadbhistu saptagodāvare sadā \|\| 165 \|\|*

*stheyaṃ viśeṣato māsamimaṃ mādhavamuttamam \|*  
*bāḍhamuktvā surāḥ sarve jagmurhaṣṭā divaṃ kramāt \|\| 166 \|\|*

165-166. When the marriage of all so solemnised, Rtadhvaja said to Indra and other gods- "Reside always you all in this holy place of Saplagodavara. You all should particularly live here during the month of Vaisakha. The gods went to heaven with the words “Very well.”

## \|\| 65.167 \|\|

*munayo munimādāya saputraṃ jagmurādarāt \|*  
*bhāryāścādāya rājānaḥ svaṃ svaṃ nagaramāgatāḥ \|\| 167 \|\|*

167\. The sages together with Rtadhvaja and his son returned to their hermitage. The kings too returned to their capitals with their wives.

## \|\| 65.168 \|\|

*prahṛṣṭāḥ sukhinastasthuḥ bhuñjate viṣayān priyān \|*  
*citrāṅgadāyāḥ kalyāṇi evaṃ vṛttaṃ purā kila \|*  
*tanmāṃ kamalapatrākṣi bhajasva lalanottame \|\| 168 \|\|*

168\. All people began to live happily and enjoyed all that they desired. О nice lady! The episode in detail of Citrangada thus, arrives at conclusion. Hence, О lotus-eyed lady, do you gratify me.

## \|\| 65.169 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā naradevasūnu- stāṃ bhūmidevasya sutāṃ varorum \|*  
*stuvanmṛgākṣīṃ mṛdunā krameṇa sā cāpi vākyaṃ nṛpatiṃ babhāṣe \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. With these words, the king Danda began to appreciate the fawn-eyed lady with pretty thigh, psalm. She too replied to the king in soft tone.

## Chapter 66. Reduction of King Danda to ashes

## \|\| 66.1 \|\|

*arajā uvāca- nātmānaṃ tava dāsyāmi bahunoktena kiṃ tava \|*  
*rakṣantī bhavataḥ śāpādātmānaṃ ca mahīpate \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Araja said- О lord of the earth! It is no use saying much to you. I shall defend myself and you also from the disastrous curse of my father i.e., I shall not surrender myself to you.

## \|\| 66.2 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca- itthaṃ vivadamānāṃ tāṃ bhārgavendrasutāṃ balāt \|*  
*kāmopahatacittātmā vyadhvaṃsayata mandadhīḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Prahlada said- "That evil-minded was filled with lust and forcibly ravished the daughter of the leading scion of Bhrgu (Sukra) even after her strong protest."

## \|\| 66.3 \|\|

*tāṃ kṛtvā cyutacāritrāṃ madānyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ \|*  
*niścakrāmāśramāt tasmād gataśca nagaraṃ nijam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The egoist king came out from that hermitage when satisfied with intercourse and returned to his realm.

## \|\| 66.4 \|\|

*sā'pi śukrasutā tanvī arajā rajasāplutā \|*  
*āśramādatha nirgatya bahistasthāvadhomukhī \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Araja being smeared with menstrual blood due to intercourse, too came out of the hermitage and seated there. She had bent her head down on account of shame and agony.

## \|\| 66.5 \|\|

*cintayantī svapitaraṃ rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*mahāgrahopatapteva rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. She thought of her father frequently and began wailing like Rohini, a constellation beloved of moon god, when oppressed by the great seizer (Rahu).

## \|\| 66.6 \|\|

*tato bahutithe kāle samāpte yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*pātālādāgamacchukraḥ svamāśramapadaṃ muniḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. After a long lapse of time, the sage Sukra came back to his hermitage from the nether world when the sacrificial offerings were over.

## \|\| 66.7 \|\|

*āśramānte ca dadṛśe sutāṃ daitya rajasvalām \|*  
*meghalekhāmivākāśe saṃdhyārāgeṇa rañjitām \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О demon! He saw his daughter with marks of menstrual blood seated outside the hermitage like the cluster of clouds reddened in evening.

## \|\| 66.8 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paripapraccha putri kenāsi dharṣitā \|*  
*kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa samamāśīviṣeṇa hi \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He enquired her- “O daughter! Who has done intercourse with you? Who is playing with the furious snake?”

## \|\| 66.9 \|\|

*ko'caiva yāmyāṃ nagarīṃ gamivyati sudurmatiḥ \|*  
*yastvāṃ śuddhasamācārāṃ vidhvaṃsayati pāpakṛt \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Tell me that who is such wicked sinner now willing to go to the abode of Yama on this very day? Who has polluted you, my nice charactered- daughter.?

## \|\| 66.10 \|\|

*tataḥ svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kampamānā punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*rudantī brīḍayopetā mandaṃ mandamuvāca ha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then seeing her father, Araja told with tremble, pain and continous weeping to her father-

## \|\| 66.11 \|\|

*tava śiṣyeṇa daṇḍena vāryamāṇena cāsakṛt \|*  
*balādanāthā rudatī nītā'haṃ vacanīyatām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Your disciple Danda had committed this offence even when I protested, wept and begged him not to do such evil act. I could not defend myself as forcibly he had put me in this blame-worthy state.

## \|\| 66.12 \|\|

*etat putryā vacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ \|*  
*upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Sukracarуа filled with anger and his eyes became red. He did acamanа, purified his mouth by sipping water and then said these words-

## \|\| 66.13-14 \|\|

*yasmāt tenāvinītena matto hyabhayamuttamam \|*  
*gauravaṃ ca tiraskṛtya cyutadharmā'rajāḥ kṛtā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tasmāt sarāṣṭraḥ sabalaḥ sabhṛtyo vāhanaiḥ saha \|*  
*saptarātrāntarād bhasma prāvavṛṣṭyā bhaviṣyati \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. "As that wicked had humiliated the preaching delivered by me during study and made Araja corrupt; he along with his kingdom, army, servants and means of conveyance shall be reduced to ashes as a result of continuous raining with hailstorms within seven nights."

## \|\| 66.15 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā munipuṅgayo'sau śaptvā sa daṇḍaṃ svasutāmuvāca \|*  
*tvaṃ pāpamokṣārthamihaiva putri tiṣṭhasva kalyāṇī tapaścarantī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. He so cursed Danda with these words and then turned towards his daughter. He consoled her saying that- “O daughter! Stay here in this very place to practice austerities for the purging of your sin.”

## \|\| 66.16 \|\|

*śaptvetthaṃ bhagavān śukro daṇḍamikṣvākunandanam \|*  
*jagāma śiṣyasahitaḥ pātālaṃ dānavālayam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Lord Sukra thereafter, took his disciples in company and went to nether world where the demons were living.

## \|\| 66.17 \|\|

*daṇḍo'pi bhasmasāndbhūtaḥ sarāṣṭrabalavāhanaḥ \|*  
*mahatā grāvavarṣeṇa saptarātrāntare tadā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On account of excessive rain with hailstorms, Danda was destroyed within seven nights with his state, army and chariot.

## \|\| 66.18 \|\|

*evaṃ taddaṇḍakāraṇyaṃ parityajyanti devatāḥ \|*  
*ālayaṃ rākṣasānāṃ tu kṛtaṃ devena śaṃbhunā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The gods therefore, avoided the forest Dandakaranya and Sambhu made that place abode of demons.

## \|\| 66.19 \|\|

*evaṃ parakalatrāṇi nayanti sukṛtīnapi \|*  
*bhasmabhūtān prākṛtāṃstu mahāntaṃ ca parābhavam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus, the intercourse with other's wife is so disastrous that it bums into ashes even welldoing laymen. What to say than of the common people as they definitely are destroyed?

## \|\| 66.20 \|\|

*tasmādandhaka durbuddhirna kāryā bhavatā tviyam \|*  
*prākṛtā'pi dahennārī kimutāhodrinandinī \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О Andhaka! You should therefore, avoid to commit such offence. When an ordinary woman can bums a man in ashes, what to say about the consequence for committing such offence with the daughter of mountain?

## \|\| 66.21 \|\|

*śaṃkaro'pi na daityeśa śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*draṣṭumapyamitaujaskaḥ kimu yodhayituṃ raṇe \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O demon king! Nobody among gods and demons can defeat Sankara. When it is impossible to see god Mahadeva in battle, how then imagining a battle with him is possible?

## \|\| 66.22 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamukte vacane kruddhastāprekṣaṇaḥ śvasan \|*  
*vākyamāha mahātejāḥ prahlādaṃ cāndhakāsuraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Pulastya said : This being said, the demon Andhaka, possessing immense power, filled with anger, his eyes copper-red, took a deep breathe and replied-

## \|\| 66.23 \|\|

*kiṃ mamāsau raṇe yoddhaṃ śaktastriṇayano'sura \|*  
*ekākī dharmarahito bhasmāruṇitavigrahaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О demon! Whether that ash smeared body, lonely and impious person abiding three eyed can dare to battle with me?

## \|\| 66.24 \|\|

*nāndhako bibhiyādindrānnāmarebhyaḥ kathaṃcana \|*  
*sa kathaṃ vṛṣapatrākṣād bibheti strīmukhekṣakāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. How I (Andhaka) can fear from one whose eyes resemble marmelos Vrsa leaves and who gazes at women’s face, when I never afraid of Indra or other gods?

## \|\| 66.25 \|\|

*tacchrutvā'sya vaco ghoraṃ prahlādaḥ prāha nārada \|*  
*na samyaguktaṃ bhavatā viruddhaṃ dharmato'rthataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О Narada! Prahlada, on being so heard from him said- “You have spoken incorrectly. Your statement is just contrary to Dharma (the sacred law) and Artha (worldy gains).”

## \|\| 66.26-27 \|\|

*hutāśanapataṅgābhyāṃ siṃhakroṣṭhakayoriva \|*  
*gajendramaśakābhyāṃ ca rukmapāṣāṇayoriva \|\| 26 \|\|*

*eteṣāmebhiruditaṃ yāvadantaramandhaka \|*  
*tāvadevāntaraṃ cāsti bhavato vā harasya ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. О Andhaka! The difference between you and Mahadeva is so large as it is seen between fife and an insect, a lion and a jackal, a huge elephant and a masaka and between gold and the stone.

## \|\| 66.28 \|\|

*vārito'si mayā vīra bhūyo bhūyaśca vāryase \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva vākyaṃ devarṣerasitasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О valorous! I have restricted you and tried my efforts to prohibit you from indulging such heinous activity. Listen to the dictum laid down by the renowned sage Asita in this context:

## \|\| 66.29 \|\|

*yo dharmaśīlo jitamānaroṣo vidyāvinīto na paropatāpī \|*  
*svadāratuṣṭaḥ paradāravarjī na tasya loke bhayamasti kiṃcit \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The person religion abiding, without anger and ego, polite and learned, avoiding cause for pain of other's, contented with his own wife and without any lust for other's wife is free from all fears in this world.

## \|\| 66.30 \|\|

*yo dharmahīnaḥ kalahapriyaḥ sadā paropatāpī śrutiśāstravarjitaḥ \|*  
*parārthadārepsuravarṇasaṃgamī sukhaṃ na vindeta paratra ceha \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The man not abiding religion, indulging in quarrels every time, putting others in pain, alien to Vedas and scriptures, tempted to other's wife and wealth and who does courtship with varnas other than his own; cannot feel pleasure either in this material world or in the next.

## \|\| 66.31 \|\|

*dharmānvito'bhūd bhagavān prabhākaraḥ saṃtyaktaroṣaśca muniḥ sa vāruṇiḥ \|*  
*vidyā'nvito'bhūnmanu rarkaputraḥ svadāra saṃtuṣṭamanāstvagastyaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. God Prabhakara (Sun) was attended with virtue, hermit Varuni (Vasistha) had abandoned the anger, Manu, the son of Sun god was learned and Agastya was contented with his own wife.

## \|\| 66.32 \|\|

*etāni puṇyāni kṛtānyamībhi- rmayā nibaddhāni kulakramoktyā \|*  
*tejonvitāḥ śāpavarakṣamāśca jātāstu sarve surasiddhapūjyāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. These meritorious deeds, which I have related as a traditional saying, were done by them. Consequently, all these ascetics became powerful, capable of pronouncing a curse and granting a boon, and worthy of respect by gods and Siddhas.

## \|\| 66.33 \|\|

*adharmayukto'ṅgasuto babhūva vibhuśca nityaṃ kalahapriyo'bhūt \|*  
*paropatāpī namucirdurātmā parābalepsurnahuṣaśca rājā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The son of Anga was atheist, Vibhu was quarrelsome, the wicked-minded Namuci gave pains to others and the king Nahusa wanted to enjoy courtship with other's wife.

## \|\| 66.34 \|\|

*parārthalipsurditijo hiraṇyadṛk mūrkhastu tasyāpyanujaḥ sudurmatiḥ \|*  
*avarṇasaṅgī yaduruttamaujā ete vinaṣṭāstvanayāt purā hi \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Hiranyaksa, the son of Diti was tempted to grab other's wealth, his younger brother was fool and evil-hearted and the valorous Yadu was interested in doing intercourse with the women of other varnas. All these perished in ancient times because of their haughtiness.

## \|\| 66.35 \|\|

*tasmād dharmo na saṃtyājyo dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ \|*  
*dharmahīnā narā yānti rauravaṃ narakaṃ mahat \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. One should therefore, not abandon Dharma because religion is the supreme position to acquire for a man. The atheist or non-religious people fall in the wide hell called Raurava.

## \|\| 66.36 \|\|

*dharmastu gaditaḥ puṃbhistāraṇe divi ceha ca \|*  
*patanāya tathā'dharma iha loke paratra ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The people have said the religion as a sole boat that ferry them across this world and the world where everyone has to go after death.

## \|\| 66.37 \|\|

*tyājyaṃ dharmānvitairnityaṃ paradāropasevanam \|*  
*nayanti paradārā hi narakānekaviṃśatim \|*  
*sarveṣāmapi varṇānāmeṣa dharmo dhruvo'ndhaka \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Courtship with other's wife is strictly prohibited particularly for the religion abiding people. The wives of others carry the man to suffer in twenty one hells. О Andhaka! This is the eternal duty of all vamas.

## \|\| 66.38 \|\|

*parārthaparadāreṣu yadā vāñchāṃ karivyati \|*  
*sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ rauravaṃ bahulāḥ samāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The man who tempts to other's wealth and wife, definitely falls in gross hell called Raurava for several years.

## \|\| 66.39 \|\|

*evaṃ purā'surapate devarṣirasito'vyayaḥ \|*  
*prāha dharmavyavasthānaṃ khagendrāyāruṇāya hi \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О lord of the demons! The great soul hermit Asita had long ago laid down this dictum before Garuda and Aruna.

## \|\| 66.40 \|\|

*tasmāt sudūrato varjet paradārān vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*nayanti nikṛtitrajñaṃ paradārāḥ parābhavam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The wise man should therefore, abandon even the thinking of coition with other's wife. Other's wives lead men of humble wisdom to discomfiture.

## \|\| 66.41 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamukte vacane prahlādaṃ prāha cānyakaḥ \|*  
*bhavān dharmaparasveko nāhaṃ dharmaṃ samācare \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Pulastya said- Andhaka replied Prahlada that “You are the only person devoted to religion. I do not practice Dharma."

## \|\| 66.42 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā prahlādamancakaḥ prāha śambaram \|*  
*gaccha śambara śailendraṃ mandaraṃ vada śaṃkaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Andhaka then ordered Sambara- О sambara! go at the mountain Mandara, the chief of the mountains and say there to Sankara-

## \|\| 66.43 \|\|

*bhikṣo kimarthaṃ śailendraṃ svargopamyaṃ sakandaram \|*  
*paribhuñjasi kenādya tava dato vadasva mām \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O beggar! why is it that you enjoy the great mountain Mandara which is heaven like and surrounded by several caves? Tell me that who has given you this mountain for residing?

## \|\| 66.44 \|\|

*tiṣṭhanti śāsane mahāṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*tat kimarthaṃ nivasase māmanādṛtya mandare \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Indra etc. all gods follow my orders. How are you living on this mountain Mandara with sheer disobedience to me?

## \|\| 66.45 \|\|

*vadīṣṭastava śailendraḥ kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama \|*  
*yeyaṃ hi bhavataḥ patnī sā me śīghraṃ pradīyatām \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If you really like this mountain, do then as I say. Give me your wife immediately.

## \|\| 66.46 \|\|

*ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena śambaro mandaraṃ drutam \|*  
*jagāma tatra yatrāste saha devyā pinākadhṛk \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Sambara immediately followed the order and went at mountain Mandara where the wielder of the Pinaka bow was staying along with the goddess Parvati.

## \|\| 66.47 \|\|

*gatvovācānyakavaco yāthātathyaṃ danoḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*tamṛttaraṃ haraḥ prāha śṛṇvatyā girikanyayā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. sambara gave the message exactly as it was given by Andhaka there. Sankara replied in presence of Parvati (daughter of mountain):

## \|\| 66.48 \|\|

*mamāyaṃ mandaro dattaḥ sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmata \|*  
*tanna śaknobhyahaṃ tyaktuṃ vinājñāṃ vṛtravairiṇaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The wise hundred-eyed Indra has given me this mountain. Hence, I cannot abandon it without orders from the enemy of Vrtra.

## \|\| 66.49 \|\|

*yathābravīd dīyatāṃ me giriputrīti dānavaḥ \|*  
*tadeṣā yātu svaṃ kāma nāhaṃ vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The demon has raised demand for Parvati, she is free to go if so desired by herself. I cannot resist her.

## \|\| 66.50 \|\|

*tato'bravīt girisutā śambaraṃ munisattama \|*  
*brūhi gatvā'nyakaṃ vīra mama vākyaṃ vipaścitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. О great sage! Parvati then said to Sambara- O chivalrous! Give a message from me to Andhaka:

## \|\| 66.51 \|\|

*ahaṃ patākā saṃgrāme bhavānīśca devinau \|*  
*prāṇadyūtaṃ paristīrya yo jeṣyati sa lapyate \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. “I am like a flag (of victory) in war. You and Sankarа are the players around a dice- board of life. The one who shall take risk of life and defeat the other opponent, shall be accepted by me.”

## \|\| 66.52 \|\|

*ityevamukto matimān śambaro'ndhakamāgamat \|*  
*samāgamyābravīd vākyaṃ śarvagauryośca bhāṣitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The wise Sambara went to Andhaka and reported there the message given by Sankara and Parvati.

## \|\| 66.53 \|\|

*tacchrutvā dānavapatiḥ krodhadīptekṣaṇaḥ śvasan \|*  
*samāhūyābravīd vākyaṃ duryodhanamidaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The eyes of demon king reddened with anger. He expirated long, calling Duryodhana ordered-

## \|\| 66.54 \|\|

*gaccha śīghra mahābāho bherī sāntrāhikīṃ dṛḍhām \|*  
*tāḍayasva suviśrabdhaṃ duḥśīlāmiva yoṣitam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. O large-armed one! Go immediately and beat hard, without any hesitation, the war preparatory drum, like a woman of evil- conduct.

## \|\| 66.55 \|\|

*samādiṣṭonyakenātha bherīṃ duryodhano balāt \|*  
*tāḍayāmāsa vegena yathāprāṇena bhūyasā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Duryodhana followed the order and began blowing the drum with full power and speed.

## \|\| 66.56 \|\|

*sā tāḍitā balavatā bherī duryodhanena hi \|*  
*satvaraṃ bhairavaṃ rāvaṃ rurāva surabhī yathā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The trumpet so piped by mighty Duryodhana made a loud sound like Surabhi.

## \|\| 66.57 \|\|

*tasyāstaṃ svaramākarṇya sarva eva mahāsurāḥ \|*  
*samāyātāḥ sabhāṃ tūrṇaṃ kimetaditi vādinaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. When demons heard the loud sound of trumpet, they rushed with curiosity and entered within seconds in the assembly.

## \|\| 66.58 \|\|

*yāthātathyaṃ ca tān sarvānāha senāpatirbalī \|*  
*te cāpi balināṃ śreṣṭhāḥ sannaddhā yuddhakāṅgiṇaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The mighty commander-in-chief then revealed the facts before them. Those all warriors then got ready to fight.

## \|\| 66.59 \|\|

*sahāndhakā niryayuste gajairuṣṭrerhayai rathaiḥ \|*  
*andhako rathamāsthāya pañcanalyapramāṇataḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. They came out under lead of Andhaka with elephants, camels, horses and chariots. Andhaka with decision to defeat Sankara сomе out on a chariot measuring five furlongs (Nalva) with determination to defeat the threeeyed deity.

## \|\| 66.60-63 \|\|

*tryambakaṃ sa parājetuṃ kṛtabuddhirviniryayā~\| jambhaḥ kujambho huṇḍaśca tuhuṇḍaḥ śambaro baliḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*bāṇaḥ kārtasvaro hastī sūryaśatrurmahodaraḥ \|*  
*ayaḥ śaḍkuḥ śibiḥ śālvo vṛṣaparvā virocanaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*hayagrīvaḥ kālanemiḥ saṃhlādaḥ kālanāśanaḥ \|*  
*śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva vipracittiśca vīryavān \|\| 62 \|\|*

*duryodhanaśca pākśca vipākaḥ kālaśambarau \|*  
*ete cānye ca bahavo mahāvīryā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*prajagmurutsukā yoddhaṃ nānāyudhadharā raṇe \|\| 63 \|\|*

60-63. The demons Jambha, Kujambha, Hunda, Tuhunda, Sambara, Bali, Bana, Kartasvara, Hasti, Stiryasatru, Mahodara, Ayahsankuh, Sibi, Salva, Vrsaparavana, Virocana, Hayagriva, Kalanemi, Samhlada, Kalanasana, Sarabha, Salabha, strong Vipracitti, Duryodhana, Раkа, Vipaka, Kala and Sambara and other numerous mighty and valorous demons picked up their weapons and set out for fight with curiosity.

## \|\| 66.64 \|\|

*itthaṃ durātmā danusainyapāla- stadāndhako yoddhamanā hareṇa \|*  
*mahācalaṃ mandaramabhyupeyivān sa kālapāśāvasito hi mandadhīḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Thus the evil-hearted, foolish Andhaka, the commander-in-chief of demons army went at Mandara mountain with a decision to fight against Sankara as the time of his death was near.

## Chapter 67. Vision of Sadasiva

## \|\| 67.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- haro'pi śambare yāte samāhūyātha nandinam \|*  
*prāhāmantraya śailāde ye sthitāstava śāsane \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Sankara too when Sambara departed, summoned Nandi and said- "O Sailadi! call all those who are under your dominion."

## \|\| 67.2 \|\|

*tato maheśavacanānnandī tūrṇataraṃ gataḥ \|*  
*upaspṛśya jalaṃ śrīmān sasmāra gaṇanāyakān \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Nandi went out immediately in compliance with Sankara's words and summoned Gana- chiefs with Scamana.

## \|\| 67.3 \|\|

*nandinā saṃsmṛtāḥ sarve gaṇanāthāḥ sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*samutpatya tvarāyuktāḥ praṇatāstridaśeśvaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. All chiefs of Ganas, being thousands in number came immediately where Sankara was and bowed their heads before him.

## \|\| 67.4 \|\|

*āgatāṃśca gaṇānnandī kṛtāñjalipuṭo'vyayaḥ \|*  
*sarvān nivedayāmāsa śaṃkarāya mahātmane \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Immortal Nandi then informed Sankara that all the Ganas had arrived.

## \|\| 67.5 \|\|

*nandyuvāca- vānetān paśyase śaṃbho trinetrāñjaṭilāśucīn \|*  
*ete rudrā iti khyātāḥ koṭya ekādaśaiva tu \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Nandi said- О Sambhu! The neat and clean Ganas having three eyes, matted hairs are called Rudras. They are eleven crores in number.

## \|\| 67.6 \|\|

*vānarāsyān paśyase yān śārdūlasamavikramān \|*  
*eteṣāṃ dvārapālāste mantrāmāno yaśodhanāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The faced and valorous like lions bears the same name as myself and are the door-keepers of Rudras. They regard fame as the only wealth.

## \|\| 67.7 \|\|

*ṣaṇmukhān paśyase yāṃśca śaktipāṇīśikhidhvajān \|*  
*ṣaṭ ca ṣaṣṭistathā koṭyaḥ skandanāmnaḥ kumārakān \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The six-faced Sakhas with sakti in their hand and rode on peacock are Skanda Kumaras. These are sixty six crores in number.

## \|\| 67.8 \|\|

*etāvatyastathā koṭyaḥ śākhā nāma ṣaḍānanāḥ \|*  
*viśākhāstāvadevoktā naigameyāśca śaṃkara \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O Sankara! The Ganas called Sakhas having six faces are in same number (sixty-six crores) and Visakhas as also Naigameya Ganas are also in same number.

## \|\| 67.9 \|\|

*saptakoṭiśataṃ śaṃbho amī vai pramathottamāḥ \|*  
*ekaikaṃ prati deveśa tāvatyo hāpi mātaraḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O Sambhu! Those worthy Pramathas are in seven hundred crores number. О god of gods! They have each, as many Matrkas.

## \|\| 67.10 \|\|

*bhasmāruṇitadehaṣṭha trinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*ete śaivā iti proktāstava bhaktā gaṇeśvarāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. These ash-smeared bodies, three eyed garias having Sula in hand are called Saivas. All these pioneer Ganas are your devotees.

## \|\| 67.11 \|\|

*tathā pāśupatāścānye bhasmatraharaṇā vibho \|*  
*ete gaṇāstvasaṃkhyātāḥ sāhāyārthaṃ samāgatāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O sovereign! Numerous other ash-smeared bodies with weapons in hands are Pasupata Ganas. They have also came here to serve you.

## \|\| 67.12 \|\|

*pinākadhāriṇo raudrā gaṇāḥ kālamukhāpare \|*  
*tava bhaktāḥ samāyātā jaṭāmaṇḍalinodbhutā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Your other ganas called Kalamukhas, fierce in body, having dangerous face, holding Pinaka bows, wearing matted locks and devoted to you have also come here.

## \|\| 67.13 \|\|

*khaṭvāṅgayodhino vīrā raktacarmasamāvṛtāḥ \|*  
*ime prāptā gaṇā yoddhaṃ mahāvratina uttamāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The excellent Ganas Mahavrati expert in fighting with Khatvanga and having red shield have also come to fight for you.

## \|\| 67.14 \|\|

*digvāsaso maunincha vaṇṭātraharaṇāstathā \|*  
*nirāśrayā nāma gaṇāḥ samāyātā jagaduro \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О preceptor of the imiverse! The nude Ganas Nirasrayas have also come here. They observe silence and hold bells as weapon in their hands.

## \|\| 67.15 \|\|

*sārthadvinetrāḥ padmākṣāḥ śrīvatsāṅkittavakṣasaḥ \|*  
*samāyātāḥ khagārūḍhā vṛṣabhadhvajino'vyayāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The Ganas possessing two and a half eyes, with lotus like eyes, mark of Srivatsa on their chests, seated on birds, bull-bannered have also come here. All of them are imperishable.

## \|\| 67.16 \|\|

*mahāpāśupatā nāma cakraśulagharāstathā \|*  
*bhairavo viṣṇunā sārddhamabhedenārcito hi yaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. They are called the Mahapasupatas, holding discuses and Sula in their hands. They have worshipped Bhairava with Visnu identically.

## \|\| 67.17 \|\|

*ime mṛgendravadanāḥ śūlabāṇadhanurvarāḥ \|*  
*gaṇāstvadromasaṃbhūtā vīrabhadrapurogamāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. These are the lion-faced Ganas with Virabhadra as their leader, holding spears, arrows and bows and originating from the hair on your body.

## \|\| 67.18 \|\|

*ete cānye ca bahavaḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*sāhāyārthaṃ tavāyātā yathā prītyādiśasva tān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. These and several hundred other ganas too have come for assisting you. Give them order as per your choice.

## \|\| 67.19 \|\|

*tato'bhyetya gaṇāḥ sarve praṇemurvṛṣabhadhvajam \|*  
*tān kareṇaiva bhagavān samāśvāsyopaveśayat \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. All Ganas then bowed their heads before the bull-riding god. God gave hint of acceptance through his hand and wished that they should take their seats.

## \|\| 67.20 \|\|

*mahāpāśupatān dṛṣṭvā samutthāya maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*saṃpariṣvajatādhyakṣāṃste praṇemurmaheśvaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Mahesvara seeing the Mahipasupatas, rose and embraced his army commanders. They all saluted him with reverence.

## \|\| 67.21 \|\|

*tatastadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve gaṇeśvarāḥ \|*  
*suciraṃ vismitākṣāca vailakṣyamagamat param \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The eyes of all Ganas began dizzying of having an eye on that excellent scene. Then they all wondered for a very long time and were ashamed to the extreme.

## \|\| 67.22 \|\|

*vismitākṣān gaṇān dṛṣṭvā śailā diryogināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*prāha prahasya deveśaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ gaṇādhipam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. When the great Yogi Sailadi etc. saw them dizzy eyed, they smiled and said to the god of gods Sulapani.

## \|\| 67.23 \|\|

*vismitāmi gaṇā deva sarva eva maheśvara \|*  
*mahāpāśupatānāṃ hi yat tvayāliṅganaṃ kṛtam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O god Mahesvara! Your embrace of Mahapasupatas have threw these all Ganas in surprise.

## \|\| 67.24 \|\|

*tadeteṣāṃ mahādeva sphuṭaṃ trailokyavindakam \|*  
*rūpaṃ jñānaṃ vivekaṃ ca vadasva svecchyā vibho \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Hence О Mahadeva! О sovereign! Describe as you please about their complexion, knowledge and conscience that have reached the three-world.

## \|\| 67.25 \|\|

*pramathādhipatervākyaṃ viditvā bhūtabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*babhāṣe tān gaṇān sarvān bhāvābhāvavicāriṇaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Understanding the sayings of Parmatha- chief, the lord of the creator addressed all those Ganas, considerers of existence and non-existence.

## \|\| 67.26 \|\|

*rudra uvāca bhavadbhirbhaktisaṃyuktairharo bhāvena pūjitaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃkāravimūḍhaiśca nindadbhiddharvaiṣṇavaṃ padam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Rudra said- You all have worshipped Hara with reverence but condemned the devotees of Visnu on account of ignorance causing dullness to mind.

## \|\| 67.27 \|\|

*tenājñānena bhavato'nādṛtyānuvirodhitā \|*  
*yo'haṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇurviṣṇuryaḥ so'hamavyayaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. On account of such ignorance looming in you all, special honour was given to them while you have been disregarded. Listen that Visnu and I myself are one and equal. There is no dividing line between both of us.

## \|\| 67.28-30 \|\|

*nāvayorve vai viśeṣo'sti ekā mūrtirdvidhā sthitā \|*  
*tadamībhirnaravyāghdvairbhaktibhāvayutairgaṇeḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*yathāhaṃ vai parijñāto na bhavadbhistathā hariḥ \|*  
*yenāhaṃ nindito nityaṃ bhavadbhirmūḍhabuddhibhiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tena jñānaṃ hi vai naṣṭaṃ nātastvāliṅgittā mayā \|*  
*ityevamukte vacane gaṇāḥ procurmaheśvaram \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. There lies no discrimination between us. A single form is seen in two reflections. These Ganas therefore, know me better than you all. No doubt can be raised in their conscience. When I take the matter from this angle, you all have so condemned me instead of praying. This is the reason, you all have lost your discretion. I therefore, has not embraced you. On this, the Ganas said to Mahesvara.

## \|\| 67.31 \|\|

*kathaṃ bhavānyathaikyena saṃsthito'sti janārdanaḥ \|*  
*bhavān hi nirmalaḥ śuddhaḥ śāntaḥ śuklo nirañjanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. “How is it that you are identical with Janardana?” You are of pure heart, sacrosanct, always in peace, white and Niranjana (detached) while Visnu is attached.

## \|\| 67.32-33 \|\|

*sa cāpyañjanasaṅkāśaḥ kathaṃ teneha yujyate \|*  
*teṣāṃ vacanamarthākyaṃ śrutvā jīmūtavāhanaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vihasya meghagambhīraṃ gaṇānevamuvāca ha \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ sarvamākhyāsye svayaśovarddhanaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. In these circumstances, how can he join or integrate with you? Having heard such substantial pleas, Jimuta-vahana Sankara smiled and thundered to Ganas like the cloud and said- "I shall tell everything that enhances my own glory in detail.

## \|\| 67.34 \|\|

*na tveva yogyā yūyaṃ hi mahājñānasya karhicit \|*  
*apavādabhayādruhyaṃ bhavatāṃ hi prakāśaye \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. You all are not entitled to acquire Mahajnana. Yet due to fear that you may blame, I disclose the cryptic element before you all.

## \|\| 67.35 \|\|

*priyadhvamapi caitena yanmacittāstu nityaśaḥ \|*  
*ekarūpātmakaṃ dehaṃ kurudhvaṃ yatnamāsthitāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By having exclusive devotion to me, other people are also dear to you. Make your indiscriminative or integrated relation with the god to whom you worship.

## \|\| 67.36 \|\|

*payasā haviṣādyaiśca snapanena prayatnataḥ \|*  
*candanādibhirekātrairna me prītiḥ prajāyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. I never please on the devotees who give bath to my icon with milk or ghee and smear sandal etc. without any concentration.

## \|\| 67.37 \|\|

*yatnāttakacamādāya chindadhvaṃ mama vigraham \|*  
*narakārhā bhavadbhaktā rakṣāmi svayaśo'rthataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Take a saw in your hand and cut me in pieces, yet I shall defend you all hell-bearing devotees for my fame.

## \|\| 67.38 \|\|

*mā'yaṃ vadiṣyate loko mahāntamapavādinam \|*  
*yathā patanti narake harabhaktāstapasvinaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. (This is because) this world will call me a highly scandalous person, by saying that the devotees to Sankara fall in hell.

## \|\| 67.39 \|\|

*vrajanti narakaṃ ghoraṃ ityevaṃ parivādinaḥ \|*  
*ato'rthaṃ na kṣipāmyadya bhavato narake'dbhute \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The people criticising this way, fall in the gross hell. I therefore, do not want to throw you in that gross hell.

## \|\| 67.40 \|\|

*yannindadhvaṃ jagannāthaṃ puṣkarākṣaṃ ca manmayam \|*  
*sa caiva bhagavāśarvaḥ sarvavyāpī gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The Puskaraksa Jagannatha criticised by you is actually god Sarva, the head of ganas and omnipresent god. He is of my own form.

## \|\| 67.41 \|\|

*na tasya sadṛśo loke vidyate sacarācare \|*  
*śvetamūrtiḥ sa bhagavānpīto rakto'ñjanaprabhaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Nobody analogous to him is existed in this movable and immovable world. That god has white, yellow, red and dark aura or complexion.

## \|\| 67.42 \|\|

*tasmātparataraṃ loke nānyad dharmaṃ hi vidyate \|*  
*sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ miśrakaṃ tathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. There is no other Dharma in this world better than him. That god Sadasiva, adored by all people holds the Sattva, Rajasa, Tamasa and the mixed properties (guna).

## \|\| 67.43 \|\|

*sa eva dhatte bhagavānsarvapūjyaḥ sadāśivaḥ \|*  
*śaṃkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā śaivādyāḥ pramayottamāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Hearing Sankara’s words, Saiva and other Ganas then enquired- “O god! Kindly describe the characteristics of Sadasiva.”

## \|\| 67.44 \|\|

*pratyūcurbhagavanyūhi sadāśivaviśeṣaṇam \|*  
*teṣāṃ tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā pramathānāmatheśvaraḥ \|*  
*darśayāmāsa tadrūpaṃ sa ca śaivaṃ nirañjanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. When the god of Pramathas (Sankara) saw curiosity of Ganas, he showed his Sadasiva form.

## \|\| 67.45 \|\|

*tataḥ paśyanti hi gaṇāḥ tamīśaṃ vai sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*sahasravavatracaraṇaṃ sahastrabhujamīśvaram \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The several thousand Ganas then saw that god having thousand mouths, thousand feet and thousand arms.

## \|\| 67.46 \|\|

*daṇḍapāṇiṃ sudurdṛśyaṃ lokairvyāptaṃ samantataḥ \|*  
*daṇḍasaṃsthā'sya dṛśyante devapraharaṇāstathā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. He was everywhere in all lokas, Dandapani and rarest to see. All weapons of god were also seen comprised in his Danda.

## \|\| 67.47 \|\|

*tatastvekamukhaṃ bhūyo dadṛśuḥ śaṃkaraṃ gaṇāḥ \|*  
*raudraiśca vaiṣṇavaiścaiva dhṛtaṃ cilaiḥ sahasraśaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The Ganas then saw one mouthed Sankarа with several thousands marks of Rudra and Visnu.

## \|\| 67.48 \|\|

*arddhana vaiṣṇavavapurarkhena haravigrahaḥ \|*  
*khagadhvajaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ khagārūḍhaṃ vṛṣadhvajam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The half part of that form was of Hara and another half was of Visnu (the bird rider). Further, one fraction of that half was of bull rider while the another fraction was of bird rider.

## \|\| 67.49 \|\|

*yathā yathā trinayano rūpaṃ dhatte guṇāgraṇīḥ \|*  
*tathā tathā caṃ jāyante mahāpāśupatā gaṇāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. With the changing of forms by three eyed god, more and more Ganas i.e. Mahapasupatas came into being

## \|\| 67.50-53 \|\|

*tato'bhavaccaikarūpī śaṃkaro bahurūpavān \|*  
*kṣaṇācchvetaḥ kṣaṇādraktaḥ pīto nīlaḥ kṣaṇādapi \|\| 50 \|\|*

*miśrako varṇahīnaśca mahāpāśupatastathā \|*  
*kṣaṇādbhavati rudrendraḥ kṣaṇācchaṃbhuḥ prabhākaraḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*kṣaṇārthyācchaṃkaro viṣṇuḥ kṣaṇāccharvaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tatastadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaibādayo gaṇāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*ajānanta tadaikyena brahmaviṣṇvīśabhāskarān \|*  
*yadā'bhinnamamanyanta devadevaṃ sadāśivam \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. Then the multi-formed Sankara converted into single-formed. He also appeared with two forms, single form and without any form. He continuously changed his complexion within seconds and seen as white, red, yellow, blue, mixed coloured, colourless and Mahapasupata. Sri Sankara was seen Indra at a moment, Surya at another moments, Visnu and Pitamaha (Brahma) etc. in half instant of time. Momentary changes were seen one after another. The ganas Saiva etc. were confirmed that Brahma, Visnu, Isa and Bhaskara are one and there lies no duality when they find such phenomenal scene.

## \|\| 67.54-55 \|\|

*tadā nirvṛtayāpāste samajāyanta pārṣadāḥ \|*  
*teṣvevaṃ dhūtapāpeṣu abhinneṣu harīśvaraḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*prītātmā vibabhau śaṃbhuḥ prītyā yukto'bravīdvacaḥ \|*  
*parituṣṭo'smi sarveṣāṃ jñānenānena suvratāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. When all attendants of Siva realised Sadasiva as an integrated god, they all come out from the trap of evils. When the discrimination in their minds was effaced, Sambhu pleased on them. He said affectionately- "O great resolute! I am happy on being you all so conscious."

## \|\| 67.56 \|\|

*vṛṇudhvaṃ varamānantyaṃ dāsye vo manasepsitam \|*  
*ūcuste dehi bhagavanvaramasyākamīśvara \|*  
*bhinnadṛṣṭayuddhavaṃ pāpaṃ yattadabhraṃśaṃ prayātu naḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. "Now ask your desires to uncountable number. I will give you whatever boon you desire." They said- О god! О Mahesvara! Endow us with absolving all sins crept in our minds due to sense of dualism.

## \|\| 67.57 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- bāḍhamityabravīccharvaścakre nirvṛtakalmavān \|*  
*saṃparyaṣvajatāvyaktastānsarvāngaṇayūthapān \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Pulastya said- Sankara wished as they desired and removed their evil feelings with embracement to all those heads of Gana- regiments.

## \|\| 67.58 \|\|

*iti vibhunā praṇatārtihareṇa gaṇapatyaḥ vṛṣamevarathena \|*  
*śrutigaditānugameneva mandaraṃ girimavatya samavyavasantam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Then all heads of Ganas spread over the entire territory of Mandara mountain from all sides with Sankara, the bull and cloud riding god. It was arranged in accordance with the Vedic injunctions.

## \|\| 67.59 \|\|

*ācchādito girivaraḥ pramathairghanābhai- rābhāti śuklatanurīśvarapādajuṣṭaḥ \|*  
*nīlājinātatatanuḥ śaradabhravarṇo yadvadvibhāti balavānvṛṣabho harasya \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. As the mighty bull of Sankara having fair complexion like clouds of pleasant season (Sarada) covered with the hide of blue stag is looked, the white mountain Mandara was looking the same when all Pramathas having cloud complexion covered it.

## Chapter 68. Andhaka’s fight with Siva

## \|\| 68.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- etasminnantare prāptaḥ samaṃ daityaistā'nyakaḥ \|*  
*mandaraṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ pramathāśritakandaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- In the meantime, Andhaka reached at the greatest of mountains Mandara, where Pramathas were living. His army of demons was also with him.

## \|\| 68.2 \|\|

*pramathā dānavāndṛṣṭvā cakruḥ kilakilādhvanim \|*  
*pramathāścāpi saṃrabdhā jaghnustūryāṇyanekaśaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When Pramathas saw demons, they made a loud voice ‘kil-kil’ and began to play with several trumpets and other war striking instruments in sheer excitement.

## \|\| 68.3 \|\|

*sa cāvṛṇonmahānādo rodasī pralayopamaḥ \|*  
*śuśrāva vāyumārgastho vighnanātho vināyakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. That fierce sound had pierced the heart of ether and the earth viz. everywhere echo of these was heard because it was the same big- bang as occurs at the time of great devastation (Pralaya). Vinayaka, the god removing hurdles was moving through sky route that lime. He therefore, also heard that voice.

## \|\| 68.4 \|\|

*samabhyayāt susaṃkruddhaḥ pramathairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ \|*  
*mandaraṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ dadṛśe pitaraṃ tathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. With great indignation, he went at the mountain Mandara in company of Pramathas and saw there his father.

## \|\| 68.5 \|\|

*praṇipatya tathā bhaktyā vākyamāha maheśvaram \|*  
*kiṃ tiṣṭhasi jagannātha samuttiṣṭha raṇotsukaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He bowed his head for father (Sartkara) and enquired- “O lord of the world! Why are you so relaxing? Please, stand up with zeal to fight against enemy.”

## \|\| 68.6 \|\|

*tato vighneśavacanāñjagannātho'mbikāṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*prāha yāsye'ndhakaṃ hantuṃ stheyamevāpramattathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Mahadeva then stood up and said to Ambika- "I will go for killing Andhaka. Take guard of yourself."

## \|\| 68.7 \|\|

*tato girisutā devaṃ samāliṅgaya punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*samīkṣya sasnehaharaṃ prāha gaccha jayāndhakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Parvati embraced him frequently, looked at Siva with love and said- "Go and vanquish Andhaka."

## \|\| 68.8 \|\|

*tato'maragurorgaurī candanaṃ rocanāñjanam \|*  
*prativandha susaṃprītā pādāvevābhyavandata \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Gauri then put sandal paste, rocana and anjana on the forehead of Sankara and worshipped his feet affectionately.

## \|\| 68.9 \|\|

*tato haraḥ prāha vaco yaśasyaṃ mālinīmapi \|*  
*jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva jayantīṃ cāparājitām \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Mahadeva then said to Malini, Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanti and Aparajita-

## \|\| 68.10 \|\|

*yuṣmābhirapramattābhiḥ stheyaṃ gehe surakṣite \|*  
*rakṣaṇīyā prayatlena giriputrī pramādataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. "You women must now live cautiously in a safe house and defend Parvati from being careless with your efforts."

## \|\| 68.11 \|\|

*iti saṃdiśya tāḥ sarvāḥ samāruhya vṛṣaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*nirjagāma gṛhāt tuṣṭo javepsuḥ śūladhṛg balī \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. After, instructing all of them, God Sankara took sula in his hand and left happily from home with a determination of victory.

## \|\| 68.12 \|\|

*nirgacchatastu bhavanādīśvarasya gaṇādhipāḥ \|*  
*samantāt parivāryeva jayaśabdāṃśca cakrire \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The heads of ganas immediately surrounded Sankara as soon as he came out from the house from four sides and pronounced the voice for ‘victory, victory’.

## \|\| 68.13 \|\|

*raṇāya nirgacchati lokapāle maheśvare śūladhare maharṣe \|*  
*śubhāni saumyāni sumaṅgalāni jātāni cihnāni jayāya śaṃbhoḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О hermit! When Sankara, protector of the world, started for the battle, having spear in hand, there appeared good, modest and benevolent indications indicative of victory.

## \|\| 68.14 \|\|

*śivā sthitā vāmatare'tha bhāge prayāti cāggre svanamunnadantī \|*  
*kravyādasaṃghāśca tathāmiṣaiṣiṇaḥ prayānti hṛṣṭāstṛṣitāsṛgarthe \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A she-jackal was seen at the left hand side and she was running with expressions from mouth. Groups of carrion-eating, blood-thirsty creatures desirous of flesh also went cheerfully.

## \|\| 68.15 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāṅga nakhāntaṃ vai samakampata śūlinaḥ \|*  
*śakuniścāpi hārīto maunī yāti parāṅmukhaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The right part of Sartkara's body was shivered from root to the finger tips. A bird Harita was following silently them.

## \|\| 68.16 \|\|

*nimittamīdṛśān dṛṣṭvā bhūtabhavyabhavo vibhuḥ \|*  
*śailādiṃ prāha vacanaṃ sasmitaṃ śaśiśekharaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When Mahadeva, the sovereign god with crescent on his forehead, the all-pervading god covering the past, present and the future, smiled and said to Sailadi (Nandi):

## \|\| 68.17 \|\|

*śaśiśekhara uvāca- nandin jayayo'dya me bhāvī na kathaṃcit parājayaḥ \|*  
*nimittānīha dṛśyante saṃbhūtāni gaṇeśvara \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Sankara said- О Nandi! О heads of Ganas! There are good indications appearing to my eyes (for the omens have appeared and are seen here). Hence, I will definitely achieve victory. I will not suffer from defeat by any means.

## \|\| 68.18 \|\|

*tacchaṃbhuvacanaṃ śrutvā śailādiḥ prāha śaṃkaram \|*  
*kaḥ saṃdeho mahādeva yat tvaṃ jayasi śātravān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Sailadi replied- “O Mahadeva! How can it be doubted that you will vanquish the enemies? You will definitely conquer.”

## \|\| 68.19 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ nandī rudragaṇāṃstathā \|*  
*samādideśa yuddhāya mahāpāśupataiḥ saha \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. With these words, Nandi ordered Rudras to attack on enemy along with Mahapasupatas.

## \|\| 68.20 \|\|

*te'bhyetya dānavabalaṃ mardayanti sma vegitāḥ \|*  
*nānāśastradharā vīrā vṛkṣānaśanayo yathā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Those warriors began to crush the army of demons by using numerous weapons the same way as the thunderbolt destroys the trees.

## \|\| 68.21 \|\|

*te vadhyamānā balibhiḥ pramathairdaityadānavāḥ \|*  
*pravṛttāḥ pramathān hantuṃ kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Those sons of Diti and Danu took Kuta- Mudgara in their hands and attacked on Pramathas when attack was so made by them. Indra, Visnu, Brahma, Surya and Agni etc. gods then gathered in sky in order to see that fierce battle.

## \|\| 68.22 \|\|

*tato'mbaratale devāḥ sendraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ \|*  
*sasūryāgnipurogāstu samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Narada! Echo from drum, the slogans and the sound of other war declaring instruments then began to spread throughout the sky.

## \|\| 68.23 \|\|

*tato'mbarattale ghoṣaḥ sasvanaḥ samajāyata \|*  
*gītavādyādisaṃmiśro dundubhīnāṃ kalipriya \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The furious Mahapasupatas and other Ganas then began slaughtering the demons army within seconds when the gods were just looking on.

## \|\| 68.24 \|\|

*tataḥ paśyatsu deveṣu mahāpāśupatādayaḥ \|*  
*gaṇāstaddānavaṃ sainyaṃ jighāṃsanti spa kopitāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Tuhunda forwarded furiously when he saw severe killing of the four segments (infantry, horse rider, elephant rider and camel rider) through the hands of Gana-chiefs.

## \|\| 68.25 \|\|

*caturaṅgavalaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanyamānaṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ \|*  
*krodhānvitastuhuṇḍastu vegenābhisasāra ha \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He was looking excellently good like uplifted flag of Indra with formidable silver- white iron mace, fixed with a strip of silk in his hand.

## \|\| 68.26 \|\|

*ādāya parighaṃ ghoraṃ paṭṭoiddhamayasmayam \|*  
*rājate rājate'rtyamindradhvajamivocchritam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The mighty Tuhunda gave hard blows to Ganas in battle by brandishing that mace. All those Ganas from Rudras to even Skandas fled panic-stricken.

## \|\| 68.27 \|\|

*taṃ bhrāmayāno balavānnijaghāna raṇe gaṇān \|*  
*rudrādyāḥ skandaparyantāste'bhajyanta bhayāturāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When Vinayaka, the head of Gana saw his soldiers so scattered, he speedily rushed towards the demon Tuhunda.

## \|\| 68.28 \|\|

*tatprabhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇanātho vināyakaḥ \|*  
*samādravata vegena tuhuṇḍaṃ danupuṃgavam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. When the wicked and mighty demon saw Ganapati forwarding fast, he let his mace fall on the frontal globe of Ganapati.

## \|\| 68.29 \|\|

*āpatantaṃ gaṇapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā daityo durātmavān \|*  
*parighaṃ pātayāmāsa kumbhapṛṣṭhe mahābalaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О Brahman! That mace as hard as thunderbolt split into several hundred pieces when so blown on the frontal globe of Ganapati. This phenomenon took place the same way as the thunderbolt is split in several hundred pieces if befallen on the ridge of Meru mountain.

## \|\| 68.30 \|\|

*vināyakasya tatkumbhe parighaṃ vajrabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*śatadhā tvagamadbrahman meroḥ kūṭa ivārśānaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. When Rahu (the devil head) saw the mace infructuous and the Parsada (Ganesa) coming, he just appeared and gripped him tightly with his fastening arms, with a view to protect his maternal uncle.

## \|\| 68.31 \|\|

*parighaṃ viphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ ca pārṣadam \|*  
*babandha bāhupāśena rāhū rakṣan hi mātulam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Inspitc of so gripped by Rahu, Vinayaka dragged with force the demon and gave a sharp blow from his axe on his head.

## \|\| 68.32 \|\|

*sa baddho bāhupāśena balādākṛṣya dānavam \|*  
*samājaghāna śirasi kuṭhāreṇa mahodaraḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. That demon divided into two parts and fell down. The mighty Rahu still not loosened his grip, О Narada! He did his every effort to cutoff the arm grip and get liberty yet he failed.

## \|\| 68.33 \|\|

*kāṣṭhavatsa dvidhā bhūto nipapāta dharātale \|*  
*tathā'pi nātyajad rāhurbalavān dānaveśvaraḥ \|*  
*sa mokṣārtha'karod yatnaṃ na śaśāka ca nārada \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. When Kundodara Gana having enormous size saw Vinayaka so gripped by Rahu, he took musala and gave a blow on Rahu.

## \|\| 68.34 \|\|

*vināyakaṃ saṃyatamīkṣya rāhuṇā kuṇḍodaro nāma gaṇeśvaro'tha \|*  
*pragṛhya tūrṇa muśalaṃ mahātmā rāhuṃ durātmānamasau jaghāna \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Then Kalasa-dhvaja Gana pierced the heart region of Rahu with a spear. Ghatodara hit him by a mace and the demon king Sukesi hit with sword.

## \|\| 68.35 \|\|

*tato gaṇeśaḥ kalaśadhvajastu prāsena rāhuṃ hṛdaye bibheda \|*  
*ghaṭodaro vai gadayā jadhāna khaṅgena rakṣo'dhipatiḥ sukeśī \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Rahu could not bear the simultaneous blows by four warriors from every side and he made Vinayaka free from his grip. He immediately cut-off the head of Tuhunda when released from Rahu's grip.

## \|\| 68.36 \|\|

*sa taiścaturbhiḥ paritāḍyamāno gaṇādhipaṃ rāhurathotsasarja \|*  
*saṃtyaktamātro'tha paraśvadhena tuhuṇḍamūrddhānamatho bibheda \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. When Tuhunda was so killed and Rahu lost power to sustain, the five Ganesvaras simultaneously forced their way into the army of demons with a view to disgorging the venom of their wrath upon them.

## \|\| 68.37 \|\|

*hate tuhuṇḍe vimukhe ca rāhau gaṇeśvarāḥ krovavivaṃ mumukṣavaḥ pañcakakālānalasannikāśā viśanti senāṃ danupuṃgavānām \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The mighty Bali took his club and gave hard blows on the belly, forehead and trunk of Vinayaka when he saw that his army was being butchered by them.

## \|\| 68.38 \|\|

*tāṃ vadhyamānāṃ svacamūṃ samīkṣya balirbalī mārutatulyavegaḥ \|*  
*gadāṃ samādhidhya jaghāna mūrdhni vināyakaṃ kumbhataṭe kare ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. He rendered Kundodara broken in the waist, crushed the skull of Mahodara, cracked the joints of Kumbhadhvaja and broked the legs of Ghatodara.

## \|\| 68.39 \|\|

*kuṇḍodaraṃ bhagnakarṭi cakāra mahodaraṃ śīrṇaśiraḥ kapālam \|*  
*kumbhadhvajaṃ cūrṇitasaṃdhibandhaṃ ghaṭodaraṃ coruvipannasaṃdhim \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. That mighty, exceedingly valiant demonchief, after having repulsed those Ganesvaras, rushed to kill Skanda, Visakha etc. pioneer Ganesvara.

## \|\| 68.40 \|\|

*gaṇādhipāṃstānvimukhān sa kṛtvā balānvito vīrataro'surendraḥ \|*  
*samabhyayāvat tvarito nihantuṃ gaṇeśvarān skandaviśākhamukhyān \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Then, the omnipresent Mahesvara called the chief of Ganas, Sailadi (Nandi) when saw him marching forward and said- “O warrior! Go and kill the demons in battle.”

## \|\| 68.41 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ bhagavān samīkṣya maheśvaraḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ gaṇānām \|*  
*śailādimāmantrya vaco babhāṣe gacchasva daityān jahi vīra yuddhe \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Nandi, the son of Silada then took a thunderbolt, approached to Bali and hit hard on his head. He fainted and fell down on the ground.

## \|\| 68.42 \|\|

*ityevamukto vṛṣabhadhvajena vajraṃ samādāya śilādasūnuḥ \|*  
*baliṃ samabhyetya jaghāna mūrdhni saṃmohitaḥ so'vanimāsasāda \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. When Kujambha saw his nephew unconscious, he gave a round turn to boulder with anger and threw it with full force on Nandi.

## \|\| 68.43 \|\|

*saṃmohitaṃ bhrātṛsutaṃ viditvā balī kujambho musalaṃ pragṛhya \|*  
*saṃbhrāmayaṃstūrṇataraṃ sa vegāt sasarja nandiṃ prati jātakopaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The mighty Nandi held that musala in his hand and gave the hard blows from that boulder to him. He could not bear the blows and fell down dead.

## \|\| 68.44 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ musalaṃ pragṛhya kareṇa tūrṇaṃ bhagavān sa nandī \|*  
*jaghāna tenaiva kujambhamāhave sa prāṇahīno nipapāta bhūmau \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Warrior Nandi killed several hundred other demons with the thunderbolt after killing Kujambha. The demons took shelter of Duryodhana then.

## \|\| 68.45 \|\|

*hatvā kujambhaṃ musalena nandī vajreṇa vīraḥ śataśo jaghāna \|*  
*te vadhyamānā gaṇānāyakena duryodhanaṃ vai śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. When Duryodhana saw demons killed by the blows of thunderbolt, he picked up Prasa as quickly as the spark of lightening and threw it towards Nandi with words that "you are killed now."

## \|\| 68.46 \|\|

*duryodhanaḥ prekṣya gaṇādhipena vajraprahārairnihatānditīśān \|*  
*prāsaṃ samāvidhya taḍitprakāśaṃ nandi pracikṣepa hato'si vai bruvan \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Nandi cut-off that Prasa from thunderbolt the same way as a backbiter discloses the secrecy. When Duryodhana saw that javelin cut-off, he made fist and approached to Nandi.

## \|\| 68.47 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ kuliśena nandī bibheda guhyaṃ piśuno yathā naraḥ \|*  
*tatprāsamālakṣya tadā nikṛttaṃ saṃvatrtya muṣṭiṃ gaṇamāsasāda \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Nandi then beheaded him like the fruit of Tala by his Kulisa. He fell down on the ground and the frightened demons ran away towards all directions.

## \|\| 68.48 \|\|

*tato'sya vajrī kuliśena tūrṇaṃ śiro'cchinat tālaphalaprakāśam \|*  
*hato'tha bhūmau nipapāta vegād daityāśca bhītā vigatā diśo daśa \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. When Hasti saw his son so dead, he approached to Nandi. He picked up his bow and shot volley of arrows analogous to Yamadanda on him.

## \|\| 68.49 \|\|

*tato hataṃ svaṃ tanayaṃ nirīkṣya hastī tadā nandinamājagāma \|*  
*pragṛhya bāṇāsanamugravegaṃ vibheda bāṇairyamadaṇḍakalpaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. As the clouds cover the mountains with streams, he covered all Ganas of Sankara including Nandi with arrows. Those Vinayaka and other warriors so covered by the net of arrows shot by that demon began to run here and there like the bulls when attacked by lion.

## \|\| 68.50 \|\|

*gaṇān sanandīn vṛṣabhadhvajāṃstān dhārābhirevāmbudharāstu śailān \|*  
*te chādyamānagurabāṇajālai- vināyakādyā balino'pi vīrāḥ \|*  
*siṃhapraṇunnā vṛṣabhā yathaiva bhayāturā dudruvire samantāt \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When Kumara saw Ganas showing back to the battlefield, he cut-off all arrows by throwing his Sakti. He then immediately approached to the enemy and plunged the sakti into his chest.

## \|\| 68.51 \|\|

*paraṅmukhān vīkṣya gaṇān kumāraḥ śaktyā pṛṣatkānatha vārayitvā \|*  
*tūrṇaṃ samabhyetya ripuṃ samīkṣya pragṛhya śaktiṃ hṛdayaṃ bibheda \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Hasti fell down dead on ground when his heart so pierced by Sakti and the army of enemy once again shattered.

## \|\| 68.52 \|\|

*śaktinirbhinnahṛdayo hastī bhūmyāṃ papāta ha \|*  
*mamāra cāripṛtanā jātā bhūyaḥ parāṅmukhī \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. When Ganesvara saw the demon army so shattered, he furiously began killing demons under lead of Nandi.

## \|\| 68.53 \|\|

*amarāribalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ kruddhā gaṇeśvarāḥ \|*  
*purato nandinaṃ kṛtvā jighāṃsanti sma dānavān \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. As the Pramathas started killing them, the mighty demons too, who had retreated, came back with Kartasvara leading.

## \|\| 68.54 \|\|

*te vadhyamānāḥ pramathairdaityāścāpi parāṅmukhāḥ \|*  
*bhūyo nivṛttā balinaḥ kārttasvarapurogamāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. When Nandisena with tiger mouth saw them so returned, he filled with anger, his eyes became red and he expirated long. He then also turned towards battle field.

## \|\| 68.55 \|\|

*tānnivṛttānsamīkṣyaiva krodhadīptekṣaṇaḥ śvasan \|*  
*nandiveṇo vyāghnamukho nivṛttaścapi vegavān \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. О Narada! Karttasvara returned to battlefield with mace in his hand when he saw the leader of Ganas again ready to fight with a Pattisa in his hand.

## \|\| 68.56 \|\|

*tasmin nivṛtte gaṇape paṭṭiśāgrakare tadā \|*  
*kārttasvaro nivavṛte gadāmādāya nārada \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. When Ganapati saw that mighty demon king, having glow of body as fire, he gave a round turn to his Pattisa and hit hard on his head. Karttasvara fell down dead with a ear piercing cry.

## \|\| 68.57 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ jvalanaprakāśaṃ gaṇaḥ samīkṣyaiva mahāsurendram \|*  
*taṃ paṭṭiśaṃ bhrāmya jaghāna mūrdhni kāntasvaraṃ visvaramunnadantam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. 4. Sharp-edged spear.

## \|\| 68.58 \|\|

*tasminhate bhrātari mātuleve pāśaṃ samāvidhya turaṅgakandharaḥ \|*  
*babandha vīraṃ saha paṭṭiśena gaṇeśvaraṃ cāpyatha nandiṣeṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. When the warrior Turangakandhara saw that his maternal brother is dead, he threw his noose and tied Nandisena, the head of ganas with Pattisa in his hand.

## \|\| 68.59 \|\|

*nandiṣeṇaṃ tathā baddhaṃ samīkṣya balināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*viśākhaḥ kupito'bhyetya śaktipāṇiravasthitaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. When mighty Visakha saw Nandisena so fastened, he approached to him immediately in fury and stood up before him with spear in his hand.

## \|\| 68.60 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā balināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pāśapāṇirayaḥ śirāḥ \|*  
*saṃyodhayāmāsa balī viśākhaṃ kukkuṭadhvajam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. When mighty Ayahsira saw the cock- bannered Visakha, he picked up noose in his hand and began battle against Visakha.

## \|\| 68.61 \|\|

*viśākhaṃ sanniruddhaṃ vai dṛṣṭrā'yaḥ śirasā raṇe \|*  
*śākhca naigameyaśca tūrṇamādravatāṃ ripum \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. When the Ganas sakha and Naigameya saw Visakha bound by Ayahsira in the battle, they immediately rushed towards the enemy.

## \|\| 68.62 \|\|

*ekato naigameyena bhinnaḥ śaktayā tvayaḥ śirāḥ \|*  
*ekatacaiva śākhena viśākhapriyakāmyayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. In order to please Visakha, Naigameya from one side and sakha from other side pierced Ayahsira with a sharp-edged spear.

## \|\| 68.63 \|\|

*sa tribhiḥ śaṃkarasutaiḥ pīḍyamāno jahau raṇam \|*  
*te prāptāḥ śambaraṃ tūrṇaṃ prekṣyamāṇā gaṇeśvarāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. When Ayahsira was hit by the three sons of Sankara, he left the battle. Ganesvara, then saw Sambara and approached him immediately.

## \|\| 68.64 \|\|

*pāśaṃ śaktyā samāhatya caturbhiḥ śaṃkarātmajaiḥ \|*  
*jagāma vilayaṃ tūrṇamākāśādiva bhūtalam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The noose, being hit with spear by four sons of Sankara, broke into pieces in no time and fell down from sky on the ground.

## \|\| 68.65 \|\|

*pāśe nirāśatāṃ yāte śambaraḥ kātarekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*diśo'tha bheje devarṣe kumāraḥ sainyamardayat \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Sambara was threatened when Pasa (noose) was destroyed and ran wherever he found the route and Kumara began to suppress the army.

## \|\| 68.66 \|\|

*tairvadhyamānā putanā maharṣe sā dānavī rudrasutairgaṇaiśca \|*  
*vivarṇarūpā bhayavihnalāṅgī jagāma śukraṃ śaraṇaṃ bhayārtā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. О hermit! That army of demons so beaten by those sons of Rudra and Ganas panicked with fear of blows and sheltered to Sukracarya.

## Chapter 69. Killing of Jambha and Kujambha

## \|\| 69.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tataḥ svasainyamālakṣya nihataṃ pramathairatha \|*  
*andhako'bhyetya śukraṃ tu idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- When Andhaka saw his army incessantly being killed by Pramathas, he went to Sukracarуа and said-

## \|\| 69.2 \|\|

*bhagavaṃstvāṃ samāśritya vayaṃ bādhāma devatāḥ \|*  
*athānyānapi viprarṣe gandharvasurakinnarān \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О lord! О great Brahmin! Having obtained you as our asylum, we will kill the gods and others, also the Gandharvas, Suras and Kinnaras.

## \|\| 69.3 \|\|

*tadiyaṃ paśya bhagavan mayā guptā varūthinī \|*  
*anātheva yathā nārī pramathairapi kālyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О god! Please, see that the army so defended by me is being destroyed by Pramathas like a woman without support of her husband.

## \|\| 69.4 \|\|

*kujambhādyāśca nihatā bhrātaro mama bhārgava \|*  
*akṣavāḥ pramathāścāmī kurukṣetraphalaṃ yathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О Bhargava! My brothers Kujambha and others have been killed and these Pramathas are imperishable like immortal fruits of Kuruksetra, the holiest place.

## \|\| 69.5 \|\|

*tasmāt kuruṣva śreyo no na jīyema yathā paraiḥ \|*  
*jayema ca parān yuddhe tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Hence, do welfare of us all so that we remain undefeated by the enemies and further, exercise such a measure that ensure our victory in the battle.

## \|\| 69.6-7 \|\|

*śukro'ndhakavacaḥ śrutvā sāntvayan paramādbhutam \|*  
*vacanaṃ prāha devarṣe brahmarṣirdānaveśvaram \|*  
*tvaddhitārthaṃ yatiṣyāmi kariṣyāmi tava priyam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ vidyāṃ saṃjīvanīṃ kaviḥ \|*  
*āvartayāmāsa tadā vidhānena śucivrataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. О divine hermit! The Brahmarsi Sukracarya listened to Andhaka, consoled the demon king and said- "I will do all effort for your welfare and do your favour." With these words, Sukracarya used his Sanjivani Vidya by virtue of being his a great resolute.

## \|\| 69.8 \|\|

*tasyāmāvartyamānāyāṃ vidyāyāmasureśvarāḥ \|*  
*ye hatāḥ prathamaṃ yuddhe dānavāste samutthitāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. When that Vidya was used, all the demon kings and the demons killed earlier in war came back to life.

## \|\| 69.9 \|\|

*kujambhādiṣu daityeṣu bhūya evotthiteṣvatha \|*  
*yuddhāyābhyāgateṣveva nandī śaṃkaramabravīt \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. When Nandi saw Kujambha etc. demons, revived and forwarding for re-fighting, he said to Sankara:

## \|\| 69.10 \|\|

*mahādeva vaco mahāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ paramādbhutam \|*  
*avicintyamasahyaṃ ca mṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ punaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Mahadeva! Listen to my phenomenal statement : “It is beyond imagination and tolerance to see revival of once dead demons.”

## \|\| 69.11 \|\|

*ye hatāḥ pramathairdaityā yathāśaktyā raṇājire \|*  
*te samujjīvitā bhūyo bhārgaveṇātha vidyayā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The demons killed by Pramathas in battle have once again brought back to life by Bhargava by virtue of application of his Sanjivani Vidya.

## \|\| 69.12 \|\|

*tadidaṃ tairmahādeva mahatkarma kṛtaṃ raṇe \|*  
*saṃjātaṃ svalpameveśa śukravidyābalāśrayāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Hence, О Mahadeva! О god! The enormous labour made by us in battle has now been proved futile due to the Vidya (learning) applied by Sukracarya.

## \|\| 69.13 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane nandinaṃ kulanandinam \|*  
*pratyuvāca prabhuḥ prītyā svārthasādhanamuttamam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. These words being said by Nandi, the bestower of joy to his family, Mahadeva said to Nandi, the words leading to the best accomplishment of his object-

## \|\| 69.14 \|\|

*gaccha śukraṃ gaṇapate mamāntikamupānaya \|*  
*ahaṃ taṃ saṃyamiṣyāmi yathāyoga sametya hi \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О lord of Ganas! “Go to Sukra and bring him quickly to me. I shall restrain him after encountering according to circumstances.”

## \|\| 69.15 \|\|

*ityevamukto rudreṇa nandī gaṇapatistataḥ \|*  
*samājagāma daityānāṃ camūṃ śukrajighṛkṣayā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. When Rudra so ordered, the master of Ganas, Nandi entered into the army of demons with an intention to seize Sukracarya.

## \|\| 69.16 \|\|

*taṃ dadarśāsuraśreṣṭho balavān hayakañcaraḥ \|*  
*saṃrūrodha tadā mārgaṃ siṃhasyeva paśurvane \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. He was seen by mighty and prominent demon Hayakandhara and precluded him the same way as if the animal is restricting the route of a lion.

## \|\| 69.17 \|\|

*samupetyāhanannandī vajreṇa śataparvaṇā \|*  
*sa papātātha niḥsaṃjño yayau nandī tatastvaran \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Nandi approached him, gave an acute blow of Sataparva (thunderbolt of hundred joints) and he fell down on ground unconscious. Then Nandi left that place in hurry.

## \|\| 69.18 \|\|

*tataḥ kujambho jambhaśca balo vṛtrastvayaḥ śirāḥ \|*  
*pañcadānavaśārdūlā nandinaṃ samupādravan \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then Kujambha, Jambha, Bala, Vrtra and Ayahsira, the five excellent demons rushed towards Nandi.

## \|\| 69.19 \|\|

*tathā'nye dānavaśreṣṭhā mayahlādapurogamāḥ \|*  
*nānāpraharaṇā yuddhe gaṇanāthamabhidravan \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Similarly, Maya and Hlada etc. demons, holding numerous type of arms and weapons in battle-field rushed towards Nandi.

## \|\| 69.20 \|\|

*tato gaṇānāmadhipaṃ kuṭyamānaṃ mahābalaiḥ \|*  
*samapaśyanta devāstaṃ pitāmahapurogamāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The gods including Pitamaha (Brahma) saw that Ganadhipa was than badly thrashed by the mighty demons.

## \|\| 69.21 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavān brahmā prāha śukrapurogamān \|*  
*sāhāyyaṃ kriyatāṃ śaṃbhoretadantaramuttamam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Lord Brahma said to Indra and other gods- "Give support to Sambhu at this tough moment you all."

## \|\| 69.22 \|\|

*pitāmahoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|*  
*samāpatanta vegena śivasainyamathāmbarāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Indra etc. gods descended immediately then and assembled with Siva’s army in compliance with the instructions of Brahma.

## \|\| 69.23 \|\|

*teṣāmāpatatāṃ vegaḥ pramathānāṃ bale babhau \|*  
*āpagānāṃ mahāvegaṃ patantīnāṃ mahārṇave \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. As the rivers run rapidly towards ocean, the gods same way assembled with the army of Pramathas.

## \|\| 69.24 \|\|

*tato halahalāśabdaḥ samajāyata cobhayoḥ \|*  
*balayorghorasaṅkāśo surapramathayoratha \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A loud commotion and sound (Halahala- sound) was produced from the two armies of Pramathas and demons.

## \|\| 69.25 \|\|

*tamantaramupāgamya nandī saṃgṛhya vegavān \|*  
*rathād bhārgavamākrāmatsiṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. At the same time, Nandi got opportunity to seize Bhargava, attacked him from the chariot as a lion grips a tiny animal.

## \|\| 69.26 \|\|

*tamādāya harābhyāśamāgamagaṇanāyakaḥ \|*  
*nipātya rakṣiṇaḥ sarvānatha śukraṃ nyavedayat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Gananayaka approached to Sankara cleaning the way by killing demons and ultimately brought Sukracarya before him.

## \|\| 69.27 \|\|

*tamānītaṃ kaviṃ śarvaḥ prākṣipadvadane prabhuḥ \|*  
*bhārgavaṃ tvāvṛtatanuṃ jaṭhare sa nyaveśayat \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. God Sankara threw Sukra into his mouth and put him comfortably in his belly.

## \|\| 69.28 \|\|

*sa śaṃbhunā kaviśreṣṭho grasto jaṭharamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāva bhagavantaṃ taṃ munirvāgbhirathādarāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus gobbled within stomach by Sambhu, Sukracarya began to praise respectfully the glorious one while in the belly of god.

## \|\| 69.29 \|\|

*śukra uvāca- varadāya namastubhyaṃ harāya guṇaśāline \|*  
*śaṃkarāya maheśāya tryambakāya namo namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Sukra prayed- “Obeisance to Hara, the meritorious and bestower of boons. Frequent salute to Sankara, Mahesa, Tryambaka.”

## \|\| 69.30 \|\|

*jīvanāya namatastubhyaṃ lokanātha vṛṣākape \|*  
*madanāgne kālaśatro vāmadevāya te namaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О Lokanatha! О Vrsakapi! You are in the form of life. I salute you. О fire like god! О Kalasatru! Salute to you, О Vamadeva.

## \|\| 69.31 \|\|

*sthāṇave viśvarūpāya vāmanāya sadāgate \|*  
*mahādevāya śarvāya īśvarāya namo namaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Frequent salute to Sthanu, the universal form, Vamana, Sadagati, Mahadeva, Sarva and Isvara. Frequent salute to three-eyed, Hara, Sankara, husband of Uma, Jimutaketu, Guhagrha, Smasananirata, Bhutivilepana, Sulapani, Pasupati, Gopati, Tatpurusa.

## \|\| 69.32 \|\|

*itthaṃ stutaḥ kavivareṇa haro'tha bhaktyā prīto varaṃ varaya dadmi tavetyuvāca \|*  
*saṃ prāha devavara dehi varaṃ mamādya yadvai tavaiva jaṭharāt pratinirgamo'stu \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. When the great poet so prayed, Sankara said- "I am pleased with you. Ask everything desired, I will give you the same." He requested- "O god! Give me boon to come out from your stomach."

## \|\| 69.33 \|\|

*tato haro'kṣīṇi tadā nirudhya prāha dvijendrādya vinirgamasva \|*  
*ityuktamātro vibhunā cacāra devodare bhārgavapuṃgavastu \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Sankara then closed his eyes and said- "O great Dvija (Brahmana)! Now come out. Bhargava began to stroll in the belly of Mahadeva when god instructed with these words.

## \|\| 69.34 \|\|

*paribhraman dadarśātha śaṃbhorevodare kaviḥ \|*  
*bhuvanārṇavapātālān vṛtān sthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. While so strolling within the belly of Sankara, Sukracarya saw the earth, ocean and nether world covered by movable and immovable things.

## \|\| 69.35-38 \|\|

*ādityān vasavo rudrān viśvedevān gaṇāṃstathā \|*  
*yakṣānkiṃpuruṣādyādīn gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇān \|\| 35 \|\|*

*munīn manujasādhyāṃśca paśukīṭapipīlikān \|*  
*vṛkṣagulmān girīn vallyaḥ phalamūlauṣadhāni ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sthalasthāṃśca jalasthāṃścānimeṣānnimiṣānapi \|*  
*catuṣpadān sadvipādan sthāvarān jaṅgamānapi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*avyaktāṃścaiva vyaktāṃśca saguṇānnirguṇānapi \|*  
*sa dṛṣṭvā kautukāviṣṭaḥ paribabhrāma bhārgavaḥ \|*  
*tatrāsato bhārgavasya divyaḥ saṃvatsaro gataḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-38. Bhargava curiously began to walk there observing Adityas, Vasus, the host of Maruts, Visvedevas, Ganas, Yaksas, Kinnaras, Gandharvas, host of Apsarases, Sages, human beings, Sadhyas, animals, insects, ants, trees, creepers, mountains, buds, fruits, roots, plants, terrestrial, aquarium, Animisas, Sanimisas, quadrupeds, human beings (two leg creatures), immovable, movable, inexpressible, expressible (tangible and intangible), with qualities (Sagunas) and without qualities (Nirgunas). Having seen these things, possessed of curiosity, Sukra roamed here and there and one divine year passed with Sukra dwelling there.

## \|\| 69.39 \|\|

*na cāntmalabhad brahmastataḥ śrānto'bhavat kaviḥ \|*  
*sa śrāntaṃ vīkṣya cātmānaṃ nālabhannirgamaṃ vaśī \|*  
*bhaktinamro mahādevaṃ śaraṇanaṃ samupāgamat \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О Brahmins! Sukra could not find the end of the route and he tired badly there. When he found him unable to walk more and could not find the exit, nothing else he did but resorted to god Mahadeva.

## \|\| 69.40 \|\|

*śukra uvāca- viśvarūpa mahārūpa viśvarūpākṣasūtravṛk \|*  
*sahasrākṣa mahādeva tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Sukra said- О Visvarupa! О Maharupa! О Visvarupaksa! О Sutradhrk! О Sahastraksа! О Mahadevo! I have come to you for my refuge.

## \|\| 69.41 \|\|

*namo'stu te śaṃkara śarva śaṃbho sahasranetrāṅghribhujaṅgabhūṣaṇa \|*  
*dṛṣṭaiva sarvān bhuvanāṃstavodare śrānto bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О Sankara! О Sambhu! О Sarva! О Sahastranetranghra! О Bhujangabhusana! I have seen all lokas (worlds) in your belly and now I am badly exhausted. Hence, finally came to your shelter.

## \|\| 69.42 \|\|

*ityevamukte vattane mahātmā śaṃbhurvacaḥ prāha tadā vihasya \|*  
*nirgaccha putro'si mamādhunā tvaṃ śiśnena bho bhārgavavaṃśacandra \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The great soul Sambhu laughed on this and said- “You have now become my son. Hence, О descendant of Bhargava dynasty! Come out from my penis now.”

## \|\| 69.43 \|\|

*nāmnā tu śukreti carācarāstvāṃ stovyanti naivātra vicāramanyat \|*  
*ityevamuktvā bhagavān mumoca śiśnena śukraḥ sa ca nirjagāma \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The entire movable and immovable world will now pray you calling ‘Sukra’. There is no more scope for thinking otherwise. God Mahadeva then released Sukra from his penis route and he came out safely.

## \|\| 69.44 \|\|

*vinirgato bhārgavavaṃśacandraḥ śukratvamāpadya mahānubhāvaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śaṃbhuṃ sa jagāma tūrṇa mahāsurāṇāṃ balamuttamaujāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Released from the route of penis, thus, having obtained the acquaintance of semen gland, Sukra, the moon like descendant in Bhargava dynasty bowed his head before Sambhu and immediately joined the army of mighty demons.

## \|\| 69.45 \|\|

*bhārgave punarāyāte dānavā muditābhavan \|*  
*punaryuddhāya vidadyurmatiṃ saha gaṇeśvaraiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The demons pleased on safe return of Bhargava. They again determined to fight against Ganesvaras.

## \|\| 69.46 \|\|

*gaṇeśvarāstānasurān sahāmaragaṇairatha \|*  
*yuyudhuḥ saṃkulaṃ yuddhaṃ sarva eva jayepsavaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The Ganesvaras including all gods desirous of victory fought fiercely against those demons.

## \|\| 69.47 \|\|

*tato'suragaṇānāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca yudhyatām \|*  
*dvandvayuddhaṃ samabhavaddhorarūpaṃ tapodhana \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О austere! A fierce battle was then started between mighty demons and the gods.

## \|\| 69.48 \|\|

*andhako nandinaṃ yuddhe śaṅkukarṇaṃ tvayaḥ śirāḥ \|*  
*kumbhadhvajaṃ balirdhīmānnandiṣeṇaṃ virocanaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Andhaka began to fight against Nandi, Ayahsira against Sankukarna, wise Bali against Kumbhadhvaja and Virocana against Nandisena.

## \|\| 69.49 \|\|

*aśvagrīvo viśākhaṃ ca śākho vṛtramayodhayat \|*  
*bāṇastathā naigameyaṃ balaṃ rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Asvagriva fought against Visakha, Sakha against Vrtra, Bana, the foremost among the demons with Bala, the son of Nigama.

## \|\| 69.50 \|\|

*vināyako mahāvīryaḥ paraśvadhadharo raṇe \|*  
*saṃkruddho rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ tuhuṇḍaṃ samayodhayat \|*  
*duryodhanaśca balinaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇamayodhayat \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Vinayaka, the great valorous with an axe in hand began to fight against mighty demonchief Tuhunda and Duryodhana began fighting against the powerful Ghantakarna.

## \|\| 69.51 \|\|

*hastī ca kuṇḍajaṭharaṃ hlādo vīraṃ ghaṭodaram \|*  
*ete hi balināṃ śreṣṭhā dānavāḥ pramathāstathā \|*  
*saṃyodhayanti devarṣe divyābdānāṃ śatāni ṣaṭ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Hasti began fighting against Kundajathara and Hlada began fighting against Ghatodara. О divine hermit! All these mighty demons and Pramathas fought continuously till six hundred divine years were over.

## \|\| 69.52 \|\|

*śatakratumathāyāntaṃ vajrapāṇimabhisthitam \|*  
*vārayāmāsa balavān jambho nāma mahāsuraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The mighty and great demon Jambha, countered Indra who was forwarding with thunderbolt in his hand.

## \|\| 69.53 \|\|

*śaṃbhunāmā'surapatiḥ sa brahmāṇamayodhayat \|*  
*mahaujasaṃ kujambhaśca viṣṇuṃ daityāntakāriṇam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The demon king Sambhu began fighting against Brahma and Kujambha the mighty demon began fighting against Visnu, the destroyer of demons.

## \|\| 69.54 \|\|

*vivasvantaṃ raṇe śālvo varuṇaṃ triśirāstathā \|*  
*dvimūrdhā pavanaṃ somaṃ rāhurmitraṃ virūpadhṛk \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Salva began fighting against Yama, Trisira against Varuna, Dvimurdha against Pavana, Rahu against Soma and Virupadhrk against Mitra.

## \|\| 69.55-56 \|\|

*aṣṭau ye vasavaḥ khyātā dharādyāste mahāsurān \|*  
*aṣṭāveva maheṣvāsān vārayāmāsurāhave \|\| 55 \|\|*

*sarabhaḥ śalabhaḥ pākaḥ puro'tha vipṛthuḥ pṛthuḥ \|*  
*vātāpī celvalacaiva nānāśastrāstrayodhinaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. The eight Vasus renowned as Dhara etc. names coped with eight archers in demons' army. These were Sarabha, Salabha, Рака, Рurа, Viprthu, Prthu, Vatapi and Ilvala. Those demons began fighting with numerous type of arms and weapons.

## \|\| 69.57 \|\|

*viśvedevagaṇān sarvān vivvaksenapurogamān \|*  
*eka eva raṇe raudraḥ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. A dreadful demon Kalanemi began fighting lonely against Visvedeva Ganas with Visvaksena as their leader.

## \|\| 69.58 \|\|

*ekādaśaiva ye rudrāstāneko'pi raṇotkaṭaḥ \|*  
*yodhayāmāsa tejasvī vidyunmālī mahāsuraḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. A mighty demon Vidyunmall, furious in battle, faced lonely the eleven Rudras.

## \|\| 69.59 \|\|

*dvāvaśvinau ca narako bhāskarāneva śambaraḥ \|*  
*sādhyān marudgaṇāṃścaiva nivātakavacādayaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Naraka fought against bom Asvinikumaras, Sambara against Adityas and Nivata, Kavaca etc. fought against Sadhyas and Marudganas.

## \|\| 69.60 \|\|

*evaṃ dvandvasahasrāṇi pramathāmaradānavaiḥ \|*  
*ktāni ca surābdānāṃ daśatīḥ ṣaṭ mahāmune \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О great sage! Several thousand couples of Pramathas and demons thus, fought continuos war up to sixty divine years.

## \|\| 69.61 \|\|

*yadā na śakitā yoddhaṃ daivatairamarādayaḥ \|*  
*tadā bhāyāṃ samāśritya grasantaḥ kramaśo'vyayān \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. When demons failed in defeating the gods, they resorted to fallacy (tactics) and started grasping the gods under manipulations.

## \|\| 69.62 \|\|

*tato'bhavacchaila pṛṣṭhaṃ prāvṛḍabhrasamaprabhaiḥ \|*  
*āvṛtaṃ varjitaṃ sarvaiḥ pramathairamarairapi \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The mountain without Pramathas and gods then covered with the lustre of demons like the rainy clouds.

## \|\| 69.63 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ giriprasthaṃ grastāṃśca pramathāmarān \|*  
*krodhādutpādayāmāsa rudro jṛmbhāyikāṃ vaśī \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. When Rudra saw the mountain region void of Pramathas and gods badly gripped in by demons, he in vagary of anger, originated Jrmbhayika.

## \|\| 69.64 \|\|

*tayā spṛṣṭā nusutā alasā mandabhāṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*vadanaṃ vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā muktaśastraṃ vijṛmbhire \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. When Jrmbhayika touched the demons, they began to talk slowly, fell in laxity, curved their mouths and started yawning.

## \|\| 69.65 \|\|

*jumbhamāṇeṣu ca tadā dānaveṣu gaṇeśvarāḥ \|*  
*surākṣa niryayustūrṇaṃ daityadehebhya ākulāḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. When demons yawned, the Ganesvaras and gods immediately came out from their mouths and thus, became scot-free from the anxiety.

## \|\| 69.66 \|\|

*meghaprabhebhyo detyebhyo nirgacchanto'marottamāḥ \|*  
*śobhante padmapatrākṣā meghebhya iva vidyutaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The great lotus-eyed gods while coming out from the body of demons appeared like clouds, looked as brilliant as lightening coming out from the clouds.

## \|\| 69.67 \|\|

*gaṇāmareṣu ca samaṃ nirgataṣu tapodhana \|*  
*ayudhyanta mahātmāno bhūya evātikopitāḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О austere! The ganas and gods when so came out, the mighty demons filled with anger and started fighting.

## \|\| 69.68 \|\|

*tatastu devaiḥ sagaṇaiḥ dānavāḥ śarvapālitaiḥ \|*  
*parājīyanta saṃgrāme bhūyo bhūyastvaharniśam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The ganas and gods under lead of Sambhu then frequently gave bitter defeat to demons in battle, day and night.

## \|\| 69.69 \|\|

*tatrastrinetraḥ svāṃ saṃdhyāṃ saptābdaśatike gate \|*  
*kāle'bhyupāsata tadā so'ṣṭādaśabhujo'vyayaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. When a period of seven hundred years lapsed in such fighting incessantly, the three eyed, eighteen arms god Mahadeva began to observe his sandhya (meditation).

## \|\| 69.70 \|\|

*saṃspṛśyāpaḥ sarasvatyāṃ snātvā ca vidhinā haraḥ \|*  
*kṛtārtho bhaktimān mūrdhyā puṣpāñjalimupākṣipat \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. He took bath in Sarasvati river, touched the water and offered a handful of flowers with his head bowed in reverence.

## \|\| 69.71 \|\|

*tato nanāma śirasā tataścakre pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*hiraṇyagarbhetyādityamupatasye jajāpa ha \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Не then did salute by bowing his head, made Pradaksina and prayed as also did japa with Hiranyagarbha etc. hymns, the sun god.

## \|\| 69.72 \|\|

*tvaṣṭhe namo namaste'stu samyagucārya śūladhṛk \|*  
*nanarta bhāvagambhīraṃ dordaṇḍaṃ bhrāmayan balāt \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Sulapani then pronounciated duly the hymn- "Tvastre Namo Namaste stu", began whirling his arms with force and danced.

## \|\| 69.73 \|\|

*parinṛtyati deveśe gaṇācaivāmarāstathā \|*  
*nṛtyante bhāvasaṃyuktā harasyānuvilāsinaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. When Ganas and Gods saw Hara dancing, they also followed him. Thus, all began dancing.

## \|\| 69.74 \|\|

*saṃdhyāmupāsya deveśaḥ parinṛtya yathecchayā \|*  
*yuddhāya dānavaiḥ sārddha marti bhūyaḥ samādadhe \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. When sandhya and dancing was over, the god of gods decided again to fight against the demons.

## \|\| 69.75 \|\|

*tato'maragaṇaiḥ sarvaistrinetrabhujapālitaiḥ \|*  
*dānavā nirjitāḥ sarve balibhirbhayavarjitaiḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The mighty and fearless gods under defence of Sankara's arm, won all demons in war.

## \|\| 69.76 \|\|

*svabalaṃ nirjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā matvā'jecaṃ ca śaṃkaram \|*
