*andhakaḥ sundamāhūya idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. When Andhaka saw his army defeated badly and victory of Sankara, he called Sunda and said:

## \|\| 69.77 \|\|

*sundaḥ bhrātā'si me vīra viśvāsyaḥ sarvavastuṣu \|*  
*tadvadāmyadya yadvākyaṃ tacchrutvā yatkṣamaṃ kuru \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. О warrior Sunda! You are my brother and loyal to me in all matters. Hence, listen to carefully what I say and complete the same as early as you can.

## \|\| 69.78 \|\|

*durjayo'sau raṇapaṭurdharmātmā kāraṇāntaraiḥ \|*  
*samāsate hi hṛdaye padmākṣī śailanandinī \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. This pious-minded Siva is undefeatable because of expert in war-craft and strategy. The lotus-eyed Parvati has however, won my heart and I want to gain her at any cost.

## \|\| 69.79 \|\|

*taduttiṣṭhasva gacchāmo yatrāste cāruhāsinī \|*  
*tatraināṃ mohayisyāmi hararūpeṇa dānava \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Hence, be ready now. Let us go, where the lotus-eyed Parvati is living. “O demon! I will turn my complexion into Sankara's and thus, enchant her.”

## \|\| 69.80 \|\|

*bhavāndhavasyānucaro bhava nandī gaṇeśvaraḥ \|*  
*tato gatvā'tha bhuktyā tāṃ jeṣyāmi pramathānsurān \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. You should go with me in disguise of Nandi there. I will enjoy with her to the extent of my satiation and then conquer these -Pramathas and gods.

## \|\| 69.81 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane bāḍha sundo'bhyabhāṣata \|*  
*samajāyata śailādinnyakaḥ śaṃkaro'pyabhūt \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Sunda replied- “Very well, I am ready to serve you.” He immediately turned into Nandi's complexion and Andhaka became Siva.

## \|\| 69.82 \|\|

*nandirudrau tato bhūtvā mahāsuracamūpatī \|*  
*saṃprāptau mandaragiriṃ prahāraiḥ kṣatavigrahau \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The chivalrous Andhaka and his assistant Sunda in disguise of Siva and Nandi went then at the place where Parvati was. There were several wounds on their body due to battle.

## \|\| 69.83 \|\|

*hastamālambya sundasya andhako haramandiram \|*  
*viveśa nirviśaṅkena cittenāsurasattamaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Andhaka fearlessly entered the home of Siva holding the hand of Sunda.

## \|\| 69.84-85 \|\|

*tato girisutā dūrādāyāntaṃ vīkṣya cāndhakam \|*  
*maheśvaravapuśchannaṃ prahārairjarjaracchavim \|\| 84 \|\|*

*sundaṃ śailādirūpasthamavaṣṭabhyāviśattataḥ \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā mālinīṃ prāha suyayāṃ vijayāṃ jayām \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. When Parvati saw Siva coming with Nandi and there were several wounds on their bodies, she entered her home hurrily and ordered to illustrious Malini, Suyasa, Vijaya and Jaya:

## \|\| 69.86 \|\|

*jaye paśyasva devasya madarthe vigrahaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*śatrubhirdānavavaraistaduttiṣṭhasva satvaram \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. “O Jaya! Look at the body of my husband. How has his body formed with wounds. Hence, stand-up immediately.”

## \|\| 69.87 \|\|

*ghṛtamānaya paurāṇaṃ bījikāṃ lavaṇaṃ dadhi \|*  
*vraṇabhaṅga kariṣyāmi svayameva pinākinaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Bring immediately here the pre-stored ghee, bijika, salt and curd. I myself will soothe and dress the wounds of Sankara, the Pinaka holder.

## \|\| 69.88-90 \|\|

*kuruṣva śīghra suyaśe svabharturvaṇanāśanam \|*  
*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ samutthāya varāsanāt \|\| 88 \|\|*

*abhyudyayau tadā bhaktyā manyamānā vṛṣadhvajam \|*  
*śūlapāṇestataḥ sthitvā rūpaṃ cihnāni yatnataḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*anviyeṣa tato brahmannobhau pārśvasthitau vṛṣau \|*  
*sā jñātvā dānavaṃ raudraṃ māyācchāditavigraham \|\| 90 \|\|*

88-90. О Suyasa! “Dress the injuries of your master immediately.” Considering Andhaka as Siva, she then stood-up and approached to him. When she approached near and stressed on herself to scrutinise indepth the characteristics on complexion of Siva. О Brahmin! She saw that both the Vrsa signs existed in his collaterals were absent. Hence, she understood that he is actually a demon, clandestinely turned in Siva's complexion.

## \|\| 69.91-92 \|\|

*apayānaṃ tadā cakre girirājasutā mune \|*  
*devyāścintitamājñāya sundaṃ tyaktvārthako'suraḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*samādravata vegena harakāntāṃ vibhāvarīm \|*  
*samādravata daiteyo yena mārgeṇa sā'gamat \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. О sage! As soon as Parvati smelt manipulation of demon, she ran away from there. Andhaka too left behind Sunda and chased Parvati speedily.

## \|\| 69.93 \|\|

*apaskārāntaraṃ bhañjan pādaplutibhirākulaḥ \|*  
*tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭva girijā prādravadbhayād \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. He ran with anxiety crushing the rubbles and other hurdles on the way under his feet. Girija frightened badly when she saw that demon is forwarding to her.

## \|\| 69.94 \|\|

*gṛhaṃ tyaktvā hyapavanaṃ sakhibhiḥ sahitā tadā \|*  
*tatrāpyanujagāmāsau madānkho munipuṃgava \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. О great sage! The goddess then reached in a garden with her maids. Andhaka chased her there too.

## \|\| 69.95 \|\|

*tathāpi na śaśāpainaṃ tapaso gopanāya tu \|*  
*tadbhayādāviśadgaurī śvetārkakusumaṃ śuci \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. In spite of such contravention made by Andhaka, she still held control on her anger and finally entered the radiant Arka flower on account of fear.

## \|\| 69.96 \|\|

*vijayādyā mahāgulme saṃprayātā layaṃ mune \|*  
*naṣṭāyāmatha pārvatyāṃ bhūyo hairaṇyalocaniḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. О sage! Vijaya etc. too merged in the dense bushes. When Parvati had vanished, the son of Hiranyaksa, Andhaka returned to the battlefield with Sunda in a despair.

## \|\| 69.97-98 \|\|

*sundaṃ haste samādāya sva sainyaṃ punarāgamat \|*  
*andhake punarāyāte svabalaṃ munisattama \|\| 97 \|\|*

*prāvartata mahāyuddhaṃ pramathāsurayoratha \|*  
*tato'maragaṇaśreṣṭho viṣṇuścakragadādharaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. О great sage! The battle between Pramatha and gods thereafter took a fierce shape when Andhaka rejoined his army. In the meantime, there appeared god Visnu with discus and gada in his hands.

## \|\| 69.99-100 \|\|

*nijaghānāsurabalaṃ śaṃkarapriyakāmyayā \|*  
*śārṅgacāpacyutairvāṇaiḥ saṃsyūtā dānavarṣabhāḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*pañca ṣaṭ sapta cāṣṭau vā bradhnapādairghanā iva \|*  
*gadayā kāṃścidavayīt cakreṇānyān janārdanaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. Не began killing the demons with a desire to do good to Sankara. The arrows shot from Sarnga bow killed five, six, seven or eight demons simultaneously the same way as the sun beams shatter the clouds. Janardana (Visnu) killed a few among them by the blows of mace and some others by discus.

## \|\| 69.101 \|\|

*khaṅgena ca cakartānyān dṛṣṭyānyān bhasmasād vyadhāt \|*  
*halenākṛṣya caivānyān musalena vyacūrṇayat \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. He killed some demons by giving blows of sword, turned into ash some other by his sight and dragged some demons, he crushed with pestle.

## \|\| 69.102-103 \|\|

*garuḍaḥ pakṣapātābhyāṃ tuṇḍenāpyurasā'hanat \|*  
*sa cādipuruvo dhātā purāṇaḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

*bhrāmayanvipulaṃ padmamabhyaṣiñcata vāriṇā \|*  
*saṃspṛṣṭā brahmatoyena sarvatīrthamayena hi \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. Garuda killed countless demons by attack he made through wings, beak and the chest. Adipurusa (the first bom) Brahma revolved the great lotus round and sprinkled water on all of them. The ganas and gods each obtained energy equaled more that one hundred young elephants when that droplets touched their bodies.

## \|\| 69.104-105 \|\|

*gaṇāmaragaṇāścāsan navanāgaśatādhikāḥ \|*  
*dānavāstena toyena saṃspṛṣṭāścāghahāriṇā \|\| 104 \|\|*

*savāhanāḥ kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ kuliśeneva parvatāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā brahmaharī yuddhe yātayantau mahāsurān \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. On other side, these droplets began killing demons with their chariots (vahanas) as the mountains are destroyed when thunderbolt is befallen on them. When Indra saw Brahma and Visnu killing these chivalrous demons; he too rushed there with thunderbolt.

## \|\| 69.106-107 \|\|

*śatakratuśca dudrāva pragṛhya kuliśaṃ bali \|*  
*tamāpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya balo dānavasattamaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*muktvā devaṃ gadāpāṇiṃ vimānasthaṃ ca padmajam \|*  
*śakramevādravat yoddhaṃ muṣṭiyudyamya nārada \|*  
*balavān dānavapatirajeyo devadānavaiḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

106-107. О Narada! When the demon king Bala saw Indra's joining war, he left aside Brahma, sitting on the aircraft and Visnu with mace in his hand. He rushed towards Indra fiercely for an attack on him. Bala was a demon lord undefeated till then by all gods and demons.

## \|\| 69.108 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ tridaśeśvarastu doṣṇāṃ sahasreṇa yathābalena \|*  
*vrajaṃ paribhrāmya balasya mūrdhni cikṣepa he mūḍha hato'syudīrya \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. When Indra saw Bala forwarding, he gave a round turn to thunderbolt by using his thousand arms and threw it targeting his head with saying- "O stupid! You are now killed."

## \|\| 69.109 \|\|

*sa tasya mūrdhni pravaro'pi vajro jagāma tūrṇaṃ hi sahastradhā mune \|*  
*balo'dravaddevapatiśca bhītaḥ parāṅmukho'bhūtsumarānmaharṣe \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. О sage! That thunderbolt split into several thousand pieces when blown on his head. Bala then rushed towards Indra. О great hermit! The king of gods badly threatened and turned back from the battle.

## \|\| 69.110 \|\|

*taṃ cāpi jambho vimukhaṃ nirīkṣya bhūtvā'grataḥ prāha na yuktametat \|*  
*tiṣṭhasva rājā'si carācarasya na rājadharme gaditaṃ palāyanam \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. When Jambha saw Indra showing back to the battle, he came forward and said- "It is not good for you О Indra. You are the king of all movable and immovable worlds. Showing conduct slated for a king like yours.

## \|\| 69.111 \|\|

*sahasrākṣo jambhavākyaṃ niśamya bhītastūrṇa viṣṇumāgānmaharṣe \|*  
*upetyāha śrūyatāṃ vākyamīśa tvaṃ me nātho bhūtabhavyeśa viṣṇo \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. О great sage! Indra feared badly when Jambha scorned so bitterly. He approached to Visnu and said- "O god! Listen to me. О governor of past and future! You are my only master."

## \|\| 69.112 \|\|

*jambhastarjayate'tyarthaṃ māṃ nirāyudhamīkṣya hi \|*  
*āyudhaṃ dehi bhagavan tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Seeing me without weapons, Jambha is challenging me with taunts. О god! Please, give weapons to me to carry on fighting. I have come in your shelter.

## \|\| 69.113 \|\|

*tamuvāca hariḥ śakraṃ tyaktvā darpa vrajādhunāḥ prārthayasvāyudhaṃ vahni sa te dāsyatyasaṃśayam \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Visnu said to Indra- "Go to the fire god and pray him for any weapon. I think, fire god will accede to your humble request and provide you with suitable weapons.

## \|\| 69.114 \|\|

*janārdanavacaḥ śrutvā śakrastvaritavikramaḥ \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ pāvakamagādidaṃ covāca nārada \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. О Narada! Indra complied with Visnu’s suggestion immediately. He reached to fire god and requested-

## \|\| 69.115 \|\|

*śakra uvāca- nighnato me balaṃ vajraṃ kṛśāno śatayā gatam \|*  
*eṣa cāhūyate jambhastasmādde hyāyudhaṃ mama \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. Indra said- "O Agni! My thunderbolt has split into several hundred pieces when I was killing Bala. Now, Jambha is challenging me. Hence, please, provide me with any suitable weapon."

## \|\| 69.116 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tamāha bhagavānvahniḥ prīto'smi tava vāsava \|*  
*yattvaṃ darpa parītyajya māmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Pulastya said- “Agni (God fire) replied- О Vesava (Indra)! I am pleased on you, because you have come here setting aside the feeling of superiority.”

## \|\| 69.117 \|\|

*ityucārya svaśaktyāstu śaktiṃ niṣkāmya bhāvataḥ \|*  
*prādādindrāya bhagavānocamāno divaṃ gataḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. The ever luminary god fire made appear another Sakti-weapon from his sakti and gave it to Indra and went to heaven.

## \|\| 69.118 \|\|

*tāmādāya tadā śaktiṃ śataghaṇṭāṃ sudāruṇām \|*  
*pratyudyayau tadā jambhaṃ hantukāmo'rimardanaḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. Indra, the suppresser of enemy then returned to battle-field for killing Jambha with £akti he so received from fire god. It was fierce with one hundred bells.

## \|\| 69.119 \|\|

*tayātiyaśasā daityaḥ sahasaivābhisaṃdṛtaḥ \|*  
*krodhaṃ cakre tadā jambho nijaghāna gajādhipam \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. When Indra suddenly chased Jambha, he furiously hit hard on his Airavata.

## \|\| 69.120 \|\|

*jambhamuṣṭinipātena bhagnakumbhakaṭo gajaḥ \|*  
*nipapāta yathā śailaḥ śakravajrahataḥ purā \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. The elephant lost its forehead region due to severe blow of fist and it fell on ground as the mountains earlier were fell when thunderbolt thrown by Indra.

## \|\| 69.121 \|\|

*patamānād dvipendrāttu śakraśca \|*  
*plutya vegavān \|*  
*tyaktvaiva mandaragiriṃ papāta vasudhātale \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Indra immediately jumped from falling elephant, escaped from Mandara mountain and began falling straight way on the ground.

## \|\| 69.122 \|\|

*patamānaṃ hari siddhacāraṇāśca tadā'bruvan \|*  
*mā mā śakra patasvādya bhūtale tiṣṭha vāsava \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. When he was so falling, the Siddhas and Caranas said- "O Indra! Don't fall on the earth! Stop please."

## \|\| 69.123 \|\|

*sa teṣāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā yogī tasthau kṣaṇaṃ tadā \|*  
*prāha caitān kathaṃ yotsye apaḥ śatrubhiḥ saha \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. Yogi Indra made balance for a second and said- "How will I fight these enemies without carrier (vahana)?"

## \|\| 69.124 \|\|

*tamūcurdevagandharvā mā viṣādaṃ vrajeśvara \|*  
*yudhyasva tvaṃ samāruhya preṣayiṣyāma yad ratham \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. The gods and gandharvas replied- О god! Don’t be grievous. We are sending a chariot for yours continuing the war. Please, accept it and carry on fighting.

## \|\| 69.125-126 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vipulaṃ rathaṃ svastikalakṣaṇam \|*  
*vānaradhvajasaṃyuktaṃ haribhirharribhiryutam \|\| 125 \|\|*

*śuddhajāmbūnadamayaṃ kiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitam \|*  
*śakrāya preṣayāmāsurviśvāvasupurogamāḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

125-126. Visvavasu etc. then sent a grand chariot for Indra. Its shape was that of Svastika (an auspicious mark), Hanuman on its flag, green colour horses were yoked with it. It was made up of pure gold and tingeing bells were fixed.

## \|\| 69.127 \|\|

*tamāgatamudīkṣyātha hīnaḥ sārathinā hariḥ \|*  
*prāha yotsye kathaṃ yuddhe saṃyamiṣye kathaṃ hayān \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. When Indra saw that chariot without charioteer he said- "How will I do both functions simultaneously i.e. controlling the horse and fighting.

## \|\| 69.128 \|\|

*yadi kaścica sārathyaṃ kariṣyati mamādhunā \|*  
*tato'haṃ ghātaye śatrūnnānyatheti kathaṃcana \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. In case, someone acts as charioteer to me, I can destroy the enemies and can do nothing without it.

## \|\| 69.129 \|\|

*tato'nuvaṃste gandharvā nāsmākaṃ sārathivibho \|*  
*vidyate svayamevāśvāṃstvaṃ saṃyantumihārhasi \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Gandharva then replied- О king! We have no charioteer this time. You yourself can control the horses.

## \|\| 69.130 \|\|

*ityevamukte bhagavāṃstyaktvā syandanamuttamam \|*  
*kṣmātalaṃ nipapātaiva paribhraṣṭasragambaraḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. These words having been said, Lord Indra then left the most excellent chariot and fell down on the ground with a big thud. His garlands and garments both scattered.

## \|\| 69.131 \|\|

*calanmaulirmuktakacaṃ paribhraṣṭāyudhāṅgadaḥ \|*  
*patamānaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūḥ samakampata \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. (Indra while falling from the mountain to ground), His crown was unsteady, hair of the head scattered and his weapons as also bracelet fell down on ground. The earth began shivering when it saw the fall of Indra.

## \|\| 69.132 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ kampamānāyāṃ śamīkarṣestapasvinī \|*  
*bhāryā'bravīt prabho bālaṃ bahiḥ kuru yathāsukham \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. When the wife of hermit Samika felt the earth shivering, she said- "Dear husband! Take this baby conformably out from the hermitage."

## \|\| 69.133-134 \|\|

*sa tu śīlāvacaḥ śrutvā kimarthamiti cābravīt \|*  
*sā cāha śrūyatāṃ nātha daivajñaparibhāṣitam \|\| 133 \|\|*

*yadeyaṃ kampate bhūmistadā prakṣipyate bahiḥ \|*  
*yadvāhyato muniśreṣṭha tadbhavedviguṇaṃ mune \|\| 134 \|\|*

133-134. Hearing the words of Sila, He told- But why? She replied- О husband! Please, listen. The astrologers say that the things should be taken out from the home as things existed outside become twofold (viz. Increase just double).

## \|\| 69.135 \|\|

*etadvākyaṃ tadā śrutvā bālamādāya putrakam \|*  
*nirāśaṅko bahiḥśīghra prākṣipat kṣmātale dvijaḥ \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. Then, hearing these words, the Brahmin took his son immediately out and put him on the ground.

## \|\| 69.136 \|\|

*bhūyo goyugalārthāya praviṣṭo bhāryayā dvijaḥ \|*  
*nivārito gatā velā arddhahānirbhaviṣyati \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. When he was again entering into cowshed to take two cows out her wife forbaded and said that earthquake is now over and the things taken out this moment will reduce to just half.

## \|\| 69.137 \|\|

*ityevamukte devarṣirbahirnirgamya vegavān \|*  
*dadarśa bāladvitayaṃ samarūpamavasthitam \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. This being said, О hermit! Brahmin then came out of the house and saw that two babies of analogous form are lying there.

## \|\| 69.138 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ pūjya bhāryāṃ cādbhutadarśanām \|*  
*prāha tattvaṃ na vindāmi yat pṛcchāmi vadasva tat \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. He then came in, worshipped god and then said to his genius wife- "I don't know the mystery lying with this. Hence, please give answer to my queries."

## \|\| 69.139 \|\|

*bālasyāsya dvitīyasya ke bhaviṣyad guṇā vada \|*  
*bhāgyāni cāsya yacoktaṃ karma tat kathayādhunā \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. First tell me that what qualities the other baby will acquire? Tell further, their luck as also the activities they will perform in their life.

## \|\| 69.140 \|\|

*sā'bravīnnādya te vakṣye vadiṣyāmi punaḥ prabho \|*  
*so'bravīd vada me'caiva nocennāśnāmi bhojanam \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. His wife replied- О dear husband! I will not reply you today on these matters wait for another time, please. He stressed on her and said that he will abandon food if it is not explained today.

## \|\| 69.141 \|\|

*sā prāha śrūyatāṃ brahman vadiṣye vacanaṃ hitam \|*  
*kātareṇādya yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhāvyaṃ kārurayaṃ kila \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. She replied- О Brahmin! Listen to the facts, I am now going to disclose. As you are hurry to answer, this baby shall definitely be a craftsman (Silpi).

## \|\| 69.142 \|\|

*ityuktvati vākye tu bāla eva tvacetanaḥ \|*  
*jagāma sāhāṃ śakrasya kartuṃ sautyaviśāradaḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. The baby was just innocent that time yet he stood-up and went to assist Indra to drive his chariot will expertise.

## \|\| 69.143 \|\|

*taṃ vrajantaṃ hi gandharvā viśvāvasupurogamāḥ \|*  
*jñātvendrasyaiva sāhāyye tejasā samavarvayan \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. Visvavasu and other Gandharvas blessed that infant with enormous energy when he was on his way to see Indra.

## \|\| 69.144 \|\|

*gandharvatejasā yuktaḥ śiśuḥ śakraṃ sametya hi \|*  
*projācaiohi deveśa priyo yantā bhavāmi te \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. The infant energised with blessing of Gandharvas approached to Indra and said- "O king of god! Come, please. I offer my services as an expert charioteer to you.”

## \|\| 69.145 \|\|

*tacchrutvāsya hariḥ prāha kasya putro'si bālaka \|*  
*saṃyantā'si kathaṃ cāśvān saṃśayaḥ pratibhāti me \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. Indra enquired- О baby! Tell me that who is your father? How will you bridle the horses? I am doubtful in this matter.

## \|\| 69.146 \|\|

*so'bravīdṛṣitejotthaṃ kṣmābhavaṃ viddhi vāsava \|*  
*gandharvatejasā yuktaṃ vājiyānaviśāradam \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. He replied- О Vasava! Consider me promoted by the semen of hermit, bom from land and equipped with splendour of Gandharvas. I am expert in handling the chariot.

## \|\| 69.147 \|\|

*tacchrutvā bhagavāñchakraḥ khaṃ bheje yogināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*sa cāpi vitratanayo mātalirnāmaviśrutaḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. God Indra when satisfied, went to the ether and that Brahmin's on renowned later-on as Matali too followed him.

## \|\| 69.148 \|\|

*tato'dhirūḍhastu rathaṃ śaṛstridaśapuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*raśmīn śamīkatanayo mātaliḥ pragṛhītavān \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Indra then rode on chariot and Matali; the son of sage Samlka held the bridle.

## \|\| 69.149-150 \|\|

*tato mandaramāgamya viveśa ripuvāhinīm \|*  
*praviśya dadṛśe śrīmān patitaṃ kārmukaṃ mahat \|\| 149 \|\|*

*saśaraṃ pañcavarṇābhaṃ sitaraktāsitāruṇam \|*  
*pāṇḍucchāyaṃ suraśreṣṭhastaṃ jagrāha samārgaṇam \|\| 150 \|\|*

149-150. They then marched towards to battle-field at Mandara mountain. When they were entering, Indra saw a bow having painted with five colours i.e. white, red, dark, pink and yellow, with an arrow. He picked up it.

## \|\| 69.151 \|\|

*tatastu manasā devān rajaḥ sattvatamomayān \|*  
*namaskṛtya śaraṃ cāpe sādhijye viniyojayat \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. He then summoned Brahma, Visnu and Siva in mind, bowed his head, gave tension to the string and put an arrow on bow.

## \|\| 69.152 \|\|

*tato niśceruratyugrāṃ śarā barhiṇavāsasaḥ \|*  
*brahmeśaviṣṇunāmāṅkā sūdayanto'surān raṇe \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. Several arrows came out from that single arrow with names of Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara inscribed on them and the demons could not bear the blows so hard.

## \|\| 69.153 \|\|

*ākāśaṃ vidiśaḥ pṛthvīṃ diśaśca sa śarotkaraiḥ \|*  
*sahasrākṣo'tipadubhiśchādayāmāsa nārada \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. О Narada! That thousand eyed god shot a volley of arrows aptly and covered the sky, the earth, directions and the sub-directions with them.

## \|\| 69.154 \|\|

*gajo viddho hayo bhinnaḥ pṛthivyāṃ patito rathaḥ \|*  
*mahāmātro dharāṃ prāptaḥ sadyaḥ sīdañcharāturaḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. The elephants penetrated, horses slaughtered, chariots fell on ground and the elephant drivers fell down dead with cries.

## \|\| 69.155 \|\|

*padātiḥ patito bhūmau śakramārgaṇatāḍitaḥ \|*  
*hatapradhānabhūyiṣṭhaṃ balaṃ tadabhavad ripo \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. The infantry killed badly on account of injury caused by the arrows shot by Indra. About a major part of prominent commanders in demons army thus, finished.

## \|\| 69.156 \|\|

*taṃ śakrabāṇābhihataṃ durāsadaṃ sainyaṃ samālakṣya tadā kujambhaḥ \|*  
*jambhāsuycāpi sureśamavyayaṃ prajagmaturguhya gade sughore \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. When the demon Kujambha and Jambha saw that victorious army killed by Indra's arrows, they rushed towards him with mace in their hands.

## \|\| 69.157 \|\|

*tāvāpatantau bhagavān nirīkṣya sudarśanenārivināśanena \|*  
*viṣṇuḥ kujambhaṃ nijaghāna vegāt sa svandanād gāmagamad gatāsuḥ \|\| 157 \|\|*

157\. God Visnu, the destroyer of the enemies, seeing these two demons coming, struck hard Kujambha with his Sudarsana-cakra. He fell down on the earth from the chariot and was dead on the ground.

## \|\| 69.158 \|\|

*tasminhate bhrātari mādhavena jambhastataḥ krodhavaśaṃ jagāma \|*  
*krodhānvitaḥ śakramupādravad raṇe siṃhaṃ yathaiṇo'tivipannabuddhiḥ \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. When Kujambha was so killed by Medhava (Visnu), Jambha filled with anger. He rushed towards Indra in sheer anger the same way as the stag in stable of puzzle runs towards lion.

## \|\| 69.159 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ prasamīkṣya śakra- styaktvaiva cāpaṃ saśaraṃ mahātma \|*  
*jagrāha śaktiṃ yamadaṇḍakalpāṃ tāmagnidattāṃ ripave sasarja \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. When Indra saw him forwarding swiftly, he left aside the bow and arrow and threw the sakti like Yama's danda given by fire god on him.

## \|\| 69.160 \|\|

*śaktiṃ saghaṇṭāṃ kṛtaniḥsvanāṃ vai dṛṣṭvā patantīṃ gadayā jayāna \|*  
*gadāṃ ca kṛtvā sahasaiva bhasmasād bibheda jambhaṃ hṛdaye ca tūrṇam \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. When Jambha saw the sakti with bells forwarding, he hit it by his mace that sakti set mace in fire and penetrated the heart of Jambha within seconds.

## \|\| 69.161 \|\|

*śaktyā sa bhinno hṛdaye surāriḥ papāta bhūmyāṃ vigatāsureva \|*  
*taṃ vīkṣya bhūmau patitaṃ visaṃjña daityāstu bhītā vimukhā babhūvuḥ \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. That god's enemy fell down dead when his heart was so pierced. When demons saw him dead, they terrified and set back to the battlefield.

## \|\| 69.162 \|\|

*jambhe hate daityabale ca bhagne gaṇāstu hṛṣṭā harimarcayantaḥ \|*  
*vīryaṃ praśaṃsanti śatakratośca sa gotrabhiccharvamupetya tasthau \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. When Jambha was killed and demons army so scattered, all ganas appreciated the valour exhibited by Indra and worshipped Hari. Indra went to Sartkara and stood up there.

## Chapter 70. Defeat of Andhaka and eulogy of Siva by Andhaka

## \|\| 70.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tasmiṃstadā daityabale ca bhagne śukro'bravīdandhakamāsurendram \|*  
*ehyehi vīrādya gṛhaṃ mahāsurā yotsyāma bhūyo harametya śailam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- When the army of demons so scattered, Sukra said to Andhaka- О chivalrous demon! Return to home this time, we will come again on this mountain and fight against Sankara.

## \|\| 70.2 \|\|

*tamuvācānyako brahman na samyagbhavatoditam \|*  
*raṇānnaivāpayāsyāmi kulaṃ vyapadiśan svayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Andhaka said to him- О Brahmin! You have not said outright. I shall not bring scar to my family by showing back to the battle-field.

## \|\| 70.3 \|\|

*paśya tvaṃ dvijaśārdūla mama vīryaṃ sudurdharam \|*  
*devadānavagandharvān jeṣye sendramaheśvarān \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О great Dvija! See please, my prominent valour. I will conquer and subjugate all gods, demons and gandharvas including Indra and Mahesvara.

## \|\| 70.4 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ hiraṇyākṣasuto'ndhakaḥ \|*  
*samāśvāsyābravācchaṃbhuṃ sārathiṃ madhurākṣaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. With these words Andhaka, the son of Hiranyaksa, inspired in sweet voice, his charioteer Sambhu and said-

## \|\| 70.5 \|\|

*sārathe vāhaya rathaṃ harābhyāśaṃ mahābala \|*  
*yāvannihanmi bāṇaudhaiḥ pramathāparavāhinīm \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. "О mighty charioteer! Bring forward any chariot just before Mahadeva. I will kill the army of Pramathas and gods by shorting with volley of arrows.

## \|\| 70.6 \|\|

*ityandhakavacaḥ śrutvā sārathisturagāṃstadā \|*  
*kṛṣṇavarṇān mahāvegān kaśayā'bhyāhananmune \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О sage! When charioteer was so ordered by Andhaka, he lashed very powerful the dark coloured horses with whip.

## \|\| 70.7 \|\|

*te yatnato'pi turagāḥ preryamāṇā haraṃ prati \|*  
*jayaneṣvavasīdantaḥ kṛcchreṇohuśca taṃ ratham \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The horses so forwarded to Sankara were feeling pain in legs and anyhow were pulling that chariot.

## \|\| 70.8 \|\|

*vahantasturagā daityaṃ prāptāḥ pramathavāhinīm \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa sāgreṇa vāyuvegasamā api \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In spite of being fastest as air in speed, the horses carrying that demon could reach at Mandara after a period of year.

## \|\| 70.9 \|\|

*tataḥ kārmukamānasya bāṇajālaurgaṇaśvarān \|*  
*surān saṃchādayāmās sendropendramaheśvarān \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Andhaka there gave bend to his bow and covered all gods including, Ganesvara, Indra, Upendra (Visnu) and Mahesvara with a volley of arrows.

## \|\| 70.10 \|\|

*bāṇaiśchādittamīkṣyaiva balaṃ trailokyarakṣita \|*  
*surān provāca bhagavāṃścakrapāṇirjanārdanaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. When Janardana, the holder of discus and defender of three-worlds saw the army covered by arrows, he said to gods.

## \|\| 70.11 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca- kiṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ suraśreṣṭhā hatenānena vai jayaḥ \|*  
*tasmānmadvacanaṃ śīghra kriyatāṃ vai jayepsavaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Visnu said- О gods! Why have you so seated? Victory in its real meaning can be gained only when this demon is killed. Hence, you all gods act as I suggest for obtaining that victory.

## \|\| 70.12 \|\|

*śāsyantāmasya turagāḥ samaṃ rathakuṭumbinā \|*  
*bhajyatāṃ syandanśvāpi virathaḥ kriyatāṃ ripuḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Kill his horses with the charioteers and make the enemy without chariot by splitting the chariot.

## \|\| 70.13 \|\|

*virathaṃ tu kṛtaṃ paścādenaṃ dhakṣyati śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*nopekṣyaḥ śatruruddiṣṭo devācāryeṇa devatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Sankara will set him on fire after he losses his chariot and charioteer. О gods! Jupiter, the preceptor of gods has truly said that one should not neglect his enemy.

## \|\| 70.14 \|\|

*ityevamuktāḥ pramathā vāsudevena sāmarāḥ \|*  
*cakrurvegaṃ sahendreṇa samaṃ cakradhareṇa ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. When Vasudeva so instructed, all Pramathas and gods including Indra and Visnu attacked fiercely.

## \|\| 70.15 \|\|

*turagāṇāṃ sahasraṃ tu meghābhānāṃ janārdanaḥ \|*  
*nimiṣāntaramātreṇa gadayā vinipothayat \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Janardana killed one thousand horses having cloud like complexion by blowing mace within seconds.

## \|\| 70.16 \|\|

*hatāśvāt syandanāt skandaḥ pragṛhya rathasārathim \|*  
*śaktyā vibhinna hṛdayaṃ gatāsuṃ vyasṛjadbhuvi \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Skanda pulled the chariot so broken will all horses killed out and pierced his heart by hitting sakti. When he found dead, the corpso was thrown on the ground.

## \|\| 70.17 \|\|

*vināyakādyāḥ pramathāḥ samaṃ śakreṇa daivataiḥ \|*  
*sadhvajākṣaṃ rathaṃ tūrṇamabhañjata tapodhanāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Austerious Vinayaka et. In company of Indra etc. gods broke into pieces shortly the chariot with flag and the axis.

## \|\| 70.18 \|\|

*sahasā sa mahātejā virathastyajya kārmukam \|*  
*gadāmādāya balavānabhidudrāva daivatān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The mighty Andhaka kept aside his bow when he lost his chariot and rushed towards gods with mace in his hand.

## \|\| 70.19 \|\|

*padānyaṣṭau tato gatvā meghagambhīrayā girā \|*  
*sthitvā provāca daityendro mahādevaṃ sa hetumat \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He walked eight steps, stopped then and said Mahadeva in sensuous voice his motive.

## \|\| 70.20 \|\|

*bhikṣo bhavān sahānīkastvasahāyo'smi sāmpratam \|*  
*tathāpi tvāṃ vijeṣyāmi paśya me'dya parākramam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О beggar! You have an army this time and I am lonely and helpless yet I will conquer you. See my valour today.

## \|\| 70.21 \|\|

*tadvākyaṃ śaṃkaraḥ śrutvā sendrāsuragaṇāṃstadā \|*  
*brahmaṇā sahitān sarvān svaśarīre nyaveśayat \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Sankara merged all gods including Indra and Brahma within him when he heard the statement of Andhaka.

## \|\| 70.22 \|\|

*śarīrasthāṃstān pramathān kṛtvā devāṃśca śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*prāha ehohi duṣṭātman ahameko'pi saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. When Sankara kept all gods within his belly, he said- "O ciked! Come now because I also lonely stood here.

## \|\| 70.23 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ sarvāmaragaṇakṣayam \|*  
*daityaḥ śaṃkaramabhyāgādgadāmādāya vegavān \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. That demon saw amazingly that merger of gods yet he picked up mace in his hand and went to Sankara within second.

## \|\| 70.24 \|\|

*tamāpatantaṃ bhagavāndṛṣṭvā tyaktvā vṛṣottamam \|*  
*śūlapāṇirgiriprasthe padātiḥ pratyatiṣṭhata \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. When Sulapani saw him approaching fast, he left the mountain and stood on feet at the mountain.

## \|\| 70.25 \|\|

*vegenaivāpatantaṃ ca bibhedorasi bhairavaḥ \|*  
*dāruṇaṃ sumahad rūpaṃ kṛtvā trailokyabhīṣaṇaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Bhairava made a fierce form of his body and pierced the heart of Andhaka so approaching.

## \|\| 70.26 \|\|

*daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ ravikoṭisaṃnibhaṃ mṛgāricarmābhivṛtaṃ jaṭādharam \|*  
*bhujaṅgahārāmalakaṇṭhakandaraṃ viṃśārthabāhuṃ saṣaḍarghalocanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. (That form of Sankara) was with fierce jaws, glowing with the light of one crore suns, covered by the hide of tiger, it had matted hair, its neck was decorated by snake garland, it had ten arms and three eyes.

## \|\| 70.27 \|\|

*etādṛśena rūpeṇa bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*vibheda śatru śūlena śubhadaḥ śāśvataḥ śivaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Siva in such fierce form penetrated the heart of enemy by blowing Sula on his heart. Sankara, the god is all benevolent, immortal, loved by all creatures.

## \|\| 70.28 \|\|

*saśūlaṃ bhairavaṃ gṛhya bhinne'pyurasi dānavaḥ \|*  
*vijahārātivegena krośamātraṃ mahāmune \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О great sage! In spite of so penetrated his heart, that demon gripped Bhairava with Sula and pulled him to a distance of one kosa.

## \|\| 70.29 \|\|

*tataḥ kathaṃcidbhagavān saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā \|*  
*tūrṇamutpāṭayāmāsa śūlena sagadaṃ ripum \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Then the god stopped him from so pulling through stronger check on mind, gave a sharp blow by Sula on the enemy with mace.

## \|\| 70.30 \|\|

*daityādhipastvapi gadāṃ haramūrdhni nyapātayat \|*  
*karābhyāṃ gṛhya śūlaṃ ca samutpatata dānavaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The demon king also hit hard on the forehead of Sankara by his mace and he sprang upside with Sula gripped in hand.

## \|\| 70.31 \|\|

*saṃsthitaḥ sa mahāyogī sarvādhāraḥ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*gadāpātakṣatādbhūri caturdhā' sṛgathāpatat \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. That Mahayogi being basis of all creatures remain undeviated and in standing posture but the blood streams abundantly began flowing in four number from his forehead due to severe blow of mace.

## \|\| 70.32 \|\|

*pūrvadhārāsamudbhūto bhairavo'gnisamaprabhaḥ \|*  
*vidyārājeti vikhyātaḥ padmamālāvibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The blood stream facing east gave birth to Bhairava known as Vidyaraja. His complexion was like glowing fire and a lotus garland was around his neck.

## \|\| 70.33 \|\|

*tathā dakṣiṇadhārotyo bhairavaḥ pretamaṇḍitaḥ \|*  
*kālarājeti vikhyātaḥ kṛṣṇāñjanasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The south facing stream gave birth to a Bhairava known as Kalaraja. He was of Krsnanjana glowing with preta like complexion.

## \|\| 70.34 \|\|

*atha pratīcīdhārotyo bhairavaḥ patrabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*atasīkusumaprakhyaḥ kāmarājeti viśrutaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The renowned Bhairava Karaja was originated from the blood stream facing crest direction. He was decorated by the leaves like Atasipuspa.

## \|\| 70.35 \|\|

*udagdhārābhavaścānyo bhairavaḥ śūlabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*somarājeti vikhyātaścakramālāvibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. From the blood stream facing north, the Bhairava called Somaraja with Sula, discus in hand, garland in neck was originated.

## \|\| 70.36 \|\|

*kṣatasya rudhirāt jāto bhairavaḥ śūlabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*svacchandarājo vikhyātaḥ indrāyudhasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The blood from the injury gave birth to renowned Bhairava called Svaccandaraja.

## \|\| 70.37 \|\|

*bhūmisvād rudhirājjāto bhairavaḥ śūlabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*khyāto lalitarājeti saubhāñjanasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. From the blood fell on earth, Lalitaraja Bhairava was originated. His complexion was like Srubhahjana and Sula in his hand.

## \|\| 70.38 \|\|

*evaṃ hi saptarūpo'sau kathyate bhairavo mune \|*  
*vighnarājo'ṣṭamaḥ prokto bhairavāṣṭakamucyate \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О sage! Thus seven Bhairavas were originated from the wound made by Andhaka on the head of Sankara. The eighth Bhairava is called Vighnaraja. Thus, there are eight Bhairavas in all.

## \|\| 70.39 \|\|

*evaṃ mahātmanā daityaḥ śūlaproto mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*chatravad dhārito brahman bhairaveṇa triśūlinā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О Brahman! The great soul Trisull thus, held the Sula stabbed demon like an umbrella.

## \|\| 70.40 \|\|

*tasvāsṛgulvaṇaṃ brahmañchūlabhedādavāpatat \|*  
*yenākaṇṭhaṃ mahādevo nimagnaḥ saptamūrtimān \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Brahmin! Excessive blood was poured from that demon due to deep wound so given by Sula. Mahadeva in seven forms that time was soaked fully with that blood.

## \|\| 70.41 \|\|

*tataḥ svedo'bhavadbhūri śramajaḥ śaṃkarasya tu \|*  
*lalāṭaphalake tasmājjātā kanyā'sṛgāplutā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On account of excessive labour so made, perspiration caused on the forehead of Sankara. It gave birth to a virgin fully soaked in blood.

## \|\| 70.42 \|\|

*yadbhūmyāṃ nyapatadvipra svedabinduḥ śivānanāt \|*  
*tasmādaṅgārapuñjābho bālakaḥ samajāyata \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О Brahmin! The sweat drops fallen from the face of Sankara on ground originated a child with complexion of fire (viz. Yellow).

## \|\| 70.43 \|\|

*sa bālastṛdhito'tyarthaṃ papau rudhiramāndhakam \|*  
*kanyā cotkṛtya saṃjātamasṛgvililihe'dbhutam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. That thirsty baby began sipping the blood of Andhaka and that excellent girl too stood- up and began licking the blood so oozing.

## \|\| 70.44 \|\|

*tatastāmāha bālārkaprabhāṃ bhairavamūrtimān \|*  
*śaṅkaro varado loke śreyo'rthāya vaco mahat \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Sankara, in the form of Bhairava that live, said to that virgin having complexion as that of sun with blessing voice.

## \|\| 70.45 \|\|

*tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti surā ṛṣayaḥ pitaroragāḥ \|*  
*yakṣavidyādharāścaiva mānāvaśca śubhaṃkari \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О benevolent girl! The gods, hermits, pitara, snakes, yaksa, vidyadhara and human beings all will pray you.

## \|\| 70.46 \|\|

*tvāṃ stoṣyanti sadā devi balipuṣpotkaraiḥ karaiḥ \|*  
*carciketi śubhaṃ nāma yasmād rudhiracarcitā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О goddess! Those people will pray you by giving sacrifice (Bali) and palmful flowers. You are soaked with the blood this way, the devotees will address you as Carcika.

## \|\| 70.47 \|\|

*ityevamuktā varadena carcikā bhūtānuyātā haricarmavāsinī \|*  
*mahīṃ samantādvicacāra sundarī sthānaṃ gatā haiḍgulatādrimuttamam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. That beautiful Carcika with tiger hide as garment and bom from the blood of Andhaka strolled around the earth and reached at the best mountain Haingulata for residing.

## \|\| 70.48 \|\|

*tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ varadaḥ kujasya prādādvaraṃ sarvavarottamaṃ yat \|*  
*grahādhipatyaṃ jagataḥ śubhāśubhaṃ bhaviṣyate tvadvaśagaṃ mahātman \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Sankara after her departure, gave Kuja (Mars) his desired. (He said) О great soul! You will become the king of stars and good and bad of this world will depend on your pleasure or anger.

## \|\| 70.49-51 \|\|

*haro'ndhakaṃ varṣasahastramātraṃ divyaṃ svanetrārkahutāśanena \|*  
*cakāra saṃśuṣkatanuṃ tvaśoṇitaṃ tvagasthiśevaṃ bhagavānsa bhairavaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tatrāgninā netrabhavena śuddha sa muktapāpo'surarāṅ babhūva \|*  
*tataḥ prajānāṃ bahurūpamīśaṃ nāthaṃ hi sarvasya carācarasya \|\| 50 \|\|*

*jñātvā'tha sarveśvaramīśamavyayaṃ trailokyanāthaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyam \|*  
*sarvaiḥ surādyairnatamīḍyamādyaṃ tato'ndhakaḥ stotramidaṃ cakāra \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. Those Bhairava Hara dried up the body of Andhaka for one thousand divine years through his fire and sun form eyes thus, it became void of blood and were bones and skin could remain there. That demon king purified and his sins absolved on account of being dried up by fire originated from Sankara's eye. Andhaka during that period could understand properly the multiform god, the regulator, ruler of all movable and immovable world, Sarvesvara, Avyaya, Isa, master of. three-worlds, Varda, Varenya, adorable to all gods etc. and the Adya Sankara. He therefore, prayed-

## \|\| 70.52 \|\|

*andhaka uvāca- namo'stu te bhairava bhībhamūrte trailokyagopve śitaśūladhāriṇe \|*  
*viśārddhabāho bhujageśahāra trinetra māṃ pāhi vipannabuddhim \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О gigantic form Bhairava! О defender of three-worlds, О holder of Sula and splendour, I salute you. О three eyed god! You hold ten arms and make garland of serpent king! Please, defend me, the demon of misdirected mind.

## \|\| 70.53 \|\|

*jayasva sarveśvara viśvamūrte surāsurairvanditapādapīṭha \|*  
*trailokyamātargurave vṛṣāṅka bhītaḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇāgato'smi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Victory to you О Visvamurti Sarvesvara! Your feet are adored by the gods and demons both. О Vrsanka! You are the husband of the mother of three-world. I have come in shelter to you in spite of my being capable to give shelter. This is due to fear of my enmity unknowingly made with you.

## \|\| 70.54 \|\|

*tvāṃ nātha devāḥ śivamīrayanti siddhā haraṃ sthāṇu maharṣayaśca \|*  
*bhīmaṃ ca yakṣā manujā maheśvaraṃ bhūtāni bhūtādhipamāmananti \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. О god! The gods say you Siva (the benevolent god), Siddhas address you as Hara (absolver from sins), hermits address as Sthanu (undeviated), Yaksa say Bhima, human beings say Mahesvara and the creatures consider their master.

## \|\| 70.55 \|\|

*niśācarā ugramupārcayanti bhaveti puṇyāḥ pitaro namanti \|*  
*dāso'smi tubhyaṃ hara pāhi mahāṃ pāpakṣayaṃ me kuru lokanātha \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The demons worship you as Ugra, your name. He noble ancestors salute calling you Bhava. О Hara! I am your slave. Please, defend me. О Lokanatha! Please, eradicate the sins committed by me.

## \|\| 70.56 \|\|

*bhavāṃstridevastriyugastridharmā tripuṣkaraścāsi vibho trinetra \|*  
*trayyāruṇistriśrutiravyayātman punīhi māṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gato'smi \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. О sovereign three eyed god! You are Trideva, Triyuga, Tridharma and Tripuskara. О Avyaya soul! You are Trayyaruni and three Vedas. Please, render me with purity. I have come to your shelter.

## \|\| 70.57 \|\|

*triṇāciketastripadapratiṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit tvaṃ viṣayeṣvalubdhaḥ \|*  
*trailokyanātho'si punīhi śaṃbho dāso'smi bhītaḥ śaraṇāgataste \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. You are Trinaciketa, enshrined on three positions (the heaven, the earth and nether), you are learned to six components. (Education, Kalpa, grammar, etymology, rhyme and astrology) of Vedas, detached to worldly affairs and the ruler of three worlds. О Sambhu! Please, render me with purity. I am your slave. I am frightened and have come to your shelter.

## \|\| 70.58 \|\|

*kṛto mahāt śaṃkara te'parādhaṃ mayā mahābhūtapate girīśa \|*  
*kāmāriṇā nirjitamānasena prasādaye tvāṃ śirasā nato'smi \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O Sankara! О master of all beings! О mountain residing god! The enemy in the form of lust had overpowered me. This is the reason, I committed such heinous crime. I salute you with bowing my head.

## \|\| 70.59 \|\|

*pāpo'haṃ pāpakarmā'haṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*trāhi māṃ deva īśāna sarvapāpaharo bhava \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. I am sinner, evildoer, manipulator and grown on sins. О god Isana! О all sin absolving Mahadeva! Please, defend me.

## \|\| 70.60 \|\|

*mā me krudhyasva deveśa tvayā caitādṛśo'smyaham \|*  
*spṛṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāro me prasanno bhaveśvara \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О Devesa! don't be so angry with me. You yourself have made me such offender. О god! Please, be happy on me.

## \|\| 70.61 \|\|

*tvaṃ karttā caiva dhātā ca tva jayastvaṃ mahājayaḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ maṅgalyastvamoṃkārastvamīśāno dhruvo'vyayaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. You are creator and administrator. You are victory and you also are the grand victory. You are benevolent. You are the syllable "Orh". You are yourself Isana, Avyaya and the Dhruva.

## \|\| 70.62 \|\|

*tvaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭikṛnnāthastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*tvamindrastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāro dharmastvaṃ ca surottamaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. You are creator Brahma and sovereign, you are Isvara, you are Visnu and Mahesvara. You are Indra, you are Vasatkara, you are religion and you are the best god.

## \|\| 70.63 \|\|

*sūkṣmastvaṃ vyaktarūpastvaṃ tvamavyaktastvamīśvaraḥ \|*  
*tvayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. You are in micro form, you are tangible and intangible. You are Isvara. This entire movable and immovable world is existed because of your creation.

## \|\| 70.64 \|\|

*tvamādiranto madhyaśca tvamanādiḥ sahastrapāt \|*  
*vijayastvaṃ sahasrākṣo virūpākṣo mahābhujaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. You are the begin, the middle and the end, you are unborn and Sahastrapata. You are victory, you are thousand eyed, Virupaksa and of huge anus god.

## \|\| 70.65 \|\|

*anantaḥ sarvago vyāpī haṃsaḥ puṇyādhipo'cyutaḥ \|*  
*gīrvāṇapatiravyaggro rudraḥ paśupatiḥ śivaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. You are Ananta, Sarvagata, omnipresent, Hamsa, Pranadhipa, Acyuta, Girvanapati, Avyakula, Rudra, Pasupati and Siva.

## \|\| 70.66 \|\|

*traividyastvaṃ jitakrodho jitārirvirjitendriyaḥ \|*  
*jayaśca śūlapāṇistvaṃ trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. You are Traividya, Krodhajayi, Satrujayi, Indriyajayi, Jaya and Sulapani. Please, defend me, who is in your shelter.

## \|\| 70.67 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- itthaṃ maheśvaro brahmanstuto daityādhipena tu \|*  
*prītiyuktaḥ piṅgalākṣo hairaṇyākṣamuvāca ha \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Pulastya said- О Brahmin! When so prayed by demon king Andhaka, Mahesvara, the yellow eyed god said to him-

## \|\| 70.68 \|\|

*siddho'si dānavapate parituṣṭo'smi te'ndhaka \|*  
*varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yamicchasi vinā'mbikām \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. О demon king! You have now become Siddha. I am pleased with you. Ask whatever please you except Ambika. May you see all welfare.

## \|\| 70.69 \|\|

*andhaka uvāca- ambikā jananī mahāṃ bhagavāṃstryambakaḥ pitā \|*  
*vandāmi caraṇau māturvandanīyā mamāmbikā \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Andhaka said- Ambika is my mother and you Tryambaka are my father. I pray at the feet of mother. Ambika is adorable to me.

## \|\| 70.70 \|\|

*varado'si yadīśāna tadyātu vipulaṃ mama \|*  
*śārīraṃ mānasaṃ vāgjaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ durvicintitam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. О Isana! If you really want to give me desired, please, bless me with bona-fides and eradicate the mala-fides that lead to physical, mental and evils committed by speech.

## \|\| 70.71 \|\|

*tathā me dānavo bhāvo vyapayātu maheśvara \|*  
*sthirā'stu tvayi bhaktistu varametat prayaccha me \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О Mahesvara! I want stable and undeviating devotion at your feet and removal of my monstrous spirits. Please, render me with such boon.

## \|\| 70.72 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca- evaṃ bhavatu daityendra pāpaṃ te yātu saṃkṣayam \|*  
*mukto'si daityabhāvācca bhṛṅgī gaṇapatirbhava \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Mahadeva said- О king of demons! Be it as you have desired. May your all evils destroy. You are now free from the monstrous feelings. Be now my Ganapati Bhrngi.

## \|\| 70.73 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā varadaḥ śūlāggrādavatārya tam \|*  
*nirmārjya nijahastena cakre nivraṇamandhakam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. With these words, god Mahadeva brought down Andhaka from the point of Sula and filled his would merely of touching thereupon.

## \|\| 70.74 \|\|

*tataḥ svadehato devatā brahmādīnājuhāva saḥ \|*  
*te niśverumarhātmāno namasyantastrilocanam \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. He then summoned Brahma etc. gods existed in his body. All those great souls came out with salute to three eyed god.

## \|\| 70.75 \|\|

*gaṇān sanandīnāhūya saṃniveśya tadāgrataḥ \|*  
*bhṛṅginaṃ darśayāmāsa dhruvaṃ naiṣo'ndhaketi hi \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. He called all ganas including Nandi, ordered to take seat there, introduced Bhrngi with them and said- "He is definitely not Andhaka now."

## \|\| 70.76 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavapati saṃśuṣkapiśitaṃ ripum \|*  
*gaṇādhipatyamāpannaṃ praśaśaṃsurvṛṣadhvajam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. They all appreciated the bull riding god Mahadeva when they saw that the enemy demon king turned in skeleton and now made the head of ganas.

## \|\| 70.77 \|\|

*tatsaṃbandha pradhānasaṃsthādhyakṣa devatāḥ gaḍhakheda svīna vidhvāṃśina pujodeva nirveśa sukhamā \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The god then embraced those gods and said- О gods! Go now to your respective places and live happily in the heaven.

## \|\| 70.78 \|\|

*sahasrākṣo'pi saṃyātu parvataṃ malayaṃ śubham \|*  
*tatra svakārya kṛtvaiva paścādyātu triviṣṭapam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The one thousand eyed Indra should also go at the white Malaya mountain and return to heaven after completing the task there.

## \|\| 70.79 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā tridaśānsamābhāvya vyasarjayat \|*  
*pitāmahaṃ namaskṛtya pariṣvajya janārdanam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. He saluted Pitamaha, embraced Janirdana and did conversation with gods and so bade good-bye to all. These all gods so given farewell then returned to the heaven.

## \|\| 70.80-82 \|\|

*mahendro malayaṃ gatvā kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*gateṣu śakraprāgyeṣu deveṣu bhagavāśivaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*visarjayāmāsa gaṇānanumāmanya yathārhataḥ \|*  
*gaṇāśca śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamāsthitāḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*jagmuste śubhalokāni mahābhogāni nārada \|*  
*yatra kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvakāmaphaladrumāḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

80-82. Mahendra went Malayacala, accomplished his work there and then returned to the heaven. When Sakra etc. gods so returned to their respective places, god Siva honoured ganas according their position and status and bade them fare-well. О Narada! The ganas too rode on their carriers (vehicles) after seeing Sankara and returned to those worlds (abodes) where the cows give desired things, the trees bestow with all desired fruits.

## \|\| 70.83-84 \|\|

*nadyastvamṛtavāhinyo hṛdāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ \|*  
*svāṃ svāṃ gatiṃ prayāteṣu pramatheṣu maheśvaraḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*samādāyāndhakaṃ haste sanandiḥ śailamabhyagāt \|*  
*dvābhyāṃ varṣasahasrābhyāṃ punarāyāddharo gṛhyam \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. Where there are rivers in which nectar flows and the reservoirs filled with Payasa. When Pramathas returned to their respective places, Mahesvara took the hand of Andhaka in his hand and went at the Mandara mountain with his Nandi. After the passage of two thousand,years, Sankara returned to his home.

## \|\| 70.85-86 \|\|

*dadṛśe ca gireḥ putrī śvetārkakusumasthitām \|*  
*samāyātaṃ nirīkṣyaica sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuttam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*tyaktvā'rkakusumaṃ tūrṇa sakhīstāḥ samupāhvayat \|*  
*samāhūtāśca devyā tā jayādyā stūrṇama \|*  
*gaman \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. He saw Girija within white colour Arka flower. When Parvati saw Sankara with proper examination of the special marks on his body, she came out from that flower and then called all her maids. Jaya etc. all goddesses immediately came there when so called by Parvati.

## \|\| 70.87-88 \|\|

*tābhiḥ parivṛtā tasthau haradarśanalālasā \|*  
*tatastrinetro girijāṃ dṛṣṭvā prekṣya ca dānavam \|\| 87 \|\|*

*nandinaṃ ca tathā harṣādāliṅgañca gireḥ sutām \|*  
*athovācaiṣa dāsaste kṛto devi mayā'ndhakaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. Surrounded by the maids, Parvati stood-Up with an appetite to see Hara. The three eyed god saw first Girija then turned towards that demon and Nandi and ultimately, embraced her. He then said- О goddess! I have made Andhaka your slave now.

## \|\| 70.89-91 \|\|

*paśyasva praṇati yātaṃ svasutaṃ cāruhāsini \|*  
*ityudyāryāndhakaṃ caiva putra ehyehi satvaram \|\| 89 \|\|*

*vrajasva śaraṇaṃ mātureṣā śreyaskarī tava \|*  
*ityukto vibhunā nandī andhakakṣa gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*samāgamyāmbikāpādau vavandaturubhārvāpa \|*  
*andhako'pi tadā gaurīṃ bhaktinamro mahāmune \|*  
*stutiṃ cakre mahāpuṇyāṃ pāpaghnīṃ śrutisaṃmatām \|\| 91 \|\|*

89-91. О nice smiling beloved! Look at your son. He is saluting you. He then said- О son! Come quickly. Take shelter to your mother. She will do your all good. Ganesvara Nandi and Andhaka both touched the feet of Ambika. О great sage! Andhaka then started praying Gauri with sin effacing, evil crushing and Vedas affirmed psalm.

## \|\| 70.92 \|\|

*andhaka uvāca- oṃ namaste'stu bhavānīṃ bhūtabhavyapriyāṃ lokadhātrīṃ janitrīṃ skandamātaraṃ mahādevatriyāṃ syandinīṃ cetanāṃ trailokyamātaraṃ dharitrīṃ devamātaramathejyāṃ śrutiṃ smṛtiṃ dayāṃ lajjāṃ kāntimatryāmasūyāṃ matiṃ sadāpāvanīṃ daityasainyakṣayakarīṃ māhāmāyāṃ vaijayantīṃ suśubhāṃ kālarātri govindaginīṃ śailarājaputrīṃ sarvadevārcitāṃ sarvabhūtārcitāṃ vidyāṃ sarasvatīṃ trinayanamahiṣīṃ namasyāmi mṛḍānīṃ śaraṇamupāgato'haṃ namo namaste \|*  
*itthaṃ stutā sā'ndhakena parituṣṭā vibhāvarī \|*  
*prāha putra prasannā'smi vṛṇuṣva varamuttamam \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Andhaka prayed- “I salute Bhavani. I bow my head on the feet of Bhutabhavya Priya, Lokadhatri, Janitri, mother of Skanda, wife of Mahadeva, Dharini, Syandini, Cetana, mother of three-worlds, Dharitri, mother of gods, Ijya, Veda, Smrti, kindness, shame, the best brilliance, indignation, thought, always purifier, killer of the demons army, Маhаmaya, Vaijayanti, extremely auspicious, Kalaratri, sister of Govinda, daughter of the king mountain, worshipped by all gods, adored by all organisms, learning, Sarasvati and the life of three eyed god. I have come in shelter of Mrdani.” I do frequent salute to you. Bhavani pleased on Andhaka having so prayed by him. She said- “O son! I am pleased on you. As the best thing desired by you.”

## \|\| 70.93 \|\|

*bhṛṅgiruvāca- pāpaṃ praśamamāyātu trividhaṃ mama pārvati \|*  
*tatheśvare ca satataṃ bhaktirastu mamāmbike \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Bhrngi said- О Parvati! О Ambika! I ask you that all sins committed by me three ways (i.e. physical, mental, speech) and fee my firm devotion for the god.

## \|\| 70.94 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- vāḍhamityabravīdgaurī hiraṇyākṣasutaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*sa cāste pūjayanśarvaṃ gaṇānāmadhipo'bhavat \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. Pulastya said- Gauri then blessed the son of Hiranyaksa. Be it as desired by you. He became one of the heads of ganas and engrossed his mind always with worship of god Siva.

## \|\| 70.95 \|\|

*evaṃ purā dānavasattamaṃ taṃ maheśvareṇātha virūpadṛṣṭyā \|*  
*kṛtvaiva rūpaṃ bhayadaṃ tu bhairavaṃ bhṛṅgittvamīśena kṛtā svabhaktyā \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Thus, Mahesvara during ancient period gave a dreadful form by his curved sight to that demon king Andhaka and then he himself instilled devotion in his heart and made him Bhrngi.

## \|\| 70.96 \|\|

*etattavokta harakīrtivardhanaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ śubhadaṃ maharṣe \|*  
*saṃkīrtanīyaṃ dvijasattameṣu dharmāyurārogyadhanaiṣiṇā sadā \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. О great hermit! I have told you an episode increasing the fame of Hara. It is noble, sacrosanct and benevolent too. The Dvijas desirous of religion, age, health and wealth should always do pray of it and recite it always.

## Chapter 71. Birth of the seven Maruts in the different Manvantaras

## \|\| 71.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- malaye'pi mahendreṇa yatkṛtaṃ brāhmaṇarṣabha \|*  
*niṣpāditaṃ svakaṃ kāryaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- О great Dvija! Listen to the task executed by Mahendra at Malaya mountain from me also.

## \|\| 71.2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śrūyatāṃ yanmahendreṇa malaye parvatottame \|*  
*kṛtaṃ lokahite brahmannātmanaśca tathā hitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- О Brahmin! The book executed by Mahendra at the mountain Malaya for the welfare of the world and his own is worth listening. Hence, listen to it carefully.

## \|\| 71.3 \|\|

*anyāsurasyānucarā mayatārapurogamāḥ \|*  
*te nirjitāḥ suragaṇaiḥ pātālagamanotsukāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The servants of Andhaka demon i.e. Maya, Tara etc. intended to go into nether when they were defeated by the gods.

## \|\| 71.4-5 \|\|

*dadṛśurmalayaṃ śailaṃ siddhāvyuṣitakandaram \|*  
*latāvipānasaṃchantraṃ mattasattvasamākulam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*candanairuragākrāntaiḥ suśītairatisevitam \|*  
*mādhavīkusumāmodaṃ ṛṣyarthitaharaṃ girim \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Those people saw Malaya mountain adored by hermits, caves used as residence by siddhas, surrounded by the creepers filled with the intoxicated creatures, covered by the cold blood serpents and filled with the fragrance of Madhavi flower.

## \|\| 71.6 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā śītalacchāyaṃ śrāntā vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ \|*  
*mayatārapurogāste nivāsaṃ samarocayan \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The demons Maya, Tara etc. were tired and felt weakness in body when they reached there, so they wished to reside there.

## \|\| 71.7 \|\|

*teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu prāṇatṛptiprado'nilaḥ \|*  
*vivāti śītaḥ śanakairdakṣiṇo gandhasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. When they seated there, the cold breeze from south direction was blown with satiating effect to the breathing they felt there.

## \|\| 71.8 \|\|

*tatraiva ca ratiṃ cakkuḥ sarva eva mahāsurāḥ \|*  
*kurvanto lokapūjye vidveṣaṃ devatāgaṇe \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. All mighty demons started living there without giving ear to the protest made by the gods worshipped by all human beings.

## \|\| 71.9 \|\|

*ityevamuktā sā bharnā ditirniyamamāsthitā \|*

23\. Having heard this suggestion, Diti resorted to the rule. At the due time, Kasyapa participated in intercourse and went at Udayagiri.

## \|\| 71.24 \|\|

*gate tasmin muniśreṣṭhaḥ sahasrākṣo'pi satvaram \|*

24\. Indra went at that cottage just when the sage took departure and said to Diti-

## \|\| 71.25 \|\|

*kariṣyāmyanuśuśrūṣāṃ bhavatyā yadi manyase \|*

25\. “I will wait upon you, if you please.” As the forthcoming events definitely take place, Diti permitted Indra to serve her.

## \|\| 71.26 \|\|

*samidāharaṇādīni tasyāṣścakre puraṃdaraḥ \|*

## \|\| 71.27-28 \|\|

*jānubhyāmuparisthāpya muktakeśā nijaṃ śiraḥ \|*

27-28. When a period of one thousand years passed, the lady over cautious in maintaining purity, took bath from head to feet, her hair were unlocked, she put her head on pubic and eventually began slumbering. Her hairs covered her feet.

## \|\| 71.29 \|\|

*tama taramaśaucasya jñātvā devaḥ sahasradṛk \|*

29\. О Narada! Thousand-eyed Indra searched the loophole and entered into the ovary of mother through nostril.

## \|\| 71.30 \|\|

*praviśya jaṭhare kruddho daityamātuḥ puraṃdaraḥ \|*

30\. Entering into the ovary, the furious Indra saw there a baby with his hands on loins and mouth upside lifted.

## \|\| 71.31 \|\|

*tasyaivāsye'tha dadṛśe peśīṃ māṃsasya vāsavaḥ \|*

31\. Vasava saw a vein white as sphatic in his mouth. He lightly gripped that muscle with couple hand.

## \|\| 71.32 \|\|

*tattaḥ kopasamādhmāto māṃsapeśīṃ śatakratuḥ \|*

32\. Indra in sheer anger churned that muscle by hand resulting which it became very hard.

## \|\| 71.33 \|\|

*ūrdhvanārthaṃ ca vavṛdhe tvadho'rthaṃ vavṛdhe tathā \|*

33\. The half part of that muscle slided upside and another half slided downside. Thus, a thunderbolt with hundred knots was formed by that muscle.

## \|\| 71.34 \|\|

*tenaiva garbhaṃ ditijaṃ vajreṇa śataparvaṇā \|*

34\. О Brahmin! Indra cut-off the womb in seven parts by using that thunderbolt. That baby began to weep loudly in the womb.

## \|\| 71.35 \|\|

*tato'vyabudhyata ditirajānācchakraceṣṭitam \|*

35\. O Narada! Diti then awakened and she understood the offence so committed by Indra. She heard the voice of so weeping baby.

## \|\| 71.36 \|\|

*śakro'pi prāha mā mūḍha rudasveti sughargharam \|*

36\. Indra too said- О idiot! Don't weep with "thundering" sound. He again cut of each part in seven pieces with these words.

## \|\| 71.37 \|\|

*te jātā maruto nāma devabhṛtyāḥ śatakratoḥ \|*

37\. They thus, became later-on the servants of gods and called Maruta. Due to the mistake committed by mother, the run forward.

## \|\| 71.38 \|\|

*tataḥ sakuliśaḥ śakro nirgamya jaṭharāt tadā \|*

38\. Indra then came out from the every ovary of Diti, frightened of the curse to be given by her and said with folded hands-

*mamāsti nāparādho'yaṃ yacchastastanayastava \|*

39\. I have committed no offence in cutting-off the baby in your womb. You had bent downward and this mistake in taking care of sanctity caused this all. Hence, you should not angry with me.

## \|\| 71.40 \|\|

*na tavātrāparādho'sti manye diṣṭamidaṃ purā \|*

40\. Diti said- "You have committed no mistake at all. I consider it predestined. Perhaps, on account of such preponderance of event, a slight mistake in hiking care of purity has committed by me just at the time when period was matured.

## \|\| 71.41 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamuktvā tānbālānparisāntvya ditiḥ svayam \|*

*evaṃ purā svānapi sodarān sa garbhasthitānuñjaritaṃ bhayārtaḥ \|*

42\. О great sage! Indra had thus, cut-off his sibling in pieces within the womb of his mother during long past. This is the reason, he got another name as Gotrabhit (viz. one who had killed his siblings).

## Chapter 72. Birth of the seven Maruts

## \|\| 72.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- yadamī bhavatā proktā maruto ditijottamāḥ \|*  
*tatkena pūrvamāsan vai marunmārgeṣu kathyatām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said - Kindly explain that at what branch or route Maruts were existed before their origin from Diti as you have already told to us?

## \|\| 72.2 \|\|

*pūrvamanvantarevvava samatīteṣu sattama \|*  
*ke tvāsanvāyumārgasthāstanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O great hermit! Kindly tell me specifically that which branch of Maruts was existed at air route when the previous Manvantara passed by?

## \|\| 72.3 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śrūyatāṃ pūrvamarutāmutpatti kathayāmi te \|*  
*svāyaṃbhuvaṃ samārabhya yāvanmanvantaraṃ tvidam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Pulastya replied- I explain now the story pertaining to the origin of Marudganas from Svayambhuva Manvantara to current Manvantara before you. Please, listen to it carefully.

## \|\| 72.4 \|\|

*svāyaṃbhuvasya putro'bhūnmanurnāma priyavrataḥ \|*  
*tasyāsītsavano nāma putrastrailokyapūjitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Priyavrata was the son of Svayambhuva Manu and Savana renowned throughout the three-world was the son of that Priyavrata.

## \|\| 72.5 \|\|

*sa cānapatyo devarṣe nṛpaḥ pretagatiṃ gataḥ \|*  
*tato'rudattasya patnī suvedā śokavihvalā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О sage! Savana could not reproduce children and thus, dead without issue. He therefore, obtained Pretagati (as per Hindu ritual, the man if dead without son, becomes Preta). His wife Sudeva began weiling bitterly on his sudden death.

## \|\| 72.6 \|\|

*na dadāti tathā dagdhuṃ samāliṅgaya sthitā patim \|*  
*nātha nātheti bahuśo vilapantī tyanāthavat \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She did not offered the corpse for pyre, embraced tightly her husband's dead body and started weeping with loud cries as an orphan.

## \|\| 72.7 \|\|

*tāmantarikṣādaśarīriṇī vāk provāca mā rājapatnīha rodīḥ \|*  
*yadyasti te satyamanuttamaṃ tadā bhavatvayaṃ te patinā sahāgniḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. An intangible voice in the meantime came from the sky and addressed her- "O queen! Do not weep. If you are so chaste, this fire of your chastity shall turn in pyre for both of you together."

## \|\| 72.8 \|\|

*sā tāṃ vāṇīmantarikṣāntri śamya provācedaṃ rājaputrī suvedā \|*  
*śocāmyenaṃ pārthivaṃ putrahīnaṃ naivātmānaṃ mandabhāgyaṃ vihaṅgaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Sudeva heard this voice and said- "O space moving voice! "I am weeping for this king who has dead without son and seldom for my being."

## \|\| 72.9 \|\|

*so'thābravīnmā rudasva \|*  
*yatā kṣi putrāstvatto bhūmipālasya sapta \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti vahnimāroha śīghra satyaṃ proktaṃ śraddadhasva tvamadya \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The voice again suggested- О huge eyed lady! Don't weep. You will shortly given birth to seven sons from consummation with the same king. Hence, sit on pyre immediately. I am telling you the truth. Have faith on me.

## \|\| 72.10 \|\|

*ityevamuktā khacareṇa bālā citau samāropya patiṃ varārham \|*  
*hutāśamāsādya pativratā taṃ saṃcintayantī jvalanaṃ prapannā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. That lady followed the suggestion given by that intangible voice, put the corpse of her husband on pyre, kept in mind the memory of him, lit the fire and thus, resorted to fire.

## \|\| 72.11 \|\|

*tato muhūrtānnṛpatiḥ śriyā yutaḥ samuttasthau sahito bhāryayā' sau \|*  
*khamutpapātātha sa kāmakārī samaṃ mahiṣyā ca sunābhaputryā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Within hours when the fire blazed, that king stood-up with her wife from pyre, ascended to the sky and began strolling there voluntarily.

## \|\| 72.12 \|\|

*tasyāmbare nārada pārthivasya jātā rajogā mahiṣīṃ tu gacchataḥ \|*  
*sa divyayogāt pratisaṃsthito'mbare bhāryāsahāyo divasāni pañca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Narada! While ascending to sky, the queen got menstruation and that king stayed in sky with divine sextile there for five days. His wife also was with him.

## \|\| 72.13 \|\|

*tatastu ṣaṣṭhe'hani pārthivena ṛturna vanthyo'dya bhavedvicintya \|*  
*rarāma tanvyā saha kāmacārī tato'mbarātprācyavatāsya śukram \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The sensuous king took care of utilising the cycle of reproduction and began enjoying intercourse with his wife on the sixth day of menstruation. He was finally ejaculated from the sky.

## \|\| 72.14 \|\|

*śukrotsargāvasāne tu nṛpatirbhāryayā saha \|*  
*jagāma divyayā gatyā brahmaloka tapodhana \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О austere! That king moved to the abode of Brahma just after he ejaculated. His wife also followed him.

## \|\| 72.15 \|\|

*tadambarāt pracalitamabhravarṇa śukraṃ samānā nalinī vapuṣyatī \|*  
*citrā viśālā haritālinī ca saptarvipalyo dadṛśuryathecchayā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О great hermit! The seven spouses of hermits saw. The semen as white as Abhraka falling from the sky with curiosity and attraction. These wives were- Samana, Nalini, Vapusmati, Citra, Visala, Harita and Alini.

## \|\| 72.16 \|\|

*tadṛṣṭvā puṣkare nyastaṃ pratyaicchanta tapodhana \|*  
*manyamānāstadamṛtaṃ sadā yauvana lipsayā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О austere! They all considered the semen as nectar and kept it safely in Puskara with a desire to receive enduring youth.

## \|\| 72.17-19 \|\|

*tataḥ snātvā tu vidhivatsaṃpūjya tān nijān patīn \|*  
*patibhiḥ samanujñaptāḥ papuḥ puṣkarasaṃsthitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tacchukraṃ pārthivendrasya manya māna \|*  
*stadā' mṛtam \|*  
*pītamātreṇa śukreṇa pārthivendrodbhavena tāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*brahmatejovihīnāstā jātāḥ patnyastapasvinām \|*  
*tatastu tatyajuḥ sarve sadoṣāstāṣca patnayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. They all took bath, honoured their husbands, asked their permission and then sipped that semen considering the same as if nectar. No sooner they sipped that semen ejaculated by the king, all of them were lost of Brahma splendour. The ascetics considered them defective and gave up their ties with them.

## \|\| 72.20 \|\|

*sudhuvuḥ sapta tanayān rudato bhairavaṃ mune \|*  
*teṣāṃ ruditaśabdena sarvamāpūritaṃ jagat \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О sage! The wives of those hermits wept bitterly throughout the period the womb matured in their belly and gave birth finally seven sons. All babies were wept so loud as it echoed the entire territory of the world.

## \|\| 72.21 \|\|

*athājagāma bhagavānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*samabhyetyābravīd bālān mā rudadhvaṃ mahābalāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Subsequently god Brahma appeared there. He went to the babies and said- О brave babies! "Don’t weep so loud."

## \|\| 72.22-23 \|\|

*maruto nāma yūyaṃ vai bhaviṣyadhvaṃ viyacarāḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā deveśo brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tānādāya viyaccāri mārutānādideśa ha \|*  
*te tvāsanmarutastvādyā manoḥ svāyaṃbhuve'ntare \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. You all will be addressed as Marut and slroll freely in the sky. He then took them all to sky and ordered them to reside there. These babies were the foremost Marut during the regime of Svayambhuva Manu.

## \|\| 72.24 \|\|

*svārociṣe tu maruto vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada \|*  
*svārociṣasya putrastu śrīmānāsīt ṛtadhvajaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О Narada! I will now tell you about Marut's originated during the regime of Svarocisa Manu. Listen it patiently. Rtadhvaja was the son of Svarocisa.

## \|\| 72.25 \|\|

*tasya putrābhavan sapta saptārciḥ pratimā mune \|*  
*tapo'rthaṃ te gatāḥ śaila mahāmeruṃ nareśvarāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О sage! He had seven sons having fire like complexion. The all kings went at great Meru mountain for penance.

## \|\| 72.26 \|\|

*ārādhayanto brahmāṇaṃ padamaindramayepsavaḥ \|*  
*tato vipaścinnāmātha sahastrākṣo bhayāturaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. They began worshipping Brahma with an intention to obtain the throne of god Indra. When Indra took notice of their resolution, he was badly frightened.

## \|\| 72.27 \|\|

*pūtanāmapsaromukhyāṃ prāha nārada vākyavit \|*  
*gacchasva pūtane śailaṃ mahāmeru viśālinam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О Narada! Skilled orator Indra called the chief nymph Putana and ordered- "O Putana! Go at Mahameru mountain."

## \|\| 72.28-30 \|\|

*tatra tapyanti hi tapaḥ ṛtadhvajasutā mahat \|*  
*yathā hi tapaso vighnaṃ teṣāṃ bhavati sundari \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tathā kuruṣva mā teṣāṃ siddhirbhavatu sundari \|*  
*ityevamuktā śakreṇa pūtanā rūpaśālinī \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tatrājagāma tvaritā yatrātapyanta te tapaḥ \|*  
*āśramasyāvidūre tu nadī mandodavāhinī \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. The sons of Kratudhvaja are engrossed with penance there. О charming lady! Exercise all that could disturb them and create circumstances just contrary to drive their mind away from the intention they have made. Beautiful Putana immediately went there and saw them engrossed with penance. A rivulet with soft flow was nearby that place.

## \|\| 72.31 \|\|

*tasyāṃ snātuṃ samāyātāḥ sarva eva sahodarāḥ \|*

31\. All those siblings came there to take a bath in morning. That beautiful nymph too descended in that rivulet at the same time for bath.

## \|\| 72.32-33 \|\|

*dadṛśuste nṛpāḥ snātāṃ tataścakṣubhire mune \|*  
*teṣāṃ ca prācyavacchukraṃ tatpapau jalacāriṇī \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śaṅkhinī grāhamukhyasya mahāśaṅkhasya vallabhā \|*  
*te'pi vibhraṣṭatapaso jagmū rājyaṃ tu paitṛkam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. O sage! When those princes saw her bathing there, they were highly excited and ejaculated in the river. The semen so discharge was sipped by Sankhini, the wife of a crocodile Mahusankha. Thus, their penance was breached and they returned back desperately to their father's kingdom.

## \|\| 72.34-36 \|\|

*sā cāpsarāḥ śakrametya yāthātathyaṃ nyavedayat \|*  
*tato bahutithe kāle sā grāhī śaṅkharūpiṇī \|\| 34 \|\|*

*samuddhatā mahājālairmatsyabanyena māninī \|*  
*sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāśaṅkhīṃ sthalasthāṃ matsyajīvikaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*nivedayāmāsa tadā ṛtadhvajasuteṣu vai \|*  
*tathā'bhyetya mahātmāno yogināṃ yogadhāriṇaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. That nymph also returned to Indra and reported the event. Subsequently, a fisherman after several year once caught in net that Sankhini, crocodile. When he saw it was crocodile instead of fish, he left her at the bank and went to Kratudhvaja. He reported the matter there before those princes. Those expert Yogi immediately went to her (crocodile's wife).

## \|\| 72.37 \|\|

*nītvā svamandiraṃ sarve puravāpyāṃ samutsṛjan \|*  
*tataḥ kramācchaṃkhinī sā suṣuve sapta vai śiśūn \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. They brought her to the palace and released in a vast reservoir there. That crocodile gave birth to seven sons subsequently.

## \|\| 72.38 \|\|

*jātamātreṣu putreṣu mokṣabhāvamagāca sā \|*  
*amātṛpitṛkā bālā jalamadhyavihāriṇaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The crocodile was dead immediately after delivery and the parentless babies began to live in the water.

## \|\| 72.39 \|\|

*stanyārthino vai rurudurathābhyāgātpitāmahaḥ \|*  
*mā rudadhvamitītyāha maruto nāma putrakāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. They started weeping loudly for milk. Brahma appeared their for their assistance and consoled them by saying- "O sons! Don't weep. You all shall be addressed as Marut.

## \|\| 72.40-41 \|\|

*yūyaṃ devā bhaviṣyadhvaṃ vāyuskanyavicāriṇaḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvāthādāya sarvāṃstān daivatān prati \|\| 40 \|\|*

*niyojya ca marunmārge vairājaṃ bhavanaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*evamāsaṃśca maruto manoḥ svārociṣe'ntare \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. “You will stroll on the shoulder of the air.” With these words, Brahma took all those gods with him, set them at the air route and returned to his abode. Thus, Maruts were originated during the regime of Svarocisa Manu.

## \|\| 72.42-43 \|\|

*uttame maruto ye ca tāñchṛṇuṣva tapodhana \|*  
*uttamasyānvavāye tu rājāsīnnivayādhipaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vapuṣpāniti vikhyāto vapuṣā bhāskaropamaḥ \|*  
*tasya putro guṇaśreṣṭho jyotiṣmāndhārmiko'bhavat \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. O austere! Listen to about Maruts during Manvantara (uttama). In the dynasty of uttama, there was a renowned king Vapusmana having complexion as bright as the sun. He was Nisadhadhipa. He had a religious and meritorious son called Jyotismana.

## \|\| 72.44-45 \|\|

*sa putrārthī tapastepe nadīṃ mandākinīmanu \|*  
*tasya bhāryā ca suśroṇī devācāryasutā tathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tapaścaraṇayuktasya babhūva paricārikā \|*  
*sā svayaṃ phalapuṣyāmbusamitkuśaṃ samāharat \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. He began to exercise penance on the bank of Mandakini as he was desirous of getting a son. His wife, Kalyani, the daughter of Jupiter (preceptor to gods) began to assist him during that penance. She herself used to collect fruits, flowers, water, fuel and kusa grass.

## \|\| 72.46 \|\|

*cakāra padāpatrākṣī samyak cātithipūjanam \|*  
*patiṃ śuśrūṣamāṇā sā kṛśā dhamanisaṃtatā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. That lotus-eyed beautiful woman used to greet all guests at the cottage there. Owing to such hard living during penance, her body became thin and lean and the veins appeared on the skin.

## \|\| 72.47-48 \|\|

*tejoyuktā sucārvaṅgī dṛṣṭā saptarvibhirvane \|*  
*tāṃ tathā cārusarvāṅgīṃ dṛṣṭvā'tha tapasā kṛśām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*papracchustapaso hetuṃ tasyāstadbhartureva ca \|*  
*sā'bravīttanayārthāya āvābhyāṃ vai tapaḥ kriyā \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. The seven hermits (Saptarsis) once met that beautiful and bright lady living in a forest. They saw that her body became thin and lean. During their stay there, they asked that why were they observing such strict penance. She replied- "Both of us are desirous of a son."

## \|\| 72.49-50 \|\|

*te cāsyai varadā brahman jātāḥ sapta maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*vrajadhvaṃ tanayāḥ sapta bhaviṣyardhyānta na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yuvayorguṇasaṃyuktā maharṣīṇāṃ prasādataḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā jagmuste sarva eva maharṣayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. О Brahmin! They blessed her by saying- "Now return to your kingdom. You will definitely give birth to seven sons by virtue of our blessing. With these words, all those hermits had taken departure from there."

## \|\| 72.51-52 \|\|

*sa cāpi rājarṣiragāt sabhāryo nagaraṃ nijam \|*  
*tato bahutithe kāle sā rājño mahiṣī priyā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*avāpa garbhaṃ tanvaṅgī tasmānnṛpatisattamāt \|*  
*gurviṇyāmatha bhāryāyāṃ mamārāsau narādhipaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Following the suggestion of Saptarsis, that king returned to his palace with wife from forest. After a lapse of several years, that queen conceived and just then the king was dead.

## \|\| 72.53 \|\|

*sā cāpyārodumicchantī bhartāraṃ vai pativratā \|*  
*nivāritā tadā'mātyairna tathā'pi vyatiṣṭhata \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The chaste lady was passionate to sit on pyre with her husband but the ministers tried to console her. She did not still put ear to their suggestions and became stubborn to die with husband.

## \|\| 72.54 \|\|

*samāropyātha bhartāraṃ citāyāmāruhaca sā \|*  
*tato'gnimadhyāt salile māṃsapeśyapatanmune \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. She put the corpse of her husband on pyre and then sat on the same with it. О sage! When the pyre was blazing in flames, a muscle from body from the middle portion of pyre fell in the water.

## \|\| 72.55 \|\|

*sā'mbhasā sukhaśītena saṃsiktāṃ saptadhā'bhavata \|*  
*te'jāyantātha maruta uttamasyāntare manoḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The muscle divided in seven pieces when immersed into cold water. Those seven pieces became Maruts during regime of Uttama Manu.

## \|\| 72.56 \|\|

*tāmasasyāntare ye ca marutopyabhavanpurā \|*  
*tānahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi gītanṛtyakalipriya \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O hermit! You are found of singing, dancing and the lover of strife. I will describe about very first the Maruts bom on first Manvantara.

## \|\| 72.57 \|\|

*tāmasasya manoḥ putro ṛtadhvaja iti śruttaḥ \|*  
*sa putrārthī juhāvāgnau svamāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ tathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The son of Tamasa Manu was famously called Rtadhvaja. He offered his flesh and blood of his body in order to obtain a son.

## \|\| 72.58 \|\|

*asthīni romakeśāṃśca snāyumajjāyakṛddhanam \|*  
*śukraṃ ca citragau rājā sutārthī iti naḥ śrutam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. We all have heard that the king desirous of son had offered his bones, furs, hair, nerves, marrow, liver and semen in fire.

## \|\| 72.59 \|\|

*saptasvevārciṣu tataḥ śukrapātādanantaram \|*  
*mā mā kṣipasvetyabhavacchabdaḥ so'pi mṛto nṛpaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Who semen was throw on seven fires, a voice was heard restricting for doing that act with- "don't throw, don’t throw" and that king was dead suddenly.

## \|\| 72.60 \|\|

*tatastasmādbhutavahātsaptadhā tattejasopamāḥ \|*  
*śiśavaḥ samajāyanta te rudanto'bhavan mune \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O sage! Seven brilliant babies then appeared from those seven type fires and began weeping there.

## \|\| 72.61 \|\|

*teṣāṃ tu dhvanimākarṇya bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*samāgamya nivāryātha sa cakre marutaḥ sutān \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. God Padmayoni came there and prohibited them from so weeping. He made those seven babies Marut gods.

## \|\| 72.62 \|\|

*te tvāsan maruto brahmastāmase devatā gaṇāḥ \|*  
*ye'bhavatraivate tāṃśca śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ tapodhana \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О Brahmin! Those seven babies became the god Marut during the period of Tamasa Manvantara. О great resolute! The Maruts bom during Raivata Manvantara had the following account of their life.

## \|\| 72.63 \|\|

*raivatasyānvavāye tu ya āsīdripujiddhanī \|*  
*ripujinnāmataḥ khyātto na tasyāsītsutaḥ kila \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Ripujit was a popular king in the dynasty of Raivata. He was a victorious king and had strong control on senses but issuless.

## \|\| 72.64 \|\|

*sa samārādhya tapasā bhāskaraṃ tejasāṃ nidhim \|*  
*avāpa kanyāṃ suratiṃ tāṃ pragṛhya gṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. He worshipped god Bhaskara through strict penance and got a daughter Surati under that god's grace. He took her to his palace.

## \|\| 72.65 \|\|

*tasyāṃ pitṛgṛhe brahmanvasantyāṃ sa pitā mṛtaḥ \|*  
*sā'pi duḥkhaparītāṅgī svāṃ tanuṃ tyaktumudyatā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. О Brahmin! The father of that girl was dead when she was unmarried. She too became ready under severe influence of grief to commit suicide.

## \|\| 72.66 \|\|

*tatastāṃ vārayāmāsutraṛṣayaḥ sapta mānasāḥ \|*  
*tasyāmāsaktacittāstu sarva eva tapodhanāḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Seven mind-bom psis forbaded her from doing that as all of them were fell in love with her.

## \|\| 72.67 \|\|

*apārayantī tadduḥkhaṃ prajvālyāgni viveśa ha \|*  
*te cāpaśyanta ṛṣayastacittā bhāvitāstathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. That spinster however, could not endure the grief, she burnt fire and seated on that pyre, the hermits fell in love with her saw her so burning.

## \|\| 72.68 \|\|

*tāṃ mṛtaḥ mṛṣayo dṛṣṭvā kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭeti vādinaḥ \|*  
*prajagmurdhvalanādyāpi saptājāyanta dārakāḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. They expressed grief by saying- "it is a matter of regret" and then walked from there away. Seven sons then bom from that pyre.

## \|\| 72.69 \|\|

*te ca mātrā vinābhūtā rurudustānpitāmahaḥ \|*  
*nivārayitvā kṛtavāṃllokanātho marudgaṇān \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. They began weeping due to lack of mother. God Brahma consoled them any how and then designated on the position of Maruts.

## \|\| 72.70 \|\|

*raivatasyāntare ātā maruto'mī tapodhana \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva kīrtayiṣyāmi cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. О great resolute! Those seven babies were later-on called Maruts during Raivata Manvantara. I will now describe the Maruts who bom during the regime of Caksusa Manu. Please, listen to carefully.

## \|\| 72.71 \|\|

*āsīnmaddhiriti khyātastapasvī satyavāk śuciḥ \|*  
*saptasārasvate tīrthe so'tapyata mahattapaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. There was an ascetic called Manki. He was truthful and sacrosanct. He had observed strict penance in Saptasarasvata Tirtha.

## \|\| 72.72 \|\|

*vighnārthaṃ tasya tuṣitāṃ devāḥ saṃpreṣayan vapum \|*  
*sā cābhyetya nadītīre kṣobhayāmāsa bhāminī \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The gods sent a nymph called "vapu" in order to impede his penance. That nymph descended down at the bank of river and enchanted to her beauty, he was excited.

## \|\| 72.73 \|\|

*tato'sya prācyavacchukraṃ saptasārasvate jale \|*  
*tāṃ caivāpyaśapanmūḍhāṃ munirmaṅkaṇako vapum \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. He was ejaculated when taking bath in Saptasarasvata. The sage Mankanak cursed that stupid "vapu" too.

## \|\| 72.74 \|\|

*gaccha labdhā'si mūḍhe tvaṃ pāpasyāsya mahat phalam \|*  
*vidhvaṃsayiṣyati hayo bhavatīṃ yajñasaṃsadi \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О stupid nymph! Go on your way immediately. You will receive very hard for so impeding in my penance. The horse in yajna sansada shall destroy you under hoofs.

## \|\| 72.75 \|\|

*evaṃ śaptvā ṛṣiḥ śrīmān jagāmātha svamāśramam \|*  
*sarasvatībhyaḥ saptabhyaḥ sapta vai maruto'bhavan \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. That great hermit after inflicting curse, returned back to his cottage subsequently, the seven Sarasvatfs gave birth to seven Maruts.

## \|\| 72.76 \|\|

*etat tavoktā marutaḥ purā yathā jātā viyadvyāptikarā maharṣe \|*  
*yeṣāṃ śrute janmani pāpahāni- rbhavecca dharmābhyudayo mahān vai \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. О hermit! I have now completely described the episode on the origin of Maruts present in the space during ancient period. This account of their origin results in the decay of evils and great introduction of religion (noble deed) with the man merely by withering to it.

## Chapter 73. Appearance of Vamana and the slaughter of Kalanemi

## \|\| 73.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- etadarthaṃ balirdaityaḥ kṛtto rājā kalipriya \|*  
*mantrapradātā prahlādaḥ śukrayā sītpurohitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*
