1\. Pulastya said- О Kalipriya! Bali the demon was therefore, made king. Prahlada was his minister and Sukra was the priest (Purohita).

## \|\| 73.2 \|\|

*jñātvā'bhiṣiktaṃ daiteyaṃ virocanasutaṃ balim \|*  
*didṛkṣavaḥ samāyātā samayāḥ sarva eva hi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When Maya and all other demons knew about incoronation of Bali, the son of Virocana, they came to see him there.

## \|\| 73.3 \|\|

*tānāgatānnirīkṣyaiva pūjayitvā yathākramam \|*  
*papraccha kulajānsarvānkinu śreyaskaraṃ mama \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Bali honoured his kith and kins came there and asked- "What is good for me?"

## \|\| 73.4 \|\|

*tamūcuḥ sarva evainaṃ śṛṇuṣva suramardana \|*  
*yatte śreyaskaraṃ karma yadasmākaṃ hitaṃ tathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. All of them suggested- "О suppressor of gods! Listen to all good for you coupled with good for your interests."

## \|\| 73.5 \|\|

*pitāmahastava balī āsīd dānavapālakaḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyakaśipurvīraḥ sa śakro'bhūjjagattraye \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The most chivalrous Hiranyakasipu was your grandfather. He during his life-span had subjugated the three worlds and ruled there.

## \|\| 73.6 \|\|

*tamāgatya suraśreṣṭho viṣṇuḥ siṃhavapurdharaḥ \|*  
*pratyakṣaṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ nakhaistaṃ hi vyadārayatḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The greatest god Visnu appeared in disguise of lion and pierced his heart in the presence of all respected demons.

## \|\| 73.7 \|\|

*apakṛṣṭaṃ tathā rājyamandhakasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*teṣāmarthe mahābāho śaṃkareṇa triśūlinā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О great warrior! The trident holder Sankara had took over the kingdom of mighty Andhaka for those gods.

## \|\| 73.8 \|\|

*tathā tava pitṛvyo'pi jambhaḥ śakreṇa ghātitaḥ \|*  
*kujambho viṣṇunā cāpi pratyakṣa paśuvat tava \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Similarly, Indra had killed your brother Jambha and Visnu had killed Kujambha like an animal before you.

## \|\| 73.9 \|\|

*śambhuḥ pāko mahendreṇa bhrātā tava sudarśanaḥ \|*  
*virocanastava pitā nihataḥ kathayāmi te \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Mahendra had killed Sambhu, Paka and your own brother Sudarsana. Your father Virocana was also killed.

## \|\| 73.10 \|\|

*śrutvā gotrakṣayaṃ brahmankṛtaṃ śakreṇa dānavaḥ \|*  
*udyogaṃ kārayāmāsa saha sarvairmahāsuraiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Brahmin! When the demon heard of his family massacre through Sakra (Indra), he issued instructions to all demons to be ready for war.

## \|\| 73.11 \|\|

*rathairanye gajairanye vājibhiścāpare'surāḥ \|*  
*padātayastathaivānye jagmuryuddhāya daivataiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A certain number of demons were on chariots, some on elephants, some on horses and some on foot while marching past to fight a war against the gods.

## \|\| 73.12-13 \|\|

*mayo'gre yāti balavān senānātho bhayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*sainyasya madhye ca bali kālanemiśca pṛṣṭhataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vāmapārśvamavaṣṭabhya śālvaḥ prathitavikramaḥ \|*  
*prayāti dakṣiṇaṃ ghoraṃ tārakākhyo bhayaṃkaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The fierce and mighty commander-in-chief Maya had gone to the fore portion of the army. Bali was at the middle of the army, Kalanemi at the back, the popular valorous salva was that left and the dreadful Taraka was at the right collateral of that army.

## \|\| 73.14 \|\|

*dānavānāṃ sahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca \|*  
*saṃprayātāni yuddhāya devaiḥ saha kalipriya \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O Kalipriya (Narada)! Thousands, millions and billions of demons departed to battle against the gods.

## \|\| 73.15 \|\|

*śrutvā'surāṇā mudyogaṃ śakraḥ surapatiḥ surān \|*  
*uvāca yogaṃ daityāṃstān yoddhu sabalasaṃyutān \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. God Indra when heard of the preparation made on part of demons, said to the gods- all of us should march past for fighting against those demons.

## \|\| 73.16 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ surarāṭ syandanaṃ balī \|*  
*samāruroha bhagavān yatamātalivājinam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. With these words, mighty god Indra rode on the chariot controlled by Matali.

## \|\| 73.17 \|\|

*samārūḍhe sahasrākṣe syandanaṃ devatāgaṇāḥ \|*  
*svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamāruhya niśceruryuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. When Indra rode on chariot, all gods rode on their respective chariots and began doing march past for the battle.

## \|\| 73.18-19 \|\|

*ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve'śvinau tathā \|*  
*vidyādharā guhyakāśca yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*rājarṣayastathā siddhā nānābhūtāśca saṃhatāḥ \|*  
*gajānanye rathānanye havānanye samāruhan \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Aditya, Vasu, Rudra, Sadhya, Visvedeva, Asvinikumara, Vidyadhara, Guhyaka, Yaksa, Raksasa, Pannaga, Rajarsi, Siddha and several types of Bhutas were joined with them. Some were on elephants, some others on chariots and a few among them rode on the horses.

## \|\| 73.20 \|\|

*vimānāni ca śubhrāṇi pakṣivāhyāni nārada \|*  
*samāruhyādravansarve yato daityabalaṃ sthitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О Narada! Some gods went there riding on the white aircrafts driven by the birds.

## \|\| 73.21 \|\|

*etasminnantare bīmānvainateyaḥ samāgataḥ \|*  
*tasminviṣṇuḥ suraśreṣṭha adhiruhya samabhyagāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the meantime, there came Garuda, god Visnu rode on his back and went to fight against the demons.

## \|\| 73.22 \|\|

*tamāgataṃ sahastrākṣastrailokyapatimavyayam \|*  
*vavanda mūrjā'vanataḥ saha sarvaiḥ surottamaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The thousand eyed Indra bowed his head including all gods with him in honour of the three-world ruler god Visnu.

## \|\| 73.23 \|\|

*tato'gre devasainyasya kārttikeyo gadādharaḥ \|*  
*pālayañjaghanaṃ viṣṇuryāti madhyaṃ sahastradṛk \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Then Kartikeya took the front, god Visnu with his mace took the rear and thousand eyed Indra covered the middle portion of that army.

## \|\| 73.24 \|\|

*vāmaṃ pārśvamavaṣṭabhya jayanto vajrate mune \|*  
*dakṣiṇaṃ varuṇaḥ pārśvamavaṣṭabhyāvrajad balī \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O sage! Jayanta covered the left collateral and mighty Varuna covered the right collateral portion of the army.

## \|\| 73.25 \|\|

*tato'marāṇāṃ pṛtanā yaśasvinī skandendraviṣṇavambupasūryapālitā \|*  
*nānāstraśastrodyatadoḥ samūhā samāsasādāribalaṃ mahīdhe \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Subsequently, the illustrious army of gods under lead of Skanda, Visnu, Varuna and sun equipped with a number of arms and weapons approached to the army of enemy on the mountain.

## \|\| 73.26 \|\|

*udayādritaṭe ramye śubhe samaśilātale \|*  
*nirvṛkṣe pakṣirahite jāto devāsuro raṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A fierce battle of gods and demons was fought at the attractive, plain valley of hillock at Udayacala where there were no trees and birds.

## \|\| 73.27 \|\|

*saṃnipātatastayo raudraḥ sainyayorabhavanmune \|*  
*mahīdharottame pūrvaṃ yathā vānarahastinoḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О sage! As the battle between monkeys and elephants took place during earlier period, the same fierce battle was fought amid both armies.

## \|\| 73.28 \|\|

*raṇareṇū rathoddhataḥ piṅgalo raṇamūrdhani \|*  
*saṃdhyānuraktaḥ sadṛśo meghaḥ khe suratāpasa \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О divine ascetic! The tawny battle-dust raised by the chariot wheels ascended to the sky and appeared like red cloud in the evening.

## \|\| 73.29 \|\|

*tadāsīt tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana \|*  
*śrūyate tvaniśaṃ śabdaḥ chindhi bhindhīti sarvataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. It was difficult to notice that who was killing to whom in that fierce battle. "Kill", "hurt" like words from the mouth of soldiers were only coming out there.

## \|\| 73.30 \|\|

*tato viśasano raudro daityānāṃ daivataiḥ saha \|*  
*jāto rudhiraniṣyando rajaḥ saṃyamanātmakaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. On account of dreadful killing made by gods and demons, the streams of blood started flowing which pressed the dust so flown to sky.

## \|\| 73.31 \|\|

*śānte rajasi devādyāstad dānavabalaṃ mahat \|*  
*abhidravanti sahitāḥ samaṃ skandena dhīmatā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. When dust was so pressed, the gods under lead of Kartikeya, attacked on the army of demons.

## \|\| 73.32 \|\|

*nijaghnurdānavān devāḥ kumārabhujapālitāḥ \|*  
*devān nijaghnurdaityāśca mayaguptāḥ prahāriṇaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The gods defended by Kartikeya killed the demons and the demons defended by Maya attacked fiercely on the gods.

## \|\| 73.33 \|\|

*tato'mṛtarasāsvādād vinā bhūtāḥ surottamāḥ \|*  
*nirjitāḥ samare daityaiḥ samaṃ skandena nārada \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О Narada! Then the mighty gods including Skanda were defeated by demons in war because they had no nectar to sip.

## \|\| 73.34 \|\|

*vinirjitān surān dṛṣṭvā vainateyadhvajo'rihā \|*  
*śārṅgamānamya bāṇaudhairnijaghāna tatastataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. When the rider of Garuda, the enemy killer god Visnu saw the gods defeated, he gave a bend to his Sarnga bow and began shooting arrows like rain.

## \|\| 73.35 \|\|

*te viṣṇunā hanyamānāḥ patattribhirayomukhaiḥ \|*  
*daiteyāḥ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ kālanemi mahāsuram \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The demons so being killed by the iron head arrows shot from Visnu resorted to the mighty demon Kalanemi.

## \|\| 73.36 \|\|

*tebhyaḥ sa cābhayaṃ dattvā jñātvā'jeyaṃ ca mādhavam \|*  
*vivṛddhimagamad brahman yathā vyādhirupekṣitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. O Brahmin! He assured the demons not being worry, he started forwarding as a disease towards the undefeated Madhava.

## \|\| 73.37 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ kareṇa spṛśati devaṃ yakṣaṃ sakinnaram \|*  
*taṃ tamādāya cikṣepa vistṛte vadane balī \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. That mighty Kalanemi began to grip Yaksa or Kinnara in his hand and put in mouth just then.

## \|\| 73.38 \|\|

*saṃrambhād dānavendro vimṛdati ditijaiḥ saṃyuto devasainyaṃ sendraṃ sārka sacandraṃ karacaraṇanakhairastrahīno'pi vegāt \|*  
*cakrairvaiśvānarāmaistvavanigaganayostiryagūrdhva samantāt prāpte'nte kālavaherjagadakhilamidaṃ rūpamā sīddidyakṣoḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. That demon lord inspite of having no weapons started inflicting nails, kicks and slaps on gods' army including Indra, Surya, moon etc. fiercely with strong support from the demons. He began to give blows upside sky and down on earth by using discus like fire blazed. Every direction was covered by such discus. His complexion at that time was looked analogous to the fire blazed for destruction of whole universe at the time of devastation.

## \|\| 73.39 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā varddhamānaṃ ripumatibalinaṃ devagandharvamukhyāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyāśvimukhyā bhayataraladṛśaḥ prādvan dikṣu sarve poplūyantaśva daityā harimamaragaṇairarcitaṃ cārumauliṃ nānāśastrāstrapātairvigalitayaśasaṃcakrurutsiktadarpāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. When gods, Gandharvas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Asvinikumaras etc. saw forwarding that mighty enemy, they frightened and began to flee here and there. The demons were exhilarated when they saw the gods fleeing. They were specially energised and jumped towards Visnu, the god adored by all gods with attractive 'crown he had and blew attacks on him with special arms and weapons.

## \|\| 73.40 \|\|

*tānityaṃ prekṣya daityān mayabalipuragān kālanemipradhānān bāṇairākṛṣya śārṅga tvanavaratamurobhedibhirvajrakalpaiḥ \|*  
*kopādāraktadṛṣṭiḥ sarathagajahayān dṛṣṭinirmūtavīryān nārācākhyaiḥ supuhu~rjaladaivagirīnchādayāmāsaviṣṇuḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. When god Visnu saw such aggressive efforts on part of demons i.e. Maya, Bali and Kalanemi, he became furious and his eyes reddened. He made the chariots, elephants and horses stand still merely by a gaze at them. As the clouds cover the sky, he then covered the entire hillock with special arrows called Naraca having attractive wings attached.

## \|\| 73.41 \|\|

*taibāṇaiśchādyamānā harikaranuditaiḥ kāladaṇḍaprakāśai- rnārācairarkhacandrairbalimayapuragā bhītabhītāstvarantaḥ \|*  
*prārambhe dānavendraṃ śatavadanamayo preṣayan kālanemi sa prāyāddevasainyaprabhumamitabalaṃ keśavaṃ lokanātham \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Bali and Maya etc. demons afraid of such severe attack by god Visnu as the crescent shaped Naraca arrows shot by him had covered them all. They sent very first to cope with Visnu, the mightiest hundred-faced demon-chief Kesava to Lokanatha.

## \|\| 73.42 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā śataśīrṣamudyatagadaṃ śailendraśṛṅgākṛtiṃ viṣṇuḥ śārṅgamapāsya satvaramatho jagrāha cakraṃ kare \|*  
*so'pyenaṃ prasamīkṣya daityaviṭapapracchedanaṃ māninaṃ provācātha vihasya taṃ ca suciraṃ meghasvano dānavaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. When Visnu saw Kalanemi analogous to the mountain ridge with one hundred heads and mace in his hand, he put the bow at rest and picked up immediately the discus. The demons gazed at Visnu laughed longer with a voice of thundering cloud and then addressed to Hari, the destroyer of demon like trees.

## \|\| 73.43 \|\|

*ayaṃ sa danuputrasainyavitrāsakṛdripuḥ paramakopitaḥ sa mavorvicātakṛt \|*  
*hiraṇyanayanāntakaḥ kusumapūjāratiḥ kva yāti mama dṛṣṭigocare nipatitaḥ khalaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. This is the highly indignant foe causing fear to the troops of demons, most furious, killer of Madhu, slaughterer of Hiranyaksa and pleased when flowers are offered. Where does this wicked may go now from escape of my eyes?

## \|\| 73.44 \|\|

*yadyeṣa samprati mamāhavamabhyupaiti nūnaṃ na yāti nilayaṃ nijamambujākṣaḥ \|*  
*manmuṣṭipiṣṭaśithilāṅgacupāttabhasma saṃdrakṣyate surajano bhayakātarākṣaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. If the lotus-eyed one now meets me in duel, I am sure he will not go back to his own house. The god-fold will, with terror-stricken eyes, find him kissing the dust, his limbs smashed and slackened by my fists.

## \|\| 73.45 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā madhusūdanaṃ vai sa kālanemiḥ sphuritādharoṣṭhaḥ \|*  
*gadāṃ khagendropari jātakopo mumoca śaile kuliśaṃ yathendraḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. With these words, Kalanemi giving a thrill to his both lips under sheer influence of anger, threw his mace on Garuda as Indra throws thunderbolt on the mountain.

## \|\| 73.46 \|\|

*tāmāpatantīṃ prasamīkṣya viṣṇu- ghorāṃ gadāṃ dānavabāhumuktām \|*  
*cakreṇa ciccheda sudurgatasya manorathaṃ pūrvakṛteva karma \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. God Visnu destroyed that dreadful mace thrown by that demon the same way as the pre-executed deeds destroy the ambitions of an unlucky man.

## \|\| 73.47 \|\|

*gadāṃ chittvā dānavābhyāśametya bhujau pīnau saṃpraciccheda vegāt \|*  
*bhujābhyāṃ kṛttābhyāṃ dagdhaśailaprakāśaḥ saṃdṛśyetāpyaparaḥ kālanemiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Visnu approached to that demon after he cut-off mace and immediately cut-off his study arms. Kalanemi without arms looked as next burnt moimtain.

## \|\| 73.48 \|\|

*tato'sya mādhavaḥ kopāt śiṣcakreṇa bhūtale \|*  
*chittvā nipātayāmāsa pakvaṃ tālaphalaṃ yathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Madhava then beheaded him by a sharp blow of discus and it fell down on the earth like Talaphala.

## \|\| 73.49 \|\|

*tathā vibāhurviśira \|*  
*muṇḍatālo yathā vane \|*  
*tasthau merurivākampyaḥ kabandhaḥ kṣmāyareśvaraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The trunk of Kalanemi without arms and head appeared as Mundatala in the forest yet it remain stood there.

## \|\| 73.50 \|\|

*taṃ vainateyo'pyurasā khagottamo nipātayāmāsa mune dharaṇyām \|*  
*yathā'mbarād bāhuśiraḥ praṇaṣṭa- balaṃ mahendraḥ kuliśena bhūmyām \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. О sage! As Mahendra had cut-off the arms and beheaded Bala through his attack by thunderbolt, Garuda the same way pushed on ground that trunk of Kalanemi by hitting through his chest.

## \|\| 73.51 \|\|

*tasminhate dānavasainyapāle saṃpīḍyamānastridaśaiśca daityāḥ \|*  
*vimuktaśastrālakacarmavastrāḥ saṃprādravan bāṇamṛte' surendrāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. When that commander-in-chief of demons was killed, all demons except Banasura ran away from there throwing their arms, shields and garments there as the gods had badly beaten them.

## Chapter 74. The fight of Asuras-Bali, Maya and other with the gods and the victory of demons

## \|\| 74.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- saṃnivṛtte tato bāṇe dānavāḥ satvaraṃ punaḥ \|*  
*nivṛttā devatānāṃ saśastrā yuddhalālasāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- "The demons again picked up their weapons and came back to the battlefield when Banasura began to fight again.

## \|\| 74.2 \|\|

*viṣṇurapyamitaujāstaṃ jñātvā'jeyaṃ baleḥ sutam \|*  
*prāhāmantrya surānsarvānyudhyadhvaṃ vigatajvarāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When the most valorous Visnu saw that mighty son of Bali is forwarding, he called all gods and said- "Do carry fighting fearlessly."

## \|\| 74.3 \|\|

*viṣṇunā'tha samādiṣṭā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*yuyudhurdānavaiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇu stvantaradhīyata \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The gods Indra etc. ordered by Visnu began fighting while god Visnu himself disappeared.

## \|\| 74.4 \|\|

*mādhavaṃ gatamājñāya śukro balimuvāca ha \|*  
*govindena surāstyaktāstvaṃ jayasvādhunā bale \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. When Sukra saw Madhava's absence, he said to Bali- "O Bali! Govinda has abandoned the gods. Now, proceed and be conqueror."

## \|\| 74.5 \|\|

*sa purohitavākyena prīto yāte janārdane \|*  
*gadāmādāya tejasvī devasainyamabhidrutaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The valorous Banasura exhilarated on encouragement given by Sukra. He took mace and rushed towards the army of gods.

## \|\| 74.6 \|\|

*bāṇo bāhusahasreṇa gṛhya praharaṇānyatha \|*  
*devasainyamabhidrutya nijaghāna sahasraśaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Banasura took weapons on his thousand arms, raided on the army of gods and killed several thousand gods.

## \|\| 74.7 \|\|

*mayo'pi māyāmāsthāya taiste rūpāntarairmune \|*  
*yodhayāmāsa balavān surāṇāṃ ca varūthinīm \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О sage! The mighty Maya also began fighting against the gods by representing him in varied complexions through the illusion.

## \|\| 74.8 \|\|

*vidyujjihnaḥ pāribhadro vṛṣaparvā śatekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*vipāko vikṣaraḥ sainyaṃ te'pi devānupādravan \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The demons Vidyujihva, Paribhadra, Vrsaparva, Sateksana, Vipaka and Viksara also made severe attack on the army of gods.

## \|\| 74.9 \|\|

*te hanyamānā ditijairdevāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*gate janārdane deve prāyaśo vimukhābhavan \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. On account of sudden absence made by god Visnu, Indra etc. gods got severe blows on their body and most of them were set aside from the war.

## \|\| 74.10 \|\|

*tān prabhagnān suragaṇānbalibāṇapurogamāḥ \|*  
*pṛṣṭhatastvadravansarve trailokyavijigīṣavaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. All demons intended to conquer the three- worlds including Bali and Bana rushed towards fleeing gods.

## \|\| 74.11 \|\|

*saṃbādhyamānā daiteyairdevāḥ sendrā bhayāturāḥ \|*  
*triviṣṭapaṃ parityajya brahmalokamupāgatāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Indra and other badly beaten gods were frightened, they left behind the heaven and went to the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 74.12 \|\|

*brahmalokaṃ gateṣvitthaṃ sendreṣvapi sureṣu vai \|*  
*svargabhoktā balirjātaḥ saputrabhrātṛvāndhavaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus, on departure of Indra etc. gods to the abode of Brahma, Bali became the king of heaven with his sons, siblings and kith and kins.

## \|\| 74.13 \|\|

*śakro'bhūd bhagavān brahmanvalirbāṇo yamo'bhavat \|*  
*varuṇo'bhūnmayaḥ somo rāhurhādo hutāśanaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О Brahmin! Bali became Indra and Bana became Yama. Similarly, Maya became Varuna and devil-head, moon and Prahlada became fire there.

## \|\| 74.14 \|\|

*svarbhānurabhavatsūryaḥ śukracchāsīdṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*ye'nye'pyadhikṛtā devāsteṣu jāttāḥ surārayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The devil-tail (Ketu) got the seat of sun god and Sukra substituted for Jupiter (Brhaspati). Similarly, the demons took over all designations of other several gods.

## \|\| 74.15 \|\|

*pañcamasya kalerādau dvāparānte sudāruṇaḥ \|*  
*devāsuro'bhūtsaṃgrāmo yatra śakro'pyabhūdvaliḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In the beginning of fifth Kali era and at later part of Dvapara, a fierce battle took place between the gods and demons. Bali became Indra that time.

## \|\| 74.16 \|\|

*pātālāḥ sapta tasyāsan vaśe lokatrayaṃ tathā \|*  
*bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti khyātaṃ daśalokādhipo baliḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The seven nether and three worlds known as Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah were under his ruling. Thus, Bali had become a king of ten worlds.

## \|\| 74.17 \|\|

*svarge svayaṃ nivasati bhuñjan bhogān sudurlabhān \|*  
*tatropāsata gandharvā viśvāvasupurogamāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Bali began to live in heaven with all luxuries for his enjoyments there. Visvavasu etc. Gandharvas started serving him.

## \|\| 74.18 \|\|

*tilottamādyāpsaraso nṛtyanti suratāpasāḥ \|*  
*vādayanti ca vādyāni yakṣavidyādharādayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О divine hermit! The nymphs Tilottama etc. always used to keep him happy through their expert dance and Yaksa as also Vidyadhara etc. used to play on musical instruments.

## \|\| 74.19 \|\|

*vividhānapi bhogāṃśca bhuñjan daityaiśvaro baliḥ \|*  
*sasmāra manasā brahmantrahlādaṃ svapitāmaham \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О Brahmin! The demon king Bali remembered his grandfather Prahlada while his days were passing in such comforts.

## \|\| 74.20 \|\|

*saṃsmṛto naghṛṇā cāsau mahābhāgavato'suraḥ \|*  
*samabhyāgāttvarāyuktaḥ pātālāt svargamavyayam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Prahlada, the great devotee to god Visnu ascended to the immortal heaven on the call from his grandson.

## \|\| 74.21 \|\|

*tamāgataṃ samīkṣyaiva tyaktvā siṃhāsanaṃ baliḥ \|*  
*kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vavande caraṇāvubhau \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Bali left his seat, stood-up immediately and honoured him with folded hands. When he saw grandfather has come.

## \|\| 74.22 \|\|

*pādayoḥ patitaṃ vīraṃ prahlādastvarito balim \|*  
*samutyāpya pariṣvajya viveśa paramāsane \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Prahlada quickly gave support of his hands to so bowed on feet Bali, made him to stand, gave a tight embrace and then seated comfortably.

## \|\| 74.23 \|\|

*taṃ baliḥ prāha bhostāta tvatprasādātpurā mayā \|*  
*nirjitāḥ śakrarājyaṃ ca hṛtaṃ vīryabalānmayā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Bali said to him- О grandfather! I have given a defeat to all gods and seized the kingdom of Indra under your kind grace.

## \|\| 74.24 \|\|

*tadidaṃ tāta madvīryavinirjitasurottamam \|*  
*trailokyarājyaṃ bhuñja tvaṃ mayi bhṛtye puraḥsthite \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О father! Please, enjoy the ruling of this three-worlds so seized from the gods by virtue of giving them defeat and I would like to register my presence as your orderly.

## \|\| 74.25 \|\|

*etāvatā puṇyayutaḥ syāmahaṃ tāta yat svayam \|*  
*tvadaṅgipūjābhiratastvaducchiṣṭānnabhojanaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O father! I will become a noble man by such service to you and by taking the residual food from you.

## \|\| 74.26 \|\|

*na sā pālayate rājyaṃ dhṛtirbhavati sattama \|*  
*na dhṛtirguruśuśrūṣāṃ kurvato jāyate vibho \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О great saint! О sovereign! The patience is learnt at the feet of preceptor and it is decayed while ruling a state (viz. service provides with the virtue of tolerance but ruling makes the man disobedient and rude).

## \|\| 74.27 \|\|

*tatastaduktaṃ balinā vākyaṃ śrutvā dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*prahlādo prāha vacanaṃ dharmakāmārthasādhanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O great Dvija! Prahlada replied favouring Dharma, Artha and Kama when he heard the request of his grandson.

## \|\| 74.28 \|\|

*mayā kṛtaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakaṃ purā praśāsitābhaḥ suhṛdo'nupūjitāḥ \|. dattaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ janitāstathā''tmajāḥ sthito bale samprati yogasādhakaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I have enjoyed the pleasure of ruling earlier without any hurdles. I have administered the earth and worshipped the friends. I already have made donations to the extent of my satisfaction and reproduced the sons. However, I am an ascetic this time.

## \|\| 74.29 \|\|

*gṛhītaṃ putra vidhivanmayā bhūyo'rpitaṃ tava \|*  
*evaṃ bhava gurūṇāṃ tvaṃ sadā śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О son! I have accepted all that you give and now I have returned it to you. Always maintain your obeisance for the preceptors as it is seen in you this time.

## \|\| 74.30 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ kare tvādāya dakṣiṇe \|*  
*śākre siṃhāsane brahmanbaliṃ tūrṇa nyaveśayat \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О Brahmin! With this reply, Prahlada took Bali with his right hand and enthroned him on the seat of Indra.

## \|\| 74.31 \|\|

*sopaviṣṭo mahendrasya sarvaratnamaye śubhe \|*  
*siṃhāsane daityapatiḥ śuśubhe maghavāniva \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. That demon king Bali looked like Indra himself when he took seat on that great throne of Indra which was studded with all gems.

## \|\| 74.32 \|\|

*tatropaviṣṭaścaivāsau kṛtāñjalipuṭo nataḥ \|*  
*prahlādaṃ prāha vacanaṃ medhagambhīrayā girā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Having seated on that throne, he said to Prahlada in serious voice, with folded hand and in polite tone.

## \|\| 74.33 \|\|

*yanmayā tāta kartavyaṃ trailokyaṃ parirakṣatā \|*  
*dharmārthakāmamokṣebhyastadādiśatu me bhavān \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О father! Kindly, tell me the duties as a king to three-worlds which could cover all aspects relating to Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa.

## \|\| 74.34 \|\|

*tadvākyasamakālaṃ ca śukraḥ prahlādamabravīt \|*  
*yadyuktaṃ tanmahābāho vadasvāsyottaraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Simultaneously, Sukra also said- "O great warrior! Give answer to what you think outright."

## \|\| 74.35 \|\|

*vacanaṃ baliśukrābhyāṃ śrutvā bhāgavato'suraḥ \|*  
*prāha dharmārthasaṃyuktaṃ prahlādo vākyamuttamam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Prahlada, the devotee of Visnu suggested the aspects covering all the aspects of Dharma and Artha when he heard the requests from Bali and Sukra simultaneously.

## \|\| 74.36-37 \|\|

*yadāyatyāṃ kṣamaṃ rājan yaddhitaṃ bhuvanasya ca \|*  
*avirodhena dharmasya arthasyopārjanaṃ ca yat \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sarvasattvānugamanaṃ kāmavargaphalaṃ ca yat \|*  
*paratreha ca yacchreyaḥ putra tatkarma ācara \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. О son! Capable of giving birth to good future, benevolent to the world, earning of wealth permissible in religion, consumption of things not disturbing any creature and an act appreciated in this material world and that metaphysical world is worth of executing. Hence, execute only such acts.

## \|\| 74.38 \|\|

*yathā ślāghyaṃ prayāsyadya yathā kīrtirbhavettava \|*  
*yathā nāyaśaso yogastathā kuru mahāmate \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О wise king! Do such a act that may deserve appreciation, bring in fame for you and not least infamy.

## \|\| 74.39-40 \|\|

*etadarthaṃ śriyaṃ dīptāṃ kāṅkṣante puruṣottamāḥ \|*  
*yenaitāni gṛhe'smākaṃ nivasanti sunirvṛtāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kulajo vyasane magnaḥ sakhā cārthabahiḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*vṛddho jñātirguṇī vipraḥ kīrtiśca yaśasā saha \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. The noble people intend to acquire specific wealth which can give shelter to noble but suffering man, poor friend, old aged scholar, meritorious Brahmin and the brilliant fame may thus come to their home.

## \|\| 74.41 \|\|

*tasmādyathaite nivasanti putra rājyasthitasyeha kulodgatādyāḥ \|*  
*tathā yatasvāmalasattvaceṣṭa yathā yaśasvī bhavitā'si loke \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Hence, О son! О good thinker and doer! Engage yourself in acts which may give shelter to the people bom in above noble families and which may bring in popularity for you.

## \|\| 74.42 \|\|

*bhūmyāṃ sadā brāhmaṇabhūṣitāyāṃ kṣatrānvitāyāṃ dṛḍhavāpitāyām \|*  
*śuśrūṣaṇāsaktisamudbhavāyā- mṛddhi prayāntīha narādhipendrāḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The great kings receive prosperity when the state ruled by them is duly filled by Brahmins, Ksatriyas, the land duly cultivated by Vaisyas and due services are given by Sudras.

## \|\| 74.43 \|\|

*tasmād dvijātryāḥ śrutiśāstrayuktā narādhipāṃste pratiyājayantu \|*  
*divyairyajantu kratubhirdvijendrā yajñāgnidhūmena nṛpasya śāntiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Hence, the great Brahmins duly known to scriptures should arrange yajna for the kings. Only learned Dvijas should do divine yajna. The smoke ascending from the fire of yajna ensures peace for the king.

## \|\| 74.44 \|\|

*tapo'dhyayanasaṃpannā yājanādhyāpane ratāḥ \|*  
*santu viprāḥ bale pūjyāstvatto'nujñāmavāpya hi \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О Bali! The Brahmins engrossed with the yajna executed according to the procedure prescribed by study on Vedas and teaching be honoured by receipt of your orders.

## \|\| 74.45 \|\|

*svādhyāyayajñaniratā dātāraḥ śastrajīvinaḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyāḥ santu daityendra prajāpālanadharmiṇaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О king of demons! Take care that the Ksatriyas should do perseverance and yajna, be generous, expert in arms and weapons as also keep the subject at charms.

## \|\| 74.46 \|\|

*yajñādhyayanasaṃpannā dātāraḥ kṛṣikāriṇaḥ \|*  
*pāśupālyaṃ prakurvantu vaiśyā vipaṇijīvinaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The Vaisyas under your ruling should perform yajna and study, they should be generous, agriculturist, businessmen and should do animal husbandry.

## \|\| 74.47 \|\|

*brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ sadā śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ \|*  
*śūdrāḥ santvasuraśreṣṭha tavājñākāriṇaḥ sadā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О demon king! The Sadras should do service to Brahmins, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas and should always observe the discipline imposed by you.

## \|\| 74.48 \|\|

*yadā varṇāḥ svadharmasthā bhavanti ditijeśvara \|*  
*dharmavṛddhistadā syādvai varmavṛddhau nṛpodayaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О Ditijesvara! When the people of all varnas observe their respective religions, the religion is definitely increased and the king obtains accession to on proper enhancement of the religion.

## \|\| 74.49 \|\|

*tasmādvarṇāḥ svadharmasthāstvayā kāryāḥ sadā bale \|*  
*tavṛddhau bhavato vṛddhistaddhānau hānirucyate \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Hence, О Bali! Always maintain the vamas in their respective religion/acts. You will receive progress when their religion will get good progress.

## \|\| 74.50 \|\|

*itthaṃ vacaḥ śrāvya mahāsurendro baliṃ mahātmā sa babhūva tūṣṇīm \|*  
*tato yadājñāpayase kariṣye ityaṃ baliḥ prāha vaco maharṣe \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Prahlada! The great man became silent with these words to Bali, О hermit! Bali then replied- "I shall act on the order so passed by you."

## Chapter 75. Description of wealth of Bali

## \|\| 75.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tato gateṣu deveṣu brahmalokaṃ prati dvija \|*  
*trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa balirdharmānvitaḥ sadā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О Dvija! Bali began ruling on three-worlds by observing the religion perpetually when the gods went to the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 75.2 \|\|

*kalistadā dharmayutaṃ jagadṛṣṭvā kṛte yathā \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ bheje svabhāvasya niṣevaṇāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When Kali era saw that all people under the rale of Bali are busy with their respective duties as per religion prescribed for them, he went to the shelter of Brahma with a request to bring back the situations in which he could sustain.

## \|\| 75.3 \|\|

*gatvā sa dadṛśe devaṃ sendrairdevaiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*svadīptyā dyotayantaṃ ca svadeśaṃ sasurāsuram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He saw Brahma there in company of Indra etc. gods when he reached. They were illuminating his abode with the mixed radiance.

## \|\| 75.4 \|\|

*praṇipatya tamāhātha tiṣyo brahmāṇamīśvaram \|*  
*mama svabhāvo balinā nāśito devasattama \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Kali bowed before Brahma and said- О great god! Bali has destroyed my nature completely.

## \|\| 75.5 \|\|

*taṃ prāha bhagavān yogī svabhāvaṃ jagato'pi hi \|*  
*na kevalaṃ hi bhavato hṛtaṃ tena balīyasā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The Yogi god Brahma said to Kali- "Not only yours but the nature of entire world has been abducted by that mightiest Bali.

## \|\| 75.6 \|\|

*paśyasva tiṣṭha devendraṃ varuṇaṃ ca samāstam \|*  
*bhāskaro'pi hi dīnatvaṃ prayāto hi balādbaleḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Kali! Look at Varuna and Indra including Marat. Bhaskara even has lost of his radiance before the radiance of Bali.

## \|\| 75.7 \|\|

*na tasya kaścit trailokye pratiṣeddhā'sti karmaṇaḥ \|*  
*ṛte sahastraṃ śirasaṃ hariṃ daśaśatāṅghrikam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Visnu with his one thousand heads and one thousand feet can only restrict his activities as nobody other than him is so capable.

## \|\| 75.8 \|\|

*sa bhūmi ca tathā nākaṃ rājyaṃ lakṣmīṃ yaśo'vyayaḥ \|*  
*samāhariṣyati baliḥ kartuḥ saddharmagocaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. That imperishable god shall abduct the land, heaven, state, wealth and fame received by Bali through his noble deeds.

## \|\| 75.9 \|\|

*ityevamukto devena brahmaṇā kaliravyayaḥ \|*  
*dīnāndūṣṭhā sa śakrādīnvibhītakavanaṃ gataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. When Brahma told him to Kali, he stared at Indra etc. gods and found them all faded. He then went into the forest called Vibhitaka.

## \|\| 75.10 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ prāvartata tadā kalernāśāt jagattraye \|*  
*dharmo'bhavaccatuṣpādaścāturvarthe'pi nārada \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Narada! Krtayuga spread throughout three-worlds when Kali is vanished and Catuspada religion was spread in four varnas.

## \|\| 75.11-12 \|\|

*tapo'hiṃsā ca satyaṃ ca śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ \|*  
*dayā dānaṃ tvānṛśaṃsyaṃ śuśrūṣā yajñakarma ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*etāni sarvajagataḥ parivyāpya sthitāni hi \|*  
*balinā balavān brahman tiṣyo'pi hi kṛtaḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The entire world got the people observing penance, non-violence, truthfulness, purity, celibacy, kindness, donation, politeness, service and performance of yajna. О Brahmin! Bali had converted the mighty Kali into Krtayuga.

## \|\| 75.13 \|\|

*svadharmasthāyino varṇā hyāśramāṃścāviśandvijāḥ \|*  
*prajāpālanadharmasthāḥ sadaiva manujarṣabhāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. All varnas duly settled with their respective religion, the Dvijas began to resort various asramas and the king began to observe his first and foremost religion of defending the subject properly.

## \|\| 75.14 \|\|

*dharmottare vartamāne brahmannasmiñjagattraye \|*  
*trailokyalakṣmīrvaradā tvāyātā dānaveśvaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О Brahmin! When the three-worlds was observing religion, the wealth goddess of three-worlds came to Bali.

## \|\| 75.15 \|\|

*tāmāgatāṃ nirīkṣyaiva sahasrākṣatriyaṃ baliḥ \|*  
*papraccha kā'si māṃ brūhi kenāpyarthena cāgatā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. When Bali saw the wealth of Indra came at this door, he asked- "Tell me that who are you and have come for what purpose?

## \|\| 75.16 \|\|

*sā tadvacanamākarṇya tadā śrīḥ padmamālinī \|*  
*bale śṛṇuṣva yā'smi tvāmāyātā mahiṣī balāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Laksmi adorned with the lotus garland, heard him and said- О Bali! I forcibly have come to you and please, listen to me."

## \|\| 75.17 \|\|

*aprameyabalo devo yo'sau cakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*tena tyaktastu maghavā tato'haṃ tvāmihāgatā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. God Visnu, the unique in power and discus as also mace in his hands has abandoned Indra. Hence, I have come to you.

## \|\| 75.18-20 \|\|

*sa nirmame yuvatyaśvatastro rūpasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*śvetāmbaradharā caiva śvetakhaganulepanā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śvetavṛndārakā ruḍha \|*  
*sattvāṭhyā śvetavigrahā \|*  
*raktāmbaradharā cānyā raktastraganulepanā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*raktvājisamārūḍhā raktāṅgī rājasī hi sā \|*  
*pītāmbarā pītavarṇā pītastraganulepanā \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Visnu had created four spinsters among which, the first was having ‘Sattva’ prominent, white complexion, white garments, white garland, smeared with white sandal and riding on white elephant. The second was ‘Rajasa’ prominent, red complexion, red garments on body, red garland, smeared with red sandal and riding on red colour horse.

## \|\| 75.21-26 \|\|

*sauvarṇasyandanacarā tāmasaṃ guṇamāśritā \|*  
*nīlāmbarā nīlamālyā nīlagandhānulepanā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*naulavṛṣasamārūḍhā triguṇā sā prakīrtitā \|*  
*yā sā śvetāmbarā śvetā sattvāḻyā kuñjarasthitā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sā brahmāṇaṃ samāyātā candraṃ candrānugānapi \|*  
*yā sā raktā rakttvāsanā vājisthā rajasānvitā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tāṃ prādāddevarājāya manave tatsameṣu ca \|*  
*pītāmbarā yā subhagā rathasthā kanakaprabhā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*prajāpatibhyastāṃ prādāt śukrāya ca viśaḥsu ca \|*  
*nīlavastrālisadṛśī yā caturthī vṛṣasthitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sā dānavānnairṛtāṃśca śūdrānvidyādharānapi \|*  
*viprādyāḥ śvetarūpāṃ tāṃ kathayanti sarasvatīm \|\| 26 \|\|*

21-26. The third was ‘Tamasa’ prominent, yellow complexion, yellow garments, yellow garland, yellow colour fragrance smeared and riding on chariot made of gold. The fourth was three properties mixed, blue complexion, blue garments, blue flower garland, fragrance and riding on blue colour bull. The Sattva prominent, white complexion, white garment and seating on white elephant goddess went to Brahma, moon-god and the followers of moon. The goddess having Rajasa prominent, red complexion, red garment and sitting on red colour horse was provided to the lord of gods, Manu and the people analogous to them. The goddess having gold complexion, yellow garments, sitting on chariot was given to Prajapatis, Sukra and Vaisyas. The goddess having blue garments, analogous to a bee, sitting on a bull was given to demons, Nairtas, Sudras and Vidyadharas. That white complexion goddess is called Sarasvati by Vipra etc.

## \|\| 75.27 \|\|

*stuvanti brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ makhe mantrādibhiḥ sadā \|*  
*kṣatriyā raktavarṇāṃ tāṃ jayaśrīmiti śaṃsire \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. They offer psalm to her in yajna by Brahma etc. through psalm etc. Ksatriyas say that goddess having red complexion as Jayasri.

## \|\| 75.28-30 \|\|

*sā candreṇāsuraśreṣṭha manunā ca yaśaśvinī \|*  
*vaiśyāstāṃ pītavasanāṃ kanakāṅgīṃ sadaiva hi \|\| 28 \|\|*

*stuvanti lakṣmīmityeva prajāpālāstathaiva hi \|*  
*śūdrāstāṃ nīlavarṇāṅgoṃ stuvanti ca subhaktitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śriyadevīti nāmnā tāṃ samaṃ daityaiśca rākṣasaiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ vibhaktāstā nāryastena devena cakriṇā \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. О great demon! She became illustrious in company of Indra and Manu. Vaisya and Prajapatis worship that yellow garment goddess having golden complexion calling her Laksmi. Sudras including demons and devils do offer psalm to that blue complexion goddess calling her Sridevi. Thus, that discus holding god classified those goddesses.

## \|\| 75.31-35 \|\|

*etāsāṃ ca svarūpasthāstiṣṭhanti nidhayo'vyayāḥ \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni vedāḥ sāṅgāstathoktayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*catuḥṣaṣṭikalāḥ śvetā mahāpadmo nidhiḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*muktāsuvarṇarajataṃ rathāśvajagabhūṣaṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śastrāstrādikavastūni raktā padmo nidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*gomahiṣyaḥ kharoṣṭrāṃ ca suvarṇāmbarabhūmayaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*oṣadhyaḥ paśavaḥ pītā mahānīlo nidhiḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*sarvāsāmapi jātīnāṃ jātirekā pratiṣṭhitā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*anyeṣāmapi saṃharjī nīlā śaṅkhane nidhiḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*etāsu saṃsthitānāṃ ca yāni rūpāṇi dānava \|*  
*bhavanti puruṣāṇāṃ vai tān nibodha vadāmi te \|\| 35 \|\|*

31-35. Imperishable Nidhis are existed in their complexion. History, Purina, Vedas with their parts (Angas), Veda, Smrtis, sixty four Kalis and Mahipadma Nidhi are vested with the goddess having white complexion. Pearls, gold, silver, chariot, horse, elephant, garments, weapons, arms and Padmanidhi in the form of garments are vested with the goddess having red complexion cow, buffalo, donkey, camel, gold, garments, land, medicines and Mahinlla Nidhi in the form of animal are vested with the goddess having yellow complexion. Sankha Nidhi in the form of the best among all castes embedding with her all other castes is existed with the goddess having blue complexion. О demon! Now I am going to describe the characteristics of Purusas falling under these complexions of Nidhis. Understand these all.

## \|\| 75.36 \|\|

*satyaśaucābhisaṃyuktā makhadānotsave ratāḥ \|*  
*bhavanti dānavapate mahāpadmāśritā narāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О demon king! The people sheltered to Mahapadma observe truth and purity and always engaged with performing yajna, donation and festivals.

## \|\| 75.37 \|\|

*yajvino subhagā dṛptā mālino bahudakṣiṇāḥ \|*  
*sarvasāmānyasukhino narāḥ padmāśritāḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The man with Padma perform yajna, enjoy luck, egoist, honour preferring, generous to high level and enjoy more pleasure as compared to the common people.

## \|\| 75.38 \|\|

*satyānṛtasamāyuktā dānāharaṇadakṣiṇāḥ \|*  
*nyāyānyāyavyayopetā mahānīlāśritā narāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The person vesting Mahanila are found using truth and false in mixed form, clever while doing transactions. They do justice, injustice and extravagant.

## \|\| 75.39-40 \|\|

*nāstikāḥ śaucarahitāḥ kṛpaṇā bhogavarjitāḥ \|*  
*steyānṛtakathāyuktā narāḥ śaṅkhāśritā bale \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathitastubhyaṃ teṣāṃ dānava nirṇayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. О Bali! The people vesting Sankha are found atheist, unclean, miser, away from luxury, thief and liar. О demon! I have thus, described their complexion to you.

## \|\| 75.41 \|\|

*ahaṃ sā rāgiṇī nāma jayaśrīstvāmupāgatā \|*  
*mamāsti dānavapate pratijñā sādhusaṃmatā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. That Jayasri addressed as Ragin! have now come to you. О demon king! I have made a promise duly confirmed by the gentlemen.

## \|\| 75.42 \|\|

*samāśrayāmi śauryābyaṃ na ca klīvaṃ kathaṃcana \|*  
*na cāsti bhavastulyo trailokye'pi balāyikaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. I always go to the bold man and seldom go to the impotent. Nobody in three-world is as mighty as you.

## \|\| 75.43 \|\|

*tvayā balavibhūtyā hi prītirme janitā dhruvā \|*  
*yattvayā yudhi vikramya devarājo vinirjitaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. You have won Indra by virtue of your valour shown in the war and thus, you have acquired my firm affection for you.

## \|\| 75.44 \|\|

*ato mama parā prītirjātā dānava śalyatī \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ sattvaṃ sarvebhyo'pi balādhikam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О demon! This is the reason I have become affectionate to you firmly and to the level best as you have supreme power and the best valour.

## \|\| 75.45-50 \|\|

*śauṇḍīryamāninaṃ vīraṃ tato'haṃ svayamāgatā \|*  
*nāścaryaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kule \|\| 45 \|\|*

*prasūtasyāsurendrasya tava karma cadīdṛśam \|*  
*viśeṣatastvayā rājandaiteyaḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*vijitaṃ vikramādyena trailokyaṃ vai parairhatam \|*  
*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ dānavendraṃ tadā balim \|\| 47 \|\|*

*jayaśrīścandravadanā praviṣṭā'dyotayacchubhā \|*  
*tasyāṃ cātha praviṣṭāyāṃ vidhavā iva yoṣitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*samāśrayanti balinaṃ līśrīdhīdhṛkīrtiyaḥ \|*  
*prabhā matiḥ kṣamā bhūtirvidyā nautirdayā tathā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*śrutiḥ smṛtidhṛti kīrtidhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ kriyānvitā \|*  
*puṣṭistuṣṭī rucistvanyā tathā sattvaśritā guṇāḥ \|*  
*tāḥ sarvā balimāśritya vyaśrāmyanta yathāsukham \|\| 50 \|\|*

45-50. Hence, I myself have come to you О most valorous and respected warrior. О the best demon! As you have bom in the family of Hiranyakasipu, your dead are therefore, not surprising at all. О king! The three-world seized by enemies has now again conquered by you bravely and thus, has enhanced the fame of your great grandfather, the son of Diti. With these word to the demon king Bali, the moon complexion goddess Jayasri entered in him and began radiating him. With her entrance, all other goddesses like Hri, Sri, Buddhi, Dhrti, Kirti, Prabha, Mati, Ksama, Samrddhi, Vidya, ethics, kindness, Sruti, Smrti, Murti, Santi, Kriya, Pusti, Tusti too began living with ease like widows under shelter of Bali.

## \|\| 75.51 \|\|

*evaṃguṇo'bhūddanupuṃgavo'sau balirmahātmā śubhabuddhirātmavān \|*  
*yajvā tapasvī mṛdureva satyavāāk dātā vibhartā svajanābhigoptā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The great soul Bali was thus enriched with positive mission, self realisation, asceticism, performance of yajna, courteous, truthful, generous, defender to his own people and began providing subject with nice maintenance.

## \|\| 75.52 \|\|

*triviṣṭapaṃ śāsati dānavendre nāsīkkṣudhārto malino na dīnaḥ \|*  
*sadojjvalo dharmarato'tha dāntaḥ kāmopabhoktā manujo'pi jātaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. During the regime of Bali in heaven, there was no person suffering from hunger, poverty and evil-doer. The human beings also became brilliant, religions, generous and dutiful.

## Chapter 76. Aditi obtains boon from Visnu

## \|\| 76.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- gate trailokyarājye tu dānaveṣu puraṃdaraḥ \|*  
*jagāma brahmasadanaṃ saha devaiḥ śacīpatiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- When the empire of three- worlds fell under the demons, Indra, the husband of Saci went to the abode of Brahma with all gods.

## \|\| 76.2 \|\|

*tatrāpaśyat sa deveśaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam \|*  
*ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhamāsīnaṃ pitaraṃ svaṃ ca kaśyapam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He saw there the lotus-bom Brahma and his father Kasyapa in the company of a number of hermits.

## \|\| 76.3 \|\|

*tato nanāma śirasā śakraḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ caiva tāṃstu sarvāṃstapodhanān \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Indra in company of all gods bowed his head before Brahma, Kasyapa and all those ascetics.

## \|\| 76.4 \|\|

*provācendraḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ devanāthaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*pitāmaha hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ balinā balinā mama \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Indra along with gods said to the god of gods Pitamaha- О Pitamaha! The mighty Bali has seized my empire.

## \|\| 76.5 \|\|

*brahmā provāca śanaitadbhujyate svakṛtaṃ phalam \|*  
*śakraḥ papraccha bho brūhi kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma said- О Indra! You are suffering from the account of pre-deeds performed by you. Indra asked- kindly, highlight the evils committed by me.

## \|\| 76.6 \|\|

*kaśyapo'pyāha deveśa bhrūṇahatyā kṛtā tvayā \|*  
*dityudarāt tvayā garbho kṛtto vai bahudhā balāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Kasyapa also said to Indra- “You have committed infanticide. You had once cut into several pieces the womb of Diti forcibly.”

## \|\| 76.7 \|\|

*pitaraṃ prāha devendraḥ sa māturdoṣato vibho \|*  
*kṛntanaṃ prāptavāngarbho yadaśaucā hi sā'bhavat \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Indra said to his father- “O sovereign! That womb was split due to the omission committed by mother as she had become defile.”

## \|\| 76.8 \|\|

*tato'bravīt kaśyapastu māturdoṣaḥ sa dāsatām \|*  
*gatastato vinihato dāso'pi kuliśena bho \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Kasyapa then replied- ‘‘On account of the fault committed by mother, that womb was become slave. You then hit hard by thunderbolt that slave too.”

## \|\| 76.9 \|\|

*tacchrutvā kaśyapavacaḥ prāha śakraḥ pitāmaham \|*  
*vināśaṃ pāpmano brūhi prāyaścittaṃ vibho mama \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Indra said to Pitamaha when heard this- “O sovereign! Kindly tell me the procedure for regrettal that could efface the sin.”

## \|\| 76.10 \|\|

*brahmā provāca deveśaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapastathā \|*  
*hitaṃ sarvasya jagataḥ śakrasyāpi viśeṣataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Brahma, Vasistha and Kasyapa told Indra the following procedure benevolent not only for him but for the entire world.

## \|\| 76.11 \|\|

*śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirmādhavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*taṃ prapadyasva śaraṇaṃ sa te śreyo vidhāsyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Go at shelter to Purusottama Madhav holding conch, discus and mace in hands. He will certainly do your all good.

## \|\| 76.12 \|\|

*sahasrākṣo'pi vacanaṃ gurūṇāṃ sa niśamya vai \|*  
*provāca svalpakālena kasmin prāpyo bahūdayaḥ \|*  
*tamūcurdevatā martya svalpakāle mahodayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. That thousand eyed god then enquired- "Where is possible the progress within short term?" The gods said to him- "It is only possible at short term on the earth."

## \|\| 76.13 \|\|

*ityevamuktaḥ surarāḍviriñcinā marīciputreṇa ca kaśyapena \|*  
*tathaiva mitrāvaruṇātmajena vegānmahīpṛṣṭhamavāpya tasthau \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. When so said by Brahma, Kasyapa, the son of Marici and Vasistha, the god's king Indra descended on the earth.

## \|\| 76.14 \|\|

*kālañjarasyottarataḥ supuṇya- stathā himādrerapi dakṣiṇasthaḥ \|*  
*kuśasthalātpūrvata eva viśruto vasoḥ purātpaścimato'vatasthe \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. He began to live at the holy place located at the north to Kalingara mountain, south to Himadri, east to Kusasthala and west to Vasupura.

## \|\| 76.15 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ gayena nṛvareṇa yatra yaṣṭo'śvamedhaḥ śatakṛtsudakṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*manuṣyamedhaḥ śatakṛtsassrakṛ narendrasūyca sahasrakṛd vai \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The king Gaya had during ancient period, executed one hundred sacrifices of horses, eleven hundred sacrifices of human beings and one thousand Rajasuya yajna with daksina in abundance.

## \|\| 76.16 \|\|

*tathā purā durvajanaḥ surāsuraiḥ khyāto mahāmedha iti prasiddhaḥ \|*  
*yatrāsya cakre bhagavān murāriḥ vāstavyamavyaktatanuḥ khamūrtimat \|*  
*khyātiṃ jagāmātha gadādhareti mahāghavṛkṣasta śitaḥ kuṭhāraḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When Gaya had performed the yajna called popularly Mahamedha rare to perform by the gods and demons, inexpressive and sky form Murari had lived that holy place. He then became popular as Gadadhara in the form of sharp axe for the largest tree of evils.

## \|\| 76.17 \|\|

*vasmindvijendrāḥ śrutiśāstravarjitāḥ samatvamāyānti pitāmahena \|*  
*sakṛt pitṛn yatra ca saṃprapūjya bhaktyā tvananyena mānavā \|*  
*phalaṃ mahāmedhamakhasya mānavā labhantyanantaṃ bhagavatprasādāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Where the great Brahmin receive the position of Pitamaha in spite of unknown to Vedas and scriptures. The man receives the unending fruit of Mahamedha under the grace of god even when he once offers worship to ancestors.

## \|\| 76.18 \|\|

*mahānadī yatra surarṣikaऱyā jalāpadeśāddhimaśailametya \|*  
*cakre jagatpāpavimuktamatryāṃ saṃdarśanaprāśanamajjanena \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. There flows the best Mahanadi, the virgin of divine hermit (Narada). It approaches to Himalaya in the form of water and decays the worldly evils by sipping, bathing and merely looking at her.

## \|\| 76.19 \|\|

*tatra śakraḥ samabhyetya mahānadyāstaṭe'dbhute \|*  
*ārādhanāya devasya kṛtvāśramabhavasthitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Indra went at the excellent bank of Mahanadi for worship of god Visnu and began living these in a cottage.

## \|\| 76.20 \|\|

*prātaḥ snāyī tvadhaḥ śāyī ekabhaktastvayācitaḥ \|*  
*tapastepe sahasrākṣaḥ stuvandevaṃ gadādharam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Indra observed a good routine consisting of bath, lying on ground, living on one time good in begged and by worshipping Gadadhara god.

## \|\| 76.21 \|\|

*tasyaivaṃ tapyataḥ samyag jitasarvendriyasya hi \|*  
*kāmakrodhavihīnasya sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro gataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He observed celibacy strictly and kept him free from sex and anger upto a year thereafter. Thus, his penance for a year was completed.

## \|\| 76.22 \|\|

*tato gadādharaḥ prīto vāsavaṃ prāha nārada \|*  
*gaccha prīto'smi bhavato mukta pāpo'si sāmpratam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Narada! Gadadhara Visnu then pleased and said to Indra- "I am pleased on you. You should now go because your sins have absolved."

## \|\| 76.23 \|\|

*nijaṃ rājyaṃ ca deveśa prāpsyase na cirādiva \|*  
*yatiṣyāmi tathā śakra bhāvi śreyo yathā tava \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О Indra! You shall now shortly take over your state. О Indra, I will do all that defend your interests.

## \|\| 76.24 \|\|

*ityevamukto'tha gadādhareṇa visarjitaḥ srāpya manoharāyām \|*  
*snātasya devasya tadainaso narā- staṃ procurasmānanuśāsayasva \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. With these words, Gadadhara suggested him to take bath in the river Manohara and then gave fare-well. When Indra took a dip, the evils till then existing with him said- "Give us permission to leave, please."

## \|\| 76.25 \|\|

*provāca tānbhīṣaṇakarmakārān nāmnā pulindānmama pāpasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*vasavvamevāntaramadrimukhyayo- himādrikālañjarayoḥ pulindāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Indra said to those evils- "As you have bom on account of the sins committed by me, you shall be addressed as Pulinda. Go and live in the middle of Himalaya and Kalinjara, two great mountain.

## \|\| 76.26 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā surarāṭ pulindān vimukta pāpo'marasiddhayakṣaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjyamāno'nujagāma cāśramaṃ mātustadā dharmanivāsamīḍyam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. With these words to Pulindas, the purified Indra got honour from gods, siddhas and yaksas and went to the cottage of his religious mother.

## \|\| 76.27 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā'ditiṃ mūrdhni kṛtāñjalistu vinamajjamauliḥ samupājagām \|*  
*praṇamya pādau kamalodarābhau nivedayāmāsa tapastadātmanaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Indra approached to Aditi with folded hands, bowed head, touched her lotus feet and then he described his penance before her.

## \|\| 76.28 \|\|

*papraccha sā kāraṇamīśvaraṃ tam āghrāya cāliṅgaya sahāśrudṛṣṭyā \|*  
*sa cācacakṣe balinā raṇe jayaṃ tadātmano devagaṇaiśca sārddham \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Aditi with tears in her eyes, smelt Indra, embraced her and asked the reason for his observing the so-called penance. Indra said the entire account of his defeat with all gods in a war against Bali.

## \|\| 76.29 \|\|

*śrutvaiva sā śokapariplutāṅgī jñātvā jitaṃ daityasutaiḥ sutaṃ tam \|*  
*duḥkhānvitā devamanādyamīḍyaṃ jagāma viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ vareṇyam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. When Aditi came to know about defeat of his son in the hands of Diti's sons, she suffered agony and grief. She therefore, sheltered to Visnu, the unborn and adorable god.

## \|\| 76.30 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- kasminjanitrī surasattamānāṃ sthāne hṛṣīkeśamanantamādyam \|*  
*carācarasya prabhavaṃ pramāṇa- mārādhayāmāsa śubhe vada tvam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Narada said- Please, tell us that the mother of gods, Aditi had at what place worshipped Hrsikesa, the unborn, unending, creator of movable and immovable world and the most ancient god.

## \|\| 76.31-32 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- surāraṇiḥ śakramavekṣya dīnaṃ parājitaṃ dānavanāyakena \|*  
*site'tha pakṣe makarakṣage'rke ghṛtārciṣaḥ syādatha saptame'hni \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭva devaṃ tridaśādhipaṃ taṃ mahodaye śakradiśā'dhirūḍham \|*  
*nirāśanā saṃyatavāksucittā tadopatasthe śaraṇaṃ surendram \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Pulastya said- When Aditi saw Indra seized of power of subjugated by Bali, sheltered to god sun with imposing control on mind and speech both when sun god enshrined on Capricorn zodiac, on the day of Surya Saptami and when she saw the sun rising at the east.

## \|\| 76.33 \|\|

*aditiruvāca- jayasva divyāmbujakośacaura jayasva saṃsārataroḥ kuṭhāra \|*  
*jayasva pāpenśdhanajātaveda staghaughasaṃrodha namo namaste \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Aditi said- О thief of divine Ambujakosa! Victory to you. О axe to the tree like world! Victory to you. О fire to the evil form fuel! Victory to you. О destroyer of darkness! Frequent salute to you.

## \|\| 76.34 \|\|

*namo'stu te bhāskara divyamūrte trailokyalakṣmītilakāya te namaḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvacarācarasya nātho'si māṃ pālaya viśvamūrta \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О Bhaskara! О divine icon! Salute to you. О husband of Laksmi of three-worlds! Salute to you. You are the cause for the movable and immovable world and administrator. О Visvamurti! Please, defend me.

## \|\| 76.35 \|\|

*tvayā jagannātha jaganmayena nāthena śakro nijarājyahānim \|*  
*avāptavan śakraparābhavaṃ ca tato bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О ruler of the world! It is due to your wish that made Indra loosing his empire and defeated by his enemy. Hence, I have come in shelter to you.

## \|\| 76.36-37 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā surapūjitaṃ sā ālikhya raktena hi candenana \|*  
*saṃpūjayitvā karavīrapuṣpaiḥ saṃdhūpya dhūpaiḥ kaṇamarkabhojyam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*nivedya caivājyuyataṃ mahārha- mantraṃ mahendrasya hitāya devī \|*  
*stavena puṇyena ca saṃstuvantī sthitā nirāhāramathopavāsam \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. She then draw a sketch of sun god with red sandal, worshipped by offering Karvira flower (kanail flowers), lighted Dhupa and grain worth consumable by sun as also best food cooked with ghee. She observed fast, recited sacred psalms and sat there for long.

## \|\| 76.38 \|\|

*tato dvitīye'hni kṛtapraṇāmā sātvā vidhānena ca pūjayitvā \|*  
*dattvā dvijebhyaḥ kaṇakaṃ tilājyaṃ tato'grataḥ sā prayatā babhūva \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. She did salute, took bath and worshipped on next day also and gave Brahmins kanaka, sesamum and ghee. Then see observed more hard penance.

## \|\| 76.39 \|\|

*tataḥ prīto'bhavadbhānughṛtārciḥ sūryamaṇḍalāt \|*  
*viniḥsṛtyāgrataḥ sthitvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. These acts in worship made Sun graceful. He came out from the orbit, stood up before Adili and said-

## \|\| 76.40 \|\|

*vratenānena suprītastavāhaṃ dakṣanandini \|*  
*prāpyase durlabhaṃ kāmaṃ matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О daughter of Daksa! I am very pleased on the fast observed by you. You therefore, shall definitely receive rare things by virtue of my grace.

## \|\| 76.41 \|\|

*rājyaṃ tvattanayānāṃ vai dāsye devi surāraṇi \|*  
*dānavān dhvaṃsayiṣyāmi saṃbhūyaivodare tava \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О mother of gods! I will take birth from your belly, bring back the throne for your sons and kill all demons.

## \|\| 76.42 \|\|

*tadvākyaṃ vāsudevasya śrutvā brahman surāraṇiḥ \|*  
*provāca jagatāṃ yoniṃ vepamānā punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Hearing those words of Vasudeva, О Brahman! Aditi with shivering body frequently said to Jagatyoni Visnu-

## \|\| 76.43 \|\|

*kathaṃ tvāmuderaṇāmahaṃ voḍhuṃ śakṣyāmi durdharam \|*  
*yasthodare jagatsarvaṃ vasetsthāvarajaṅgamam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. You hold this entire world consisting of movable and immovable. Then tell me that how my belly will hold you as baby?

## \|\| 76.44 \|\|

*kastvāṃ dhārayituṃ nātha śaktastrailokyadhāryasi \|*  
*yasya saptārṇavāḥ kukṣau nivasanti sahādribhiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О god! You hold this three-world. Your armpit holds seven seas including all mountains. Who then dare to hold you?

## \|\| 76.45 \|\|

*tasmādyathā surapatiḥ śakraḥ syātsurarāḍiha \|*  
*yathā ca na mama kleśastathā kuru janārdana \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Hence, О Janardana! Do such thing which one side restore the empire of gods and no bigger trouble caused to me on the other.

## \|\| 76.46 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca- satyametanmahābhāge durdharo'smi surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*tathāpi saṃbhaviṣyāmi ahaṃ devyudare tava \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Visnu said- О lucky lady! It is true that the gods and demons cannot hold me. I will still take birth from your womb.

## \|\| 76.47 \|\|

*ātmānaṃ bhuvanān śailāṃstvāñca devi sakaśyapām \|*  
*dhārayiṣyāmi yogena mā viṣādaṃ kṛthā'mbike \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О goddess! I will hold myself, the bhuvanas, the mountains and Kasyapa including you yourself through an exercise of Yoga. О mother! You need not worry at all.

## \|\| 76.48 \|\|

*tavodare'haṃ dākṣeyi saṃbhaviṣyāmi vai yadā \|*  
*tadā nistejaso daityāḥ saṃbhaviṣyantyasaṃśayam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О daughter of Daksa! the demons shall cross their splendour when I will establish as foetus in your belly.

## \|\| 76.49 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā bhagavān viveśa tasyāśca bhūyo'rigaṇapramardī \|*  
*svatejasoṃ'śena viveśa devyāḥ tadodare śakrahitāya vipra \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О Brahmana! With these words god Visnu, the killer of enemies, inserted in the belly of that goddess through a fraction of his splendour for safeguarding the interests of Indra.

## Chapter 77. Teachings of Prahlada to Bali

## \|\| 77.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- devamātuḥ sthite deve udare vāmanākṛtau \|*  
*nistejaso'surā jāta \|*  
*yathoktaṃ viśvayoninā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- According to the statement of Visvayoni (creator), the demons become powerless when the dwarf from god was inserted into the womb of the mother of gods.

## \|\| 77.2 \|\|

*nistejaso'surāndṛṣṭvā prahlādaṃ dānaveśvaram \|*  
*balirdānavaśārdūla idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When the mighty Bali saw the demons lost of splendour, he said Prahlada.

## \|\| 77.3 \|\|

*baliruvāca- tāta nistejaso daityāḥ kena jātāstu hetunā \|*  
*kathyatāṃ paramajño'si śubhāśubhaviśārada \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Bali said- О father! Kindly tell me the reason that why have the demons lost of power? О knower to all good and bad! You are supreme learned.

## \|\| 77.4 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tatpautravacanaṃ śrutvā muhūrta dhyānamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*kimarthaṃ tejaso hāniriti kasmādatīva vā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Pulastya said- Why and by whose effect the splendour of demons have receded was the question on which Prahlada concentrated his mind for a moment in order to see the clue and explain the same.

## \|\| 77.5 \|\|

*sa jñātvā vāsudevotthaṃ bhayaṃ daityeṣvanuttamam \|*  
*cintayāmāsa yogātmā kva viṣṇuḥ sāmprataṃ sthitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. As that soul of Yogi came to know the fear arisen due to Vasudeva, he pondered on tracing the presence of Visnu through his intuitive power.

## \|\| 77.6 \|\|

*adho nābheḥ sa pātālān sapta saṃcintya nārada \|*  
*nābherupari bhūrākṣīllokāṃścartumiyād vaśī \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Narada! In course of applying his intuitive power, he presumed and traced seven nether in the lower part of navel zone and then He saw lotus shaped land and the great lotus shaped Meru enriched with great prosperity and gold in the middle of that land.

## \|\| 77.7 \|\|

*bhūmiṃ tāṃ paṅkajākārāṃ tanmadhye paṅkajākṛtim \|*  
*meruṃ dadarśa śailendraṃ śātakumbhaṃ maharddhimat \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He saw eight rulers of loka (world) in Mahapuris upside and Vairajpuri upper side that Mahapuri. It was the abode of lord Brahma.

## \|\| 77.8 \|\|

*tasyopari mahāpuryastvaṣṭau lokapatīṃstathā \|*  
*teṣāmupari vairājī dadṛśe brahmaṇaḥ purīm \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Не saw below that the cottage of god's mother Aditi, a sacred place, adored by gods and filled with the birds and animals.

## \|\| 77.9 \|\|

*tadavastānmahāpuṇyamāśramaṃ surapūjitam \|*  
*devamātuḥ sa dadṛśe mṛgapakṣigaṇairvṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Не saw below that the cottage of god's mother Aditi, a sacred place, adored by gods and filled with the birds and animals.

## \|\| 77.10 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devajananīṃ sarvatejo'dhikāṃ mune \|*  
*viveśa dānavapatiranveṣṭuṃ madhusūdanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О sage! Having seen Aditi, filled with supreme splendour, Prahlada entered into the belly of Aditi in order to trace Madhusudana.

## \|\| 77.11 \|\|

*sa dṛṣṭavāñjagannāthaṃ mādhavaṃ vāmanākṛtim \|*  
*sarvabhūtavareṇyaṃ taṃ devamāturathodare \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. He saw that Madhava, the ruler of the world and the foremost among all beings, in the form of a dwarf man in her belly.

## \|\| 77.12-13 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam \|*  
*surāsuragaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvatto vyāptavigraham \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tenaiva kramayogena yogena dṛṣṭvā vāmanatāṃ gatam \|*  
*daityatejoharaṃ viṣṇuṃ prakṛtistho'bhavattataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. When he saw Pundarikaksa holding conch, discus and mace and all gods and demons merged with him, he immediately calculated by the same power of intuition that the cause for loss of demons energy is the incarnation of Visnu in dwarf form. Then, he gradually, came back to the normal state.

## \|\| 77.14 \|\|

*athovāca mahābuddhirvirocanasutaṃ balim \|*  
*prahlādo madhuraṃ vākyaṃ praṇamya madhusūdanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The wisest Prahlada then saluted Madhusudana and replied benevolent to Bali, the son of Virocana.

## \|\| 77.15 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca- śrūyatāṃ sarvanākhyāsye yato vo bhayamāgatam \|*  
*yena nistejaso daityā jātā daityendra hetunā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Prahlada said- О king of demon! The cause of fear an the effect of which has made demons loss of their energy is now known to me perfectly. Please, listen to what I am going to tell you.

## \|\| 77.16 \|\|

*bhavatā nirjitā devāḥ sendrarudrārkapāvakāḥ \|*  
*prayātāḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ tribhuvaneśvaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Rudra, Surya and fire etc. gods defeated by. you asked the shelter of Hari.

## \|\| 77.17 \|\|

*sa teṣāmabhayaṃ dattvā śakrādīnāṃ jagadguruḥ \|*  
*avatīrṇo mahābāhuradityā jaṭhare hariḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. That preceptor of world, the chivalrous Hari, had assured Indra etc. gods to live fearlessly and has now appeared in Indra etc. gods to live fearlessly and has now appeared in the womb of Aditi, the mother of gods.

## \|\| 77.18 \|\|

*hṛtāni vastena bale tejāṃsīti matirmama \|*  
*nālaṃ tamo vihituṃ śakraṃ sūryodayaṃ bale \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Bali! It is my opinion that he was abducted the splendour of you all, О Bali! Remember that the dark cannot bear the dawn.

## \|\| 77.19 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- prahlādavacanaṃ śrutvā krodhe prasphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*prahlādamāhātha balirbhāvikarmapracoditaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Pulastya said- When Bali heard the statement of Prahlada, his lips began vibrating up and down and as the future events cannot be restricted, Bali enquired Prahlada in anger.

## \|\| 77.20 \|\|

*baliruvāca- tāta ko'yaṃ harirnāma yato no bhayamāgatam \|*  
*santi me śataśo daityā vāsudevabalādhikāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Bali said- О father! Who is this Hari? Which has become cause for our fear. We have several hundred demons mightier than Vasudeva.

## \|\| 77.21 \|\|

*sahasraśo yairamarāḥ sendrarudrāgnimārutāḥ \|*  
*nirjitya tyājitāḥ svargaṃ bhagnadarpā raṇājire \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Those people had defeated, suppressed their ego and driven out from the territory of heaven the several thousands gods including Rudra, fire, mind and Indra etc.

## \|\| 77.22 \|\|

*yena sūryarathādvegāccakraṃ kṛṣṭaṃ mahājavam \|*  
*sa vipracittirbalavānmama sainyapurassaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. That mighty Vipracitti is the commander of my army. He had pulled the discus more speedy than the chariot of sun.

## \|\| 77.23-24 \|\|

*ayaḥ śaḍkuḥ śivaḥ śaṃbhurasilomā vilomakṛt \|*  
*triśirā makarākṣaśca vṛṣaparvā natekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ete cānye ca balino nānāyudhaviśāradāḥ \|*  
*yeṣāmekaikaśo viṣṇuḥ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Ayahsankha, Siva, Sambhu, Asiloma, Vilomakrt, Trisira, Makaraksa, Vrsaparva and Nateksana and other numerous experts in war are my assistants and Visnu is even not equal to the sixteenth friction of their power.

## \|\| 77.25-26 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- putrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā prahlādaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ \|*  
*dhigdhigityāha sa baliṃ vaikuṇṭhākṣe pavā dinam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dhiktvāṃ pāpasamācāra duṣṭabuddhi subāliśa \|*  
*hariṃ nindayato jihvā kathaṃ na patitā tava \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Pulastya said- Prahlada annoyed when he heard such criticism of god Visnu and cursed him- "I reprimand the evildoer and wicked fool like you. Why does your tongue not fall on ground while criticising god Visnu.

## \|\| 77.27 \|\|

*śocyastvasi durbuddhe nindanīyaśca sādhubhiḥ \|*  
*yattrailokyaguruṃ viṣṇumabhinindasi durmate \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. О fool! О wicked! You are condemnable for gentlemen and learned people because you are criticising Visnu, the only preceptor of three-worlds.

## \|\| 77.28 \|\|

*śocyaścāpi na saṃdeho yena jātaḥ pitā tava \|*  
*yasya tvaṃ karkaśaḥ putra jāto devāvamānyakaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I myself is also uncivilsed who reproduced you father because he in turn got such cruel and god critic son.

## \|\| 77.29 \|\|

*bhavānkila vijānāti tathā cāmī mahāsurāḥ \|*  
*yathā nānyaḥ priyaḥ kaścinmama tasmājjanārdanāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. You and these mighty demons undoubtedly know that there is no other person beloved me as Visnu himself.

## \|\| 77.30 \|\|

*jānannapi priyataraṃ prāṇebhyo'pi hariṃ mama \|*  
*sarveśvareśvaraṃ devaṃ kathaṃ ninditavānasi \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Hari is favourite to me more than my own breathing. You are known to this fact, yet deliberately you have criticised him before me.

## \|\| 77.31 \|\|

*guruḥ pūjyastava pitā pūjyastasyāpyahaṃ guruḥ \|*  
*mamāpi pūjyo bhagavāngururlokagururhariḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Your father is adorable and preceptor to you. I am preceptor and honourable to him. God Hari, preceptor of this entire universe is my preceptor and honourable too.

## \|\| 77.32 \|\|

*gurorgurugururmūḍha pūjyaṃ pūjyatamastava \|*  
*pūjya nindayase pāpa katha na patito'syadhaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О foolish evildoer! The preceptor to preceptor i.e. supreme preceptor is worth more respect and honour from you. You criticise the respected hence, why don't you decline.

## \|\| 77.33 \|\|

*śocanīyā durācārā dānavāmī kṛtāstvayā \|*  
*yeṣāṃ tvaṃ karkaśo rājā vāsudevasya nindakaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. You has made these evildoer demons more cruel and notorious as you the critic of Vasudeva are the ruler of them.

## \|\| 77.34 \|\|

*yasmātpūjyo'rcanīyaśca bhavatā nindito hariḥ \|*  
*tasmātpāpasamācāra rājyanāśamavāpnuhi \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О sinner! As you have criticised an adorable and honourable Hari, you will loss the rein of your ruling.

## \|\| 77.35 \|\|

*yathā nānyatpriyataraṃ vidyate mama keśavāt \|*  
*manasā karmaṇā vācā rājyabhraṣṭastathā pata \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. As nobody is more favourite to me than Hari to my mind, acts and speech. Hence, fall from the throne and suffer from the dishonour.

## \|\| 77.36 \|\|

*yathā na tasmādaparaṃ vyatiriktaṃ hi vidyate \|*  
*caturdaśasu lokeṣu rājyabhraṣṭastathā pata \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. As nobody than him is equal to his powers, hence, loss your throne and be an item to criticise.

## \|\| 77.37 \|\|

*sarveṣāmapi bhūtānāṃ nānyalloke parāyaṇam \|*  
*yathā tathā'nupaśyeyaṃ bhavantaṃ rājyavicyutam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. As nobody else than Vasudeva is the shelter of all worldly organisms, hence, may I see your fall from the throne.

## \|\| 77.38-39 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- evamucarite vākye baliḥ satvaritastadā \|*  
*avatīryāsanād brahmankṛtāñjalipuṭo balī \|\| 38 \|\|*

*śirasā praṇipatyāha prasāda yātu me guruḥ \|*  
*kṛtāparādhānapi hi kṣamante guravaḥ śiśūn \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Pulastya said- О Brahmin! The mighty Bali immediately alighted down from his throne, bowed his head with folded hands and said- "O preceptor! Kindly, please on me because preceptors pardon the disciples whenever any fault is committed on their part.

## \|\| 77.40 \|\|

*tatsādhu yadahaṃ śapto bhavatā dānaveśvara \|*  
*na bibhemi parebhyo'haṃ na ca rājyaparikṣayāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О mighty demon! You have all right to curse me. I am not afraid of enemies and decline of the throne too.

## \|\| 77.41 \|\|

*naiva duḥkhaṃ mama vibho yadaha rājyavicyutaḥ \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ kṛtāparādhatvādbhavato me mahattaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О sovereign! I feel no sorry for decline of state from my ruling. The only cause for my agony is that I have committed something so worse as you aggrieved.

## \|\| 77.42 \|\|

*tat kṣamyatāṃ tāta mamāparādho bālo'smayanātho'smi sudurmatiśca \|*  
*kṛte'pi doṣe guravaḥ śiśūnāṃ kṣāmyanti dainyaṃ samupāgatānām \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Hence, О father! Kindly, pardon me. I am an orphan and a child of caprice mind. The preceptors always pardon their students found guilt but when they express regret for the same.

## \|\| 77.43 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- sa evamukto vacanaṃ mahātmā vimuktamoho haripādabhaktaḥ \|*  
*ciraṃ vicintyādbhutametaditya- muvāca pautraṃ madhuraṃ vaco'tha \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Pulastya said- Prahlada, the greatman having detached feelings and extreme devotion to god Visnu's feet thought sometime and then reciprocated his grandson in these words-

## \|\| 77.44 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca- tāta mohena me jñānaṃ vivekśca tiraskṛtaḥ \|*  
*yena sarvagataṃ viṣṇuṃ jānaṃstvāṃ śaptavāhanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Prahlada said- О father! The affection had covered my discretion and understanding both. This was the reason, I cursed you while I am known very well to the fact that Visnu is omnipresent and omniscient.

## \|\| 77.45 \|\|

*nūnametena bhāvyaṃ vai bhavato yena dānava \|*  
*mamāviśanmahābāho vivekapratiṣedhakaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О demon! You had definitely such future and this very thing had inserted affection, the lock to the room of discretion within me at that moment.

## \|\| 77.46 \|\|

*tasmādrājyaṃ prati vibho na jvaraṃ kartumarhasi \|*  
*avaśyaṃbhāvino hyarthā na vinaśyanti karhicit \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Hence, О sovereign! Don't worry for the state. The preponderant matters seldom destroy.

## \|\| 77.47 \|\|

*putramitrakalatrārthe rājyabhogadhanāya ca \|*  
*āgame nirgame prājño na viṣādaṃ samācaret \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. A wise man should not feel dismay on arrival and departure of the son, friend, wife, royal luxuries and the wealth.

## \|\| 77.48 \|\|

*yathā yathā samāyānti pūrvakarmavidhānataḥ \|*  
*sukhaduḥkhāni daityendra narastāni sahettathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О king of demons! As the pleasure and grief come down according to the provision of pre-discharged activities, it is better to endure them all by establishing a possible coordination.

## \|\| 77.49 \|\|

*āpadāmāmagaṃ dṛṣṭvā na viṣaṇṇo bhavedvaśī \|*  
*saṃpadaṃ ca suvistīrṇāṃ prāpya no'dhṛtimān bhavet \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A resolute and balanced man should not fall prey to anxiety and never give up the shelter of patience when wealth in abundance knocks at his door.

## \|\| 77.50 \|\|

*dhanakṣaye na muhyanti na hṛṣyanti dhanāgame \|*  
*dhīrāḥ kāryeṣu ca sadā bhavanti puruṣottamāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The best people do not feel pleasure when wealth comes to them nor they feel dismay when it goes out. They always stand for their duties and seldom deviated.

## \|\| 77.51 \|\|

*evaṃ viditvā daityendra na viṣādaṃ kathaṃcana \|*  
*kartumarhasi vidvaṃstvaṃ paṇḍito nāvasīdati \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О lord of demons! You should not feel any bad for the curse inflicted by me due to my being blind in affection. You are scholar and a scholar never feels pain.

## \|\| 77.52 \|\|

*tathā'nyaca mahābāho hitaṃ śṛṇu mahārthakam \|*  
*bhavato'tha tathā'nyeṣāṃ śrutvā tacca samācara \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O warrior! Listen to the words in essence and benevolent for you yourself and all others and bring in practice these.

## \|\| 77.53 \|\|

*śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gaccha tametaṃ puruṣottamam \|*  
*sa te trātā bhayādasmāddānavendra bhaviṣyati \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О king of demons! Go to the shelter of that Purusottama who is yielder of refuge. He will only defend you from this fear.

## \|\| 77.54 \|\|

*ye saṃśrayanti harimīśamanādimadhyaṃ viṣṇuṃ carācaraguruṃ harimīśitāram \|*  
*saṃsāragartapatitasya karāvalamba nūnaṃ na te bhuvi narā jvariṇo bhavanti \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The people sheltering to Hari, Visnu, beyond the beginning, middle and end, preceptor to the movable and immovable worlds, the uplifter of the people fell in the worldly pit (trench) through his hands and regulating authority of all- definitely attain to all pleasure viz. never fall prey to the sorrow.

## \|\| 77.55 \|\|

*tanmanā dānavaśreṣṭha tadbhaktaśca bhavādhunā \|*  
*sa eṣa bhavataḥ śreyo vidhāsyati janārdanaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. O mighty demon! Engross your mind with that god and be his devotee. That Janardana will do your all welfare.

## \|\| 77.56 \|\|

*ahaṃ ca pāpopaśamārthamīśa- mārādhya yāsye prati tīrthayātrām \|*  
*vimuktapāpaśca tadā gamiṣye yatrācyuto lokapatirnṛsiṃhaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. I will also go on pilgrimage after due worship of god so as my sins could resolve. I will go where acyuta Nrsimha, the master of this entire universe is.

## \|\| 77.57 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- ityevamāśvāsya baliṃ mahātmā saṃsmṛtya yogādhipati ca viṣṇum \|*  
*āmantrya sarvāndanuyūthapālān jagāma kartuṃ tvatha tīrthayātrām \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Pulastya said- The great soul Prahlada summoned god Visnu, the king of Yogis after he consoled Bali this way and he went on journey with due permission of the ruler of demon communities.

## Chapter 78. Defeat of Dhundhu demon

## \|\| 78.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- kāni tīrthāni viprendra prahlādo'nujagāma ha \|*  
*prahlādatīrthayātrāṃ me samyagākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- О great Brahmin! How may pilgrims were visited by Prahlada? Describe the pilgrimage of Prahlada appropriately and with full account.

## \|\| 78.2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śṛṇu tvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi pāpapaṅkapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*prahlādatīrthayātrāṃ te śuddhapraṇyapradāyinīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- Listen please, the description on pilgrimage made by Prahlada capable to destroy the evil mud and provide sacred mind to execute noble deeds.

## \|\| 78.3 \|\|

*saṃtyajya meruṃ kanakācalendra tīrthaṃ jagāmāmarasaṃghajuṣṭam \|*  
*khyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ śubhadaṃ hi mānasaṃ yatra sthito matsyavapuḥ pureśaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He left behind the mountain Meru made up of gold and visited at the popular holy place addressed as Manasa Tirtha where gods reside and Suresa, in the form of a fish lives.

## \|\| 78.4 \|\|

*tasmistīrthavare snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya ca jagannāthamacyutaṃ śrutibhiryutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He worshipped at that holy place Acyuta Jagannatha with Vedic hymns after bath and tarpana made for the Pitrs or deceased ancestors and gods.

## \|\| 78.5 \|\|

*upoṣya bhūyaḥ saṃpūjya devarṣipitṛmānavān \|*  
*jagāma kacchapaṃ draṣṭuṃ kauśikyāṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Further, he worshipped with observing fasts, the gods, hermits, ancestors and human beings and went to see Kacchapa (tortoise) absolving evils in the river Kausiki.

## \|\| 78.6 \|\|

*tasyāṃ snātvā mahānadyāṃ saṃpūjya ja jagatpatim \|*  
*samupoṣya śucirbhūtvā dattvā vipreṣu dakṣiṇām \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He took bath in that great river, worshipped Jandrdana, observed fasts, purified him and gave daksina to Brahmins.

## \|\| 78.7 \|\|

*namaskṛtya jagannāthamatho kūrmavapurdharam \|*  
*tato jagāma kṛṣṇākhyaṃ draṣṭuṃ vājimukhaṃ prabhum \|*  
*tatra devahnade snātvā tarpayitvā pitṛnsurān \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He saluted Jagannatha existed there in the form of a tortoise and went to see the god having horse mouth and addressed as Krsna from there. He took bath in a reservoir Devahrda offered tarpana to the gods and pitaras, worshipped Hayagriva and then returned to Hastinapura.

## \|\| 78.8-9 \|\|

*saṃpūjya hayaśīrṣaṃ ca jagāma gajasāhvayam \|*  
*tatra devaṃ jagannāthaṃ govindaṃ cakrapāṇinam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*snātvā saṃpūjya vidhivat jagāma yamunāṃ nadīm \|*  
*tasyāṃ snātaḥ śucirbhūtvā saṃtarpyarṣisurānpitṛn \|*  
*dadarśa devadeveśaṃ lokanāthaṃ trivikramam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. He took bath there, worshipped Jagannatha Govinda god holding discus in his hand and then reached near Yamuna river. He took there bath too, do tarpana of hermits, pitaras and gods and finally, went to see Trivikrama, the god of gods and master of this world.

## \|\| 78.10-11 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- sāmprataṃ bhagavānviṣṇustrailokyākramaṇaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*kariṣyati jagatsvāmī balerbandhanamīśvaraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tatkathaṃ pūrvakāle'pi vibhurāsottrivikramaḥ \|*  
*kasya vā bandhanaṃ viṣṇuḥ kṛtavāṃstaca me vada \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. О Narada asked- God Visnu, the ruler of this world will now hold a body rising fear for the three-world and will thus, bind Bali. Therefore, how the all-pervading Visnu has been spoken of as having strided over the three worlds in three steps in former time also or tell me whom did Visnu bind?

## \|\| 78.12 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi yo'yaṃ proktastrivikramaḥ \|*  
*yasminkāle saṃbabhūva yaṃ ca vañcitavānasau \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Pulastya said- Listen carefully the introduction with Trivikrama, his period of birth and who was tied by him that time as being explained by me now.

## \|\| 78.13 \|\|

*āsīddhanyuriti khyātaḥ kaśyapasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*danorgarbhasamudbhūto mahābalaparākramaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A wedlock son of Kasyapa and Danu was mightiest and valorous. His name was Dhundhu.

## \|\| 78.14 \|\|

*sa samārādhya varadaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tapasā'suraḥ \|*  
*avadhyatvaṃ suraiḥ sendraiḥ prārthayat sa tu nārada \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О Narada! That demon worshipped Brahma, the great giver through strict penance and requested him to make him so strong as undefeated by Indra gods.

## \|\| 78.15 \|\|

*tad varaṃ tasya ca prādāt tapasā paṅkajodbhavaḥ \|*  
*parituṣṭaḥ sa ca balī nirjagāma triviṣṭapam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. When Brahma pleased on his penance, he booned him as desired. That mighty Dhundhu then went to heaven.

## \|\| 78.16 \|\|

*caturthasya kalerādau jitvā devānsavāsavān \|*  
*dhundhuḥ śakratvamakaroddhiraṇyakaśipau sati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. During initiation period of the fourth Kali when Hiranyakasipu was ruling Dhundhu conquered all gods including Indra and seized his throne.

## \|\| 78.17 \|\|

*tasminkāle sa balavānhiraṇyakaśipustataḥ \|*  
*cacāra mandaragirau daityo dhundhuṃ samāśritaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The mighty demon Hiranyakasipu used to stroll around Mandara mountain under subordination from Dhundhu.

## \|\| 78.18 \|\|

*tato'surā yathā kāmaṃ vicaranti triviṣṭape \|*  
*brahmaloke ca tridaśā saṃsthitā duḥkhasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The demons also began to live and enjoy the pleasure of heaven voluntarily. All gods were very anxious and began to live in the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 78.19 \|\|

*tato'marān brahmasado nivāsinaḥ śrutvā'tha dhundhurditijānuvāca \|*  
*vrajāma daityā vayamatrajasya sado vijetuṃ tridaśānsaśakrān \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. When Dhundhu heard of god's residing in abode of Brahma he said to demons- О demons! Let us march to the abode of Brahma to win Indra etc. gods.

## \|\| 78.20 \|\|

*te dhunyuvākyaṃ tu niśamya daityāḥ procurna no vidyatti lokapāla \|*  
*gatiryayā yāma pitāmahājiraṃ sudurgamo'yaṃ parato hi mārgaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*
