20\. When demons heard Dhundhu, they replied- О king! We are lack of that speed which may proceed us to the abode of Brahma. The route to Brahmaloka is inaccessible and very far from here.

## \|\| 78.21 \|\|

*itaḥ sahastrairbahuyojanākhyai- rloko maharnāma maharṣijuṣṭaḥ \|*  
*yeṣāṃ hi dṛṣṭyā'rpaṇacoditena dahyanti daityāḥ sahasekṣitena \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A world called Mahah is existed at several thousands yojana away from here. The hermits reside there. A sight of those hermits is so powerful as it can bum all demons.

## \|\| 78.22 \|\|

*tato'paro yojanakoṭinā vai loko jano nāma vasanti yatra \|*  
*gomātaro'smāsu vināśakāri yāsāṃ rajo'pīha mahāsurendraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A world known as "Jana" exists at another one crore yojana distance where the cows lie. О great king! The dust flown from their movement is of killing effect to us.

## \|\| 78.23 \|\|

*tato'paro yojanakoṭibhistu ṣaḍbhistapo nāma tapasvijuṣṭaḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭhanti yatrāsura sādhyaryā yeṣāṃ hi niśvāsamarut tvasahyaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The world "Тара" surrounded by ascetics is at another distance of six crore yojana. О demon! The great Sadhyas live there. The expirated air from them is intolerable to us.

## \|\| 78.24 \|\|

*tato'paro yojanakoṭibhistu triśandirādityasahasradīptiḥ \|*  
*satyābhidhāno bhagavannivāso varaprado'bhūdbhavato hi yo'sau \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Then there exists the world "Satya" radiating with the light of one thousand Adityas at a distance of thirty crore yojana thereafter. That world is the residence of that god who had provided you with a home.

## \|\| 78.25 \|\|

*yasya vedadhvaniṃ śrutvā vikasanti surādayaḥ \|*  
*saṃkocamasu \|*  
*yānti ye ca teṣāṃ saghārmiṇaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The gods etc. avail growth by hearing to the recital of Vedas from them and the demons as also their homogeneous receive recession to the growth.

## \|\| 78.26 \|\|

*tasmānmā tvaṃ mahābāho matimetāṃ samādadhaḥ \|*  
*vairājyabhuvanaṃ dhunyo durārohaṃ sadā nṛbhiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Hence, О warrior Dhundhu! Don't even think of this because the abode of Brahma is always impossible to ascend.

## \|\| 78.27 \|\|

*teṣāṃ vacanamākarṇya dhundhuḥ provāca dānavān \|*  
*gantukāmaḥ sa sadanaṃ brahmaṇo jetumīśvarān \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Hearing their words, Dhundhu, who intended to reach at Brahmaloka to win the gods; said to the demons-

## \|\| 78.28 \|\|

*kathaṃ tu karmaṇā kena gamyate dānavarṣabhāḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ tatra sahastrākṣaḥ saṃprāptaḥ saha daivataiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О warrior demons! How and by what manner one can access to there? How did Indra reach there with gods?

## \|\| 78.29 \|\|

*te dhundhunā dānavendrāḥ pṛṣṭāḥ procurvaco'dhipam \|*  
*karma tanna vayaṃ vidmaḥ śukrastadvettyasaṃśayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. On being enquired by the king, those demons replied- "We do not know that manner. However, there is no doubt that Sukracarya is known to this act."

## \|\| 78.30 \|\|

*daityānāṃ tu vacaḥ śrutvā dhuncurdaityapurohitam \|*  
*papraccha śukraṃ kiṃ karma kṛtvā brahmasadogatiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Hearing the words of demons, Dhundhu then asked Sukracarya, the priest of demons- "Please, tell me that what deed can enable to access at the abode of Brahma?"

## \|\| 78.31-32 \|\|

*tato'smai kathayāmāsa daityācāryaḥ kalipriyaḥ \|*  
*śakrasya caritaṃ śrīmānpurā vṛtraripoḥ kila \|\| 31 \|\|*

*śakraḥ śataṃ tu puṇyānāṃ ṛtūnāmajayat purā \|*  
*daityendra vājimedhānāṃ tena brahmasado gataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. O favourite to Kali! He was then told the activities of Indra, the enemy of Vrtra. (He said)- О demon king! Indra, during ancient period had performed one hundred Asvamedha yajnas. On account of this, he could went to the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 78.33-35 \|\|

*tadvākyaṃ dānavapatiḥ śrutvā śukrasya vīryavān \|*  
*yaṣṭuṃ turagamevānāṃ cakāra matimuttamām \|*  
*athāmantryāsuraguruṃ dānavāṃścāpyanuttamān \|\| 33 \|\|*

*provāca yakṣye'haṃ yajñaisśvamedhaiḥ sudakṣiṇaiḥ \|*  
*tadāgacchvvamavanīṃ gacchāmo vasudhādhipān \|\| 34 \|\|*

*vijitya hayamedhānyai yathākāmaguṇānvitān \|*  
*āhūyantāṃ ca nidhayastvājñāpyantāṃ ca guhyakāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The mighty lord of demon wished to perform Asvamedha yajna when he heard this from Sukracarya. He then invited the preceptor of demon and the selected demons and said- "I will organise Asvamedha yajnas and give daksina to the Brahmins. Hence, come with me. Let us move to the earn and perform Asvamedha voluntarily and appropriately by subjugating the kings call Nidhis and order Guhyakas."

## \|\| 78.36 \|\|

*āmantryantāṃ ca ṛṣayaḥ prayāmo devikātaṭam \|*  
*sā hi puṇyā saricchreṣṭhā sarvasiddhikarī śubhā \|*  
*sthānaṃ prācīnamāsādya vājimedhān yajāmahe \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Invite the hermits. Let us move to the bank of Devika river. That holy river is all benevolent and shall provide us with all success. We will organise yajna after reaching at that ancient place.

## \|\| 78.37 \|\|

*itthaṃ surārervadhanaṃ niśamyāsurayājakāḥ \|*  
*bāḍhamityabravīd hṛṣṭo nidhayaḥ saṃdideśaḥ saḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The preceptor of demon okayed the plan of that demon and he happily ordered Nidhis to come.

## \|\| 78.38 \|\|

*tato dhuncurdevikāyāṃ prācīne pāpanāśane \|*  
*bhārgavendreṇa śukreṇa vājimedhāca dīkṣitaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Sukra, the great Bhargava then reached at the bank of Devika river, the ancient holy place and consecrated Dhundhu for hosting the Asvamedha yajna.

## \|\| 78.39 \|\|

*sadasyā ṛtvijaśvāpi tatrāsan bhārgava \|*  
*dvijāḥ \|*  
*śukrasyānumate brahman śukraśivyāca paṇḍitāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О Brahmin! The disciples of Sukra and learned Brahmins of Bhargava clan became -the member and Rtvija to that yajna under instructions of Sukra.

## \|\| 78.40 \|\|

*yajñabhāgadhujastatra svarbhānupramukhā mune \|*  
*kṛtāmdhāsuranāthena śukrasyānumate surāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. O sage! The king of demons made Svarbhanu etc. demons the consumer (bhogi) to the oblation (havi) of that yajna under permission of Sukracarya.

## \|\| 78.41 \|\|

*tataḥ pravṛtto yajñastu samutsṛṣṭastathā hayaḥ \|*  
*havasthānuyayau śrīmānasilomā mahāsuraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The yajna then stated and horse was released free. The mighty demon Asiloma followed the path of that demon.

## \|\| 78.42 \|\|

*tato'gnidhūmena mahī saśailā vyāptā diśaḥ śaṃ vidiśaṣṭa pūrṇāḥ \|*  
*tenogragandhena divaspṛśena marudvavau brahmaloke maharṣe \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. O hermit! The smoke emitted from that yajna covered the earth with mountains, the ether, directions and sub-directions. The sky touching fragrance began to flow in the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 78.43 \|\|

*taṃ gandhamāghghrāya surā viṣaṇṇā jānanta dhundhuṃ hayamedhadīkṣitam \|*  
*tataḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ janārdanaṃ jagmuḥ saśakrā jagataḥ parāyaṇam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The gods were desperated by smelling that fragrance. They came to know that Dhundhu has taken consecration of Asvamedha. They thereafter, took shelter to Janardana including Indra as he is only shelter to all suffering people.

## \|\| 78.44 \|\|

*praṇamya varadaṃ devaṃ padmanābhaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*procuḥ sarve suragaṇā cacagadgadayā girā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. All gods saluted god Janardana, the lotus navel and great giver and said in sharp pain-

## \|\| 78.45 \|\|

*bhagavan devadeveśa carācaraparāyaṇa \|*  
*vijñaptiḥ śrūyatāṃ viṣṇo surāṇāmārtināśana \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О god of gods Visnu! You always remove gods from the trap of grief and do welfare to all movable and immovable organisms. Please, listen to bur submission in pain.

## \|\| 78.46 \|\|

*dhuncurnāmāsurapatirbalavān varavṛṃhitaḥ \|*  
*sarvānsurānvinirjitya trailokyamaharadvaliḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The king of demons, Dhundhu has taken sky rocketing growth. That mighty demon has conquered all gods and seized the three-world.

## \|\| 78.47 \|\|

*ṛte pinākino devāt trātā'smān na yato hare \|*  
*ato vivṛddhimagamadyathā vyādhirupekṣitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О Hari! There being no defender than Pinakin to gods, that demon has grown like a disease left in carelessness.

## \|\| 78.48 \|\|

*sāmprataṃ brahmalokasthānapi jetuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*śukrasya matamādāya so'śvamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. He now wants to conquer and subjugate us even in the abode of Brahma and he has consecrated under suggestions of Sukra for Asvamedha yajna.

## \|\| 78.49 \|\|

*śataṃ ṛtūnāmiṣṭhā'sau brahmalokaṃ mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*ārodumicchati vaśī vijetuṃ tridaśānapi \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. That might demon wants to get into Brahmaloka and defeat gods by virtue of one hundred Asvamedha sacrifice, he has already started.

## \|\| 78.50 \|\|

*tasmādakālahīnaṃ tu cintayasva jagahuro \|*  
*upāyaṃ makhavibvaṃse yena syāma sunirvṛtāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Hence, О preceptor of this whole universe! Please, do some immediate acts which may breach the process of Asvamedha, so arranged by him so that we all could take a sign of relief.

## \|\| 78.51-53 \|\|

*śrutvā surāṇāṃ vacanaṃ bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ \|*  
*dattvā'bhayaṃ mahābāhuḥ preṣayāmāsa sāmpratam \|*  
*visṛjya devatāḥ sarvā jñātvā'jeyaṃ mahāsuram \|\| 51 \|\|*

*bandhanāya matiṃ cakre dhunyordharmadhvajasya vai \|*  
*tataḥ kṛtvā sa bhagavān vāmanaṃ rūpamīśvaraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*dehaṃ tyaktvā nirālambaṃ kāṣṭhaddevikājale \|*  
*kṣaṇānmajjaṃstathonmajjanmuktakeśo yadṛcchayā \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. On hearing the words of gods, God Visnu assumed them living fearless and made them to return to Brahmaloka. He was well known that Dhundhu is religion abiding thereby undefeated. Hence, he thought fastening him under certain conditions. God Visnu then disguised Vamana (dwarf) and left him flowing with the water of Devika river like a wooden piece. Within a moment, the open hair god began giving up and down in the water of that river.

## \|\| 78.54-56 \|\|

*dṛṣṭo'tha daityapatinā daiteyaiścanyaistatharṣibhiḥ \|*  
*tataḥ karma parityajya yajñiyaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*samuttārayituṃ vipramādravanta samākulāḥ \|*  
*sadasyā yajamānaśca ṛtvijo'tha mahaujasaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*nimajjamānamujjahuḥ sarve te vāmanaṃ dvijam \|*  
*samuttārya prasannāste papracchuḥ sarva eva hi \|*  
*kimarthaṃ patito'sīha kenākṣipto'si no vada \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. He was seen to Dhundhu, the demons and other hermits organising that yajrla. The Brahmana left their attendance in yajna and rushed impatiently to rescue that Brahmins. All members, client and learned Rtvijas rescued that drowned Brahmins and asked- ”Tell us that why have you fallen here or who had thrown you?"

## \|\| 78.57 \|\|

*teṣāmākarṇya vacanaṃ kampamāno muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*prāha dhundhupurogāṃstāñchrayatāmatra kāraṇam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. He shivered frequently and then replied Dhundhu etc.- "Listen to its reason, please.

## \|\| 78.58 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo guṇavānāsītprabhāsa iti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*sarvaśāstrārthavitprājño gotrataścāpi vāruṇaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. There was a an excellent Brahmin called by Prabhasa, intellect and master of all scriptures, bom in the clan of Varuna.

## \|\| 78.59 \|\|

*tasya putradvayaṃ jātaṃ mandaprajñaṃ suduḥkhitam \|*  
*tatra jyeṣṭho mama bhrātā kanīyānaparastvaham \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He was blessed with two sons. Both of them were dull mind and suffering from palms. Out of them, I am younger and my brother was elder.

## \|\| 78.60 \|\|

*netrabhāsa iti khyāto jyeṣṭho bhrātā mamāsura \|*  
*mama nāma pitā cakre gatibhāseti kautukāt \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О demon! Му elder brother is popularly known as Netrabhasa. My father had gave me name as Gatibhasa with curiosity.

## \|\| 78.61 \|\|

*ramyaśvāvasatho banyo śubhavāsīt piturmama \|*  
*traviṣṭapaguṇairyuktaścārurūpo mahāsura \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. O mighty Dhundhu! The home of my father was attractive, pleasant, enriched with the divine qualities and beautiful.

## \|\| 78.62 \|\|

*tataḥ kālena mahatā āvayoḥ sa pitā mṛtaḥ \|*  
*tasyaurdhvadehikaṃ kṛtvā gṛhamāvāṃ samāgatau \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Later-on our father met to death on one fateful day. We performed the funeral rites and came back to home.

## \|\| 78.63 \|\|

*tato mayoktaḥ sa bhrātā vibhajāma gṛhaṃ vayam \|*  
*tenokto naiva bhavato vidyate bhāga ityaham \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. I then suggested my brother- "Let us do partition of the home. He said- "You have no shame at all in the home."

## \|\| 78.64 \|\|

*kubjavāmanakhañjānāṃ klībānāṃ śvitriṇāmapi \|*  
*unmattānāṃ tathā'ndhānāṃ dhanabhāgo na vidyate \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. It is because the humpbacked, dwarf, lame, impotent, leper, lunatic and blinds have no share with the property.

## \|\| 78.65 \|\|

*śayyāsanasthānamātraṃ svecchyānnabhujakriyā \|*  
*etāvaddīyate tebhyo nārthabhāgaharā hi te \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. They are only provided with a place for sleeping and a right to take food voluntarily. They seldom become claimant of the wealth.

## \|\| 78.66 \|\|

*evamukte mayā soktaḥ kimarthaṃ paitṛkād gṛhāt \|*  
*vanārthabhāgamarhāmi nāhaṃ nyāyena kena vai \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. I enquired him that on what justice and why am I not entitle to the half share in parental property?

## \|\| 78.67 \|\|

*ityuktvati vākye'sau bhrātā me kopasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*samutkṣipyākṣipannadyāmasyāṃ māmiti kāraṇam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. My elder brother was furiated on this statement from me, he picked-up my body and threw with full force into river.

## \|\| 78.68 \|\|

*mamāsyāṃ nimnagāyāṃ tu madhyena plavato gataḥ \|*  
*kālaḥ saṃvatsarākhyastu yuṣmābhiriha coddhataḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. I have completed more than the period of a year so floating on river. All of you have here rescued me.

## \|\| 78.69 \|\|

*ke bhavanto'tra saṃprāptāḥ sasnehā bāndhavā iva \|*  
*ko'yaṃ śakrapratimo dīkṣito yo mahābhujaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Who are all of you to whom I am gratified and consider as my kith and kins? Who is this valorous like Indra duly consecrated for yajna?

## \|\| 78.70 \|\|

*tanme sarvaṃ samākhyāta yāthātathyaṃ tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*mahaddhisaṃyutā yūyaṃ sānukampācha me bhṛśam \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. O ascetics! Tell me all this in detail. You all people are prosperous and have done special mercy on me.

## \|\| 78.71 \|\|

*tadvāmanavacaḥ śrutvā bhārgavā dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*procurvayaṃ dvijā brahman gotratacāpi bhārgavāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The Brahmins of Bhargava clan replied him- "O Brahmin! All of us are Brahmins from Bhargava race."

## \|\| 78.72 \|\|

*asāvapi mahātejā dhundhurnāma mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*dātā bhoktā vibhaktā ca dīkṣito yajñakarmaṇi \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The great demon Dhundhu was splendid and also a great donor, distributor and enjoyer demon. He has been consecrated in performance of yajna.

## \|\| 78.73 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā deveśaṃ vāmanaṃ bhārgavāstataḥ \|*  
*procurdaityaparti sarve vāmanārthakaraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. All Brahmins of Bhargava clan then turned towards demon's king Dhundhu and suggested him to do favour of the dwarf so saved from drowning.

## \|\| 78.74 \|\|

*dīyatāmasya daityendra sarvopaskarasaṃyutam \|*  
*śrīmadāvasathaṃ dāsyo ratnāni vividhāni ca \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О king of demons! Give him with a home enriched with all facilities including servants and a number of gems too.

## \|\| 78.75 \|\|

*iti dvijānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā daityapatirvacaḥ \|*  
*prāha dvijendra te dadmi yāvadicchasi vai dhanam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The king said on their suggestion- “O great Dvija! I will give you wealth to the extent desired by you.”

## \|\| 78.76 \|\|

*dāsye gṛhaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca vājinaḥ syandanān gajān \|*  
*pracacchāmyadya bhavato briyatāmīpsitaṃ vibho \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. О sovereign! Ask for all things desired by you. I will give you today the home, gold, horse, chariot and elephant.

## \|\| 78.77 \|\|

*tadvākyaṃ dānavapateḥ śrutvā devo'tha vāmanaḥ \|*  
*prāhāsurapatiṃ dhundhuṃ svārthasiddhikaraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Hearing the words of the lord of demons, the dwarf god very aptly stated to Dhundhu, his purposeful thing.

## \|\| 78.78 \|\|

*sodareṇāpi hi bhrātrā hriyante yasya saṃpadaḥ \|*  
*tasyākṣamasya yaddattaṃ kimanyo na haraṣyati \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Whether the donated property shall not be again seized from an unable man by others who could not acquire his right even on parental property?

## \|\| 78.79 \|\|

*dāsīrdāsāṃśca bhṛtyāṃśca gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ paricchadam \|*  
*samartheṣu dvijendreṣu prayacchasva mahābhuja \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. O warrior! Provide the great Brahmins with servants, maids, slaves, home, gems and good clothes too.

## \|\| 78.80 \|\|

*mama pramāṇamālokya māmakaṃ ca padatrayam \|*  
*saṃprayacchasva daityendra nādhika rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. О king of demons! Look at my body size and only provide me with three steps of land because I am not able to defend more than it.

## \|\| 78.81 \|\|

*ityevamuktaṃ vacanaṃ mahātmanā vihasya daityādhipatiḥ saṛtvijaḥ \|*  
*prādād dvijendrāya padatrayaṃ yadā yadā sa nānyaṃ pragṛhāṇaṃ kiṃcit \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. When that dwarf god did not accept anything else, the Rtvijas and demons king laughed at his demand but provided three steps measuring land.

## \|\| 78.82 \|\|

*kramatrayaṃ tāvadavekṣya dattaṃ mahāsurendreṇa vibhuryaśasvī \|*  
*cakre tato laṅghayituṃ trilokīṃ trivikramaṃ rūpamanantaśaktiḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. When the resolution was passed by the king, the illustrious sovereign held a Trivikrama form in order to measure the three worlds.

## \|\| 78.83 \|\|

*kṛtvā ca rūpaṃ ditijāṃśca hatvā praṇamya carṣīśca prathamakrameṇa \|*  
*mahīṃ mahīdhaiḥ sahitāṃ sahārṇavāṃ jahāra ratnākarapattanairyutām \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. He then killed the demops, saluted the hermits and measured in a step the whole earth consisting of mountains, seas, quarry of gems and cities.

## \|\| 78.84 \|\|

*bhuvaṃ sanākaṃ tridaśādhivāsaṃ somārkaṛkṣairabhimaṇḍitaṃ nabhaḥ \|*  
*devo dvitīyena jahāra vegāt krameṇa devapriyamīpsurīśvaraḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The god Vamana desirous of doing good for the gods measured Bhuvarloka with heaven, the abode of gods and the ether adorned with moon, sun and constellations with his second step.

## \|\| 78.85 \|\|

*kramaṃ tṛtīyaṃ na yadā'sya pūritaṃ tadā'tikopāhunupuṅgavasyā papāta pṛṣṭhe bhagavāṃstrivikramo merupramāṇena tu vigraheṇa \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. When his third step was not completed, then the glorious one of three steps fell on the back of the excellent demon with his body measuring as much as the Meru mountain.

## \|\| 78.86 \|\|

*patatā vāsudevena dānavopari nārada \|*  
*triṃśadyojanasāhasrī bhūmirgarta dṛḍhīkṛtā \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. О Narada! On account of Vasudeva's fall on a demon, a trench of thirty thousand yojana formed under ground.

## \|\| 78.87 \|\|

*tato daityaṃ samuttpāṭya tasyāṃ prakṣipya vegataḥ \|*  
*avarṣat sikatāvṛṣṭyā taṃ ca gartamapūrayat \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Having tron out the demon, he then threw the demon in the trench so formed and filled then that trench with sand.

## \|\| 78.88 \|\|

*tataḥ svargaṃ sahastrākṣo vāsudevaprasādataḥ \|*  
*suraṣṭha sarve trailokyamavāpurnirupadravāḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Indra then got heaven with the grace of Vasudeva and all gods thus, regained their respective places without any more hurdles in three-worlds.

## \|\| 78.89 \|\|

*bhagavānapi daityendraṃ prakṣipya sikatārṇave \|*  
*kālindyā rūpamādhāya tatraivāntaradhīyata \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The god again came back to his original form just after he threw the king of demons in the lump of sand at river Yamuna's bank and then, he vanished.

## \|\| 78.90 \|\|

*evaṃ purā viṣṇurabhūcca vāmano dhundhuṃ vijetuṃ ca trivikramo'bhūt \|*  
*yasminsa daityendrasuto jagāma mahāśrame puṇyayuto maharṣe \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Thus, god Visnu had become Vamana and Trivikrama in order to conquer Dhundhu. О hermit! Prahlada, the son of Hiranyakasipu visited at that asrama.

## Chapter 79. Legend of Pururava

## \|\| 79.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- kālindīsalile snātvā pūjayitvā trivikramam \|*  
*upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ liṅgabhedaṃ giriṃ yayau \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Prahlada worshipped Trivikrama after bath in the river of Yamuna, observed fast for a night and then went at the mountain addressed as Lingabheda.

## \|\| 79.2 \|\|

*tatra snātvā ca vimale bhava dṛṣṭvā ca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ tīrthaṃ kedāramāvrajata \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Не took bath in the holy water of Yamuna, worshipped Sankara with keen devotion and visited at the holy place Kedara after a night halt there.

## \|\| 79.3 \|\|

*tatra snātvā'rcya ceśāṃ mādhavaṃ cāpyabhedataḥ \|*  
*uṣitvā vāsarānsapta kubjāghraṃ prajagāma ha \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Не worshipped siva and Visnu after bath with indiscriminative mind, resided there for seven days and then moved to Kubjamra.

## \|\| 79.4 \|\|

*tataḥ sutīrthe srātvā ca sopavāsī jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*hṛṣīkeśaṃ samabhyarcya yayau badarikāśramam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Prahlada, the balanced mind demon took bath and observed fast there. He then worshipped god Hrsikesa and then went to Badarikasrama.

## \|\| 79.5 \|\|

*tatroṣya nārāyaṇamarthya bhaktyā snātvā'tha vidvānsa sarasvatījale \|*  
*vārāhatīrthe garuḍāsanaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā'tha saṃpūjya subhaktimāṃśca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. That learned Prahlada worshipped Narayana after bath in river Sarasvati while residing there. He then visited to Varaha- tirtha, saw Visnu rode on Garuda there and worshipped with keen devotion.

## \|\| 79.6 \|\|

*bhadrakarṇe tato gatvā jayeśaṃ śaśiśekharam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya ca śivaṃ vipāśāmabhito yayau \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He then visited at Bhadrakama, saw the god of victory Sasisekhara Siva there, worshipped that god and went towards Vipasa thereafter.

## \|\| 79.7-8 \|\|

*tasyāṃ snātvā samabhyarcya devadevaṃ dvijapriyam \|*  
*upavāsī irāvatyāṃ dadarśa parameśvaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

*samārādhya dvijaśreṣṭha śākale vai purūravāḥ \|*  
*samavāpa paraṃ rūpamaiśvaryaṃ ca sudurlabham \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Не took bath in Vipasa, observed fast, worshipped the god of gods and then went towards Iravati. О great Brahmin! He saw Paramesvara there. Pururava once got the best complexion and rare luxury when he worshipped the gods at Sakala.

## \|\| 79.9 \|\|

*kuṣṭharogābhibhūtaśca yaṃ samārādhya vai bhṛguḥ \|*  
*ārogyamatulaṃ prāpa saṃtānamapi cākṣayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Bhrgu had recovered health after attack of contagious disease called leprosy when he worshipped Paramesvara there. He also got children after convalescence.

## \|\| 79.10 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- kathaṃ purūravā viṣṇumārādhya dvijasattam \|*  
*virūpatvaṃ samutsṛjya rūpaṃ prāpa śriyā saha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Narada enquired- О great Dvija! How Pururava had regained the rare complexion leaning back the deformity as a result of worshipping god Visnu?

## \|\| 79.11 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*pūrvaṃ tretāyugasyādau yathāvṛttaṃ tapodhana \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Pulastya said- О great resolute! Listen to an ancient episode which took place during earlier part of Treta era to which I am going to describe.

## \|\| 79.12 \|\|

*madradeśa iti khyāto deśo vai brāhmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*śākalaṃ nāma nagaraṃ khyātaṃ sthānīyamuttamam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О son of Brahma! There was a province, known as Madradesa. In Madra state, there was a best city addressed as Sakala.

## \|\| 79.13 \|\|

*tasminvipaṇivṛttisvaḥ sadharmākhyo'bhavadvaṇik \|*  
*dhanāḍhyo guṇavānbhogī nānāśāstraviśāradaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. There lived a businessman named Sudharma, rich, meritorious, luxurious and learned to a number of scriptures.

## \|\| 79.14-15 \|\|

*sa tvekadā nijād rāṣṭrāt surāṣṭra gantumudyataḥ \|*  
*sārthena mahatā yukto nānāvipaṇipaṇyavān \|\| 14 \|\|*

*gacchataḥ pathi tasyātha marubhūmau kalipriya \|*  
*abhavad dasyuto rātrau skando'tiduḥ sahaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. He once became ready to departure towards Surasfta from his own country. О Kalipriya! When he was on the way through the desert in a caravan of businessmen with marketable items, the decoits attacked on them at a night.

## \|\| 79.16 \|\|

*tataḥ sa hṛtasarvasvo vaṇigduḥkhasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*asahāyo marau tasmiścacāronmattavadvaśī \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. That balanced mind Sudharma became very sad on such loot and seizure and began strolling like a mad man around the desert.

## \|\| 79.17 \|\|

*caratā tadaraṇyaṃ vai duḥkhākrāntena nārada \|*  
*ātmā iva śamīvṛkṣo marāvāsāditaḥ śubhaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О Narada! When he was moving hither and thither like a mad man, he could see a Sami tree in that desert and felt it like a good friend.

## \|\| 79.18 \|\|

*taṃ mṛgaiḥ pakṣibhiścaiva hīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā śamītarum \|*  
*śrāntaḥ kṣuttṛṭparītātmā tasyādhaḥ samupāviśat \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. That tree was without birds and there were no animals under it. Having seen it, the tired and hungry business man Sudharma sat under its shade.

## \|\| 79.19 \|\|

*suptaścāpi suviśrānto madhyāhne punarutthitaḥ \|*  
*samapaśyadathāyāntaṃ pretaṃ pretaśatairvṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He slept for hours and could get up in the noon and saw a Preta forwarding in company of several thousand Pretas.

## \|\| 79.20 \|\|

*uhyamāntamathā'nyena pretena pretanāyakam \|*  
*piṇḍāśibhiśca purato dhāvandrī rūkṣavigrahaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. That commander of Preta was being carried by another Preta. The dried body Pindasi (Preta) were rushing front to him.

## \|\| 79.21 \|\|

*athājagāma preto'sau paryaṭitvā vanāni ca \|*  
*upagāmya śamīmūle vaṇikputraṃ dadarśa saḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. That Preta came back after sufficient touring in forests and he saw that businessman Sudharma when reached at the Sami tree.

## \|\| 79.22 \|\|

*svāgatenābhiva \|*  
*dyainaṃ samābhāṣya parasparam \|*  
*sukhopaviṣṭaśchāyāyāṃ pṛṣṭvā kuśalamāptavān \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He saluted Sudharma courteously and Sudharma greeted him. They mutually conversated. Then the Preta sat under the shade of that tree comfortably and duly introduced with Sudharma.

## \|\| 79.23 \|\|

*tataḥ pretādhipatinā pṛṣṭaḥ sa tu vaṇiksakhaḥ \|*  
*kutaṃ āgamyate brūhi kva sādho vā gamiṣyasi \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The commander of Pretas then asked that merchant- “O gentleman! Tell me the place of your arrival and where will you go now?”

## \|\| 79.24 \|\|

*kathaṃ cedaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ mṛgapakṣivivarjitam \|*  
*samāpanno'si bhadraṃ te sarvamākhyātumarhasi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. I wish your good. Tell me that how have you come in this largest forest where no birds and animals are living?

## \|\| 79.25 \|\|

*evaṃ pretādhipatinā vaṇikpṛṣṭaḥ samāsataḥ \|*  
*sarvamākhyātavān brahman svedaśavanavicyutim \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О Brahmin! In reply to the enquiry, that businessman explained in brief the name of his country and the event causing loss of his wealth.

## \|\| 79.26 \|\|

*tasya śrutvā sa vṛttāntaṃ tasya duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*vaṇikputraṃ tataḥ prāha pretapālaḥ svabandhuvat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Having heard his complete story, the commander of Preta became sad, treated him as his own brother and said to that son of businessman-

## \|\| 79.27 \|\|

*evaṃ gate'pi mā śokaṃ kartumarhasi suvrata \|*  
*bhūyo'pyarthā bhaviṣyanti yadi bhāgyabalaṃ tava \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. ”O great resolute! You should not be felt grief even if this all has happened. In case, you are supported by fortune, the wealth will come again to you.”

## \|\| 79.28 \|\|

*bhāgyakṣaye'rthāḥ kṣīyante bhavantyabhyudaye punaḥ \|*  
*kṣīṇasyāsya śarīrasya cintayā nodayo bhavet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The wealth is decayed when not supported by the destiny. Again the proceeds starts deeming when luck is again supportive. If this body is deteriorated in worry, nothing like progress can be achieved.

## \|\| 79.29 \|\|

*ityucārya samāhṛya svānmṛtyānvākyamabravīt \|*  
*adyātithirayaṃ pūjyaḥ sadaiva svajano mama \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. With these words, he called his attendants and ordered- "Girl all entertainment to this guest who has become my brother like now."

## \|\| 79.30 \|\|

*asmindṛṣṭe vaṇikputre yathā svajanadarśanam \|*  
*asminsamāgate pretāḥ prītirjātā mamātulā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. After seeing this son of the merchant it has seemed to me as if I have seen my own man. О ghosts! “I am happy to see him here.”

## \|\| 79.31-32 \|\|

*evaṃ hi vadatastasya mṛtpātraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam \|*  
*dadhyodanena saṃpūrṇamājagāma yathepsitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tathā navā ca sudṛḍhā saṃpūrṇā paramāmbhasā \|*  
*vāridhānī ca saṃprāptā pretānāmagrataḥ sthitā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. A new clay pot was immediately brought by ghosts. It was filled up with curd and odana. Then there appeared before ghosts, a water pot filled-up with pure drinking water.

## \|\| 79.33 \|\|

*tāmāgatāṃ sasalilamannaṃ vīkṣya mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*prāhottiṣṭha vaṇikputra tvamāhnikamucāpara \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The high-minded when saw that food and water said- "O the son of a merchant! Stand- up please and eat these things."

## \|\| 79.34 \|\|

*tatastu vāridhānyāstau salilena vidhānataḥ \|*  
*kṛtāhnikāvubhau jātau vaṇik pretapatistathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Subsequently, the merchant and the commander of Pretas both performed their routine activities prior to feeding. They use the pure water from the pitcher for this purpose.

## \|\| 79.35 \|\|

*tato vaṇiksutāyāsau dadhyodanamathecchayā \|*  
*dattvā tebhyaśca sarvebhyaḥ pretebhyo vyadadāt tataḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The commander of Preta then offered curd and food sufficient to that businessman and all Pretas received it thereafter.

## \|\| 79.36 \|\|

*bhuktavatsu ca sarveṣu kāmato'mbhasi sevite \|*  
*anantaraṃ sa bubhuje pretapālo varāśanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. When all of them have taken sufficient food and refreshment, that commander took himself that food.

## \|\| 79.37 \|\|

*prakāmatṛpte prete ca vāridhānyodanaṃ tathā \|*  
*antaryānamagādbrahmanvaṇiputrasya paśyataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. When Preta duly satiated, the water pot and food vessel immediately vanished and it surprised the businessman.

## \|\| 79.38 \|\|

*tatastadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa matimān vaṇik \|*  
*papraccha taṃ pretapālaṃ kautūhalamanā vaśī \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Seeing that very great wonder, that powerful merchant, with his mind filled with curiosity, enquired that lord of ghosts-

## \|\| 79.39 \|\|

*araṇye nirjane sādho kuto'nnasya samudbhavaḥ \|*  
*kutaśca vāridhānīyaṃ saṃpūrṇā paramāmbhasā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. “O gentleman! The pitchers containing food and water suddenly appeared here and then vanished when all of us are satiated. This phenomenon presses me to ask you that from which place, they had been come.”

## \|\| 79.40-41 \|\|

*tathāmī tava ye bhṛtyāstvattaste varṇataḥ kṛśāḥ \|*  
*bhavānapi ca tejasvī kiṃcitpuṣṭavapuḥ śubhaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śuklavastraparīdhāno bahūnāṃ paripālakaḥ \|*  
*sarvametanmamācakṣva ko bhavān kā śamī tviyam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Who are these attendants thinner then you in body? Again you, a little bit sturdy body, white dressed, glowing complexion and provider of food to so many Pretas are still strange to me. So, please, give me your introduction. Please, tell me in detail that who are you and what is this Sami tree.

## \|\| 79.42 \|\|

*itthaṃ vaṇiksutavacaḥ śrutvā'sau pretanāyakaḥ \|*  
*śaśaṃsa sarvamasyāṣṭāṃ yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. When commander of Pretas heard businessman's curiosity, he described in detail about him.

## \|\| 79.43 \|\|

*ahamāsaṃ purā vipra śākale nagarottame \|*  
*somaśarmeti vikhyāto bahulāgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. (He said)- long ago I was bom from the womb of Bahula, my mother in a city called Sakala. I got the name as Somasarma, a renowned Brahmin during his life-span.

## \|\| 79.44 \|\|

*mamāsti ca vaṇik śrīmāntrātiveśyo mahādhanaḥ \|*  
*sa tu somaśravā nāma viṣṇubhakto mahāyaśāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Somasrava was my neighbour. He was prosperous and wealthy businessman. He was illustrious and devotee to god Visnu.

## \|\| 79.45 \|\|

*so'haṃ kadaryo mūḍhātmā dhane'pi sati durmatiḥ \|*  
*na dadāmi dvijātibhyo na cāśnāmyannamuttamam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. In spite of my being prosperous too, I was miser and fool. I neither gave donation to Dvijatis nor consume that money in luxuries.

## \|\| 79.46 \|\|

*pramādādyadi bhuñje'haṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtānvitam \|*  
*tato rātrau nṛbhir ghoraistāḍyate mama vigrahaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. If any day I took by mistake the edibles like curd, sweet dish (rice cooked with milk) and products cooked in ghee; the dreadful people used to beat me at night.

## \|\| 79.47 \|\|

*prātarbhavati me ghorā mṛtyutulyā viṣūcikā \|*  
*na ca kaścinmamābhyāse tatra tiṣṭhati bāndhavaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. On next morning, it was the routine that cholera caught to me with dire dysentery. Nobody among my own family members used to stay and serve me that time.

## \|\| 79.48 \|\|

*kathaṃ kathamapi prāṇā mayā saṃpratidhāritāḥ \|*  
*evametādṛśaḥ pāpī nivasāmyatinirvṛṇaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Anyhow I served myself and lived alone. Thus, I was living a evil some and shameless life.

## \|\| 79.49 \|\|

*sauvīratilapiṇyākasatuśākādibhojanaiḥ \|*  
*kṣapayāmi kadannādyairātmānaṃ kālayāpanaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. I was deteriorating my health by living merely on jujube fruits, oil-cake of sesamum, sattu (groats of barley-meal) and vegetable etc. Thus, anyhow my life passed.

## \|\| 79.50 \|\|

*evaṃ tatrāsato mahāṃ mahānkālo'bhyagādatha \|*  
*śravaṇadvādaśī nāma māsi bhādrapade'bhavat \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. I lived there prolong and once the auspicious day of Sravana Dvadasi fell in the month of Bhadrapada (August).

## \|\| 79.51 \|\|

*tato nāgariko loko gataḥ snātuṃ hi saṃgamam \|*  
*irāvatyā naḍvalāyā brahmakṣatrapurassaraḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Brahmins, Ksatriya etc. varnas people went for taking bath in the confluence of Iravati and Nadvala rivers.

## \|\| 79.52 \|\|

*prātiveśyaprasaṅgena tatrāpyanugato' smyaham \|*  
*kṛtopavāsaḥ śucimānekādaśyāṃ yatavrataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. On persuasion of my neighbour, I too followed those people. I observed fast On Ekadasi with all care to sanctity.

## \|\| 79.53-54 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃgamatoyena vāridhānoṃ dṛḍhāṃ navām \|*  
*saṃpūrṇāṃ vastusaṃvītāṃ chatropānahasaṃyutām \|\| 53 \|\|*

*mṛtpātramatimṛṣṭasya pūrṇa dadhyodanasya ha \|*  
*pradataṃ brāhmaṇendrāya śucaye jñānadharmiṇe \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. I offered the learned and religious Brahmins as donation a numerous things including umbrella, shoes, water pots filled with the water of confluence and clay pots filled with sweet, curd and food.

## \|\| 79.55 \|\|

*tadeva jīvatā dattaṃ mayā dānaṃ vaṇiksuta \|*  
*varṣāṇāṃ saptatīnāṃ vai nānyaddattaṃ hi kiṃcana \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. O businessman! That was single donation which I made during the life-span of seventy years. Nothing else it was donated by me throughout life.

## \|\| 79.56 \|\|

*mṛtaḥ pretatvamāpanno dattvā pretānnameva hi \|*  
*amī cādattadānāstu madannenopajīvinaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. I became Preta after death as I had only donated that food for Preta. The people living on the food offered by me had never donated anything in their lives.

## \|\| 79.57 \|\|

*etatte kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ yattadannaṃ mayāmbhasā \|*  
*dattaṃ tadidamāyāti madhyāhne'pi dine dine \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. I have told the reason for the phenomenon seen by you that at every noon, the food and water donated that day appears before me.

## \|\| 79.58 \|\|

*yāvannāhaṃ ca bhuñjāmi na tāvatkṣayameti vai \|*  
*mayi bhukte ca pīte ca sarvamantarhitaṃ bhavet \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. It is undepleted till I take but as soon as I am satiated with that food and drink, it is vanished.

## \|\| 79.59 \|\|

*yaccātapatramadadaṃ so'yaṃ jātaḥ śamītaruḥ \|*  
*upānadyugale datte preto me vāhano'bhavat \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. The umbrella I donated to Brahmins provides me shelter and shade in the form of Sami tree. A pair of shoes given by me has provided me with a carriage of Preta.

## \|\| 79.60 \|\|

*idaṃ tavoktaṃ dharmajña mayā kīnāśatātmanaḥ \|*  
*śravaṇadvādaśīpuṇyaṃ tavoktaṃ puṇyavardhanam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. О religious man! I have told you the reason for my being a Preta simultaneous to the description on Sravana Dvadasi, an auspicious and benevolent day.

## \|\| 79.61 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane vaṇikputro'bravīdvacaḥ \|*  
*yanmayā tāta karttavyaṃ tadanujñātumarhasi \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The businessman said- "O brother! Order me that what good should I do for you."

## \|\| 79.62 \|\|

*tattasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vaṇikputrasya nārada \|*  
*pretapālo vacaḥ prāha svārthasiddhikaraṃ tataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Hearing the words of that businessman, О Narada! The commander of Preta replied with a statement which was good for him.

## \|\| 79.63 \|\|

*yattvayā tāta kartavyaṃ maddhitārthaṃ mahāmate \|*  
*karyāyaṣyāmi tat samyak tava śreyaskaraṃ mama \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О wise man! I tell the thing you capable to do for my welfare. In case, you execute in properly, it will endow with the good for both.

## \|\| 79.64 \|\|

*gayāyāṃ tīrthajuṣṭāyāṃ snātvā śaucasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*mama nāma samuddiśya piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuru \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Please, go at the holy place Gaya and observe fast there. Then, do Pindadana for me there.

## \|\| 79.65 \|\|

*tatra piṇḍapradānena pretabhāvādahaṃ sakhe \|*  
*muktastu sarvadātṛṇāṃ yāsyāmi sahalokatām \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. О friend! Your deed (Pindadana) will ensure my relieve from this Pretayoni and the abode of the people who donate all they had.

## \|\| 79.66 \|\|

*yatheyaṃ dvādaśī puṇyā māsi prauṣṭhapade sitā \|*  
*budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā sā'tiśreyaskarī smṛtā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Dvadasi (the twelfth day of bright fortnight) with Sravana constellation and Wednesday of the month Pausa (January) is said the most auspicious day for Pindadana.

## \|\| 79.67 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā vaṇijaṃ pretarājo'nugaiḥ saha \|*  
*svanāmāni yathānyāyaṃ samyagākhyātavāñchuciḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. With these words to that businessman, the commander of Pretas explained his and all other Pretas name to him.

## \|\| 79.68 \|\|

*pretaskandhe samāropya tyājito marumaṇḍalam \|*  
*ramye'tha śūrasenākhye deśe prāptaḥ sa vai vaṇik \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. He was provided a Preta to carry on shoulder and thus, he sent-off that desert area. Thus, that businessman reached in the attractive country known as Surasena.

## \|\| 79.69 \|\|

*svakarmadharmayogena dhanamucāvacaṃ bahu \|*  
*upārjayitvā prayayau gayāśīrṣamanuttamam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. He earned the precious and common wealth by putting at stake his activities and religion and thus, became wealthy soon. He then went at the holy place of Gayasirsa.

## \|\| 79.70 \|\|

*piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tatra pretānāmanupūrvaśaḥ cakāra svapitṛṇā ca dāyādānāmanantaram \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. He did there Pindadana for relieve of Pretas and then gave Pindas to his ancestors and coparceners too.

## \|\| 79.71 \|\|

*ātmanaśca mahabuddhirmahābodhyaṃ tilairvinā \|*  
*piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ cakre tathānyānapi gotrajān \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. That wise man did Pindadana called Mahabodhya without sesamum for himself. Pindadana for other kith and kins was thereafter also made by him.

## \|\| 79.72 \|\|

*evaṃ pradatteṣvatha vai piṇḍeṣu pretabhāvataḥ \|*  
*vimuktāste dvijāḥ pretā brahmalokaṃ tato gatāḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. О Dvija! Those Preta relieved from their existing yoni by virtue of such Pindadana made by that businessman and went to the abode of Brahma.

## \|\| 79.73 \|\|

*sa cāpi hi vaṇikputro nijamālayamāvrajata \|*  
*śravaṇadvādaśīṃ kṛtvā kāladharmamupeyivān \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. That businessman also returned to his home and observed fast on Sravana Dvadasi regularly till his last breath.

## \|\| 79.74 \|\|

*gandharvaloke suciraṃ bhogānmuktvā sudurlabhān \|*  
*mānuṣyaṃ janmamāsādya ca babhau śākale virāṭ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. He thereafter enjoyed the rare luxuries prolong in the abode of Gandharvas and then became the king of Sakalapuri on rebirth as a man.

## \|\| 79.75 \|\|

*svadharmakarmavṛttisthaḥ śravaṇadvādaśīrataḥ \|*  
*kāladharmamavāpyāsau guhyakāvāsamāśrayat \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. He again observed fast on Sravana Dvadasi regularly coincide skilfully tackling the stately affairs.

## \|\| 79.76 \|\|

*tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ bhogānyuktvā'tha kāmataḥ \|*  
*matryalokamanuprāpya rājanyatanayo'bhavat \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. He enjoyed a number of luxuries there for prolong period, maintained himself on the throne and then descended to the earth. Here too he became a prince.

## \|\| 79.77 \|\|

*tatrāpi kṣatravṛttistho dānabhogarato vaśī \|*  
*gograhe'rigaṇāñjitvā kāladharmamupeyivān \|*  
*śakralokaṃ sa saṃprāpya devaiḥ sarvaiḥ supūjitaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Here he again followed the conduct of a Ksatriya and satisfied him with luxuries and donations in a balanced manner. Once upon a time, he suppressed the cow abductors but then met to natural death. He then went to the abode of Indra and honoured by all gods there.

## \|\| 79.78 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayātparibhraṣṭaḥ śākale so'bhavadvijaḥ \|*  
*tato vikaṭarūpo'sau sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. He lived in heaven till the account of noble deeds not squared up. Then he came to earth and became Brahmin in Sakala country. He was of fierce complexion but all scriptures were duly known to him.

## \|\| 79.79-81 \|\|

*vivāhayadvijasutāṃ rūpeṇānupamāṃ dvija \|*  
*sāvamene ca bhartāraṃ suśīlamapi bhāminī \|\| 79 \|\|*

*virūpamiti manvānā tatasso'bhūt suduḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*tato nirvedasaṃyukto gatvāśramapadaṃ mahat \|\| 80 \|\|*

*irāvatyāstaṭe śrīmānrūpadhāriṇamāsadat \|*  
*tamārādhya jagannāthaṃ nakṣatrapuruṣeṇa hi \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. О Dvija! He married with an excellent beautiful Brahmin's daughter. That lady used to dishonour her husband because of being his ugly face and never could see his merits. On account of such attitude from spouse, the Brahmin became very sad. One day he abandoned all his love for her, reached at a great asrama located on the bank of Iravati river and began worshipping Jagannatha in the form of Naksatra Purusa, the beautiful god.

## \|\| 79.82 \|\|

*surūpatāmavāpyābhyāṃ tasminneva ca janmani \|*  
*tataḥ priyo'bhūdbhāryāyā bhogavāṃścābhavadvaśī śravaṇadvādaśībhaktaḥ pūrvābhyāsādajāyata \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. He thus, regained beautiful complexion after some time and got affection and love from her wife. He further, became prosperous by the grace of god so worshipped. As the habit of observing fast of Sravana Dvadasi descending since pre-births, he maintained it in this life too.

## \|\| 79.83 \|\|

*evaṃ purā'sau dvijapuṅgavastu kurūparūyo bhagavatprasādāt \|*  
*anaṅgarūpapratimo babhūva mṛtaśca rājā sa purūravā'bhūt \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. In spite of being ugly complexion earlier, that Brahmin got a beautiful complexion analogous to sex god and became Pururava after death.

## Chapter 80. The rules for observing Naksatra-Purusa- vrata

## \|\| 80.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- purūravā dvijaśreṣṭha yathā devaṃ śriyaḥ patim \|*  
*nakṣatrapuruṣākhyena ārādhayata tadvada \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- О great twice-bom! Please describe the fast known as Naksatra Purusa and followed by Pururava for the worship of Vasudeva, the husband of goddess Laksmi.

## \|\| 80.2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi nakṣatrapuruṣavratam \|*  
*nakṣatrāṅgāni devasya yāni yānīha nārada \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- О Narada! I enumerate the Naksatra Purusa fast and the constellation form organs of that god. Please, listen to it attentively.

## \|\| 80.3 \|\|

*mūlakṣa caraṇau viṣṇorjaḍḍe dve rohiṇī smṛte \|*  
*dve jānunī tathā'śvinyau saṃsthite rūpavāriṇaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The constellation Mula is both feet of Visnu, Rohini is both pubic and Asvini is existed in the form of his both legs.

## \|\| 80.4 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe dve dvayaṃ corvorguhmasvaṃ phālgunīdvayam \|*  
*kaṭisthāḥ kṛttikācaiva vāsudevasya saṃsthitāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The constellations Purvasadha and Uttarasadha exist at both thighs of Vasudeva, Purvaphalguni and Uttaraphalguni constellations at anus region and Krttika constellation exists at the loin of Vasudeva.

## \|\| 80.5 \|\|

*prauṣṭhapadyādvayaṃ pārśve kukṣibhyāṃ revatī sthitā ūraḥ saṃsthā tvanurādhā śraniṣṭhā pṛṣṭasaṃsthitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The constellations Purvabhadrapada and Uttarabhadrapada exist at both collaterals, Revati at both armpits, Anuradha at the chest and Dhanistha at the rear region.

## \|\| 80.6 \|\|

*viśākhā bhujayorhastaḥ karadvayamanuttamama punarvasurathoṅgulyo nakhāḥ sārpa tathocyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Visakha exists at both arms, Hasta at both hands, Punarvasu exist at fingers and Aslesa at the nails.

## \|\| 80.7 \|\|

*grīvāsthitā tasya jyeṣṭhā śravaṇaṃ karṇayoḥ sthitam \|*  
*mukhasaṃsthastathā puṣyaḥ svātirdantāḥ prakīrtitā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Jyestha in neck, Sravana in both ears, Pusya in mouth and Svati constellation exist at the teeth of Vasudeva.

## \|\| 80.8 \|\|

*hanū dve vāruṇaścokto nāsā paitra udāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*mṛgaśīrṣa nayanayo rūpadhāriṇi tiṣṭhati \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Satabhisa at both chins, Magha at the nose and Mrgasirsa exists at the eyes of beautiful god.

## \|\| 80.9 \|\|

*citrā caiva lalāṭe tu bharaṇī tu tathā śiraḥ \|*  
*śiroruhasthā caivārdrā nakṣatrāṅgamidaṃ hareḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Citra exists at forehead, Bharani at the head, Ardra at hair and thus, the complete body of Visnu is formed of constellations. Hence, it is Naksatra-sarira of god.

## \|\| 80.10 \|\|

*vidhānaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathānyāyena nārada \|*  
*saṃpūjito hariḥ kāmān vidadhāti yathepsitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Narada! I will now describe the fast, procedure of which pleases god Visnu to the extent that he renders with all desired fruits.

## \|\| 80.11 \|\|

*caitramāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ yadā mūlagataḥ śaśī \|*  
*tadā tu bhagavatpādau pūjayet tu vidhānataḥ \|*  
*nakṣatrasannidhau dadyādviprendrāya ca bhojanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. One should worship the feet of god when moon enters in Mula constellation and the day is the eighth of bright fortnight in the month of Caitra (March). The Brahmins should be fed in the existence of that constellation.

## \|\| 80.12 \|\|

*jānunī cāśvinīyoge pūjayedatha bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*dohadaṃ ca haviṣyānnaṃ pūrvavad dvijabhojanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Both knees of god are to be adored with obeisance when there exists Asvini constellation. He cereal prepared for oblation (havi) should be used as massage and Brahmins should be offered with food.

## \|\| 80.13 \|\|

*āṣāḍhābhyāṃ tathā dvābhyāṃ dvāvūrū pūjayed budhaḥ \|*  
*salilaṃ śiśiraṃ tatra dohade ca prakīrtitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In a conjoin stale of Purvasadha and Uttarasadha, the thighs should be worshipped by the learned people and cold water is to be smeared.

## \|\| 80.14 \|\|

*phālgunīdvitaye guhāṃ pūjanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*dohadaṃ ca payo gavyaṃ deyaṃ ca dvijabhojanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A learned man should worship the genital (private part) of god in conjoin state of both phalguni constellations. The Brahmin should be given food and a dohada (massage) of milk and ghee is to be given.

## \|\| 80.15 \|\|

*kṛttikāsu kaṭiḥ pūjyā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*dohadaṃ ca vibhordeyaṃ sugandhaṃ kusumodakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The waist region of god to be worshipped in presence of Krttika constellation. The devotee should observed fast, impose checks on senses and donate a dohada of water immersing scanted flowers within it.

## \|\| 80.16 \|\|

*pārśve bhādrapadāyugme pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*guḍaṃ saleyakaṃ dadyāddohadaṃ devakīrtitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Both colleterals of god are to be worshipped with prescribed manner in both Bhadrapadas. The jaggery liquefied as pleases god should be given for dohada.

## \|\| 80.17 \|\|

*dve kukṣī revatīyoge dohade mudgamodakāḥ \|*  
*anurādhāsu jaṭharaṃ ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ ca dohade \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Both armpits of god are to be worshipped when Revati constellation is existed. Laddus prepared by green-gram should be given in Dohada. Belly is to be worshipped in Anuradha constellation and Sasti rice (sixty days crop of rice) should be given in Dohada.

## \|\| 80.18 \|\|

*śraviṣṭhāyāṃ tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ śālibhaktaṃ ca dohade \|*  
*bhujayugmaṃ viśākhāsu dohade paragnedanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Worship of back region is prescribed in presence of Dhanistha constellation cooked Sail rice is to be given in Dohada. Both arms of god should be worshipped in Visakha constellation and superior cereal is prescribed for Dohada.

## \|\| 80.19 \|\|

*haste hastau tathā pūjyau yāvakaṃ dohade smṛtam \|*  
*puḥrvasāvaṅgulīśca paṭolastatra dohade \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Worship of two hands and dohada of cooked food prepared from barley product is to be offered in the presence of Hasta constellation. Fingers to be worshipped and Patola (cucumber) as dohada should be given in Punarvasu constellation.

## \|\| 80.20 \|\|

*āśleṣāsu nakhān pūjyā dohade tittirāmiṣam \|*  
*jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūjayedrīvāṃ dohade tilamodakaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Worship of nails and flesh of partridge is prescribed in presence of Aslesa constellation. Neck is to be worshipped and sesamum laddu as dohada are prescribed in Jyestha.

## \|\| 80.21 \|\|

*śravaṇe śravaṇau pūjyau dadhibhaktaṃ ca dohade \|*  
*puṣye mukhaṃ pūjayeta dohade ghṛtapāyasam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Worship of both ears and dohada of curd and rice is prescribe in Sravana constellation. Worship of month in Pusya constellation with dohada of sweet dish cooked in ghee should be made.

## \|\| 80.22 \|\|

*svātiyoge ca daśanā dohade tilaśaṣkulī \|*  
*dātavyaṃ keśavaprītyai brāhmaṇasya ca bhojanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The teeth are to be worshipped in Svati constellation with dohada of sesamum and Saskuli (pudi). Brahmins should be offered food for the pleasure of Kesava.

## \|\| 80.23 \|\|

*hanū śatabhiṣāyoge pūjayedya prayatnataḥ \|*  
*priyaṅguraktaśālyantraṃ dohade madhuvidviṣaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Chins of god to be worshipped in Satabhisa constellation and dohada of Visnu's favourite Priyangu and Raktasali food to be given.

## \|\| 80.24 \|\|

*maghāsu nāsikā pūjyā madhu dadyādyaṃ dohade \|*  
*mṛgottamāṅge nayane mṛgamāṃsaṃ ca dohade \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Nose should be worshipped in Magha constellation and dohada of Madhu is to be given. Two eyes on forehead are to be worshipped in Mrgasira constellation and flesh of Mrga as dohada to be given.

## \|\| 80.25 \|\|

*citrāyoge lalāṭaṃ ca dohade cārubhojanam \|*  
*bhagṇīṣu śiraḥ pūjyaṃ cāru bhakṣyaṃ ca dohade \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Forehead of god in Citra constellation and dohada of tasty food is to be given. Head of Visnu to be worshipped in Bharani constellation and finely cooked rice is to be given in dohada.

## \|\| 80.26 \|\|

*saṃpūjanīyā vidvadbhirārdrāyoge śiroruhāḥ \|*  
*viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktyā dohade ca guḍārdrakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The scholars should worship the hair of god in Ardra constellation, donation of jaggery and ginger in dohada and food should be offered to Brahmin with keen devotion.

## \|\| 80.27 \|\|

*nakṣatrayogeṣveteṣu saṃpūjya jagataḥ patim \|*  
*pārite dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt strīpuṃsoścāruvāsasī \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When Visnu, the ruler of universe is duly worshipped, one should offer two nice garments to a man and woman after Parayana (the ceremony of completion).

## \|\| 80.28 \|\|

*chatropānatvetayugaṃ saptadhānyāni kāñcanam \|*  
*ghṛtapātraṃ ca matimān brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The wise man should give in donation an umbrella, a pair of white shoes, seven cereals, gold and vessel of ghee to the Brahmin.

## \|\| 80.29 \|\|

*pratinakṣatrayogena pūjanīyā dvijātayaḥ \|*  
*nakṣatramaya evaiṣa puruṣa śāśvato mataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The Brahmins should be worshipped/ honoured at the conjoining of each and every constellation. It is the everlasting Purusa in the form of Naksatra (constellation).

## \|\| 80.30 \|\|

*nakṣatrapuruṣākhyaṃ hi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*pūrva kṛtaṃ hi bhṛguṇā sarvapātakanāśanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. This religious vow or practice of Naksatra Purusa is the supreme. Bhrgu had observed this sin absolving religious practice long ago.

## \|\| 80.31 \|\|

*aṅgopāṅgāni devarṣe pūjayitvā jagadguroḥ \|*  
*surūpāṇyabhijāyante pratyaṅgāṅgāni caiva hi \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О divine hermit! When a man worships all organs and organille of god, his own organs receive the beauty and strength both in return.

## \|\| 80.32 \|\|

*saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kulasaṃgāgataṃ ca yat \|*  
*pitṛmātṛsamutthaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ hanti keśavaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The account of sins during seven previous birth either committed by the man himself, stuck due to acquaintance of family and due to parent being sinner are all eradicated completely by Kesava.

## \|\| 80.33 \|\|

*sarvāṇi bhadrāṇyāpnoti śarīrārogyamuttamam \|*  
*anantāṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ rūpaṃ cātīva śobhanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. By virtue of worship, they receive all good, a healthy body, unending love in mind and the complexion of the devotee also becomes attractive.

## \|\| 80.34 \|\|

*vāṅmādhurya tathā kānti yadyānyadabhivāñchitam \|*  
*dadāti nakṣatrapumānpūjitastu janārdanaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Naksatra Purusa Janardana as a result of worship endow the devotee with melodious speech, radiance and other desired things.

## \|\| 80.35 \|\|

*upoṣya samyageteṣu krameṇardheṣu nārada \|*  
*arundhatī mahābhāgā khyātimatryāṃ jagāma ha \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О Narada! The luckiest Arundhati had gained supreme popularity as a result of observing fast in presence of these constellations in an orderly manner.

## \|\| 80.36 \|\|

*aditistanayārthāya nakṣatrāṅgaḥ janārdanam \|*  
*saṃpūjayitvā govindaṃ revanta putramāptavān \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Aditya had once worshipped Janardana, the Naksatra Purusa with a passion for being blessed with son and thus, received Revanta, the meritorious son.

## \|\| 80.37 \|\|

*rambhārūpamavāpāśrya vāḍmādhuryaṃ ca menakā \|*  
*kānti vidhuravāpātryāṃ rājyaṃ rājā purūravāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. As a consequence of observing this fast, Rambha, the nymph had got supreme beauty, Menaka sweet voice, the moon best radiance and Pururava had got the throne.

## \|\| 80.38 \|\|

*evaṃ vidhānato brahmannakṣatrāṅgane janārdanaḥ \|*  
*pūjito rūpadhārī yaistaiḥ prāptā tu sukāmitā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О Brahmin! Whosoever had worshipped Janardana (Visnu) in the form of Naksatra Purusa, definitely received the desired things in his life.

## \|\| 80.39 \|\|

*etat tavokta paramaṃ pavitraṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ śubharūpadāyi \|*  
*nakṣatrapuṃsaḥ paramaṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva puṇyāmiha tīrthayātrām \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. I have this, enumerated the procedure of the fast for the pleasure of god Naksatra Purusa capable to give the best and illustrious complexion before you. Now, listen to the description on the sacrosanct pilgrimage.

## Chapter 81. Descriptiion of killing of Jalodbhava

## \|\| 81.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- irāvatīmanuprāpya puṇyāṃ tāmṛṣikanyakām \|*  
*snātvā saṃpūjayāmāsa caitrāṣṭamyāṃ janārdanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Prahlada took bath in the river Iravati, the holiest virgin of a hermit and worshipped Janardana on the eighth day of either fortnight in the month of Caitra (March).

## \|\| 81.2 \|\|

*nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ cīrvā vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ śuci \|*  
*jagāma sa kurukṣetraṃ prahlādo dānaveśvaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The demon king Prahlada observed sanctitively this holy religious act of Naksatra Purusa and went at Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 81.3 \|\|

*airāvatena mantreṇa cakratīrthaṃ sudarśanam \|*  
*upāmantrya tataḥ sasnau vedoktavidhinā mune \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О sage! He summoned Sudarsana-cakra Tirtha though Airavata hymn and took bath there as the procedure prescribed.

## \|\| 81.4 \|\|

*upoṣya kṣaṇadāṃ bhaktyā pūjayitvā kurudhvajam \|*  
*kṛtaśauco jagāmātha draṣṭuṃ puruṣakesarim \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He stayed there for a night, worshipped Kurudhvaja with keen devotion and after purifying his body, he went to see Nrsimha.

## \|\| 81.5 \|\|

*snātvā tu devikāyāṃ tu nṛsiṃhaṃ pratipūjya ca \|*  
*tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ gokarṇaṃ dānavo yayau \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He took bath in Devika river, worshipped Nrsimha, stayed there for a night and then went at Gokarna Tirtha.

## \|\| 81.6 \|\|

*tasmin snātvā tathā prācīne pūjyeśaṃ viśvakarmiṇam \|*  
*prācīne cāpare daityo draṣṭuṃ kāmeśvaraṃ yayau \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He first took bath at Praci compound and worshipped Visvakarma god there. Then he went to see Kamesvara at another compound.

## \|\| 81.7 \|\|

*tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca pūjayitvā ca śaṃkaram \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ yayau ca prahlādaḥ puṇḍīrakaṃ mahāmbhasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He took bath, sighted god Sankara, worshipped and went to see Pundarika, a god existed in water.

## \|\| 81.8 \|\|

*tataḥ snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*puṇḍīrakaṃ ca saṃpūjya uvāsa divasatrayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He did tarpana for departed forefathers, after bath, saw Pundarika, worshipped and stayed there for three days.

## \|\| 81.9 \|\|

*viśākhayūpe tadanu dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tathājitam \|*  
*snātvā tathā kṛṣṇatīrthe trirātraṃ nyavasacchuciḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Prahlada then saw the got Ajita in Visakhayupa, took bath in Krsna-tirtha and resided there for three nights observing all rules of purity.

## \|\| 81.10 \|\|

*tato haṃsapade haṃsaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya ceśvaram \|*  
*jagāmāsau payoṣṇāyāmakhaṇḍaṃ draṣṭumīśvaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He then saw and worshipped god Hamsa in Hamsapada and went thereafter at Payosni to see Akhandesvara.

## \|\| 81.11 \|\|

*snātvā payovḻyāḥ salile pūjyākhaṇḍaṃ jagatpatim \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ jagāma mattimān vitastāyāṃ kumārilam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Prahlada went to see Kumarila in Vitasta when the took bath in Payosni and worshipped unimpaired, the ruler of universe.

## \|\| 81.12 \|\|

*tatra snātvā'rcya deveśaṃ bālakhilyairmarīcibhiḥ \|*  
*ārādhyamānaṃ yadyatra kṛtaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. After bath there, he worshipped sin absolving go of gods adored by Balakhilyas who sip the sun beams.

## \|\| 81.13 \|\|

*yatra sā surabhirdevī svasutāṃ kapilāṃ śubhām \|*  
*devapriyārthamasṛjaddhitārthaṃ jagatastathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The goddess Surabhi had abandoned his daughter Kapila in order to obtain the pleasure of god and welfare of the whole world.

## \|\| 81.14 \|\|

*tatra devahnade snātvā śaṃbhuṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*vidhivaddadhi ca prāśya maṇimantaṃ tato yayau \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. He took bath in Devahrda, worshipped sambhu and went at the holy place Maniman after taking curd as prescribed custom for there.

## \|\| 81.15 \|\|

*tatra tīrthavare snātvā prājāpatye mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ brahmāṇaṃ deveśaṃ ca prajāpatim \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The wise Prahlada took bath at the holy place Prajapati and saw Sankara, Brahma and god of gods Prajapati.

## \|\| 81.16 \|\|

*vidhānatastu tāndevānpūjayitvā tapodhanaḥ \|*  
*ṣaḍrātraṃ tatra ca sthitvā jagāma madhunandinīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О resolute! Prahlada stayed there for six nights after worship of those gods in orderly manner and then went at Madhunandini.

## \|\| 81.17 \|\|

*madhumatsalile snātvā devaṃ cakradharaṃ haram \|*  
*śūlabāhuṃ ca govindaṃ dadarśa danupuṅgavaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Prahlada (Danupungava) took bath in the water of Madhumati river and saw Siva holding discus and Govinda, holding sula.

## \|\| 81.18 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- kimarthaṃ bhagavānśaṃbhurdadhārātha sudarśanam \|*  
*śūlaṃ tathā vāsudevo mamaitad brūhi pṛcchataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Narada said- kindly, tell me that why had Siva held Sudarsana and Vasudeva the Sula there?

## \|\| 81.19 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm \|*  
*kathayāmāsa tāṃ viṣṇurbhaviṣyamanave purā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Pulastya said- Please, listen to the ancient story now being told by me. God Visnu had told it to the prospective Manu.

## \|\| 81.20-21 \|\|

*jalodbhavo nāma mahāsurendro ghoraṃ sa taptvā tapa ugravīryaḥ \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa virañcimārāt sa tasya tuṣṭo varado babhūva \|\| 20 \|\|*

*devāsurāṇāmajayo mahāhave nijaiśca śastrairamarairavadhyaḥ \|*  
*brahmarṣiśāṣaiśca nirīpsitārtho jale ca vahrau svaguṇopaharttā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. There was one mighty king of demons called Jalodbhava (water-born). That mighty demon worshipped god Brahma with observing terrific penance. Brahma pleased and endowed him with powers defeating all gods and demons. It was said that the specific weapons of gods too shall fail to put any harm to him. The curse thundered by hermits known to Brahma shall even prove futile and the fire and water shall do not harm to him.

## \|\| 81.22 \|\|

*evaṃprabhāvo danupuṅgavo'sau devānmaharṣīnnṛpatīnsamatrān \|*  
*ābādhamāno vicacāra bhūmyāṃ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ nāśayadugramūrtiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. That demon having these specific powers then began ruling on earth. He put in pain all gods, hermits and kings too. That cruel demon had destroyed all benevolent activities.

## \|\| 81.23 \|\|

*tato'marā bhūmibhavāḥ sabhūpāḥ jagmuḥ śaraṇyaṃ harimīśitāram \|*  
*taiścāpi sārdhaṃ bhagavāñjagāma himālayaṃ yatra harastriṇetraḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The gods then took birth on the earth took the kings in their company and went to the supreme regulating authority god Visnu. God too went with them at Himalaya where Hara was existed.

## \|\| 81.24 \|\|

*saṃmantrya devarṣihitaṃ ca kārya matiṃ ca kṛtvā nidhanāya śatroḥ \|*  
*nijāyudhānāṃ ca virpayayaha tau devādhipau cakraturugrakarmiṇau \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A meeting arranged there and strategy stated for killing that enemy as it was only benevolent project for gods and hermits. Both gods then exchanged their weapons immediately.

## \|\| 81.25 \|\|

*tataścāsau dānavau viṣṇuśarvo samāyātau tañjighāṃsū sureśau \|*  
*matvā'jeyau śatrubhiryorarūpau bhayāttoye nimnagāyāṃ viveśa \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. When that wicked demon saw the god of gods Sankara and Visnu marching forward of attack, considering them undefeated. The demon entered into the bottom of river with a fright.

## \|\| 81.26 \|\|

*jñātvā praviṣṭaṃ tridivendraśatru nadīṃ viśālāṃ madhumatsupuṇyām \|*  
*dvayoḥ saśastrau taṭayorharīśau pracchannamṛrtī sahasā babhūvatuḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. When Sankara and Visnu saw the demon hidden in huge and holy river Madhumati, they suddenly hide on the both banks of that river.

## \|\| 81.27 \|\|

*jalodbhavaścāpi jalaṃ vimucya jñātvā gatau śaṃkaravāsudevau \|*  
*diśasasmīkṣya bhayakā tarākṣo durgaṃ himādriṃ ca tadāruroha \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Jalodbhava came up from the water considering Sankara and Visnu returned till then. He cautiously started looking all sides with fear and thus, climbed on the ridge of inaccessible Himalaya.

## \|\| 81.28 \|\|

*mahīghraśśṛṅgopari viṣṇuśaṃbhū cañcaryamāṇaṃ svaripuṃ ca dṛṣṭvā \|*  
*vegādubhau dudruvatuḥ saśastrau viṣṇustriśūlī giriśaśca cakrī \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Visnu with trident and Sankara with discus rushed fast towards every when they saw him climbing on the ridge of the mountain.

## \|\| 81.29 \|\|

*tābhyāṃ sa dṛṣṭastridaśottamābhyāṃ cakreṇa śūlena ca bhinnadehaḥ \|*  
*papāta śailāttapanīyavarṇo yathā'ntarikṣādi vimalā ca tārā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. They hit hard on his body by throwing discus and trident simultaneously. That demon having golden complexion fell down from the mountain like a white star falling from the sky.

## \|\| 81.30 \|\|

*evaṃ triśūlaṃ ca dadhāra viṣṇu- ścakraṃ trinetro'pyarisūdanārtham \|*  
*yatrādhahantrī hṛābhavad vitastā harāṅghripātācchiśirācalāttu \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Visnu had thus, held trident while Sankara had held discus for killing their enemy Jalodbhida. The foot print of Siva on Himalaya began emanating the river Vitasta just then.

## \|\| 81.31 \|\|

*tatprāpya tīrthaṃ tridaśādhipābhyā pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā hariśaṃkarābhyām \|*  
*upoṣya bhaktyā himavantamāgād draṣṭuṃ girīśaṃ śivaviṣṇuguptam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Prahlada worshipped Visnu and Sankara both gods there, stayed there with obeisance and went to see then Himalaya duly defended by Siva and Visnu both gods.

## \|\| 81.32 \|\|

*taṃ samabhyarcya vidhivaddattvā dānaṃ dvijātiṣu \|*  
*vitaste himavatpāde bhṛgutuṅgaṃ jagāma saḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Prahlada worshipped both gods in orderly manner, gave donation to Brahmins and visited thereafter at Bhigutunga, existing at the extended foothill of Himalaya.

## \|\| 81.33 \|\|

*yatreśvaro devavarasya viṣṇoḥ prādādrathāṅgagravarāyudhaṃ vai \|*  
*yena ciccheda tridhaiva śaṃkaro jijñāsamāno'strabalaṃ mahātmā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. God Sambhu had given supreme god Visnu the best weapon there. In order to examine the power vested in that weapon, Visnu had cutoff Sankara in three pieces.

## Chapter 82. Legend of Asura Sridama and his killing by Visnu

## \|\| 82.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca- bhagavaillokanāthāya viṣṇave viṣamekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*kimarthamāyudhaṃ cakraṃ dattavā~llokapūjitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- О god! Why had three eyed Sankara given Cakra, the weapon renowned to Visnu, the ruler of universe?

## \|\| 82.2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā kathāmetāṃ purātanīm \|*  
*cakrapradānasaṃbaddhāṃ śivamāhātpyavardhinīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- Please, listen attentively to the ancient story having contents of reasons on which Siva gave Cakra to Visnu. It enhances the magnificence of god Siva.

## \|\| 82.3 \|\|

*āsīdvijātipravaro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ \|*  
*gṛhāśramī mahābhāgo vītamanyuriti smṛtaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. There was a luckiest and great Brahmin Vitamanyu. He was expertly known to Vedas, their components (angas) and a house-hold Brahmin.

## \|\| 82.4 \|\|

*tasyātreyī mahābhāgā bhāryā''sīcchīlasaṃmatā \|*  
*pativratā patiprāṇā dhamaśīleti viśrutā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. His wife Dharmasila was luckiest, modest, chaste, beloved to husband and from the clan of Atri.

## \|\| 82.5 \|\|

*tasyāmasya maharvestu ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ \|*  
*saṃbabhūva sutaḥ śrīmān upamanyuriti smṛtaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. When that hermit enjoyed intercourse with her in appropriate time (viz. at menstruation period), she gave birth to a beautiful son Upamanyu.

## \|\| 82.6 \|\|

*taṃ mātā muniśārdūlaṃ śālipiṣṭarasena vai \|*  
*poṣayāmāsa vadatī kṣīrametat sudurgatā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О great sage! The parent being poorest, the juice of ground rice was given him during infancy on pretext to being it milk. Thus, he was brought up.

## \|\| 82.7 \|\|

*so'jānāno'sya kṣīrasya svāduttāṃ paya ityatha \|*  
*saṃbhāvanāmapyakarocchālipiṣṭarase'pi hi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. As the baby had never tasted milk, he habitually used to think that rice juice as milk.

## \|\| 82.8 \|\|

*sa tvekadā samaṃ pitrā kutricidvijaveśmani \|*  
*kṣīraudanaṃ ca bubhuje susvādu prāṇipuṣṭidam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Later-on he once attend the feast in the home of a client with his father. Sweet-dish (rice cooked with milk) was offered there and he ate it with taste never recognised.

## \|\| 82.9 \|\|

*sa labdhvā'nupamaṃ svādaṃ kṣīrasya ṛṣidārakaḥ \|*  
*mātrā dattaṃ dvitīye'hni nādatte piṣṭavāri tat \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. That baby did not accept next day the rice juice when it was offered by mother because he had till then recognised the real taste of rice cooked with milk.

## \|\| 82.10 \|\|

*rudodātha tato bālyātpayo'rthaṃ cātako yathā \|*  
*taṃ mātā rudatī prāha bāāṣpagadgadayā girā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He instead began weeping for milk like a thirsty Cataka and revealed inflexibility. The mother lost patience, tears came out from her eyes and said-

## \|\| 82.11 \|\|

*umāpatau paśupatau śūladhāriṇi śaṃkare \|*  
*aprasanne virūpākṣe kutaḥ kṣīreṇa bhojanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. How can we get sweet dish until Siva, the lord of Uma, the Pasupati, trident holder, deformed body god pleases?

## \|\| 82.12 \|\|

*yadīcchasi payo bhoktuṃ sadyaḥ puṣṭikaraṃ sutta \|*  
*tamārādhaya deveśaṃ virūpākṣaṃ triśūlinam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О son! If you really want to sip nutritious milk immediately, do worship of that Mahadeva holding trident.

## \|\| 82.13 \|\|

*tasmistuṣṭe jagaddhāmni sarvakalyāṇadāyini \|*  
*prāpyate'mṛtapāyitvaṃ kiṃ punaḥ kṣīrabhojanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Leave the side the milk when nectar is available easily under the grace of that god because he is the only basis of this whole world and a great giver. So, pray to him.

## \|\| 82.14 \|\|

*tanmāturvacanaṃ śrutvā vītamanyusuto'bravīt \|*  
*ko'yaṃ virūpākṣa iti tvayārādhyastu kīrtitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The son of Vitamanyu enquired his mother- "Who is that deformed body god (Virupaksa) to whom you say I should please?"

## \|\| 82.15 \|\|

*tataḥ sutaṃ dharmaśīlā dharmākyaṃ vākyamabravīt \|*  
*yo'yaṃ virūpākṣa iti śrūyatāṃ kathayāmi te \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Dharmasila then replied- Listen to the introduction of that deformed body god to which I am going to explain.

## \|\| 82.16 \|\|

*āsīnmahāsurapatiḥ śrīdāma iti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*tenākramya jagatsarvaṃ śrīrnītā svavaśaṃ purā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Long long ago there was a mighty king of demon's called Sridama. He had suppressed all human beings of this whole world and enslaved Laksmi, the goddess of wealth.

## \|\| 82.17 \|\|

*niḥśrīkāstu trayo lokāḥ kṛtāstena durātmanā \|*  
*śrīvatsaṃ vāsudevasya hartumaicchanmahābalaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. That wicked demon had terrified the three- worlds. He then intended to seize the Srivatsa, an ornament of god Visnu.

## \|\| 82.18 \|\|

*tasya duṣṭaṃ sa bhagavānabhiprāyaṃ janārdanaḥ \|*  
*jñātvā tasya vadhākāṅkṣī maheśvaramupāgamat \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. When god Janardana smelt that malice intention of the wicked demon, he went to Mahesvara to consult a strategy for his murder.

## \|\| 82.19 \|\|

*etasminnantare śaṃbhūryogamūrtidharo'vyayaḥ \|*  
*tasthau himācalaprasthamāśritya ślakṣṇabhūṣitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He saw there that Sambhu, the immortal and apparent icon of Yoga has seated on a smooth surface on Himalaya's ridge.

## \|\| 82.20 \|\|

*athābhyetya jagannāthaḥ sahasraśirasaṃ vibhum \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa hariḥ svayamātmānamātmanā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Visnu then approached to one thousand headed sovereign Jagannatha and began worshipping himself.

## \|\| 82.21 \|\|

*sāyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pādāṅguṣṭhena tasthivān \|*  
*guṇastatparamaṃ brahma yogijñeyamalakṣaṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He stood on thumb of his foot for a period longer than one thousand years and observed Japa of supreme Brahma, beyond characteristics and inaccessible to the reach of Yogis.

## \|\| 82.22 \|\|

*tataḥ prītaḥ prabhuḥ prādādviṣṇave paramaṃ padam \|*  
*pratyakṣaṃ taijasaṃ śrīmān divyaṃ cakraṃ sudarśanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. God Mahadeva pleased then and gave a supreme divine Sudarsana-cakra glowing with light.

## \|\| 82.23 \|\|

*taddattvā devadevāya sarvabhūtabhayapradam \|*  
*kālacakranibhaṃ cakraṃ śaṃkaro viṣṇumabravīt \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. While Sankara gave Visnu that Cakra equivalent to Kalacakra terrifying all creatures, he said-

## \|\| 82.24 \|\|

*varāyudho'yaṃ deveśa sarvāyudhanibarhaṇaḥ \|*  
*sudarśanaṃ dvādaśāraṃ ṣaṇṇābhirdviyugo javī \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О god of gods! This supreme weapon having twelve spikes, six nuclear and two yugas is speedy and it can split the power of all other weapons available till now. It is called Sudarsana-cakra.

## \|\| 82.25-27 \|\|

*ārāsaṃsthāstvamī tatra devā māsāśca rāśayaḥ \|*  
*śiṣṭānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya saṃsthitā ṛtavaśca ṣaṭ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*agniḥ somastathā mitro varuṇo'tha śacīpatiḥ \|*  
*indrāgnī cāpyatho viśve prajāpataya eva ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*hanūmāṃścātha balavān devo dhanvantaristathā \|*  
*tapaścaiva tapasyaśca dvādaśaite pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|*  
*caitrādyāḥ phālgunāntāśca māsāstatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. The gods, months, zodiacs, six seasons, fire, moon, sun, water, Indra, Visvedeva, Prajapati, mightiest Hanuman, Dhavantari Deva, penance and austerity i.e. twelve in number and the twelve months falling from Caitra (March) to Phalguna (February) are installed in its spikes for defence of gentlemen.

## \|\| 82.28 \|\|

*tvamevamādhāya vibho varāyudhaṃ śatru surāṇāṃ jahi mā viśaṅkithāḥ \|*  
*amogha eṣo'mararājapūjito dhṛto mayā netragatastapobalāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. ‘O all-pervading one, you accept this great weapon to kill the enemy of the gods without any hesitation. This is unfailing, honoured by the lord of gods and held by me in the eyes by the power of penance. ’

## \|\| 82.29 \|\|

*ityuktaḥ śaṃbhunā viṣṇuḥ bhavaṃ vacanamabravīt \|*  
*kathaṃ śaṃbho vijānīyāmamogho mogha eva vā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. When Sambhu heard by Visnu, he said curiously- "O Sambhu! How will I confirm with its being supreme powerful or a common weapon?

## \|\| 82.30 \|\|

*yadyamogho vibho cakraḥ sarvatrāpratiyastava \|*  
*jijñāsārthaṃ tavaiveha prekṣiṣyāmi pratīccha bhoḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. О sovereign! If this discus is really Amogha (supreme) and bears undefeated powers why should not I first try it on you. Please, bear its blows.

## \|\| 82.31 \|\|

*tadvākyaṃ vāsudevasya niśamyāha pinākadhṛk \|*  
*yadyevaṃ prakṣipasveti nirviśaṅkena cetasā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The holder of Pinaka bow suggested- "If this is the position, blow it then without any reservation on me."

## \|\| 82.32 \|\|

*tanmaheśānavacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇuḥ sudarśanam \|*  
*mumoca tejojijñāsuḥ śaṃkaraṃ prati vegavān \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. In order to examine the undefeated and unfailed power of that cakra, Visnu blew it on Sankara.

## \|\| 82.33 \|\|

*murārikaravibhraṣṭaṃ cakramabhyetya śūlinam \|*  
*tridhā cakāra viśveśaṃ yajñeśaṃ yajñayājakam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. That cakra immediately reached at Sankara and it divided his (the gods of world, god of offering and performer of offering) body in three pieces.

## \|\| 82.34 \|\|

*haraṃ haristridhābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛttaṃ mahābhujaḥ \|*  
*vrīḍopaplutadehastu praṇipātaparo'bhavat \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. When great warrior Hari saw Sankara cutoff in three pieces, he ashamed. He bowed to Sankara.

## \|\| 82.35 \|\|

*pādapraṇāmavanataṃ vīkṣya dāmodaraṃ bhavaḥ \|*  
*prāha prītiparaḥ śrīmānuttiṣṭheti punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Sankara picked up Hari from his feet with love and said- "Please, stand-up." He then consoled.

## \|\| 82.36 \|\|

*prākṛto'yaṃ mahābāho vikāraścakraneminā \|*  
*nikṛtto na svabhāvo me so'cchedyo'dāhya eva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. O great warrior! My Prakrta Vikara has only been cut-off by the cakra edge. My nature is still as before and not split. It is inseparable and impenetrable.

## \|\| 82.37 \|\|

*tadyadetāni cakreṇa trīṇi bhāgāni keśava \|*  
*kṛttāni tāni puṇyāni bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. О Kesava! Three parts of my body as made by cakra shall undoubtedly enhance the welfare of the world.

## \|\| 82.38 \|\|

*hiraṇyākṣaḥ smṛto hokaḥ suvarṇākṣastathā paraḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyo viśvarūpākṣastrayo'mī puṇyadā nṛṇām \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The first part shall be called Hiranyaksa, the second Suvarnaksa and the third part will be addressed as Virupaksa. All these three parts shall bestow the people with great fruits.

## \|\| 82.39 \|\|

*uttiṣṭha gacchasva vibho nihantumamarārdanam \|*  
*śrīdāmni nihate viṣṇo nandayiṣyanti devatāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О sovereign! Stand please and march for slaughtering the enemy of gods. О Visnu! the gods will express joy on slaughtering of Sridama.

## \|\| 82.40 \|\|

*ityevamukto bhagavānhareṇa garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*gatvā suragiriprasthaṃ śrīdāmānaṃ dadarśa ha \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In pursuance with the words of Sankara, the Garuda rider god went at the mountain ridge and saw Sridama there.

## \|\| 82.41 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadarpanaṃ daityaṃ devavaro hariḥ \|*  
*mumoca cakraṃ vegākyaṃ hato'sīti bruvanmuhuḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Just when Visnu saw that suppressor of gods, he threw with full force that cakra with frequent challenge that he is now dead.

## \|\| 82.42 \|\|

*tatastu tenāpratipauruṣeṇa cakreṇa daityasya śiro nikṛttam \|*  
*saṃchinnaśīrṣo nipapāta śailād vajrāhataṃ śailaśiro yathaiva \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. That cakra beheaded that demon within no time as it was having unique power. The beheaded demon fell down from the mountain ridge as the ridge falls on befalling the thunderbolt.

## \|\| 82.43 \|\|

*tasminhate devaripau murāri- rīśaṃ samārādhya virūpanetram \|*  
*labvā ca cakraṃ pravaraṃ mahāyudhaṃ jagāma devo nilayaṃ taponidhim \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. When the demon was killed, Murari worshipped Virupaksa Sankara and he then returned to his abode in Ksirasagara with that supreme weapon cakra.

## \|\| 82.44 \|\|

*so'yaṃ putra virūpākṣo devadevo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*tamārādhaya cetsādho kṣīreṇecchasi bhojanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О son! He is that Mahesvara, the god having deformed body. О gentle body! If you want to take food with milk, do worship of him.

## \|\| 82.45 \|\|

*tanmāturvacanaṃ śrutvā vītamanyusuto balī \|*  
*tamārādhya virūpākṣaṃ prāptaḥ kṣīreṇa bhojanam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. That mighty son of Vitamanyu followed the words of his mother, worshipped Virupaksa Sankara and got then the food with milk.

## \|\| 82.46 \|\|

*evaṃ tavoktaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ saṃchedanaṃ śarvatanoḥ purā vai \|*  
*tattīrthavaryaṃ sa mahāsuro vai samāsasādātha supuṇyahetoḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thus, I have told you the sacrosanct story related to the penetration of Sankara's body as taken place during long long past. That great demon Prahlada went at that supreme place for adding noble deed with his career.

## Chapter 83. Prahlada’s pilgrimage

## \|\| 83.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca- tasmastīrthavare snātvā gg devaṃ trilocanam \|*  
*pūjayitvā suvarṇākṣaṃ naimiṣaṃ prayayau tataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Prahlada took bath at that holiest place, saw three eyed Mahadeva, worshipped Suvarnaksa and then visited at Naimisaranya.

## \|\| 83.2 \|\|

*tatra tīrthasahasrāṇi triṃśatyāpaharāṇi gomatyāḥ kāñcanāṣṣyaśca gurudāyāśca madhyataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. In between the rivers Gomati, Kahcanaksi and Guruda, there are as much as thirty thousand holy places.

## \|\| 83.3-4 \|\|

*teṣu snātvā'rcya deveśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam \|*  
*ṛṣīnapi ca saṃpūjya naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*devadevaṃ tatheśānaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tataḥ \|*  
*gayāyāṃ gopati daṣṭaṃ jagāpara sa maha \|suraḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. He took bath on all those rivers and worshipped Acyuta with Pitambara on body and who is the god of gods. He honoured duly the hermits residing at Naimisaranya, worshipped Mahesa, the god of gods in orderly manner and then went at Gaya for seeing Gopati.

## \|\| 83.5 \|\|

*tatra brahnavvaje snātvā kṛtvā cāsya pradakṣiṇām piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pitṛṇāṃ sa cakāra ha \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He took bath in Brahmadhvaja, did parikrama of that holy place and did Pindadana for ancestor.

## \|\| 83.6 \|\|

*udapāne tathā snātvā tatrārcya pitṛnvaśī \|*  
*gadāpārṇi samabhyarcya gopatiṃ cāpi śaṃkaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Prahlada took bath in Udapana there and worshipped ancestors, Visnu, the holder of mace and Sankara, the Gopati.

## \|\| 83.7 \|\|

*inadratīre tathā snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*pahānadījale snātvā sarayūmājagāma saḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Не took bath in Indra-tirtha and did tarpana of ancestors and gods. He then took bath in the pure water of Mahanadi and reached near Sarayu.

## \|\| 83.8 \|\|

*tasyāṃ snātvā samabhyarcya gopratāraṃ kuśeśayam \|*  
*upoṣya rajanīṣekau virajāṃ nagarīṃ cayau \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He took bath in Sarayu also, worshipped Kusesaya in Gopratara, took halt for a night there and entered into Viraja city.

## \|\| 83.9 \|\|

*snātvā virajase tīrthe datvā piṇḍaṃ pitṛstathā \|*  
*darśanārthaṃ yayau śrīmān ajitaṃ yurūboktamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. After having a bath in Viraja-tirtha, he offered Pindadana to ancestors and then went to see the Supreme lord Purusottama.

## \|\| 83.10 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭā puṇḍārīkākṣamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ śuciḥ \|*  
*ḍratruṣya tatraiva mahendraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ yayau \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. That innocent Prahlada saw Pundarikaksa, stayed there for six nights and then went at Mahendra mountain existed in south.

## \|\| 83.11 \|\|

*tatra devavaraṃ śudhramarddhanārīśvaraṃ haram \|*  
*daṣacya saṃpūjya pitūnūnamaheraṃ cottaraṃ gataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Prahlada saw there Mahadeva, the supreme god Ardhanarisvara, worshipped and prayed him and then moved toward north.

## \|\| 83.12 \|\|

*tatra devavaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ gopālaṃ somapāyinam \|*  
*dṛṣṭā snātvā somatīrthe sahācalamupāgataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He saw the god Sambhu and Gopala, Somapayin, took bath in Soma-tirtha and then went at Sahyacala.

## \|\| 83.13 \|\|

*tatra snātvā mahodakyāṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cārcya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*surānyatṛn samabhyarcya pāriyātraṃ giraṃ gataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Prahlada took a dip in Mahodaki, worshipped Visnu, gods and ancestors with keen devotion and then visited at Pariyatra mountain.

## \|\| 83.14 \|\|
