*tatra snātvā lādbhalinyāṃ pṛjayitvā'parājitam \|*  
*kaśesdeśaṃ cābhyetya viśvarūpaṃ dadarśaṃ saḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Prahlada took bath there in Langalini, worshipped Aparajita and saw Visvarupa at Kaserudesa.

## \|\| 83.15 \|\|

*yatra devavaraḥ śaṃbhurgaṇānāṃ tu supūjitaḥ \|*  
*viśvarūpamathātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa yogavit \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The supreme god Sambhu, worshipped by Ganas, conversant with Yoga exhibited himself in the universal form.

## \|\| 83.16 \|\|

*tatra maṅkuraṇikātoye snātvā'bhyarcya maheśvaram \|*  
*jagāmadriṃ sa saugandhiṃ prahlādo malayācalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Prahlada took bath in the water of Mankunika worshipped Mahesvara and then went at Malayacala, filled with scent.

## \|\| 83.17 \|\|

*mahāhnade tataḥ snātvā pūjayitvā ca śaṃkaram \|*  
*tato jagāma yogātpā draṣṭuṃ vindhye sadāśivam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The soul of Yogi, Prahlada took bath in great reservoir, worshipped Satikara and then visited at the mountain Vindhya for seeing god Sadasiva.

## \|\| 83.18 \|\|

*tato vipāśāsalile snātvā'bhyarcya sadāśivam \|*  
*trirātraṃ samupoṣyātha avantīṃ nagarīṃ yayau \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He there took bath in the river Vipasa and worshipped Sadasiva. He took halt for three nights there and then entered in Avanti city.

## \|\| 83.19 \|\|

*tatra śiprājale snātvā viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*śmaśānasthaṃ dadarśātha mahākālavapurvaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He took bath there in the holy water of Sipra, worshipped god Visnu with keen devotion and went to seen Mahakala body holder in Smasana.

## \|\| 83.20 \|\|

*tasmin hi sarvasattvānāṃ tena rūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*tāmasaṃ rūpamāsthāya saṃhāraṃ kurute vaśī \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Self-controlled Sankara in his Tamasa form, destroy all organisms there.

## \|\| 83.21 \|\|

*tatrasthena sureśena śvetakirnāma bhūpatiḥ \|*  
*rakṣitastvantakaṃ dagdhvā sarvabhūtā pahāriṇām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Suresa existed there had set Antaka, the suppressor of all organisms on fire and defended the king Svetaki.

## \|\| 83.22 \|\|

*tatrātihṛṣṭo vasati nityaṃ śarvaḥ sahomayā \|*  
*vṛtaḥ pramathakoṭībhirbahubhistridaśārcitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Summoned by several crore ganas and worshipped by gods the supreme god Sarikara lives there happily with Uma.

## \|\| 83.23-24 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā'tha mahākālaṃ kālakālāntakāntakam \|*  
*yamasaṃyamanaṃ mṛtyormṛtyuṃ citravicitrakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śmaśānanilayaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhūtanāthaṃ jagatpatim \|*  
*pūjayitvā śūladharaṃ jagāma nidhadhān prati \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. After seeing Mahakala, the destroyer of the dreadful god of death, the multiformed, death of death, Smasanavasi, Bhutanatha, Jagatpati, Suladhari, Sankara went towards the Nisadha country.

## \|\| 83.25 \|\|

*tatrāmareśvaraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya bhaktittaḥ \|*  
*mahodayaṃ samabhyetya hayagrīvaṃ dadarśa saḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Having seen and worshipped god Amaresvara with keen devotion, Prahlada went at Mahodaya and saw there Hayagriva.

## \|\| 83.26 \|\|

*aśvatīrthe tataḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca turagānanam \|*  
*śrīdharaṃ caiva saṃpūjya pañcālaviṣayaṃ yayau \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He then took bath in Asva-tirtha, saw the icon of Asvamukha, worshipped Sridhara and went at Pancala country.

## \|\| 83.27 \|\|

*tatreśvaraguṇairyuktaṃ putramarthapateratha \|*  
*pāñcalika vaśī dṛṣṭvā prayāgaṃ parato yayau \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Prahlada went Prayaga after he saw Pancalika, the son of Kubera, the god of wealth and enriched with the divine quality.

## \|\| 83.28-29 \|\|

*strātvā sannihite tīrtha yāmune lokaviśrute \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā vaṭeśvaraṃ rudraṃ mādhavaṃ yogaśāyinam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dvāveva bhaktitaḥ pūjyau pūjayitvā mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*māghamāsamathopoṣya tato vārāṇasīṃ gataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Prahlada took bath in the well-known Sannihita Tirtha of the Yamuna region, worshipped Vatesvara Rudra and Madhava lying in meditation and stayed there throughout the month of Magha (January). He then went at Varanasi.

## \|\| 83.30-31 \|\|

*tato'syāṃ varaṇāyāṃ ca tīrtheṣu ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*sarvapāpaharāhyeṣu snātvā'rcya pitṛdevatāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pradakṣiṇīkṛtya purīṃ pūjyāvimuktakeśavau \|*  
*lolaṃ divākaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tato madhuvanaṃ yayau \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Prahlada then took bath in several holy places situated in the region covered by Asi and Varuna, worshipped ancestors and gods and then made Pradaksina of Puri. He then worshipped Avimuktesvara and Kesava and after seeing Lolarka, he entered into Madhuvana.

## \|\| 83.32 \|\|

*tatra svāyaṃbhuvaṃ devaṃ dadarśāsurasattamaḥ \|*  
*tamabhyarcya mahātejāḥ puṣkarāraṇyamāgamat \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The great demon Prahlada saw Svayambhu god there. He worshipped that god and then went at Puskararanya. In all the three Tirthas, he bathed and worshipped the Manes and gods.

## \|\| 83.33 \|\|

*etatpavitraṃ parama purāṇaṃ prokta tvagastyena maharṣiṇā ca \|*  
*dhanyaṃ yaśasya bahupāpanāśanaṃ saṃkīrtanācchraṇātsaṃsmṛteśca \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. This most pious Purana is narrated by great hermit Agastya. One who recites, hears and remembers this Purana, he becomes fortunate, gains fame and all his sins are destroyed.

## Chapter 84. Prahlada’s pilgrimage

## \|\| 84.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca-*  
*gate ca tīrthayātrāyā prahve dānaveśvare \|*  
*kussaṣatraṃ samadhyāgādṛraṣaṭaṃ vairodhano mune \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- “O sage!, when lord of demons Prahlada departed for pilgrimage, then king Bali came to visit Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 84.2 \|\|

*tasmanyahādharmayute tīrtha brāhmaṇayuṅgavaḥ \|*  
*śukro davijātipravarānāmanrayata bhārgavaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The great Brahmana Sukra invited foremost of the brahmanas in this religion-bound pilgrimage.

## \|\| 84.3-4 \|\|

*bhṛguṇa'manyamaṇaste śrutvā''trayesagautamāḥ \|*  
*kaulikāgirasañcaiva tatvajñāḥ kurujāṅgalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*uttārāśāṃ prajāgamuste nadīmanu śatadravīm \|*  
*satave jale stratva vivāsaṃ prayayustataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. On invitation of Sukracarya, Atri, Gautam, Kausika, Angira and other hermits conversant in all scriptures went to the north direction guided by Satadravi river and after taking bath in the river, they all went to the hermitage of Sukra.

## \|\| 84.5 \|\|

*vijñāya tatrāsya ratiṃ satrātvā'rcya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*tato'pi kiraṇā puṇyāṃ dineśakiraṇacyutām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Feeling the great honour by Sukracarya, they took bath, worshipped the ancestors and gods and went to the bank of the Kirana river originated from the rays of Sun.

## \|\| 84.6 \|\|

*tasyāṃ ca devarṣe sarvaṃ eva maharvacaḥ \|*  
*supuṇyodāṃ vegavatīṃ ratvā jagmurathesrin \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О great sage! All those hermits after taking bath in that virtue providing, Vegavati river went towards Isvari.

## \|\| 84.7 \|\|

*devikāyā jale ātva payoṣṇāyāṃ ca tāpasāḥ \|*  
*avatīrṇā mune strātuṃ mādhavādyāḥ sumānavīm \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. There they took bath in the water of Devika and Payosna and after that they Madhava etc. Rsis proceeded to take bath in Sumanavi river.

## \|\| 84.8 \|\|

*tato nimagnā dadṛśuḥ pratiṣipbamathātmanaḥ \|*  
*antarjale dvijaśreṣṭha mahadāśryacachāraṇam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О great Brahmana, when they dived in water and saw the reflection of theirselves on the surface of water, they were highly surprised.

## \|\| 84.9 \|\|

*unmajjantajca dadṛśuḥ punartismitamānasāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sātvā samuttīrṇā ṛṣayaḥ sarvaṃ eva hi \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. When they came out from the water, again they saw such reflection which caused them further wonder. After a bath, they all worshipped Ayogandhi, Puskaraksa and Brahma.

## \|\| 84.10 \|\|

*puṣkarākṣamayogandhi brahmāṇaṃ cāpyapūjayat \|*  
*tato bhūyaḥ sarasvatyāstīrthe trailokyaviśrute \|*  
*koṭitīrthe rudrakoṭiṃ dadarśa vṛṣabhadhvajam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He then visited at renowned holy place Koti-tirtha on the bank of Sarasvati and saw bull- bannered Rudrakoti.

## \|\| 84.11-12 \|\|

*naimiṣeyā dvijavarā māgadheyāḥ sasaindhavāḥ \|*  
*dharmāraṇyāḥ pauṣkareyā daṇḍakāraṇyakāstathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*cāmpeyā bhārukaccheyā devikātīragāśca ye \|*  
*te tatra śaṅkaraṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātā dvijātayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. During long long past, the residents of Naimisaranya, Magadha, Sindhu province, Dharmaranya, Puskara, Dandakaranya and the Brahmanas of Campa, Bharukaccha and of the bank of Devika river came there to see Sankara.

## \|\| 84.13 \|\|

*koṭisaṃkhyāstapaḥ siddhā haradarśalālasāḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamityevaṃ vādino mun \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О sage! Several crore siddha ascetics, sanctified by penance and endowed with supernatural powers began to dispute by saying- "I will see first, I will see first."

## \|\| 84.14 \|\|

*tān saṃkṣubdhān haro dṛṣṭvā maharṣīn dagdhakilbiṣān \|*  
*teṣāmevānukampārthaṃ koṭimūrttirabhūd bhavaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. When god Sankara saw these innocent hermits, who were purged of sins, the agitated Sankara, out of compassion for them, assumed a crore of forms.

## \|\| 84.15 \|\|

*tataste munayaḥ prītāḥ sarva eva maheśvaram \|*  
*saṃpūjayantastasthurvai tīrthaṃ kṛtvā pṛthak pṛthak \|*  
*ityevaṃ rudrakoṭīti nāmnā śaṃbhurajāyata \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. All those sages then constructed separate holy places happily and began to live regularly worshipping Mahesvara. Thus, Sambhu was called Rudrakoti.

## \|\| 84.16 \|\|

*taṃ dadarśa mahātejāḥ prahlādo bhaktimān vaśī \|*  
*koṭitīrthe tataḥ snātvā tarpayitvā vasun pitṝn \|*  
*rudrakoṭiṃ samabhyarcya jagāma kurujāṅgalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Prahlada, the devotee of balanced mind perceived them, took bath in one crore holy places, did tarpana of Vasus and ancestors and he went Kurujangala after they worshipped duly god Sankara.

## \|\| 84.17 \|\|

*patra devavaraṃ sthāṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ pārvatīpriyam \|*  
*sarasvatījale magnaṃ dadarśa surapūjitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. There he saw the great God Sankara, the consort of Parvati and who was immersed in the water of Sarasvati river.

## \|\| 84.18-19 \|\|

*sārasvate 'mbhasi snātvā sthāṇuṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*snātvā dasāśvamedhe ca saṃpūjya ca surān pitṛn \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sahasraliṅgaṃ saṃpūjya snātvā kanyāhrade śuciḥ \|*  
*abhivādya guruṃ śukraṃ somatīrthaṃ jagāma ha \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Bathing in the water of Sarasvati and worshipping Sthanu with keen devotion, and worshipping gods and ancestors after taking bath in Dasasvamedha, he took bath in Kanya reservoir, observed purity, worshipped Sahasralihga, saluted the preceptor Sukracarya in Sukra-tirtha and went to the Soma-tirtha.

## \|\| 84.20 \|\|

*tatra snātvār'cya ca pitṛn somaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitataḥ \|*  
*kṣīrikāvāsamabhyetya snānaṃ cakre mahāyaśāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The highly reputed Prahlada took bath there, worshipped ancestors and Soma and took bath in Ksirikavasa when he reached there.

## \|\| 84.21 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇīkṛtya taruṃ varuṇaṃ cārcya buddhimān \|*  
*bhūyaḥ kurudhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā padmākhyāṃ nagarī gataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Wise Prahlada did circumambulation of the tree existed there, worshipped Varuna, perceived Kurudhvaja and went to Padma city.

## \|\| 84.22 \|\|

*tatrārcya mitrāvaruṇau bhāskarau lokapūjitau \|*  
*kumāradhārāmabhyetya dadarśa svāminaṃ vaśī \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Prahlada, the celibate worshipped Mitravaruna, renowned in the world, visited at Kumaradhara and perceived Svami there.

## \|\| 84.23 \|\|

*snātvā kapiladhārāyāṃ saṃtarpyārcya pitṛn surān \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ samabhyarcya narmadāyāṃ jagāma ha \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. He took bath in Kapiladhara, offered Tarpana oblations to the Manes, worshipped gods, perceived and worshipped Skanda and then went to the Narmada river.

## \|\| 84.24 \|\|

*tasyāṃ snātvā samabhyarcya vāsudevaṃ śriyaḥ patim \|*  
*jagāma bhūdharaṃ draṣṭuṃ vārāhaṃ cakradhāriṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He took bath in Narmada, worshipped Vasudeva, the husband of Laksmi and then he went to see Varaha god, the discus-holder and the sustainer of earth.

## \|\| 84.25 \|\|

*snātvā kokāmuke tīrthe saṃpūjya dharaṇīdharam \|*  
*trisauvarṇaṃ mahādevamarbudeśaṃ jagāma ha \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He took bath in Kokamukha holy place, worshipped Dharanidharam there and then went to Trisauvama, Siva, the lord of Arbuda.

## \|\| 84.26 \|\|

*tatra nārīhrade snātvā pūjayitvā ca śaṅkaram \|*  
*kāliñjaraṃ samabhyetya nīlakaṇṭhaṃ dadarśa saḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He took bath in Narihrda, worshipped god Sankara, reached Kalinjara and perceived the temple of Nilakantha there.

## \|\| 84.27 \|\|

*nīlatīrthajale snātvā pūjayitvā tataḥ śivam \|*  
*jagāma sāgarānūpe prabhāse draṣṭumīśvaram \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. He took bath in the holy water of Nila-titha, worshipped Siva and went to see god at Prabhas-tirtha located on sea-shore.

## \|\| 84.28 \|\|

*snātvā ca saṃgame nadyāḥ sarasvatyārṇaṃvasya ca \|*  
*someśvaraṃ lokapatiṃ dadarśa sa kapardinam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. He could see Kapardi Somesvara, the lord of the universe while bathing at the confluence of Sarasvati river and the sea.

## \|\| 84.29 \|\|

*yo dakṣaśāpanirdagdhaḥ kṣayī tārādhipaḥ śaśī \|*  
*āpyāyitaḥ śaṅkareṇa viṣṇunā sakapardinā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Kapardi Sankara and Visnu had given the moon, the lord of stars, its full shape when it was suffering from deterioration on account of the curse inflicted by Daksa.

## \|\| 84.30 \|\|

*tāvarcya devapravarau prajagāma mahālayam \|*  
*tatra rudraṃ samabhyarcya prajagāmottarān kurūn \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. He went at Mahalaya after worshipping both these gods. He worshipped Rudra and then went Uttarakuru.

## \|\| 84.31 \|\|

*padmanābhaṃ sa tatrarcya saptagodāvaraṃ yayau \|*  
*tatra snātvār'cya viśveśaṃ bhīmaṃ trailokyavanditam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. After worshipping Padmanabha there, he went at Saptagodavara. After bath, he worshipped Bhima, the ruler of universe as renowned throughout the three-worlds.

## \|\| 84.32 \|\|

*gatvā dāruvane śrīmān liṅgaṃ sa dadarśa ha \|*  
*tamarcya brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā snātvār'cya tridaśeśvaram \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Sri Prahlada went into Daruvana and saw linga of Siva there. After worship of that lirtga, he took bath in Brahman! river and worshipped Mahadeva, the Tridasesvara.

## \|\| 84.33 \|\|

*plakṣāvataraṇaṃ gatvā śrīnivāsamapūjayat \|*  
*tataśca kuṇḍinaṃ gatvā saṃpūjya prāmatṛptidam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. He then Went at Plaksavatarana and worshipped Srinivasa. He then worshipped the soul-consoling one, at Kundina.

## \|\| 84.34 \|\|

*śūrpārake caturbāhuṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*māgadhāraṇyamāsādya dadarśa vasudhādhipam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He worshipped the four armed god at Surparaka, went to Magadharanya and perceived god Vasudhadhipa there.

## \|\| 84.35 \|\|

*tamarcayitvā viśveśaṃ sa jagāma prajāmukham \|*  
*mahātīrthe tataḥ snātvā vāsudevaṃ praṇamya ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. He went at Prajamukha after worship of that Visvesa. He then took bath in Maha-tirtha and saluted Vasudeva.

## \|\| 84.36-37 \|\|

*śoṇaṃ śaṃprāpya saṃpūjya skamavarmāṇamīśvaram \|*  
*mahākośyāṃ mahādevaṃ haṃsākhyaṃ bhaktimānatha \|\| 36 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā jagāmātha saindhavāraṇyamuttamam \|*  
*tatreśvaraṃ sunetrākhyaṃ śaṅkhaśūladharaṃ gurum \|*  
*pūjayitvā mahābāhuḥ prajāgāma triviṣṭapam \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. He went at Sona and worshipped the god holding gold shield (Siva). The devotee Prahlada then worshipped Mahadeva known as Hamsa in Mahakosi, went to the excellent Saindhavaranya and worshipped Sunetra, the revered god holding conch and trident. Prahlada thereafter went at Trivistapa.

## \|\| 84.38 \|\|

*tatra devaṃ maheśānaṃ jaṭādharamiti śrutam \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvār'cya hariṃ cāsau tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ yayau \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Не there worshipped Mahesana popularly known as Jatadhara. Seeing and adoring him and Hari, he went to the Kanakhala Tirtha.

## \|\| 84.39 \|\|

*tatrārcya bhadrakālīśaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca dānavaḥ \|*  
*dhanādhipaṃ ca meghaṅkaṃ yayāvatha girivrajam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Demon Prahlada worshipped Bhadrakalisa, Virabhadra and Meghanka, the god of wealth (Kubera) and then went to Girivraja.

## \|\| 84.40 \|\|

*tatra devaṃ paśupatiṃ lokanāthaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*saṃpūjayitvā pidhivatkāmarūpaṃ jagāma ha \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He worshipped there the god Pasupati Mahesvara in orderly manner and went at Kamarupa.

## \|\| 84.41 \|\|

*śaśiprabhaṃ devavaraṃ trinetraṃ saṃpūjayitvā saha vai mṛḍānyā \|*  
*jagāma tīrthapravaraṃ mahākhyaṃ tasmin mahādevamapūjayat \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. He worshipped there systematically god of gods three-eyed Sankara with Mrdani (Parvati) having moonlight complexion, went at Mahakhya-tirtha thereafter and worshipped Mahadeva there.

## \|\| 84.42 \|\|

*tatastrikūṭaṃ girimatriputraṃ jagāma draṣṭuṃ sa hi cakrapāṇinam \|*  
*tamīḍya bhaktyā tu gajendrasokṣaṇaṃ jajāpa japyaṃ paramaṃ pavitram \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Prahlada then went at Trikuta in order to see Visnu, the son of Atri and holder of discus in hand, worshipped him with keen devotion and recited Gajendra Moksana, the holy psalm to god at the peak of adversity.

## \|\| 84.43 \|\|

*tatroṣya daityeśvarasūnurādarānmāsatrayaṃ mūlaphalāmbubhakṣī \|*  
*nivedya viprapravareṣu kāñcanaṃ jagāma ghoraṃ sa hi daṇḍakaṃ vanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Prahlada, the son of demon's king stayed there for three months living on roots, fruits and water. He then gave Brahmins gold and went at gross forest called Dandakavana.

## \|\| 84.44 \|\|

*tatra divyaṃ mahāśākhaṃ vanaspativapurdharam \|*  
*dadarśa puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mahāśvāpadavāraṇam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He saw there Pundarikaksa defender from predator animals and in the form of a tree having huge branches and green leaves.

## \|\| 84.45 \|\|

*tasyādhasthāt trirātraṃ sa mahābhāgavato 'suraḥ \|*  
*sthitaḥ sthiṇḍilaśāyī tu paṭhan sārasvataṃ stavam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The great devotee to Visnu, Prahlada recited Sarasvata Stava for three nights there and took rest on a compound under it without and quilt.

## \|\| 84.46 \|\|

*tasmāt tīrthavaraṃ vidvān sarvapāpapramocanam \|*  
*jagāma dānavo draṣṭuṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The learned Prahlada went from there Sresthatirtha in order to cool his eyes by seeing at Hari, the absolver of all sins.

## \|\| 84.47 \|\|

*tasyāgrato jajāpāsau stavau pāpapraṇāśanau \|*  
*yau purā bhagavān prāha kroḍarūpī janārdanaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. He recited two sin-destroying hymns revealed in days of yore by Lord Narayana in his Kroda-form.

## \|\| 84.48 \|\|

*tasmādathāgād daityendraḥ śālagrāmaṃ mahāphalam \|*  
*yatra saṃnihito viṣṇuścareṣu sthāvareṣu ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Prahlada thereafter went at Salagrama-tirtha from there. Visnu is existed there in all movable and immovable things.

## \|\| 84.49 \|\|

*tatra sarvagataṃ viṣṇuṃ matvā cakre ratiṃ balī \|*  
*pūjayan bhagavatpādau mahābhāgavato mune \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. O sage! Considering god Visnu omniscient, devotee demon Prahlada adored the feet of that god and established his sheer obeisance.

## \|\| 84.50 \|\|

*iyaṃ tavoktā munisaṃghajuṣṭā prahlādatīrthānugatiḥ supuṇyā \|*  
*yatkīrttanācchravaṇāt sparśanācca vimuktapāpā manujā bhavanti \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. I have explained completely the pilgrimage of Prahlada, the great devotee to god Visnu in which he saw the groups of sages living at each and every holy place so visited by him. The people reciting, hearing and visiting there enjoy the pleasure of being free from the bondage of sins.

## Chapter 85. Gajendra-Moksa-Stotra

## \|\| 85.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*yān japyān bhagavadbha bhaktyā prahlādo dānavo 'japat \|*  
*gajendramokṣaṇādīṃstu caturastān vadasva me \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- Kindly tell me the four psalms including Gajendra Moksana etc. recited by Prahlada with sheer devotion.

## \|\| 85.2 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva kathayiṣyāmi japyānetāṃstapodhana \|*  
*duḥsvapnanāśo bhavati yairuktaiḥ saṃśrutaiḥ smṛtaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Pulastya said- О resolute! Listen to the psalms being told by me. The nightmares are decayed by mere reciting, listening and remembering them.

## \|\| 85.3 \|\|

*gajendramokṣaṇaṃ tvādau śṛṇuṣva tadanantaram \|*  
*sārasvataṃ tataḥ puṇyau pāpapraśamanau stavau \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. There comes first the Gajendra Moksana hymn. I will then described Sarasvata and two other psalms absolving from the sins.

## \|\| 85.4 \|\|

*sarvaratnamayaḥ śrīmāṃstrikūṭo nāma parvataḥ \|*  
*sutaḥ parvatarājasya sumerorbhāskaradyuteḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The beautiful mountain Trikuta studded all gems is the son of king mountain Sumeru having radiance like the Sun.

## \|\| 85.5 \|\|

*kṣīrodajalavīcyagrairdhaitāmalaśilātalaḥ \|*  
*utthitaḥ sāgaraṃ bhittvā devarṣigaṇasevitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. That mountain having clean valleys washed continuously by the waves of Ksirasagara once had come up from the bottom of sea. The gods and hermits always reside there.

## \|\| 85.6-7 \|\|

*apasarobhiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmān prasvaṇākulaḥ \|*  
*gandharvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣaiḥ siddhacāraṇapannagaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vidyādharaiḥ sapatnīkaiḥ saṃyataiśca tapasvibhiḥ \|*  
*vṛkadvīpigajendraśca vṛgātro virājate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. That mountain looks very nice as surrounded by nymphs, covered by the fountains, gandharvas, kinnaras, yaksas, siddhas, caranas, serpents, vidhyadharas with their wives, ascetics and surrounded by the wild animals like vrka, tigers and elephants.

## \|\| 85.8-9 \|\|

*punnāgaiḥ karṇikāraiśca bilvāmalakapāṭalaiḥ \|*  
*cūtanīpakadambaiśca candanāgurucampakaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śālaistālaistamālaiśca saralārjunaparpaṭaiḥ \|*  
*tathānyairvividhairvṛkṣaiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. That mountain is well decorated by punnagas, karnikara, bilva, amalaka, patala, mango, nipa, kadamba, sandal, aguru, campaka, sala, tala, tamala, sarala, arjuna, parpata and a number of other trees.

## \|\| 85.10 \|\|

*nānādhātvaṅkitaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ prasravadbhiḥ samantataḥ \|*  
*śobhito ruciraprakhyaistribhirvistīrṇasānubhiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. That mountain is adorned with the peaks marked by several metals, fountains flowing from four sides and three ridges very broad and attractive.

## \|\| 85.11 \|\|

*mṛgaiḥ śākhāmṛgaiḥ siṃdairmātaṅgaiśca sadāmadaiḥ \|*  
*jīvañjīvakasaṃghuṣṭaiścakoraśikhināditaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. That mountain is always filled with the voices of stags, monkeys, lions, intoxicated elephants, cakoras, partridges and peacocks.

## \|\| 85.12 \|\|

*tasyaikaṃ kāñcanaṃ śṛṅgaṃ sevate yaṃ divākaraḥ \|*  
*nānāpuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ nānāgandhādhivāsitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. God sun rises from one of its gold studded ridges covered by numerous kinds of flowers and scented with several kinds of flavours.

## \|\| 85.13 \|\|

*dvitīyaṃ rājataṃ śṛṅgaṃ sevate yaṃ niśākaraḥ \|*  
*pāṇḍurāmbudasaṃkāśaṃ tuṣāracayasaṃnibham \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. God moon rises from another ridge studded with silver and analogous to white colour clouds and dew cluster.

## \|\| 85.14 \|\|

*vajrendranīlavaiḍūryatejobhirbhāsayan diśaḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyaṃ brahmasadanaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ śṛṅgamuttamam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The third ridge of Trikuta is abode of Brahma, it luminates all direction with radiance of diamond, Indranila, Vaidurya etc. gems.

## \|\| 85.15 \|\|

*na tatkṛtaghnāḥ paśyanti na nṛśaṃsā na nāstikāḥ \|*  
*nātaptatapaso loke ye ca pāpakṛto janāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The ungrateful, the wicked, the atheist, those who have not practised austerity and those that are sinful in this world cannot see it.

## \|\| 85.16-18 \|\|

*tasya sānumataḥ pṛṣṭhe saraḥ kāñcanapaṅkajam \|*  
*kāraṇḍavasamākīrṇaṃ rājahaṃsopaśobhitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kumudotpalakahlāraiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca maṇḍitam \|*  
*kamalaiḥ śatapatraiśca kāñcanaiḥ samalaṅkṛtam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*patrairmarakataprakhyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kāñcanasaṃnibhaiḥ \|*  
*gulmaiḥ kīcakaveṇūnāṃ samantāt pariveṣṭitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. There lies a reservoir at rear side of that mountain surrounded by golden flowers having petals like Markata gem and the bushes of bamboo called Kicaka from four sides. It is covered by Karandavas, trimmed by flamingos, decorated by lily, lotus, kahlara, pundarika etc. species of lotus and ornamented by golden lotus having one hundred petals.

## \|\| 85.19 \|\|

*tasmin sarasi duṣṭātmā virūpo 'ntarjaleśayaḥ \|*  
*āsīd grāho gajendrāṇāṃ ripurākekarekṣamaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On the water of that reservoir, there lived a wicked and ugly crocodile with half-closed eyes and who was the enemy of elephants.

## \|\| 85.20-22 \|\|

*atha dantojjvalamukhaḥ kadācid gajayūthapaḥ \|*  
*madasrāvī jalākāṅkṣī pādacārīva parvataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*vāsayanmadagandhena girimairāvatopamaḥ \|*  
*gajo hyañjanasaṃkāśo madāccalitalocanaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tṛṣitaḥ pātukāmo 'sau avatīrṇaśca tajjalam \|*  
*salīlaḥ paṅkajavane yūthamadhyagataścaran \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Once upon a time an elephant, the chief of his group, having white shining teeth, intoxicated, thirsty, having huge body like a walking mountain analogous to Airavata, making the mountain fragrant with the scent of ichor, like the guardian elephant Anjana, with eyes moving on account of rut, descended in the water of that reservoir by spreading scent of his intoxication and began to play with his commune around lotus cluster.

## \|\| 85.23-24 \|\|

*gṛhītastena raudreṇa grāheṇāvyaktamūrtinā \|*  
*paśyantīnāṃ kareṇūnāṃ krośantīnāṃ ca dāruṇam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*hriyate paṅkajavane grāheṇātibalīyasā \|*  
*vāruṇaiḥ saṃyataḥ pāśairniṣprayatnagatiḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The crocodile clandestinely caught that elephant. He began wailing but within no time that mighty crocodile pulled the elephant in the lotus forest, fastened him with Pasa of Varuna and made him motionless and dull.

## \|\| 85.25 \|\|

*veṣṭyamānaḥ sughoraistu pāśairnāgo dṛḍhaistathā \|*  
*visphūrya ca yathāśakti vikrosaṃśca mahāravān \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. When that chief elephant was fastened with the dreadful Pasa, he began to roar loudly longing for life.

## \|\| 85.26 \|\|

*vyathitaḥ sa nirutsāho gṛhīto ghorakarmaṇā \|*  
*paramāpadamāpanno manasācintayaddharim \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. When elephant was so gripped by crocodile, he lost courage and aggrieved. At that moment of extreme adversity, he began summoning god Hari in his mind.

## \|\| 85.27 \|\|

*sa tu nāgavaraḥ śrīman nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tameva śaraṇaṃ devaṃ gataḥ sarvātmanā tadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. That king elephant was devotee to Narayana. He therefore, sheltered to that omnipresent god.

## \|\| 85.28 \|\|

*ekātmā nigṛhītātmā viśuddhenāntarātmanā \|*  
*janmajanmāntarābhyāsāt bhaktimān garuḍadhvaje \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. That elephant being practised during several pre-births could easily focused his mind on god and began praying god Visnu, the Garuda rider with all purity in heart.

## \|\| 85.29-30 \|\|

*nānyaṃ devaṃ mahādevāt pūjayāmāsa keśavāt \|*  
*mathitāmṛtaphenābhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sahasraśubhanāmānamādidevamajaṃ vibhum \|*  
*pragṛhya puṣkarāgreṇa kāñcanaṃ kamalottamam \|*  
*āpadvimokṣamanvicchan gajaḥ stotramudīrayat \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. He did not worshipped other gods except Kesava. He focused his mind on unborn, sovereign god Visnu having complexion as white as the froth of nectar obtained after churning and conch, discus and mace in his hands. He picked up a golden lotus in his tusk, wished liberty from that sudden calamity and began reciting the psalm.

## \|\| 85.31 \|\|

*gajendra uvāca \|*  
*oṃ namo mūlaprakṛtaye ajitāya mahātmane \|*  
*anāśritāya devāya niḥspṛhāya namo 'stu te \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The king elephant said- Salute to unconquerable soul in the form of Om, the root nature. Salute to independent and unique god.

## \|\| 85.32 \|\|

*nama ādyāya bījāya ārṣeyāya pravartine \|*  
*antarāya caikāya avyaktāya namo namaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Salute to the god in form of Adyabija, adored by hermits and the founder. Indiscriminative, one and all and inexpressible god in saluted frequently.

## \|\| 85.33 \|\|

*namo guhyāya gūḍhāya guṇāya guṇavartine \|*  
*aprarkyāprameyāya atulāya namo namaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Salute to cryptic, secret, in the form of property (gana) and beyond property (without gana). Salute to the god beyond logic, unique and incomparable.

## \|\| 85.34 \|\|

*namaḥ śivāya śāntāya niścintāya yaśasvine \|*  
*sanātanāya pūrvāya purāṇāya namo namaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Frequent salute to quiet, benevolent, auspicious, beyond imagination, illustrious, everlasting, Ancient and Primeval.

## \|\| 85.35 \|\|

*namo devādhidevāya svabhāvāya namo namaḥ \|*  
*namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya govindāya namo namaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Salute to the god of gods. Frequent salute to His Nature. Salute to the god creating this world. Frequent salute to Govinda.

## \|\| 85.36 \|\|

*namo 'stu padamanābhāya namo yogodbhavāya ca \|*  
*viśveśvarāya devāya śivāya haraye namaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Salute to Padmanabha and Yogadbhava. Salute to the Lord of Universe and of divine form, Siva and Hari.

## \|\| 85.37 \|\|

*namo 'stu tasmai devāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane \|*  
*nārāyaṇāya viśvāya devānāṃ paramātmane \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Salute to the divine form, Nirguna and Gunatma. Salute to the soul of universe Narayana and supreme soul of gods.

## \|\| 85.38 \|\|

*namo namaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya \|*  
*śrīśārṅgacakrāsigadādharāya namo 'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Salute to the god dwarf form and uniaue valorous. Salute to Purusottama holding Sri, Sarnga, discus, sword and mace.

## \|\| 85.39 \|\|

*guhyāya vedanilayāya mahodarāya siṃhāya daityanidhanāya caturbhujāya \|*  
*brahmendrarudramunicāraṇasaṃstutāya devottamāya varadāya namo 'cyutāya \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Salute to the best god Acyuta, great giver, secret, abode of Vedas, Mahodara, holder of lion form for demon killing, four armed and adored by Brahma, Indra, Rudra, sages and soothsayers.

## \|\| 85.40 \|\|

*nāgendradehaśayanāsanasupriyāya gokṣīrahemaśukanīlaghanopamāya \|*  
*pītāmbarāya madhukaiṭabhanāśanāya viśvāya cārumukuṭāya namo 'jarāya \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Salute to the universe formed god, free from old age, the god sleeping on the bed of king serpent, the god described using simile of cow milk, gold, parrot and blue clouds, who puts yellow garments, who has killed Madhu- kaitabha and the god holding beautiful crown.

## \|\| 85.41 \|\|

*nābhiprajātakramalasthacaturmakhāya śrīrodakārṇavaniketayaśodharāya \|*  
*nānāvicitramukuṭāṅgadabhūṣaṇāya sarveśvarāya varadāya namo varāya \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Salute to the god with Brahma existing on the lotus originated from the navel, the god dwelling in Ksirasagara, illustrious, with excellent crown and Angada etc. ornaments, great giver and boon from god of all.

## \|\| 85.42 \|\|

*bhaktipriyāya varadīptasudarśanāya phulālāravindavipulāyatalocanāya \|*  
*devendravighnaśamanodyatapauruṣāya yogeśvarāya virajāya namo varāya \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Salutation to the most Excellent, Boon- giver, Master of Yoga, Fond of devotion, who is glowing with the best radiance, beautiful complexion god, having huge eyes like blossomed lotus, the god always prepared to efface the hurdles of Indra and who is in the form of boon itself.

## \|\| 85.43 \|\|

*brahmāyanāya tridaśāyanāya lokādhināthāya bhavāpanāya \|*  
*nārāyaṇāyātmahitāyanāya mahāvarāhāya namaskaromi \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. I salute Him who is abode of Brahma and other god's shelter, ruler of three-worlds, destroyer of this universe, Narayana, the resort to self-interest Maha Varaha.

## \|\| 85.44 \|\|

*kūṭasthamavyaktamacintyarūpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāraṇamādidevam \|*  
*yugāntaśeṣaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ taṃ devadevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. I go to the shelter of Kutastha, inexpressible, having complexion beyond imagination, causative, the foremost Narayana, Purana Purusa (Ancient) who remains even after the end of era and god of gods.

## \|\| 85.45 \|\|

*yogeśvaraṃ cāruvicitramaulim ajñeyam agryaṃ prakṛteḥ parastham \|*  
*kṣetrajñamātmaprabhavaṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadya \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. I go to shelter of Yogesvara, crown holder; having strange complexion, beyond knowledge, the supreme god, beyond Prakrti, knower of the territory, Atmaprabhava (Self- bom), Varenya Vasudeva.

## \|\| 85.46 \|\|

*adṛśyamavyaktamacintyamavyayaṃ maharṣayo brahmayaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*vadanti yaṃ vai puruṣaṃ sanātanaṃ taṃ devaguhyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. I go to shelter the god Guhya addressed as invisible, inexpressible, beyond imagination, imperishable, Brahma form and immortal Purusa by hermits.

## \|\| 85.47 \|\|

*yadakṣaraṃ brahma vadanti sarvagaṃ niśamya yaṃ mṛtyumukhāt pramucyate \|*  
*tamīśvaraṃ tṛptamanuttamairguṇaiḥ parāyaṇaṃ viṣṇumupaimi sāśvatam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The god addressed as imperishable, omnipresent, Brahman, the absolute reality, Listening about whom, the people are escaped from the jaws of death, who is enriched with the best qualities, self satiated and perpetual shelter giver.

## \|\| 85.48 \|\|

*kāryaṃ kriyā kāraṇamaprameyaṃ hiraṇyabāhuṃ varapadmanābham \|*  
*mahābalaṃ vedanidhiṃ sureśaṃ va3jāmi viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ janārdanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. I shelter to the god being in the form of act, procedure and cause, inaccessible to the proofs, Hiranyabahu, with best lotus in navel, supreme powerful, trouser of Vedas, god of gods, Janardana Visnu.

## \|\| 85.49 \|\|

*kirīṭakeyūramahārhaniṣkairmaṇyuttamālaṅkṛtasarvagātram \|*  
*pītāmbaraṃ kāñcanabhakticitraṃ mālādharaṃ keśavamabhyupaimi \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. I shelter to Kesava whose body is adorned with crown, Keyura and most precious gems, who puts yellow garments, adorned with golden leaf composition and who put garland in the neck.

## \|\| 85.50 \|\|

*bhavodbhavaṃ vedavidāṃ pariṣṭhaṃ yogātmanāṃ sāṃkhyavidāṃ variṣṭham \|*  
*ādityarudrāśvivasuprabhāvaṃ prabhuṃ prapadye 'cyutamātmavantam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. I shelter to the creator of world, the supreme among people known to Vedas, best among Yogis and Samkhya knowers, Aditya, having influence of Rudra, Asvinikumara and Vasus, Acyuta and soul form god.

## \|\| 85.51 \|\|

*śrīvatsāṅkaṃ mahādevaṃ devaguhyamanaupamam \|*  
*prapadye sūkṣmamacalaṃ vareṇyamabhayapradam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. I shelter to the god holding Srivatsa, great god, cryptic among gods, beyond comparison, micro, stable, the Most distinguished who endow with fearlessness.

## \|\| 85.52 \|\|

*prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nirguṇaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*prapadye muktasaṃgānāṃ yatīnāṃ paramāṃ gatim \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. I shelter to creator of all organisms, Nirguna (attributeless), supreme position of detached ascetics, the supreme god.

## \|\| 85.53 \|\|

*bhagavantaṃ guṇādhyakṣamakṣaraṃ puṣkarekṣaṇam \|*  
*śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktyā prapadye bhaktavatsalam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. I shelter to the master of merits, aksara, lotus eyed, great shelter, gracious to devotees with keen devotion.

## \|\| 85.54 \|\|

*trivikramaṃ trilokeśaṃ sarveṣāṃ prapitāmaham \|*  
*yogātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ prapadye 'haṃ janārdanam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. I shelter to great soul Janardana, the Trivikrama, god of three-worlds, the foremost ancestor of all organisms.

## \|\| 85.55 \|\|

*ādidevamajaṃ śaṃbhuṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*nārāyaṇamaṇīyāṃsaṃ prapadye brāhmaṇapriyam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. I shelter to Adideva, unborn, Sambhu, present in expressible and inexpressible both forms, the Eternal, most micro, favourite to Narayana.

## \|\| 85.56 \|\|

*namo varāya devāya namaḥ sarvasahāya ca \|*  
*prapadye devadeveśamaṇīyāṃsamaṇoḥ sadā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Salute to the supreme god. Salute to almighty. I am always in shelter to most micro form god of gods.

## \|\| 85.57 \|\|

*ekāya lokattvāya parataḥ paramātmane \|*  
*namaḥ sahasraśirase anantāya mahātmane \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Salute to great soul ananta, who is in the form of world, all alone, Paratpara (Higher than highest) Supreme soul and having thousand heads.

## \|\| 85.58 \|\|

*tvāmeva paramaṃ devamṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ \|*  
*kīrtayanti ca yaṃ sarve brahmādīnāṃ parāyaṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The hermits having expertise in Vedas, you only are addressed as supreme god and shelter to Brahma etc. gods.

## \|\| 85.59 \|\|

*namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa bhaktānāmabhayaprada \|*  
*subrahmaṇya namaste 'stu trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О Lotus-eyed! О defender of devotees! I salute you. О Subrahmanya! Salute to you. Please, defend me, your sheltered.

## \|\| 85.60 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*bhaktiṃ tasyānusaṃcintya nāgasyamoghasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*prītimānabhavad viṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Pulastya said- Visnu, whose birth was unerring (amoghasambhava), holder of conch, discus and mace pleased on considering the devotion of that king elephant.

## \|\| 85.61 \|\|

*sānnidhyaṃ kalpayāmāsa tasmin sarasi keśavaḥ \|*  
*garuḍastho jagatsvāmī lokādhārastapodhanaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The ruler of universe, the sole basis of all lokas, the resolute Kesava rode immediately on Garuda and went at the bank of that reservoir.

## \|\| 85.62 \|\|

*grāhagrastaṃ gajendraṃ taṃ taṃ ca grāhaṃ jalāśayāt \|*  
*ujjahārāprameyātmā tarasā madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The unique soul Madhusudana pulled out that elephant and crocodile both from the reservoir immediately.

## \|\| 85.63 \|\|

*sthalasthaṃ dārayāmāsa grāhaṃ cakreṇa mādhavaḥ \|*  
*mokṣayāmāsa nāgendraṃ pāśebhyaḥ śaraṇāgatam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Madhava made free the king elephant so sheltered from the grip of crocodile by cutting-off his head through discus.

## \|\| 85.64 \|\|

*sa hi devalaśāpena hūhūrgandharvasattamaḥ \|*  
*grāhatvamagamat kṛṣṇād vadhaṃ prāpya divaṃ gataḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The Gandharva Huhu turned into crocodile on account of curse inflicted by Devala went to heaven when so killed by Krsna (Visnu).

## \|\| 85.65 \|\|

*gajo 'pi viṣṇunā spṛṣṭo jāto divyavapuḥ pumān \|*  
*āpadviktau yugapad gajagandharvasattamau \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. That elephant also became a man having divine body when touched by god Visnu. Thus, the elephant and Gandharva both freed from adversity simultaneously.

## \|\| 85.66 \|\|

*prītīmān puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ \|*  
*abhavat tvatha deveśastābhyāṃ caiva prapūjitaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. When both of them worshipped god Visnu, that defender to sheltered Pundarikaksa god was pleased.

## \|\| 85.67 \|\|

*idaṃ ca bhagavān yogī gajendraṃ śaraṇāgatam \|*  
*provāca muniśārdūla madhuraṃ madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О great sage! The glorious God Madhusudana, the Yogi sweetly said to the excellent elephant who has taken shelter with Him.

## \|\| 85.68-70 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*yo māṃ tvāñca saraścaiva grāhasya ca vidāraṇam \|*  
*gulmakīcakareṇūnāṃ rūpaṃ meroḥ sutasya ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

*aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṅgaṃ naimiṣāraṇyameva ca \|*  
*saṃsmariṣyanti manujāḥ prayatāḥ sthirabuddhayaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kīrtayiṣyanti bhaktyā ca śroṣyanti ca śucivrataḥ \|*  
*duḥsvapno naśyate teṣāṃ susvapnaśca bhaviṣyati \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. Sri god said- "The man whosoever will summon in mind with all purity and balanced disposition this reservoir, you, I, killing of crocodile, bushes grown here, Kicaka, forms of Renu and Meru's son, pipal, sun, Ganga and Naimisaranya with recital and listening attentively, nightmares to them shall effaced and better days will come undoubtedly.

## \|\| 85.71-72 \|\|

*mātsyaṃ kaurmañca vārāhaṃ vāmanaṃ tārkṣyameva ca \|*  
*nārasiṃhaṃ ca nāgendraṃ sṛṣṭipralayakārakam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*etāni prātarutthāya saṃsmariṣyanati ye narāḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyante puṇyaṃ lokamavāpnuyuḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. The man whosoever will call in mind early in morning while leaving bed my incarnation as fish, tortoise, pig, dwarf, eagle, Nrsimha, elephant and creator as also destroyer of this universe, definitely receive the noble world by absolving from the evils.

## \|\| 85.73 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśo gajendraṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*sparśayāmāsa hastena gajaṃ gandharvameva ca \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Pulastya said- with these words to elephant, Garuda rider Hrsikesa touched elephant and gandharva both.

## \|\| 85.74 \|\|

*tato divyavapurbhatvā gajendro madhusūdanam \|*  
*jagāma śaraṇaṃ vipra nārāyaṇaparāyamaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О Brahmin! The elephant sheltered exclusively to Visnu held a divine body and bowed before god.

## \|\| 85.75 \|\|

*tato nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān mokṣayitvā gajottamam \|*  
*pāpabanadhācca śāpācca grāhaṃ cādbhutakarmakṛt \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Narayana, the excellent doer then made free the elephant and crocodile from bondage of evils and curse.

## \|\| 85.76 \|\|

*ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānaśca devaguhyaparāyaṇaiḥ \|*  
*gataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurdurvijñeyagatiḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. That god executing deeds beyond imagination was prayed by the devotee hermits and god Visnu then disappeared suddenly.

## \|\| 85.77 \|\|

*gajendramokṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*vavandire mahātmānaṃ prabhuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Indra etc. gods prayed varied ways Narayana Hari when they saw that elephant has become freed from the grip of crocodile.

## \|\| 85.78 \|\|

*maharṣayaścāraṇāśca dṛṣṭvā gajavimokṣaṇam \|*  
*vismayotphūllanayanāḥ saṃstuvanti janārdanam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Hermits and Caranas became happy to see rescue of elephant and all they recited psalms in praise of Janardana.

## \|\| 85.79 \|\|

*prajāpatipatirbrahmā cakrapāṇiviceṣṭitam \|*  
*gajendramokṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Prajapati Lord Brahma on seeing at Visnu’s act of liberation of chief elephant, said-

## \|\| 85.80 \|\|

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāntityaṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ \|*  
*prāpnuyāt paramāṃ siddhiṃ duḥsvapnastasya naśyati \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The man whosoever will listen to it in early morning after leaving bed, attain to supreme position and his nightmare will efface forever.

## \|\| 85.81 \|\|

*gajendra mokṣaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*kathitena smṛtenātha śrutena ca tapodhanaḥ \|*  
*gajendramokṣaṇeneha sadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. О resolute! This episode on rescue campaign of elephant by god Visnu is all sacrosanct and it effaces all evils. A man is absolved from evil immediately when he states, summons to mind and listen to it.

## \|\| 85.82 \|\|

*etatpavitraṃ paramaṃ supuṇyaṃ saṃkīrtanīyaṃ caritaṃ murāreḥ \|*  
*yasmin kilokte bahupāpabandhanāt labhyeta mokṣo dviradena yadvat \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. This all pure act of Murari Visnu is worth reciting and giver of supreme blessing. A man reciting it, enjoys liberty from all ties of evils like the elephant in this episode.

## \|\| 85.83 \|\|

*ajaṃ vareṇyaṃ varapadmanābhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ brahmanidhiṃ sureśam \|*  
*taṃ devaguhyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ vandāmyahaṃ lokapatiṃ vareṇyam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. I pray Aja (unborn), Varenya (Excellent), the best Padmanabha, Narayana, Brahmanidhi, Suresa, Devaghuya, Purana- purusa and the ruler of the three-worlds.

## \|\| 85.84 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*etat tavoktaṃ pravaraṃ stavānāṃ stavaṃ murārervaranāgakīrtanam \|*  
*yaṃ kīrtya saṃśrutya tathā vicintya pāpāpanodaṃ puruṣo labheta \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Pulastya said- I have thus, explained this supreme psalm of Murari before you which was once recited by elephant. A man enjoys liberty from the ties of evils by reciting, listening and summoning to mind this best psalm.

## Chapter 86. The Sarasvata-Stotra

## \|\| 86.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*kaścidāsīd dvijadrogdhā piśunaḥ kṣatriyādhamaḥ \|*  
*parapīḍāruciḥ kṣudraḥ svabhāvādapi nirghṛṇaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- there was a Ksatriya meanest in behaviour, envious to Brahmins, critic, coercive, cunning and barbarious nature.

## \|\| 86.2 \|\|

*paryāsitāḥ dā tena pitṛdevadvijātayaḥ \|*  
*sa tvāyuṣi parikṣiṇe jajñe ghoro niśācaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He always dishonoured the gods and dvijatis. He became a gross demon when his age was finished.

## \|\| 86.3 \|\|

*tenaiva karmadoṣema svena pāpakṛtāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*kruraiścakre tato vṛttiṃ rākṣasatvād viśeṣataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. On account of that evil and particularly because of being his demon, that heinous criminal began to earn his livelihood through the cruel or illegal acts.

## \|\| 86.4 \|\|

*tasya pāparatasyaivaṃ jagmurvarṣaśatāni tu \|*  
*tenaiva karmadoṣeṇa nānyāṃ vṛttimarocayat \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The period about one hundred years passed to his involvement in doing heinous acts. Due to defects of that act his interests to other profession were dead.

## \|\| 86.5 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ paśyati sattvaṃ sa taṃ tamādāya rākṣasaḥ \|*  
*cakhāda raudrakarmāsau bāhugocaramāgatam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. That heinous demon would then grip the man seen of his sturdy arms and make prey of him.

## \|\| 86.6 \|\|

*evaṃ tasyātiduṣṭasya kurvataḥ prāṇināṃ vadham \|*  
*jagāma ca mahān kālaḥ pariṇāmaṃ tathā vayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. That wicked demon had passed a longer period in killing the innocent lives and then his body started deteriorating.

## \|\| 86.7 \|\|

*sa kadācit tapasyantaṃ dadarśa sataritastaṭe \|*  
*mahābhāgamūrdhvabhujaṃ yathāvatsaṃyatendriyam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He once saw a luckiest hermit duly balance mind and sensory organs in systematic a process, keeping his mouth facing the ether on the bank of a river.

## \|\| 86.8 \|\|

*anayā rakṣayā brahman kṛtarakṣaṃ taponidhim \|*  
*yogācāryaṃ śuciṃ dakṣaṃ vāsudevaparāyaṇam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Brahmin! That Yogacarya, devotee to Vasudeva, resolute, pure soul and mind, expert, had defended him from the clutches of that demon.

## \|\| 86.9 \|\|

*viṣṇuḥ prācyāṃ stitaścakrī viṣaṇurdakṣiṇato gadī \|*  
*pratīcyāṃ śārṅgadhṛgviṣṇurviṣṇuḥ khaḍgī mamottare \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. May Visnu with discus defend me at east, Gadadhara Visnu at the south, Visnu holding Sarnga bow at the west and Visnu holding sword at the north defend me.

## \|\| 86.10 \|\|

*hṛṣīkeśo vikoṇeṣu tacchidreṣu janārdanaḥ \|*  
*kroḍarūpī harirbhūmau nārasiṃho 'mbare mama \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Hrsikesa in the angles of directions, Janardana in those direction and sub- directioes, Hari in Varaha form on the land and Nrsimha in the sky should defend me.

## \|\| 86.11 \|\|

*śrurāntamamalaṃ cakraṃ bhramatyetat sudarśanam \|*  
*asyāṃśumālā duṣprekṣyā hantuṃ pretaniśācarān \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. This Sudarsana-cakra is rotating fastly, it is acute and its beams are very tough to endure.

## \|\| 86.12 \|\|

*gadā ceyaṃ sahasrārcirudvaman pāvako yathā \|*  
*rakṣobhūtapiśācānāṃ ḍākinīnāṃ ca śātanī \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. May this mace destroy the demons, ghosts, devils and dakinis. It is vested with one thousand beams like the fire emitting flames.

## \|\| 86.13 \|\|

*śārṅgaṃ visphūrjitaṃ caiva vāsudevasya madripūn \|*  
*tiryaṅmanuṣyakūṣmāṇḍapretādīn hantvaśeṣataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. May the glowing Sarnga bow of Vasudeva destroy completely the violent animals and predating birds, the men, demons and devils now become my enemies.

## \|\| 86.14 \|\|

*khaḍgadhārājvalajjyotsnānirdhūtā ye mamāhitāḥ \|*  
*te yāntu saumyatāṃ sadyo garuḍeneva pannagāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. As the serpents are stunned of fear when they saw eagle, my opponents and rivals would loss their vanity and turn humble by virtue of the sharp edge of sword held by god Visnu. I wish for it.

## \|\| 86.15-16 \|\|

*ye kūṣmāṇḍāstathā yakṣā daityā ye ca niśācarāḥ \|*  
*pretā vināyakāḥ krūrā manuṣyā jṛmbhakāḥ khagāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*siṃhādayo ye paśavo dandaśūkāśca pannagāḥ \|*  
*sarve bhavantu me saumyā viṣṇucakraravāhatāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. I wish all Kusmanda, Yaksa, demon, demon, devil, Vinayaka, cruel people, Jrmbhaka, birds, lion etc. animals and bite of serpents having dangerous poison be subdued before the speed of discus held by god Visnu and -nay these all become modest to me.

## \|\| 86.17-18 \|\|

*cittavṛttiharā ye ca ye janāḥ smṛtīhārakāḥ \|*  
*balaujasāṃ ca hartāraśchāyāvidhvaṃsakāśca ye \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ye copabhogahartāro ye ca lakṣaṇanāśakāḥ \|*  
*kūṣmāṇḍāste praṇaśyantu viṣṇucakraravāhatāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. May all Kusmanda etc. (ghost and devils) disturbing the citta (the heart and mind both), reducing memory, predator of power and splendour, destroyer of radiance, killer of pleasures and destroyer of characteristics be wound thereby eradicate.

## \|\| 86.19 \|\|

*buddhisvāsthyaṃ manaḥsvāsthyaṃ svāsthamaindriyakaṃ tathā \|*  
*mamāstu devadevasya vāsudevasya kīrtanāt \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. May recital of god of gods Vasudeva endow me with healthy mind, attitude and sensors.

## \|\| 86.20 \|\|

*pṛṣṭhe purastādatha dakṣiṇottare vikoṇataścāstu najārdano hariḥ \|*  
*tamīḍyamīśānamanantamacyutaṃ janārdanaṃ praṇipatito na sīdati \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. May Janardana Hari be present at my back, front, right, left and the angles existed in directions. A man bowing his head with sheer obeisance before Janardana, the adorable Isana, Ananta and Acyuta seldom suffers.

## \|\| 86.21 \|\|

*yathā paraṃ brahma haristathā paraṃ jagatsvarūpaśca sa eva keśavaḥ \|*  
*ṛtena tenācyutanāmakīrtanātpraṇāśametu trividhaṃ mamāsubham \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Hari is supreme as Brahma has supreme place. That Kesava is in the form of world. May! The three omens of me destroy by virtue of the truth that I have recited the names of Acyutas.

## \|\| 86.22 \|\|

*ityasāvātmarakṣārthaṃ kṛtvā vai viṣṇupañjaram \|*  
*saṃsthito 'sāvapi balī rākṣasaḥ samupādravat \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thus, he was existed there vinyasa (summoning god with several names on the parts of bodes). That mighty demon rushed towards hiin.

## \|\| 86.23-24 \|\|

*tato dvijaniyuktāyāṃ rakṣāyāṃ rajanīcaraḥ \|*  
*nirdhūtavegaḥ sahasā tasthau māsacatuṣṭayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yāvad dvijasya devarṣe samāptirvai samādhitaḥ \|*  
*jāte japyāvasāne 'sau ta dadarśa niśācaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. O divine hermit! When that demon approached to the boundary of defence appropriated by Brahmana, he became motionless and fell there unless after passage of four months, the meditation was over. After satisfactory completion of Japa, he saw that demon lying there.

## \|\| 86.25-27 \|\|

*dīnaṃ hatabālotsāhaṃ kāndiśīkaṃ hataujasam \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayāviṣṭaḥ samāśvāsya niśācaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

*papracchāgamane hetuṃ sa cācaṣṭa yathātatham \|*  
*svabhāvamātmano draṣṭuṃ rakṣayā tejasaḥ kṣitim \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kathayitvā ca tadrakṣaḥ kāraṇaṃ vividhaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*prasīdetyabravīd vipraṃ nirviṇṇāḥ svena karmaṇā \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Не consoled that down-head, powerless, discouraged, anxious and splendour lost demon and asked the reason for his arrival. He explained that his splendour has been reduced as he has understood his real nature. He described a number of reasons but expressed pain on his activity. He said to Brahmin- "Please, be in cheers."

## \|\| 86.28 \|\|

*bahūni pāpāni mokṣamicchāmi tvatprasādataḥ \|*  
*kṛtāḥ striyo mayā bahvyo vidhavāḥ putravarjitāḥ \|*  
*anāgasāṃ ca sattvānāmalpakānāṃ kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I have committed sins in abundance and killed a number of people. I made the women widows and issueless and killed the innocent organisms lesser in power than me.

## \|\| 86.29 \|\|

*tasmāt pāpādahaṃ mokṣamicchami tvatprasādataḥ \|*  
*pāpapraśamanāyālaṃ kuru me dharmadeśanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. I want to get-rid-of the evils so committed under your grace. Please, preach me the religion (acts) that could efface the evils.

## \|\| 86.30 \|\|

*pāpasyāsya kṣayaramupadeśaṃ prayaccha me \|*  
*tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasasya dvijottamaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Please, preach me the way to absolve the heinous activities committed by me. The religious dvija preached for his interests.

## \|\| 86.31 \|\|

*vacanaṃ prāha dharmātmā hetumacca subhāṣitam \|*  
*kathaṃ krūrasvabhāvasya satastava niśācara \|*  
*sahasaiva samāyātā jijñāsā dharmavartmani \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. O demon! How your curiosity was bom suddenly in the matter of acts and now you want to observe regrettal.

## \|\| 86.32 \|\|

*rākṣasa uvāca \|*  
*tvāṃ vai samāgato 'smyadya kṣipto 'haṃ rakṣayā balāt \|*  
*tava saṃsargato brahman jāto nirveda uttamaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The demon said- I was thrown forcibly out as soon as I could love to you. Perhaps, it was the phenomenal of the defence you summoned metaphysically. О Brahmin! It is the influence of your contact that inspired me to detach from such activities.

## \|\| 86.33 \|\|

*kā sā rakṣā na tāṃ vedmi vedmi nāsyāḥ parāyaṇam \|*  
*yasyāḥ saṃsargasāsādya nirvedaṃ prāpitaṃ param \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. I don’t know that which type of that defence is so phenomenal that it has suddenly shifted my mind to other side.

## \|\| 86.34 \|\|

*tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru dharmajña mayyanukrośamāvaha \|*  
*yathā pāpāpanodo me bhavatyārya tathā kuru \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О religion abiding! О Arya! Have a grace on me. Be merciful to me. Do the activity which could efface the sins committed by me.

## \|\| 86.35 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca\|*  
*ityevamuktaḥ sa munistadā vai tena rakṣasā \|*  
*pratyuvāca mahābhāgo vimṛśya suciraṃ muniḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Pulastya said- Being thus addressed by Raksasa that great sage thought in mind for a little while and then replied.

## \|\| 86.36 \|\|

*ṛṣiruvāca\|*  
*yanmamāhopadeśārthaṃ nirviṇṇāḥ svena karmaṇā \|*  
*yuktametaddhi pāpānāṃ nivṛttirupakārikā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The hermit said- You have done outright to ask my suggestion when you suddenly realised the dire-consequence of the acts committed by you. A man receives progress by effacing his evils.

## \|\| 86.37 \|\|

*kariṣye yātudhānānāṃ natvahaṃ dharmadeśanam \|*  
*tān saṃpṛccha dvijān saumya ye vai pravacane ratāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. However, I will not preach religion to the demons. Hence, О modest man! Ask those Brahmins who deliver speech.

## \|\| 86.38 \|\|

*evamuktvā yayau vipraścintāmāpa sa rākṣasaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ pāpāpanodaḥ syāditi cintākulendriyaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. That Brahmin with these words, left that place. His senses became inpatient when he worried of the acts committed and their consequences.

## \|\| 86.39 \|\|

*na cakhāda sa sattvāni kṣudhā saṃbādhito 'pi san \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe tadā kāle jantumekamabhakṣayat \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Не did not eat the organisms in spite of suffering from hunger. He began to kill and prey at only bird / organism within three days (six time means single diet on third day).

## \|\| 86.40 \|\|

*sa kadācitkṣudhāviṣṭaḥ paryaṭan vipule vane \|*  
*dadarśātha phalāhāramāgataṃ brahmacāriṇam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Once upon a time, he saw a celibate came for plucking fruits from the forest when he was strolling there. He was most hungry.

## \|\| 86.41 \|\|

*gṛhīto rakṣasā tena sa tadā munidārakaḥ \|*  
*nirāśo jīvite prāha sāmapūrvaṃ niśācaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The demon gripped the son of hermit. That celibate, having lost hope of life, enquired him.

## \|\| 86.42 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*bho bhadra brūhi yat kāryaṃ gṛhīto yena hetunā \|*  
*tadanubrūhi bhadraṃ te ayamasmyanuśādhi mām \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The Brahmin said- О gentleman! Tell me about your mission and why have you gripped me? I wish all good for you. Order me, please.

## \|\| 86.43 \|\|

*rākṣasa uvāca \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhe kāle tvamāhāraḥ kṣudhitasya samāgataḥ \|*  
*niḥśrīkasyātipāpasya nirghṛṇasya dvijadruhaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The demon said- I am without money, an evildoer, most miscreant, cruel and rival to Brahmin. I am hungry and on third day as my rule for taking diet, I see you here.

## \|\| 86.44 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*yadyavaśyaṃ tvayā cāhaṃ bhakṣitavyo niśācara \|*  
*āyāsyāmi tavādyaiva nivedya gurave phalam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Brahmin said- О demon! Of you really want to eat my flesh, I first want to offer these, fruits to my preceptor and will then return soon.

## \|\| 86.45 \|\|

*gurvarthametadāgatya yatphalagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*mamātra niṣṭhā prāptasya phalāni viniveditum \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The fruits gathered by me here for preceptor, I with obeisance, want to hand-over these to him.

## \|\| 86.46 \|\|

*sa tvaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ māmatraivaṃ pratipālaya \|*  
*nivedya gurave yāvadihāgacchāmyahaṃ phalam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Hence, wait for me here for a few minutes (muhurta) so that I could come back after giving these fruits to preceptor.

## \|\| 86.47 \|\|

*rākṣasa uvāca\|*  
*ṣaṣṭhe kāle na me brahman kaścid grahaṇamāgataḥ \|*  
*pratimucyeta devo 'pi iti me pāpājīvikā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The Raksasa said- О Brahmin! Nobody even the gods themselves cannot escape from my hand when I see him on the expiry of third day living without food.

## \|\| 86.48 \|\|

*eka evātra mokṣasya tava hetuḥ śṛṇuṣva tat \|*  
*muñcāmyahamasaṃdigdhaṃ yadi tatkurute bhavān \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Listen to a single step for your liberty. I will relieve you if you could exercise it properly.

## \|\| 86.49 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*guroryanna virodhāya yanna dharmoparodhakam \|*  
*tatkariṣyāmyahaṃ rakṣo yanna vrataharaṃ mama \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The Brahmin said- О demon! If the assignment is not against preceptor, resister to religion and not having effect of splitting my resolution; I certainly perform it without any reservations.

## \|\| 86.50 \|\|

*rākṣasa uvāca \|*  
*mayā nisargato brahman jātidoṣād viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*nirvivekena cittena pāpakarma sadā kṛtam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The demon said- О Brahmin! I have committed sins always due to having it my nature, particularly being defective caste and without discretion of citta.

## \|\| 86.51 \|\|

*ābālyānmama pāpeṣu na dharmeṣu rataṃ manaḥ \|*  
*tatpāpāsaṃkṣayānmokṣaṃ prāpnuyāṃ yena tad vada \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Му mind stacked to evils instead of religion. Please, therefore tell me the step that may curtail my evils and ensure my emancipation.

## \|\| 86.52 \|\|

*yāni pāpāni karmāṇi bālatvāccaritāni ca \|*  
*duṣṭāṃ yonimimāṃ prāpya tanmuktiṃ kathaya dvija \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O Dvija! Tell me the steps to be followed for regrettal of the offences committed unknowingly due to having this wicked yoni and which may ensure my emancipation.

## \|\| 86.53 \|\|

*yadyetad dvijaputra tvaṃ samākhyāsyasyaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ kṣudhārtānmattastvaṃ niyataṃ mokṣamāpsyasi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О Brahmin! In case you could explain a viable method duly understood to me, I assure of not killing you and would like to starve better than murder.

## \|\| 86.54 \|\|

*na cet tatpāpaśīlo 'hamatyarthaṃ kṣutpipāsitaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhe kāle nṛśaṃsātmā bhakṣayiṣyāmi nirghṛṇaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. If you could not satisfy me, I am starving thereby cruel as I could get you on the third day of my living without food.

## \|\| 86.55 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*evamukto munisutastena ghorema rakṣasā \|*  
*cintāmavāpa mahatīmaśaktastadudīraṇe \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Pulastya said- As that hermit's son was not able enough to suggest viable way the method to receive emancipation, he worried most as his life was at stake.

## \|\| 86.56 \|\|

*sa vimṛśya ciraṃ vipraḥ śaraṇaṃ jātavedasam \|*  
*jagāma jñānadānāya saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. He pondered on the matter longer but confused. Hence, he summoned fire to mind for providing with the viable knowledge.

## \|\| 86.57 \|\|

*yadi śuśruṣito vahnirguruśuśrūṣaṇādanu \|*  
*vratāni vā sucīrṇāni saptārciḥ pātu māṃ tataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. He prayed- О Agni! Defend me at this eleven hour if I have given you importance and honour next to preceptor with the core of my heart and mind. Please, rescue me if I have really served you and observed the parts solemnly.

## \|\| 86.58 \|\|

*na mātaraṃ na pitaraṃ gauraveṇa yathā gurum \|*  
*sarvadaivāvagacchāmi tathā māṃ pātu pāvakaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O Agni! If I have given the teacher more importance then parent in the matter of expression of respect, please, defend me.

## \|\| 86.59 \|\|

*yathā guruṃ na manasā karmaṇā vacasāpi vā \|*  
*avajānāmyahaṃ tena pātu satyena pāvakaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. If I have really not insulted anyway either through acts or speech and mind to my preceptor, this truth may ensure my defence under grace of fire.

## \|\| 86.60 \|\|

*ityevaṃ manasā satyān kurvataḥ śapathān punaḥ \|*  
*saptarciṣā samādiṣṭā prādurāsīt sarasvatī \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. When he was so summoning wisdom from fire, goddess Sarasvati appeared there at once under instructions of fire.

## \|\| 86.61 \|\|

*sā provāca dvijasutaṃ rākṣasagrahaṇākulam \|*  
*mā bhairdvijasutāhaṃ tvāṃ mokṣayiṣyāmi saṃkaṭāt \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. She said to the anxious and puzzled Brahmin who was trembling wit fright of death, О Brahmin! Don’t be afraid. I will rescue you at this moment of calamity.

## \|\| 86.62 \|\|

*yadasya rakṣasaḥ śreyo jihvāgre saṃsthitā tava \|*  
*tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tato mokṣamavāpsyasi \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. I will make my seat at the fore-portion of your tongue and automatically start telling the welfare forth to exercise for this demon. You shall then enjoy liberty.

## \|\| 86.63 \|\|

*adṛśyā rakṣasā tena proktvetthaṃ sā sarasvatī \|*  
*adarśānaṃ gatā so 'pi dvijaḥ prāha niśācaram \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Maintaining her invisible to that demon, goddess Sarasvati vanished. That Brahmin then suggested the demon.

## \|\| 86.64 \|\|

*brāhmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*śruyatāṃ tava yacchreyastathānyeṣāṃ ca pāpinām \|*  
*samastapāpaśuddhyarthaṃ puṇyopacayadaṃ ca yat \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Brahmin said- "Listen carefully being now told by me the way which will ensure all good not only for you but also for other evil-doers like you.

## \|\| 86.65 \|\|

*prātarutthāya japtavyaṃ madhyāhne 'hnakṣaye 'pi vā \|*  
*asaṃśayaṃ sadā japyo japatāṃ puṣṭiśāntidaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Get up early in morning and recite this psalm in noon and evening also. This japa give peace and satisfaction to the man who exercises it.

## \|\| 86.66 \|\|

*oṃ hariṃ kuṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*praṇato 'smi jagannāthaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. I salute Om Hari, Krsna, Hrsikes'a, Vasudeva, Janardana, Jagannatha. I wish he should remove my evils.

## \|\| 86.67 \|\|

*carācarasuruṃ nāthaṃ govindaṃ śeṣaśāyinam \|*  
*praṇato 'smi paraṃ devaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. I do salute to the preceptor of this movable and immovable world, die ruler of the universe, the supreme god Govinda. I pray to absolve my sins.

## \|\| 86.68 \|\|

*śaṅkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ śārṅgadhāriṇaṃ sragdharaṃ param \|*  
*praṇato 'smi patiṃ lakṣmyāḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. I salute the husband of Laksmi, the conch, discus, sarnga bow and garland holding god. I pray him to absolve me sins.

## \|\| 86.69 \|\|

*dāmodaramudārākṣaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam \|*  
*praṇato 'smi stutaṃ stutyaiḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. I bow my head at the feet of Damodara, kind eyed, Pundarikaksa and Acyuta worshipped through reciting a number of psalms.

## \|\| 86.70 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ śauriṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam \|*  
*praṇato 'smi dharādhāraṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. I salute to Narayana, Nara, Sauri, Madhava, Madhusudana and Dharadhara. May that god absolve the sins committed by me earlier.

## \|\| 86.71 \|\|

*keśavaṃ candrasūryākṣaṃ kaṃsakeśiniṣūdanam \|*  
*praṇato 'smi mahābāhuṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. I salute Kesava, sun and moon eyed, killer of Kamsa and Кеsi, the great warrior. May be absolve my sins.

## \|\| 86.72 \|\|

*śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ śrīśaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīniketanam \|*  
*praṇato 'smi śriyaḥ kāntaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. I salute Srisa, Sridhara, Sriniketana and Srikanta holding Srivatsa on the chest. May he remove the effect of sins committed erstwhile.

## \|\| 86.73 \|\|

*yamīśaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhyāyanti yatayo 'kṣaram \|*  
*vāsudevamanirdeśyaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. I am tempted to the shelter of Vasudeva on which ascetics concentrate looking and feeling him on Aksara. He is sovereign god.

## \|\| 86.74 \|\|

*samastālambanebhyo yaṃ vyāvṛttya manaso gatim \|*  
*dhyāyanti vāsudevākhyaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. I go to shelter Isvara known as Vasudeva concentrated by ascetics controlling their mind from other worldly issues.

## \|\| 86.75 \|\|

*sarvagaṃ sarvabhūtaṃ ca sarvasyādhāramīśvaram \|*  
*vāsudevaṃ paraṃ brahma tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. I go to shelter of omniscient, in the form of all organisms, nourisher of all, Isvara and Vasudeva called Brahma.

## \|\| 86.76 \|\|

*paramātmānamavyaktaṃ yaṃ prayānti sumedhasaḥ \|*  
*karmakṣaye 'kṣayaṃ devaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. I go to the shelter of inexpressible, undepleting, the supreme soul god who is perceived by the learned persons when their activities are declined or involved in evils.

## \|\| 86.77 \|\|

*puṇyapāpavinirmuktā yaṃ praviśya punarbhavam \|*  
*na yoginaḥ prāpnuvanti tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. I go to the shelter of Yogis who after crossing the boundary of feelings as evil and noble attain him and them enjoy liberty from the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 86.78 \|\|

*brahma bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam \|*  
*yaḥ sṛjatyacyuto devastamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. I go to the shelter of imperishable god, who hold the form of Brahma and create gods, demons and entire world including human beings.

## \|\| 86.79 \|\|

*brahmatve yasya vaktrebhyaścaturvedamayaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*prabhuḥ purātano jajñe tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. I go to the shelter of Brahma from whose mouth the Puratana sovereign having body consisting of four Vedas originated.

## \|\| 86.80 \|\|

*brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ jagadyoni janārdanam \|*  
*sraṣṭṛtve saṃsthitaṃ sṛṣṭau praṇato 'smi sanātanam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. I salute Janardana, the Eternal and the origin of all beings in the form of Brahma existed as creator for this entire world.

## \|\| 86.81 \|\|

*sraṣṭā bhūtvā sthito yogī sthitāvasurasūdanaḥ \|*  
*tamādipuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ pramato 'smi janārdanam \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. I salute Janardana, the First-born who exists as гесluse in spite of being his creator and who destroys the demons at the time of great devastation (Pralaya).

## \|\| 86.82 \|\|

*dhṛtā mahī hatā daityāḥ paritrātāstathā surāḥ \|*  
*yena taṃ viṣṇumādyeśaṃ praṇato 'smi janārdanam \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. I salute the foremost god Janardana Visnu who holds this earth, killed the demons and guarded gods time to time.

## \|\| 86.83 \|\|

*yajñairyajanti yaṃ viprā yajñeśaṃ yajñabhāvanam \|*  
*taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇato 'smi sanātanam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. I salute to Sanatana Visnu, yajna purusa, yajnabhavana, yangesa worshipped by Brahmins through the yajnas they perform.

## \|\| 86.84 \|\|

*pātālavīthībhūtānu tathā lokān nihanti yaḥ \|*  
*tamantapuruṣaṃ rudraṃ praṇato 'smi sanātanam \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. I salute Sanatana Rudra, the god residing in nether world, destroyer of organisms and lokas (worlds). He is Anta-purusa (who only exists after devastation).

## \|\| 86.85 \|\|

*saṃbhakṣayitvā sakalaṃ yathāsṛṣṭamidaṃ jagat \|*  
*yo vai nṛtyati rudrātmā praṇato 'smi janārdanam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. I salute Rudratma Janardana who merges this once created whole world with him and then start dancing.

## \|\| 86.86 \|\|

*surāsurāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*saṃbhūtā yasya devasya sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmyaham \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. I bow down that all-pervading Visnu, from whom all Gods, demons, Pitrganas (ancestors), yaksa, gandharva and Raksasas have bom.

## \|\| 86.87 \|\|

*samastadevāḥ sakalā manuṣyāṇāṃ ca jātayaḥ \|*  
*yasyāṃśabhūtā devasya sarvagaṃ taṃ nato 'smayaham \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. I salute that omnipresent god from whose rays all species of gods and human beings have been originated.

## \|\| 86.88 \|\|

*vṛkṣagulmādayo yasya tathā paśumṛgādayaḥ \|*  
*ekāṃśabhūtā devasya sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmyaham \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. I salute that all reaching god whose rays are existed in this world in the form of trees, creepers etc.

## \|\| 86.89 \|\|

*yasmānnānyat paraṃ kiñcid yasmin sarvaṃ mahātmani \|*  
*yaḥ sarvamadhyago 'nantaḥ sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmyaham \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. I salute that omnipresent god from whom nothing is different, that supreme soul holds everything and he is inserted in all hearts everlasting.

## \|\| 86.90 \|\|

*yathā sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍho 'gniriva dāruṣu \|*  
*viṣṇurevaṃ tathā pāpaṃ mamāśeṣaṃ praṇaśyatu \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. May Visnu, the god inserted in. all organisms so micro form as the fire is inserted in the wood-absolve the evils committed by me.

## \|\| 86.91 \|\|

*yathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmadi sacarācaram \|*  
*yacca jñānaparicchedyaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatu me tathā \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. As this material world in its entirety including Brahma etc. is covered by Visnu, he is the treasure of knowledge. I wish my evils get absolved.

## \|\| 86.92 \|\|

*śubhaśubhāni karmāṇi rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca \|*  
*anekajanmakarmotthaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatu me tathā \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. May the account of sins accumulated from several previous births due to evil-deeds committed, the Tamasa, Rajasa and Sattva being cause for good and evil acts, be eradicated.

## \|\| 86.93-95 \|\|

*yanniśāyāṃ ca yatprātaryanmadhyāhnāparāhṇayoḥ \|*  
*saṃdhyayośca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā \|\| 93 \|\|*

*yat tiṣṭhatā yad vrajatā yacca śayyāgatena me \|*  
*kṛtaṃ yadaśubhaṃ karma kāyena manasā girā \|\| 94 \|\|*

*ajñānato jñānato vā madāccalitamānasaiḥ \|*  
*tat kṣipraṃ vilayaṃ yātu vāsudevasya kīrtanāt \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. May the good or evil acts committed by my body through mind, speech and action, at night, in morning, at noon, afternoon and evening, while sitting, walking, sleeping, deliberately or undeliberately (innocently) or a mind deflated in ego- be absolved by virtue of reciting psalms for the pleasure of Vasudeva.

## \|\| 86.96-97 \|\|

*paradāraparadravyavāñchādrohodbhavaṃ ca yat \|*  
*parapīḍodbhavāṃ nindāṃ kurvatā yanmahātmanām \|\| 96 \|\|*

*yacca bhojye tathā peye bhakṣye coṣye vilehane \|*  
*tad yātu vilayaṃ toye yathā lavaṇabhājanam \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. Sins originated on account of greed for other’s wife and wealth, envy, coercion, abusing greatmen and due to effect of edibles, drinks, the food which needs gobble the liquid food consumed by licking and sipping should be dissolved as salt pot is dissolved in water.

## \|\| 86.98-99 \|\|

*yad bālye yacca kaumāre yat pāpaṃ yauvane mama \|*  
*vayaḥpariṇatau yacca yacca janmātare kṛtam \|\| 98 \|\|*

*tannārāyaṇa govinda harikṛṣṇeśa kīrtanāt \|*  
*prayātu vilayaṃ toye yathā lavaṇabhājanam \|\| 99 \|\|*

98-99. As the salt vessel is dissolved when placed in water, the sins committed during childhood, teenage, youth, old age and previous births should be dissolved by virtue of reciting the names of god as Narayana, Govinda, Harikrsna and Isa.

## \|\| 86.100 \|\|

*viṣṇave vāsudevāya haraye keśavāya ca \|*  
*janārdanāya kṛṣṇāya namo bhūyo namo namaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. My salutation frequently is conveyed to Hari, Visnu, Vasudeva, Kesava, Janardana and Krsna.

## \|\| 86.101 \|\|

*bhaviṣyannarakaghnāya namaḥ kaṃsavighātine \|*  
*ariṣṭakeśicaṇūradevārikṣayiṇe namaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. I salute to the killer of Kamsa, the god defending from perspective fall in the hell, salute to killer of Arista, Kesi and Canura etc. demons.

## \|\| 86.102 \|\|

*ko 'nyo balervañcayitā tvāmṛte vai bhaviṣyati \|*  
*ko 'nyo nāśayati balād darpaṃ haihayabhūpateḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. Who except you could cheat Bali and who could destroy the egoness of Haihaya king without you?

## \|\| 86.103 \|\|

*kaḥ kariṣyatyathānyo vai sāgare setubandhanam \|*  
*vadhiṣyati daśagrīvaṃ kaḥ sāmātyapuraḥsaram \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Who can construct a bridge on sea except you? And who can kill Dasagriva (Ravana) along with his ministers.

## \|\| 86.104 \|\|

*kastvāmṛte 'nyo nandasya gokule ratimeṣyati \|*  
*pralambapūtanādīnāṃ tvāmṛte madhusūdana \|*  
*nihantāpyathabā śāstā devadeva bhaviṣyati \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. О Madhusudana! Who except you can play with game of love in Gokula of Nanda? О god of gods! Who except you could slaughter and control Pralamba and Putana etc.

## \|\| 86.105-107 \|\|

*japannevaṃ naraḥ puṇyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmamuttamam \|*  
*iṣṭāniṣṭaprasaṃgebhyo jñānato 'jñānato 'pi vā \|\| 105 \|\|*

*kṛtaṃ tena tu yat pāpaṃ saptajanmāntarāṇi vai \|*  
*mahāpātakasaṃjñaṃ vā tathā caivopapātakam \|\| 106 \|\|*

*jajñādīni ca puṇyāni japahomavratāni ca \|*  
*nāśayed yogināṃ sarvamāmapātramivāmbhasi \|\| 107 \|\|*

105-107. The man reciting this supreme Vaisnava decays the pretty and heinous evils committed in context with desired and undesired, deliberately or innocently during seven births and the noble deeds performed like yajna, homa and fasts etc. as the coarse pitcher is dissolve in water.

## \|\| 86.108-109 \|\|

*naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ tilapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*ahanyahani yo dadyāt paṭhatyetacca tatsamam \|\| 108 \|\|*

*aviluptabrahmacaryaṃ saṃprāpya smaraṇaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*viṣṇulokamavāpnoti satyametanmayoditam \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. I state solemnly that the man giving sixteen vessels full of sesamum daily along with reciting this psalm under strict observance of celibacy and summoning god receives the abode of Visnu after his death.

## \|\| 86.110 \|\|

*yathaitat stayamuktaṃ me na hyalpamapi me mṛṣā \|*  
*rākṣasastrastasarvāṅgaṃ tathā māmeṣa muñcatu \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. If I have stated it true and nothing is false like in my statement, this demon should left me as I am suffering.

## \|\| 86.111 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*evamuccārite tena mukto viprastu rakṣasā \|*  
*akāmena dvijo bhūyastamāha rajanīcaram \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. Pulastya said- The demon made free the Brahmin. Dvija again said to demon in plain words.

## \|\| 86.112 \|\|

*brahmaṇa uvāca \|*  
*etad bhadra mayā khyātaṃ tava pātakanāśanam \|*  
*viṣṇoḥ sārasvataṃ stotraṃ yajjagāda sarasvatī \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Brahmin said- О gentleman! the Eternal (Sarasvata) hymns of Visnu as stated by goddess Sarasvati herself has been explained by me exacted in that form without modification anyway.

## \|\| 86.113 \|\|

*hutāśanena prahitā mama jihvāgrasaṃsthitā \|*  
*jagādainaṃ stavaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarveṣāṃ copaśāntidam \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Sarasvati existed on the fore portion of my tongue who was sent by the fire god, has recited this psalm to Visnu.

## \|\| 86.114 \|\|

*anenaiva jagannāthaṃ tvamārādhaya kesavam \|*  
*tataḥ śāpāpanodaṃ tu stute lapsyasi keśave \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. Do worship of Kesava, the master of universe. By offering psalm to Kesava you shall definitely absolve from the evils.

## \|\| 86.115 \|\|

*aharniśaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ stavenānena rākṣasa \|*  
*stuhi bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pāpād vimokṣyase \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. О demon! Pray Hrsikesa with this psalm daily night and day. Keep sheer devotion for god in your heart and mind. By offering this psalm to Kesava you shall be absolved from sins.

## \|\| 86.116 \|\|

*stuto hi sarvapāpāni nāśayiṣyatyasaṃśayam \|*  
*stuto hi bhaktyā nṝṇāṃ vai sarvapāpaharo hariḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. Hari so prayed shall definitely destroy your all evils. Hari, the destroyer of all sins absolve the people from the sins committed earlier.

## \|\| 86.117 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*tataḥ praṇamya taṃ vipraṃ prasādya sa niśācaraḥ \|*  
*tadaiva tapase śrīmān śālagrāmamagād vaśī \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Pulastya said- that self-controlled demon then saluted the Brahmin, pleased him and moved for Sslagrama in order to observe penance so suggested.

## \|\| 86.118 \|\|

*aharniśaṃ sa evainaṃ japan sārasvataṃ stavam \|*  
*devakriyāratirbhūtvā tapastepe niśācaraḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. That demon began engrossing his mind there with the worship of god with reciting the above-said psalm throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 86.119 \|\|

*samārādhya jagannāthaṃ sa tatra puraṣottamam \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokamavāptavān \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Не worshipped there Purusottama Jagannatha, absolved from all sins committed till then and obtained the abode of Visnu.

## \|\| 86.120 \|\|

*etat te kathitaṃ brahman viṣṇoḥ sārasvataṃ stavam \|*  
*vipravaktrasthayā samyaksarasvatyā samīritam \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. O Brahmin! I have thus completely told you this Sarasvata strotra for the pleasure of Visnu as it came down from Sarasvati seated tongue of Brahmin.

## \|\| 86.121 \|\|

*ya etat paramaṃ stotraṃ vāsudevasya mānavaḥ \|*  
*paṭhaṣyati sa sarvebhyaḥ pāpebhyo mokṣamāpsyati \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. The man reciting this supreme psalm, will definitely absolve from the sins committed earlier by him.

## Chapter 87. Birth of Vamana and his eulogy by Brahma

## \|\| 87.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*namaste 'stu jagannātha devadevaṃ namo 'stu te \|*  
*vāsudeva namaste 'stu bahurūpa namo 'stu te \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О Lord of Universe! Salute is conveyed to you. О god of gods! I salute you. О Vasudeva! Salute to you. О multifarious god! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.2 \|\|

*ekaśṛṅga namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ vṛṣākape \|*  
*śrīnivāsa namaste 'stu namaste bhūtabhāvana \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О single horn god! Salute to you. О Vrsakapi (Man-ape)! Salute to you. О Srinivasa (abode of Laksmi)! Salute to you. О Bhutavahana! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.3 \|\|

*viṣvaksena namastubhyaṃ nārāyaṇa namo 'stu te \|*  
*dhruvadhvaja namasto 'stu satyadhvaja namo 'stu te \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О Visvaksena! Salute to you. О Narayana! salute to you. О Dhruvadhvaja! Salute to you. О Satyadhvaja! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.4 \|\|

*yajñadhvaja namastubhyaṃ dharmadhvaja namo 'stu te \|*  
*tāladhvaja namaste 'stu namaste garuhadhvaja \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О Yajnadhvaja! Salute to you. О Dharmadhvaja! Salute to you. О Taladhvaja! Salute to you. О Garudadhvaja! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.5 \|\|

*vareṇya viṣṇo vaikuṇṭha namaste puruṣottama \|*  
*namo jayanta vijaya jayānanta parājita \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O Varenya! О Visnu! О Vaikuntha, О Purusottama! Salute to you. О Jayanta, О Vijaya, О Jaya! О Ananta! О Parajita! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.6 \|\|

*kṛtāvartada mahāvarta mahādeva namo 'stu te \|*  
*anādyādyanta madhyānta namaste padmajapriya \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Krtavarta! О Mahavarta! О Mahadeva! Salute to you. О Anadya! О Adyanta! О Madhyanta! О Padmajapriya! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.7 \|\|

*purañjaya namastubhyaṃ śatruñjaya namo 'stu te \|*  
*śubhañjaya namaste 'stu namaste 'stu dhanañjaya \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Puranjaya! Salute to you. О Satrunjaya! Salute to you. О Subhanjaya! Salute to you. О Dhananjaya! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.8 \|\|

*sṛṣṭigarbha namastubhyaṃ śuciśravaḥ vṛthuśravaḥ \|*  
*namo hiraṇyagarbhāya padmagarbhāya te namaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О Srstigarbha! О Sucisrava! О Prthusrava! Salute to you. Salute to Hiranyagarbha. Salute to Padmagarbha.

## \|\| 87.9 \|\|

*namaḥ kamalanetrāya kālanetrāya te namaḥ \|*  
*kālanābha namastubhyaṃ mahānābha namo namaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Salute to lotus-eyed. Salute to Kalanetra! Salute to Kalanabha! О Mahanabha! Frequent salute to you.

## \|\| 87.10 \|\|

*vṛṣṭimūla mahāmūla mūlāvāsa namo 'stu te \|*  
*dharmāvāsa jalāvāsa śrīnivāsa namo 'stu te \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Vrstimula! O Mahamula! О Mulavasa! Salute to you. О Dharmavasa! О Jalavasa! О Srinivasa! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.11 \|\|

*dharmādhyakṣa prajādhyakṣa lokādhyakṣa namo namaḥ \|*  
*senādhyakṣa namastubhyaṃ kālādhyakṣa namo namaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О Dharmadhyaksa! О Prajadhyaksa! О Lokadhyaksa! frequent salute to you. О Senadhyaksa! Salute to you. О Kaladhyaksa! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.12 \|\|

*gadādhara śrutidhara cakradhārin śriyo dhara \|*  
*vanamālādhara hare namaste dharaṇīdhara \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Gadadhara! О Srutidhara! Cakradhara! О Sridhara! О Vanamaladhara! О Dharanidhara Hari! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.13 \|\|

*ārciṣeṇa mahāsena namaste 'stu puruṣṭuta \|*  
*vahukalpa mahākalpa namaste kalpanāmukha \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О Arcisena! О Mahasena! О Purustuta! Salute to you. О Bahukalpa! О Mahakalpa! О Kalpanamukha! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.14 \|\|

*sarvātman sarvaga vibho viriñce śveta keśava \|*  
*nīla rakta mahānīla aniruddha namo 'stu te \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Salute to Sarvatman, omnipresent, sovereign, Varinci, Sveta, Kesava, Nila, Rakta, Mahanila, Aniruddha.

## \|\| 87.15 \|\|

*dvādaśātmaka kālātman sāmātman paramātmaka \|*  
*vyomakātmaka subrahman bhūtātmaka namo 'stu te \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Salute to Dvadasatmaka, Kalatman, Samatman, Paramatmaka, Vyomakatmaka, Subrahman, Bhutatmaka.

## \|\| 87.16 \|\|

*harikeśa mahākeśa guḍākeśa namo 'stu te \|*  
*muñjakeśa hṛṣīkeśa sarvanātha mano 'stu te \|\| 16 \|\|*
