16\. Salute to Harikesa, Mahakesa, Gudakesa. Salute to Munjakesa, Hrsikesa, Sarvanatha.

## \|\| 87.17 \|\|

*sukṣma sthūla mahāsthūla mahāsūkṣma śubhaṅkara \|*  
*śvetapītāmbaradhara nīlavāsa namo 'stu te \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О Suksma! О Sthula! О Mahasthula! О Mahasuksma! О Subhankara! О Svetapitambaradhara! О Nilavasa! I salute you.

## \|\| 87.18 \|\|

*kuśeśaya namaste 'stu sīradhvaja najārdhana \|*  
*govinda prītikartā ca haṃsa pītāmbarapriya \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Kusesaya! О Padmesaya! О Jalesaya! О Govinda! О Pritikarta! О Hamsa! О Pitambarapriya! I salute you.

## \|\| 87.19 \|\|

*adhokṣaja namastubhyaṃ sīradhvaja janārdana \|*  
*vāmanāya namaste 'stu namaste madhusūdana \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О Adhoksaja! О Soradhvaja! O Janardana! Salute to you. О Vamana! Salute to you. О Madhusudana! Salute to you.

## \|\| 87.20 \|\|

*sahasraśīrṣāya namo brahmaśīrṣāya te namaḥ \|*  
*namaḥ sahasranetrāya somasūryānalekṣama \|*  
*\|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I salute to Sahastrasirsa (thousand headed), salute to Brahmasirsa. I salute to thousand eyed, sun, moon and fire-eyed.

## \|\| 87.21 \|\|

*namaścātharvaśirase mahāśīrṣāya te namaḥ \|*  
*namaste dharmanetrāya mahānetrāya te namaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. I salute Atharvasira, I salute Mahasirsa. Salute to Dharmanetra and Mahanetra.

## \|\| 87.22 \|\|

*namaḥ sahasrapādāya sahasrabhujamanyave \|*  
*namo yajñavarāhāya mahārūpāya te namaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I salute the god having innumerable feet, thousand arms and in one thousand yajna’s form. Salute to yajna Varaha. Salute to the gigantic complexion of god.

## \|\| 87.23 \|\|

*namaste viśvadevāya viśvātman viśvasaṃbhava \|*  
*viśvarūpa namaste 'stu tvatto viśvamabhūdidam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Salute to Visvedeva. Salute you О Visvatman, Visvasambhava and Visvarupa. This whole world has originated from you.

## \|\| 87.24 \|\|

*nyagrodhastavaṃ mahāśākhastvaṃ mūlakusumārcitaḥ \|*  
*skandhapatrāṅkuralatāpallavāya namo 'stu te \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. You are Nyagrodha, Mahasakha and you are adored with the mula flowers. I salute you seeing in the form of trunk, leaves, buds, creepers etc.

## \|\| 87.25 \|\|

*mūlaṃ te brāhmaṇā brahman skandhaste kṣatriyordiśaḥ \|*  
*nābhyā hyabhūdantarikṣaṃ śaśāṅko manasastava \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О Brahmana! Brahmins are your root. О god! Ksatriyas are your shoulders, Vaisya are branches and Sudras are the leaves. О vegetation! I salute you.

## \|\| 87.26 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāḥ sāgnayo vaktrāḥ derdaṇḍāḥ sāyudhā nṛpāḥ \|*  
*pārśvād viśaśceruyugājjātāḥ śūdrāśca pādataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Brahmin with fire is your mouth and Ksatriya with weapons are your two great arms. Vaisyas and Sudras have been originated from the collateral parts two thighs and feet respectively.

## \|\| 87.27 \|\|

*netrād bhānurabhūt tubhyaṃ padbhyāṃ bhūḥ śrotrayordiśaḥ \|*  
*nābhyā hyabhūdantarikṣaṃ śaśāṅko manasastava \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The sun god was originated from your eyes. Your feet, ears, navel and mind have originated the earth, directions, space and moon respectively.

## \|\| 87.28 \|\|

*prāṇād vāyuḥ samabhavat kāmād brahmā pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*krodhāt trinayano rudraḥ śīrṣṇoḥ dyauḥ samavartata \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The wind, Brahma, three-eyed Rudra and Dyuloka (abode of sun) have been originated from your breathing (Prana), sex, anger and head.

## \|\| 87.29 \|\|

*indrāgnī vadanāt tubhyaṃ paśavo malasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*oṣadhyo romasaṃbhūtā virājastvaṃ namo 'stu te \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Indra and fire originated from your mouth, animals were bom of the refuse, plants came into being from the hair of your body. You are Viraja. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.30 \|\|

*puṣpahāsa namaste 'stu mahāhāsa namo 'stu te \|*  
*oṅkārastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāro vauṣaṭ tvaṃ ca svadhā sudhā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Salute to Puspahasa, Mahahasa, Omkara, Vasatkara and Vausat. You are Svadha and Sudha.

## \|\| 87.31 \|\|

*svāhākāra namastubhyaṃ hantakāra namo 'stu te \|*  
*sarvākāra nirākāra vedākāra namo 'stu te \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Salute to Svahakara, Hantakara, Sarvakara, Nirakara and Vedakara.

## \|\| 87.32 \|\|

*tvaṃ hi vedamayo devaḥ sarvadevamayastathā \|*  
*sarvatīrthamayaścaiva sarvayajñamayastathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. You contain the Vedic knowledge and you comprise all gods. You are all holy places and all yajnas.

## \|\| 87.33 \|\|

*namaste yajñapuruṣa yajñabhāgabhuje namaḥ \|*  
*namaḥ sahasradhārāya śatadhārāya te namaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O Yajnapurusa! Salute to you. Salute to Yajnabhagabhogi! Salute to Sahastradhara and Satadhara.

## \|\| 87.34 \|\|

*bhīrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpāya godāyāmṛtadāyine \|*  
*suvarṇabrahmadātre ca sarvadātre ca te namaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. I salute to the god in the form of Bhur-Bhuvah-Svah, Goda (Presenting with Kine), Amrtadata, Suvarnabrahmadata (Giver of wealth and religious knowledge) and bestower of every thing.

## \|\| 87.35 \|\|

*brahmeśāya namastubhyaṃ brahmāde brahmarūpadhṛk \|*  
*parabrahma namaste 'stu śabdabrahma namo 'stu te \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Salutation to Brahmesa. I salute you О Brahmadi, О god in the form of Brahma, О supreme Brahma. I salute you О Sabdabrahma!

## \|\| 87.36 \|\|

*vidyāstvaṃ vedyarūpastvaṃ vedanīyastvameva ca \|*  
*buddhistvamapi bodhyaśca bodhastvaṃ ca namo 'stu te \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. You are learning, you are knower and you yourself are knowable too. You are wisdom, the matter understood and the knowledge itself. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.37 \|\|

*hotā homaśca havyaṃ ca hūyamānaścahavyāvāṭ \|*  
*pātā potā ca putaśca pāvanīyaśca oṃ namaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. You are Hota, Ноmа, Havya, Нuуamana and you are Havyavat, Patr, Potr, Puta and sacrosanct Om syllable. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.38 \|\|

*hantā ca hanyamānaś ca hrimāṇastvameva ca \|*  
*harttā netā ca nītiśca pūjyo 'gryo viśvadhāryasi \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. You are killer, you are killed, abductor you are and you also are abducted. You are politician, the politics you are. You are revered, supreme and holder of entire world.

## \|\| 87.39 \|\|

*sruksruvau paradhāmāsi kapālolūkhalo 'raṇiḥ \|*  
*yajñapātrāṇeyastvamekadhā bahudhā tridhā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. You are Sruk Suvau (Sruk and Sruva ladles used in sacrifice), Paradhama, Kapala, Ulukhala, Arani, yajna vessels, Araneya, one-form, two-forms and three (many forms).

## \|\| 87.40 \|\|

*yajñastvaṃ yajamānastvamīḍyastvamasi yājakaḥ \|*  
*jñātā jñeyastathā jñānaṃ dhyeyo dhyātāsi ceśvara \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. You are yajna and you also are client (yajamana). You are Idya (to be invoked) and Yajaka (sacrificer). You are as scholar (knower), knowable, knowledge, aim, aimer and Isvara.

## \|\| 87.41 \|\|

*dhyānayogaśca yogī ca gatirmokṣo dhṛtiḥ sukham \|*  
*yogāṅgāni tvamīśānaḥ sarvagastvaṃ namo 'stu te \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. You are Dhyanayoga, Yogi, Gati, Moksa (emancipation), patience (Dhri), pleasure, Yogaaga, Isana and omniscient. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.42 \|\|

*brahma hotā tathodgātā sāma yūpo 'ta dakṣiṇā \|*  
*dīkṣā tvaṃ tvaṃ puroḍāśastvaṃ paśuḥ paśuvāhyasi \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. You are Brahma, Hota, Udgata, Sama, Yupa, Daksina and Diksa. You are Purodasa, you are sacrifical animal and carrier of animals (Pasuvahi).

## \|\| 87.43 \|\|

*guhyo dhātā ca paramaḥ śivo nārāyaṇastathā \|*  
*mahājano nirayanaḥ sahasrārkendurūpavān \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. You are Guhya, Dhata, Parama, Siva, Narayana, Mahajana, Nirayana, and glowing with complexion of one thousand sun and moons' radiance.

## \|\| 87.44 \|\|

*dvādaśāro 'tha ṣaṇṇābhistrivyūho dviyugastathā \|*  
*kālacakro bhavānīśo namaste puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. You are Kalacakra, Isa and Purusottama having twelve spikes, six nucleus (Nabhi), three Vyuhas and two yokes. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.45 \|\|

*parākramo vikramastvaṃ hayagrīvo harīśvaraḥ \|*  
*nareśvaro 'tha brahmeśaḥ sūryeśastvaṃ namo 'stu te \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. You are valour, chivalours, Hayagriva, Harisvara, Naresvara, Brahmesa and Suryesa. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.46 \|\|

*aśvavaktro mahāmedhāḥ śaṃbhuḥ śakraḥ prabhañjanaḥ \|*  
*mitrāvaruṇamūrtistvamamūrtiranaghaḥ paraḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. You are Asvavaktra, Mahamedha, Sambhu, Sakra, Prabhanjana, Mitravarunamurti, Amurti, Anagha and supreme.

## \|\| 87.47 \|\|

*prāgvaṃśakāyo bhūtādirmahābhūto 'cyuto dvijaḥ \|*  
*tvamūrdhvakarttā ūrdhvaś ca ūrdhvaretā namo 'stu te \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. You are Pragvansakaya, Bhutadi, Mahabhuta, Acyuta and Dvija. You are Udhrvakartta, Udhrva and Udhrvareta. I salute you.

## \|\| 87.48 \|\|

*mahāpātakahā tvaṃ ca upapātakahā tathā \|*  
*anīśaḥ sarvapāpebhyastvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. You are destroyer of heinous offences and efface the petty offences. You are unattached to all sins. I here come to your shelter.

## \|\| 87.49 \|\|

*ityetat paramaṃ stotraṃ sarvapāpapramocanam \|*  
*maheśvareṇa kathitaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ purā mune \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О sage! Mahesvara during long past had recited this great praiseful, sin absolving psalm in Varanasi.

## \|\| 87.50 \|\|

*keśavasyāgrato gatvā snātvā tīrthe sitodake \|*  
*upaśāntastathā jāto rudraḥ pāpavaśāt tataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Rudra absolved from the effect of sin and cooled down when he took bath in the clean water here and saw Kesava.

## \|\| 87.51 \|\|

*etat pavitraṃ tripuradhnabhāṣitaṃ paṭhan naro viṣṇuparo maharṣe \|*  
*vimuktapāpo hyupaśāntamūrti saṃpūjyate devavaraiḥ prasiddhaiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. O great hermit! The man devotee to god Visnu who recites this psalm once recited by the enemy of Tripura definitely absolves from evils, becomes courtious, gains popularity and honoured by the supreme gods.

## Chapter 88. Another sin-absolving Eulogy

## \|\| 88.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*dvitīyaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ stavaṃ vakṣyāmi te mune \|*  
*yena samyagadhītena pāpaṃ nāśaṃ tu gaccati \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О sage! I recite another psalm capable to absolve the sins. A study properly of it, effaces the accumulated account of sins.

## \|\| 88.2 \|\|

*matsyaṃ namasye deveśaṃ kūrmaṃ govindameva ca \|*  
*hayaśīrṣaṃ namaste 'haṃ bhavaṃ viṣṇuṃ trivikramam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. I salute Govinda in the forms of god Matsya and Kurma. I salute Hayasirsa, Bhava and Trivikrama Visnu.

## \|\| 88.3 \|\|

*namasye mādhaveśānau hṛṣīkaśakumāriṇau \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ namasye 'haṃ namasye garuḍāsanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. I salute Madhava, Isana, Hrsikesa and Kumara. I salute Narayana. I salute the Garuda-rider.

## \|\| 88.4 \|\|

*ūrdhvakeśaṃ nṛsihaṃ ca rupadhāraṃ kurudhvajam \|*  
*kāmapālamakhaṇḍaṃ ca namasye brāhmaṇapriyam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. I salute Udhrvakesa, Narasimha, Kurudhvaja, Kamapala, Akhanda, and Brahmin loving god.

## \|\| 88.5 \|\|

*ajitaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ dvijapriyam \|*  
*haṃsaṃ śaṃbhuṃ namasye ca brahmāṇaṃ saprajāpatim \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. I salute unconquerable, Visvakarma, Pundarika, Dvijapriya, Hamsa, Sambhu and Brahma with Prajapati.

## \|\| 88.6 \|\|

*namasye śūlabāhuṃ ca devaṃ cakradharaṃ tathā \|*  
*śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ suvarṇākṣaṃ gopatiṃ pītavāsasam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. I salute Sulabahu, the god holding cakra, Siva, Visnu, Suvarnaksa, Gopati and Pitavasa.

## \|\| 88.7 \|\|

*namasye ca gadāpāṇiṃ namasye ca kuśośayam \|*  
*ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ namasye pāpanāśanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. I salute the god holding mace. I salute Kusesaya. I salute Ardhanarisvara and the god absolving sins.

## \|\| 88.8 \|\|

*gopālaṃ ca saivakuṇṭhaṃ namasye cāparājitam \|*  
*namasye viśvarūpaṃ ca saugandhiṃ sarvadāśivam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. I salute Gopala, Vaikuntha and undefeatable. I bow head before Visvarupa, Saugandhi and Sadasiva.

## \|\| 88.9 \|\|

*pāñcālikaṃ hayagrīvaṃ svayambhuvamamareśvaram \|*  
*namasye puṣkarākṣaṃ ca payogandhiṃ ca keśavam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. I salute Pancalika, Hayagriva, Svayuambhuva, Amaresvara, Puskaraka, Payogandhi and Kesava.

## \|\| 88.10 \|\|

*avimuktaṃ ca lolaṃ ca jyeṣṭheyaṃ madhyamaṃ tathā \|*  
*upaśāntaṃ tamasye 'haṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ sajambukam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. I salute Avimukta, Lola, Jyesthesa, Madhyama, Upasanta and Markandeya with Jambuka.

## \|\| 88.11 \|\|

*namasye padmakiraṇaṃ namasye vaḍavāmukham \|*  
*kārttikeyaṃ namasye 'haṃ bāhlīkaṃ śikhinaṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. I salute the god Padmakirana. I salute Vadavamukha. I salute Karttikeya, Bahlika and Sikhi.

## \|\| 88.12 \|\|

*namasye sthāṇumanaghaṃ namasye vanamālinam \|*  
*namasye lāṅgalīśaṃ ca namasye 'haṃ śriyaḥ patim \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. I salute Sthanu and Anagha including Vanamali. I salute Langalisa and husband of Laksmi.

## \|\| 88.13 \|\|

*namasye ca trinayanaṃ namasye havyavāhanam \|*  
*namasye ca trisauvarṇaṃ namasye śaśibhūṣaṇam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. I salute Trinetra and Havyavahana. I salute Trisauvarna and Dharanidhara.

## \|\| 88.14 \|\|

*triṇāciketaṃ brahmeśaṃ namasye śaśibhūṣaṇam \|*  
*kapardinaṃ namasye ca sarvāmayavināśanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. I salute Trinaciketa, Brahmesa and Sasibhusana. I salute Kapardi who are penance to all ills.

## \|\| 88.15 \|\|

*namasye śaśinaṃ sūryaṃ dhruvaṃ raudraṃ mahaujasam \|*  
*padmanābhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ namasye skandamavyayam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. I salute moon, sun, Dhruva and splendours Rudra. I salute Padmanabha, Hiranyaksa and imperishable Skanda.

## \|\| 88.16 \|\|

*namasye bhīmahaṃsau ca namasye hāṭakeśvaram \|*  
*sadā haṃsaṃ namasye ca namasye prāmatarpaṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. I salute Bhima and Hamsa. I salute Hat akesvara. I salute Sadahamsa and Pranatarpana.

## \|\| 88.17 \|\|

*namasye rukmakavacaṃ mahāyoginamīśvaram \|*  
*namasye śrīnivāsaṃ ca namasye puruṣottamam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. I salute Rukmakavaca, great Yogi and Isvara. I salute Srinivasa and Purusottama.

## \|\| 88.18 \|\|

*namasye ca caturbāhuṃ namasye vasudhādhipam \|*  
*vanaspatiṃ paśupatiṃ namasye prabhumavyayām \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. I salute the four-armed god. I salute the ruler of the earth. I salute vegetation, Pasupati and imperishable god.

## \|\| 88.19 \|\|

*śrīkaṇṭhaṃ vāsudevaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadaṇḍinam \|*  
*namasye sarvamanaghaṃ gaurīśaṃ nakulīsvaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. I salute Srikantha, Vasudeva, Dandi including Nilakantha, Sarva, Anagha, Gaunsa and Nakulisvara.

## \|\| 88.20 \|\|

*manoharaṃ kṛṣṇakeśaṃ namasye cakrapāṇinam \|*  
*yaśodharaṃ mahābāhuṃ namasye ca kuśapriyam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. I salute Krsnakesa and Cakraparti the attractive gods. I salute Yasodhara, Mahabahu and Kusapriya.

## \|\| 88.21 \|\|

*bhūdharaṃ chāditagadaṃ sunetraṃ śūlaśaṅkhinam \|*  
*bhadrākṣaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca namasye śaṅkukarṇikam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. I salute Bhudhara, Chaditagada, Sunetra, Sulasankhi, Bhadraksa, Virabhadra and Sankukarnika.

## \|\| 88.22 \|\|

*vaṣadhvajaṃ maheśaṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ śaśiprabham \|*  
*upendra caiva govindaṃ namaste paṅkajapriyam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I say Namaskara to bull rider, Mahesa, Visvamitra, Sasiprabha, Upendra, Govinda and Pahkajapriya.

## \|\| 88.23 \|\|

*sahasraśirsaṃ devaṃ namasye kundamālinam \|*  
*kālāgniṃ rudradeveśaṃ namasye kṛttivāsasam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. I salute the one thousand headed god and Kundamali. I salute Kalangni, Rudra and Krttivasa.

## \|\| 88.24 \|\|

*namasye chāgaleśaṃ ca namasye paṅkajāsanam \|*  
*sahasrākṣaṃ kokanadaṃ namasye hariśaṅkaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. I salute Chagalesa and Pankajasana. I salute thousand eyed god, Kokanada and Harisankara.

## \|\| 88.25 \|\|

*agastayaṃ garuḍaṃ viṣṇuṃ kapilaṃ brahmavāṅmayam \|*  
*sanātanaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ namasye brahmatatparam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. I salute Agastya, Garuda, Visnu, Kapila, Brahmavangmaya, Sanatana, Brahma and that all alert Brahma.

## \|\| 88.26 \|\|

*apratarkyaṃ caturbāhuṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ tapomayam \|*  
*namasye dharmarājānaṃ devaṃ garuḍavāhanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. I salute Apratakrya, four armed, one thousand rays, resolute, Dharmaraja and the god having carriage of eagle.

## \|\| 88.27 \|\|

*sarvabūtagataṃ śāntaṃ nirmalaṃ sarvalakṣaṇam \|*  
*mahāyoginamavyaktaṃ namasye pāpanāśanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I salute omnipresent, a god residing in the hearts of all, the silent, pure, holy, meritorious, great Yogi, inexpressible and sin resolving god.

## \|\| 88.28 \|\|

*nirañjanaṃ nirākāraṃ nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ padam \|*  
*namasye pāpahantāraṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I salute Niranjana, Niritkara, Nirguna, the holiest place of god and the god absolving sins. I salute him obeisance.

## \|\| 88.29 \|\|

*etat pavitraṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ proktaṃ tvagastayena maharṣiṇā ca \|*  
*dhnyaṃ yaśasyaṃ bahupāpanāśanaṃ saṃkartanāt smāraṇāt saṃśravācca \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The hermit Agastya had recited this most ancient psalm. Numerous evils are effaced merely when it is recited, summoned and hearing. The man doing this becomes illustrious and successful in his life.

## Chapter 89. Description of the birth of Visnu as incarnation of Vamana

## \|\| 89.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*gate 'tha tīrthayātrāyāṃ prahlāde dānaveśvare \|*  
*kurukṣetraṃ samabhyāgād yaṣṭuṃ vairocano valiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Bali, son of Virocana went Kuruksetra to organise offering (yajna) when demon king Prahlada set-off for pilgrimage.

## \|\| 89.2 \|\|

*tasmin mahādharmayute tīrthe brāhmaṇapuṅgavaḥ \|*  
*śukro dvijātipravarānāmantrayat bhārgavān \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The great Brahmin Sukracarya invited Bhargavas (Brahmanas of Bhargava family) to participate in that holy place for yajna.

## \|\| 89.3 \|\|

*bhṛgūnāmantryamāṇān vai śrutvātreyāḥ sagautamāḥ \|*  
*kauśikāṅgirasaścaiva tatyajuḥ kurujāṅgalān \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. When Atri, Gautama, Kausika and Angira gotra Brahmins came to know that Brahmins of Bhrgu race were also invited, they abandoned Kurujangala.

## \|\| 89.4 \|\|

*uttarāśāṃ prajagmuste nadīmanu śatadrukām \|*  
*śātadrave jale snātvā vipāśāṃ prayayustataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. They reached at the bank of Satadru river at north. They took bath in the holy water of Satadru and then went at the bank of Vipasa river.

## \|\| 89.5 \|\|

*vijñāya tatrāpyaratiṃ snātvār'cya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*prajagmuḥ kiraṇāṃ puṇyāṃ dineśakiraṇacyutām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Having not found suitable and comfortable place, they took bath, worshipped ancestors and gods and then went on the bank of river Kirana originated from the sun beams.

## \|\| 89.6 \|\|

*tasyāṃ snātvār'cya deverṣe sarva eva maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*airāvatīṃ supuṇyodāṃ snātvā jagmuratheśvarīm \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О divine hermit! After bath and worship in that river, all hermits went at the bank of river Airavati, took bath in it and then reached at the bank of lsvari river.

## \|\| 89.7 \|\|

*devikāyā jale snātvā payoṣṇyāṃ caiva tāpasāḥ \|*  
*avatīrṇā mune snātumātreyādyāḥ śubhāṃ nadīm \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О sage! Atreya etc. ascetics descended in Subha river after having bath in Devika and Payosni rivers.

## \|\| 89.8 \|\|

*tato nimagnā dadṛśuḥ pratibimbamathātmanaḥ \|*  
*antarjale dvijaśreṣṭha mahadāścaryakārakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О great Dvija! Those people saw their reflection when they were immersed into water. They were surprised.

## \|\| 89.9 \|\|

*unmajjane ca dadṛśuḥ punarvismitamānasāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ snātvā samuttīrṇā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva hi \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The hermits so surprised again saw that reflection when they came out from river. Ultimately, they took bath and came out from that river.

## \|\| 89.10 \|\|

*jagamustato 'pi te brahman kathayantaḥ parasparam \|*  
*cintayantaśca satataṃ kimetaditi vismitāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О Brahmana! all people then moved from there discussing mutually the surprising thing they came across in the river.

## \|\| 89.11 \|\|

*tato dūrādapaśyanta vanaṣaṇḍaṃ suvistṛtam \|*  
*vanaṃ haragalaśyāmaṃ khagadhvaninināditam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Then they saw a forest, from a certain distance. It was huge, dark looking as Sankara's throat and echoed with the chattering of birds.

## \|\| 89.12 \|\|

*atituṅgatayā vayoma āvṛṇvānaṃ nagottamam \|*  
*vistṛtābhirjaṭābhistu antarbhūmiñca nārada \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Narada! Being that forest at highest altitude, it was appeared touching the sky and the earth lower side was covered by the roots deep emerged.

## \|\| 89.13 \|\|

*kānanaṃ puṣpitairvṛkṣairatibhāti samantataḥ \|*  
*daśārddhavarṇaiḥ sukhadairnabhastārāgaṇairiva \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. That forest was looking very attractive with five coloured flower plants on all sides like, sky with the lunar mansions, giver of happiness and with the stars.

## \|\| 89.14-15 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā kamalairvyāptaṃ puṇḍarīkaiśca śobhitam \|*  
*tadvat kokanadairvyāptaṃ vanaṃ padmavanaṃ yathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*prajagmustuṣṭimatulāṃ te hlādaṃ paramaṃ yayaḥ \|*  
*viviśuḥ prītamanaso haṃsā iva mahāsaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. They exhilarated and satiated to see that forest covered by lotus-like Padmavana (forest of lotus), ornamented by Pundarikas and surrounded by Kokanadas. As swan enters in a great reservoir, they entered this forest happily.

## \|\| 89.16 \|\|

*tanmadhye dadṛśuḥ puṇyamāśramaṃ lokapūjitam \|*  
*caturṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ vargāṇāṃ munisattama \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О great sage! They saw amid that forest a holy cottage popularised in public. It was of four vargas (Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa).

## \|\| 89.17-18 \|\|

*dharmāśramaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ tu palāśaviṭapāvṛtam \|*  
*pratīcyabhimukhaṃ brahman arthasyekṣuvanāvṛtam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kāmyaṃ rambhāśokavanāvṛtam \|*  
*udaṅmukhaṃ ca mokṣasya śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. О Brahmin! The cottage facing east and covered by Palasa trees is Dharmasrama, the cottage surrounded by the cane forest at west was Arthasrama, the cottage facing south and covered by banana and Asoka trees was Kamasrama and the cottage facing north and white as sphatika was Moksasrama.

## \|\| 89.19 \|\|

*kṛtānte tvāśramī mokṣaḥ kāmastretāntare śramī \|*  
*āśramyartho dvāparānte tiṣyādau dharma āśramī \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Moksa occupies the hermitage at the end of Satya yuga. Kama becomes dweller of asrama in Treta, the Artha becomes dweller of asrama at the end of Dvapara while Dharma starts living in the hermitage in the beginning of Kaliyuga.

## \|\| 89.20 \|\|

*tānyāśramāṇi munayo dṛṣṭvātreyādayo 'vyayāḥ \|*  
*tatraiva ca ratiṃ cakrurakhaṇḍe salilāplute \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Having seen those hermitages, the imperishable sages, took delight there on the Akhanda mountain sprinkled with water.

## \|\| 89.21 \|\|

*dharmādyairbhagavān viṣṇurakhaṇḍa viśrutaḥ \|*  
*caturmurtirjagannāthaḥ purvameva pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. God Visnu is renowned as Akhanda according to books in religion. It is already settled that Jagannatha is of four icons.

## \|\| 89.22 \|\|

*tamarcayanti ṛṣayo yogātmāno bahuśrutāḥ \|*  
*śuśrūṣayātha tapasā brahmacaryeṇa nārada \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Narada! Learned ascetics and hermits worship them with service, penance and celibacy.

## \|\| 89.23 \|\|

*evaṃ te nyavasaṃstatra sametā munayo vane \|*  
*asurebhyastadā bhītāḥ svāśrityākhaṇḍaparvatam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The hermits frightened from demons began to live together under proper shelter of that Akhanda mountain.

## \|\| 89.24 \|\|

*tathānye brāhmaṇā brahman aśmakuṭṭā marīcipāḥ \|*  
*snātvā jale hi kālindyāḥ prajagmurdakṣiṇāmukhāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О Brahmana! other Brahmins, Asmakuttas and Maricipas took bath in the water of Yamuna and moved towards south.

## \|\| 89.25 \|\|

*avantiviṣayaṃ prāpya viṣṇumāsādya saṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*viṣṇorapi prasādena duṣpraveśaṃ mahāsuraiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. They reached at Avanti city, an inaccessible place to demons under Visnu's grace and began to live in shelter to Visnu.

## \|\| 89.26 \|\|

*bālakhilyādayo jagmuravaśā dānavād bhayāt \|*  
*rudrakoṭiṃ samāśritya sthitāste brahmacāriṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The helpless Balakhilya etc. hermits went at Rudrakofi under influence of fright from demon's side and began living there.

## \|\| 89.27 \|\|

*evaṃ gateṣu vipreṣu gautamāṅgirasādiṣu \|*  
*śukrastu bhārgavān sarvān ninye yajñavidhau mune \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O sage! Sukracarya took all Brahmins from Bhargava family to organise yajna when Gautama and Angirasa etc. Brahmins left that place vacate.

## \|\| 89.28 \|\|

*adhiṣṭhite bhārgavaistu mahāyajñe 'mitadyute \|*  
*yajñadīkṣāṃ baleḥ śukraścākāra vidhinā svayam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. О splendours sage! Sukracarya gave Bali yajnadiksa in an orderly manner in the yajna organised by the Brahmins from Bhargava clan.

## \|\| 89.29-30 \|\|

*śvetāmbaradharo daityaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ \|*  
*mṛgājināvṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe barhipatravicitritaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*samāste vitate yajñe sadasyairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ \|*  
*hayagrīvapralambādyairmayabāṇapurogamaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. The demon Bali with white garments, white garland and anointing the body, covered by the skin of deer at the back, looking charming due to kuss-grass, took seat in pavilion of yajna. He was surrounded by the other members i.e. Hayagriva, Pralamba, Maya and Bana etc.

## \|\| 89.31 \|\|

*patnī vindhyāvalī cāsya dīkṣitā yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*lalanānāṃ sahasrasya pradhānā ṛṣikanyakā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. His wife Vindhyavali, the chief among the thousand wives, the daughter of a sage, too consecrated.

## \|\| 89.32 \|\|

*śukreṇāśvaḥ śvetavarṇo madhumāse sulakṇaḥ \|*  
*mahīṃ vihartumutsṛṣṭastārakākṣo 'nvagācca tam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Sukracarya relieved a horse in the month of Caitra having auspicious characteristics for strolling on the earth. The demon Tarakaksa began following him.

## \|\| 89.33-34 \|\|

*evamaśve samutsṛṣṭe vitate yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*gate ca māsatritaye hūyamāne ca pāvake \|\| 33 \|\|*

*pūjyamāneṣu daityeṣu miṣunasthe divākare \|*  
*suṣuve devajananī mādhavaṃ vāmanākṛtim \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. When the horse had been released, the sacrifice had expanded, when three months had passed, when oblations had been offered in the fire and when the demons were being worshipped and the sun existed in Mithuna, then the mother of god gave birth to Visnu of dwarfish form.

## \|\| 89.35 \|\|

*taṃ jātamātraṃ bhagavantamīśaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lokapatiṃ purāṇam \|*  
*brahmā samabhyetya samaṃ maharṣibhiḥ stotraṃ jagādātha vibhormaharṣe \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О great hermit! No sooner that glorious god, Narayana, Purana-purusa bom, Brahma in company of hermits went there and prayed him.

## \|\| 89.36 \|\|

*namo 'stu te mādhava sattvamūrtte namo 'stu te śāśvata viśvarūpa \|*  
*namo 'stu te śatruvanendhanāgne namo 'stu vai pāpamahādavāgne \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О Sattvamurta! О Madhava! Salute to you. О immortal! О universal form god! I salute you. Salute to fire for the fuel of trees in the form of enemies. Obeisance to you, О terrible forest-fire for sin.

## \|\| 89.37 \|\|

*namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana \|*  
*namaste jagādādhāra namaste puruṣottama \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. We salute Pundarikaksa, Visvabhavana, Jagadadhara and Purusottama.

## \|\| 89.38 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa jaganmūrte jagannātha gadādhara \|*  
*pītavāsaḥ śriyaḥkānta janārdana namo 'stu te \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. We salute Narayana, Jaganmurti, Jagannatha, Gadadhara, yellow apparel god, husband of Laksmi and Janardana.

## \|\| 89.39 \|\|

*bhavāṃstrātā ca goptā ca viśvātmā sarvago 'vyayaḥ \|*  
*sarvadhārī dharādhārī rūpadhārī namo 'stu te \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Namaskara to rescuer, defender, Visvatma, omni-reach (Sarvagami), imperishable, Sarvadharaka, Dharadharaka and Rupadharaka.

## \|\| 89.40 \|\|

*vardhasva vardhitāśeṣatrailokya surapūjita \|*  
*kuruṣva daivatapate maghono 'śrupramārjanam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О revered god! О extender of all the three- worlds, О who is worshipped by Gods, О ruler of gods! Extend your grace to console Indra with prompt relief.

## \|\| 89.41 \|\|

*tvaṃ dhātā ca vidhātā ca saṃhartā tvaṃ maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*mahālaya mahāyogin yogaśāyin namo 'stu te \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. You are nourisher, creator, destroyer, Mahesvara, Mahalaya, Mahayogi and Yogasayi. Salute to you.

## \|\| 89.42 \|\|

*itthaṃ stuto jagannāthaṃ sarvātmā sarvago hariḥ \|*  
*provāca bhagavān mahyaṃ kurūpanayanaṃ vibho \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. That omni-soul, omni-reach, ruler of the world, god Hari said- "O sovereign! Do please, my Upanayana ritual."

## \|\| 89.43 \|\|

*tataścakāra devasya jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ \|*  
*bharadvājo mahātejā bārhaspatyastapodhanaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Bharadvaja descendant of Brhaspati race and of great splendour performed the rituals like Jatakarma etc. of Vamana.

## \|\| 89.44 \|\|

*vratabandhaṃ tatheśasta kṛtavān sarvasāstravit \|*  
*tato daduḥ prītiyutāḥ sarva eva varān kramāt \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Bharadvaja, learned to all scriptures then performed the rituals of sacred thread ceremony for Isvara. All others present there then presented the gifts to him in order.

## \|\| 89.45 \|\|

*yajñopavītaṃ pulahastvahaṃ ca sitavāsasī \|*  
*mṛgājinaṃ kumbhayonirbharadvājastu mekhalām \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Pulaha gave sacred thread, I (Pulastya) gave two white garments, Agastya, bom in water-jar, gave stag-hide and Bharadvaja gave Mekhala (waist thread).

## \|\| 89.46 \|\|

*pālāśamadadad daṇḍaṃ marīcirbrahmaṇāḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*akṣasūtraṃ vāruṇistu kauśyaṃ vedamathāṅgirāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Marici, son of Brahma gave a stick of Palasa, Varuni (Vasistha) gave Aksasutra (basil garland) and Ahgira gave a broom made of Kusa grass.

## \|\| 89.47 \|\|

*chatraṃ prādād raghū rājā upānadyugalaṃ nṛgaḥ \|*  
*kamṇḍaluṃ bṛhattejāḥ prādādviṣṇorbṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The king Raghu gave umbrella, Nrga gave a pair of shoes and Brhaspati gave a Kamandalu to Visnu (then Vamana).

## \|\| 89.48 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛtopanayano bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*saṃstūyamāno ṛṣibhiḥ sāṅgaṃ vedamadhīyata \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. When Upanayana ritual so performed completely, god Bhuta-bhavana did study on Vedas with their Angas (viz. education, kalpa, grammar, etymology, rhyme and astrology).

## \|\| 89.49 \|\|

*bharadvājādāṅgirasāt sāmavedaṃ mahādhvanim \|*  
*mahadākhyānasaṃyuktaṃ gandharvasahitaṃ mune \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О sage! He learned Samaveda based on sounds with complete stories including Gandharvavidya under kind guidance of Ahgirasa Bharadvaja.

## \|\| 89.50 \|\|

*māsenaikena bagavān jñānaśrutimahārṇavaḥ \|*  
*lokacārapravṛttyarthamabhūcchrutiviśāradaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The glorious god, a great ocean of wisdom became expert in Vedas within interval of one month only. He thus, gave respect to the worldly traditions.

## \|\| 89.51 \|\|

*sarvaśāstreṣu naipuṇyaṃ gatvā devo 'kṣayo 'vyayaḥ \|*  
*provāca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ bharadvājamidaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Vamana, the Aksaya, imperishable said politely to. Bharadvaja when study on all scriptures was completed.

## \|\| 89.52 \|\|

*śrīvāmana uvāca \|*  
*brahman vrajāmi dehyājñāṃ kurukṣetraṃ mahodayam \|*  
*tatra daityapateḥ puṇyo hayamedhaḥ pravartate \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Sri Vamana said- “O Brahmana! I want to go at the holiest place of Kuruksetra. Please, order me.” The demon's king has arranged there the holy Asvamedha yajna.

## \|\| 89.53 \|\|

*samāviṣṭāni paśyasva tejāṃsi pṛthivītale \|*  
*ye saṃnidhānāḥ satataṃ madaṃśāḥ puṇyavardhanāḥ \|*  
*tenāhaṃ pratijānāmi kurukṣetraṃ gato baliḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Please, see that the brilliance is being introduced in my holy places existed on the earth. I therefore, acknowledged with Bali's presence at Kuruksetra.

## \|\| 89.54 \|\|

*bharadvāja uvāca \|*  
*svecchayā tiṣṭha vā gaccha nāhamājñāpayāmi te \|*  
*gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ viṣṇo baleradhvaraṃ mā khida \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Bharadvaja said- “I will not order you in the matter of yours taking visit there or not doing so. It depends on you choice whether you live here or go anywhere.” О Visnu! we will go at the yajna hosted by Bali. Don’t worry on it.

## \|\| 89.55 \|\|

*yad bhavantamahaṃ deva paripṛcchāmi tad vada \|*  
*keṣu keṣu vibho nityaṃ sthāneṣu puruṣottama \|*  
*sānnidhyaṃ bhavato brūhi jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. О god Please, explain to what is being enquired by me. О sovereign! О Purusottama! I want to know clearly the places where you really reside.

## \|\| 89.56 \|\|

*vāmana uvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi yeṣu yeṣu guro aham \|*  
*nivāsāmi supuṇyeṣu sthāneṣu bahurūpavān \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Vamana said- ‘‘O preceptor! Please listen to the places where I reside in varied forms as I am capable to appear in different forms.”

## \|\| 89.57 \|\|

*mamāvatārairvasudhā nabhastalaṃ pātālamambhonidhayo divañca \|*  
*diśaḥ samastā girayo 'mbudāśca vyāptā bharadvāja mamānurūpaiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. О Bharadvaja! The earth, sky, nether, ocean, heaven, all directions, mountains and clouds are fully covered by my incarnated forms.

## \|\| 89.58 \|\|

*ye divyā ye ca bhaumā jalagaganacarāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca sendrāḥ sārkāḥ sacandrā yamavasuvaruṇā hyagnayaḥ sarvapālāḥ \|*  
*brahmādyāḥ sthāvarāntā dvijakhagamahitā mūrtimanto hyamūrtāḥ te sarve matprasūtā bahu vividhaguṇāḥ pūraṇārthaṃ pṛthivyāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. О Brahmana! those which dwells in heaven, those which dwells on earth, those which move in water and air, moving ones and non-moving ones, Indra, Sun, Moon, Yama, Vasu, Varuna and all-protecting fires; corporeals and incorporeals beginning from Brahma and ending with immovables-all these, along with birds having extremely varied qualities, have been produced by me for filling the earth.

## \|\| 89.59 \|\|

*ete hi mukhyāḥ surasiddhadānavaiḥ pujyāstathā saṃnihitā mahītale \|*  
*yairdṛṣṭamātraiḥ sahasaiva nāśaṃ prayāti pāpaṃ dvijavarya kīrtanaiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. All these cardinal matters existed on earth are adorable to gods, siddhas and demons. О great Dvija! The evil is decayed merely by reciting these.

## Chapter 90. Description of different places of god Vamana

## \|\| 90.1 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*ādyaṃ mātsyaṃ mahadrupaṃ saṃsthitaṃ mānase hrade \|*  
*sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ kīrtanasparśanādibhiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. God Vamana said- My first huge fish form (Matsya) capable to decay all sins by offering psalm and touch is existed in Manasa reservoir.

## \|\| 90.2 \|\|

*kaurmamanyatsannidhānaṃ kośikyāṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*hayaśīrṣaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśe govindaṃ hastināpure \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. My second sin absolving tortoise (Kaurma) incarnation is existed in the river Kausiki. Hayasirsa form at Krsnansa and Govinda form at Hastinapura are existed.

## \|\| 90.3 \|\|

*tatrivikramaṃ ca kālindyāṃ liṅgabhede bhavaṃ vibhum \|*  
*kedāre mādhavaṃ śauriṃ kubjāmre hṛṣṭamūrdhajam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. I am in the form of Trivikrama in Kalindi, Vyapaka Bhava in Lingabheda, Madhava Sauri in Kedara and Hrstamurdhaja in Kubjamra is existed.

## \|\| 90.4 \|\|

*nārāyaṇaṃ badarthāṃ ca vārāhe garuḍāsanam \|*  
*jayeśaṃ bhadrakarṇe ca vipāśāyāṃ dvijapriyam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Narayana in Badarikasrama, eagle rider in Varaha, Jayesa in Bhadrakarna and Dvijapriya on the bank of Vipasa river is existed.

## \|\| 90.5 \|\|

*rūpadhāramirāvatyāṃ kurukṣetre kurudhvajam \|*  
*kṛtaśauce nṛsiṃhaṃ ca gokarṇe viśvakarmiṇam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Rupadhara form in Iravati, Kurudhvaja in Kuruksetra, Nrsimha in Krtasauca, Visvakarma in Gokarna is existed.

## \|\| 90.6 \|\|

*prācīne kāmapālaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ mahāmbhasi \|*  
*viśākhayūpe hyajitaṃ haṃsaṃ haṃsapade tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Kamapala form in Pracina, Pundarika in Mahambhasa, Ajita in Visakhayupa and Hamsa form is existed in Hamsapada.

## \|\| 90.7 \|\|

*payoṣṇāyāmakhaṇḍaṃ ca vitastāyāṃ kumārilam \|*  
*maṇimatparvate śaṃbhuṃ brahmaṇye ca prajāpatim \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Akhanda in Payosni-river, Kumarila in Vitasta, Sambhu in mountain Maniman and Prajapati form in Brahmanya is existed.

## \|\| 90.8 \|\|

*madhunadyāṃ cakradharaṃ śūlabāhuṃ himālaye \|*  
*viddhi viṣṇuṃ muniśreṣṭa sthitamoṣadhisānuni \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О great sage! Cakradhara in Madhu river, Sulabahu in Himalaya and Visnu form in Ausadhiprastha is existed.

## \|\| 90.9 \|\|

*bhṛ-gutuṅge suvarṇāśraṃ naimiṣe pītavāsasam \|*  
*gayāyāṃ gopatiṃ devaṃ gadāpāṇinamīśvaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Suvarnaksa in Bhrgutunga, Pitavasa in Naimisa and Gadapani Isvara Gopatideva form in Gaya is existed.

## \|\| 90.10 \|\|

*trailokyanāthaṃ varadaṃ gopratāre kuśeśayam \|*  
*arddhanārīśvaraṃ puṇye māhendre dabhiṇe girau \|\| 10 \|\|*

## \|\| 90.11 \|\|

*gopālamuttare nityaṃ mahendre somapīthinam \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhamapi sahyādrau pāriyātra'parājitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Somapithi Gopala form at north to Mahendra mountain, Vaikuntha on Sahyadri mountain and Aparajita form in Pariyatra is existed.

## \|\| 90.12 \|\|

*kaśerudeśe deveśaṃ viśvarūpaṃ tapodhanam \|*  
*malayādrau ca saugandhiṃ vindhyapāde sadāśivam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Resolute Visvarupa Devesa in Kaseru country, Saugandhi in Malaya mountain and Sadasiva form in Vindhyapada is existed.

## \|\| 90.13 \|\|

*avanativiṣaye viṣṇuṃ niṣadheṣvamareśvaram \|*  
*pāñcālikaṃ ca brahmarṣe pāñcāleṣu vyavasthitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. О Brahmarsi! Visnu form in Avanti country, Amaresvara in Nisadha and my Pancalika form in Pancala country is existed.

## \|\| 90.14 \|\|

*mahodaye hayagrīvaṃ prayāge yogaśāyinam \|*  
*svayaṃbhuvaṃ madhuvate ayogandhiṃ ca puṣkare \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Hayagriva in Mahodara, Yogasayi in Prayaga, Svayambhuva in Madhuvana and Ayogandhi form in Puskara is existed.

## \|\| 90.15 \|\|

*tathaiva viprapravara vārāṇasyāṃ ca keśavam \|*  
*avimuktakamatraiva lolaścātraiva gīyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О great Brahmin! Similarly Kesava form is existed at Varanasi. At the same place, it is said that my Avimuktaka and Lola form is existed.

## \|\| 90.16 \|\|

*padmāyāṃ padmakiraṇaṃ samudre vaḍavāsukham \|*  
*kumāradhāre bāhlīśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca barhiṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Padmakirana form exists in Padma, Vadavamukha form in ocean, Bahisa form, Kartikeya form and Barhin form exists in Kumaradhara.

## \|\| 90.17 \|\|

*ajeśe śaṃbhumanaghaṃ sthāṇuṃ ca kurujāṅgale \|*  
*vanamālinamāhurmāṃ diṣkindhāvāsino janāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Anagha and Sambhu form in Ajesa, Sthanumurti in Kurujangala is existed. The residents of Kiskindha call me Vanamali.

## \|\| 90.18 \|\|

*vīraṃ kuvalāyārūḍhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam \|*  
*śrīvatsāhkamudārāṅgaṃ narmadāyāṃ śriyaḥ patim \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Devotees address me as Vira, Kuvalayarudha, Sankha-cakra-gadadhara (holder of conch, discus and mace), - Srivatsanka and Udaranga Sripati in Narmada.

## \|\| 90.19 \|\|

*māhiṣmatyāṃ trinayanaṃ tatraiva ca hutāśanam \|*  
*arbude ca trisauparṇa kṣmādharaṃ sūkarācale \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. My three-eyed and Hutasana form is existed in Mahismati. Similarly, my Trisauparna form in Arbuda and Ksmadhara form in Sukaracala is existed.

## \|\| 90.20 \|\|

*triṇāciketaṃ brahmarṣe prabhāse ca kapardinam \|*  
*tathaivātrāpi vikhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ śaśisekharam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. О Brahmarsi! My Trinaciketa, Kapardi and the well-known third Sasisekhara form is renowned in Prabhasa.

## \|\| 90.21 \|\|

*udaye śaśinaṃ sūryaṃ dhruvaṃ ca tritayaṃ sthitam \|*  
*hemakūṭe hiraṇyākṣaṃ skandaṃ śaravaṇe mune \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Three icons i.e. Sasi (moon), Surya (sun) and Dhruva forms are situated at Udayagiri. О sage! My Hiranyaksa form in Hemakuta and Skanda form in the thicket of reeds is existed.

## \|\| 90.22 \|\|

*mahālaye smṛtaṃ rudramuttareṣu kuruṣvatha \|*  
*padmanābhaṃ muniśreṣṭha sarvasaukhyapradāyakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О great sage! My Rudra form in Mahalaya and Padmanabha form, the giver of all pleasures is existed at Uttarakuru.

## \|\| 90.23 \|\|

*saptagodāvare brahman vikhyātaṃ hāṭakeśvaram \|*  
*tatraiva ca mahāhaṃsaṃ prayāge 'pi vaṭeśvaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О Brahmana! my renowned Hatakesvara and Mahahamsa form exists in Saplagodavara and Vatesvara form exists in Prayaga.

## \|\| 90.24 \|\|

*śoṇe ca rukmakavacaṃ kuṇḍine ghrāṇatarpaṇam \|*  
*bhillīvane mahāyogaṃ mādreṣu puruṣottamam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Rukmakavaca in Sona, Ghranatarpana in Kundina, Mahayoga in Bhillivana and Purusottama form in Madra is existed.

## \|\| 90.25 \|\|

*plakṣāvataraṇe viśvaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ dvijottama \|*  
*śūrpārake caturbāhuṃ magadhāyāṃ sudhāpatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О great Dvija! Srinivasa in Plaksavatarana, Caturbahu in Sorparaka and Sudhapati form in Magadha is existed.

## \|\| 90.26 \|\|

*girivraje paśupatiṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ yamunātaṭe \|*  
*vanaspatiṃ samākhyātaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Pasupati in Girivraja, Srikantha on the bank of Yamuna and the Vanaspati (vegetative) form in Dandakaranya is renowned.

## \|\| 90.27 \|\|

*kāliñjare nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarayvāṃ śaṃbhumuttamam \|*  
*haṃsayuktaṃ mahākośyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Nilakantha in Kalinjara, the foremost Sambhu form in Saryu and Hamsayukta form in Mahakosi is existed.

## \|\| 90.28 \|\|

*gokarṇe dakṣiṇe śarvaṃ vāsudevaṃ prajāmukhe \|*  
*vinghyaśṛṅge mahāśairiṃ kanthāyāṃ madhusūdanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Sarva form in south Gokarna, Vasudeva in Prajamukha, Mahasauri on the peak of Vindhya mountain and Mahdusadana form in Kantha is existed.

## \|\| 90.29 \|\|

*trikūṭaśikhare brahman cakrapāṇinamīśvaram \|*  
*lauhadaṇḍe hṛṣīkeśaṃ kosalāyāṃ manoharam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O Brahmin! Cakrapanin (Isvara with discus) on the peak of Trikuta mountain, Hrsikesa in Lauhadanda and Manohara form in Kosala is existed.

## \|\| 90.30 \|\|

*mahābāhuṃ surāṣṭre ca navarāṣṭre yaśodharam \|*  
*bhūdharaṃ devakānadyāṃ mahodāyāṃ kuśapriyam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Mahabahu form exists in Surastra, Yasodhara n Navarastra, Bhudhara in Devika river and Kusapriya form in Mahoda is existed.

## \|\| 90.31 \|\|

*gomatyāṃ chāditagadaṃ śaṅkhoddhāre ca śaṅkhinam \|*  
*sunetraṃ saindhavāraṇye śūraṃ śūrapure sthitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Chaditagata form in Gomati, Sankhi form in Sankhoddhara, Sunetra form in Saindhava forest and Sara form in Sorapura is existed.

## \|\| 90.32 \|\|

*rudrākhyaṃ ca haraṇvatyāṃ vīrabhadraṃ triviṣṭape \|*  
*śaṅkukarṇaṃ ca bhīmāyāṃ bhīmaṃ śālavane viduḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The people are known my Rudra form exists at Hiranyavati, Virabhadra form at Trivistapa, Sartkukama in Bhima and Bhima form in Salavana is existed.

## \|\| 90.33 \|\|

*viśvāmitraṃ ca gaditaṃ kailāse vṛṣabhadhvajam \|*  
*maheśaṃ mahilāśaile kāmarūpe śaśiprabham \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Bull rider Visvamitra in Kailasa, Mahesa in Mahilasaila and Sasiprabha form in Kamarupa is existed.

## \|\| 90.34 \|\|

*balabhyāmapi gomitraṃ kaṭāhe paṅkajapriyam \|*  
*upendraṃ siṃhaladvīpe śakrāhve kundamālinam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Gomitra in Balabhi, Pankajapriya in Kataha, Upendra in Simhaladvipa and Kundamali form in Sakrahva is existed.

## \|\| 90.35 \|\|

*rasātale ca vikhyātaṃ sahasraśirasaṃ mune \|*  
*kālāgnirudraṃ tatraiva tathānyaṃ kṛttivāsasam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О sage! The well-known Sahastrasirsa, Kalagni and Krttivasa form is existed in Rasatala (nether land).

## \|\| 90.36 \|\|

*sutale kūrmamacalaṃ vitale paṅkajāsanam \|*  
*mahātale guro khyātaṃ deveśaṃ chāgaleśvaram \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. О preceptor! Kurma and Acala form in Sutala, Pankajasana in Vitala and Chagalesvara form is popularly situated at Mahatala.

## \|\| 90.37 \|\|

*tale sahasracaraṇaṃ sahasrabhujamīśvaram \|*  
*sahasrākṣaṃ parikhyātaṃ musalākṛṣṭadānavam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. My one-thousand eyed form having one thousand feet, one thousand arms and killer of enemy by Musala is located in Tala.

## \|\| 90.38 \|\|

*pātāle yogināmīśaṃ sthitañca hariśaṅkaram \|*  
*dharātale kokanadaṃ medinyāṃ cakrapāṇinam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Yogisa and Harisankara form exists in nether world, Kokanada form on surface and Cakrapani form in Medini (earth) is exited.

## \|\| 90.39 \|\|

*bhuvarloke ca garuḍaṃ svarloke viṣṇumavyayam \|*  
*maharlloke tathāgastyaṃ kapilaṃ ca jane sthitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Garuda a in Bhuvarloka, imperishable Visnu in Svarloka, Agastya in Maharloka and Kapila in Janaloka is existed.

## \|\| 90.40 \|\|

*tapoloke 'khilaṃ brahman vāṅmayaṃ satyasaṃyutam \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ brahmaloke ca saptame vai pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Brahmin! Akhila and Vangamaya form with truth is existed in Tapoloka and Brahma form in Saptama Brahmaloka is existed.

## \|\| 90.41 \|\|

*sanātanaṃ tathā śaive paraṃ brahma ca vaiṣṇave \|*  
*apratarkyaṃ nirālambe nirākāśe tapomayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Sanatana form in Sivaloka, Supreme Brahma in Visnuloka, Apratarkya in Niralamba and Tapomaya form is existed at Nirakasa.

## \|\| 90.42 \|\|

*jambudvīpe caturbāhuṃ kuśadvīpe kuśeśayam \|*  
*plakṣadvipe muniśreṣṭha khyātaṃ garuḍavāhanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О great sage! Caturbahu in Jambudvipa, Kusesaya in Kusadvipa and Garudavahana in Plaksadvipa is existed.

## \|\| 90.43 \|\|

*padmanābhaṃ tathā krauñce śālmale vṛṣabhadhvajam \|*  
*sahasrāṃśuḥ sthitaḥ śāke dharmarāṭ puṣkare sthitaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Padmanabha form in Krauncadvipa, Vrsabhadhvaja form in Salmaladvipa, Sahastransu exists in Sakadvipa and Dharmaraja exists in Puskaradvipa.

## \|\| 90.44 \|\|

*tathā pṛthivyāṃ brahmarṣe śālagrāme sthito 'smayaham \|*  
*sajalasthalaparyantaṃ careṣu stāvareṣu ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. O Brahmarsi! I am similarly, located within Salagrama on the earth. Thus, I exist in all movable and immovable things/organisms starting from water and land.

## \|\| 90.45 \|\|

*etāni puṇyāni mamālayāni brahman purāṇāni sanātanāni \|*  
*dharmapradānīha mahaujasāni saṃkīrtanīyanyaghanāśanāni \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. O Brahmana! these are my sacred abodes, ancient, eternal, bestower of piety, most influencive, wroth reciting and sin absolving places.

## \|\| 90.46 \|\|

*saṃkīrtanāt smāraṇād darśanācca saṃsparśanādeva ca devatāyāḥ \|*  
*dharmārthakāmādyapavargameva labhanti devā manujāḥ sasādhyāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The gods, human beings and sadhya people attain Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa by virtue of reciting these psalm, keeping in memory, visiting, seeing and touching these icons.

## \|\| 90.47 \|\|

*etāni tubhyaṃ viniveditāni mamālayānīha tapomayāni \|*  
*uttiṣṭha gacchāmi mahāsurasya yajñaṃ surāṇāṃ hi hitāya vipra \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О Brahmin! I have told you these holiest places pertaining to me. Please, stand-up now as I proceed to yajna arranged by Bali for safe-guard of divine interests.

## \|\| 90.48 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ maharṣe viṣṇurbharadvājamṛṣiṃ mahātmā \|*  
*vilāsalīlāgamano girīndrāt sa cābhyagacchat kurujāṅgalaṃ hi \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Pulastya said! О Maharsi! With these words to the hermit Bharadvaja, great soul Visnu started moving from there with speed and reached soon at Kurujangala from that mountain.

## Chapter 91. Dialogue of Sukra and Bali

## \|\| 91.1 \|\|

*śrīvāmanapurāṇaṃ-64 pulastya uvāca \|*  
*tataḥ samāgaccati vāsudeve mahī cakampe girayaca celuḥ \|*  
*kṣubdhāḥ samudrā śrīvāmanapurāṇaṃ-64 pulastya uvāca \|*  
*tataḥ samāgaccati vāsudeve mahī cakampe girayaśca celuḥ \|*  
*kṣubdhāḥ samudrā divi ṛkṣamaṇḍalo babhau viparyastagatirmaharṣe \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О hermit! The earth on walking Vasudeva in dwarf form began shivering, the motmtains deviated, oceans rose in tides and the galaxy in sky suffered dwindling.

## \|\| 91.2 \|\|

*yajñaḥ samāgāt paramākulatvaṃ na vedmi kiṃ me madhuhā kariṣyati \|*  
*yathā pradagdho 'smi maheśvareṇa kiṃ māṃ na saṃdhakṣyayati vāsudevaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sacrifice became very much perturbed thinking. “I don’t know what Visnu, the killer of Madhu, will do to me. Will Visnu not bum me in the same way I was burnt by Siva.

## \|\| 91.3 \|\|

*ṛksāmamantrāhutibhirhutābhirvitānakīyān jvalanāstu bhāgān \|*  
*bhaktyā dvijendrarapi saṃprapāditān naiva pratīccanti vibhorbhayena \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The oblations offered through ahutis with Dvijas of Rgveda and Samaveda hymns and with keen devotion were not being accepted by fire due to fear of god Visnu.

## \|\| 91.4 \|\|

*tān dṛṣṭvā ghorarupāṃstu utpātān dānaveśvaraḥ \|*  
*papracchośanasaṃ śukraṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Seeing those portents of terrible form, the lord of demons Bali asked Sukracarya, the preceptor of demons, after bowing down to him and with folded hands-

## \|\| 91.5 \|\|

*kimarthamācārya mahī saśailā rambheva vātābhihatā cacāla \|*  
*kimāsurīyān suhutānapīha bhāgān na gṛhṇanti hutāśanāśca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Acarya! Why the earth including mountains is shivering like a plantain tree beaten by the waves of wind and why was fire not accepting the oblations offered in course of yajna which particularly are being offered for demons?

## \|\| 91.6 \|\|

*kṣubdhāḥ kimarthaṃ makarālayāśca bho ṛkṣā na khe kiṃ pracaranti pūrvavat \|*  
*diśaḥ kimarthaṃ tamasā pariplutā doṣeṇa kasyādya vadasva me guro \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Why have oceans filled with tides? Why are the constellations moving with unusual speed in the sky and why have the directions covered with dark? О preceptor! Kindly, tell me whose fault is responsible for all this?

## \|\| 91.7 \|\|

*pulstya uvāca \|*  
*śukrastad vākyamākarṇya virocanasuteritam \|*  
*atha jñātvā kāraṇaṃ ca baliṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Pulastya said- Hearing those words spoken by the son of Virocana, Sukra thought for a few moments and replied Bali when cause became apparent to his mind.

## \|\| 91.8 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva daityeśvara yena bhāgān nāmī pratīcchanti hi āsurīyān \|*  
*hutāśanā mantrahutānapīha nūnaṃ samāgacchati vāsudevaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Sukracarya said- “O king of demons! Listen to me. Vasudeva is definitely coming here.” This is the reason the oblations for demons offered with fire hymns remain unaccepted.

## \|\| 91.9 \|\|

*tadaṅghrivikṣepamapārayantī mahī saśailā calitā ditīśa \|*  
*tasyāṃ calatyāṃ makarālayāmī udvṛttavelā ditijādya jātāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. О son of Diti! As the earth is unable to bear the burden of his foot steps, it is shivering. О Ditija (lord of demons)! These oceans are violating their limits due to frequent shivering of earth.

## \|\| 91.10 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*śukrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā balirbhārgavamabravīt \|*  
*dharmaṃ satyaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca sarvotsāhasamīritam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Pulastya said- Hearing the words of Sukra, Bali said to Bhargava the statement endowed with piety, true, benevolent and energising-

## \|\| 91.11 \|\|

*baliruvāca \|*  
*āyāte vāsudeve vada mama bhagavan dharmakāmarthattattvaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ kiṃ ca deyaṃ maṇikankamatho bhūgajāśvādikaṃ vā \|*  
*kiṃ vā vācyaṃ murārernijahitamathavā taddhitaṃ vā prayuḍhañje tathyaṃ pathyaṃpriyabhomama vadaśubhadantatkariṣye na cānyat \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Bali said- “O god! Explain the exercisable deed on arrival of Vasudeva corroborating to religion, essence, harmony and emancipation.” What thing out of gem, earth, elephant or horse should I donate him? What should I say Murari? What good for myself or his should be performed? Please, tell me the facts benevolent, auspicious and favourite. I will do as you suggest and will do nothing otherwise.

## \|\| 91.12 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*tad vākyaṃ bhārgavaṃ śrutvā daityanātheritaṃ varam \|*  
*vicintya nārada prāha bhūtabhavyavidīśvaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Pulastya said- ”O Narada! Bhargava, knower of past and future both, thought for a little while on request and said-

## \|\| 91.13 \|\|

*tvāyā kṛtā yajñabhujo 'surendrā bahiṣkṛtā ye śrutidṛṣṭamārge \|*  
*śrutipramāṇaṃ makhabhojino bahiḥ surāstadarthaṃ harir abhyupaiti \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You have made demons entitle to receive oblations of yajna while it has been prohibited in Vedas as these have been ousted from this right out. You have again denied the god entitle ab-initio to oblations of offering in Vedas. This is the reason, Hari is coming here.

## \|\| 91.14 \|\|

*tasyādhvaraṃ daityasamāgatasya kāryaṃ hi kiṃ māṃ paripṛcchase yat \|*  
*kāryaṃ na deyaṃ hi vibho tṛṇāgraṃ yadadhvare bhūkanakādikaṃ vā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О demon! As you have asked dealing with Vamana on his arrival here, (it is to state) he should not be given even the tip of a thorn or the earth, gold and other things in the sacrifice.

## \|\| 91.15 \|\|

*vācyaṃ tathā sāma nirarthakaṃ vibho kaste varaṃ dātumalaṃ hi śaknuyāt \|*  
*yasyodare bhūrbhuvanākapālarasātaleśā nivasanti nityaśaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. You should say these peaceful words to him which convey no sense, О sovereign! “Who is able to give anything to a god whose stomach dwells permanently the protectors of earth, aerial region and heaven and the lord of the netherworld.”

## \|\| 91.16 \|\|

*baliruvāca \|*  
*mayā na coktaṃ vacanaṃ hi bhārgava na cāsti mahyaṃ na ca dātumutsahe \|*  
*samāgate 'pyayarthini hīnavṛtte janārdane lokapatau kathaṃ tu \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Bali said- “O Bhargava! I seldom said even any misconduct man who came to me with expectation that I have nothing and I don't want to give.” When Janardana, the ruler of universe is now approaching to me, then tell me that how can I say as suggested by you?

## \|\| 91.17 \|\|

*evaṃ ca śruyate ślokaḥ satāṃ kathayatāṃ vibho \|*  
*sadbhāvo brāhmaṇeṣveva karttavyo bhūtimicchatā \|*  
*dṛśyate hi tathā tacca satyaṃ brāhmaṇasattama \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О sovereign! Gentleman have stated that the man willing luxury should always keep bona-fide spirit for Brahmins. О great Brahmin! His dictum appears allright.

## \|\| 91.18 \|\|

*pūrvābhyāsena karmāṇi saṃbhavanti nṛṇāṃ sphuṭam \|*  
*vākkāyamanasānīha yonyantaragatānyapi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The activities performed by people through speech, body and mind, automatically appear and sprout in other births too on account of previous practice made.

## \|\| 91.19 \|\|

*kiṃ vā tvayā dvijaśreṣṭha paurāṇī na śrutā kathā \|*  
*yā vṛttā malaye pūrvaṃ kośakārasutasya tu \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О great Dvija! Have you not heard the ancient story of Kosakara's son which took place at Malayacala?

## \|\| 91.20 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*kathayasva mahābāho kośakārasutāśrayām \|*  
*kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ puṇyāṃ mahākautūhalaṃ hi me \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Sukra said- “O great warrior! Please, tell the story pertaining to the son of Kosakara. I am curious to listen.”

## \|\| 91.21 \|\|

*baliruvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva kathayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ makhāntare \|*  
*pūrvābhyāsanibaddhāṃ hi satyāṃ bhṛgukulodvaha \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Bali said- “O great son of Bhrgu family! I am telling this true story related to impact of previous practice.” Please, listen to it.

## \|\| 91.22 \|\|

*mudgalasya muneḥ putro jñānavijñānapāragaḥ \|*  
*kośakāra iti khyāta āsīd brahmaṃstaporataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. O Brahmana! hermit Mudgala had a son called Kosakara. He was renowned scholar and full of conscience.

## \|\| 91.23 \|\|

*tasyāsīd dayitā sādhvī dharmiṣṭhā nāmataḥ sutā \|*  
*satī vātsyāyanasutā dharmaśīlā pativratā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Dharmistha was the name of his wife. She was daughter of Vatsyayana, chaste, celibate, religious and devoted to her husband.

## \|\| 91.24 \|\|

*tasyāmasya suto jātaḥ prakṛtyā vai jaḍākṛtiḥ \|*  
*mūkavannālapati sa na ca paśyati cāndhavat \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He was blessed with a son from that lady. He was of inert nature. Like a dumb man neither he could speak nor watch the things like a blind.

## \|\| 91.25 \|\|

*taṃ jātaṃ brāhmaṇī putraṃ jaḍaṃ mūkaṃ tvacakṣuṣam \|*  
*manyamānā gṛhadvāri ṣaṣṭhe 'hani samutsṛjat \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. When that Brahmana's wife considered that baby inert, dumb and blind, she threw him at the gate of her home on the sixth day of birth.

## \|\| 91.26 \|\|

*tato 'bhyāgād durācārā rākṣasī jātahāriṇī \|*  
*svaṃ śiśuṃ kṛśamādāya sūrpākṣī nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A misconduct female-demon Surpaksi who used to theft babies came there with her thin and lean built son.

## \|\| 91.27 \|\|

*tatrotsṛjya svaputraṃ sā jagrāha dvijanandanam \|*  
*tamādāya jagāmātha bhoktuṃ śālodare girau \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She left her son there and picked up the son of Brahmin. She took him and went to eat at the mountain Salodara.

## \|\| 91.28 \|\|

*tatastāmāgatāṃ vīkṣya tasyā bhartā ghaṭodaraḥ \|*  
*netrahīnaḥ pratyuvāca kimānītastvayā priye \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Her blind husband Ghatodara when guessed of her arrival asked- "O beloved! What have you brought here?"

## \|\| 91.29 \|\|

*sābravīt rākṣasapate mayā sthāpya nijaṃ śiśum \|*  
*kośakāradvijagṛhe tasyānītaḥ prabho sutaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. She said- “O lord! О master of the demons! I have left my son behind at the home of sage Kosakara and brought here his son.

## \|\| 91.30 \|\|

*sa prāha na tvayā bhadre bhadramācaritaṃ tviti \|*  
*mahājñānī dvijendro 'sau tataḥ śapsyati kopitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. I have left my son behind at the home of sage Kosakara and brought here his son.

## \|\| 91.31 \|\|

*tasmācchīghramimaṃ tyaktvā manujaṃ ghorarupiṇam \|*  
*anyasya kasyacit putraṃ śīghramānaya sundari \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The demon said- “O gentle woman! You have not done any good act that Brahmin is a great scholar.” Hence, he shall curse on us under influence of anger.

## \|\| 91.32 \|\|

*ityevamuktā sā raudrā rākṣasī kāmacāriṇī \|*  
*samājagāma tvaritā samutpatya vihāyasam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О nice lady! Leave therefore, this baby having ugly face at the same place from where you picked it up and bring here the son of another person.

## \|\| 91.33 \|\|

*sa cāpi rākṣasasuto nisṛṣṭo gṛhabāhyataḥ \|*  
*ruroda susvaraṃ brahman prakṣipyāṅguṣṭhamānane \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Following the suggestion of hei husband, that fierce woman (demon) flew on sky and reached there within no time.

## \|\| 91.34 \|\|

*sā kranditaṃ cirācchrutvā dharmiṣṭhā patimabravīt \|*  
*paśya svayaṃ muniśreṣṭha saśabdastanayastava \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. О Brahmana! That son of demon left outside the home, began weeping loudly with his thumb in mouth.

## \|\| 91.35 \|\|

*trastā sā nirjagāmātha gṛhamadhyāt tapasvinī \|*  
*sa cāpi brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ samapaśyata taṃ śiśum \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. When Dharmistha heard him weeping for longer time, she said to her husband- “O great sage! Look at here! Your son has started weeping loudly.”

## \|\| 91.36 \|\|

*varṇarūpādisaṃyuktaṃ yathā svatanayaṃ tathā \|*  
*tato vihasya provāca kośakāro nijāṃ priyām \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. That virtuous and fearful lady went outside the home. That Brahmin also saw that baby.

## \|\| 91.37 \|\|

*etenāviśya dharmiṣṭhe bhāvyaṃ bhūtena sāmpratam \|*  
*ko 'pyaṭasmākaṃ chalayituṃ surūpī bhuvi saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. When Kosakara sage saw the similar complexion of that baby as that of his own son, he laughed and said to his wife.

## \|\| 91.38 \|\|

*ityuktvā vacanaṃ mantrī mantraistaṃ rākṣasātmajam \|*  
*babandhollikhya vasudhāṃ sakuśenātha pāṇinā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О Dharmistha! Now some evil-spirit has entered the body of the child. Definitely some one of good form, is staying on earth to deceive us.

## \|\| 91.39 \|\|

*etasminnantare prāptā sūrpākṣī viprabālakam \|*  
*antardhānagatā bhūmau cikṣepa gṛhadūrataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. With these words, that learned of Mantras tied that son of demon with Mantras after making lines upon earth with his hand holding Kusa-grass.

## \|\| 91.40 \|\|

*taṃ kṣiptamātraṃ jagrāha kośakāraḥ svakaṃ sutam \|*  
*sā cābhyetya grahītuṃ svaṃ nāśakad rākṣasī sutam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In the meantime, the invisible Surpaksi reached there. She stopped at a distance and threw that son of Brahmana on earth.

## \|\| 91.41 \|\|

*itaścetaśca vibhraṣṭā sā bhartāramupāgamat \|*  
*kathayāmāsā yad vṛttaṃ svadvijātmajahīriṇam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Kosakara gripped his own son just after he was thrown. However that demoness could not seize her son even after coming there.

## \|\| 91.42 \|\|

*evaṃ gatāyaṃ rākṣasyāṃ brāhmaṇena mahātmanā \|*  
*sa rābhasaśiśurbrahman bhāryāyai viniveditaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Falling here and there on both sides, she went to her husband and explained that she had then lost her own as also the son of Brahmin both.

## \|\| 91.43 \|\|

*sa cātmatanayaḥ pitrā kapilāyāḥ savatsayāḥ \|*  
*dadhnā saṃyojito 'tyarthaṃ kṣīreṇekṣurasena ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О Brahmana! when demoness returned, that Brahmin gave the child of demon to his wife.

## \|\| 91.44 \|\|

*dvāveva vardhitau bālau saṃjātau saptavārṣikau \|*  
*pitrā ca kṛtanāmānau niśākaradivākarau \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. His own son was nourished by the father with a lot of curd and milk of brown cow having a calf and with the sugarcane juice.

## \|\| 91.45 \|\|

*naiśācarirdivākīrtirniśākīrtiḥ svaputrakaḥ \|*  
*tayoścakāra vipro 'sau vratabandhakriyāṃ kramāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Both boys attained the age of seven years. The father gave them names as Nisakara and Divakara.

## \|\| 91.46 \|\|

*vratabandhe kṛte vedaṃ papāṭhāsau divākaraḥ \|*  
*niśākaro jaḍatayā na papāṭheti naḥ śrutam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The name of demon's son was Divakirti while the name of Brahmin's son was Nisakirti. Brahmin systematically performed the sacred thread ceremony of both.

## \|\| 91.47 \|\|

*taṃ bāndhavāśca pitarau mātā bhrātā gurustathā \|*  
*paryanindaṃstathā ye ca janā malayavāsinaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Divakara began reciting Vedas when thread ceremony was made. However, Nisakara being inertia, did not set his mind on Vedas. We people have listen this all.

## \|\| 91.48 \|\|

*tataḥ sa pitrā kruddhena kṣiptaḥ kūpe nirūdake \|*  
*mahāśilāṃ copari vai pidhānamavaropayat \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The mother, father, brother, siblings, preceptor and other residents of Malaya mountain began criticising him.

## \|\| 91.49 \|\|

*evaṃ kṣiptastadā kūpe samatīteṣu bhārgava \|*  
*tasya mātāgamat kūpaṃ tamandhaṃ śilayācitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. One day the Brahmin became furious on his folly, threw him in a well without water and covered by a boulder.

## \|\| 91.50 \|\|

*tato daśasu varṣeṣu samatīteṣu bhārgava \|*  
*tasya mātāgamat kūpaṃ tamandhaṃ śilayācitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. That boy lived there for a number of years when so thrown in the well. An Amalaki tree was grown in that well. It laden with fruits for the maintenance of that baby.

## \|\| 91.51 \|\|

*sā dṛṣṭāvā nicitaṃ kūpaṃ śilayā girikalpayā \|*  
*uccaiḥ provāca keneyaṃ kūpopari śilā kṛtā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О Bhargava! “A period of decade passed when his mother went near that dark and boulder covered well.”

## \|\| 91.52 \|\|

*kūpāntasthaḥ sa tāṃ vāṇīṃ śrutvā māturniśākaraḥ \|*  
*prāha pradattā pitrā me kūpopari śilā tviyam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. She spoke loudly when saw that well covered by a heavy boulder- "Who has kept this boulder on the well?"

## \|\| 91.53 \|\|

*sātibhītābravīt ko 'si kūpāntastho 'dbhutasvaraḥ \|*  
*so 'pyāha tava putro 'smi niśākareti viśrutaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. When Nisakara heard his mother's voice, he told- "My father has kept this stone on the mouth of well."

## \|\| 91.54 \|\|

*sābravīt tanayo mahyaṃ nāmnā khyāto divākaraḥ \|*  
*niśākareti nāmnāho na kaścit tanayo 'sti me \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. She frightened and said- Who are you inside well speakingly so strange? He replied- "I am your son Nisakara."

## \|\| 91.55 \|\|

*sa cāha pūrvacaritaṃ māturniravaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sā śrutvā tāṃ śilāṃsubhraḥ samutkṣipyāntayo 'śripat \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. She said- "My son is Divakara and I have no son addressed as Nisakara."

## \|\| 91.56 \|\|

*sottīrya kūpāt bhagavan mātuḥ pādāvavandata \|*  
*sā svānurūpaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā svasutasya ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. That boy then told the previous story in the fullest details and being satisfied, his mother anyhow removed that boulder and threw it other side.

## \|\| 91.57 \|\|

*tatastamādāya sutaṃ dharmiṣṭhā patimetya ca \|*  
*kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ svasutasya ca \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. O god! That boy touched the feet of his mother when he was pulled upside the well. She saw the son bom from her womb as there was resemblance existed.

## \|\| 91.58 \|\|

*tato\|nvapṛcchad vipro 'sau kimidaṃ tāta kāraṇam \|*  
*noktavān yadbhavān pūrvaṃ mahatkautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Dharmistha then took him to home and told the whole episode of her son to husband.

## \|\| 91.59 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ dhīmān kośakāraṃ dvijottamam \|*  
*prāha putro 'dbhutaṃ vākyaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. That Brahmin asked then- “O son! You didn't speak during birth. Tell me its reason. I am very curious to listen it.”

## \|\| 91.60 \|\|

*śrūyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tāta yena mūkatvamāśritam \|*  
*mayā jaḍatvamanagha tathāndhatvaṃ svacakṣuṣaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Hearing these words, the wise son reciprocated strange to Kosakara, the excellent Brahmana, his father and mother.

## \|\| 91.61 \|\|

*pūrvamāsamahaṃ vipra kule vṛndārakasya tu \|*  
*vṛṣākapeśca tanayo mālāgarbhasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Nisakara said- ‘‘O innocent father! Listen to the reason why I had resorted to dumbness, inertia and blindness.”

## \|\| 91.62 \|\|

*tataḥ pitā pāṭhayanmāṃ śāstraṃ dharmārthakāmadam \|*  
*mokṣaśāstraṃ paraṃ tāta setihāsaśrutiṃ tathā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О Brahmin! I was the son of Vrsaakapi bom from the womb of Mala in respectable Vrndaraka family in my previous life.

## \|\| 91.63 \|\|

*so 'haṃ tāta mahājñānī parāvaraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*jāto madāndhastenāhaṃ duṣkarmābhirato 'bhavam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О father! My father that time taught me the scriptures providing with accomplishment of Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa, history and scriptures ensuing emancipation including Vedas.

## \|\| 91.64 \|\|

*madāt samabhavallebhastena naṣṭā pragalbhatā \|*  
*viveko nāśamagamat mūrkhabhāvamupāgataḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. О father! I was great scholar and expert in prudence as also metaphysics. It increased my ego making me blind and it all had turned me into evil activities.

## \|\| 91.65 \|\|

*mūḍha bhāvatayā cātha jātaḥ pāparato 'smbhaham \|*  
*paradāraparārtheṣu matirme ca sadābhavat \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The ego further originated greed in me. It had mined my knowledge on scriptures. My discretion was cost and I became quite stupid.

## \|\| 91.66 \|\|

*paradārābhimarśitvāt parārthaharaṇādapi \|*  
*mṛto 'smyudbndhanenāhaṃ narakaṃ rauravaṃ gataḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. On account of having ignorance, I became evildoer. My mind also attached to other's wife and wealth.

## \|\| 91.67 \|\|

*tasmād varṣasahasrānte bhuktaśiṣṭe tadāgasi \|*  
*araṇye mṛgahā pāpaḥ saṃjāto 'haṃ mṛgādhipaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. As I had made physical contacts with other's wife and extorted other's wealth, I was thrown into Raurava hell after death.

## \|\| 91.68 \|\|

*vyāghratve saṃsthitastāta baddhaḥ pañjaragaḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*narādhipena vibhunā nītaśca nagaraṃ nijam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. After suffering for as much as one thousand years, the residual sins then gave me birth as tiger and began killing animals mercilessly.

## \|\| 91.69 \|\|

*baddhasya piñjarasthasya vyāghratve 'dhiṣṭhitasya ha \|*  
*dharmārthakāmaśāstrāṇi pratyabhāsanta sarvaśaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. О father! Any influencive.king caught me one day, fastened and kept in a cage. He then took me to his palace from the forest.

## \|\| 91.70 \|\|

*tato nṛpatiśārdūlo gadāpāṇiḥ kadācana \|*  
*ekavastraparīdhāno nagarānniryayau bahiḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Inspite of being a tiger, fastened and kept in cage, I was still in memory of the scriptures relating to Dharma, Artha and Kama.

## \|\| 91.71 \|\|

*tasya bhāryā jitā nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi \|*  
*sā nirgate tu ramaṇe mamāntikamupāgatā \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. That glorious king subsequently put single garment on body, took mace in hand and moved out from his city.

## \|\| 91.72 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vavṛdhe mahyaṃ pūrvābhyāsānmanobhavaḥ \|*  
*yathaiva dharmaśāstrāṇi tathāhamavadaṃ ca tām \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. His wife Jita was unique beautiful on this earth. She came to me one day when her husband was away.

## \|\| 91.73 \|\|

*rājaputri sukalyāṇi navayauvanaśālini \|*  
*cittaṃ harasi me bhīru kokilā dhvaninā yathā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. When I saw her, my sensuality too increased in line with the increase of my knowledge on scriptures due to previous practice. I said to her-

## \|\| 91.74 \|\|

*sā madvacanamākarṇya provāca tanumadhyamā \|*  
*kathamevāvayorvyāghra ratiyogamupeṣyati \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. О handsome, nice and ascending youth lady! As cuckoo attracts the minds of people through her sweet voice, you have attracted

## \|\| 91.75 \|\|

*tato 'hamabruvaṃ tāta rājaputrīṃ sumadhyamām \|*  
*dvāramudghāṭayasvādya nirgamiṣyāmi satvaram \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Hearing my words, that beautiful lady replied- “O tiger! How is coition between us is possible?”

## \|\| 91.76 \|\|

*sāpyayabravīd divā vyāghra loko 'yaṃ paripaśyati \|*  
*rātrāvudghāṭayiṣyāma tato raṃsyāva svecchayā \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. O father! I then said to that beautiful queen- "Open the doors of cage and I would then come out immediately."

## \|\| 91.77 \|\|

*tāmevāhamavocaṃ vai kālakṣepe 'hamakṣamaḥ \|*  
*tasmādudghāṭaya dvāraṃ māṃ bandhācca vimocaya \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. She said- О tiger! The people will see us in the day. I will open it at night and then enjoy coition to the extent of satiation.

## \|\| 91.78 \|\|

*tataḥ sā pīvaraśreṇī dvāramudghāṭayanmune \|*  
*udghāṭite tato dvāre nirgato 'haṃ bahiḥ śraṇāt \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. I further said- “I am unable to enjoy if any more delay is made. Hence, open the door and make me free from striyos.”

## \|\| 91.79 \|\|

*pāśāni nigaḍādīni chinnāni hi balānmayā \|*  
*sā gṛhītā ca nṛpaterbhāryā ramitumicchatā \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Then the large hipped lady opened the door. The gate being opened, I jumped within a moment outside.

## \|\| 91.80 \|\|

*tato dṛṣṭo 'smi nṛpaterbhṛtyairatulavikramaiḥ \|*  
*śastrahastaiḥ sarvataśca tairahaṃ pariveṣṭitaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. I forcibly cut-off the fetters, iron-chains etc. and caught that queen for coition.

## \|\| 91.81 \|\|

*mahāpāśaiḥ śṛṅkhalābhiḥ samāhatya ca mudgaraiḥ \|*  
*vadhyamāno 'bruvamahaṃ mā mā hiṃsadhvamākulāḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The attendants of king, powerful and chivalrous enough saw me and gripped me with weapons from all sides.

## \|\| 91.82 \|\|

*te madvacanamākarṇya matvaiva rajanīcaram \|*  
*dṛḍhaṃ vṛkṣe samudbdhya ghātayanta tapodhana \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. They fastened me with thicker cords and chains and then thrashed by mudgaras. I requested them not blowing so hard on my body when it was continuously going on.

## \|\| 91.83 \|\|

*bhayo gataśca narakaṃ paradāraniṣevaṇāt \|*  
*mukto varṣasahasrānte jāto 'haṃ śvetagardabhaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. O resolute! Hearing my words, those people thought me demon, tied me with a tree and killed at last.

## \|\| 91.84 \|\|

*brāhmaṇasyāgniveśyasya gehe bahukalatriṇaḥ \|*  
*tatrāpi sarvavijñānaṃ pratyabhāsat tato mama \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. I again fell in heaven on account of coition with other's wife. After passage of a period of one thousand years, I got liberty and then took birth as a white donkey.

## \|\| 91.85-86 \|\|

*upavanāhyaḥ kṛtaścāsmi dvijayoṣidbhirādarāt \|*  
*ekadā navarāṣṭrīyā bhāryā tasyāgrajanmanaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*vimatirnāmataḥ khyātā gantumaicchad gṛhaṃ pituḥ \|*  
*tāmuvāca patirgaccha āruhyaṃ śvetagardabham \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. At that stage, I lived in the custody of a Brahmin called Agnivesya having several wives. Here too the knowledge acquired by me in previous birth was ready in my memory.

## \|\| 91.87 \|\|

*māsenāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ na stheyaṃ paratastataḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktā sā bhartrā tanvī māmadhiruhya ca \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. The wives of Brahmins have employed me in riding work, one day the wife of that Brahmin wished to go at her father's house in Navarastra Desa. Her name was Vimati. Her husband said to her- "Ride on this white donkey and visit there happily."

## \|\| 91.88-89 \|\|

*bandhanādavamucyātha jagāma tvaritā mune \|*  
*tator'dhapathi sā tanvī matpṛṣṭhādavaruhya vai \|\| 88 \|\|*

*avatīrṇā nadīṃ snātuṃ svarūpā cārdravāsasā \|*  
*sāṅgopāṅgāṃ rūpavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmahamādravam \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. Return from there within a month and don't wish to live there anymore. That wife rode on me after she heard these instruction from the Brahmin.

## \|\| 91.90 \|\|

*mayā cābhidrutā tūrṇaṃ patitā pṛthivītale \|*  
*tasyāmupari bho tāta patito 'haṃ bhṛśāturaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. О sage! She freed me from tie and set out. When she reached just half the way, she alighted from back and got down for bath in a river. Being in wet clothes, her complexion fully disclosed before my eyes. I fell in love with her and excited.

## \|\| 91.91 \|\|

*hṛṣṭo bhartrānusṛṣṭena nṛṇā tadanusāriṇā \|*  
*protkṣipya yaṣṭiṃ māṃ brahman samādhāvat tvarānvitaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. She fell down when I leapt upon her in sheer excitement. О father! Having under severe influence of lust, I bent on her immediately.

## \|\| 91.92 \|\|

*tad bhayāt tāṃ parityajya pradruto dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ \|*  
*tato 'bhidravatastūrṇa khalīnarasanā mune \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. О Brahmin! An attendant of her husband was coming behind us. He saw what I was doing. He picked a rod in hand and rushed towards me.

## \|\| 91.93 \|\|

*mamāsaktā vaṃśagulme durmokṣe prāṇanāśane \|*  
*tatrāsaktasya ṣaḍrātrānmamābhūjjīvitakṣayaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

107-108. I am remembering really all those previous practice, I got knowledge on scriptures and bondage of evils both coincide. I will therefore, seldom commit any evil though application of my mind, acts and speech in this yoni.

110\. О father! When a man is known to his previous birth, he always remains away from committing the evils again once committed.

111\. Hence, О sage! I will go to forest for increasing the account of noble deeds and absolving the evils committed earlier. Apparent Divakirtti, your son for worldly affairs i.e. living as household.

*baliruvāca \|*

112\. Bali said- О hermit! With these words to his father, Nisakara touched the feet of his parent and went at Badarikasrama, the sacred residing place of renowned god Narayana.

115\. Pulastya said- the demon king, Bali, the mighty began to fix his mind on Narayana, holder of discus, mace and sword, the killer of Madhu-kaitbha with these words to Sukracarya, his preceptor and regulator/adviser.

## Chapter 92. Bondage of king Bali

## \|\| 92.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*

*oṅkārapūrvāḥ śrutayo makhe 'smin tiṣṭhanti rūpeṇa tapodhanānām \|*

*tato 'bravīt suraśreṣṭho daityarājānamavyayaḥ \|*

*surārervacanaṃ śrutvā balirbhāryāmavekṣya ca \|*

*śrīsamudrā uromadhye candramā manasi sthitaḥ \|*

*mukhe tu sāgnayo viprāḥ saṃskārā daśanacchadāḥ \|*  
*dharmakāmārthamokṣīyāḥ śāstraḥ śaucasamanvitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*lakṣmyā saha lalāṭasthāḥ śravaṇābhyāmathāśvinau \|*  
*śvāsastho mātariśvā ca marutaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Brahmin worshipping fire was in his mouth, all religious rituals on lips, the scriptures relating to virtue, love, money and salvation, together with the hygienic rules, including Laksmi on forehead, Asvinikumaras in ears, wind in breathing and Marudganas on all joins existed.

*sarvasūktāni daśānā jihvā devī sarasvatī \|*

28\. King Dhruva sat on the tuft of God of gods, the stars shot from the pores of his skin and hermits on hair were existed.

## \|\| 92.29 \|\|

*guṇaiḥ sarvamayo bhūtvā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ \|*

29\. The god, dear to all organisms so merged all and measured this entire earth consisting of movable and immovables in a single step.

## \|\| 92.30 \|\|

*bhūmiṃ vikramamāṇasya mahārūpasya tasya vai \|*  
*dakṣiṇo 'bhūt stanaścandraḥ sūryo 'bhūdatha cottaraḥ \|*

*dvitīyena krameṇātha svarmaharjanatāpasāḥ \|*

*tataḥ pratāpinā brahman bṛhadviṣṇvaṅghriṇāmbare \|*

32\. О Brahmin! The huge and valorous foot of Visnu thereafter crossed the belly portion of cosmos and entered into Niraloka.

## \|\| 92.33-35 \|\|

*viśvāṅghriṇā prasaratā kaṭāho bhedito balān \|*  
*kuṭilā viṣṇupāde tu sametya kuṭilā tataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tasyā viṣṇupadītyevaṃ nāmākhyātamabhūnmune \|*

*bhagavānapyasaṃpūrṇe tṛtīye tu krame vibhuḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*samabhyetya baliṃ prāha īṣat prasphuritādharaḥ \|*  
*ṛmād bhavati daityendra bandhanaṃ ghoradarśanam \|*  
*tvaṃ pūraya padaṃ tanme no ced bandhaṃ pratīccha bhoḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The stretching foot of Visnu then crossed forcibly the Kataha. His foot then reached near Kutila river. О sage! Kutila then renowned as Visnupada. The ascetics subsequently began taking bath in her considering as divine river. The gigantic god reached Bali when third, step could not feet anyplace to measure. He said in an irony- О demon king! Fierce bondage grip the man when the debt is not repaid. Accept either my foot now or accept the rest as liability.

## \|\| 92.36 \|\|

*tanmurārivacaḥ śrutvā vihasyātha baleḥ sutaḥ \|*
