36\. Hearing those words of Murari, Bana, the son of Bali smiled and said with reasons to the lord of gods-

## \|\| 92.37 \|\|

*bāṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛtvā mahīmalpatarāṃ jagatpate svāyaṃbhuvādibhuvanāni vai ṣaṭ \|*  
*kathaṃ baliṃ prārthayase suvistṛtāṃ yāṃ prāgbhavān no vipulāmathākarot \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Bana said- “O ruler of universe! You have derogated the dignity of the earth by constructing/classifying it in six bhuvanas like Svayambhuva etc. When you already have made the borders of land so short, how can you claim of more extended land to give?

## \|\| 92.38 \|\|

*vibho sahī yāvatīyaṃ tvayādya sṛṣṭacā sametā bhuvanāntarālaiḥ \|*  
*dattā ca tātena hi tāvatīyaṃ kiṃ vākchalenaiṣa nibadhyate 'dya \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О sovereign! My father has given you today the earth consisting of bhuvanas classified and created by you. Why does you then bound him through your manipulation of speech?

## \|\| 92.39 \|\|

*yā naiva śakya bhavatā hi pūrituṃ kathaṃ vitanyād ditijeśvaro 'sau \|*  
*śaktastu saṃpūjayituṃ murāre prasīda mā bandhanamādiśasva \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O Murari! “How can the lord of demons offer what is not possible for you to create? He is able to worship you.” Be pleased, do not order his imprisonment.

## \|\| 92.40 \|\|

*proktaṃ śrutau bhavatāpīśa vākyaṃ dānaṃ pātre bhavate saukhyadāyi \|*  
*deśe supuṇye varade yacca kāle taccāśeṣaṃ dṛśyate cakrapāṇe \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Also О god! You himself have stated in Vedas that the donation made to eligible in unity of time, place and action always proves pleasure pouring. О god having discus in hand! That circumstance is really existed here.

## \|\| 92.41 \|\|

*dānaṃ bhūmiḥ sarvakāmapradeyaṃ bhavān pātraṃ devadevo jitātmā \|*  
*kālo jyeṣṭhāmūlayoge mṛgāṅgaḥ kurukṣetraṃ puṇyadeśaṃ prasiddham \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The land giving all desires is being donated, you are eligible to it. The time also is that when moon is in the conjunction of Jyestha and Mela (stars) and there exists renowned Kuruksetra, the sacred place.

## \|\| 92.42 \|\|

*kiṃ vā devo 'smadvidhairbuddhihīnaiḥ śikṣāpanīyaḥ sādhu vāsādhu caiva \|*  
*svayaṃ śrutīnāmapi cādikarttā vyāpya sthitaḥ sadasad yo jagad vai \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The people fools like us cannot give any suggestion either good or bad to the god like you. You yourself are the first composer of Vedas and existed covering the entire world consisiting of real and unreal.

## \|\| 92.43 \|\|

*kṛtvā pramāṇaṃ svayaseva hīnaṃ padatrayaṃ yācitavān bhuvaśca \|*  
*kiṃ tvaṃ na gṛhṇāsi jagattrayaṃ bho rūpeṇa lokatrayavanditena \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. You yourself had begged the land measuring three steps by reducing the size of your body to a dwarf. О god! “Whether you have not already covered the three worlds by your gigantic form adored by all people of three worlds?”

## \|\| 92.44 \|\|

*nātrāścaryaṃ yajjagad vai samagraṃ kramatrayaṃ naiva pūrṇaṃ tavādya \|*  
*krameṇa tvaṃ laṅghayituṃ samartho līlāmetāṃ kṛtavān lokanātha \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. It is not surprising if this whole world has fell short to complete your three steps as you are capable, to measure it even by single step. О ruler of lokas! You have merely revealed it like your art.

## \|\| 92.45 \|\|

*pramāṇahīnāṃ svayameva kṛtvā vasuṃdharāṃ mādhava padmanābha \|*  
*viṣṇo na badhnāsi baliṃ na dūre prabhuryadevecchati tatkaroti \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О Madhava! О Padmanabha! О Visnu! It is not good to derogate the earth by proving it smaller as you yourself has created it. The almighty does what he likes.

## \|\| 92.46 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*ityevamukte vacane bāṇena balisūnunā \|*  
*provāca bhagavān vākyamādikarttā janārdanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Pulastya said- This being said by Bana, son of Bali, God Janardana, the foremost creator replied Bana-

## \|\| 92.47 \|\|

*trivikrama uvāca \|*  
*yānyuktāni vacāṃsītthaṃ tvayā bāleya sāmpratam \|*  
*teṣāṃ vaica hetusaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu pratyuttaraṃ mama \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Trivikrama said- “O son of Bali! Listen to the reasonable answer to your curious statements from me.”

## \|\| 92.48 \|\|

*pūrvamuktastava pitā mayā rājan padatrayam \|*  
*dehi mahyaṃ pramāṇena tadetat samanuṣṭhitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. I very first had stated to your father to give land measuring three steps as per the size of my body. He has performed donation appropriately.

## \|\| 92.49 \|\|

*kiṃ na vetti pramāṇaṃ me balistava pitāsura \|*  
*prāyacchad yena niḥśaṅkaṃ mamānantaṃ kramatrayam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О demon! Does not your father, Bali, know my size, so that he unhesitatingly offered me three endless steps?

## \|\| 92.50 \|\|

*satyaṃ krameṇa caikena krameyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam \|*  
*balerapi hitārthāya kṛtametat kramatrayam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. It is true that I can measure the entire worlds consisting of Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah etc. It is for the benefit of Bali too that the three steps have been made.

## \|\| 92.51 \|\|

*tasmād yanmama bāleya tvatpitrāmbu kare mahat \|*  
*dattaṃ tenāyuretasya kalpaṃ yāvad bhaviṣyati \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О son of Bali! As your father has given water in my palm as a proof or resolution, he will attain age of a Kalpa.

## \|\| 92.52 \|\|

*gate manvantare bāṇa śrāddhadevasya sāmpratam \|*  
*sāvarṇike ca saṃprāpte balirindro bhaviṣyati \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О Вana! Bali will be coronated as Indra on expiry of Sraddhadeva Manvantara and on commencement of Savarnika Manvantara.

## \|\| 92.53 \|\|

*itthaṃ proktvā balisutaṃ bāṇaṃ devastrivikramaḥ \|*  
*provāca balimabhyetya vacanaṃ madhurākṣaram \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. With these words to Bana, the son of Bali, Trivikrama god went to Bali and said him affectionately-

## \|\| 92.54 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*āpūraṇād dakṣiṇāyā gaccha rājan mahāphalam \|*  
*sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ vasa tatra nirāmayaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. God said- “O king! Till my honorarium is paid, you go and live free from diseases in the nether world called Sutala which is highly fruitful.”

## \|\| 92.55 \|\|

*baliruvāca \|*  
*sutale vasato nātha mama bhogāḥ kuto 'vyayāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti tu yenāhaṃ nivatsyāmi nirāmayaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Bali said- ‘‘O demon! Tell me the wherefrom I will get undepleting luxuries for living with cheers and sound health in Sutala.”

## \|\| 92.56 \|\|

*trivikrama uvāca \|*  
*sutalasthasya daityendra yāni bhogāni te 'dhunā \|*  
*bhivaṣyanti mahārhāṇi tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Trivikrama said- “O demon king! I describe all those sumptuous luxuries which will be received by you while residing in Sutala.”

## \|\| 92.57 \|\|

*dānānyavidhittāni śrāddhānyaśrotriyāṇi ca \|*  
*tathādhītānyavratibhirdāsyanti bhavataḥ phalam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The donations made without following the manner prescribed, funeral rites (Sraddha) without Vedic scholars, studies performed by those who do not observe the vow of Brahmacarya will have their fruit accrued to you.

## \|\| 92.58 \|\|

*tathānyamutsavaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛtte śakramahotsave \|*  
*dvārapratipadā nāma tava bhāvī mahotsavaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Pratipada after Sakra festival shall be observed as a day of your worship and this day will be addressed as Dvarapratipada.

## \|\| 92.59 \|\|

*tatra tvāṃ naraśārdūlā hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ \|*  
*puṣpadīpapradānena arjayiṣyanti yatnataḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. At that time, the healthy and wealthy people will dress well and worship you with flowers and lamp lighted.

## \|\| 92.60 \|\|

*tatrotsavo sukhyatamo bhaviṣyati divāniśaṃ hṛṣṭajanābhirāmam \|*  
*yathaiva rājye bhavatastu sāmprataṃ tathaiva sā bhāvyatha kaumudī ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. As an attractive festivity (mahotsava) continuously maintained in your state due to human beings all in pleasure, the festival being celebrated on that auspicious day shall be called Kaumudi.

## \|\| 92.61 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā madhuhā ditīśvaraṃ visarjayitvā sutalaṃ sabhāryam \|*  
*yajñaṃ samādāya jagāma tūrṇaṃ sa śakrasadbhāmarasaṃghajuṣṭam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Madhusudana then sent Bali with his queen in Sutala loka. He took yajna with him and immediately went at Indra's palace surrounded by gods.

## \|\| 92.62 \|\|

*dattvā maghone ca vibhustriviṣṭapaṃ kṛtvā ca devān makhabhāgabhoktṝn \|*  
*antardadhe viśvapatirmaharṣe saṃpaśyatāmeva murādhipānām \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. О hermit! God Visnu, the omnipresent god then returned heaven to Indra, made them share-holder to the oblations offered through yajna and suddenly disappeared before the very eyes of the lord of gods.

## \|\| 92.63 \|\|

*svargaṃ gate dhātari vāsudeve śālvo 'surāṇāṃ mahatā balena \|*  
*kṛtvā puraṃ saubhamiti prasiddhaṃ tadāntarikṣe vicacāra kāmāt \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The demon Salva made a large army of demons, constructed the city known as Saubha and began to walk freely in the sky when Vasudeva returned to his abode at Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 92.64 \|\|

*mayastu kṛtvā tripuraṃ mahātmā suvarṇatāmrāyasamagryasaukhyam \|*  
*satārakākṣaḥ saha vaidyutena saṃtiṣṭhate bhṛtyakalatravān saḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The great Maya with his wives and attendants constructed three palaces by using gold, copper and iron, provided with all amenities of the highest order, and began to live happily there in company of Tarakaksa and Vaidyuta and his servants.

## \|\| 92.65 \|\|

*baṇo 'pi devena hṛte triviṣṭape baddhe balau cāpi rasātalasthe \|*  
*kṛtvā suguptaṃ bhuvi śoṇitākhyaṃ puraṃ sa cāste saha dānavendraiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Banasura also constructed Sonita city taking care of all safety norms and began to live there with demon kings when the heaven was seized by Visnu and Bali tied under resolution and sent to nether.

## \|\| 92.66 \|\|

*evaṃ purā cakradhareṇa viṣṇunā baddho balirvāmanarūpadhāriṇā \|*  
*śakrapriyārtha surakāryasiddhaye hitāya viprarṣabhagodvijānām \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Thus, Visnu, the discus holding god appeared in dwarf form during long past and tied Bali under promise for the interests of Indra, welfare of gods and all benevolents for hermits, cows and dvijas.

## \|\| 92.67 \|\|

*prādurbhavaste kathito maharṣe puṇyaḥ śucirvāmanasyāghahārī \|*  
*śrute yasmin saṃsmṛte kīrtite ca pāpaṃ yāti prakṣayaṃ puṇyameti \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. О hermit! I have described the episode on appearance of Vamana, the god absolving sins and enhancing noble deeds. Sins are absolved and noble deeds increase by listening, summoning and reciting this episode.

## \|\| 92.68 \|\|

*etat proktaṃ bhavataḥ puṇyakīrtteḥ prādurbhāvo balibandho 'vyayasya \|*  
*yaccāpyanyan śrotukāmo 'si vipra tatprocyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmyaśeṣam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. O Brahmin! I have described an episode on origin of Vamana, the immortal god having far and wide fame and binding down of Bali by the imperishable (Visnu) of sacred fame. Now, ask “what more you want to listen?” I will tell that exhaustively.

## Chapter 93. Worship of Vamana by Brahma

## \|\| 93.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*śrutaṃ yathā bhagavatā balirbaddho mahātmanā \|*  
*kiṃ tvastayanyattu praṣṭavyaṃ tacchrutvā kathayādya me \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Narada said- “I heard all that as Vamana, the along almighty had tied Bali under promissory estoppel. However, there is also another matter to enquire. Please, explain it to me as I ask you.

## \|\| 93.2-3 \|\|

*bhagavān devarājāya dattvā viṣṇustriviṣṭapam \|*  
*antardhānaṃ gataḥ kvāsau sarvātmā tāta kathyatām \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sutalasthaśca daityendraḥ kimakārṣīt tathā vada \|*  
*kā ceṣṭā tasya viprarṣe tanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. O learned hermit! “Tell me that where had god Visnu gone after disappearing when he assigned the ruling of heaven to Indra, the king of gods? In addition to it, please tell me that what did Bali at Sutala do? Kindly, tell me in particular that what activities he performed thereafter.”

## \|\| 93.4 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*antardhāya surāvāsaṃ vāmano 'bhūdavāmanaḥ \|*  
*jagāma brahmasadanamadhiruhyoragāśanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Pulastya said- God Vamana abandoned his dwarf form after he vanished and went, riding on the serpent devourer (Garuda) at the abode of Brahma, the abode of gods.

## \|\| 93.5 \|\|

*vāsudevaṃ samāyāntaṃ jñātvā brahmāvyayātmakaḥ \|*  
*samutthāyāyatha sauhārdāt sasvaje kamalāsanaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma, the imperishable god stood up on his lotus-feet and embraced affectionately him when he saw Visnu came there.

## \|\| 93.6 \|\|

*pariṣvajyārcya vidhinā vedhāḥ pūjādinā harim \|*  
*papraccha kiṃ cireṇeha bhavatāgamanaṃ kṛtam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Brahma honoured Hari in prescribed manner and asked- "Please, tell me the purpose of your arrival after a lapse of prolong period."

## \|\| 93.7 \|\|

*athovāca jagatsvāmī mayā kāryaṃ mahatkṛtam \|*  
*surāṇāṃ kratubhāgārthaṃ svayaṃbho balibandhanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The ruler of universe replied- I have performed a noble deed. О Svayambhu! I have tied Bali for ensuring gods’ share with yajna.

## \|\| 93.8 \|\|

*pitāmahastad vacanaṃ śrutvā muditamānasaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ kathamiti prāha tvaṃ māṃ darśitumarhasi \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Brahma pleased hearing this- "But how? Please, reveal that form before me too."

## \|\| 93.9 \|\|

*ityevamukte vacane bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*darśayāmāsa tadrūpaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ laghu \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The Garuda-bannered God exhibited that complexion incoiporating all gods therein.

## \|\| 93.10 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ yojanāyutavistṛtam \|*  
*tāvānevordhvāmānena tato 'jaḥ praṇato 'bhavat \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Pitamaha bowed his head when he saw Pundarikaksa expanded to ten-thousand yojanas wide and equally vast in height.

## \|\| 93.11 \|\|

*tataḥ praṇamya suciraṃ sādhu sādhvityudīrya ca \|*  
*bhaktitamro mahādevaṃ padmajaḥ stotramīrayat \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Brahma bowed his bead for longer, appreciated and began reciting psalm of Mahadeva with keen devotion.  
I salute you О god of gods! Vasudeva! Aiksrnga! Multiform! Vrsakapi! Bhutabhavana! Supreme among gods and demons! Surasura mathana! Pitavasa! Srinivasa! Asuranirmitanta! Amitanirmita! Kapila! Mahakapila! Visvaksena! Narayana! Dhruvadhvaja! Satyadhvaja! Khadgadhvaja! Taladhvaja! Vaikuntha! Purusottama! Varenya Visnu! Aparajita! Jaya! Jayanta! Vijaya! Krtavarta! Mahadeva! Anadi, Ananta, Adyanta, Puranjaya, Dhananjaya, Sucisrava, Prsnigarbha (I salute you). I salute you О Kamalagarbha! Kamalayataksa, Sripati, Visnumula, Muladhivasa, Dharmadhivasa, Dharmavasa, Dharmadhyaksa, Prajadhyaksa, Gadadhara, Sridhara, Vanamaladhara, Laksmidhara, Dharanidhara, Padmanabha. I bow my head for Virinci, Arstisena, Mahasena, Senadhyaksa, Purustuta, Bahukalpa, Mahakalpa, Kalpanamukha, Aniruddha, Sarvaga, Sarvatman, Dvadasatmaka, Suryatmaka, Somatmaka, Kalatmaka, Vyomatmaka, Bhutatmaka. О essence, supreme soul, immortal, Munjakesa, Harikesa, Gudadesa, Kesava, Nila, Suksma, Sthula, Pita, Rakta, Sveta, Svetadhivasa, found of red apparel, dear to all, treasure of love, Hamsa, Nilavasa, Siradhvaja, Sarvalokadhivasa, Kusesaya, Adhoksaja, Govinda, Janardana, Madhusudana, I salute you. You are having one thousand heads, eyes, feet, lotus, Mahapurusa, one thousand armed and having one thousand icons. The gods address you as Sahasravadana, I salute you. Salute to Om Visvedeva, Visvabhu, Visvatmaka, Visvarupa, Visvasambhava. This world has been originated from you. Brahmins have originated from your mouth, Ksatriyas from arms, Vaisyas from both thighs and Sudras from your lotus feet. О Svayambhu! Space is originated from your navel, Indra and fire from mouth, the sun from your eyes, moon from your mind and I am originated by your pleasure. Your anger has given birth to Tryambaka, your breathing has given birth to Matarisva, the head originated Dyuloka, the directions from your ears, this earth from your feet and constellations have been originated from your splendour. All tangible and intangible matters have been originated from you. I salute you as you are in world form "Om" syllable. You are Puspahasa, Mahahasa, Parama, Omkara, Vasatkara, Svahakara, Vausatkara, Svadhakara, Vedas form, holy places, clients, yajna, creator of all, yajnabhokta, Sukradhata, Bhurda, Bhuvarda, Svarda, Svamada, Goda and Amrtada. You are "Om" syllable Brahma etc., Brahma, Yajna, Vedakama, Vadya, Yajnadhara, Mahamina, Mahasena, Mahasiva, Nrkesari, Hota, Homya, Havya, Нuyamanа, Hayamedha, Pota, Pavayita, Puta, Pujya, Data, Hanyamana, Hryamana and Harita. "Om" you are ethics, leader, agray, Visvadhama, Subhanda, Dhruva, Araneya, Dhayna, Dhyeya, Jneya, Jnana, Yasta, Dana, Bhuma, Iksya, Brahma, Hota, Udgata, speed of racers, knowledge of scholars, yoga of yogis, emancipation of its desirous, wealth of rich people and you are Grhya, Pata and Parama. You are moon, sun, consecration, donation, man, three-eyed, great-eyed, Adityaprabhava, Surottama, Suci, Sukra, Sky, rainy season, the months Agrahayana and Bhadra, Pausa, Magha, Phalguna, Caitra and Vaisakha, time transference, Isa, Urja, Saha, Sahasya, Тара, Tapasya, honey, Madhava, Kala, Sankrama, valourous, courageous, horse-necked, great yajna, Sankara, Harisvara, Sambhu, Brahmesa, Surya, Mitravaruna, Pragvansakaya, Bhuta etc., Mahabhuta, Urdhvakarma, Kartta, Sarvapapavimocana and Trivikrama. I salute you.

## \|\| 93.12 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*itthaṃ stutaḥ padmavena viṣṇustapasvibhiścādbhutakārmakārī \|*  
*provāca devaṃ prapitāmahaṃ tu varaṃ vṛṇīṣvāmalasattvavṛtte \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Pulastya said- When so prayed by Brahma and other ascetics, Visnu, the excellent doer said Pitamaha- "O purest Sattvavrtti! Ask to what you desire."

## \|\| 93.13 \|\|

*tamabravīt prītiyutaḥ pitāmaho varaṃ mamehādya vibho prayaccha \|*  
*rūpeṇa puṇyena vibo hyanena saṃsthīyatāṃ madbhavane murāre \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Brahma said politely- “O sovereign! О Murari! I wish you should live always in very complexion here at my residence.”

## \|\| 93.14 \|\|

*itthaṃ vṛte devavareṇa prādāt prabhustathāstviti tamavyayātmā \|*  
*tasthau hi rūpeṇa hi vāmanena saṃpūjyamānaḥ sadane svayaṃbhoḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The sovereign Avyayatma said in reply- "It will be as you desired." Since then he remained there in dwarf form and received honour with keen devotion.

## \|\| 93.15 \|\|

*nṛtyanti tatrāpsarasāṃ samūhya gāyanti gītāni surendragāyanāḥ \|*  
*vidyādharāstūryarāṃśca vādayan stuvanti devāsurasiddhasaṅghāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A group of nymphs began dancing there, the singers started singing under instructions from Indra, Vidyadhara began piping trumpet and the commune of gods, demons and siddhas began reciting psalms.

## \|\| 93.16 \|\|

*tataḥ samārādhya vibhuṃ surādhipaḥ pitāmaho dhautamalaḥ sa śuddhaḥ \|*  
*svarge viriñciḥ sadanāt supuṣpāṇyānīya pūjāṃ pracakāra viṣṇoḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Then the lord of gods, the grandfather Brahma became absolved from sins and attained all purity. Brahma in heaven brought beautiful flowers and offered them to Visnu while worship.

## \|\| 93.17 \|\|

*svarge sahasraṃ sa tu yojanānāṃ viṣṇoḥ pramāṇena hi vāmano 'bhūt tatrāsya śakraḥ pracakāra pūjāṃ svayaṃbhuvastulyaguṇāṃ maharṣe \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Visnu in heaven extended to one thousand yojanas in his dwarf form. О hermit! Indra worshipped him there with fragrant producing beautiful flowers like Brahma.

## \|\| 93.18 \|\|

*etat tavoktaṃ bhagavāṃstrivikramaścakāra yad devahitaṃ mahātmā \|*  
*rasātalastho ditijaścakāra yattacchṛṇuṣvādya vadāmi vipra \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O Brahmin! I have enunciated the complete episode of sending Bali in Sutala and return of ruling to Indra. Whatever Bali had did in Sutala, I am going to describe the same today. Please, listen it carefully.

## Chapter 94. Praise of Vamana by Prahlada

## \|\| 94.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*gatvā rasātalaṃ daityo mahārhamaṇicitritam \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭisopānaṃ kārayāmāsa vai puram \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- Going to the nether world the demon equipped the city with staircases of pure crystal and decorated it with costly gems.

## \|\| 94.2 \|\|

*tatra madhye suvistīrmaḥ prāsādo vajravedikaḥ \|*  
*muktājālāntaradvāro nirmito viśvakarmaṇā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Visvakarma constructed a palace in the centre of that city having extended altars reinforced like thunderbolt and a gate studded with pearls fairly trimmed.

## \|\| 94.3 \|\|

*tatrāste vividhān bhogān bhuñjan divyān sa mānuṣān \|*  
*nāmnā vindhyāvalītyevaṃ bhāryāsya dayitābhavat \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Bali began residing there enjoying the worldly and divine comforts and luxuries. Vindhyavali was his beloved wife.

## \|\| 94.4 \|\|

*yuvatīnāṃ sahasrasya pradhānā śīlamaṇḍitā \|*  
*tayā saha mahātejā reme vairocanirmune \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О sage! She was a modest lady pioneer to several thousand women there. Bali, the son of mighty Virocana enjoyed intercourse with her.

## \|\| 94.5 \|\|

*bhogāsaktasya daityasya vasataḥ sutale tadā \|*  
*daityatejoharaḥ prāptaḥ capātāle vai sudarśanaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. When he was thus dwelling in Sutala, steeded in enjoyment, one day there reached Sudarsana-cakra, the killer of demons pride.

## \|\| 94.6 \|\|

*cakre praviṣṭe pātālaṃ dānavānāṃ pure mahān \|*  
*babhai halahalāśabdaḥ kṣubhitārṇavasaṃnibhaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. With entrance of that Cakra in nether, the city of demons, there roused a loud, commotion like an agitated ocean in that city of demons.

## \|\| 94.7 \|\|

*taṃ ca śrutvā mahāśabdaṃ baliḥ khaṅgaṃ samādade \|*  
*āḥ kimetaditītthañca papracchāsurapuṅgavaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Having heard that loud noise, king Bali, drew his sword in hand and asked- "Hay! What is it?"

## \|\| 94.8 \|\|

*tato vindhyāvalī prāha sāntvayantī nijaṃ patim \|*  
*kośe khaṅgaṃ samāveśya dharmapatnī śucivratā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Vindhyavali, his chaste and religious queen consoled him, put the sword within scabbard and said-

## \|\| 94.9 \|\|

*etad bhagavataścakraṃ daityacakrakṣayaṅkaram \|*  
*saṃpūjanīyaṃ daityendra vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*ityevamuktvā cārvaṅgī sārghapātrā viniryayau \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. It is the adorable Cakra of god Vamana who is capable to kill the commune of demons. With these words, that pretty-limbed lady went out with arghya etc.

## \|\| 94.10 \|\|

*athābhyāgāt sahasrāraṃ viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam \|*  
*tato 'surapatiḥ prahvaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo mune \|*  
*saṃpūjya vidhivaccakramidaṃ stotramudīrayat \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the meantime, Sudarsana-cakra having one thousand spikes reached there rotating. О sage! Bali worshipped that Cakra with folded hands and politely. He then recited this psalm-

## \|\| 94.11 \|\|

*baliruvāca \|*  
*namasyāmi hareścakraṃ daityacakravidāraṇam \|*  
*sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasrābhaṃ sahasrāraṃ sunirmalam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Bali said-1 salute Sudarsana-cakra of Visnu the sacrosanct god having one thousand beams, one thousand light rays and one thousand spikes.

## \|\| 94.12-14 \|\|

*namasyāmi hareścakraṃ yasya nābhyāṃ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tuṇḍe triśūladhṛk śarva ārāmūle mahādrayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*areṣu saṃsthitā devāḥ sendrāḥ sārkāḥ sapāvakāḥ \|*  
*jave yasya sthito vāyurāpogniḥ pṛthivī nabhaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*āraprānteṣu jīmūtāḥ saudāminyṛkṣatārakāḥ \|*  
*bāhmato munayo yasya bālakhilyādayastathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. I salute that cakra of Visnu in whose navel, there is Pitamaha, trident-holding Mahadeva on the top, great mountain in the root of spikes, Indra sun, fire etc. gods in spikes, wind, water, fire, earth and ether in motion, cloud, lightening, constellations and galaxy on its edges and Balakhilya etc. sages are existed in its exterior part.

## \|\| 94.15-17 \|\|

*tamāyudhavaraṃ vande vāsudevasya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*yanme pāpaṃ śarīrotthaṃ vāgjaṃ mānasameva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tanme dahasva dīptāṃśo viṣṇoścakra sudarśana \|*  
*yanme kulodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ paitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ tathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tanme harasva tarasā namaste acyutāyudha \|*  
*ādhayo mama naśyantu vyādhayo yāntu saṃkṣayam \|*  
*tvannāmakīrtanāc cakra duritaṃ yātu saṃkṣayam \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. I salute that supreme weapon of Vasudeva with keen devotion. О Sudarsana-cakra, you are the radiated fraction of Sri Visnu. Please, absolve my physical, mental and the evils committed by speech. О weapon of Acyuta! Please, remove immediately all sins committed in my paternal and maternal families. I salute you. May the ills and calamities stuck to me removed. О Cakra! My eyes at you would absolve me from sins. I recite psalm for you.

## \|\| 94.18 \|\|

*saṃsmaran puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāsanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. With these words, the wise Bali worshipped the discus with sheer reverence and summoned Pundarikaksa to his mind.

## \|\| 94.19 \|\|

*pūjitaṃ balinā cakraṃ kṛtvā nistejaso 'surān \|*  
*niścakrāmātha pātālād viṣuve dakṣime mune \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О sage! The discus so honoured by Bali made all demons lost of splendour, came up from nether and moved towards south.

## \|\| 94.20 \|\|

*sudarśane nirgate tu balirviklavatāṃ gataḥ \|*  
*paramāmāpadaṃ prāpya sasmāra svapitāmaham \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. When Sudarsana disappeared from his sight, Bali became anxious. Having gross calamity he guessed of, no other option but he thought better to summon his grand father.

## \|\| 94.21 \|\|

*sa cāpi saṃsmṛtaḥ prāptaḥ sutalaṃ dānaveśvaraḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tasthau mahātejāḥ sārghapātro balistadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. With that summon, Prahlada having eminent power of intuition, appeared before Bali in Sutala. The mighty warrior Bali stood immediately up with arghya in his hands.

## \|\| 94.22 \|\|

*tamarcya vidhinā brahman pituḥ pitaramīśvaram \|*  
*kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Brahmana! Bali gave reverence and worship to his noble grandfather and requested him with folded hands.

## \|\| 94.23 \|\|

*saṃsmṛto 'si mayā tāta suviṣaṇṇena cetasā tanme hitaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca śreyogryaṃ vada tāta me \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. О grand-father! I have summoned you with most desperated heart. Hence, suggest me what is advantageous and salutary, and the highest blessing for me.

## \|\| 94.24 \|\|

*kiṃ kāryaṃ tāta saṃsāre vasatā puruṣoṇa hi \|*  
*kṛtena yena vai nāsya bandhaḥ samupajāyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О grand-father! What a man should do in worldly living which may keep him free from bondage?

## \|\| 94.25 \|\|

*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ narāṇāmalpacetasām \|*  
*taraṇe yo bhavet potastanme vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Kindly, tell me the raft capable of crossing over, for people of little understanding, plunged into the ocean of wordly life.

## \|\| 94.26 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*etadvacanamākarṇya tatpautrād dānaveśvaraḥ \|*  
*vicintya prāha vacanaṃ saṃsāre yadvitaṃ param \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Pulastya said- “Demon king (Prahlada) thought for a while and then made a statement benevolent for living in the world.”

## \|\| 94.27 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca \|*  
*sādhu dānavaśārdūla yatte jātā matistviyam \|*  
*pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ te 'dya tathāneyeṣāṃ hitaṃ bale \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Prahlada said- “O great demon! You are really thankful as such wit has arisen in your mind.” О Bali! I say now the things good for you and all others living in this world.

## \|\| 94.28 \|\|

*bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvāndvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām \|*  
*viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāmaplāvānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The people immersed in worldly ocean, striken by the wind of opposite conditions, bent with the over burden of defending the sons, daughters and wife, engrossed with other worldly affairs have only a boat of Visnu to shelter and row across it without any disruption.

## \|\| 94.29 \|\|

*ye saṃśritā harimanantamanādimadhyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ śubhadaṃ vareṇyam \|*  
*śuddhaṃ khagendragamanaṃ kamalālayeśaṃ te dharmarājakaraṇaṃ na viśanti dhīrāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The people who have resorted to Narayana, beginningless, middleless and endless, giver of auspiciousness, most distinguished, bestower of good furtune, rider of Garuda, husband of Laksmi, chiwf of the gods do not enter the court of king Yama.

## \|\| 94.30 \|\|

*svapuruṣamabhivīkṣya pāśahastaṃ vadati yamaḥ kila tasya karṇamūle \|*  
*parihara madhusūdanaprannān prabhurahamanyanṛṇāṃ na vaiṣṇavānām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Yamaraja whispers into the ears of his messenger stood before him with pasa in his hands- “Leave them who betake themselves to Madhusudana. I am sovereign to other people and seldom to Vaisnava.”

## \|\| 94.31 \|\|

*tathānyaduktaṃ narasattamena ikṣvākuṇā bhaktiyutena nūnam \|*  
*ye viṣṇubhaktāḥ puruṣāḥ pṛthivyāṃ yamasya te nirviṣayā bhavanti \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Besides it, Iksvaku, the most excellent man, endowed with devotion had said that “devotees to Visnu on earth are outside the jurisdiction of Yama. ”

## \|\| 94.32 \|\|

*sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ yattadarpitam \|*  
*tāveva kevalaṃ śalāghyau yau tatpūjākarau karau \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. That is verily the tongue which recites the psalm to Visnu, Citta (Mind) is admirable if it is engrossed with Visnu and the hands admirable are those through which god Visnu is worshipped.

## \|\| 94.33 \|\|

*nūnaṃ na tau karau proktau vṛkṣaśākhāgrapallavau \|*  
*na yau pūjituṃ śaktau haripādāmbujadvayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The hands that do not worship the lotus feet of Hari are not hands but the fore buds of a tree branch.

## \|\| 94.34 \|\|

*nūnaṃ tatkaṇṭhaśālūkamathavā pratijihvakā \|*  
*rogovānyo na sā jihvā yā na vakti harerguṇān \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The tongue not describing the gracious deeds of god is not tongue and it is only Kantasaluka (throat of a frog), Pratijihva or any other type of a disease of throat.

## \|\| 94.35 \|\|

*śocanīyaḥ sa bandhūnāṃ jīvannapi mṛto naraḥ \|*  
*yaḥ pādapaṅkajaṃ viṣṇorna pūjayati bhaktitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The man not worshipping the lotus feet of god Visnu with reverence is like a dead man inspite of living and a scar like for his siblings.

## \|\| 94.36 \|\|

*ye narā vāsudevasya satataṃ pūjane ratāḥ \|*  
*mṛtā api na śocyāste satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. I say solemnly that the people engrossed with the worship of Vasudeva regularly don't derogate even after their death,

## \|\| 94.37 \|\|

*śārīraṃ mānasaṃ vāgjaṃ mūrtāmūrtaṃ carācaram \|*  
*dṛśyaṃ spṛsyamadṛśyañca tatsarvaṃ keśavātmakam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. All matters related to body, mind, speech, intangible, tangible, movable, immovable, visible and invisible are in the form of Visnu.

## \|\| 94.38 \|\|

*yenārcito hi bhagavān caturdhā vai trivikramaḥ \|*  
*tenārcitā na saṃdeho lokāḥ sāmaradānavāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The people engrossed with worshipping Trivikrama (Vamana) god have definitely worshipped all lokas including gods and demons.

## \|\| 94.39 \|\|

*yatā ratnāni jaladherasaṃkhyeyāni putraka \|*  
*tathā guṇā hi devasya tvasaṃkhyātāstu cakriṇaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О son! As the ocean bears countless gems, the properties (gunas) of Visnu too are countless.

## \|\| 94.40 \|\|

*ye śaṅkhacakrābjakaraṃ saśārṅgiṇaṃ khagendraketuṃ varadaṃ śriyaḥ patim \|*  
*samāśrayante bhavabhītināśanaṃ saṃsāragarte na patanti te punaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The people sheltering to Sripati, the great giver, holder of conch, discus, lotus and sarnga bow in hands, eagle rider, destroyer of worldly fears, seldom fall in the worldly trench.

## \|\| 94.41 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ manasi govindo nivāsī satataṃ bale \|*  
*na te paribhavaṃ yānti na mṛtyorudvijanti ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О Bali! The people whose hearts are made residence of Govinda always, do not suffer disrespect and are not afraid of death.

## \|\| 94.42 \|\|

*devaṃ sārṅgadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ ye prapannāḥ parāyaṇam \|*  
*na teṣāṃ yamasālokyaṃ na ca te narakaukasaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The best shelter, god Visnu, the holder of sarnga bow if resorted, the people have not to fall in hell or go to the abode of Yama.

## \|\| 94.43 \|\|

*na tāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvanti śrutiśāstraviśāradāḥ \|*  
*viprā dānavaśārdūla viṣṇubhaktā vrajanti yām \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О great demon! The position attained by devotees to Visnu is seldom achieved by Brahmins learned to Vedas and scriptures.

## \|\| 94.44 \|\|

*yā gatirdaityaśārdūla hatānāṃ tu mahāhave \|*  
*tato 'dikāṃ gatiṃ yānti viṣṇubhaktā narottamāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О chivalrous demon! The devotees to god Visnu attain better position than the people who are killed in great battles.

## \|\| 94.45 \|\|

*yā gatirdharmaśīlānāṃ sāttvikānāṃ mahātmanām \|*  
*sā gatirgaditā daitya bhagavatsevināmapi \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О demon! The devotees to god attain the position as attained by religion abiding, high- souled and greatmen.

## \|\| 94.46 \|\|

*sarvāvāsaṃ vāsudevaṃ sūkṣmamavyaktavigraham \|*  
*praviśanti mahātmānaṃ tadbhaktā nānyacetasaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The people exclusively devoted to god enter in subtle, unmanifested, great-souled Vasudeva having inexpressible body.

## \|\| 94.47 \|\|

*ananyamanaso bhaktyā ye namasyanti keśavam \|*  
*śucayaste mahātmānastīrthabhūtā bhavanti te \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The people saluting Kesava exclusively with devotion are always holy and high- souled.

## \|\| 94.48-50 \|\|

*gacchan tiṣṭhan svapan jāgrat pibannaścannabhīkṣṇaśaḥ \|*  
*dhyāyan nārāyaṇaṃ yastu na tato 'nyo 'sti puṇyabhāk \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhaṃ khaḍgaparaśuṃ bhavabandhasamucchidam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ saṃsāre na punarbhavet \|*  
*kṣetreṣu vasate nityaṃ krīḍannāste 'mitadyutiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*āsīnaḥ sarvadeheṣu karmabhirna sa badhyate \|*  
*yeṣāṃ viṣṇuḥ priyontyante viṣṇoḥ satataṃ priyāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. The man who keeps his mind focused on Narayana while walking, standing, sleeping, awaking and taking anything, receives blessing of god at every moment. Bowing head with reverence before Vaikuntha god holding sword and axe, does not again leaves a man to rotate with the cycle of birth and death. A devotee to Krsna living in his territory and enjoying all worldly pleasures however, attached to the material things yet seldom fall in the bondage of Karmas. The people who love Visnu are loved by Visnu always.

## \|\| 94.51 \|\|

*na te punaḥ sambhavanti tadbhaktāstatparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*dhyāyed dāmodaraṃ yastu bhaktinamror'cayeta vā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The devotees to Damodara, the sheltered or who pray them never take birth again in this material world.

## \|\| 94.52 \|\|

*na sa saṃsārapaṅke 'smin majjate dānaveśvara \|*  
*kalyamutthāya ye bhaktyā smaranti madhusūdanam \|*  
*stuvantyapyabhiśṛṇvanti durgaṇyatitaranti te \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О demon king! “The people remembering Madhusudana early in morning do not immerse in the mire of worldly life. The people reciting his psalm and listening to his gracious deeds easily cross the Castles.

## \|\| 94.53 \|\|

*harivākyāmṛtaṃ pītvā vimalaiḥ śrotrabhājanaiḥ \|*  
*prahṛṣyati mano yeṣāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The people feeling cheers in mind while sipping the nectar of the words recited about Hari through the ear vessels, easily cross all difficulties.

## \|\| 94.54 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ cakragadāpāṇau bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī \|*  
*te yānti niyataṃ sthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The people keeping stable devotion on Visnu with cakra and mace in his hands definitely go at the place of Yogesvara Hari.

## \|\| 94.55 \|\|

*viṣṇukarmaprasaktānāṃ bhaktānāṃ yā parā gatiḥ \|*  
*sā tu janmasahasreṇa na tapobhiravāpyate \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The supreme position as achieved by the devotees engross with the service to Visnu cannot be achieved even when a penance for the period covering one thousand births is observed.

## \|\| 94.56 \|\|

*kiṃ japyaistasya mantrairvā kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimāśramaiḥ \|*  
*yasya nāsti parā bhaktiḥ satataṃ madhusūdane \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The people inspite of observing japa, hymn, penance and asramas get no advantage if their mind is void of continuos devotion to Madhusudana.

## \|\| 94.57 \|\|

*vṛthā yajñā vṛtā vedā vṛthā dānaṃ vṛthā śrutam \|*  
*vṛthā tapaśca kīrtiśca yo dveṣṭi madhusūdanam \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The people envious of Madhusudana never receive any blessing from yajna, Vedas, donation, knowledge, penance and fame observed, acquired or earned by them.

## \|\| 94.58 \|\|

*kiṃ tasya bahurbharmantrairbhaktiryasya janārdane \|*  
*namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. As the only hymn "Namo Narayanaya (Saluation to Narayana)" bestows with all essence, there is no use of reciting several hymns for devotees to Janardana.

## \|\| 94.59 \|\|

*viṣṇureva gatiryoṣāṃ kutasteṣāṃ parājayaḥ \|*  
*yeṣāmindīvaraśyāmo hṛdayastho janārdanaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. How can there be their discomfiture whose shelter is Visnu alone and in whose heart dwells the lotus-blue Janardana?

## \|\| 94.60 \|\|

*sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ prabhum \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya sarvakarmāṇi kārayet \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. All acts should be performed after saluting the Auspicious of the Auspicious, the most worthy, the boon-granting lord Narayana.

## \|\| 94.61 \|\|

*viṣṭayo vyatipātāśca ye 'nye durnītisambhavāḥ \|*  
*te nāma smaraṇādviṣṇornāsaṃ yānti mahāsura \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. О chivalrous demon! Vistis, Vytipata and all other calamities originated from the malicious feelings are destroyed merely when Visnu, the pious name is recited.

## \|\| 94.62 \|\|

*tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthakoṭiśatāni ca \|*  
*nārāyaṇapraṇāmasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The hundred and thousand crore holy places are not equal to the sixteenth fraction (kala) of saluting Narayana.

## \|\| 94.63 \|\|

*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca \|*  
*tāni sarvāṇyavāpnoti viṣṇornāmānukīrtanāt \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. All holy places and sacred temples as found in whole earth are only visited when the man recites psalms of Visnu.

## \|\| 94.64 \|\|

*prāpnuvanti na tāṃllokān vratino vā tapasvinaḥ \|*  
*prāpyante ye tu kṛṣṇasya namaskāraparairna raiḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The lokas (worlds) obtained by people saluting to Sri Krsna are all obtained by virtue of reciting the sacred name of Visnu.

## \|\| 94.65 \|\|

*yo 'pyanyadevatābhakto mithyārcayati keśavam \|*  
*so\|'pi gacchati sādhūnāṃ sthānaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ mahat \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The man devotee to other god but falsely worshipping Kesava too achieves the supreme place of saints who have executed noble deeds.

## \|\| 94.66 \|\|

*sātatyena hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayitvā tu yatphalam \|*  
*sucīrṇatapasāṃ nṝṇāṃ tatā phalaṃ na kadācana \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The fruit obtained as a result of regular worship of Hrsikesa, cannot be obtained even by people observing gross penance.

## \|\| 94.67 \|\|

*trisandhyaṃ padmānābhaṃ tu ye smaranti sumedhasaḥ \|*  
*te labhantyupavāsasya phalaṃ nāsatyatra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The wise people who summons to their mind Padmanabha in three sandhyas (morning, noon and evening) undoubtedly receive the blessing as for observing fasts.

## \|\| 94.68 \|\|

*satataṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā harimarcaya \|*  
*tatprasādāt parāṃ siddhiṃ bale prāpsyasi śāśvatīm \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. О Bali! Do worship of Hari regularly as prescribed in scriptures with its procedure. You will achieve perpetual and enduring success with his pleasure.

## \|\| 94.69 \|\|

*tanmanā bhava tadbhaktastadyājī taṃ namaskuru \|*  
*tamevāśritya deveśaṃ sukhaṃ prāpyasi putraka \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. О son! Salute him by submitting yourself as Tanmana, Tadbhakta and reciting psalm of god Visnu. You will attain real pleasure under shelter of that god of gods.

## \|\| 94.70 \|\|

*ādyaṃ hyanantamajaraṃ harimavyayaṃ ca ye vai smarantyaharaharnṛvarā bhuvisthāḥ \|*  
*sarvatragaṃ śubhadaṃ brahmamayaṃ purāṇam te yānti vaiṣṇavapadaṃ dhruvamakṣayañca \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The greatmen residing on earth achieve undeviated Vaisnava position by virtue of summoning day and night imperishable, primeval, endless, unchanging, omni-reach, auspicious Hari with access everywhere and consisting of the Veda, attain the everlasting and unfailing position of Visnu.

## \|\| 94.71 \|\|

*ye mānavā vigatarāgaparāparajñā nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ satataṃ smaranti \|*  
*te dhautapāṇḍurapuṭā iva rājahaṃsāḥ saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The people detached to worldly affairs and knower of supreme Brahma, who call Narayana, the preceptor of gods regularly, they cross the worldly ocean like flamingos having white wings.

## \|\| 94.72 \|\|

*dhyāyanti ye satatamacyutamīśitāraṃ niṣkalmaṣaṃ pravarapadmadalāyatākṣam \|*  
*dhyānena tena hatakilbaṣavedanāste mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na punaḥ pibanti \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The people who focus their mind continuously on Acyuta, having best lotus eyes, innocent and regulator, they do not again suck the breast of mother for milk because their sins are fully absolved by the grace of god.

## \|\| 94.73 \|\|

*ye kīrtayanti varadaṃ varapadmanābhaṃ śaṅkhābjacakravaracāpagadāsihastam \|*  
*padmālayāvadanapaṅkajaṣaṭpadākhyaṃ nūnaṃ prayānti sadanaṃ madhughātinaste \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. The people reciting psalm of Padmanabha, the great giver, holder of conch, lotus, cakra, bow, mace and sword in his hands, keen to the lotus body of Laksmi, definitely attain the abode of Madhusudana.

## \|\| 94.74 \|\|

*śṛṇvanti ye bhaktiparā manuṣyāḥ saṃkīrtyamānaṃ bhagavantamādyam \|*  
*te muktapāpāḥ sukhino bhavanti yathāmṛtaprāśanatarpitāstu \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. The people having devotion absolve from sins and enjoy pleasure by listening to psalm of foremost god like the creature getting satisfaction after food.

## \|\| 94.75 \|\|

*tasmād dhyānaṃ smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ vā nāmnāṃ śravaṇaṃ paṭhatāṃ sajjanānām \|*  
*kāryaṃ viṣṇoḥ śraddadhānairmanuṣyaiḥ pūjātulyaṃ tat praśaṃsanti devā \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. The devotee people therefore, listen to the names of god Visnu from the people who meditate, summon, recite or pray Visnu. The gods appreciate such people adorable to all.

## \|\| 94.76 \|\|

*bāhyaistathāntaḥkaraṇairaviklavairyo nārcayet keśavamīśitaram \|*  
*puṣpaiśca patrairjalapallavādibhirnūnaṃ sa muṣṭo vidhitaskareṇa \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The man who does not worship Kesava, the controller by offering flowers, leaves, water and fragrances with healthy sensories internal and external bath, it should be considered about him that a smuggler in the form of method (vidhi) has looted him.

## Chapter 95. The method of worshipping of Visnu narrated by Prahlada to Bali

## \|\| 95.1 \|\|

*baliruvāca \|*  
*bhavatā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ samārādhya janārdanam \|*  
*yā gatiḥ prāpyate loke tāṃ me vaktumihārhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bali said- You have described all whatever was enquired by me. Please, explain now the position obtained as a result of worshipping god Janardana.

## \|\| 95.2 \|\|

*kenārcanena devasya prītiḥ samupajāyate \|*  
*kāni dānāni śastāni prīṇanāya jagadguroḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. What type of worship arouses love for Vasudeva? In order to please Jagadguru (preceptor of universe) the donations prescribed need explanation here so that I could understand then properly.

## \|\| 95.3 \|\|

*upavāsādikaṃ kāryaṃ kasyāṃ tithyāṃ mahodayam \|*  
*kāni puṇyāni śastāni viṣṇostuṣṭipradāni vai \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Kindly, tell the best day for fast which could endow with great success to the devotee. Classify please, the noble deeds favourite to god Visnu.

## \|\| 95.4 \|\|

*yaccānyadapi karttavyaṃ hṛṣṭarūpairanālasaiḥ \|*  
*tadapyaśeṣaṃ daityendra mamākhyātumihārhasi \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О demon king! Please, tell me further, other acts worth executing with fresh mental disposition and by leaving aside the laziness.

## \|\| 95.5 \|\|

*prahlāda uvāca \|*  
*śraddadhānairbhaktiparairyānyuddiśya janārdanam \|*  
*bale dānāni dīyante tānūcurmunayo 'kṣayān \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Prahlada said- О Bali! The donations given for the purpose of pleasing god Visnu are called Aksaya (undepleting) by sages. These should be made with keen devotion and obeisance.

## \|\| 95.6 \|\|

*tā eva tithayaḥ śastā yāsvabhyarcya jagatpatim \|*  
*taccittastanmayo bhūtvā upavāsī naro bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The best, days are those in which the man observes fast by focusing his heart and mind on Visnu after worship.

## \|\| 95.7 \|\|

*pūjiteṣu dvijendreṣu pūjitaḥ syājjanārdanaḥ \|*  
*etān dviṣanti ye mūḍhāste yānti narakaṃ dhruvam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Janardana is automatically worshipped when Brahmins are respected. The fools keeping jealousy of them definitely fall in hell.

## \|\| 95.8 \|\|

*tānarcayennaro bhaktyā brāhmaṇān viṣṇutatparaḥ \|*  
*evamāha hariḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇā māmakī tanuḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A man devotee to Visnu should honour Brahmins with keen devotion. God Visnu during long past had declared himself that Brahmins are his body.

## \|\| 95.9 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyo budho vāpyabudho 'pi vā \|*  
*so 'pi divyā tanurviṣṇostasmāt tāmarcayennaraḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Either Brahmin is scholar or illiterate, one should not humiliate him. He is the divine body of Visnu. Hence, he should be honoured.

## \|\| 95.10 \|\|

*tānyeva ca praśastāni kusumāni mahāsura \|*  
*yāni syurvarṇayuktāni rasagandhayutāni ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O great demon! The best flowers for worship should be consisting of colour, essence and fragrance.

## \|\| 95.11 \|\|

*viśeṣataḥ pravakṣyāmi puṣpāṇi tithayastathā \|*  
*dānāni ca praśastāni mādhavaprīṇanāya tu \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. I describe now the particular flowers, days and donations stated for the pleasure of Madhava.

## \|\| 95.12-14 \|\|

*jātī śatāhvā sumanāḥ kundaṃ bahupuṭaṃ tathā \|*  
*bāṇañca campakāśokaṃ karavīraṃ ca yūthikā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pāribhadraṃ pāṭalā ca bakulaṃ giriśālinī \|*  
*tilakaṃ ca japākusumaṃ pītakaṃ nāgaraṃ tvapi \|\| 13 \|\|*

*etāni hi praśastāni kusumānyacyutārcane \|*  
*surabhīṇi tathānyāni varjayitvā tu ketakīm \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. The flowers best for worship of Janardana are- Malati, Satahva, Sumana, Kunda, Bahuputa, Bana, Campaka, Asoka, Karvira, Kanaira, Yuthika (Juhl), Paribhadra, Patala, Bakula (maulasiri, Girisalini, Tilaka, Japa, Pitaka and Nagara.  
Apart from above, other flowers having perfume too are considered best barring Ketaki flowers.

## \|\| 95.15 \|\|

*bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ patraṃ bhṛṅgamṛgāṅkayoḥ \|*  
*tamālāmalakīpatraṃ śastaṃ keśavapūjane \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The best leaves for worship of Kesava are- Bilvapatra, Samipatra, Bhriga and Mrgankapatra, Tamala and leaves of Amalaki.

## \|\| 95.16 \|\|

*yeṣāmapi hica puṣpāṇi praśastānyacyutārcane \|*  
*pallavānyapi teṣāṃ stuḥ patrāṇyarcāvidhau hareḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The leaves of flower plants whose flowers are used for worship of Acyuta are considered equally good for worship.

## \|\| 95.17 \|\|

*vīrudhāṃ ca pravālena barhiṣā cārcayettathā \|*  
*nānārūpaiścāmbubhavaiḥ kamalendīvarādibhiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Visnu should be worshipped by offering buds of Virudhas and Kusa, several species of lotus growing in water and Indivara etc.

## \|\| 95.18 \|\|

*pravālaiḥ śucibhiḥ ślakṣṇairjalaprakṣālitairbale \|*  
*vanaspatīnāmarcyeta tathā dūrvāgrapallavaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Bali! Visnu should be worshipped by offering the buds cleaned by water, fresh and smooth of vegetables and the top side leaves of Durva (long live plant).

## \|\| 95.19 \|\|

*candanenānulimpeta kuṅkumena prayatnanataḥ \|*  
*uśīrapadmakābhyāṃ ca tathā kālīyakādinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Sandal, Kunkuma, Usira, Padmaka (lotus) and Sandal-wood etc. should be smeared on the icon of Visnu.

## \|\| 95.20 \|\|

*mahiṣākhyaṃ kaṇaṃ dāru sihlakaṃ sāgaruṃ sitā \|*  
*śaṅkhaṃ jātīphalaṃ śrīśe dhūpāni syuḥ priyāṇi vai \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The grain called Mahisa, Daru, Sihlaka, Aguru (aloe wood), Sita, conch and Jatiphala made, fragrance (Dhupa) is favourite to Visnu.

## \|\| 95.21 \|\|

*haviṣā saṃskṛtā ye tu yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ \|*  
*tilamudgādayo māṣā vrīhayaśca priyā hareḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Barley, wheat, sali rice, seasmum, green gram, urada and cereals are favourite to Hari.

## \|\| 95.22 \|\|

*godānāni pavitrāṇi bhūmidānāni cānagha \|*  
*vastrānnasvarṇadānāni prītaye madhughātinaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Sinless one! The slayer of Madhu demon is favourite of cow, sacred land, garments food and gold in donation.

## \|\| 95.23 \|\|

*māghamāse tilā deyāstiladhenuśca dānava \|*  
*indhanādīni ca tathā mādhavaprīṇanāya tu \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O demon! Sesamum in the month Magha (January), Tiladhenu and fuel etc. should be donated.

## \|\| 95.24 \|\|

*phālgune vrīhayo mudgā vastrakṛṣṇājinādikam \|*  
*govindaprīṇanārthāya dātavyaṃ puruṣarṣabhaiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The great man should donate rice, green gram; garments and hide of black stage in the month of Phalguna (February) for the pleasure of Govinda.

## \|\| 95.25 \|\|

*caitre citrāṇi vastrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca \|*  
*viṣṇoḥ prītyarthametāni deyāni brāhmaṇeṣvatha \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Garments of different designs, bed and seats should be donated to Brahmins in the month of Caitra (April) for the pleasure of god Visnu.

## \|\| 95.26 \|\|

*gandhamālyāni deyāni vaiśākhe surabhīṇi vai \|*  
*deyāni dvijamukhyebhyo madhusūdanatuṣṭaye \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Fragrant things and garlands should be donated to learned Brahmins in the month of Vaisakha for the pleasure of Madhusudana.

## \|\| 95.27 \|\|

*udakumbhāmbudhenuṃ ca tālavṛntaṃ sucandanam \|*  
*trivikramasya prītyarthaṃ dātavyaṃ sādhubhiḥ sadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. A gentleman should donate water pitcher, Jaladhenu, fan made up ofTala and high quality sandal for the pleasure of Trivikrama to Brahmins. It should be done in the month of Jyestha (May).

## \|\| 95.28 \|\|

*uvānadyugalaṃ chatraṃ lavaṇāmalakādikam \|*  
*āṣāḍhe vāmanaprītyai dātavyāni tu bhaktitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A pair of shoes, umbrella, salt and amalaka etc. should be donated in the month of Asadha (July) for the pleasure of Vamana (dwarf).

## \|\| 95.29 \|\|

*ghṛtaṃ ca kṣīrakumbhāśca ghṛtadhenuphalāni ca \|*  
*śrāvaṇe śrīdharaprītyai dātavyāni vipaścitā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. A wise man should donate Brahmins milk pitcher, Ghrtadhenu and fruits on the month of Sravana (August) for the pleasure of god Sridhara.

## \|\| 95.30 \|\|

*māsi bhādrapade dadyāt pāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣī \|*  
*hṛṣīkeśaprīṇanārthaṃ lavaṇaṃ saguḍodanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Sweet dish, honey, ghee, salt and food mixed with jaggery should be donated to Brahmins for the pleasure of Hrsikesa in the month of Bhadrapada (September).

## \|\| 95.31 \|\|

*tilāsturaṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dadhi tāmrāyasādikam \|*  
*prītyarthaṃ padmanābhasya deyamāśvayuje naraiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The people should donate to Brahmins scsamum, horse, bull, curd, copper and iron etc. for the pleasure of Padmanabha in the month of Asvina (October).

## \|\| 95.32 \|\|

*rajataṃ kanakaṃ dīpān maṇimuktāphalādikam \|*  
*dāmodarasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pradadyāt kārtike naraḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A man should donate silver, gold, lamp, gem, pearl and fruits etc. for the pleasure of Damodara in the month of Karttika (November).

## \|\| 95.33 \|\|

*kharoṣṭrāśvatarān nāgān yānayugyamajāvikam \|*  
*dātvayaṃ keśavaprītyai māsi mārgaśire naraiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The people should donate donkey, camel, mule, elephant, goat pulling carriage and the sheep for the pleasure of Kesava in the month of Margasirsa (December).

## \|\| 95.34 \|\|

*prāsādanagarādīni gṛhaprāvaraṇādikam \|*  
*nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pauṣe deyāni bhaktitaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The palace, city, home and pravarana etc. should be donated in Pausa month (January) for the pleasure of Narayana.

## \|\| 95.35 \|\|

*dāsīdāsamalaṅkāramannaṃ ṣaḍrasasaṃyutam \|*  
*puruṣottamasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ pradeyaṃ sārvakālikam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The attendants, maid servants, ornaments and food consisting of six essences should be donated all time for the pleasure of Purusottama.

## \|\| 95.36 \|\|

*yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiñcidyadvāpyasti śuci gṛhe \|*  
*tattadvi deyaṃ prītyarthaṃ devadevāya cakriṇe \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The most favourite thing or purest thing lying at home should be donated to Brahmins for the pleasure of the god of gods holding Cakra.

## \|\| 95.37 \|\|

*yaḥ kārayenmandiraṃ keśavasya puṇyāṃllokān sa jayecchāśvatān vai \|*  
*dattvārāmān puṣpaphalābhipannān bhogān bhuṅkte kāmātaḥ ślāghanīyān \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The man constructing the temple of Kesava receives continuously the higher positions. The man donating gardens enriched with flowers and fruits ensure rare luxuries for a man who donate them for the pleasure of god Visnu.

## \|\| 95.38 \|\|

*pitāmahasya purataḥ kulānyaṣṭau tu yāni ca \|*  
*tārayedātmanā sārdhaṃ viṣṇormandirakārakaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The man who constructs the temple of Visnu, absolves the sins and keeps at pleasure as much as eight generations precedent to his grandfather.

## \|\| 95.39 \|\|

*imāś ca pitaro daitya gāthā gāyanti yoginaḥ \|*  
*purato yadusiṃhasya jyāmaghasya tapasvinaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О demon! ancestors had told this magnificence to an ascetic Jyamagha, the great Yogi bom in Yadu clan.

## \|\| 95.40 \|\|

*api naḥ sa kule kaścid viṣṇubhakto bhaviṣyati \|*  
*harimandirakartā yo bhaviṣyati śicivrataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Whether any descendant to us shall bom in our successive clans. Who will construct the temple of Hari during his life time?

## \|\| 95.41 \|\|

*api naḥ santatau jāyed viṣṇvālayavilepanam \|*  
*sammārjanaṃ ca dharmātmā kariṣyati ca bhaktitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Whether any man in our children (generation) shall bom for brooming at the place of temple and smear fragrance on the icon of Visnu.

## \|\| 95.42 \|\|

*api naḥ santatau jāto dhvajaṃ cakeśavamandire \|*  
*dāsyate devadevāya dīpaṃ puṣpānulepanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Whether any man donating flag in the temple of Kesava and offering lamp, flowers and fragrance to smear on the god of gods shall bom anytime in our family (descendants).

## \|\| 95.43 \|\|

*mahāpātakayukto vā pātakī copapātakī \|*  
*vimuktapāpo bhavati viṣṇvāyatanacitrakṛt \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The man heinous miscreant, miscreant of involved in petty offences absolves them all when he trims the temple of Visnu.

## \|\| 95.44 \|\|

*itthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpatisattamaḥ \|*  
*cakārāyatanaṃ bhūmyāṃ khyaṃ ca limpatāsura \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. O Demon! That king constructed a temple on the earth when he heard such pronouncement from ancestors and used to smear fragrance to the icon of Visnu.

## \|\| 95.45 \|\|

*vibhūtibhiḥ keśavasya keśavārādhane rataḥ \|*  
*nānādhātuvikāraiśca pañcavarṇaiśca citrakaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. He began worshipping god Kesava in various forms designed, the objects made of several kind metals and fire colour pictures.

## \|\| 95.46 \|\|

*dadau dīpāni vidhivad vāsudevālaye bale \|*  
*sugandhitailapūrṇāni ghṛtapūrṇāni ca svayam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O Bali! He himself donated a lamp full of ghee and perfumed oil in orderly manner as prescribed.

## \|\| 95.47 \|\|

*nānāvarṇā vaijayantyo mahārajanarañjitāḥ \|*  
*mañjiṣṭhā navaraṅgīyāḥ śvetapāṭalikāśritāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Не installed white and red flags dyed with Kusumbha Manjistha and several type flags having nine colours in the temple of Visnu.

## \|\| 95.48 \|\|

*ārāmā vividhā hṛdyāḥ puṣpāḍhyāḥ phalaśālinaḥ \|*  
*latāpallavasaṃchannā devadārubhirāvṛtāḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. He developed an orchard by planting flower plants, creepers, Kedara etc. several trees.

## \|\| 95.49 \|\|

*kāritāśca mahāmañcādhiṣṭhitāḥ kuśalairjanaiḥ \|*  
*paurogavavidhānajñai ratnasaṃskāribhirddaḍhai \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. He engaged the people expert in processing gems and kitchen designing in construction and constructed huge pavilions there.

## \|\| 95.50 \|\|

*teṣu nityaṃ prapūjyante yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ \|*  
*śrotriyā jñānasampannā dīnāndhavikalādayaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Ascetics, celibates, srotriyas duly learned, poor, blinds and handicapped people were honoured daily in those places.

## \|\| 95.51 \|\|

*itthaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ kṛtvā śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*jyāmagho viṣṇunilayaṃ gata ityanuśuśrumaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. We people heard that the king Jyamagha went to the abode of Visnu as a result of executing these deeds. He was having keen obeisance and balanced disposition.

## \|\| 95.52 \|\|

*tameva cāgyāpi bale mārgaṃ jyāmaghakāritam \|*  
*vrajanti naraśārdūla viṣṇulokajigīṣavaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О Bali! The people Wishing to go at the abode of Visnu still follow the route shown by Jyamadha.

## \|\| 95.53 \|\|

*tasmāt tvamapi rājendra kārayasvālayaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*tamarcayasva yatnena brāhmaṇāṃśca bahuśrutān \|*  
*paurāṇikān viśeṣeṇa sadācāraratāñśucīn \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Hence О king! Construct a temple of Hari and worship that Hari, learned Brahmins and particularly the persons known to Puranas and who live tidy with courteous behaviour.

## \|\| 95.54 \|\|

*vāsobhirbhūṣaṇai ratnairgaubhirbhūkanakādibhiḥ \|*  
*vibhave sati devasya prīṇanaṃ kuru cakriṇaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Do efforts to please god holding cakra, by giving garments, ornaments, gems, cows, earth and gold etc. till prosperity vests with you.

## \|\| 95.55 \|\|

*evaṃ kriyāyogaratasya te 'dya nūnaṃ murāriḥ śubhado bhaviṣyati \|*  
*narā na sīdanti bale samāśritā vibhuṃ jagannāthamanantamacyutam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Murari shall definitely do your good if you could engage yourself in the activities as described herein before. О Bali! The people sheltering to Jagannatha, Acyuta, sovereign, Ananta seldom suffer pains during the course of their life.

## \|\| 95.56 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ ditīśvaro vairocanaṃ satyamanuttamaṃ hi \|*  
*saṃpūjitastena vimuktimāyayau saṃpūrṇakāmo haripādabhaktaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Pulastya said- Having heard the true and best advice from his grandfather (Prahlada), Bali honoured him and Prahlada, the eminent scholar then left that place.

## \|\| 95.57 \|\|

*gate hi tasmin mudite pitāmahe balerbabhau mandiraminduvarṇam \|*  
*mahendraśilpipravaro 'tha keśavaṃ sa kārayāmāsa mahāmahīyān \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. On return of Prahlada in happy disposition, the palace of Bali began luminating like the moon. That great king Bali called Disvakarma and engaged him for the construction of Kesava's temple. It was soon built by him.

## \|\| 95.58 \|\|

*svayaṃ svabhāryāsahitaścakāra devālaye mārjanalepanādikāḥ \|*  
*kriyā mahātmā yavaśarkarādyāṃ baliṃ cakārāpratimāṃ madhudruhaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Bali with his queen began brooming, smearing the temple area himself. He offered the best Naivedya (offering of food for an idol) of barley and sugar mixed to Madhusudana.

## \|\| 95.59 \|\|

*dīpapradānaṃ svayamāyatākṣī vindhyāvalī viṣṇugṛhe cakāra \|*  
*geyaṃ sa dharmyaśravaṇaṃ ca dhīmān paurāṇikairvipravarairakārayat \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He rage eyed Vindhyavali began lighting lamp at that temple of Visnu herself. Wise Bali used to arrange lectures of learned Brahmins on Puranas in that temple.

## \|\| 95.60 \|\|

*tathāvidhasyāsurapuṅgavasya dharmye sumārge pratisaṃsthitasya \|*  
*jagatpatirdivyavapurjanārdanastasthau mahātmā balirakṣaṇāya \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Mahatma Janardana, the ruler of universe, holder of divine body stood there to defend Bali the religion abiding king.

## \|\| 95.61 \|\|

*sūryāyutābhaṃ musalaṃ pragṛhya nighnan sa duṣṭāriyūthāpālān \|*  
*dvāri sthito na pradadau praveśaṃ prākāragupte balino gṛhe tu \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. He used to destroy the commanders of enemy's army by blowing musala having radiation of countless suns at the gate and never allow anyone to enter in the palace duly protected by domes.

## \|\| 95.62 \|\|

*dvāri sthite dhātari rakṣapāle nārāyaṇe sarvaguṇābhirāme \|*  
*prāsādamadhye harimīśitāramabhyarcayāmāsa surarṣimukhyam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. When Narayana, the Vidhata resumed his service as gatekeeper, Bali began worshipping the best controller Hari just at the centre of his palace.

## \|\| 95.63 \|\|

*sa evamāste 'surarāḍ balistu samarcayan vai haripādapaṅkajau \|*  
*sasmāra nityaṃ haribhaṣitāni sa tasya jāto vinayāṅkuśastu \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The demon king Bali used to worship the lotus feet of Hari and keep in memory the psalm of Hari always. This rule (routine) became mandatory (Vinayankusa) to him.

## \|\| 95.64 \|\|

*idaṃ ca vṛttaṃ sa papāṭha daityarāṭ smaran suvākyāni guroḥ śubhāni \|*  
*tathyāni pathyāni paratra ceha pitāmahasyendrasamasya vīraḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. That chivalrous demon king used to recite this episode by keeping in mind the benevolent statements of his Indra like grandfather (Prahlada). Those statements were not only benevolent to this material world but also for the metaphysical world.

## \|\| 95.65 \|\|

*ye vṛddhavākyāni samācaranti śrutvā duruktānyapi pūrvatastu \|*  
*snigdhāni paścānnavanītaśuddhā modanti te nātra vicāramasti \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The persons who follow in practice the advice first delivered in harsh words but thereafter tender as butter by the elders, definitely attain pleasure.

## \|\| 95.66 \|\|

*āpadbhujaṅgadaṣṭasya mantrahīnasya sarvadā \|*  
*vṛddhavākyaiṣadhā nūnaṃ kurvanti kila nirviṣam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The medicine in the form of advice from elders undoubtedly removes the poison inserted in a man bitten by the serpent of calamity particularly when he is thoughtless.

## \|\| 95.67 \|\|

*vṛddhavākyāmṛtaṃ pītvā taduktamanumānya ca \|*  
*yā tṛptirjāyate puṃsā somapāne kutastathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The satiation felt to the people after sipping the words nectar like of elders and brining to practice accordingly cannot anyway is felt by sipping Soma.

## \|\| 95.68 \|\|

*āpattau patitānāṃ yeṣāṃ vṛddhā na santi śāstāraḥ \|*  
*te śocyā banadhūnāṃ jīvanto 'pīha mṛtatulyāḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The elders who do not administer the people trapped in calamity are scar like to their relations and they are dead in spite of living.

## \|\| 95.69 \|\|

*āpadgrāhagṛhītānāṃ vṛddhāḥ santi na paṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*yeṣāṃ mokṣyitāre vai teṣāṃ sāntirna vidyate \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The people having lack of learned elders capable to defend from calamity by their apt advice, cannot avail peace in life and always they are gripped by crocodiles of calamity.

## \|\| 95.70 \|\|

*āpajjalanimagnānāṃ hriyatāṃ vyasanormibhiḥ \|*  
*vṛddhavākyairvinā nūnaṃ naivottāraṃ kathañcana \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Besides the elder advice, there is no other measure capable to defend the people immersed in water of calamity and fell prey to the waves of bad habits (vyasana).

## \|\| 95.71 \|\|

*tasmād yo vṛddhavākyāni śṛṇuyād vidadhāti ca \|*  
*sa sadyaḥ siddhimāpnoti yathā vairocano baliḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Hence, the man hearing to the elders advice and who brings in practice, attains success shortly like Bali, the son of Virocana.

## Chapter 96. Phala-sruti or mention of rewards of Vamana Purana

## \|\| 96.1 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*etanmayā puṇyatamaṃ purāṇaṃ tubhyaṃ tathā nārada kīrtitaṃ vai \|*  
*śrutvā ca kīrtyā parayā sameto bhaktyā ca viṣṇoḥ padamabhyupaiti \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Pulastya said- О Narada! I have thus, completely described this most sacrosanct Purana. The man listening to it, goes to the abode of Visnu after acquiring sheer devotion and supreme fame.

## \|\| 96.2 \|\|

*yathā pāpāni pūyante gaṅgāvārivigāhanāt \|*  
*tathā purāṇaśravaṇād duritānāṃ vināśanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. As all sins are washed by taking a dip in water of Ganges, they were listening to Purana all evils stuck to man are absolved.

## \|\| 96.3 \|\|

*na tasya rogā jāyante na viṣaṃ cābhicārikam \|*  
*śarīre ca kule brahman yaḥ śruṇoti ca vāmanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О Brahmin! The man listening to this Purana with keen devotion his body and family remain unaffected of the poison generally inserted as a result of involvement in worldly deeds and his family enjoys healthy living.

## \|\| 96.4-5 \|\|

*śraṇoti nityaṃ vidhivacca bhaktyā saṃpūjayan yaḥ praṇataśca viṣṇum \|*  
*sa cāśvamedhasya sadakṣiṇasya phalaṃ samagraṃ parihinapāpaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prāpnoti dattasya suvarṇabhūmeraśvasya gonāgarathasya caiva nārī naraścāpi ca pādamekaṃ śṛṇvan śuciḥ puṇyatamaḥ pṛthivyām \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The man who worships god Visnu by observing sattva tendency and listens this Purana daily with devotion, becomes free from bondage of evils and receives blessing as it would have on performing Asvamedha yajna with appropriate donation and when gold, land, horse, cow, elephant and chariot are donated. The man and woman duly digested to only chapter to this Purana, become free from the clutches of evils and start executing noble deeds in his/her very life.

## \|\| 96.6-7 \|\|

*snāne kṛte tīrthavare supuṇye gaṅgājale naimiṣapuṣkare vā \|*  
*kokāmukhe yat pravadanti viprāḥ prayāgamāsādya ca māghamāse \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sa tatphalaṃ prāpya ca vāmanasya saṃkīrtayan nānyamanāḥ padaṃ hi \|*  
*gacchenmayā nārada te 'dya coktaṃ yad rājasūyasya phalaṃ prayacchet \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The person reciting a single hymn while walking but with mind exclusively devoted to god, receives the blessing as it would have on a bath with water of holy place, water of Ganges, Naimisaranya, Puskara, Kokamukha and Prayaga in the month of Magha (January). О Narada! I have explained the Purana which blesses with the fruit of Rajasuya yajna.

## \|\| 96.8 \|\|

*yad bhūmiloke suralokalabhye mahatsukhaṃ prāpya naraḥ samagram \|*  
*prāpanoti cāsya śravaṇānmaharṣe sautrāmaṇernāsti ca saṃśayo me \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О hermit! There is no doubt anyway to my mind regarding magnificence of listening to this Purana. It really gives all great pleasures available oh this earth and heaven and thus, the devotee attains the fruit of Sautramani yajna.

## \|\| 96.9-10 \|\|

*ratnasya dānasya ca yatphalaṃ bhaved yatsūryasya cendorgrahaṇe ca rāhoḥ \|*  
*annasya dānena phalaṃ yathoktaṃ bubhukṣite vipravare ca sāgnike \|\| 9 \|\|*

*durbhikṣasaṃpīḍitaputrabhārye yāmī sadā poṣaṇatatpare ca \|*  
*devāgniviprarṣirate ca pitroḥ śuśruṣake bhrātari jyeṣṭhasāmne \|*  
*yattatphalaṃ saṃpravadanti devāḥ sa tat phalaṃ labhate cāsya pāṭhāt \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. A man reciting this Purana receives the blessing which would have received by him had he donated gems to gods, donations made on aegis of solar and moon eclipse, donation of food to hungry but the Brahmin being Agnihotra, donations made to the person engaged in maintenance of son, wife and siblings suffering from famine, donations made to a person engaged in service of Brahmins and fire and donations made by him to parent and elder brother.

## \|\| 96.11 \|\|

*caturdaśaṃ vāmanamāhuragryaṃ śrute ca yasyāghacayāśca nāśam \|*  
*prayānti nāstyatra ca saṃśayo me mahānti pāpānyapi nāradāśu \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О Narada! This Vamana Purana is the fourteenth Purana in the list of eighteen Puranas. There is no doubt to my mind being its competent to absolve shortly a number of evils committed earlier and the heinous offences too.

## \|\| 96.12 \|\|

*pāṭhāt saṃśravaṇād vipra śrāvaṇādapi kasyacit \|*  
*sarvapāpāni naśyanti vāmanasya sadā mude \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О sage! О Brahmin! A recital, hearing and explaining before others this Vamana Purana decays all sins committed by the people earlier.

## \|\| 96.13 \|\|

*idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tavoktaṃ na vācyametaddharibhaktivarjite \|*  
*dvijasya nindāratihinadakṣiṇe sahetuvākyāvṛtapāpasattve \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. I have explained this most cryptic and mysterious essence before you. It should not be disclosed before atheist, rival to Brahmins, brute, uncivilised and the people who plead otherwise than spiritual linkage.

## \|\| 96.14 \|\|

*namo namaḥ kāraṇa vāmanāya nityaṃ yo vadenniyataṃ dvijaḥ \|*  
*tasya viṣṇuḥ padaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti surapūjitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Visnu, the god adored by gods give the supreme position of liberty (emancipation) to dvija who recites regularly the hymn- "Namo Namah Karana Vamanaya."

## \|\| 96.15 \|\|

*vācakāya pradātavya gobhūsvarṇavibhūṣaṇam \|*  
*vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ kurvan śravaṇanāśakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The person reciting this Purana should be provided with cow, land and gold ornaments. One should not be miser in donation because such trend destroys the blessing of listening completely.

## \|\| 96.16 \|\|

*trisaṃdhyaṃ ca paṭhan śṛṇvan sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*asūyārahitaṃ vipra sarvasampatpradāyakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О Brahmin! All kinds of properties are achieved when this Purana is recited and listened in trio-sandhyas by observing the rules of purity in heart and mind. It absolves the man from all sins thereby progress and prosperity is assured.
